914	Carry selected preferences, favourites and traditions from previous trips into future journeys.
915	
916	Allow users to repeat, modify or avoid past experiences.
917	
918	### F48 — Neighborhood Respect Filter
919	
920	Where reliable guidance exists, favour responsible travel options.
921	
922	Avoid promoting fragile, restricted or environmentally sensitive places irresponsibly.
923	
924	### F49 — Decision Load Governor
925	
926	Create an intelligent interface that presents one obvious next action for the current journey stage.
927	
928	Implement quiet mode.
929	
930	Suppress unnecessary notifications while keeping all features accessible.
931	
932	---
933	
934	# 6. AI AND MACHINE LEARNING ARCHITECTURE
935	
936	AI must be a real, modular intelligence layer.
937	
938	Do not simply send every user request to one LLM and call the product AI-powered.
939	
940	Implement separate intelligence services.
941	
942	## A. Personal Preference Model
943	
944	Purpose: Understand individual travel preferences.
945	
946	Possible methods:
947	
948	- Feature vectors.
949	- Content embeddings.
950	- K-Means clustering.
951	- Hierarchical clustering.
952	- Hybrid recommendation.
953	
954	Inputs:
955	
956	- Explicit preferences.
957	- Saved activities.
958	- Consented feedback.
959	- Selected experiences.
960	
961	Outputs:
962	
963	- Editable Journey DNA.
964	- Interest rankings.
965	- Personalised recommendations.
966	
967	## B. Destination Recommender
968	
969	Use content-based filtering and cosine similarity.
970	
971	Consider:
972	
973	- Activity tags.
974	- User interests.
975	- Budget.
976	- Duration.
977	- Location.
978	- Travel pace.
979	
980	Add collaborative signals only when sufficient reliable interaction data exists.
981	
982	## C. Group Recommendation Model
983	
984	Use multi-objective optimisation and fairness-aware ranking.
985	
986	Implement all three Group Experience Engine modes.
987	
988	Compare its performance with majority-vote and equal-weight baselines.
989	
990	## D. Journey Optimiser
991	
992	Use OR-Tools or a suitable optimisation algorithm.
993	
994	Consider:
995	
996	- Travel times.
997	- Time windows.
998	- Opening hours.
999	- Budget.
1000	- Fixed commitments.
1001	- Rest periods.
1002	- Activity duration.
1003	- Accessibility requirements.
1004	
1005	Return feasible schedules and alternatives.
1006	
1007	## E. Traveller Matching
1008	
1009	Use eligibility filtering, KNN or cosine similarity where appropriate.
1010	
1011	Matching must be opt-in and explainable.
1012	
1013	## F. Place Intelligence
1014	
1015	Use NLP classification, duplicate detection, time-decay functions, confidence estimation and anomaly detection.
1016	
1017	Do not overstate confidence.
1018	
1019	## G. Memory Intelligence
1020	
1021	Use computer vision, image embeddings, OCR, speech recognition and NLP.
1022	
1023	Organise permitted media into suggested events.
1024	
1025	## H. Conversational AI
1026	
1027	Use a grounded LLM with structured tool calls and retrieval.
1028	
1029	The LLM must retrieve actual application data before answering factual questions.
1030	
1031	It must never invent:
1032	
1033	- Opening hours.
1034	- Ticket prices.
1035	- Crowd levels.
1036	- Travel times.
1037	- Closures.
1038	- Accessibility.
1039	- Availability.
1040	
1041	## Model development requirements
1042	
1043	For every ML subsystem:
1044	
1045	1. Identify the input data.
1046	2. Identify the target output.
1047	3. Select an appropriate algorithm.
1048	4. Prepare the dataset.
1049	5. Preprocess the data.
1050	6. Train where suitable.
1051	7. Evaluate.
1052	8. Record metrics.
1053	9. Document limitations.
1054	10. Provide a fallback.
1055	
1056	Use public or appropriately licensed datasets where necessary.
1057	
1058	Do not fabricate training results or accuracy scores.
1059	
1060	If there is insufficient real-world training data, use a transparent rule-based baseline and synthetic test data for development. Clearly distinguish synthetic testing from real model validation.
1061

1349	# 12. DATA TRUST AND INFORMATION FRESHNESS
1350	
1351	Every important travel-related information item must have provenance.
1352	
1353	Use the following classifications:
1354	
1355	- VERIFIED: Supported by an appropriate authoritative source.
1356	- REPORTED: Submitted by a traveller or contributor.
1357	- ESTIMATED: Calculated or inferred using available information.
1358	- PREDICTED: Generated using a validated predictive model.
1359	- UNKNOWN: Reliable information is unavailable.
1360	
1361	Display timestamps where appropriate.
1362	
1363	Implement freshness scoring.
1364	
1365	Old community reports must lose influence.
1366	
1367	Never present a community observation as an official fact.
1368	
1369	When APIs fail, show the last known information and indicate that it may be outdated.

- Engine hard constraints: budget_max (activity cost), accessibility requirements (activity.is_wheelchair_accessible), time availability, radius/distance (compute haversine from trip base location or pulse location), energy level vs effort.
- Modes:
  - everyone_wins: maximize average pref fit + fairness (min satisfaction) - penalties.
  - your_turn: identify members with lowest cumulative satisfaction (based on confirmed items + votes) and weight their preferences up; select items that improve their fit while not tanking others below threshold.
  - surprise_us: prefer low-popularity/novelty items (novelty = inverse of group familiarity/iconic score), still fitting constraints.
- Explanations: per member fit, rationale bullets, cost, distance, travel time, duration, constraints, data freshness, uncertainties, alternatives.
- Metrics: avg_satisfaction, min_satisfaction, fairness_gini.
- Twin: compare two candidate plan compositions (optimizer) — endpoint that takes selected activity ids or auto-generates two variants and returns diffs.
- Rescue: given disruption (rain/closure/fatigue/traffic/budget/time) and date, find affected items (outdoor when rain, specific item closed, etc.) and propose replacements meeting constraints, requires approval -> proposal record.
- Expenses: splits equal/custom/shares, balances, settlements (greedy), export CSV.
- Place Pulse: reports with category, status, observed_at, source_type, confidence; freshness decay score = exp(-age_days/half_life); aggregate.

Please slow down.\"},\n            )\n        window.append(now)\n        return await call_next(request)\n"

Write session.py:

```python
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, event
from sqlalchemy.orm import DeclarativeBase, sessionmaker
from .config import settings

class Base(DeclarativeBase): pass

connect_args = {"check_same_thread": False} if settings.database_url.startswith("sqlite") else {}
engine = create_engine(settings.database_url, connect_args=connect_args, pool_pre_ping=True)

if settings.database_url.startswith("sqlite"):
    @event.listens_for(engine, "connect")
    def _fk(dbapi_conn, _): dbapi_conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON")

SessionLocal = sessionmaker(bind=engine, autocommit=False, autoflush=False, expire_on_commit=False)
```

expire_on_commit=False simplifies returning objects after commit.

Create tables in main startup via Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine). For tests, override DATABASE_URL before import? conftest sets env DATABASE_URL to temp file then imports app. Since config reads env at import, conftest must set env first. Use `os.environ.setdefault("DATABASE_URL", ...)` at top of conftest before importing app. Fine.

#### Thinking

Now schemas. I'll create a single schemas file with Pydantic models. Need to be careful with Pydantic v2 and EmailStr. Inputs:

Auth:
- RegisterIn: email EmailStr, password str min_length 8, display_name str 2-80
- LoginIn: email, password
- TokenOut: access_token, token_type="bearer", user dict? Use UserOut.
- UserOut: id, email, display_name, is_admin, quiet_mode, locale, created_at.
- ProfileIn: headline, bio, home_city, travel_pace Literal, budget_level Literal, budget_limit, interests list[str], accessibility_needs list[str], dietary, languages, public_profile, allow_discovery, location_sharing — all optional for patch; use separate ProfileUpdate with optional fields and `model_dump(exclude_unset=True)`.
- ConsentIn: kinds dict[str,bool] maybe list. Use `consents: dict[str, bool]`.
- DNAIn: scores dict[str, int] (0-10)
- FeedbackIn: sentiment Literal, consented bool.

Trips:
- TripCreate: name, description, destination_id optional, destination_name optional, start_date, end_date, group_size 2-12, budget_total optional, currency, privacy Literal["private"] maybe only private supported; allow "private".
  Validate end >= start; do in endpoint.
- TripUpdate: optional fields.
- InviteCreate: email optional, role Literal["member","admin"], scope Literal["full","vote","pulse","view"], expires_in_days int default 7.
- InviteJoin: token (or path).
- MemberUpdate: role, budget_limit, accessibility_needs (self only).
- MemberOut built as dict.

Itinerary:
- ItemIn: day date, start_time str pattern HH:MM, title, activity_id optional, notes, cost_estimate, is_protected; auto-fill from activity if activity_id given.
- ItemUpdate optional.
- ProposalIn: kind, title, summary, payload dict, target_day optional. For add activity helper: ProposalActivityIn: activity_id, day, start_time, title, notes.
- VoteIn: value Literal["yes","no","abstain"], comment optional.
- ApprovalIn: approval bool true.
- DecisionIn? Approve requires no body; reject reason optional via query/body.
- AttendanceIn: status Literal["in","out","join_later"].

PulseIn: energy 1-5, interests list, available_minutes optional 15-1440, budget_comfort 1-5, radius_km optional, activity_prefs, note.

Engine:
- RecommendIn: mode Literal["everyone_wins","your_turn","surprise_us"], for_date optional date, limit int 1-12 default 6, include_rain bool? maybe.
- Feedback sentiment literal: loved, okay, not_for_me, too_expensive, too_far, would_return.
- ApproveRecommendationIn: day, start_time.

Twin:
- CompareIn: activity_ids list[str] max 12, day optional.
Rescue:
- RescueIn: kind Literal["rain","closure","traffic","closure","fatigue","budget","time"], item_id optional, extra_minutes int default 45, note optional.
Expenses:
- ParticipantIn: user_id optional, guest_name optional, weight optional, share_amount optional.

import Session\n\nfrom app.core.security import decode_access_token\nfrom app.db.session import SessionLocal\nfrom app.models import Trip, TripMember, User\n\nbearer = HTTPBearer(auto_error=False)\n\n\ndef get_db():\n    db = SessionLocal()\n    try:\n        yield db\n    finally:\n        db.close()\n\n\ndef _user_from_token(token: str, db: Session) -> User:\n    payload = decode_access_token(token)\n    if not payload or not payload.get(\"sub\"):\n        raise HTTPException(\n            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,\n            detail=\"Invalid or expired session\",\n            headers={\"WWW-Authenticate\": \"Bearer\"},\n        )\n    user = db.get(User, payload[\"sub\"])\n    if not user or not user.is_active or user.deleted_at:\n        raise HTTPException(\n            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, detail=\"Account unavailable\"\n        )\n    return user\n\n\ndef get_current_user(\n    credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials | None = Depends(bearer),\n    db: Session = Depends(get_db),\n) -> User:\n    if credentials is None:\n        raise HTTPException(\n            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,\n            detail=\"Authentication required\",\n            headers={\"WWW-Authenticate\": \"Bearer\"},\n        )\n    return _user_from_token(credentials.credentials, db)\n\n\ndef get_optional_user(\n    credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials | None = Depends(bearer),\n    db: Session = Depends(get_db),\n) -> User | None:\n    if credentials is None:\n        return None\n    try:\n        return _user_from_token(credentials.credentials, db)\n    except HTTPException:\n        return None\n\n\ndef require_admin(user: User = Depends(get_current_user)) -> User:\n    if not user.is_admin:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=\"Administrator access required\")\n    return user\n\n\ndef get_trip_and_member(\n    trip_id: str,\n    db: Session,\n    user: User,\n    roles: set[str] | None = None,\n) -> tuple[Trip, TripMember]:\n    trip = db.get(Trip, trip_id)\n    if not trip or trip.deleted_at:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"Trip not found\")\n    member = (\n        db.query(TripMember)\n        .filter(\n            TripMember.trip_id == trip_id,\n            TripMember.user_id == user.id,\n            TripMember.status == \"active\",\n        )\n        .first()\n    )\n    if not member:\n        # Deliberately 404 rather than 403 so private trip existence is not leaked.\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"Trip not found\")\n    if roles and member.role not in roles:\n        raise HTTPException(\n            status_code=403, detail=\"Your trip role does not allow this action\"\n        )\n    return trip, member\n\n\ndef trip_dependency(roles: set[str] | None = None) -> Callable:\n    \"\"\"Build a FastAPI dependency that resolves trip + membership.\"\"\"\n\n    def dependency(\n        trip_id: str,\n        db: Session = Depends(get_db),\n        user: User = Depends(get_current_user),\n    ) -> tuple[Trip, TripMember]:\n        return get_trip_and_member(trip_id, db, user, roles)\n\n    return dependency\n"

The UI labels this as an estimate.\n    \"\"\"\n    if distance_km <= 0:\n        return 0\n    speed = 25.0 if distance_km <= 10 else 45.0\n    return int(round((distance_km / speed) * 60 + 6))\n\n\ndef day_minutes(hhmm: str) -> int:\n    try:\n        hours, minutes = hhmm.split(\":\")\n        return int(hours) * 60 + int(minutes)\n    except (ValueError, AttributeError):\n        return 9 * 60\n\n\ndef minutes_to_hhmm(total: int) -> str:\n    total = total % (24 * 60)\n    return f\"{total // 60:02d}:{total % 60:02d}\"\n"

Fragility:
For trip items sorted by day & start:
- for each item, duration from activity or 90.
- travel between places = haversine / travel.
- slack = next_start - (start + duration + travel)
- buffer status: comfortable >= 20, tight 0-20, risky <0.
- resilience score: percentage comfortable minus risky, scaled.
- alternatives: shift next start by max(0, -slack) or suggest more buffer.

Domino: given item_id + delay_min:
- cumulative delay propagates: for subsequent items, slip = delay + sum of negatives... Compute new_start = max(original_start, previous_end + travel). affected if new_start > original. Delay accumulation.
- minimum repairs: for affected items, propose either shorten activity by slip (if possible), or drop lowest-priority (not protected) item, or shift day. Provide "repair_options".
- unaffected list.
- dependencies: sequential by time.

Effort budget: for each confirmed item, effort from activity; walking estimate = distance between consecutive places * 1.25 (street distance) * 12 min/km? Show walking_km and heat exposure based on day? We don't have weather; label estimate. Sum effort points, rest blocks (protected wander), transfers. Hard accessibility requirements not traded.

Message intents:

- recommend: "recommend", "suggest", "what should", "things to do"
- vote: "vote", "proposal", "decision", "approve"
- members: "who", "members", "group"
- weather: "weather", "rain"
- hours/price for named activity: find activity by name in message; answer from record + evidence.
- privacy: "privacy", "share", "location"
- fallback.

For itinerary: get items from today or next day; list with times, titles, cost, data note. If none: say no confirmed items and suggest next action.

Budget: expenses.balances; show total and my net; do not expose other members' budgets. We can show balances for all members? It's trip-level finance, allowed. Show total + settlements. Fine.

Recommend: latest batch: query Recommendation join batch for trip order by batch.created_at desc; if none → tell to run Group Experience Engine; else list top 3 with explanation summary + link.

Votes: open proposals count/titles.

Members: count + names + roles. Fine (trip members visible to members).

Weather: no provider configured → unknown; don't invent; advise official weather service. Trip Rescue can handle rain when known. Include limitation.

Named activity: find activity name in message; retrieve activity, opening hours, price, provenance, reports aggregate; answer with source labels. If question about "accessible" → access_chain/evidence.

Citations: dict label, type, id.

`suggested_actions`: link paths e.g. {label, href}.

Multilingual: detect non-ASCII; if non-Latin, `language_note`. For English/Spanish/etc Latin, we can't detect reliably. Keep note only for non-Latin scripts.

Return `generated_by: "safar-grounded-retrieval-1.0"`, `ai_note` "Deterministic grounded answer. No external LLM is configured; SAFAR only states what is in your trip data."

- POST /invitations/{token}/accept

- capsules: POST /trips/{id}/capsules, GET latest

#### Thinking

Issues to check in itinerary.py:
- Unused imports: build_member_contexts, TripPulse, day_minutes, ItemUpdate used, ApprovalIn used. `Destination` used. Fine.
- Proposal `payload` merge: `{... **payload.payload}` could override activity_id/day etc. User could inject. Not a security issue but inconsistency: payload.payload overrides computed keys. For add_activity we pass activity_id from schema; then payload.payload (default {}) may override with arbitrary. _build uses payload.get("activity_id"). If user passes payload={"activity_id": "other"} it's their proposal anyway. Fine.
- `approve` creates new items then commits; `_serialize_items(db, created_items)` called after commit with expire_on_commit=False, fine. But created items have ids after flush at commit. Good.
- `record_itinerary_version` increments version and snapshots confirmed items. Because new items are added in session before commit but record_itinerary_version queries DB — autoflush is off (autoflush=False). The query won't see uncommitted new items unless flushed! On add_item we call db.flush() before version, good. In approve, we don't flush before record_itinerary_version, so snapshot may miss new items (and cancelled status updates). Need db.flush() before record. Add.
- `add_item` item created; record version with flush done. Good.
- `update_item` modifies item but record version queries DB with autoflush off; changes not flushed. Need db.flush() before record. Similarly delete. Add flush.
- Vote upsert: `proposal_out` counts votes after db.commit — vote persisted. fine.
- `_proposal_impact` in create uses proposal.flush; query versions? It calls _build which may query items; fine.
- If `_proposal_impact` raises HTTPException, `db.rollback()` then re-raise. Good.
- In approve, do we require votes? Not strictly; admin can approve. UI shows votes. Fine.
- `notify_trip_members` for proposal create uses title only.
- `twin_adopt` cancellation uses cancel_op which appends cost negative; then adds. Good.
- `_build_proposal_operations` add_activity calls `date.fromisoformat(str(day_value))` if day_value is date works; if day_value None raises 422. Good.
- `ProposalCreate.kind` doesn't include twin_adopt/rescue — those proposals are created by engine/rescue routers directly, not through this endpoint. Fine.
- `_within_trip` for proposals of days outside trip returns 422.
- `update_attendance` allows any member to change own status. Good.
- Missing `db.flush()` in several version recordings. Fix.
- In approve, `operations` include adds and cancels; cancel item status change needs flush before version snapshot. Add flush.
- `get_itinerary` totals cost includes cancelled? filters confirmed. Good.
- `_serialize_items` attendance query uses item ids; fine.
- Proposal response `impact` includes dates as date objects, encoded.

Also unused import `TripPulse`, `build_member_contexts`; remove for cleanliness (not errors). `day_minutes` unused. `ItemUpdate` used. Remove those three.

112	        scores["budget"] = 3.0
113	    elif profile.budget_level == "comfort":
114	        scores["luxury"] = 7.0
115	    return scores

118	def build_member_contexts(
119	    db: Session, trip: Trip, members: list[TripMember], for_date: date
120	) -> list[MemberContext]:
121	    contexts: list[MemberContext] = []
122	    for index, member in enumerate(
123	        sorted(members, key=lambda m: m.joined_at or datetime.min), start=1
124	    ):
125	        user = db.get(User, member.user_id) if member.user_id else None
126	        profile = (
127	            db.query(Profile).filter(Profile.user_id == member.user_id).first()
128	            if member.user_id
129	            else None
130	        )
131	        dna_row = (
132	            db.query(JourneyDNA).filter(JourneyDNA.user_id == member.user_id).first()
133	            if member.user_id
134	            else None
135	        )
136	        if dna_row and dna_row.scores:
137	            dna = {
138	                dim: float(dna_row.scores.get(dim, 5)) for dim in DNA_DIMENSIONS
139	            }
140	        else:
141	            dna = _dna_from_profile(profile)
142	        pulse = (
143	            db.query(TripPulse)
144	            .filter(
145	                TripPulse.trip_id == trip.id,
146	                TripPulse.user_id == member.user_id,
147	                TripPulse.pulse_date == for_date,
148	            )
149	            .first()
150	            if member.user_id
151	            else None
152	        )
153	        accessibility = list(member.accessibility_needs or [])
154	        if not accessibility and profile:
155	            accessibility = list(profile.accessibility_needs or [])
156	        contexts.append(
157	            MemberContext(
158	                member_id=member.id,
159	                user_id=member.user_id,
160	                label=f"Member {index}",
161	                display_name=(
162	                    user.display_name if user else (member.display_name or f"Member {index}")
163	                ),
164	                dna=dna,
165	                budget_limit=member.budget_limit
166	                or (profile.budget_limit if profile else None),
167	                accessibility=accessibility,
168	                energy=pulse.energy if pulse else 3,
169	                available_minutes=pulse.available_minutes if pulse else None,
170	                budget_comfort=pulse.budget_comfort if pulse else 3,
171	                radius_km=pulse.radius_km if pulse else None,
172	                pulse=pulse,
173	            )
174	        )
175	    return contexts

178	def _activity_vector(activity: Activity) -> dict[str, float]:
179	    vector: dict[str, float] = {}
180	    for tag in activity.tags or []:
181	        key = normalize_tag(tag)
182	        vector[key] = vector.get(key, 0.0) + 1.0
183	    return vector
184	
185	
186	def _cosine(a: dict[str, float], b: dict[str, float]) -> float:
187	    if not a or not b:
188	        return 0.0
189	    dot = sum(value * b.get(key, 0.0) for key, value in a.items())
190	    norm_a = sqrt(sum(value * value for value in a.values()))
191	    norm_b = sqrt(sum(value * value for value in b.values()))
192	    if norm_a == 0 or norm_b == 0:
193	        return 0.0
194	    return dot / (norm_a * norm_b)
195	
196	
197	def _member_dna_for_today(ctx: MemberContext) -> dict[str, float]:
198	    dna = dict(ctx.dna)
199	    if ctx.pulse:
200	        for interest in list(ctx.pulse.interests or []) + list(ctx.pulse.activity_prefs or []):
201	            key = normalize_tag(interest)
202	            if key in dna:
203	                # Today's mood boosts a dimension without mutating Journey DNA (F06).
204	                dna[key] = max(dna[key], 8.5)
205	    if ctx.pulse and ctx.pulse.energy <= 2:
206	        dna["relaxation"] = max(dna.get("relaxation", 5), 7.5)
207	        dna["adventure"] = min(dna.get("adventure", 5), 3)
208	    return dna

211	def rank_activity(
212	    activity: Activity,
213	    contexts: list[MemberContext],
214	    *,
215	    base_lat: float,
216	    base_lon: float,
217	    coords: tuple[float, float],
218	    target_member_index: int | None,
219	    mode: str,
220	) -> RankedActivity | None:
221	    if not contexts:
222	        return None
223	    lat, lon = coords
224	    distance = haversine_km(base_lat, base_lon, lat, lon) if (lat or lon) else 0.0
225	    travel = travel_minutes(distance)
226	    round_trip = travel * 2
227	    vector = _activity_vector(activity)
228	    exclusions: dict[str, str] = {}
229	    fits: list[float] = []
230	
231	    for ctx in contexts:
232	        needed_time = activity.duration_minutes + round_trip
233	        hard_budget = ctx.hard_budget
234	        if hard_budget is not None and activity.price_estimate > hard_budget:
235	            exclusions[ctx.label] = "budget"
236	            continue
237	        if ctx.radius_km is not None and distance > ctx.radius_km:
238	            exclusions[ctx.label] = "radius"
239	            continue
240	        if ctx.available_minutes is not None and needed_time > ctx.available_minutes:
241	            exclusions[ctx.label] = "time"
242	            continue
243	        if ctx.needs_wheelchair_access and activity.wheelchair_accessible is False:
244	            exclusions[ctx.label] = "accessibility"
245	            continue
246	
247	        interest = 0.2 + 0.8 * _cosine(vector, _member_dna_for_today(ctx))
248	        if hard_budget:
249	            budget_fit = clamp(1 - (activity.price_estimate / hard_budget), 0, 1)
250	        else:
251	            budget_fit = clamp(1 - activity.price_estimate / 150, 0, 1)
252	        energy_fit = clamp(1 - max(0, activity.effort - ctx.energy) / 4, 0, 1)
253	        if ctx.available_minutes:
254	            time_fit = clamp(1 - (needed_time / ctx.available_minutes) * 0.85, 0.1, 1)
255	        else:
256	            time_fit = clamp(1 - round_trip / 180, 0.2, 1)
257	        if not ctx.accessibility:
258	            access_fit = 1.0
259	        elif activity.wheelchair_accessible is True:
260	            access_fit = 1.0
261	        elif activity.wheelchair_accessible is None:
262	            access_fit = 0.45
263	        else:
264	            access_fit = 1.0  # non-wheelchair needs are not matched to a field yet
265	
266	        fit = 100 * (
267	            0.58 * interest
268	            + 0.16 * budget_fit
269	            + 0.10 * energy_fit
270	            + 0.10 * time_fit
271	            + 0.06 * access_fit
272	        )
273	        fits.append(round(fit, 1))
274	
275	    if exclusions:
276	        return None
277	
278	    average = sum(fits) / len(fits)
279	    minimum = min(fits)
280	    spread = max(fits) - minimum
281	    novelty = clamp(1 - activity.popularity, 0, 1)
282	
283	    uncertainty = 0.0
284	    if any(ctx.needs_wheelchair_access for ctx in contexts) and activity.wheelchair_accessible is None:
285	        uncertainty += 8.0
286	    if activity.source_type.startswith("seed"):
287	        uncertainty += 4.0
288	    if not activity.last_verified_at or (
289	        utcnow() - activity.last_verified_at
290	    ).days > 365:
291	        uncertainty += 3.0
292	
293	    time_penalty = clamp(round_trip / max(1, min(ctx.available_minutes or 240 for ctx in contexts)) * 10, 0, 12)
294	    avg_cap = sum(ctx.hard_budget or 150 for ctx in contexts) / len(contexts)
295	    budget_penalty = clamp(activity.price_estimate / max(1, avg_cap) * 6, 0, 8)
296	    penalties = {
297	        "time": round(time_penalty, 2),
298	        "budget": round(budget_penalty, 2),
299	        "uncertainty": round(uncertainty, 2),
300	        "total": round(time_penalty + budget_penalty + uncertainty, 2),
301	    }
302	
303	    novelty_points = novelty * 100
304	    if mode == "your_turn" and target_member_index is not None:
305	        target_fit = fits[target_member_index]
306	        score = (
307	            0.45 * average
308	            + 0.20 * minimum
309	            + 0.30 * target_fit
310	            + 0.05 * novelty_points
311	            - penalties["total"]
312	        )
313	    elif mode == "surprise_us":
314	        surprise_bonus = 6.0 if not activity.iconic else -3.0
315	        score = (
316	            0.45 * average
317	            + 0.20 * minimum
318	            + 0.35 * novelty_points
319	            + surprise_bonus
320	            - penalties["total"]
321	        )
322	    else:
323	        score = (
324	            0.55 * average
325	            + 0.30 * minimum
326	            + 0.15 * novelty_points
327	            - penalties["total"]
328	        )
329	
330	    return RankedActivity(
331	        activity=activity,
332	        score=round(clamp(score, 0, 100), 1),
333	        average_fit=round(average, 1),
334	        minimum_fit=round(minimum, 1),
335	        fairness_spread=round(spread, 1),
336	        novelty=round(novelty, 3),
337	        fits=fits,
338	        penalties=penalties,
339	        distance_km=distance,
340	        travel_minutes=travel,
341	        exclusions=exclusions,
342	        target_fit=(
343	            round(fits[target_member_index], 1)
344	            if target_member_index is not None and target_member_index < len(fits)
345	            else None
346	        ),
347	    )
348

350	def _representation_scores(
351	    db: Session,
352	    contexts: list[MemberContext],
353	    confirmed_items: list[ItineraryItem],
354	) -> list[float]:
355	    """Average personal interest fit of the confirmed plan per member."""
356	    if not confirmed_items:
357	        return [0.0 for _ in contexts]
358	    activity_ids = [item.activity_id for item in confirmed_items if item.activity_id]
359	    activities = (
360	        db.query(Activity).filter(Activity.id.in_(activity_ids)).all()
361	        if activity_ids
362	        else []
363	    )
364	    by_id = {activity.id: activity for activity in activities}
365	    vectors = {aid: _activity_vector(act) for aid, act in by_id.items()}
366	    scores: list[float] = []
367	    for ctx in contexts:
368	        dna = _member_dna_for_today(ctx)
369	        fits = [
370	            0.2 + 0.8 * _cosine(vectors[item.activity_id], dna)
371	            for item in confirmed_items
372	            if item.activity_id in vectors
373	        ]
374	        scores.append(sum(fits) / len(fits) if fits else 0.0)
375	    return scores

378	def _freshness(activity: Activity) -> dict:
379	    if activity.last_verified_at:
380	        age_days = max(0, (utcnow() - activity.last_verified_at).days)
381	        if age_days <= 30:
382	            label = "Fresh catalog entry"
383	        elif age_days <= 180:
384	            label = "Aging catalog entry"
385	        else:
386	            label = "Stale catalog entry — recheck before relying on it"
387	        return {
388	            "last_verified_at": activity.last_verified_at.isoformat(),
389	            "age_days": age_days,
390	            "label": label,
391	        }
392	    return {
393	        "last_verified_at": None,
394	        "age_days": None,
395	        "label": "No verification date on record",
396	    }

399	def _explanation(
400	    ranked: RankedActivity,
401	    contexts: list[MemberContext],
402	    mode: str,
403	    target: MemberContext | None,
404	) -> dict:
405	    activity = ranked.activity
406	    tags = [normalize_tag(tag) for tag in (activity.tags or [])][:5]
407	    tag_text = ", ".join(tags) if tags else "mixed interests"
408	
409	    why: list[str] = []
410	    if mode == "everyone_wins":
411	        why.append(
412	            f"Balances the group: average fit {ranked.average_fit:.0f}/100 with the least-served member at {ranked.minimum_fit:.0f}/100."
413	        )
414	    elif mode == "your_turn":
415	        why.append(
416	            "Gives extra weight to a member whose interests the confirmed plan represents least."
417	        )
418	        if ranked.target_fit is not None:
419	            why.append(f"Fit for that member is {ranked.target_fit:.0f}/100.")
420	    else:
421	        why.append(
422	            f"Unfamiliar but relevant: novelty {round(ranked.novelty * 100):.0f}/100 while every member stays above {ranked.minimum_fit:.0f}/100."
423	        )
424	    why.append(f"Matches group interests in {tag_text}.")
425	    if ranked.penalties["total"] > 0:
426	        why.append(
427	            f"Penalties applied for time, budget and uncertainty: {ranked.penalties['total']:.0f} points total."
428	        )
429	
430	    suits = [f"Members interested in {tag_text}"]
431	    if activity.indoor:
432	        suits.append("Members who prefer indoor experiences")
433	    if activity.effort <= 2:
434	        suits.append("Members looking for a lower-effort option")
435	    if activity.price_estimate <= 15:
436	        suits.append("Budget-conscious members")
437	
438	    may_not = []
439	    low_fits = [ctx for ctx, fit in zip(contexts, ranked.fits) if fit < 55]
440	    if low_fits:
441	        may_not.append("Members whose interests are not aligned with these tags")
442	    if activity.effort >= 4:
443	        may_not.append("Members with low energy today")
444	    if activity.price_estimate >= 60:
445	        may_not.append("Members near their budget comfort level")
446	    if not may_not:
447	        may_not.append("No strong mismatch identified for the current group")
448	
449	    constraints = [
450	        {
451	            "constraint": "Budget",
452	            "status": "satisfied",
453	            "detail": f"Estimated {activity.currency} {activity.price_estimate:.0f} per person is within every stated limit.",
454	        },
455	        {
456	            "constraint": "Accessibility",
457	            "status": (
458	                "satisfied"
459	                if not any(ctx.needs_wheelchair_access for ctx in contexts)
460	                else ("satisfied" if activity.wheelchair_accessible else "unknown")
461	            ),
462	            "detail": (
463	                "Step-free access confirmed in the catalog."
464	                if activity.wheelchair_accessible is True
465	                else (
466	                    "No accessibility requirement stated by members."
467	                    if not any(ctx.needs_wheelchair_access for ctx in contexts)
468	                    else "Accessibility is not confirmed for this place; treat as unknown."
469	                )
470	            ),
471	        },
472	        {
473	            "constraint": "Time",
474	            "status": "satisfied",
475	            "detail": f"{activity.duration_minutes} min activity plus ~{ranked.travel_minutes * 2} min round-trip travel fits today's availability.",
476	        },
477	        {
478	            "constraint": "Distance",
479	            "status": "satisfied",
480	            "detail": f"{ranked.distance_km:.1f} km from the trip base, inside every stated radius.",
481	        },
482	    ]
483	
484	    uncertainties = []
485	    if activity.source_type.startswith("seed"):
486	        uncertainties.append(
487	            "Catalog attributes are curated seed data, not live provider data."
488	        )
489	    if activity.wheelchair_accessible is None:
490	        uncertainties.append("Wheelchair accessibility is unknown, not verified.")
491	    if not activity.last_verified_at:
492	        uncertainties.append("No last-verified date is recorded for opening hours or price.")
493	    if not uncertainties:
494	        uncertainties.append("Travel time is an estimate; it is not a routed ETA.")
495	
496	    return {
497	        "summary": f"{activity.name} is a {mode.replace('_', ' ')} pick for the group.",
498	        "why_selected": why,
499	        "suits": suits,
500	        "may_not_prefer": may_not,
501	        "constraints_checked": constraints,
502	        "estimated_cost": activity.price_estimate,
503	        "currency": activity.currency,
504	        "distance_km": ranked.distance_km,
505	        "travel_minutes": ranked.travel_minutes,
506	        "duration_minutes": activity.duration_minutes,
507	        "data_freshness": _freshness(activity),
508	        "uncertainties": uncertainties,
509	        "metrics": {
510	            "average_fit": ranked.average_fit,
511	            "minimum_fit": ranked.minimum_fit,
512	            "fairness_spread": ranked.fairness_spread,
513	            "novelty": ranked.novelty,
514	            "score": ranked.score,
515	        },
516	        "member_fits_anonymous": ranked.fits,
517	        "target_member": target.label if target else None,
518	    }

521	def generate_recommendations(
522	    db: Session,
523	    trip: Trip,
524	    members: list[TripMember],
525	    *,
526	    mode: str,
527	    for_date: date,
528	    limit: int = 6,
529	) -> dict:
530	    if mode not in MODE_META:
531	        mode = "everyone_wins"
532	    contexts = build_member_contexts(db, trip, members, for_date)
533	    if not contexts:
534	        return {"items": [], "error": "No active members to personalise for."}
535	    if not trip.destination_id:
536	        return {
537	            "items": [],
538	            "error": "Set a destination for this trip before generating group recommendations.",
539	        }
540	
541	    activities = (
542	        db.query(Activity)
543	        .filter(Activity.destination_id == trip.destination_id)
544	        .order_by(Activity.name)
545	        .all()
546	    )
547	    place_cache: dict[str, Place | None] = {}
548	
549	    def coords_for(activity: Activity) -> tuple[float, float]:
550	        if activity.place_id not in place_cache:
551	            place_cache[activity.place_id] = (
552	                db.get(Place, activity.place_id) if activity.place_id else None
553	            )
554	        place = place_cache[activity.place_id]
555	        return (place.lat, place.lon) if place else (0.0, 0.0)
556	
557	    confirmed = (
558	        db.query(ItineraryItem)
559	        .filter(
560	            ItineraryItem.trip_id == trip.id,
561	            ItineraryItem.status == "confirmed",
562	        )
563	        .all()
564	    )
565	    planned_activity_ids = {item.activity_id for item in confirmed if item.activity_id}
566	
567	    target_index: int | None = None
568	    target_ctx: MemberContext | None = None
569	    if mode == "your_turn":
570	        representation = _representation_scores(db, contexts, confirmed)
571	        if any(score > 0 for score in representation):
572	            target_index = min(range(len(contexts)), key=lambda i: representation[i])
573	        target_ctx = contexts[target_index] if target_index is not None else None
574	
575	    ranked: list[RankedActivity] = []
576	    exclusion_reasons: dict[str, int] = {}
577	    seen: dict[str, int] = {}
578	    for activity in activities:
579	        if activity.id in planned_activity_ids:
580	            continue
581	        result = rank_activity(
582	            activity,
583	            contexts,
584	            base_lat=trip.base_lat,
585	            base_lon=trip.base_lon,
586	            coords=coords_for(activity),
587	            target_member_index=target_index,
588	            mode=mode,
589	        )
590	        if result is None:
591	            exclusion_reasons["hard_constraint"] = (
592	                exclusion_reasons.get("hard_constraint", 0) + 1
593	            )
594	            continue
595	        ranked.append(result)
596	
597	    if mode == "your_turn" and target_index is None and ranked:
598	        # No plan yet: target the member whose interests are hardest to serve.
599	        hardest = min(range(len(contexts)), key=lambda i: sum(r.fits[i] for r in ranked) / len(ranked))
600	        target_index = hardest
601	        target_ctx = contexts[hardest]
602	        for result in ranked:
603	            result.target_fit = result.fits[hardest]
604	            result.score = round(
605	                clamp(
606	                    0.45 * result.average_fit
607	                    + 0.20 * result.minimum_fit
608	                    + 0.30 * result.fits[hardest]
609	                    + 0.05 * result.novelty * 100
610	                    - result.penalties["total"],
611	                    0,
612	                    100,
613	                ),
614	                1,
615	            )
616	
617	    ranked.sort(key=lambda item: item.score, reverse=True)
618	    top = ranked[:limit]
619	    alternatives = ranked[limit : limit + 3]
620	
621	    for result in top:
622	        explanation = _explanation(result, contexts, mode, target_ctx)
623	        explanation["alternatives"] = [
624	            {
625	                "activity_id": alt.activity.id,
626	                "name": alt.activity.name,
627	                "score_delta": round(result.score - alt.score, 1),
628	            }
629	            for alt in alternatives
630	        ]
631	        result.explanation = explanation
632	
633	    top_scores = [item.score for item in top]
634	    close_call = len(top_scores) >= 2 and (top_scores[0] - top_scores[1]) < 4
635	    missing_pulse = [ctx for ctx in contexts if ctx.pulse is None]
636	    clarifying_question = None
637	    if close_call and missing_pulse:
638	        clarifying_question = (
639	            f"{len(missing_pulse)} of {len(contexts)} members haven't shared a Trip Pulse today. "
640	            "Knowing their available time and energy could change the top result."
641	        )
642	
643	    return {
644	        "mode": mode,
645	        "mode_meta": MODE_META[mode],
646	        "for_date": for_date,
647	        "items": top,
648	        "contexts": contexts,
649	        "target": target_ctx,
650	        "meta": {
651	            "model_version": ENGINE_VERSION,
652	            "candidate_count": len(activities),
653	            "eligible_count": len(ranked),
654	            "excluded_count": sum(exclusion_reasons.values()),
655	            "planned_excluded": len(planned_activity_ids),
656	            "members_count": len(contexts),
657	            "pulse_coverage": f"{len(contexts) - len(missing_pulse)}/{len(contexts)}",
658	            "hard_constraints": [
659	                "stated budget limits",
660	                "wheelchair accessibility requirements",
661	                "today's available time",
662	                "today's travel radius",
663	            ],
664	            "ranking_formula": (
665	                "mode-weighted average fit + minimum fit + novelty - time, budget and uncertainty penalties"
666	            ),
667	            "disclosure": (
668	                "Catalog attributes are curated seed data. Travel times are estimates. "
669	                "Private budgets and preferences are used for filtering but never exposed."
670	            ),
671	        },
672	        "exclusion_reasons": exclusion_reasons,
673	        "clarifying_question": clarifying_question,
674	        "all_ranked_ids": [item.activity.id for item in ranked],
675	    }

32	    for activity in activities:
33	        coords = _activity_coords(db, activity)
34	        distance = haversine_km(trip.base_lat, trip.base_lon, *coords) if coords != (0.0, 0.0) else 0.0
35	        leg = travel_minutes(distance)
36	        ranked = rank_activity(
37	            activity,
38	            contexts,
39	            base_lat=trip.base_lat,
40	            base_lon=trip.base_lon,
41	            coords=coords,
42	            target_member_index=None,
43	            mode="everyone_wins",
44	        )
45	        if ranked:
46	            for index, fit in enumerate(ranked.fits):
47	                fits[index].append(fit)
48	        total_cost += activity.price_estimate
49	        total_duration += activity.duration_minutes
50	        total_travel += leg
51	        details.append(
52	            {
53	                "activity_id": activity.id,
54	                "name": activity.name,
55	                "cost": activity.price_estimate,
56	                "duration": activity.duration_minutes,
57	                "distance_km": distance,
58	                "travel_minutes": leg,
59	                "eligible": ranked is not None,
60	            }
61	        )
62	    per_member = [sum(values) / len(values) for values in fits if values]
63	    return {
64	        "total_cost": round(total_cost, 2),
65	        "total_duration_minutes": total_duration,
66	        "total_travel_minutes": total_travel,
67	        "average_group_fit": round(sum(per_member) / len(per_member), 1) if per_member else None,
68	        "minimum_member_fit": round(min(per_member), 1) if per_member else None,
69	        "items": details,
70	    }

73	def compare_plan(
74	    db: Session,
75	    trip: Trip,
76	    contexts,
77	    items: list[ItineraryItem],
78	    candidate_ids: list[str],
79	    day: date | None = None,
80	) -> dict:
81	    from app.services.common import utcnow
82	
83	    day = day or date.today()
84	    confirmed_activities = []
85	    by_id = {}
86	    activity_ids = [item.activity_id for item in items if item.activity_id]
87	    if activity_ids:
88	        by_id = {a.id: a for a in db.query(Activity).filter(Activity.id.in_(activity_ids)).all()}
89	        for item in sorted(items, key=lambda i: (i.day, i.start_time)):
90	            if item.activity_id and item.activity_id in by_id:
91	                confirmed_activities.append(by_id[item.activity_id])
92	
93	    candidate_activities = (
94	        db.query(Activity).filter(Activity.id.in_(candidate_ids)).all()
95	        if candidate_ids
96	        else []
97	    )
98	    order = {activity_id: index for index, activity_id in enumerate(candidate_ids)}
99	    candidate_activities.sort(key=lambda activity: order.get(activity.id, 999))
100	
101	    current = _metrics_for_activities(db, trip, contexts, confirmed_activities)
102	    alternative = _metrics_for_activities(db, trip, contexts, candidate_activities)
103	
104	    current_ids = [activity.id for activity in confirmed_activities]
105	    alt_ids = [activity.id for activity in candidate_activities]
106	    removed = [
107	        {"activity_id": activity.id, "name": activity.name}
108	        for activity in confirmed_activities
109	        if activity.id not in alt_ids
110	    ]
111	    added = [
112	        {"activity_id": activity.id, "name": activity.name}
113	        for activity in candidate_activities
114	        if activity.id not in current_ids
115	    ]
116	    kept = [
117	        {"activity_id": activity.id, "name": activity.name}
118	        for activity in candidate_activities
119	        if activity.id in current_ids
120	    ]
121	
122	    tradeoffs = []
123	    if current["average_group_fit"] is not None and alternative["average_group_fit"] is not None:
124	        delta = alternative["average_group_fit"] - current["average_group_fit"]
125	        tradeoffs.append(
126	            f"Average group fit {'improves' if delta >= 0 else 'drops'} by {abs(delta):.1f} points."
127	        )
128	    if current["minimum_member_fit"] is not None and alternative["minimum_member_fit"] is not None:
129	        delta = alternative["minimum_member_fit"] - current["minimum_member_fit"]
130	        tradeoffs.append(
131	            f"The least-served member's fit {'improves' if delta >= 0 else 'drops'} by {abs(delta):.1f} points."
132	        )
133	    cost_delta = round(alternative["total_cost"] - current["total_cost"], 2)
134	    tradeoffs.append(
135	        f"Estimated cost {'rises' if cost_delta > 0 else 'falls'} by {abs(cost_delta):.2f}."
136	    )
137	    time_delta = alternative["total_duration_minutes"] - current["total_duration_minutes"]
138	    tradeoffs.append(
139	        f"Activity time {'increases' if time_delta > 0 else 'decreases'} by {abs(time_delta)} minutes."
140	    )
141	    if alternative["minimum_member_fit"] is not None and alternative["minimum_member_fit"] < 45:
142	        tradeoffs.append("Caution: at least one member is below 45/100 on this alternative.")
143	
144	    return {
145	        "day": day,
146	        "confirmed_plan": {"name": "Confirmed plan", **current},
147	        "alternative_plan": {"name": "Trip Twin alternative", **alternative},
148	        "diff": {"added": added, "removed": removed, "kept": kept},
149	        "trade_offs": tradeoffs,
150	        "requires_approval": True,
151	        "disclosure": (
152	            "This comparison is read-only. Adopting it creates a proposal; "
153	            "the confirmed itinerary is only changed after group approval."
154	        ),
155	        "generated_at": utcnow(),
156	    }

48	    if item_id:

50	        return [{"item": target, "reason": "The group flagged this item."}] if target else []

66	    elif kind == "closure":

86	def _replacement_filter(kind: str, original: Activity | None):
87	    def predicate(activity: Activity) -> bool:
88	        if kind == "rain" and not activity.indoor:
89	            return False
90	        if kind == "fatigue" and activity.effort > 2:
91	            return False
92	        if kind == "budget":
93	            if original and original.price_estimate > 0:
94	                return activity.price_estimate <= max(original.price_estimate * 0.75, 12)
95	            return activity.price_estimate <= 20
96	        if kind == "time" and original:
97	            return activity.duration_minutes <= max(30, original.duration_minutes)
98	        return True
99	
100	    return predicate

309	def compromise(
310	    db: Session,
311	    trip: Trip,
312	    members: list[TripMember],
313	    option_a: list[str],
314	    option_b: list[str],
315	) -> dict:
316	    """Build a fair-trade compromise from two competing options (F45)."""
317	
318	    by_id = {
319	        activity.id: activity
320	        for activity in db.query(Activity).filter(Activity.id.in_(set(option_a + option_b) or {""})).all()
321	    }
322	    a = [by_id[aid] for aid in option_a if aid in by_id]
323	    b = [by_id[aid] for aid in option_b if aid in by_id]
324	    if not a or not b:
325	        return {
326	            "status": "needs_options",
327	            "message": "Provide at least one activity for each side of the negotiation.",
328	        }
329	
330	    rec = generate_recommendations(
331	        db, trip, members, mode="everyone_wins", for_date=date.today(), limit=12
332	    )
333	    ranked = {item.activity.id: item for item in rec.get("items", [])}
334	
335	    def best(pool: list[Activity]):
336	        scored = [ranked[activity.id] for activity in pool if activity.id in ranked]
337	        return max(scored, key=lambda item: item.minimum_fit) if scored else None
338	
339	    best_a = best(a)
340	    best_b = best(b)
341	    if not best_a or not best_b:
342	        return {
343	            "status": "no_feasible_option",
344	            "message": "One or both options violate a hard constraint for at least one member.",
345	        }
346	
347	    compromise_choice = best_a if best_a.minimum_fit >= best_b.minimum_fit else best_b
348	    other = best_b if compromise_choice is best_a else best_a
349	    benefits = sorted(
350	        {
351	            normalize_tag(tag)
352	            for tag in (compromise_choice.activity.tags or [])
353	            if tag
354	        }
355	    )[:3]
356	    return {
357	        "status": "compromise_ready",
358	        "compromise": {
359	            "activity_id": compromise_choice.activity.id,
360	            "name": compromise_choice.activity.name,
361	            "minimum_fit": compromise_choice.minimum_fit,
362	            "average_fit": compromise_choice.average_fit,
363	        },
364	        "alternative": {
365	            "activity_id": other.activity.id,
366	            "name": other.activity.name,
367	            "minimum_fit": other.minimum_fit,
368	            "average_fit": other.average_fit,
369	        },
370	        "who_benefits": f"Members interested in {', '.join(benefits) or 'the activity themes'}.",
371	        "who_compromises": "Members whose first choice was the other option; the protected minimum fit stays highest here.",
372	        "trade_offs": [
373	            f"Protected minimum fit {compromise_choice.minimum_fit}/100 versus {other.minimum_fit}/100 for the alternative.",
374	            f"Average fit {compromise_choice.average_fit}/100 versus {other.average_fit}/100.",
375	            "Private constraints stayed private; only aggregate suitability is shown.",
376	        ],
377	        "feasible": True,
378	        "disclosure": "Apply only with group approval. No private budget or preference is exposed.",
379	    }

75	    )
76	    activity_map = {activity.id: activity for activity in activities}
77	    place_ids = [activity.place_id for activity in activities if activity.place_id]
78	    places = db.query(Place).filter(Place.id.in_(place_ids)).all() if place_ids else []
79	    place_map = {place.id: place for place in places}
80	    destination_ids = {activity.destination_id for activity in activities}
81	    destinations = (
82	        db.query(Destination).filter(Destination.id.in_(destination_ids)).all()
83	        if destination_ids
84	        else []
85	    )
86	    destination_map = {destination.id: destination for destination in destinations}
87	
88	    attendance_rows = (
89	        db.query(ItineraryAttendance)
90	        .filter(ItineraryAttendance.item_id.in_([item.id for item in items]))
91	        .all()
92	        if items
93	        else []
94	    )
95	    attendance: dict[str, list[ItineraryAttendance]] = {}
96	    for row in attendance_rows:
97	        attendance.setdefault(row.item_id, []).append(row)
98	
99	    result = []
100	    for item in items:
101	        activity = activity_map.get(item.activity_id) if item.activity_id else None
102	        payload = item_out(item)
103	        payload["activity"] = (
104	            activity_out(
105	                activity,
106	                place_map.get(activity.place_id),
107	                destination_map.get(activity.destination_id),
108	            )
109	            if activity
110	            else None
111	        )
112	        rows = attendance.get(item.id, [])
113	        payload["attendance"] = {
114	            "in": len([row for row in rows if row.status == "in"]),
115	            "out": len([row for row in rows if row.status == "out"]),
116	            "join_later": len([row for row in rows if row.status == "join_later"]),
117	            "my_status": next(
118	                (row.status for row in rows if row.user_id == viewer_id), "in"
119	            ),
120	        }
121	        result.append(payload)
122	    return result
123

126	def get_itinerary(

128	    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
129	    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
130	):
131	    trip, member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
132	    itinerary = _get_itinerary(db, trip)
133	    items = (
134	        db.query(ItineraryItem)
135	        .filter(
136	            ItineraryItem.trip_id == trip.id,
137	            ItineraryItem.status == "confirmed",
138	        )
139	        .order_by(ItineraryItem.day, ItineraryItem.sort_order, ItineraryItem.start_time)
140	        .all()
141	    )
142	    versions = (
143	        db.query(ItineraryVersion)
144	        .filter(ItineraryVersion.itinerary_id == itinerary.id)
145	        .order_by(ItineraryVersion.version.desc())
146	        .limit(15)
147	        .all()
148	    )
149	    open_proposals = (
150	        db.query(ItineraryProposal)
151	        .filter(ItineraryProposal.trip_id == trip.id, ItineraryProposal.status == "open")
152	        .all()
153	    )
154	    total_cost = sum(item.cost_estimate for item in items)
155	    return {
156	        "itinerary_id": itinerary.id,
157	        "confirmed_version": itinerary.confirmed_version,
158	        "my_role": member.role,
159	        "items": _serialize_items(db, items, user.id),
160	        "versions": [version_out(version) for version in versions],
161	        "open_proposals": len(open_proposals),
162	        "totals": {
163	            "items": len(items),
164	            "cost": round(total_cost, 2),
165	            "currency": trip.currency,
166	            "days": len({item.day for item in items}),
167	            "protected_items": len([item for item in items if item.is_protected]),
168	        },
169	    }

172	def _next_sort_order(db: Session, trip_id: str, item_day: date) -> int:
173	    last = (
174	        db.query(ItineraryItem)
175	        .filter(ItineraryItem.trip_id == trip_id, ItineraryItem.day == item_day)
176	        .order_by(ItineraryItem.sort_order.desc())
177	        .first()
178	    )
179	    return (last.sort_order + 1) if last else 0

182	def _within_trip(trip: Trip, day: date) -> None:
183	    if day < trip.start_date or day > trip.end_date:
184	        raise HTTPException(
185	            status_code=422,
186	            detail=(
187	                f"{day.isoformat()} is outside the trip dates "
188	                f"({trip.start_date.isoformat()} to {trip.end_date.isoformat()})."
189	            ),
190	        )

193	@router.post("/{trip_id}/itinerary/items", status_code=201)
194	async def add_item(
195	    trip_id: str,
196	    payload: ItemCreate,
197	    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
198	    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
199	):
200	    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user, ADMIN_ROLES)
201	    _within_trip(trip, payload.day)
202	    itinerary = _get_itinerary(db, trip)
203	    activity = db.get(Activity, payload.activity_id) if payload.activity_id else None
204	    if payload.activity_id and not activity:
205	        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Activity not found")
206	    if activity and activity.destination_id != trip.destination_id:
207	        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Activity is not in this trip's destination")
208	    title = payload.title or (activity.name if activity else None)
209	    if not title:
210	        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="A title is required")
211	    item = ItineraryItem(
212	        itinerary_id=itinerary.id,
213	        trip_id=trip.id,
214	        day=payload.day,
215	        start_time=payload.start_time,
216	        title=title,
217	        activity_id=activity.id if activity else None,
218	        place_id=activity.place_id if activity else None,
219	        notes=payload.notes,
220	        cost_estimate=(
221	            payload.cost_estimate
222	            if payload.cost_estimate is not None
223	            else (activity.price_estimate if activity else 0.0)
224	        ),
225	        is_protected=payload.is_protected,
226	        created_by=user.id,
227	        sort_order=_next_sort_order(db, trip.id, payload.day),
228	    )
229	    db.add(item)
230	    db.flush()
231	    record_itinerary_version(
232	        db, itinerary, user_id=user.id, note=f"Added {item.title}"
233	    )
234	    audit(
235	        db,
236	        action="itinerary.item_add",
237	        entity_type="itinerary_item",
238	        entity_id=item.id,
239	        user_id=user.id,
240	        trip_id=trip.id,
241	        detail={"title": item.title},
242	    )
243	    notify_trip_members(
244	        db,
245	        trip,
246	        kind="itinerary_updated",
247	        title=f"{user.display_name} added {item.title}",
248	        link=f"/trips/{trip.id}/itinerary",
249	        exclude_user_id=user.id,
250	    )
251	    db.commit()
252	    await manager.broadcast(
253	        trip.id,
254	        event_payload("itinerary.updated", trip_id=trip.id, by=user.display_name),
255	    )
256	    return _serialize_items(db, [item], user.id)[0]

345	def _build_proposal_operations(db: Session, trip: Trip, proposal: ItineraryProposal) -> list[dict]:
346	    """Validate and normalise a proposal into concrete itinerary operations."""
347	    payload = proposal.payload or {}
348	    operations: list[dict] = []
349	
350	    def add_activity_op(activity_id: str, day_value, start_time, notes, title=None):
351	        activity = db.get(Activity, activity_id)
352	        if not activity:
353	            raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="A proposed activity no longer exists")
354	        if activity.destination_id != trip.destination_id:
355	            raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="A proposed activity is outside this destination")
356	        if day_value is None:
357	            raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="A proposed item is missing its day")
358	        day = day_value if isinstance(day_value, date) else date.fromisoformat(str(day_value))
359	        _within_trip(trip, day)
360	        start = start_time or "09:00"
361	        if len(start) != 5 or ":" not in start:
362	            raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Invalid start time in proposal")
363	        operations.append(
364	            {
365	                "op": "add",
366	                "activity_id": activity.id,
367	                "day": day,
368	                "start_time": start,
369	                "notes": notes,
370	                "title": title or activity.name,
371	                "cost": activity.price_estimate,
372	                "place_id": activity.place_id,
373	            }
374	        )
375	
376	    def cancel_op(item_id: str | None):
377	        if not item_id:
378	            return
379	        item = db.get(ItineraryItem, item_id)
380	        if not item or item.trip_id != trip.id:
381	            raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="A referenced itinerary item no longer exists")
382	        operations.append({"op": "cancel", "item_id": item.id, "title": item.title, "cost": -item.cost_estimate})
383	
384	    if proposal.kind == "add_activity":
385	        add_activity_op(
386	            payload.get("activity_id"),
387	            payload.get("day"),
388	            payload.get("start_time"),
389	            payload.get("notes"),
390	        )
391	    elif proposal.kind == "replace_item":
392	        cancel_op(payload.get("target_item_id"))
393	        add_activity_op(
394	            payload.get("activity_id"),
395	            payload.get("day"),
396	            payload.get("start_time"),
397	            payload.get("notes"),
398	        )
399	    elif proposal.kind == "remove_item":
400	        cancel_op(payload.get("target_item_id"))
401	    elif proposal.kind == "twin_adopt":
402	        day = payload.get("day")
403	        if day:
404	            day_value = day if isinstance(day, date) else date.fromisoformat(str(day))
405	            existing = (
406	                db.query(ItineraryItem)
407	                .filter(
408	                    ItineraryItem.trip_id == trip.id,
409	                    ItineraryItem.day == day_value,
410	                    ItineraryItem.status == "confirmed",
411	                )
412	                .all()
413	            )
414	            for item in existing:
415	                cancel_op(item.id)
416	        for entry in payload.get("items", []):
417	            add_activity_op(
418	                entry.get("activity_id"),
419	                entry.get("day", payload.get("day")),
420	                entry.get("start_time"),
421	                entry.get("notes"),
422	            )
423	    elif proposal.kind == "rescue":
424	        for entry in payload.get("items", []):
425	            cancel_op(entry.get("item_id"))
426	            if entry.get("activity_id"):
427	                add_activity_op(
428	                    entry.get("activity_id"),
429	                    entry.get("day"),
430	                    entry.get("start_time"),
431	                    entry.get("notes", "Trip Rescue replacement"),
432	                )
433	    else:
434	        for entry in payload.get("items", []):
435	            add_activity_op(
436	                entry.get("activity_id"),
437	                entry.get("day"),
438	                entry.get("start_time"),
439	                entry.get("notes"),
440	            )
441	        for item_id in payload.get("remove_item_ids", []):
442	            cancel_op(item_id)
443	
444	    if not operations:
445	        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="This proposal contains no itinerary changes")
446	    return operations
447	
448	
449	def _pact_conflicts(db: Session, trip: Trip, operations: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
450	    pact = db.query(JourneyPact).filter(JourneyPact.trip_id == trip.id).first()
451	    if not pact:
452	        return []
453	    must_do = {str(title).strip().lower() for title in (pact.must_do or [])}
454	    exceptions = {str(title).strip().lower() for title in (pact.exceptions or [])}
455	    conflicts = []
456	    for operation in operations:
457	        if operation["op"] != "cancel":
458	            continue
459	        title = (operation.get("title") or "").strip().lower()
460	        if not title:
461	            continue
462	        for rule in must_do:
463	            if rule and (rule in title or title in rule):
464	                if any(exception in title or title in exception for exception in exceptions):
465	                    continue
466	                conflicts.append(
467	                    {
468	                        "item": operation["title"],
469	                        "rule": "Agreed must-do activity (Journey Pact)",
470	                        "resolution": "Add a Journey Pact exception or keep the item.",
471	                    }
472	                )
473	    return conflicts
474	
475	
476	def _proposal_impact(db: Session, trip: Trip, proposal: ItineraryProposal) -> dict:
477	    operations = _build_proposal_operations(db, trip, proposal)
478	    total_delta = round(sum(operation.get("cost", 0) for operation in operations), 2)
479	    members = (
480	        db.query(TripMember)
481	        .filter(TripMember.trip_id == trip.id, TripMember.status == "active")
482	        .all()
483	    )
484	    per_member = round(total_delta / max(1, len(members)), 2)
485	    budget_conflicts = []
486	    for operation in operations:
487	        if operation["op"] != "add":
488	            continue
489	        for member in members:
490	            if member.budget_limit is not None and operation["cost"] > member.budget_limit:
491	                budget_conflicts.append(
492	                    {
493	                        "reason": "A stated hard budget limit would be exceeded.",
494	                        "item": operation["title"],
495	                    }
496	                )
497	    return {
498	        "operations": [
499	            {
500	                "op": operation["op"],
501	                "title": operation.get("title"),
502	                "day": operation.get("day"),
503	                "start_time": operation.get("start_time"),
504	                "cost": operation.get("cost"),
505	            }
506	            for operation in operations
507	        ],
508	        "cost_impact": {
509	            "total_delta": total_delta,
510	            "per_member_estimate": per_member,
511	            "currency": trip.currency,
512	            "note": "Per-member estimate assumes an equal share of the group plan.",
513	        },
514	        "budget_conflicts": budget_conflicts,
515	        "pact_conflicts": _pact_conflicts(db, trip, operations),
516	        "requires_approval": True,
517	    }
518

520	@router.post("/{trip_id}/proposals", status_code=201)
521	async def create_proposal(
522	    trip_id: str,
523	    payload: ProposalCreate,
524	    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
525	    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
526	):
527	    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
528	    if payload.kind == "add_activity" and not payload.activity_id:
529	        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="activity_id is required for add_activity")
530	    if payload.kind == "replace_item" and (not payload.activity_id or not payload.target_item_id):
531	        raise HTTPException(
532	            status_code=422,
533	            detail="replace_item needs both activity_id and target_item_id",
534	        )
535	    if payload.kind == "remove_item" and not payload.target_item_id:
536	        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="target_item_id is required for remove_item")
537	
538	    proposal = ItineraryProposal(
539	        trip_id=trip.id,
540	        kind=payload.kind,
541	        title=payload.title,
542	        summary=payload.summary,
543	        target_day=payload.day,
544	        created_by=user.id,
545	        payload={
546	            "activity_id": payload.activity_id,
547	            "day": payload.day.isoformat() if payload.day else None,
548	            "start_time": payload.start_time,
549	            "target_item_id": payload.target_item_id,
550	            **payload.payload,
551	        },
552	    )
553	    db.add(proposal)
554	    db.flush()
555	    try:
556	        impact = _proposal_impact(db, trip, proposal)
557	    except HTTPException:
558	        db.rollback()
559	        raise
560	    audit(
561	        db,
562	        action="proposal.create",
563	        entity_type="itinerary_proposal",
564	        entity_id=proposal.id,
565	        user_id=user.id,
566	        trip_id=trip.id,
567	        detail={"kind": proposal.kind, "title": proposal.title},
568	    )
569	    notify_trip_members(
570	        db,
571	        trip,
572	        kind="proposal_created",
573	        title=f"New proposal: {proposal.title}",
574	        body=f"{user.display_name} asked the group to decide.",
575	        link=f"/trips/{trip.id}/voting",
576	        exclude_user_id=user.id,
577	    )
578	    db.commit()
579	    await manager.broadcast(
580	        trip.id,
581	        event_payload("proposal.created", trip_id=trip.id, proposal_id=proposal.id),
582	    )
583	    return {**proposal_out(db, proposal, user.id), "impact": impact}
584

665	@router.post("/{trip_id}/proposals/{proposal_id}/approve")
666	async def approve_proposal(
667	    trip_id: str,
668	    proposal_id: str,
669	    payload: ApprovalIn,
670	    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
671	    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
672	):
673	    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user, ADMIN_ROLES)
674	    proposal = db.get(ItineraryProposal, proposal_id)
675	    if not proposal or proposal.trip_id != trip.id:
676	        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Proposal not found")
677	    if proposal.status != "open":
678	        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="This proposal is no longer open")
679	    if not payload.approval:
680	        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Use the reject action instead")
681	
682	    operations = _build_proposal_operations(db, trip, proposal)
683	    conflicts = _pact_conflicts(db, trip, operations)
684	    if conflicts:
685	        raise HTTPException(
686	            status_code=409,
687	            detail={
688	                "message": "This change breaks the Journey Pact.",
689	                "conflicts": conflicts,
690	            },
691	        )
692	
693	    members = (
694	        db.query(TripMember)
695	        .filter(TripMember.trip_id == trip.id, TripMember.status == "active")
696	        .all()
697	    )
698	    for operation in operations:
699	        if operation["op"] != "add":
700	            continue
701	        for member in members:
702	            if member.budget_limit is not None and operation["cost"] > member.budget_limit:
703	                raise HTTPException(
704	                    status_code=409,
705	                    detail={
706	                        "message": "At least one member's stated hard budget limit would be exceeded.",
707	                        "item": operation["title"],
708	                    },
709	                )
710	
711	    itinerary = _get_itinerary(db, trip)
712	    created_items: list[ItineraryItem] = []
713	    for operation in operations:
714	        if operation["op"] == "cancel":
715	            item = db.get(ItineraryItem, operation["item_id"])
716	            if item:
717	                item.status = "cancelled"
718	                item.updated_at = utcnow()
719	            continue
720	        item = ItineraryItem(
721	            itinerary_id=itinerary.id,
722	            trip_id=trip.id,
723	            day=operation["day"],
724	            start_time=operation["start_time"],
725	            title=operation["title"],
726	            activity_id=operation["activity_id"],
727	            place_id=operation["place_id"],
728	            notes=operation.get("notes"),
729	            cost_estimate=operation["cost"],
730	            created_by=user.id,
731	            sort_order=_next_sort_order(db, trip.id, operation["day"]),
732	        )
733	        db.add(item)
734	        created_items.append(item)
735	
736	    proposal.status = "approved"
737	    proposal.decided_by = user.id
738	    proposal.decided_at = utcnow()
739	    db.add(
740	        ItineraryApproval(
741	            proposal_id=proposal.id, user_id=user.id, approval=True
742	        )
743	    )
744	    db.flush()
745	    record_itinerary_version(
746	        db, itinerary, user_id=user.id, note=f"Approved: {proposal.title}"
747	    )
748	    audit(
749	        db,
750	        action="proposal.approve",
751	        entity_type="itinerary_proposal",
752	        entity_id=proposal.id,
753	        user_id=user.id,
754	        trip_id=trip.id,
755	    )
756	    notify_trip_members(
757	        db,
758	        trip,
759	        kind="proposal_approved",
760	        title=f"Approved: {proposal.title}",
761	        body=f"{user.display_name} confirmed the change with the group.",
762	        link=f"/trips/{trip.id}/itinerary",
763	        exclude_user_id=user.id,
764	    )
765	    total_delta = round(sum(operation.get("cost", 0) for operation in operations), 2)
766	    db.commit()
767	    await manager.broadcast(
768	        trip.id,
769	        event_payload(
770	            "proposal.approved",
771	            trip_id=trip.id,
772	            proposal_id=proposal.id,
773	            version=itinerary.confirmed_version,
774	        ),
775	    )
776	    return {
777	        **proposal_out(db, proposal, user.id),
778	        "confirmed_version": itinerary.confirmed_version,
779	        "created_items": _serialize_items(db, created_items, user.id),
780	        "cost_impact": {
781	            "total_delta": total_delta,
782	            "per_member_estimate": round(total_delta / max(1, len(members)), 2),
783	            "currency": trip.currency,
784	        },
785	    }

187	    user = db.get(User, member.user_id) if member.user_id else None
188	    is_self = member.user_id == viewer_id
189	    data = {

195	        "joined_at": member.joined_at,
196	        "is_self": is_self,
197	    }
198	    # Budget limits and accessibility needs are private by default. They are
199	    # only surfaced back to their owner (F04/F32 privacy rule).
200	    if is_self:
201	        data["budget_limit"] = member.budget_limit
202	        data["accessibility_needs"] = member.accessibility_needs or []
203	    return data

251	        counts[vote.value] = counts.get(vote.value, 0) + 1
252	        if vote.user_id not in user_cache:
253	            user_cache[vote.user_id] = db.get(User, vote.user_id)
254	        author = user_cache[vote.user_id]
255	        if vote.comment:
256	            comments.append(
257	                {
258	                    "id": vote.id,
259	                    "user": user_public(author),
260	                    "comment": vote.comment,
261	                    "value": vote.value,
262	                    "created_at": vote.created_at,
263	                }
264	            )
265	        if viewer_id and vote.user_id == viewer_id:
266	            my_vote = vote.value
267	    author = db.get(User, proposal.created_by)
268	    return {
269	        "id": proposal.id,
270	        "kind": proposal.kind,
271	        "title": proposal.title,
272	        "summary": proposal.summary,
273	        "payload": proposal.payload or {},
274	        "status": proposal.status,
275	        "target_day": proposal.target_day,
276	        "created_by": proposal.created_by,
277	        "author": user_public(author),
278	        "created_at": proposal.created_at,
279	        "decided_at": proposal.decided_at,
280	        "votes": counts,
281	        "vote_count": len(votes),
282	        "my_vote": my_vote,
283	        "comments": comments,
284	    }

```python
def _apply_feedback_to_dna(db, user, activity, sentiment):
    delta = DNA_SENTIMENT[sentiment]
    if delta == 0: return None
    row = db.query(JourneyDNA)... 
    if not row: row = JourneyDNA(user_id=user.id, scores=default_dna(), source="feedback"); db.add(row); db.flush()
    scores = dict(row.scores or default_dna())
    changed = []
    for tag in activity.tags or []:
        key = normalize_tag(tag)
        if key in DNA_DIMENSIONS:
            scores[key] = round(clamp(float(scores.get(key,5)) + delta, 0, 10), 2)
            changed.append(key)
    if not changed: return None
    row.scores = scores; row.source="feedback+explicit"
    return changed
```

Shown as changes only; nothing is applied until approved.\"\n    )\n    pact = db.query(JourneyPact).filter(JourneyPact.trip_id == trip.id).first()\n    proposal, impact = _create_proposal(\n        db,\n        trip,\n        user,\n        kind=\"rescue\",\n        title=title,\n        summary=summary,\n        day=payload.items[0].day,\n        payload={\n            \"kind\": payload.kind,\n            \"extra_minutes\": payload.extra_minutes,\n            \"note\": payload.note,\n            \"items\": items,\n        },\n    )\n    db.commit()\n    await manager.broadcast(\n        trip.id,\n        event_payload(\"proposal.created\", trip_id=trip.id, proposal_id=proposal.id),\n    )\n    response = {**proposal_out(db, proposal, user.id), \"impact\": impact}\n    if pact:\n        response[\"pact\"] = {\n            \"must_do\": pact.must_do or [],\n            \"flexible\": pact.flexible or [],\n            \"note\": \"Pact conflicts block approval until the group adds an exception.\",\n        }\n    return response\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{trip_id}/negotiate\")\ndef negotiate(\n    trip_id: str,\n    payload: NegotiateIn,\n    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),\n    db: Session = Depends(get_db),\n):\n    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)\n    for activity_id in set(payload.option_a + payload.option_b):\n        _activity_in_trip(db, trip, activity_id)\n    return rescue_service.compromise(\n        db,\n        trip,\n        _active_members(db, trip.id),\n        payload.option_a,\n        payload.option_b,\n    )\n"
```json
}
```
