22	def resolve_shares(
23	    amount: float,
24	    participants: list[dict],
25	    split: str,
26	) -> list[dict]:
27	    """Return participants with normalised share_amount values.
28	
29	    Raises ValueError when custom shares do not reconcile exactly.
30	    """
31	    cleaned = [
32	        {
33	            "user_id": participant.get("user_id"),
34	            "guest_name": participant.get("guest_name"),
35	            "weight": max(0.01, float(participant.get("weight") or 1)),
36	            "share_amount": participant.get("share_amount"),
37	        }
38	        for participant in participants
39	    ]
40	    if not cleaned:
41	        raise ValueError("At least one participant is required.")
42	
43	    if split == "custom":
44	        total = 0.0
45	        for participant in cleaned:
46	            if participant["share_amount"] is None:
47	                raise ValueError("Custom split requires a share for every participant.")
48	            participant["share_amount"] = round(float(participant["share_amount"]), 2)
49	            total += participant["share_amount"]
50	        if abs(total - amount) > 0.01:
51	            raise ValueError(
52	                f"Custom shares total {total:.2f}, which does not match the expense amount {amount:.2f}."
53	            )
54	        return cleaned
55	
56	    if split == "weights":
57	        weight_sum = sum(participant["weight"] for participant in cleaned)
58	        running = 0.0
59	        for index, participant in enumerate(cleaned):
60	            if index == len(cleaned) - 1:
61	                participant["share_amount"] = round(amount - running, 2)
62	            else:
63	                share = round(amount * participant["weight"] / weight_sum, 2)
64	                participant["share_amount"] = share
65	                running += share
66	        return cleaned
67	
68	    count = len(cleaned)
69	    base = round(amount / count, 2)
70	    running = 0.0
71	    for index, participant in enumerate(cleaned):
72	        if index == count - 1:
73	            participant["share_amount"] = round(amount - running, 2)
74	        else:
75	            participant["share_amount"] = base
76	            running += base
77	    return cleaned
78

82	        db.query(ExpenseParticipant)
83	        .filter(ExpenseParticipant.expense_id == expense_id)
84	        .all()
85	    )

88	def balances(db: Session, trip: Trip) -> dict:
89	    expenses = (
90	        db.query(Expense)
91	        .filter(Expense.trip_id == trip.id, Expense.deleted_at.is_(None))
92	        .all()
93	    )
94	    net: dict[str, float] = {}
95	    spent_total = 0.0
96	    for expense in expenses:
97	        spent_total += expense.amount
98	        net[expense.paid_by] = round(net.get(expense.paid_by, 0.0) + expense.amount, 2)
99	        for row in participant_rows(db, expense.id):
100	            if row.user_id:
101	                net[row.user_id] = round(net.get(row.user_id, 0.0) - row.share_amount, 2)
102	
103	    user_ids = (
104	        db.query(TripMember.user_id)
105	        .filter(
106	            TripMember.trip_id == trip.id,
107	            TripMember.status == "active",
108	            TripMember.user_id.isnot(None),
109	        )
110	        .all()
111	    )
112	    ids = [row[0] for row in user_ids]
113	    users = db.query(User).filter(User.id.in_(ids)).all() if ids else []
114	    names = {user.id: user.display_name for user in users}
115	    for user_id in ids:
116	        net.setdefault(user_id, 0.0)
117	
118	    creditors = sorted(
119	        [(uid, amt) for uid, amt in net.items() if amt > 0.01],
120	        key=lambda item: item[1],
121	        reverse=True,
122	    )
123	    debtors = sorted(
124	        [(uid, -amt) for uid, amt in net.items() if amt < -0.01],
125	        key=lambda item: item[1],
126	        reverse=True,
127	    )
128	    settlements = []
129	    creditors = [list(item) for item in creditors]
130	    debtors = [list(item) for item in debtors]
131	    ci = di = 0
132	    while ci < len(creditors) and di < len(debtors):
133	        amount = min(creditors[ci][1], debtors[di][1])
134	        if amount > 0.01:
135	            settlements.append(
136	                {
137	                    "from_user_id": debtors[di][0],
138	                    "from_name": names.get(debtors[di][0], "Member"),
139	                    "to_user_id": creditors[ci][0],
140	                    "to_name": names.get(creditors[ci][0], "Member"),
141	                    "amount": round(amount, 2),
142	                }
143	            )
144	        creditors[ci][1] -= amount
145	        debtors[di][1] -= amount
146	        if creditors[ci][1] <= 0.01:
147	            ci += 1
148	        if debtors[di][1] <= 0.01:
149	            di += 1
150	
151	    return {
152	        "total_spent": round(spent_total, 2),
153	        "currency": trip.currency,
154	        "balances": [
155	            {
156	                "user_id": user_id,
157	                "display_name": names.get(user_id, "Member"),
158	                "net": round(net.get(user_id, 0.0), 2),
159	            }
160	            for user_id in sorted(net, key=lambda uid: net[uid], reverse=True)
161	        ],
162	        "settlements": [
163	            {**settlement, "status": "suggested"} for settlement in settlements
164	        ],
165	        "disclosure": "Tracking only — SAFAR does not move money.",
166	    }

172	    writer.writerow(
173	        ["date", "title", "category", "amount", "currency", "paid_by", "participants"]
174	    )
175	    expenses = (

179	        .all()

182	    for expense in expenses:

184	        parts = ", ".join(
185	            f"{(users.get(row.user_id) or row.guest_name or 'Guest')} {row.share_amount:.2f}"
186	            for row in rows
187	        )
188	        writer.writerow(

191	                expense.title,
192	                expense.category,
193	                f"{expense.amount:.2f}",
194	                expense.currency,
195	                users.get(expense.paid_by, expense.paid_by),
196	                parts,
197	            ]
198	        )
199	    return buffer.getvalue()

19	def freshness(observed_at: datetime, source_type: str, verified: bool = False) -> float:
20	    age_days = max(0.0, (utcnow() - observed_at).total_seconds() / 86400)
21	    half_life = 90 if source_type == "official" else 30 if verified else 7
22	    score = exp(-log(2) * age_days / half_life)
23	    if verified:
24	        score = min(1.0, score * 1.15)
25	    return round(score, 3)

29	    if source_type == "official" and verified:
30	        return "VERIFIED"
31	    if source_type == "official":
32	        return "REPORTED"
33	    return {

125	def crowd_forecast(db: Session, activity_id: str) -> dict:
126	    reports = relevant_reports(db, activity_id, days=180)
127	    crowd = [r for r in reports if r.category == "crowd" and r.source_type in {"community", "official"}]
128	    if len(crowd) < 8:
129	        latest = crowd[0] if crowd else None
130	        return {
131	            "activity_id": activity_id,
132	            "status": "insufficient_data",
133	            "required_reports": 8,
134	            "available_reports": len(crowd),
135	            "latest_observation": (
136	                {
137	                    "observed_at": latest.observed_at,
138	                    "source_type": latest.source_type,
139	                    "source_label": SOURCE_LABELS.get(latest.source_type),
140	                    "value": latest.value,
141	                }
142	                if latest
143	                else None
144	            ),
145	            "message": (
146	                "Not enough reliable observations to forecast crowds. "
147	                "Showing the latest report instead of inventing a prediction."
148	            ),
149	        }
150	
151	    buckets: dict[str, list[float]] = {}
152	    for report in crowd:
153	        value = report.value or {}
154	        raw = value.get("score", value.get("level"))
155	        if isinstance(raw, str):
156	            raw = {"low": 0.25, "moderate": 0.5, "medium": 0.5, "high": 0.8, "very_high": 0.95}.get(raw, 0.5)
157	        try:
158	            score = float(raw)
159	        except (TypeError, ValueError):
160	            continue
161	        key = f"{report.observed_at.weekday()}-{count_bucket(report.observed_at.hour)}"
162	        buckets.setdefault(key, []).append(score)
163	    if not buckets:

165	            "activity_id": activity_id,
166	            "status": "insufficient_data",

168	        }
169	    forecasts = []
170	    for key, scores in buckets.items():
171	        weekday, bucket = key.split("-")
172	        if len(scores) < 3:

174	        mean = sum(scores) / len(scores)
175	        variance = sum((score - mean) ** 2 for score in scores) / len(scores)
176	        forecasts.append(
177	            {

179	                "bucket": bucket,
180	                "expected_level": round(mean, 2),
181	                "spread": round(variance**0.5, 2),
182	                "reports": len(scores),
183	                "confidence": round(min(0.85, 0.35 + len(scores) * 0.04), 2),
184	            }
185	        )

191	        }
192	    return {

194	        "status": "predicted",

197	        "disclosure": (
198	            "PREDICTED from historical community/official observations. "
199	            "Confidence reflects sample size and spread, not a guarantee."

27	def _cosine(a: dict[str, float], b: dict[str, float]) -> float:
28	    if not a or not b:
29	        return 0.0
30	    dot = sum(value * b.get(key, 0.0) for key, value in a.items())
31	    na = sqrt(sum(value * value for value in a.values()))
32	    nb = sqrt(sum(value * value for value in b.values()))
33	    return dot / (na * nb) if na and nb else 0.0

39	    row = db.query(JourneyDNA).filter(JourneyDNA.user_id == user_id).first()
40	    if row and row.scores:

42	    profile = db.query(Profile).filter(Profile.user_id == user_id).first()

44	    if profile:

178	    text = inspiration.content or ""
179	    lowered = text.lower()
180	    destinations = db.query(Destination).all()
181	    activities = db.query(Activity).all()
182	    matches = []
183	    for destination in destinations:
184	        if destination.name.lower() in lowered:
185	            matches.append(
186	                {
187	                    "type": "destination",
188	                    "id": destination.id,
189	                    "name": destination.name,
190	                    "confidence": 0.9,
191	                    "evidence": f"Destination name appears in the text.",
192	                }
193	            )
194	        else:
195	            for tag in destination.tags or []:
196	                if tag.lower() in lowered:
197	                    matches.append(
198	                        {
199	                            "type": "destination_hint",
200	                            "id": destination.id,
201	                            "name": destination.name,
202	                            "confidence": 0.55,
203	                            "evidence": f"Interest keyword '{tag}' matches this destination.",
204	                        }
205	                    )
206	                    break
207	    for activity in activities:
208	        if activity.name.lower() in lowered:
209	            matches.append(
210	                {
211	                    "type": "activity",
212	                    "id": activity.id,
213	                    "name": activity.name,
214	                    "confidence": 0.85,
215	                    "evidence": "Activity name appears in the text.",
216	                }
217	            )
218	    for profile_tag in ["food", "temple", "beach", "hiking", "art", "market", "museum", "nature"]:
219	        if profile_tag in lowered and not any(m["name"].lower() == profile_tag for m in matches):
220	            matches.append(
221	                {
222	                    "type": "interest",
223	                    "id": None,
224	                    "name": profile_tag,
225	                    "confidence": 0.4,
226	                    "evidence": f"Keyword '{profile_tag}' found; requires your confirmation.",
227	                }
228	            )
229	
230	    seen = set()
231	    deduped = []
232	    for match in sorted(matches, key=lambda item: item["confidence"], reverse=True):
233	        key = (match["type"], match["name"])
234	        if key in seen:
235	            continue
236	        seen.add(key)
237	        deduped.append(match)
238	
239	    extraction = {
240	        "matches": deduped,
241	        "status": "needs_confirmation",
242	        "notes": [
243	            "Extraction is keyword-based and only proposes candidates; nothing is added to a trip automatically.",
244	        ],
245	        "limitations": [],
246	    }
247	    if inspiration.source_type == "image_url":
248	        extraction["limitations"].append(
249	            "Image understanding / OCR is not configured on this deployment. The image itself was not analysed."
250	        )
251	    if inspiration.source_type == "link":
252	        extraction["limitations"].append(
253	            "Link fetching is not configured. Only the URL string you provided was inspected."
254	        )
255	    inspiration.extracted = extraction
256	    return extraction

259	def serendipity_suggestions(db: Session, user: User) -> dict:
260	    profile = db.query(Profile).filter(Profile.user_id == user.id).first()
261	    if not profile or not profile.allow_discovery:
262	        return {
263	            "eligible": False,
264	            "reason": "Enable traveller discovery in Privacy settings to see compatible travellers.",
265	            "matches": [],
266	        }
267	    my_trips = (
268	        db.query(Trip)
269	        .join(TripMember, TripMember.trip_id == Trip.id)
270	        .filter(TripMember.user_id == user.id, Trip.deleted_at.is_(None))
271	        .all()
272	    )
273	    my_destinations = {trip.destination_id for trip in my_trips if trip.destination_id}
274	    my_dates = [(trip.start_date, trip.end_date) for trip in my_trips]
275	    my_dna = dna_for_user(db, user.id)
276	    my_interests = {normalize_tag(tag) for tag in (profile.interests or [])}
277	
278	    candidates = (
279	        db.query(Profile)
280	        .filter(
281	            Profile.allow_discovery.is_(True),
282	            Profile.user_id != user.id,
283	            Profile.public_profile.is_(True),
284	        )
285	        .all()
286	    )
287	    results = []
288	    for candidate in candidates:
289	        candidate_user = db.get(User, candidate.user_id)
290	        if not candidate_user or candidate_user.deleted_at:
291	            continue
292	        their_trips = (
293	            db.query(Trip)
294	            .join(TripMember, TripMember.trip_id == Trip.id)
295	            .filter(TripMember.user_id == candidate.user_id, Trip.deleted_at.is_(None))
296	            .all()
297	        )
298	        their_destinations = {trip.destination_id for trip in their_trips if trip.destination_id}
299	        shared_destinations = my_destinations.intersection(their_destinations)
300	        shared_interests = my_interests.intersection(
301	            {normalize_tag(tag) for tag in (candidate.interests or [])}
302	        )
303	        date_overlap = any(
304	            not (trip.end_date < start or trip.start_date > end)
305	            for trip in their_trips
306	            for start, end in my_dates
307	        )
308	        if not shared_destinations and not shared_interests and not date_overlap:
309	            continue
310	        their_dna = dna_for_user(db, candidate.user_id)
311	        dna_similarity = _cosine(my_dna, their_dna)
312	        score = round(
313	            35
314	            * (1 if shared_destinations else 0)
315	            + 25 * min(1, len(shared_interests) / 3)
316	            + 25 * dna_similarity
317	            + (15 if date_overlap else 0),
318	            1,
319	        )
320	        reasons = []
321	        if shared_destinations:
322	            reasons.append("Destination overlap")
323	        if shared_interests:
324	            reasons.append("Shared interests: " + ", ".join(sorted(shared_interests)[:4]))
325	        if date_overlap:
326	            reasons.append("Overlapping travel dates")
327	        results.append(
328	            {
329	                "user": {
330	                    "id": candidate_user.id,
331	                    "display_name": candidate_user.display_name,
332	                    "avatar_url": candidate_user.avatar_url,
333	                    "headline": candidate.headline,
334	                    "home_city": candidate.home_city,
335	                },
336	                "score": score,
337	                "reasons": reasons,
338	                "shared_interests": sorted(shared_interests),
339	                "privacy": "No exact locations or contact details are shared. Contact requires mutual acceptance.",
340	            }
341	        )
342	    results.sort(key=lambda item: item["score"], reverse=True)
343	    for result in results[:10]:
344	        existing = (
345	            db.query(TravellerMatch)
346	            .filter(
347	                TravellerMatch.user_a_id == user.id,
348	                TravellerMatch.user_b_id == result["user"]["id"],
349	            )
350	            .first()
351	        )
352	        if not existing:
353	            db.add(
354	                TravellerMatch(
355	                    user_a_id=user.id,
356	                    user_b_id=result["user"]["id"],
357	                    overlap_score=result["score"],
358	                    reasons=result["reasons"],
359	                )
360	            )
361	    return {
362	        "eligible": True,
363	        "matches": results[:10],
364	        "disclosure": "Matching is opt-in and reciprocal. No private location is ever exposed.",
365	    }
366

368	def generate_missions(db: Session, trip: Trip, created_by: str) -> list[TripMission]:
369	    existing = db.query(TripMission).filter(TripMission.trip_id == trip.id).all()
370	    if existing:
371	        return existing
372	    activities = (
373	        db.query(Activity).filter(Activity.destination_id == trip.destination_id).all()
374	        if trip.destination_id
375	        else []
376	    )
377	    missions = []
378	    templates = [
379	        ("Taste something local", "food", "Find a local food experience within today's budget and radius."),
380	        ("Find a quiet viewpoint", "nature", "Discover a viewpoint that fits your energy and travel radius."),
381	        ("Meet the city's history", "history", "Visit a cultural landmark and share one thing you learned."),
382	    ]
383	    for title, tag, description in templates:
384	        matches = [
385	            activity
386	            for activity in activities
387	            if tag in {normalize_tag(t) for t in activity.tags or []}
388	        ]
389	        suggested = matches[0].name if matches else None
390	        missions.append(
391	            TripMission(
392	                trip_id=trip.id,
393	                title=title,
394	                description=description + (f" Suggestion: {suggested}." if suggested else " No matching catalog activity yet."),
395	                constraints={
396	                    "max_cost": 25,
397	                    "max_effort": 3,
398	                    "tag": tag,
399	                    "respect_accessibility": True,
400	                    "optional": True,
401	                    "suggested_activity": suggested,
402	                },
403	                created_by=created_by,
404	            )
405	        )
406	    db.add_all(missions)
407	    return missions

410	def ensure_seed_circles(db: Session, user_id: str) -> list[TravelCircle]:
411	    circles = db.query(TravelCircle).all()
412	    if circles:
413	        return circles
414	    seeds = [
415	        ("slow-travel", "Slow Travel", "Longer stays, local rhythms, fewer checkboxes.", ["culture", "local", "relaxation"]),
416	        ("food-first", "Food First", "Markets, kitchens and neighbourhood tables.", ["food", "local"]),
417	        ("trail-and-view", "Trail & View", "Walks, viewpoints and outdoor days.", ["outdoor", "nature", "adventure"]),
418	    ]
419	    created = []
420	    for slug, name, description, interests in seeds:
421	        circle = TravelCircle(
422	            slug=slug,
423	            name=name,
424	            description=description,
425	            interests=interests,
426	            created_by=user_id,
427	        )
428	        db.add(circle)
429	        created.append(circle)
430	    db.flush()
431	    return created

4	from fastapi.security import HTTPAuthorizationCredentials, HTTPBearer
5	from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
6	
7	from app.core.security import decode_access_token
8	from app.db.session import SessionLocal
9	from app.models import Trip, TripMember, User
10	
11	bearer = HTTPBearer(auto_error=False)
12	
13	
14	def get_db():
15	    db = SessionLocal()
16	    try:
17	        yield db
18	    finally:
19	        db.close()
20	
21	
22	def _user_from_token(token: str, db: Session) -> User:
23	    payload = decode_access_token(token)
24	    if not payload or not payload.get("sub"):
25	        raise HTTPException(
26	            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
27	            detail="Invalid or expired session",
28	            headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"},
29	        )
30	    user = db.get(User, payload["sub"])
31	    if not user or not user.is_active or user.deleted_at:
32	        raise HTTPException(
33	            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, detail="Account unavailable"
34	        )
35	    return user
36	
37	
38	def get_current_user(
39	    credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials | None = Depends(bearer),
40	    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
41	) -> User:
42	    if credentials is None:
43	        raise HTTPException(
44	            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
45	            detail="Authentication required",
46	            headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"},
47	        )
48	    return _user_from_token(credentials.credentials, db)
49	
50	
51	def get_optional_user(
52	    credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials | None = Depends(bearer),
53	    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
54	) -> User | None:
55	    if credentials is None:
56	        return None
57	    try:
58	        return _user_from_token(credentials.credentials, db)
59	    except HTTPException:
60	        return None
61	
62	
63	def require_admin(user: User = Depends(get_current_user)) -> User:
64	    if not user.is_admin:
65	        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Administrator access required")
66	    return user
67	
68	
69	def get_trip_and_member(
70	    trip_id: str,
71	    db: Session,
72	    user: User,
73	    roles: set[str] | None = None,
74	) -> tuple[Trip, TripMember]:
75	    trip = db.get(Trip, trip_id)
76	    if not trip or trip.deleted_at:
77	        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Trip not found")
78	    member = (
79	        db.query(TripMember)
80	        .filter(
81	            TripMember.trip_id == trip_id,
82	            TripMember.user_id == user.id,
83	            TripMember.status == "active",
84	        )
85	        .first()
86	    )
87	    if not member:
88	        # Deliberately 404 rather than 403 so private trip existence is not leaked.
89	        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Trip not found")
90	    if roles and member.role not in roles:
91	        raise HTTPException(
92	            status_code=403, detail="Your trip role does not allow this action"
93	        )
94	    return trip, member
95	
96	
97	def trip_dependency(roles: set[str] | None = None) -> Callable:
98	    """Build a FastAPI dependency that resolves trip + membership."""
99	
100	    def dependency(
101	        trip_id: str,
102	        db: Session = Depends(get_db),
103	        user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
104	    ) -> tuple[Trip, TripMember]:
105	        return get_trip_and_member(trip_id, db, user, roles)
106	
107	    return dependency

1	import asyncio
2	from collections import defaultdict
3	from typing import Any
4	
5	from fastapi import WebSocket
6	
7	
8	class TripConnectionManager:
9	    """In-process pub/sub for trip workspaces.
10	
11	    A single-process implementation keeps the reference deployment simple.
12	    For multi-instance deployments swap this for Redis pub/sub behind the
13	    same `broadcast` interface (documented in README).
14	    """
15	
16	    def __init__(self) -> None:
17	        self._connections: dict[str, set[WebSocket]] = defaultdict(set)
18	        self._lock = asyncio.Lock()
19	
20	    async def connect(self, trip_id: str, socket: WebSocket) -> None:
21	        await socket.accept()
22	        async with self._lock:
23	            self._connections[trip_id].add(socket)
24	
25	    async def disconnect(self, trip_id: str, socket: WebSocket) -> None:
26	        async with self._lock:
27	            self._connections[trip_id].discard(socket)
28	            if not self._connections[trip_id]:
29	                self._connections.pop(trip_id, None)
30	
31	    async def broadcast(self, trip_id: str, event: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
32	        async with self._lock:
33	            sockets = list(self._connections.get(trip_id, ()))
34	        for socket in sockets:
35	            try:
36	                await socket.send_json(event)
37	            except Exception:
38	                await self.disconnect(trip_id, socket)
39	
40	
41	manager = TripConnectionManager()

1	import time
2	from collections import defaultdict, deque
3	
4	from starlette.middleware.base import BaseHTTPMiddleware
5	from starlette.requests import Request
6	from starlette.responses import JSONResponse
7	
8	from .config import settings
9	
10	
11	class RateLimitMiddleware(BaseHTTPMiddleware):
12	    """Simple sliding-window limiter keyed by client IP.
13	
14	    Sufficient for a single-instance deployment; use a gateway or Redis
15	    limiter when scaling horizontally.
16	    """
17	
18	    def __init__(self, app):
19	        super().__init__(app)
20	        self._hits: dict[str, deque[float]] = defaultdict(deque)
21	
22	    async def dispatch(self, request: Request, call_next):
23	        if not request.url.path.startswith("/api") or request.method == "OPTIONS":
24	            return await call_next(request)
25	
26	        client = request.client.host if request.client else "unknown"
27	        now = time.monotonic()
28	        window = self._hits[client]
29	        while window and now - window[0] > 60:
30	            window.popleft()
31	        if len(window) >= settings.rate_limit_per_minute:
32	            return JSONResponse(
33	                status_code=429,
34	                content={"detail": "Too many requests. Please slow down."},
35	            )
36	        window.append(now)
37	        return await call_next(request)

102	def notify_trip_members(
103	    db: Session,
104	    trip: Trip,
105	    *,
106	    kind: str,
107	    title: str,
108	    body: str | None = None,
109	    link: str | None = None,
110	    exclude_user_id: str | None = None,
111	    urgent: bool = False,
112	) -> list[str]:
113	    """Create in-app notifications for active members.
114	
115	    Quiet mode (F49) suppresses non-urgent notifications. Every feature remains
116	    reachable in-app; quiet mode only removes the interruption.
117	    """
118	    members = (
119	        db.query(TripMember)
120	        .filter(TripMember.trip_id == trip.id, TripMember.status == "active")
121	        .all()
122	    )
123	    notified: list[str] = []
124	    for member in members:
125	        if not member.user_id or member.user_id == exclude_user_id:
126	            continue
127	        user = db.get(User, member.user_id)
128	        if not user:
129	            continue
130	        if user.quiet_mode and not urgent:
131	            continue
132	        db.add(
133	            Notification(
134	                user_id=user.id,
135	                trip_id=trip.id,
136	                kind=kind,
137	                title=title,
138	                body=body,
139	                link=link,
140	            )
141	        )
142	        notified.append(user.id)
143	    return notified

165	def record_itinerary_version(
166	    db: Session,
167	    itinerary: Itinerary,
168	    *,
169	    user_id: str,
170	    note: str,
171	) -> ItineraryVersion:
172	    itinerary.confirmed_version += 1
173	    items = (
174	        db.query(ItineraryItem)
175	        .filter(
176	            ItineraryItem.itinerary_id == itinerary.id,
177	            ItineraryItem.status == "confirmed",
178	        )
179	        .order_by(ItineraryItem.day, ItineraryItem.sort_order)
180	        .all()
181	    )
182	    version = ItineraryVersion(
183	        itinerary_id=itinerary.id,
184	        trip_id=itinerary.trip_id,
185	        version=itinerary.confirmed_version,
186	        snapshot=snapshot_items(items),
187	        note=note,
188	        created_by=user_id,
189	    )
190	    db.add(version)
191	    return version

def generate_missions(db: Session, trip: Trip, created_by: str) -> list[TripMission]:
    existing = db.query(TripMission).filter(TripMission.trip_id == trip.id).all()
    if existing:
        return existing
    activities = (
        db.query(Activity).filter(Activity.destination_id == trip.destination_id).all()
        if trip.destination_id
        else []
    )
    missions = []
    templates = [
        ("Taste something local", "food", "Find a local food experience within today's budget and radius."),
        ("Find a quiet viewpoint", "nature", "Discover a viewpoint that fits your energy and travel radius."),
        ("Meet the city's history", "history", "Visit a cultural landmark and share one thing you learned."),
    ]
    for title, tag, description in templates:
        matches = [
            activity
            for activity in activities
            if tag in {normalize_tag(t) for t in activity.tags or []}
        ]
        suggested = matches[0].name if matches else None
        missions.append(
            TripMission(
                trip_id=trip.id,
                title=title,
                description=description + (f" Suggestion: {suggested}." if suggested else " No matching catalog activity yet."),
                constraints={
                    "max_cost": 25,
                    "max_effort": 3,
                    "tag": tag,
                    "respect_accessibility": True,
                    "optional": True,
                    "suggested_activity": suggested,
                },
                created_by=created_by,
            )
        )
    db.add_all(missions)
    return missions


def ensure_seed_circles(db: Session, user_id: str) -> list[TravelCircle]:
    circles = db.query(TravelCircle).all()
    if circles:
        return circles
    seeds = [
        ("slow-travel", "Slow Travel", "Longer stays, local rhythms, fewer checkboxes.", ["culture", "local", "relaxation"]),
        ("food-first", "Food First", "Markets, kitchens and neighbourhood tables.", ["food", "local"]),
        ("trail-and-view", "Trail & View", "Walks, viewpoints and outdoor days.", ["outdoor", "nature", "adventure"]),
    ]
    created = []
    for slug, name, description, interests in seeds:
        circle = TravelCircle(
            slug=slug,
            name=name,
            description=description,
            interests=interests,
            created_by=user_id,
        )
        db.add(circle)
        created.append(circle)
    db.flush()
    return created

from contextlib import asynccontextmanager

MEDIA_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "storage"


@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
    Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
    MEDIA_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if settings.auto_seed:
        from app.seed import seed_if_needed

        db = SessionLocal()
        try:
            seed_if_needed(db)
        finally:
            db.close()
    yield

_SCRYPT_N = 2**14
_SCRYPT_R = 8
_SCRYPT_P = 1

def hash_password(password: str) -> str:
    salt = secrets.token_bytes(16)
    digest = hashlib.scrypt(
        password.encode("utf-8"),
        salt=salt,
        n=_SCRYPT_N,
        r=_SCRYPT_R,
        p=_SCRYPT_P,
        dklen=_SCRYPT_LEN,
    )
    return f"scrypt${_SCRYPT_N}${_SCRYPT_R}${_SCRYPT_P}${salt.hex()}${digest.hex()}"

Every recommendation, alternative and repair is persisted or returned as a
proposal. None of these endpoints mutate the confirmed itinerary: adoption
always goes through the voting and approval workflow in the itinerary router.

from datetime import date

    notify_trip_members,

)
from app.services.feedback import apply_feedback_to_dna, upsert_activity_feedback
from app.services.serializers import proposal_out, recommendation_out

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/trips", tags=["engine"])


def _trip(db, trip_id, user, roles=None):
    return get_trip_and_member(trip_id, db, user, roles)


def _active_members(db: Session, trip_id: str) -> list[TripMember]:
    return (
        db.query(TripMember)
        .filter(TripMember.trip_id == trip_id, TripMember.status == "active")
        .all()
    )


def _within_trip(trip: Trip, day: date) -> None:
    if day < trip.start_date or day > trip.end_date:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=422,
            detail=(
                f"{day.isoformat()} is outside the trip dates "
                f"({trip.start_date.isoformat()} to {trip.end_date.isoformat()})."
            ),
        )


def _activity_in_trip(db: Session, trip: Trip, activity_id: str) -> Activity:
    activity = db.get(Activity, activity_id)
    if not activity:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Activity not found")
    if activity.destination_id != trip.destination_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Activity is outside this trip's destination")
    return activity


def _batch_out(db: Session, batch: RecommendationBatch, viewer_id: str) -> dict:
    recs = (
        db.query(Recommendation)
        .filter(Recommendation.batch_id == batch.id)
        .order_by(Recommendation.rank)
        .all()
    )
    activity_ids = [rec.activity_id for rec in recs]
    activities = (
        db.query(Activity).filter(Activity.id.in_(activity_ids)).all() if activity_ids else []
    )
    activity_map = {activity.id: activity for activity in activities}
    feedback_rows = (
        db.query(RecommendationFeedback)
        .filter(
            RecommendationFeedback.recommendation_id.in_([rec.id for rec in recs]),
            RecommendationFeedback.user_id == viewer_id,
        )
        .all()
        if recs
        else []
    )
    my_feedback = {row.recommendation_id: row.sentiment for row in feedback_rows}
    return {
        "id": batch.id,
        "mode": batch.mode,
        "mode_meta": MODE_META.get(batch.mode, {}),
        "for_date": batch.for_date,
        "model_version": batch.model_version,
        "meta": batch.meta or {},
        "created_at": batch.created_at,
        "created_by": batch.created_by,
        "items": [
            {
                **recommendation_out(rec, activity_map.get(rec.activity_id)),
                "my_feedback": my_feedback.get(rec.id),
            }
            for rec in recs
        ],
    }

@router.post("/{trip_id}/engine/recommend", status_code=201)
async def recommend(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: RecommendIn,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    for_date = payload.for_date or date.today()
    _within_trip(trip, for_date)
    members = _active_members(db, trip.id)
    result = generate_recommendations(
        db,
        trip,
        members,
        mode=payload.mode,
        for_date=for_date,
        limit=payload.limit,
    )
    if result.get("error"):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=result["error"])
    if not result["items"]:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=422,
            detail=(
                "No activity passes every hard constraint for this group today. "
                "Adjust a Trip Pulse, budget limit or radius and try again."
            ),
        )

    meta = {
        **result["meta"],
        "mode_meta": result["mode_meta"],
        "clarifying_question": result.get("clarifying_question"),
        "exclusion_reasons": result.get("exclusion_reasons", {}),
        "target_member": result["target"].label if result.get("target") else None,
        "alternative_count": len(result.get("all_ranked_ids", [])) - len(result["items"]),
    }
    batch = RecommendationBatch(
        trip_id=trip.id,
        mode=payload.mode,
        for_date=for_date,
        model_version=ENGINE_VERSION,
        meta=meta,
        created_by=user.id,
    )
    db.add(batch)
    db.flush()
    for rank, ranked in enumerate(result["items"], start=1):
        db.add(
            Recommendation(
                batch_id=batch.id,
                trip_id=trip.id,
                activity_id=ranked.activity.id,
                rank=rank,
                score=ranked.score,
                average_fit=ranked.average_fit,
                minimum_fit=ranked.minimum_fit,
                fairness_spread=ranked.fairness_spread,
                novelty=ranked.novelty,
                penalties=ranked.penalties,
                explanation=ranked.explanation,
                status="suggested",
            )
        )
    audit(
        db,
        action="engine.recommend",
        entity_type="recommendation_batch",
        entity_id=batch.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
        detail={"mode": payload.mode, "for_date": for_date.isoformat()},
    )
    db.commit()
    await manager.broadcast(
        trip.id,
        event_payload("engine.updated", trip_id=trip.id, mode=payload.mode),
    )
    return _batch_out(db, batch, user.id)


@router.get("/{trip_id}/engine/latest")
def latest_batch(
    trip_id: str,
    mode: str | None = Query(default=None, pattern=r"^(everyone_wins|your_turn|surprise_us)$"),
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    query = db.query(RecommendationBatch).filter(RecommendationBatch.trip_id == trip.id)
    if mode:
        query = query.filter(RecommendationBatch.mode == mode)
    batch = query.order_by(RecommendationBatch.created_at.desc()).first()
    if not batch:
        return {
            "id": None,
            "mode": mode or "everyone_wins",
            "mode_meta": MODE_META.get(mode or "everyone_wins", {}),
            "items": [],
            "meta": {},
            "message": "No recommendation batch yet. Generate one to get started.",
        }
    return _batch_out(db, batch, user.id)

"""Group Experience Engine (F07).

Hard constraints are applied before ranking. Ranking is a transparent,
fairness-aware utility that is separate from eligibility:

    score = weighted(average fit, minimum fit, novelty) - penalties

The three modes change the weighting but never bypass a hard constraint.
No member's private budget or preferences are exposed in explanations.
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import date, datetime
from math import sqrt

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.models import (
    Activity,
    ItineraryItem,
    JourneyDNA,
    Place,
    Profile,
    Trip,
    TripMember,
    TripPulse,
    User,
)
from app.models.models import utcnow
from app.services.common import (
    DNA_DIMENSIONS,
    clamp,
    default_dna,
    normalize_tag,
)
from app.services.geo import haversine_km, travel_minutes

ENGINE_VERSION = "safar-group-engine-1.0"
BUDGET_COMFORT_CAP = {1: 15.0, 2: 35.0, 3: 70.0, 4: 120.0, 5: None}
MODE_META = {
    "everyone_wins": {
        "label": "Everyone Wins",
        "intent": "Maximise suitability for the whole group while protecting the least-served member.",
    },
    "your_turn": {
        "label": "Your Turn",
        "intent": "Give extra weight to members whose interests the current plan represents least.",
    },
    "surprise_us": {
        "label": "Surprise Us",
        "intent": "Prefer unfamiliar but relevant experiences that still satisfy every hard constraint.",
    },
}


@dataclass
class MemberContext:
    member_id: str
    user_id: str | None
    label: str
---RANK---
def rank_activity(
    activity: Activity,
    contexts: list[MemberContext],
    *,
    base_lat: float,
    base_lon: float,
    coords: tuple[float, float],
    target_member_index: int | None,
    mode: str,
) -> RankedActivity | None:
    if not contexts:
        return None
    lat, lon = coords
    distance = haversine_km(base_lat, base_lon, lat, lon) if (lat or lon) else 0.0
    travel = travel_minutes(distance)
    round_trip = travel * 2
    vector = _activity_vector(activity)
    exclusions: dict[str, str] = {}
    fits: list[float] = []

    for ctx in contexts:
        needed_time = activity.duration_minutes + round_trip
        hard_budget = ctx.hard_budget
        if hard_budget is not None and activity.price_estimate > hard_budget:
            exclusions[ctx.label] = "budget"
            continue
        if ctx.radius_km is not None and distance > ctx.radius_km:
            exclusions[ctx.label] = "radius"
            continue
        if ctx.available_minutes is not None and needed_time > ctx.available_minutes:
            exclusions[ctx.label] = "time"
            continue
        if ctx.needs_wheelchair_access and activity.wheelchair_accessible is False:
            exclusions[ctx.label] = "accessibility"
            continue

        interest = 0.2 + 0.8 * _cosine(vector, _member_dna_for_today(ctx))
        if hard_budget:
            budget_fit = clamp(1 - (activity.price_estimate / hard_budget), 0, 1)
        else:
            budget_fit = clamp(1 - activity.price_estimate / 150, 0, 1)
        energy_fit = clamp(1 - max(0, activity.effort - ctx.energy) / 4, 0, 1)
        if ctx.available_minutes:
            time_fit = clamp(1 - (needed_time / ctx.available_minutes) * 0.85, 0.1, 1)
        else:
            time_fit = clamp(1 - round_trip / 180, 0.2, 1)
        if not ctx.accessibility:
            access_fit = 1.0
        elif activity.wheelchair_accessible is True:
            access_fit = 1.0
        elif activity.wheelchair_accessible is None:
            access_fit = 0.45
        else:
            access_fit = 1.0  # non-wheelchair needs are not matched to a field yet

        fit = 100 * (
            0.58 * interest
            + 0.16 * budget_fit
            + 0.10 * energy_fit
            + 0.10 * time_fit
            + 0.06 * access_fit
        )
        fits.append(round(fit, 1))

    if exclusions:
        return None

    average = sum(fits) / len(fits)
    minimum = min(fits)
    spread = max(fits) - minimum
    novelty = clamp(1 - activity.popularity, 0, 1)

    uncertainty = 0.0
    if any(ctx.needs_wheelchair_access for ctx in contexts) and activity.wheelchair_accessible is None:
        uncertainty += 8.0
    if activity.source_type.startswith("seed"):
        uncertainty += 4.0
    if not activity.last_verified_at or (
        utcnow() - activity.last_verified_at
    ).days > 365:
        uncertainty += 3.0

    time_penalty = clamp(round_trip / max(1, min(ctx.available_minutes or 240 for ctx in contexts)) * 10, 0, 12)
    avg_cap = sum(ctx.hard_budget or 150 for ctx in contexts) / len(contexts)
    budget_penalty = clamp(activity.price_estimate / max(1, avg_cap) * 6, 0, 8)
    penalties = {
        "time": round(time_penalty, 2),
        "budget": round(budget_penalty, 2),
        "uncertainty": round(uncertainty, 2),
        "total": round(time_penalty + budget_penalty + uncertainty, 2),
    }

    novelty_points = novelty * 100
    if mode == "your_turn" and target_member_index is not None:
        target_fit = fits[target_member_index]
        score = (
            0.45 * average
            + 0.20 * minimum
            + 0.30 * target_fit
            + 0.05 * novelty_points
            - penalties["total"]
        )
    elif mode == "surprise_us":
        surprise_bonus = 6.0 if not activity.iconic else -3.0
        score = (
            0.45 * average
            + 0.20 * minimum
            + 0.35 * novelty_points
            + surprise_bonus
            - penalties["total"]
        )
    else:
        score = (
            0.55 * average
            + 0.30 * minimum
            + 0.15 * novelty_points
            - penalties["total"]
        )

    return RankedActivity(
        activity=activity,
        score=round(clamp(score, 0, 100), 1),
        average_fit=round(average, 1),
        minimum_fit=round(minimum, 1),
        fairness_spread=round(spread, 1),
        novelty=round(novelty, 3),
        fits=fits,
        penalties=penalties,
        distance_km=distance,
        travel_minutes=travel,
        exclusions=exclusions,
        target_fit=(
            round(fits[target_member_index], 1)
            if target_member_index is not None and target_member_index < len(fits)
            else None
        ),
    )

def _freshness(activity: Activity) -> dict:
    if activity.last_verified_at:
        age_days = max(0, (utcnow() - activity.last_verified_at).days)
        if age_days <= 30:
            label = "Fresh catalog entry"
        elif age_days <= 180:
            label = "Aging catalog entry"
        else:
            label = "Stale catalog entry — recheck before relying on it"
        return {
            "last_verified_at": activity.last_verified_at.isoformat(),
            "age_days": age_days,
            "label": label,
        }
    return {
        "last_verified_at": None,
        "age_days": None,
        "label": "No verification date on record",
    }

_add_member(\n    db: Session,\n    trip: Trip,\n    user: User,\n    *,\n    role: str,\n    budget_limit: float | None,\n    accessibility: list[str] | None = None,\n    invited_by: str | None = budget_limit=budget_limit,\n        accessibility_needs=accessibility or [],\n        invited_by=invited_by,\n    )\n    db.add(member)\n    db.flush()\n    return member\n\n\ndef _add_pulse(\n    db: Session,\n    trip: Trip,\n    user: User,\n    *,\n    pulse_date: date,\n    energy: int,\n    interests: list[str],\n    available_minutes: int | None,\n    budget_comfort: int,\n    radius_km: float | None,\n    activity_prefs: list[str] | None = None,\n    note: str | None = None,\n) -> TripPulse:\n    pulse = TripPulse(\n        trip_id=trip.id,\n        user_id=user.id,\n        pulse_date=pulse_date,\n        energy=energy,\n        interests=interests,\n        available_minutes=available_minutes,\n        budget_comfort=budget_comfort,\n        radius_km=radius_km,\n        activity_prefs=activity_prefs or [],\n        note=note,\n    )\n    db.add(pulse)\n    db.flush()\n    return pulse\n\n\ndef _add_item(\n    db: Session,\n    itinerary: Itinerary,\n    trip: Trip,\n    *,\n    user_id: str,\n    day: date,\n    start_time: str,\n    title: str,\n    activity: Activity,\n    duration_minutes: int,\n    cost: float,\n    sort_order: int,\n    protected: bool = False,\n    notes: str | None = None,\n) -> ItineraryItem:\n    start_hour, start_minute = map(int, start_time.split(\":\"))\n    total = start_hour * 60 + start_minute + duration_minutes\n    end_time = f\"{(total // 60) % 24:02d}:{total % 60:02d}\"\n    item = ItineraryItem(\n        itinerary_id=itinerary.id,\n        trip_id=trip.id,\n        day=day,\n        start_time=start_time,\n        end_time=end_time,\n        title=title,\n        activity_id=activity.id,\n        place_id=activity.place_id,\n        notes=notes,\n        cost_estimate=cost,\n        status=\"confirmed\",\n        is_protected=protected,\n        created_by=user_id,\n        sort_order=sort_order,\n    )\n    db.add(item)\n    db.flush()\n    return item\n\n\ndef _add_expense(\n    db: Session,\n    trip: Trip,\n    users: list[User],\n    *,\n    payer: User,\n    title: str,\n    category: str,\n    amount: float,\n    incurred_on: date,\n    notes: str | None = None,\n) -> Expense:\n    expense = Expense(\n        trip_id=trip.id,\n        title=title,\n        category=category,\n        amount=amount,\n        currency=trip.currency,\n        paid_by=payer.id,\n        incurred_on=incurred_on,\n        notes=notes,\n        created_by=payer.id,\n    )\n    db.add(expense)\n    db.flush()\n    rows = resolve_shares(\n        amount,\n        [{\"user_id\": user.id} for user in users],\n        \"equal\",\n    )\n    for row in rows:\n        db.add(\n            ExpenseParticipant(\n                expense_id=expense.id,\n                user_id=row[\"user_id\"],\n                weight=row[\"weight\"],\n                share_amount=row[\"share_amount\"],\n            )\n        )\n    return expense\n\n\ndef _add_place_report(\n    db: Session,\n    *,\n    activity: Activity,\n    trip: Trip | None,\n    reporter: User,\n    category: str,\n    value: dict,\n    note: str | None,\n    observed_at: datetime,\n    source_type: str = \"community\",\n    confidence: float = 0.6,\n    verified: bool = False,\n) -> PlaceReport:\n    report = PlaceReport(\n        activity_id=activity.id,\n        place_id=activity.place_id,\n        trip_id=trip.id if trip else None,\n        category=category,\n        value=value,\n        note=note,\n        observed_at=observed_at,\n        source_type=source_type,\n        confidence=confidence,\n        verified=verified,\n        reporter_id=reporter.id,\n    )\n    db.add(report)\n    db.flush()\n    return report\n\n\ndef _persist_recommendation_batch(\n    db: Session,\n    trip: Trip,\n    members: list[TripMember],\n    user: User,\n    *,\n    mode: str,\n    for_date: date,\n) -> RecommendationBatch | None:\n    result = generate_recommendations(\n        db, trip, members, mode=mode, for_date=for_date, limit=6\n    )\n    if result.get(\"error\") or not result.get(\"items\"):\n        return None\n    meta = {\n        **result[\"meta\"],\n        \"mode_meta\": result[\"mode_meta\"],\n        \"clarifying_question\": result.get(\"clarifying_question\"),\n        \"exclusion_reasons\": result.get(\"exclusion_reasons\", {}),\n        \"target_member\": result[\"target\"].label if result.get(\"target\") else None,\n    }\n    batch = RecommendationBatch(\n        trip_id=trip.id,\n        mode=mode,\n        for_date=for_date,\n        model_version=ENGINE_VERSION,\n        meta=meta,\n        created_by=user.id,\n    )\n    db.add(batch)\n    db.flush()\n    for rank, ranked in enumerate(result[\"items\"], start=1):\n        db.add(\n            Recommendation(\n                batch_id=batch.id,\n                trip_id=trip.id,\n                activity_id=ranked.activity.id,\n                rank=rank,\n                score=ranked.score,\n                average_fit=ranked.average_fit,\n                minimum_fit=ranked.minimum_fit,\n                fairness_spread=ranked.fairness_spread,\n                novelty=ranked.novelty,\n                penalties=ranked.penalties,\n                explanation=ranked.explanation,\n                status=\"suggested\",\n            )\n        )\n    audit(\n mode, \"for_date\": for_date.isoformat()},\n    )\n    return batch\n\n\ndef seed_if_needed(db: Session) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Populate the demo dataset once. def search_activities(
    db: Session,
    *,
    q: str | None = None,
    destination_id: str | None = None,
    tags: list[str] | None = None,
    max_budget: float | None = None,
    max_duration: int | None = None,
    indoor: bool | None = None,
    accessible: bool = False,
    lens: str = "balanced",
    dna: dict[str, float] | None = None,
    limit: int = 40,
) -> list[dict]:
    query = db.query(Activity)
    if destination_id:
        query = query.filter(Activity.destination_id == destination_id)
    if q:
        like = f"%{q.lower()}%"
        query = query.filter(Activity.name.ilike(like) | Activity.description.ilike(like))
    activities = query.all()
    places = {place.id: place for place in db.query(Place).all()}
    destinations = {dest.id: dest for dest in db.query(Destination).all()}
    wanted = {normalize_tag(tag) for tag in (tags or [])}
    dna = dna or {}

    scored = []
    for activity in activities:
        activity_tag_map = activity_tags(activity)
        if wanted and not wanted.intersection(activity_tag_map):
            continue
        if max_budget is not None and activity.price_estimate > max_budget:
            continue
        if max_duration is not None and activity.duration_minutes > max_duration:
            continue
        if indoor is not None and activity.indoor != indoor:
            continue
        if accessible and activity.wheelchair_accessible is not True:
            # Unknown accessibility is not treated as accessible (F41 honesty).
            continue
        personal = 0.25 + 0.75 * _cosine(activity_tag_map, dna) if dna else 0.5
        scored.append(
            {
                "activity": activity,
                "place": places.get(activity.place_id),
                "destination": destinations.get(activity.destination_id),
                "personal_fit": round(personal * 100, 1),
                "tag_map": activity_tag_map,
            }
        )

    if lens == "iconic":
        scored.sort(
            key=lambda item: (
                item["activity"].iconic,
                item["activity"].popularity,
                item["personal_fit"],
            ),
            reverse=True,
        )
    elif lens == "similar":
        iconic = [item for item in scored if item["activity"].iconic]
        alternatives = [item for item in scored if not item["activity"].iconic]
        for item in alternatives:
            best = 0.0
            best_name = None
            for anchor in iconic:
                similarity = _cosine(item["tag_map"], anchor["tag_map"])
                if similarity > best:
                    best = similarity
                    best_name = anchor["activity"].name
            item["similar_to"] = best_name if best >= 0.35 else None
            item["similarity"] = round(best, 2)
        alternatives.sort(
            key=lambda item: (item.get("similarity", 0), item["personal_fit"]), reverse=True
        )
        others = [item for item in scored if not item["activity"].iconic]
        scored = others
    elif lens == "balanced":
        iconic = sorted(
            [item for item in scored if item["activity"].iconic],
            key=lambda item: item["personal_fit"],
            reverse=True,
        )
        other = sorted(
            [item for item in scored if not item["activity"].iconic],
            key=lambda item: item["personal_fit"],
            reverse=True,
        )
        mixed = []
        while iconic or other:
            if iconic:
                mixed.append(iconic.pop(0))
            if other:
                mixed.append(other.pop(0))
        scored = mixed
    else:
        scored.sort(key=lambda item: item["personal_fit"], reverse=True)

    return [
        {
            "activity": item["activity"],
            "place": item["place"],
            "destination": item["destination"],
            "personal_fit": item["personal_fit"],
            "similar_to": item.get("similar_to"),
            "similarity": item.get("similarity"),
            "respect_note": (
                item["place"].respect_note
                if item["place"] and item["place"].fragile
                else None
            ),
        }
        for item in scored[:limit]
    ]

@router.post("/{trip_id}/proposals/{proposal_id}/approve")
async def approve_proposal(
    trip_id: str,
    proposal_id: str,
    payload: ApprovalIn,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user, ADMIN_ROLES)
    proposal = db.get(ItineraryProposal, proposal_id)
    if not proposal or proposal.trip_id != trip.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Proposal not found")
    if proposal.status != "open":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="This proposal is no longer open")
    if not payload.approval:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Use the reject action instead")

    operations = _build_proposal_operations(db, trip, proposal)
    conflicts = _pact_conflicts(db, trip, operations)
    if conflicts:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=409,
            detail={
                "message": "This change breaks the Journey Pact.",
                "conflicts": conflicts,
            },
        )

    members = (
        db.query(TripMember)
        .filter(TripMember.trip_id == trip.id, TripMember.status == "active")
        .all()
    )
    for operation in operations:
        if operation["op"] != "add":
            continue
        for member in members:
            if member.budget_limit is not None and operation["cost"] > member.budget_limit:
                raise HTTPException(
                    status_code=409,
                    detail={
                        "message": "At least one member's stated hard budget limit would be exceeded.",
                        "item": operation["title"],
                    },
                )

    itinerary = _get_itinerary(db, trip)
    created_items: list[ItineraryItem] = []
    for operation in operations:
        if operation["op"] == "cancel":
            item = db.get(ItineraryItem, operation["item_id"])
            if item:
                item.status = "cancelled"
                item.updated_at = utcnow()
            continue
        item = ItineraryItem(
            itinerary_id=itinerary.id,
            trip_id=trip.id,
            day=operation["day"],
            start_time=operation["start_time"],
            title=operation["title"],
            activity_id=operation["activity_id"],
            place_id=operation["place_id"],
            notes=operation.get("notes"),
            cost_estimate=operation["cost"],
            created_by=user.id,
            sort_order=_next_sort_order(db, trip.id, operation["day"]),
        )
        db.add(item)
        created_items.append(item)

    proposal.status = "approved"
    proposal.decided_by = user.id
    proposal.decided_at = utcnow()
    db.add(
        ItineraryApproval(
            proposal_id=proposal.id, user_id=user.id, approval=True
        )
    )
    db.flush()
    record_itinerary_version(
        db, itinerary, user_id=user.id, note=f"Approved: {proposal.title}"
    )
    audit(
        db,
        action="proposal.approve",
        entity_type="itinerary_proposal",
        entity_id=proposal.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
    )
    notify_trip_members(
        db,
        trip,
        kind="proposal_approved",
        title=f"Approved: {proposal.title}",
        body=f"{user.display_name} confirmed the change with the group.",
        link=f"/trips/{trip.id}/itinerary",
        exclude_user_id=user.id,
    )
    total_delta = round(sum(operation.get("cost", 0) for operation in operations), 2)
    db.commit()
    await manager.broadcast(
        trip.id,
        event_payload(
            "proposal.approved",
            trip_id=trip.id,
            proposal_id=proposal.id,
            version=itinerary.confirmed_version,
        ),
    )
    return {
        **proposal_out(db, proposal, user.id),
        "confirmed_version": itinerary.confirmed_version,
        "created_items": _serialize_items(db, created_items, user.id),
        "cost_impact": {
            "total_delta": total_delta,
            "per_member_estimate": round(total_delta / max(1, len(members)), 2),
            "currency": trip.currency,
        },
    }

@router.post("/{trip_id}/proposals", status_code=201)
async def create_proposal(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: ProposalCreate,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    if payload.kind == "add_activity" and not payload.activity_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="activity_id is required for add_activity")
    if payload.kind == "replace_item" and (not payload.activity_id or not payload.target_item_id):
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=422,
            detail="replace_item needs both activity_id and target_item_id",
        )
    if payload.kind == "remove_item" and not payload.target_item_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="target_item_id is required for remove_item")

    proposal = ItineraryProposal(
        trip_id=trip.id,
        kind=payload.kind,
        title=payload.title,
        summary=payload.summary,
        target_day=payload.day,
        created_by=user.id,
        payload={
            "activity_id": payload.activity_id,
            "day": payload.day.isoformat() if payload.day else None,
            "start_time": payload.start_time,
            "target_item_id": payload.target_item_id,
            **payload.payload,
        },
    )
    db.add(proposal)
    db.flush()
    try:
        impact = _proposal_impact(db, trip, proposal)
    except HTTPException:
        db.rollback()
        raise
    audit(
        db,
        action="proposal.create",
        entity_type="itinerary_proposal",
        entity_id=proposal.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
        detail={"kind": proposal.kind, "title": proposal.title},
    )
    notify_trip_members(
        db,
        trip,
        kind="proposal_created",
        title=f"New proposal: {proposal.title}",
        body=f"{user.display_name} asked the group to decide.",
        link=f"/trips/{trip.id}/voting",
        exclude_user_id=user.id,
    )
    db.commit()
    await manager.broadcast(
        trip.id,
        event_payload("proposal.created", trip_id=trip.id, proposal_id=proposal.id),
    )
    return {**proposal_out(db, proposal, user.id), "impact": impact}

@router.get("/{trip_id}/pact")
def get_pact(
    trip_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    pact = db.query(JourneyPact).filter(JourneyPact.trip_id == trip.id).first()
    if not pact:
        return {"pact": None}
    return {
        "pact": {
            "id": pact.id,
            "must_do": pact.must_do,
            "flexible": pact.flexible,
            "individual_limits": pact.individual_limits,
            "confirmed_times": pact.confirmed_times,
            "exceptions": pact.exceptions,
            "updated_at": pact.updated_at,
        }
    }


@router.put("/{trip_id}/pact")
def upsert_pact(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: PactUpsert,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user, {"owner", "admin"})
    pact = db.query(JourneyPact).filter(JourneyPact.trip_id == trip.id).first()
    if not pact:
        pact = JourneyPact(trip_id=trip.id, created_by=user.id)
        db.add(pact)
    pact.must_do = payload.must_do
    pact.flexible = payload.flexible
    pact.individual_limits = payload.individual_limits
    pact.confirmed_times = payload.confirmed_times
    pact.exceptions = payload.exceptions
    audit(
        db,
        action="pact.update",
        entity_type="journey_pact",
        entity_id=pact.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
    )
    db.commit()
    return {"ok": True}

4	export class ApiError extends Error {
5	  status: number;
6	  detail: unknown;
7	
8	  constructor(status: number, detail: unknown) {
9	    const message =
10	      typeof detail === "string"
11	        ? detail
12	        : Array.isArray(detail)
13	          ? detail
14	              .map((item) =>
15	                typeof item === "object" && item && "msg" in item
16	                  ? String((item as { msg: unknown }).msg)
17	                  : String(item),
18	              )
19	              .join(" · ")
20	          : detail && typeof detail === "object" && "message" in detail
21	            ? String((detail as { message: unknown }).message)
22	            : `Request failed (${status})`;
23	    super(message);
24	    this.name = "ApiError";
25	    this.status = status;
26	    this.detail = detail;
27	  }
28	}

33	    const raw = window.localStorage.getItem("safar-auth");
34	    if (!raw) return null;
35	    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as { state?: { token?: string | null } };
36	    return parsed.state?.token || null;
37	  } catch {
38	    return null;
39	  }
40	}
41	
42	type Options = Omit<RequestInit, "body"> & { body?: unknown; raw?: boolean };
43	
44	export async function api<T>(path: string, options: Options = {}): Promise<T> {
45	  const token = tokenFromStore();
46	  const headers = new Headers(options.headers);
47	  if (options.body !== undefined && !(options.body instanceof FormData)) {
48	    headers.set("Content-Type", "application/json");
49	  }
50	  headers.set("Accept", "application/json");
51	  if (token) headers.set("Authorization", `Bearer ${token}`);
52	
53	  const response = await fetch(`${API_URL}${path}`, {
54	    ...options,
55	    headers,
56	    body:
57	      options.body === undefined
58	        ? undefined
59	        : options.body instanceof FormData
60	          ? options.body
61	          : JSON.stringify(options.body),
62	    cache: "no-store",
63	  });
64	
65	  if (response.status === 401 && typeof window !== "undefined") {
66	    window.dispatchEvent(new Event("safar:unauthorized"));
67	  }
68	
69	  if (!response.ok) {
70	    let detail: unknown = response.statusText;
71	    try {
72	      const data = await response.json();
73	      detail = data.detail ?? data;
74	    } catch {
75	      try {
76	        detail = await response.text();
77	      } catch {
78	        /* ignore */
79	      }
80	    }
81	    throw new ApiError(response.status, detail);
82	  }
83	
84	  if (response.status === 204) return undefined as T;
85	  const contentType = response.headers.get("content-type") || "";
86	  if (options.raw || contentType.includes("text/html") || contentType.includes("text/csv")) {
87	    return (await response.text()) as T;
88	  }
89	  return (await response.json()) as T;
90	}
91	
92	export function wsUrl(tripId: string): string | null {
93	  const token = tokenFromStore();
94	  if (!token) return null;
95	  const base = API_URL.replace(/^http/, "ws");
96	  return `${base}/ws/trips/${tripId}?token=${encodeURIComponent(token)}`;
97	}

60	export function daysBetween(start: string, end: string) {

62	  const b = new Date(`${end.slice(0, 10)}T12:00:00`).getTime();

66	export function todayIso() {

70	}

72	export function daysUntil(start: string) {

74	  const today = new Date(`${todayIso()}T12:00:00`).getTime();
75	  return Math.round((target - today) / 86400000);

81	  const end = daysUntil(trip.end_date);
82	  if (start > 0) return `In ${start} day${start === 1 ? "" : "s"}`;
83	  if (end >= 0) return "Happening now";
84	  return "Past";

@router.post("/{trip_id}/shadowplans", status_code=201)
def create_shadowplan(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: ShadowplanCreate,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    item = db.get(ItineraryItem, payload.item_id)
    if not item or item.trip_id != trip.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Itinerary item not found")
    activity = db.get(Activity, payload.backup_activity_id)
    if not activity or activity.destination_id != trip.destination_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Backup must be a catalog activity in this destination")
    plan = Shadowplan(
        trip_id=trip.id,
        itinerary_item_id=item.id,
        backup_activity_id=activity.id,
        notes=payload.notes,
        readiness={"status": "ready", "checked_at": utcnow().isoformat()},
        created_by=user.id,
    )
    db.add(plan)
    audit(
        db,
        action="shadowplan.create",
        entity_type="shadowplan",
        entity_id=plan.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
    )
    db.commit()
    return {"id": plan.id, "backup_activity_id": activity.id, "readiness": plan.readiness}

@router.post("/{trip_id}/recommendations/{recommendation_id}/feedback")
def recommendation_feedback(
    trip_id: str,
    recommendation_id: str,
    payload: RecommendationFeedbackIn,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    rec = db.get(Recommendation, recommendation_id)
    if not rec or rec.trip_id != trip.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Recommendation not found")
    activity = db.get(Activity, rec.activity_id)
    if not activity:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Activity not found")

    row = (
        db.query(RecommendationFeedback)
        .filter(
            RecommendationFeedback.recommendation_id == rec.id,
            RecommendationFeedback.user_id == user.id,
        )
        .first()
    )
    if not row:
        row = RecommendationFeedback(
            recommendation_id=rec.id, user_id=user.id, sentiment=payload.sentiment
        )
        db.add(row)
    row.sentiment = payload.sentiment
    row.consented = payload.consented

    upsert_activity_feedback(
        db,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
        activity=activity,
        sentiment=payload.sentiment,
        consented=payload.consented,
    )
    dna_update = apply_feedback_to_dna(
        db, user, activity, payload.sentiment, consented=payload.consented
    )
    audit(
        db,
        action="recommendation.feedback",
        entity_type="recommendation",
        entity_id=rec.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
        detail={"sentiment": payload.sentiment, "consented": payload.consented},
    )
    db.commit()
    return {
        "ok": True,
        "sentiment": payload.sentiment,
        "consented": payload.consented,
        "journey_dna": dna_update,
        "note": (
            "Feedback stays private to you. It shapes your Journey DNA only while you consent."
            if payload.consented
            else "Saved privately. Because consent was declined, your Journey DNA was not changed."
        ),
    }


def _create_proposal(
    db: Session,
    trip: Trip,
    user: User,
    *,
    kind: str,
    title: str,
    summary: str | None,
    day: date | None,
    payload: dict,
) -> tuple[ItineraryProposal, dict]:
    proposal = ItineraryProposal(
        trip_id=trip.id,
        kind=kind,
        title=title,
        summary=summary,
        target_day=day,
        created_by=user.id,
        payload=payload,
    )
    db.add(proposal)
    db.flush()
    impact = _proposal_impact(db, trip, proposal)
    audit(
        db,
        action="proposal.create",
        entity_type="itinerary_proposal",
        entity_id=proposal.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
        detail={"kind": kind, "title": title, "origin": "engine"},
    )
    notify_trip_members(
        db,
        trip,
        kind="proposal_created",
        title=f"New proposal: {title}",
        body=f"{user.display_name} turned an engine suggestion into a group decision.",
        link=f"/trips/{trip.id}/voting",
        exclude_user_id=user.id,
    )
    return proposal, impact


@router.post("/{trip_id}/recommendations/{recommendation_id}/propose", status_code=201)
async def propose_recommendation(
    trip_id: str,
    recommendation_id: str,
    payload: RecommendationProposeIn,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    _within_trip(trip, payload.day)
    rec = db.get(Recommendation, recommendation_id)
    if not rec or rec.trip_id != trip.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Recommendation not found")
    activity = _activity_in_trip(db, trip, rec.activity_id)

    proposal, impact = _create_proposal(
        db,
        trip,
        user,
        kind="add_activity",
        title=f"Add {activity.name}",
        summary=(
            "Suggested by the Group Experience Engine. "
            "The group must approve before the itinerary changes."
        ),
        day=payload.day,
        payload={
            "activity_id": activity.id,
            "day": payload.day.isoformat(),
            "start_time": payload.start_time,
            "recommendation_id": rec.id,
            "source": ENGINE_VERSION,
        },
    )
    rec.status = "proposed"
    db.commit()
    await manager.broadcast(
        trip.id,
        event_payload("proposal.created", trip_id=trip.id, proposal_id=proposal.id),
    )
    return {**proposal_out(db, proposal, user.id), "impact": impact}

@router.post("/{trip_id}/twin/compare")
def twin_compare(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: TwinCompareIn,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    if not payload.activity_ids:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=422,
            detail="Provide at least one alternative activity to compare.",
        )
    for activity_id in payload.activity_ids:
        _activity_in_trip(db, trip, activity_id)
    if len(set(payload.activity_ids)) != len(payload.activity_ids):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Duplicate activities in the alternative")
    day = payload.day or date.today()
    _within_trip(trip, day)
    items = (
        db.query(ItineraryItem)
        .filter(
            ItineraryItem.trip_id == trip.id,
            ItineraryItem.day == day,
            ItineraryItem.status == "confirmed",
        )
        .all()
    )
    contexts = build_member_contexts(db, trip, _active_members(db, trip.id), day)
    result = twin_service.compare_plan(db, trip, contexts, items, payload.activity_ids, day)
    result["generated_at"] = result["generated_at"].isoformat()
    return result


@router.post("/{trip_id}/twin/propose", status_code=201)
async def twin_propose(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: TwinProposeIn,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    day = payload.day or trip.start_date
    _within_trip(trip, day)
    if len(set(payload.activity_ids)) != len(payload.activity_ids):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Duplicate activities in the alternative")
    activities = [_activity_in_trip(db, trip, activity_id) for activity_id in payload.activity_ids]
    proposal, impact = _create_proposal(
        db,
        trip,
        user,
        kind="twin_adopt",
        title="Adopt a Trip Twin alternative",
        summary=(
            f"Replaces {day.isoformat()} with: "
            + ", ".join(activity.name for activity in activities)
            + ". Read-only comparison only; adoption needs group approval."
        ),
        day=day,
        payload={
            "day": day.isoformat(),
            "items": [
                {"activity_id": activity.id, "day": day.isoformat(), "start_time": "09:00"}
                for activity in activities
            ],
        },
    )
    db.commit()
    await manager.broadcast(
        trip.id,
        event_payload("proposal.created", trip_id=trip.id, proposal_id=proposal.id),
    )
    return {**proposal_out(db, proposal, user.id), "impact": impact}

@router.post("/{trip_id}/rescue/propose", status_code=201)
async def rescue_propose(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: RescueProposeIn,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    if not payload.items:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=422,
            detail="Select at least one replacement from the rescue analysis.",
        )
    items = []
    for entry in payload.items:
        _within_trip(trip, entry.day)
        item = db.get(ItineraryItem, entry.item_id)
        if not item or item.trip_id != trip.id or item.status != "confirmed":
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="A rescue target item was not found")
        activity = _activity_in_trip(db, trip, entry.activity_id)
        items.append(
            {
                "item_id": item.id,
                "activity_id": activity.id,
                "day": entry.day.isoformat(),
                "start_time": entry.start_time,
                "notes": f"Trip Rescue ({payload.kind}) replacement",
                "title": item.title,
            }
        )
    title = f"Trip Rescue: {payload.kind.replace('_', ' ').title()}"
    summary = (
        payload.note
        or "Replaces affected activities after a disruption. Shown as changes only; nothing is applied until approved."
    )
    pact = db.query(JourneyPact).filter(JourneyPact.trip_id == trip.id).first()
    proposal, impact = _create_proposal(
        db,
        trip,
        user,
        kind="rescue",
        title=title,
        summary=summary,
        day=payload.items[0].day,
        payload={
            "kind": payload.kind,
            "extra_minutes": payload.extra_minutes,
            "note": payload.note,
            "items": items,
        },
    )
    db.commit()
    await manager.broadcast(
        trip.id,
        event_payload("proposal.created", trip_id=trip.id, proposal_id=proposal.id),
    )
    response = {**proposal_out(db, proposal, user.id), "impact": impact}
    if pact:
        response["pact"] = {
            "must_do": pact.must_do or [],
            "flexible": pact.flexible or [],
            "note": "Pact conflicts block approval until the group adds an exception.",
        }
    return response


@router.post("/{trip_id}/negotiate")
def negotiate(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: NegotiateIn,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    for activity_id in set(payload.option_a + payload.option_b):
        _activity_in_trip(db, trip, activity_id)
    return rescue_service.compromise(
        db,
        trip,
        _active_members(db, trip.id),
        payload.option_a,
        payload.option_b,
    )

    def best(pool: list[Activity]):
        scored = [ranked[activity.id] for activity in pool if activity.id in ranked]
        return max(scored, key=lambda item: item.minimum_fit) if scored else None

    best_a = best(a)
    best_b = best(b)
    if not best_a or not best_b:
        return {
            "status": "no_feasible_option",
            "message": "One or both options violate a hard constraint for at least one member.",
        }

    compromise_choice = best_a if best_a.minimum_fit >= best_b.minimum_fit else best_b
    other = best_b if compromise_choice is best_a else best_a
    benefits = sorted(
