@router.post("/trips/{trip_id}/places/{activity_id}/expectation")
def expectation_check(
    trip_id: str,
    activity_id: str,
    payload: ExpectationIn,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    activity = _activity_for_trip(db, trip, activity_id)
    return place_service.expectation_check(db, activity, payload.claim)


@router.get("/trips/{trip_id}/inspirations")
def list_inspirations(
    trip_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    rows = (
        db.query(SavedInspiration)
        .filter(
            SavedInspiration.trip_id == trip.id,
            SavedInspiration.user_id == user.id,
        )
        .order_by(SavedInspiration.created_at.desc())
        .all()
    )
    return {
        "items": [
            {
                "id": row.id,
                "source_type": row.source_type,
                "content": row.content,
                "status": row.status,
                "extracted": row.extracted or {},
                "created_at": row.created_at,
            }
            for row in rows
        ]
    }


@router.post("/trips/{trip_id}/inspirations", status_code=201)
def import_inspiration(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: InspirationIn,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    if payload.trip_id and payload.trip_id != trip.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Trip mismatch")
    inspiration = SavedInspiration(
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
        source_type=payload.source_type,
        content=payload.content,
        status="pending",
    )
    db.add(inspiration)
    db.flush()
    extraction = discovery_service.dream_import(db, user.id, inspiration)
    inspiration.status = "extracted"
    audit(
        db,
        action="inspiration.import",
        entity_type="saved_inspiration",
        entity_id=inspiration.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
        detail={"source_type": payload.source_type},
    )
    db.commit()
    return {
        "id": inspiration.id,
        "source_type": inspiration.source_type,
        "status": inspiration.status,
        "extraction": extraction,
        "disclosure": (
            "Candidates are suggestions only. Confirm them before adding anything to the itinerary."
        ),
    }


def _blocked_ids(db: Session, user_id: str) -> set[str]:
    rows = (
        db.query(UserBlock)
        .filter((UserBlock.blocker_id == user_id) | (UserBlock.blocked_id == user_id))
        .all()
    )
    blocked: set[str] = set()
    for row in rows:
        blocked.add(row.blocker_id)
        blocked.add(row.blocked_id)
    blocked.discard(user_id)
    return blocked


@router.get("/serendipity/matches")
def serendipity_matches(
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db)
):
    result = discovery_service.serendipity_suggestions(db, user)
    blocked = _blocked_ids(db, user.id)
    result["matches"] = [
        match for match in result.get("matches", []) if match["user"]["id"] not in blocked
    ]
    db.commit()
    return result


@router.get("/serendipity/requests")
def list_connection_requests(
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db)
):
    rows = (
        db.query(ConnectionRequest)
        .filter(
            (ConnectionRequest.from_user_id == user.id)
            | (ConnectionRequest.to_user_id == user.id)
        )
        .order_by(ConnectionRequest.created_at.desc())
        .all()
    )
    users = {
        person.id: person
        for person in db.query(User)
        .filter(User.id.in_({row.from_user_id for row in rows} | {row.to_user_id for row in rows}))
        .all()
    }
    return {
        "items": [
            {
                "id": row.id,
                "direction": "outgoing" if row.from_user_id == user.id else "incoming",
                "from_user": user_public(users.get(row.from_user_id)),
                "to_user": user_public(users.get(row.to_user_id)),
                "message": row.message,
                "status": row.status,
                "created_at": row.created_at,
                "decided_at": row.decided_at,
            }
            for row in rows
        ],
        "disclosure": "Contact requires mutual acceptance. Exact locations are never shared.",
    }


@router.post("/serendipity/requests", status_code=201)
def create_connection_request(
    payload: ConnectionCreate,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    if payload.to_user_id == user.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="You cannot connect with yourself")
    target = db.get(User, payload.to_user_id)
    if not target or target.deleted_at or not target.is_active:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Traveller not found")
    target_profile = db.query(Profile).filter(Profile.user_id == target.id).first()
    my_profile = db.query(Profile).filter(Profile.user_id == user.id).first()
    if not my_profile or not my_profile.allow_discovery:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=403,
            detail="Enable traveller discovery in your privacy settings first",
        )
    if not target_profile or not target_profile.allow_discovery or not target_profile.public_profile:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="This traveller is not open to contact")
    if target.id in _blocked_ids(db, user.id):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="This traveller is not open to contact")
    existing = (
        db.query(ConnectionRequest)
        .filter(
            ConnectionRequest.status.in_(["pending", "accepted"]),
            (
                ((ConnectionRequest.from_user_id == user.id) & (ConnectionRequest.to_user_id == target.id))
                | ((ConnectionRequest.from_user_id == target.id) & (ConnectionRequest.to_user_id == user.id))
            ),
        )
        .first()
    )
    if existing:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=409,
            detail="A request already exists between you two",
        )
    if payload.trip_id:
        _trip(db, payload.trip_id, user)
    request = ConnectionRequest(
        from_user_id=user.id,
        to_user_id=target.id,
        trip_id=payload.trip_id,
        message=payload.message,
    )
    db.add(request)
    db.add(
        Notification(
            user_id=target.id,
            kind="connection_request",
            title=f"{user.display_name} would like to connect",
            body="Accept only if you are comfortable. Exact locations are never shared.",
            link="/connections",
        )
    )
    audit(
        db,
        action="connection.request",
        entity_type="connection_request",
        entity_id=request.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=payload.trip_id,
    )
    db.commit()
    return {
        "id": request.id,
        "status": request.status,
        "note": "The other traveller must accept before contact details are exchanged.",
    }


@router.post("/serendipity/requests/{request_id}/decide")
def decide_connection_request(
    request_id: str,
    payload: ConnectionDecision,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    request = db.get(ConnectionRequest, request_id)
    if not request or request.to_user_id != user.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Request not found")
    if request.status != "pending":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="This request was already decided")
    request.status = "accepted" if payload.accept else "declined"
    request.decided_at = utcnow()
    match = (
        db.query(TravellerMatch)
        .filter(
            TravellerMatch.user_a_id == request.from_user_id,
            TravellerMatch.user_b_id == user.id,
        )
        .first()
    )
    if match:
        match.status = "connected" if payload.accept else "declined"
    db.add(
        Notification(
            user_id=request.from_user_id,
            kind="connection_decision",
            title=(
                f"{user.display_name} accepted your connection"
                if payload.accept
                else f"{user.display_name} declined your connection"
            ),
            body="Meet only in public places and share only what you choose." if payload.accept else None,
            link="/connections",
        )
    )
    audit(
        db,
        action="connection.decide",
        entity_type="connection_request",
        entity_id=request.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        detail={"accept": payload.accept},
    )
    db.commit()
    return {
        "ok": True,
        "status": request.status,
        "disclosure": "Both travellers have now agreed. Keep meetups in public places.",
    }


def _circle_out(db: Session, circle: TravelCircle, viewer_id: str | None) -> dict:
    member_count = db.query(CircleMember).filter(CircleMember.circle_id == circle.id).count()
    joined = (
        db.query(CircleMember)
        .filter(CircleMember.circle_id == circle.id, CircleMember.user_id == viewer_id)
        .first()
        if viewer_id
        else None
    )
    return {
        "id": circle.id,
        "slug": circle.slug,
        "name": circle.name,
        "description": circle.description,
        "interests": circle.interests or [],
        "cover_image": circle.cover_image,
        "member_count": member_count,
        "joined": bool(joined),
        "created_at": circle.created_at,
    }

@router.get("/{trip_id}/offline")
def offline_snapshot(
    trip_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    from app.models import Activity, Itinerary, ItineraryItem, Place

    items = (
        db.query(ItineraryItem)
        .filter(ItineraryItem.trip_id == trip.id, ItineraryItem.status == "confirmed")
        .order_by(ItineraryItem.day, ItineraryItem.sort_order, ItineraryItem.start_time)
        .all()
    )
    activities = {}
    places = {}
    if items:
        activity_ids = [item.activity_id for item in items if item.activity_id]
        activities = {
            activity.id: activity
            for activity in db.query(Activity).filter(Activity.id.in_(activity_ids)).all()
        } if activity_ids else {}
        place_ids = [activity.place_id for activity in activities.values() if activity.place_id]
        places = {
            place.id: place
            for place in db.query(Place).filter(Place.id.in_(place_ids)).all()
        } if place_ids else {}
    itinerary = db.query(Itinerary).filter(Itinerary.trip_id == trip.id).first()
    pact = db.query(JourneyPact).filter(JourneyPact.trip_id == trip.id).first()
    members = (
        db.query(TripMember)
        .filter(TripMember.trip_id == trip.id, TripMember.status == "active")
        .all()
    )
    return {
        "generated_at": utcnow().isoformat(),
        "stale_after": (datetime.combine(trip.end_date, datetime.min.time()) + timedelta(days=7)).isoformat(),
        "trip": {
            "id": trip.id,
            "name": trip.name,
            "destination": trip.destination_name,
            "start_date": trip.start_date,
            "end_date": trip.end_date,

                "day": item.day,
                "start_time": item.start_time,
                "title": item.title,
                "cost_estimate": item.cost_estimate,
                "is_protected": item.is_protected,
                "place": (
                    {
                        "name": places[activities[item.activity_id].place_id].name,
                        "address": places[activities[item.activity_id].place_id].address,
                        "lat": places[activities[item.activity_id].place_id].lat,
                        "lon": places[activities[item.activity_id].place_id].lon,

                    if item.activity_id in activities
                    and activities[item.activity_id].place_id in places
                    else None

            }

@router.get("/me/thread")
def journey_thread(user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    """Carry favourites and traditions from previous trips (F47)."""
    today = date.today()
    memberships = db.query(TripMember).filter(TripMember.user_id == user.id).all()
    completed_ids = []
    for membership in memberships:
        trip = db.get(Trip, membership.trip_id)
        if trip and not trip.deleted_at and (
            trip.status == "completed" or trip.end_date < today
        ):
            completed_ids.append(trip.id)
    loved = (
        db.query(ActivityFeedback)
        .filter(
            ActivityFeedback.user_id == user.id,
            ActivityFeedback.sentiment.in_(["loved", "would_return"]),
            ActivityFeedback.consented.is_(True),
        )
        .order_by(ActivityFeedback.created_at.desc())
        .all()
    )
    activities = {}
    for row in loved:
        activity = db.get(Activity, row.activity_id)
        if not activity:
            continue
        key = activity.id
        entry = activities.setdefault(
            key,
            {
                "activity_id": key,
                "name": activity.name,
                "price_estimate": activity.price_estimate,
                "duration_minutes": activity.duration_minutes,
                "sentiments": [],
            },
        )
        entry["sentiments"].append(row.sentiment)
    return {
        "completed_trips": len(completed_ids),
        "traditions": sorted(
            activities.values(), key=lambda entry: len(entry["sentiments"]), reverse=True
        )[:10],
        "note": (
            "Only outcomes you consented to share are used. You can repeat, modify or avoid "
            "any of these in a new journey."
        ),
    }

"""Trip workspace WebSocket channel for collaborative updates (F05).

Browsers cannot set Authorization headers on WebSocket handshakes, so the
short-lived access token is passed as a query parameter and verified before
the connection is accepted. Membership is re-checked on every connection.
"""

from fastapi import APIRouter, Query, WebSocket, WebSocketDisconnect

from app.core.realtime import manager
from app.core.security import decode_access_token
from app.db.session import SessionLocal
from app.models import Trip, TripMember, User
from app.services.common import event_payload

router = APIRouter()


@router.websocket("/ws/trips/{trip_id}")
async def trip_socket(
    websocket: WebSocket,
    trip_id: str,
    token: str = Query(..., min_length=20),
):
    payload = decode_access_token(token)
    if not payload or not payload.get("sub"):
        await websocket.close(code=4401)
        return

    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        user = db.get(User, payload["sub"])
        if not user or not user.is_active or user.deleted_at:
            await websocket.close(code=4401)
            return
        trip = db.get(Trip, trip_id)
        if not trip or trip.deleted_at:
            await websocket.close(code=4404)
            return
        member = (
            db.query(TripMember)
            .filter(
                TripMember.trip_id == trip.id,
                TripMember.user_id == user.id,
                TripMember.status == "active",
            )
            .first()
        )
        if not member:
            await websocket.close(code=4404)
            return
        display_name = user.display_name
    finally:
        db.close()

    await manager.connect(trip_id, websocket)
    await websocket.send_json(
        event_payload(
            "connected",
            trip_id=trip_id,
            user=display_name,
            note="Live updates for this trip workspace only.",
        )
    )
    try:
        while True:
            message = await websocket.receive_text()
            if message.strip().lower() == "ping":
                await websocket.send_json(event_payload("pong", trip_id=trip_id))
    except WebSocketDisconnect:
        pass
    finally:
        await manager.disconnect(trip_id, websocket)

    activity = db.get(Activity, payload.activity_id)
    if not activity or activity.destination_id != trip.destination_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Activity not found for this trip")
    existing = (
        db.query(MaterialWatch)
        .filter(
            MaterialWatch.trip_id == trip.id,
            MaterialWatch.activity_id == activity.id,
            MaterialWatch.field == payload.field,
        )
        .first()
    )
    if existing:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="This field is already being watched")
    watch = MaterialWatch(
        trip_id=trip.id,
        activity_id=activity.id,
        field=payload.field,
        last_value={"value": _watch_value(activity, payload.field)},
        status="watching",
    )
    db.add(watch)
    audit(
        db,
        action="material_watch.create",
        entity_type="material_watch",
        entity_id=watch.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
        detail={"field": payload.field},
    )
    db.commit()
    return {
        "id": watch.id,
        "field": watch.field,
        "last_value": watch.last_value,
        "status": watch.status,
    }


@router.delete("/trips/{trip_id}/material-watch/{watch_id}")
def delete_watch(
    trip_id: str,
    watch_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, member = get_trip_and_member(trip_id, db, user)
    watch = db.get(MaterialWatch, watch_id)
    if not watch or watch.trip_id != trip.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Watch not found")
    db.delete(watch)
    audit(
        db,
        action="material_watch.delete",
        entity_type="material_watch",
        entity_id=watch_id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
    )
    db.commit()
    return {"ok": True}


@router.post("/trips/{trip_id}/material-watch/check")
def check_watches(
    trip_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = get_trip_and_member(trip_id, db, user)
    rows = db.query(MaterialWatch).filter(MaterialWatch.trip_id == trip.id).all()
    changed = []
    unchanged = 0
    for watch in rows:
        activity = db.get(Activity, watch.activity_id) if watch.activity_id else None
        if not activity:
            watch.status = "target_missing"
            watch.last_checked_at = utcnow()
            continue
        current = _watch_value(activity, watch.field)
        previous = (watch.last_value or {}).get("value")
        watch.last_checked_at = utcnow()
        if current != previous:
            watch.status = "changed"
            watch.last_value = {"value": current, "previous": previous}
            changed.append(
                {
                    "watch_id": watch.id,
                    "activity_id": activity.id,
                    "activity_name": activity.name,
                    "field": watch.field,
                    "previous": previous,
                    "current": current,
                }
            )
        else:
            watch.status = "watching"
            unchanged += 1
    if changed:
        notify_trip_members(
            db,
            trip,
            kind="material_change",
            title=f"{len(changed)} tracked fact(s) changed",
            body="Open Material Change Watch to review the differences. Nothing was changed in your plan.",
            link=f"/trips/{trip.id}/watch",
            exclude_user_id=None,
        )
    audit(
        db,
        action="material_watch.check",
        entity_type="trip",
        entity_id=trip.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
        detail={"changed": len(changed), "unchanged": unchanged},
    )
    db.commit()
    return {
        "checked": len(rows),
        "changed": changed,
        "unchanged": unchanged,
        "note": "Alerts are only sent when a value changes. Your confirmed plan is untouched.",
    }

@router.get("/admin/abuse-reports")
def list_abuse_reports(
    status: str = Query(default="open", pattern=r"^(open|resolved|dismissed|all)$"),
    user: User = Depends(require_admin),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    query = db.query(AbuseReport)
    if status != "all":
        query = query.filter(AbuseReport.status == status)
    rows = query.order_by(AbuseReport.created_at.desc()).limit(200).all()
    users = {
        person.id: person
        for person in db.query(User)
        .filter(User.id.in_({row.reporter_id for row in rows} | {row.target_user_id for row in rows if row.target_user_id}))
        .all()
    } if rows else {}
    return {
        "items": [
            {
                "id": row.id,
                "reporter": (
                    {
                        "id": users[row.reporter_id].id,
                        "display_name": users[row.reporter_id].display_name,
                    }
                    if row.reporter_id in users
                    else None
                ),
                "target_type": row.target_type,
                "target_id": row.target_id,
                "target_user_id": row.target_user_id,
                "reason": row.reason,
                "status": row.status,
                "reviewed_by": row.reviewed_by,
                "reviewed_at": row.reviewed_at,
                "created_at": row.created_at,
            }
            for row in rows
        ]
    }


@router.post("/admin/abuse-reports/{report_id}/decide")
def decide_abuse_report(
    report_id: str,
    payload: AbuseDecisionIn,
    user: User = Depends(require_admin),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    report = db.get(AbuseReport, report_id)
    if not report:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Report not found")
    if report.status != "open":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="This report was already reviewed")
    hidden = False
    if payload.decision == "hide_content":
        if report.target_type == "post" and report.target_id:
            post = db.get(CirclePost, report.target_id)
            if post:
                post.status = "removed"
                hidden = True
        elif report.target_type == "memory" and report.target_id:
            memory = db.get(TripMemory, report.target_id)
            if memory and memory.deleted_at is None:
                memory.visibility = "private"
                memory.approved = False
                hidden = True
        else:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=422,
                detail="Content can only be hidden for posts and memories; use warn otherwise",
            )
    report.status = "resolved" if payload.decision in {"hide_content", "warn"} else "dismissed"
    report.reviewed_by = user.id
    report.reviewed_at = utcnow()
    db.add(
        Notification(
            user_id=report.reporter_id,
            kind="moderation_update",
            title="Your report was reviewed",
            body="Moderators reviewed your report and recorded an outcome.",
            link="/settings",
        )
    )
    if payload.decision == "warn" and report.target_user_id:
        db.add(
            Notification(
                user_id=report.target_user_id,
                kind="moderation_warning",
                title="Community guidelines reminder",
                body=payload.note or "A moderator reviewed content connected to your account.",
                link="/settings",
            )
        )
    audit(
        db,
        action="abuse.decide",
        entity_type="abuse_report",
        entity_id=report.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        detail={"decision": payload.decision, "hidden": hidden},
    )
    db.commit()
    return {
        "ok": True,
        "status": report.status,
        "content_hidden": hidden,
        "note": "Reporter is notified without exposing reviewer identity.",
    }

def search_activities(
    q: str | None = Query(default=None, max_length=120),
    destination_id: str | None = None,
    tags: str | None = Query(default=None, max_length=200),
    max_budget: float | None = Query(default=None, ge=0),
    max_duration: int | None = Query(default=None, ge=15, le=1440),
    indoor: bool | None = None,
    accessible: bool = False,
    lens: str = Query(default="balanced", pattern=r"^(balanced|iconic|similar)$"),
    limit: int = Query(default=24, ge=1, le=60),
    user: User | None = Depends(get_optional_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    dna = discovery_service.dna_for_user(db, user.id) if user else None
    tag_list = [tag.strip() for tag in (tags or "").split(",") if tag.strip()]
    results = discovery_service.search_activities(
        db,
        q=q,
        destination_id=destination_id,
        tags=tag_list,
        max_budget=max_budget,
        max_duration=max_duration,
        indoor=indoor,
        accessible=accessible,
        lens=lens,
        dna=dna,
        limit=limit,
    )
    return {
        "lens": lens,
        "items": [
            {
                "activity": activity_out(item["activity"], item["place"], item["destination"]),
                "personal_fit": item["personal_fit"],
                "similar_to": item["similar_to"],

                "provenance": (

                    if (item["activity"].source_type or "").startswith("seed")

    }

@router.get("/{trip_id}/memory-studio")
def memory_studio(
    trip_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    memories = memory_service.visible_memories(db, trip.id, user.id)
    events = (
        db.query(MemoryEvent)
        .filter(MemoryEvent.trip_id == trip.id)
        .order_by(MemoryEvent.start_at)
        .all()
    )
    return {
        "memories": [memory_out(memory, user) for memory in memories],
        "events": [
            {
                "id": event.id,
                "title": event.title,
                "summary": event.summary,
                "start_at": event.start_at,
                "end_at": event.end_at,
                "memory_ids": event.memory_ids or [],
                "status": event.status,
            }
            for event in events
        ],
        "capabilities": {
            "event_grouping": "time + optional location proximity",
            "caption_grounding": "capture time, location and confirmed itinerary only",
            "image_embedding": False,
            "ocr": False,
            "speech_to_text": False,
        },
        "disclosure": (
            "Image embeddings, OCR and speech-to-text are not configured on this deployment. "
            "Suggestions use recorded metadata only."
        ),
    }


@router.post("/{trip_id}/memory-studio/suggest-events", status_code=201)
def suggest_events(
    trip_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    created = memory_service.suggest_events(db, trip, user.id)
    db.commit()
    return {
        "created": [
            {
                "id": event.id,
                "title": event.title,
                "summary": event.summary,
                "start_at": event.start_at,
                "memory_ids": event.memory_ids,
                "status": event.status,
            }
            for event in created
        ],
        "note": "Suggested groups stay unapproved until a contributor approves them.",
    }

from datetime import date

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.core.config import settings
from app.core.deps import get_current_user, get_db
from app.models import (
    Activity,
    ActivityFeedback,
    ConsentRecord,
    Expense,
    JourneyDNA,
    Profile,
    Trip,
    TripMember,
    TripMemory,
    User,
    UserBlock,
)
from app.models.models import utcnow
from app.schemas.schemas import (
    ConsentUpdate,
    DNAUpdate,
    ProfileUpdate,
    UserSettingsUpdate,
)
from app.services.common import DNA_DIMENSIONS, audit, clamp, default_dna, normalize_tag
from app.services.serializers import profile_out, user_out

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/users", tags=["users"])

CONSENT_KINDS = {"terms", "personalization", "analytics", "location", "marketing"}

DNA_SENTIMENT = {
    "loved": 2.0,
    "would_return": 1.5,
    "okay": 0.0,
    "not_for_me": -1.5,
    "too_expensive": -1.0,
    "too_far": -0.5,
}


def _get_dna(db: Session, user_id: str) -> JourneyDNA:
    row = db.query(JourneyDNA).filter(JourneyDNA.user_id == user_id).first()
    if not row:
        row = JourneyDNA(user_id=user_id, scores=default_dna(), source="explicit")
        db.add(row)
        db.flush()
    return row


def _consent_map(db: Session, user_id: str) -> dict:
    rows = (
        db.query(ConsentRecord)
        .filter(ConsentRecord.user_id == user_id)
        .order_by(ConsentRecord.created_at.desc())
        .all()
    )
    latest = {}
    for row in rows:
        latest.setdefault(row.kind, row)
    return {
        kind: {
            "granted": record.granted,
            "policy_version": record.policy_version,
            "updated_at": record.created_at,
        }
        for kind, record in latest.items()
    }


@router.get("/me")
def get_me(user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    profile = db.query(Profile).filter(Profile.user_id == user.id).first()
    dna = _get_dna(db, user.id)
    return {
        "user": user_out(user),
        "profile": profile_out(profile, user),
        "dna": {
            "scores": dna.scores,
            "source": dna.source,
            "updated_at": dna.updated_at,
            "dimensions": DNA_DIMENSIONS,
        },
        "consents": _consent_map(db, user.id),
        "policy_version": settings.policy_version,
    }


@router.patch("/me/profile")
def update_profile(
    payload: ProfileUpdate,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    profile = db.query(Profile).filter(Profile.user_id == user.id).first()
    if not profile:
        profile = Profile(user_id=user.id)
        db.add(profile)
        db.flush()
    data = payload.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
    for field, value in data.items():
        setattr(profile, field, value)
    if "interests" in data and data["interests"] is not None:
        dna = _get_dna(db, user.id)
        scores = dict(dna.scores or default_dna())
        for interest in data["interests"]:
            key = normalize_tag(interest)
            if key in DNA_DIMENSIONS:
                scores[key] = max(float(scores.get(key, 5)), 7.0)
        dna.scores = scores
        dna.source = "profile+explicit"
    audit(db, action="profile.update", entity_type="profile", entity_id=profile.id, user_id=user.id)
    db.commit()
    return profile_out(profile, user)


@router.get("/me/dna")
def get_dna(user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    dna = _get_dna(db, user.id)
    return {
        "scores": dna.scores,
        "source": dna.source,
        "updated_at": dna.updated_at,
        "dimensions": DNA_DIMENSIONS,
        "note": "Journey DNA is editable and never a permanent personality label.",
    }


@router.put("/me/dna")
def update_dna(
    payload: DNAUpdate,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    unknown = set(payload.scores) - set(DNA_DIMENSIONS)
    if unknown:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=f"Unknown DNA dimensions: {', '.join(sorted(unknown))}")
    dna = _get_dna(db, user.id)
    scores = dict(dna.scores or default_dna())
    for dimension, value in payload.scores.items():
        scores[dimension] = clamp(float(value), 0, 10)
    dna.scores = scores
    dna.source = "explicit"
    audit(db, action="dna.update", entity_type="journey_dna", entity_id=dna.id, user_id=user.id)
    db.commit()
    return {"scores": dna.scores, "source": dna.source, "updated_at": dna.updated_at}


@router.get("/me/consents")
def get_consents(user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    return {
        "consents": _consent_map(db, user.id),
        "policy_version": settings.policy_version,
        "kinds": sorted(CONSENT_KINDS),
    }


@router.put("/me/consents")
def update_consents(
    payload: ConsentUpdate,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    unknown = set(payload.consents) - CONSENT_KINDS
    if unknown:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=f"Unknown consent types: {', '.join(sorted(unknown))}")
    for kind, granted in payload.consents.items():
        db.add(
            ConsentRecord(
                user_id=user.id,
                kind=kind,
                granted=bool(granted),
                policy_version=settings.policy_version,
            )
        )
    audit(
        db,
        action="consent.update",
        entity_type="consent",
        user_id=user.id,
        detail=payload.consents,
    )
    db.commit()
    return {"consents": _consent_map(db, user.id), "policy_version": settings.policy_version}


@router.patch("/me/settings")
def update_settings(
    payload: UserSettingsUpdate,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    data = payload.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
    for field, value in data.items():
        setattr(user, field, value)
    audit(db, action="settings.update", entity_type="user", entity_id=user.id, user_id=user.id)
    db.commit()
    return user_out(user)

  "content": "\"use client\";\n\nimport { useQueryClient } from \"@tanstack/react-query\";\nimport { useEffect, useRef, useState } from \"react\";\n\nimport { wsUrl } from \"@/lib/api\";\n\ntype Status = \"idle\" | \"connecting\" | \"live\" | \"closed\";\n\nexport function useTripSocket(tripId: string | undefined) {\n  const queryClient = useQueryClient();\n  const [status, setStatus] = useState<Status>(\"idle\");\n  const [lastEvent, setLastEvent] = useState<{ type: string; at: number } | null>(null);\n  const retry = useRef(0);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (!tripId) return;\n    let socket: WebSocket | null = null;\n    let heartbeat: number | undefined;\n    let reconnect: number | undefined;\n    let disposed = false;\n\n    const connect = () => {\n      const url = wsUrl(tripId);\n      if (!url) return;\n      setStatus(\"connecting\");\n      socket = new WebSocket(url);\n\n      socket.onopen = () => {\n        retry.current = 0;\n        setStatus(\"live\");\n        heartbeat = window.setInterval(() => {\n          if (socket?.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) socket.send(\"ping\");\n        }, 30_000);\n      };\n\n      socket.onmessage = (event) => {\n        try {\n          const payload = JSON.parse(event.data) as { type?: string };\n          const type = payload.type || \"update\";\n          if (type === \"pong\" || type === \"connected\") return;\n          setLastEvent({ type, at: Date.now() });\n          queryClient.invalidateQueries({\n            predicate: (query) =>\n              query.queryKey[1] === tripId ||\n              query.queryKey[0] === \"trips\" ||\n              query.queryKey[0] === \"notifications\",\n          });\n        } catch {\n          /* ignore malformed frames */\n        }\n      };\n\n      socket.onclose = () => {\n        window.clearInterval(heartbeat);\n        if (disposed) return;\n        setStatus(\"closed\");\n        retry.current = Math.min(retry.current + 1, 5);\n        reconnect = window.setTimeout(connect, 1500 * retry.current);\n      };\n\n      socket.onerror = () => {\n        socket?.close();\n      };\n    };\n\n    connect();\n    return () => {\n      disposed = true;\n      window.clearInterval(heartbeat);\n      window.clearTimeout(reconnect);\n      socket?.close();\n      setStatus(\"idle\");\n    };\n  }, [tripId, queryClient]);\n\n  return { status, lastEvent };\n}\n",

}

Never used for ads.\",\n  },\n  location: {\n    label: \"Location sharing\",\n    detail: \"Allow precise location for nearby suggestions. Off by default and never public.\",\n  },\n  marketing: {\n    label: \"Product updates\",\n    detail: \"Occasional emails about new SAFAR features. You can opt out any time.\",\n  },\n};\n\nfunction Chip({\n  active,\n  children,\n  onClick,\n}: {\n  active: boolean;\n  children: React.ReactNode;\n  onClick: () => void;\n}) {\n  return (\n    <button\n      type=\"button\"\n      onClick={onClick}\n      className={cn(\n        \"rounded-full border px-3 py-1.5 text-[12px] transition-colors\",\n        active\n          ? \"border-ember bg-ember-soft text-ember\"\n          : \"border-line bg-surface text-muted hover:border-ink/30 hover:text-ink\",\n      )}\n    >\n      {children}\n    </button>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default function OnboardingPage() {\n  const router = useRouter();\n  const queryClient = useQueryClient();\n  const push = useToasts((state) => state.push);\n  const me = useMe();\n  const [step, setStep] = useState(0);\n  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);\n  const [ready, setReady] = useState(false);\n  const [form, setForm] = useState({\n    headline: \"\",\n    bio: \"\",\n    home_city: \"\",\n    travel_pace: \"balanced\",\n    budget_level: \"moderate\",\n    budget_limit: \"\",\n    interests: [] as string[],\n    accessibility_needs: [] as string[],\n    dietary: [] as string[],\n    languages: [\"English\"],\n    public_profile: false,\n    allow_discovery: false,\n    location_sharing: false,\n  });\n  const [dna, setDna] = useState<Record<string, number>>({});\n  const [consents, setConsents] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({\n    personalization: true,\n    analytics: false,\n    location: false,\n    marketing: false,\n  });\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (!me.data || ready) return;\n    const profile = me.data.profile;\n    setForm({\n      headline: profile.headline || \"\",\n      bio: profile.bio || \"\",\n      home_city: profile.home_city || \"\",\n      travel_pace: profile.travel_pace || \"balanced\",\n      budget_level: profile.budget_level || \"moderate\",\n      budget_limit: profile.budget_limit ? String(profile.budget_limit) : \"\",\n      interests: profile.interests?.length ? profile.interests : [],\n      accessibility_needs: profile.accessibility_needs || [],\n      dietary: profile.dietary || [],\n      languages: profile.languages?.length ? profile.languages : [\"English\"],\n      public_profile: profile.public_profile,\n      allow_discovery: profile.allow_discovery,\n      location_sharing: profile.location_sharing,\n    });\n    setDna({ ...(me.data.dna.scores || {}) });\n    setConsents({\n      personalization: me.data.consents?.personalization?.granted ?? true,\n      analytics: me.data.consents?.analytics?.granted ?? false,\n      location: me.data.consents?.location?.granted ?? false,\n      marketing: me.data.consents?.marketing?.granted ?? false,\n    });\n    setReady(true);\n  }, [me.data, ready]);\n\n  if (me.isLoading || !ready) return <PageSkeleton />;\n  if (me.error) return <ErrorState error={me.error} retry={() => me.refetch()} />;\n\n  const toggle = (key: keyof typeof form, value: string) => {\n    setForm((current) => {\n      const list = current[key] as string[];\n      return {\n        ...current,\n        [key]: list.includes(value) ? list.filter((item) => item !== value) : [...list, value],\n      };\n    });\n  };\n\n  const finish = async () => {\n    setSaving(true);\n    try {\n      await api(\"/api/users/me/profile\", {\n        method: \"PATCH\",\n        body: {\n          headline: form.headline || null,\n          bio: form.bio || null,\n          home_city: form.home_city || null,\n          travel_pace: form.travel_pace,\n          budget_level: form.budget_level,\n          budget_limit: form.budget_limit === \"\" ? @router.post("/me/notifications/read-all")
def read_all_notifications(
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db)
):
    from app.models import Notification

    db.query(Notification).filter(
        Notification.user_id == user.id, Notification.read_at.is_(None)
    ).update({Notification.read_at: utcnow()})
    db.commit()
    return {"ok": True}


@router.post("/me/blocks/{blocked_id}")
def block_user(
    blocked_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    if blocked_id == user.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="You cannot block yourself")
    if not db.get(User, blocked_id):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="User not found")
    existing = (
        db.query(UserBlock)
        .filter(UserBlock.blocker_id == user.id, UserBlock.blocked_id == blocked_id)
        .first()
    )
    if not existing:
        db.add(UserBlock(blocker_id=user.id, blocked_id=blocked_id))
        db.commit()
    return {"ok": True}


@router.delete("/me/blocks/{blocked_id}")
def unblock_user(
    blocked_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    db.query(UserBlock).filter(
        UserBlock.blocker_id == user.id, UserBlock.blocked_id == blocked_id
    ).delete()
    db.commit()
    return {"ok": True}


@router.get("/me/blocks")
def list_blocks(user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    rows = db.query(UserBlock).filter(UserBlock.blocker_id == user.id).all()
    blocked = {row.blocked_id for row in rows}
    users = db.query(User).filter(User.id.in_(blocked)).all() if blocked else []
    return {
        "items": [
            {"user": {"id": person.id, "display_name": person.display_name}, "created_at": row.created_at}
            for row, person in ((row, db.get(User, row.blocked_id)) for row in rows)
            if person
        ]
    }


@router.get("/me/export")
def export_data(user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    profile = db.query(Profile).filter(Profile.user_id == user.id).first()
    dna = _get_dna(db, user.id)
    memberships = (
        db.query(TripMember)
        .filter(TripMember.user_id == user.id)
        .all()
    )
    trip_ids = [membership.trip_id for membership in memberships]
    trips = (
        db.query(Trip).filter(Trip.id.in_(trip_ids)).all() if trip_ids else []
    )
    memories = (
        db.query(TripMemory).filter(TripMemory.user_id == user.id).all()
    )
    expenses = db.query(Expense).filter(Expense.paid_by == user.id).all()
    feedback = db.query(ActivityFeedback).filter(ActivityFeedback.user_id == user.id).all()
    return {
        "exported_at": utcnow().isoformat(),
        "user": user_out(user),
        "profile": profile_out(profile, user),
        "journey_dna": {"scores": dna.scores, "source": dna.source},
        "consents": _consent_map(db, user.id),
        "trips": [
            {
                "id": trip.id,
                "name": trip.name,
                "destination": trip.destination_name,
                "start_date": trip.start_date,
                "end_date": trip.end_date,
                "role": next(
                    (m.role for m in memberships if m.trip_id == trip.id), None
                ),
            }
            for trip in trips
        ],
        "memories": [
            {
                "id": memory.id,
                "trip_id": memory.trip_id,
                "kind": memory.kind,
                "caption": memory.caption,
                "text": memory.text_content,
                "captured_at": memory.captured_at,
                "visibility": memory.visibility,
            }
            for memory in memories
        ],
        "expenses_paid": [
            {"id": expense.id, "title": expense.title, "amount": expense.amount}
            for expense in expenses
        ],
        "activity_feedback": [
            {
                "activity_id": row.activity_id,
                "sentiment": row.sentiment,
                "consented": row.consented,
                "created_at": row.created_at,
            }
            for row in feedback
        ],
        "disclosure": "This export contains your account data. Private members' information is excluded.",
    }


@router.delete("/me")
def delete_account(
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db)
):
    from app.models import Notification

    if user.is_admin:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail="Administrator accounts must be transferred before deletion.",
        )
    now = utcnow()
    profile = db.query(Profile).filter(Profile.user_id == user.id).first()
    if profile:
        profile.headline = None
        profile.bio = None
        profile.home_city = None
        profile.interests = []
        profile.accessibility_needs = []
        profile.dietary = []
        profile.languages = []
        profile.public_profile = False
        profile.allow_discovery = False
        profile.location_sharing = False
        profile.budget_limit = None
    db.query(TripMemory).filter(
        TripMemory.user_id == user.id, TripMemory.deleted_at.is_(None)
    ).update({TripMemory.deleted_at: now, TripMemory.visibility: "private"})
    db.query(Notification).filter(Notification.user_id == user.id).delete()
    db.query(UserBlock).filter(
        (UserBlock.blocker_id == user.id) | (UserBlock.blocked_id == user.id)
    ).delete()
    db.add(
        ConsentRecord(
            user_id=user.id,
            kind="terms",
            granted=False,
            policy_version=settings.policy_version,
        )
    )
    user.deleted_at = now
    user.is_active = False
    user.email = f"deleted+{user.id}@safar.invalid"
    user.display_name = "Former traveller"
    user.avatar_url = None
    user.password_hash = "deleted-account"
    user.quiet_mode = True
    audit(
        db,
        action="account.delete",
        entity_type="user",
        entity_id=user.id,
        user_id=user.id,
    )
    db.commit()
    return {"ok": True, "note": "Account anonymised. Media owned by this account is hidden."}

@router.get("/contributors")
def list_contributors(
    destination_id: str | None = None,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    query = db.query(LocalContributor)
    if destination_id:
        query = query.filter(LocalContributor.destination_id == destination_id)
    rows = query.all()
    users = {
        person.id: person
        for person in db.query(User)
        .filter(User.id.in_({row.user_id for row in rows}))
        .all()
    } if rows else {}
    destinations = {
        destination.id: destination
        for destination in db.query(Destination)
        .filter(Destination.id.in_({row.destination_id for row in rows}))
        .all()
    } if rows else {}
    return {
        "items": [
            {
                "id": row.id,
                "user": user_public(users.get(row.user_id)),
                "destination": (
                    destination_out(destinations[row.destination_id])
                    if row.destination_id in destinations
                    else None
                ),
                "bio": row.bio,
                "expertise": row.expertise or [],
                "verified": row.verified,
                "accepts_requests": row.accepts_requests,
            }
            for row in rows
        ],
        "disclosure": "Contributors are opt-in travellers, not official tourism authorities.",
    }


@router.post("/contributors")
def upsert_contributor(
    payload: ContributorIn,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    destination = db.get(Destination, payload.destination_id)
    if not destination:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Destination not found")
    row = db.query(LocalContributor).filter(LocalContributor.user_id == user.id).first()
    if not row:
        row = LocalContributor(user_id=user.id, destination_id=destination.id)
        db.add(row)
    row.destination_id = destination.id
    row.bio = payload.bio
    row.expertise = payload.expertise
    row.accepts_requests = payload.accepts_requests
    audit(
        db,
        action="contributor.upsert",
        entity_type="local_contributor",
        entity_id=row.id,
        user_id=user.id,
    )
    db.commit()
    return {
        "id": row.id,
        "destination_id": row.destination_id,
        "accepts_requests": row.accepts_requests,
        "verified": row.verified,
        "note": "Verification is granted by moderators, never self-declared.",
    }


@router.post("/trips/{trip_id}/activities/{activity_id}/feedback")
def activity_feedback(
    trip_id: str,
    activity_id: str,
    payload: FeedbackIn,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    activity = _activity_for_trip(db, trip, activity_id)
    upsert_activity_feedback(
        db,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
        activity=activity,
        sentiment=payload.sentiment,
        consented=payload.consented,
    )
    dna_update = apply_feedback_to_dna(
        db, user, activity, payload.sentiment, consented=payload.consented
    )
    audit(
        db,
        action="activity.feedback",
        entity_type="activity",
        entity_id=activity.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
        detail={"sentiment": payload.sentiment, "consented": payload.consented},
    )
    db.commit()
    return {
        "ok": True,
        "sentiment": payload.sentiment,
        "consented": payload.consented,
        "journey_dna": dna_update,
        "note": (
            "Private to you. Only consented outcomes shape future recommendations."
        ),
    }

371	export function Modal({
372	  open,
373	  onClose,
374	  title,
375	  children,
376	  wide,
377	}: {
378	  open: boolean;
379	  onClose: () => void;
380	  title: string;
381	  children: ReactNode;
382	  wide?: boolean;
383	}) {
384	  useEffect(() => {
385	    if (!open) return;
386	    const handler = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
387	      if (event.key === "Escape") onClose();
388	    };
389	    window.addEventListener("keydown", handler);
390	    document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
391	    return () => {
392	      window.removeEventListener("keydown", handler);
393	      document.body.style.overflow = "";
394	    };
395	  }, [open, onClose]);
396	
397	  return (
398	    <AnimatePresence>
399	      {open ? (
400	        <motion.div
401	          className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-end justify-center bg-ink/40 p-0 backdrop-blur-sm sm:items-center sm:p-6"
402	          initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
403	          animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
404	          exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
405	          onClick={onClose}
406	        >
407	          <motion.div
408	            role="dialog"
409	            aria-modal="true"
410	            aria-label={title}
411	            initial={{ y: 40, opacity: 0 }}
412	            animate={{ y: 0, opacity: 1 }}
413	            exit={{ y: 24, opacity: 0 }}
414	            transition={{ duration: 0.28, ease: [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1] }}
415	            className={cn(

417	              wide ? "sm:max-w-2xl" : "sm:max-w-lg",
418	            )}
419	            onClick={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
420	          >
421	            <div className="mb-4 flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
422	              <h2 className="text-xl">{title}</h2>
423	              <button
424	                type="button"
425	                onClick={onClose}
426	                className="rounded-full p-1.5 text-muted hover:bg-ink/5"
427	                aria-label="Close"
428	              >
429	                <X size={18} />
430	              </button>
431	            </div>
432	            {children}
433	          </motion.div>
434	        </motion.div>
435	      ) : null}
436	    </AnimatePresence>
437	  );
438	}

83	  if (end >= 0) return "Happening now";
84	  return "Past";

):
    trip, member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    itinerary = _get_itinerary(db, trip)
    items = (
        db.query(ItineraryItem)
        .filter(
            ItineraryItem.trip_id == trip.id,
            ItineraryItem.status == "confirmed",
        )
        .order_by(ItineraryItem.day, ItineraryItem.sort_order, ItineraryItem.start_time)
        .all()
    )
    versions = (
        db.query(ItineraryVersion)
        .filter(ItineraryVersion.itinerary_id == itinerary.id)
        .order_by(ItineraryVersion.version.desc())
        .limit(15)
        .all()
    )
    open_proposals = (
        db.query(ItineraryProposal)
        .filter(ItineraryProposal.trip_id == trip.id, ItineraryProposal.status == "open")
        .all()
    )
    total_cost = sum(item.cost_estimate for item in items)
    return {
        "itinerary_id": itinerary.id,
        "confirmed_version": itinerary.confirmed_version,
        "my_role": member.role,
        "items": _serialize_items(db, items, user.id),
        "versions": [version_out(version) for version in versions],
        "open_proposals": len(open_proposals),
        "totals": {
            "items": len(items),
            "cost": round(total_cost, 2),
            "currency": trip.currency,
            "days": len({item.day for item in items}),
            "protected_items": len([item for item in items if item.is_protected]),
        },
    }


def _next_sort_order(db: Session, trip_id: str, item_day: date) -> int:
    last = (
        db.query(ItineraryItem)
        .filter(ItineraryItem.trip_id == trip_id, ItineraryItem.day == item_day)
        .order_by(ItineraryItem.sort_order.desc())
        .first()
    )
    return (last.sort_order + 1) if last else 0


def _within_trip(trip: Trip, day: date) -> None:
    if day < trip.start_date or day > trip.end_date:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=422,
            detail=(
                f"{day.isoformat()} is outside the trip dates "
                f"({trip.start_date.isoformat()} to {trip.end_date.isoformat()})."
            ),
        )

@router.get("/{trip_id}/engine/latest")
def latest_batch(
    trip_id: str,
    mode: str | None = Query(default=None, pattern=r"^(everyone_wins|your_turn|surprise_us)$"),
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    query = db.query(RecommendationBatch).filter(RecommendationBatch.trip_id == trip.id)
    if mode:
        query = query.filter(RecommendationBatch.mode == mode)
    batch = query.order_by(RecommendationBatch.created_at.desc()).first()
    if not batch:
        return {
            "id": None,
            "mode": mode or "everyone_wins",
            "mode_meta": MODE_META.get(mode or "everyone_wins", {}),
            "items": [],
            "meta": {},
            "message": "No recommendation batch yet. Generate one to get started.",
        }
    return _batch_out(db, batch, user.id)


@router.get("/{trip_id}/engine/batches")
def list_batches(
    trip_id: str,
    limit: int = Query(default=10, ge=1, le=50),
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    batches = (
        db.query(RecommendationBatch)
        .filter(RecommendationBatch.trip_id == trip.id)
        .order_by(RecommendationBatch.created_at.desc())
        .limit(limit)
        .all()
    )
    return {
        "items": [
            {
                "id": batch.id,
                "mode": batch.mode,
                "mode_meta": MODE_META.get(batch.mode, {}),
                "for_date": batch.for_date,
                "created_at": batch.created_at,
                "summary": (batch.meta or {}).get("disclosure"),
            }
            for batch in batches
        ]
    }

    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    rec = db.get(Recommendation, recommendation_id)
    if not rec or rec.trip_id != trip.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Recommendation not found")
    activity = db.get(Activity, rec.activity_id)
    if not activity:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Activity not found")

    row = (
        db.query(RecommendationFeedback)
        .filter(
            RecommendationFeedback.recommendation_id == rec.id,
            RecommendationFeedback.user_id == user.id,

        .first()
    )
    if not row:
        row = RecommendationFeedback(
            recommendation_id=rec.id, user_id=user.id, sentiment=payload.sentiment
        )
        db.add(row)
    row.sentiment = payload.sentiment
    row.consented = payload.consented

    upsert_activity_feedback(
        db,

    )
    db.commit()
    return {

from app.services.serializers import pulse_out

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/trips", tags=["pulse"])


def _pulse_rows(db: Session, trip_id: str, day: date) -> list[TripPulse]:
    return (
        db.query(TripPulse)
        .filter(TripPulse.trip_id == trip_id, TripPulse.pulse_date == day)
        .order_by(TripPulse.created_at)
        .all()
    )


def _affected_items(db: Session, trip: Trip, member: TripMember, pulse: TripPulse) -> list[dict]:
    """Constraint Compass (F35): exactly what today's change puts at risk."""
    profile = db.query(Profile).filter(Profile.user_id == member.user_id).first()
    accessibility = list(member.accessibility_needs or [])
    if not accessibility and profile:
        accessibility = list(profile.accessibility_needs or [])
    needs_wheelchair = any(
        "wheel" in need.lower() or "mobility" in need.lower() for need in accessibility
    )
    items = (
        db.query(ItineraryItem)
        .filter(
            ItineraryItem.trip_id == trip.id,
            ItineraryItem.day == pulse.pulse_date,
            ItineraryItem.status == "confirmed",
        )
        .order_by(ItineraryItem.start_time)
        .all()
    )
    affected = []
    for item in items:
        if item.is_protected:
            continue
        activity = db.get(Activity, item.activity_id) if item.activity_id else None
        if not activity:
            continue
        place = db.get(Place, activity.place_id) if activity.place_id else None
        distance = (
            haversine_km(trip.base_lat, trip.base_lon, place.lat, place.lon)
            if place
            else 0.0
        )
        travel = travel_minutes(distance)
        reasons = []
        if pulse.radius_km is not None and distance > pulse.radius_km:
            reasons.append(
                f"{distance:.1f} km away, beyond today's {pulse.radius_km:.0f} km radius."
            )
        if (
            pulse.available_minutes is not None
            and activity.duration_minutes + travel * 2 > pulse.available_minutes
        ):
            reasons.append(
                f"Needs about {activity.duration_minutes + travel * 2} minutes including travel; "
                f"you have {pulse.available_minutes}."
            )
        cap = BUDGET_COMFORT_CAP.get(pulse.budget_comfort)
        if cap is not None and activity.price_estimate > cap:
            reasons.append(
                f"Estimated cost {activity.currency} {activity.price_estimate:.0f} is above today's comfort level."
            )
        if activity.effort > pulse.energy + 1:
            reasons.append(
                f"Effort {activity.effort}/5 is high for today's energy {pulse.energy}/5."
            )
        if needs_wheelchair and activity.wheelchair_accessible is not True:
            reasons.append(
                "Accessibility is not confirmed for this activity, which your profile requires."
            )
        if reasons:
            affected.append(
                {
                    "item_id": item.id,
                    "title": item.title,
                    "start_time": item.start_time,
                    "reasons": reasons,
                }
            )
    return affected

@router.put("/{trip_id}/pulse")
async def upsert_pulse(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: PulseIn,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, member = get_trip_and_member(trip_id, db, user)
    pulse_date = payload.pulse_date or date.today()
    pulse = (
        db.query(TripPulse)
        .filter(
            TripPulse.trip_id == trip.id,
            TripPulse.user_id == user.id,
            TripPulse.pulse_date == pulse_date,
        )
        .first()
    )
    previous = (
        {
            "energy": pulse.energy,
            "available_minutes": pulse.available_minutes,
            "radius_km": pulse.radius_km,
            "budget_comfort": pulse.budget_comfort,
            "interests": pulse.interests,
        }
        if pulse
        else None
    )
    if not pulse:
        pulse = TripPulse(
            trip_id=trip.id,
            user_id=user.id,
            pulse_date=pulse_date,
        )
        db.add(pulse)
    pulse.energy = payload.energy
    pulse.interests = [normalize_tag(interest) for interest in payload.interests]
    pulse.available_minutes = payload.available_minutes
    pulse.budget_comfort = payload.budget_comfort
    pulse.radius_km = payload.radius_km
    pulse.activity_prefs = [normalize_tag(tag) for tag in payload.activity_prefs]
    pulse.note = payload.note
    db.flush()
    affected = _affected_items(db, trip, member, pulse)
    changed = []
    if previous:
        for field in ("energy", "available_minutes", "radius_km", "budget_comfort", "interests"):
            if previous.get(field) != getattr(pulse, field):
                changed.append(field)
    audit(
        db,
        action="pulse.update",
        entity_type="trip_pulse",
        entity_id=pulse.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
        detail={"date": pulse_date.isoformat(), "changed": changed},
    )
    db.commit()
    await manager.broadcast(
        trip.id,
        event_payload(
            "pulse.updated", trip_id=trip.id, user_id=user.id, date=pulse_date.isoformat()
        ),
    )
    return {
        "pulse": pulse_out(pulse, user.id),
        "changed_fields": changed,
        "affected_items": affected,
        "constraint_compass": {
            "summary": (
                "No confirmed items conflict with today's constraints."
                if not affected
                else f"{len(affected)} confirmed item(s) no longer fit today's constraints."
            ),
            "items": affected,
            "note": "This check is about today only and does not modify the confirmed itinerary.",
        },
    }

ADMIN_ROLES = {"owner", "admin"}


def _trip(db, trip_id, user, roles=None):
    return get_trip_and_member(trip_id, db, user, roles)


def _get_itinerary(db: Session, trip: Trip) -> Itinerary:
    itinerary = db.query(Itinerary).filter(Itinerary.trip_id == trip.id).first()
    if not itinerary:
        itinerary = Itinerary(trip_id=trip.id, confirmed_version=0)
        db.add(itinerary)
        db.flush()
    return itinerary


def _serialize_items(db: Session, items: list[ItineraryItem], viewer_id: str) -> list[dict]:
    activity_ids = [item.activity_id for item in items if item.activity_id]
    activities = (
        db.query(Activity).filter(Activity.id.in_(activity_ids)).all() if activity_ids else []
    )
    activity_map = {activity.id: activity for activity in activities}
    place_ids = [activity.place_id for activity in activities if activity.place_id]
    places = db.query(Place).filter(Place.id.in_(place_ids)).all() if place_ids else []
    place_map = {place.id: place for place in places}
    destination_ids = {activity.destination_id for activity in activities}
    destinations = (
        db.query(Destination).filter(Destination.id.in_(destination_ids)).all()
        if destination_ids
        else []
    )
    destination_map = {destination.id: destination for destination in destinations}

    attendance_rows = (
        db.query(ItineraryAttendance)
        .filter(ItineraryAttendance.item_id.in_([item.id for item in items]))
        .all()
        if items
        else []
    )
    attendance: dict[str, list[ItineraryAttendance]] = {}
    for row in attendance_rows:
        attendance.setdefault(row.item_id, []).append(row)

    result = []
    for item in items:
        activity = activity_map.get(item.activity_id) if item.activity_id else None
        payload = item_out(item)
        payload["activity"] = (
            activity_out(
                activity,
                place_map.get(activity.place_id),
                destination_map.get(activity.destination_id),
            )
            if activity
            else None
        )
        rows = attendance.get(item.id, [])
        payload["attendance"] = {
            "in": len([row for row in rows if row.status == "in"]),
            "out": len([row for row in rows if row.status == "out"]),
            "join_later": len([row for row in rows if row.status == "join_later"]),
            "my_status": next(
                (row.status for row in rows if row.user_id == viewer_id), "in"
            ),
        }
        result.append(payload)
    return result

@router.post("/{trip_id}/proposals", status_code=201)
async def create_proposal(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: ProposalCreate,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    if payload.kind == "add_activity" and not payload.activity_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="activity_id is required for add_activity")
    if payload.kind == "replace_item" and (not payload.activity_id or not payload.target_item_id):
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=422,
            detail="replace_item needs both activity_id and target_item_id",
        )
    if payload.kind == "remove_item" and not payload.target_item_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="target_item_id is required for remove_item")

    proposal = ItineraryProposal(
        trip_id=trip.id,
        kind=payload.kind,
        title=payload.title,
        summary=payload.summary,
        target_day=payload.day,
        created_by=user.id,
        payload={
            "activity_id": payload.activity_id,
            "day": payload.day.isoformat() if payload.day else None,
            "start_time": payload.start_time,
            "target_item_id": payload.target_item_id,
            **payload.payload,
        },
    )
    db.add(proposal)
    db.flush()
    try:
        impact = _proposal_impact(db, trip, proposal)
    except HTTPException:
        db.rollback()
        raise
    audit(
        db,
        action="proposal.create",
        entity_type="itinerary_proposal",
        entity_id=proposal.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
        detail={"kind": proposal.kind, "title": proposal.title},
    )
    notify_trip_members(
        db,
        trip,
        kind="proposal_created",
        title=f"New proposal: {proposal.title}",
        body=f"{user.display_name} asked the group to decide.",
        link=f"/trips/{trip.id}/voting",
        exclude_user_id=user.id,
    )
    db.commit()
    await manager.broadcast(
        trip.id,
        event_payload("proposal.created", trip_id=trip.id, proposal_id=proposal.id),
    )
    return {**proposal_out(db, proposal, user.id), "impact": impact}


@router.get("/{trip_id}/proposals")
def list_proposals(
    trip_id: str,
    status: str = Query(default="open", pattern=r"^(open|approved|rejected|withdrawn|all)$"),
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    query = db.query(ItineraryProposal).filter(ItineraryProposal.trip_id == trip.id)
    if status != "all":
        query = query.filter(ItineraryProposal.status == status)
    rows = query.order_by(ItineraryProposal.created_at.desc()).all()
    return {"items": [proposal_out(db, row, user.id) for row in rows]}


@router.get("/{trip_id}/proposals/{proposal_id}")
def get_proposal(
    trip_id: str,
    proposal_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    proposal = db.get(ItineraryProposal, proposal_id)
    if not proposal or proposal.trip_id != trip.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Proposal not found")
    try:
        impact = _proposal_impact(db, trip, proposal)
    except HTTPException as exc:
        impact = {"error": exc.detail}
    return {**proposal_out(db, proposal, user.id), "impact": impact}


@router.post("/{trip_id}/proposals/{proposal_id}/vote")
async def vote_proposal(
    trip_id: str,
    proposal_id: str,
    payload: VoteIn,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    proposal = db.get(ItineraryProposal, proposal_id)
    if not proposal or proposal.trip_id != trip.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Proposal not found")
    if proposal.status != "open":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="This proposal is no longer open")
    vote = (
        db.query(Vote)
        .filter(Vote.proposal_id == proposal.id, Vote.user_id == user.id)
        .first()
    )
    if not vote:
        vote = Vote(proposal_id=proposal.id, user_id=user.id)
        db.add(vote)
    vote.value = payload.value
    vote.comment = payload.comment
    audit(
        db,
        action="proposal.vote",
        entity_type="itinerary_proposal",
        entity_id=proposal.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
        detail={"value": payload.value},
    )
    db.commit()
    await manager.broadcast(
        trip.id,
        event_payload(
            "proposal.voted",
            trip_id=trip.id,
            proposal_id=proposal.id,
            voter=user.display_name,
        ),
    )
    return proposal_out(db, proposal, user.id)

@router.post("/{trip_id}/itinerary/items/{item_id}/attendance")
def update_attendance(
    trip_id: str,
    item_id: str,
    payload: AttendanceUpdate,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    item = db.get(ItineraryItem, item_id)
    if not item or item.trip_id != trip.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Itinerary item not found")
    row = (
        db.query(ItineraryAttendance)
        .filter(ItineraryAttendance.item_id == item.id, ItineraryAttendance.user_id == user.id)
        .first()
    )
    if not row:
        row = ItineraryAttendance(item_id=item.id, user_id=user.id, status=payload.status)
        db.add(row)
    else:
        row.status = payload.status
    audit(
        db,
        action="itinerary.attendance",
        entity_type="itinerary_item",
        entity_id=item.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
        detail={"status": payload.status},
    )
    db.commit()
    return {"ok": True, "status": row.status, "note": "No reason is required or recorded."}

@router.post("/{trip_id}/shadowplans", status_code=201)
def create_shadowplan(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: ShadowplanCreate,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    item = db.get(ItineraryItem, payload.item_id)
    if not item or item.trip_id != trip.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Itinerary item not found")
    activity = db.get(Activity, payload.backup_activity_id)
    if not activity or activity.destination_id != trip.destination_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Backup must be a catalog activity in this destination")
    plan = Shadowplan(
        trip_id=trip.id,
        itinerary_item_id=item.id,
        backup_activity_id=activity.id,
        notes=payload.notes,
        readiness={"status": "ready", "checked_at": utcnow().isoformat()},
        created_by=user.id,
    )
    db.add(plan)
    audit(
        db,
        action="shadowplan.create",
        entity_type="shadowplan",
        entity_id=plan.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
    )
    db.commit()
    return {"id": plan.id, "backup_activity_id": activity.id, "readiness": plan.readiness}

):

        "items": [

                "id": row.id,

                "notes": row.notes,
                "readiness": row.readiness,
                "created_at": row.created_at,
            }
            for row in rows
        ]
    }

@router.post("/{trip_id}/twin/compare")
def twin_compare(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: TwinCompareIn,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    if not payload.activity_ids:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=422,
            detail="Provide at least one alternative activity to compare.",
        )
    for activity_id in payload.activity_ids:
        _activity_in_trip(db, trip, activity_id)
    if len(set(payload.activity_ids)) != len(payload.activity_ids):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Duplicate activities in the alternative")
    day = payload.day or date.today()
    _within_trip(trip, day)
    items = (
        db.query(ItineraryItem)
        .filter(
            ItineraryItem.trip_id == trip.id,
            ItineraryItem.day == day,
            ItineraryItem.status == "confirmed",
        )
        .all()
    )
    contexts = build_member_contexts(db, trip, _active_members(db, trip.id), day)
    result = twin_service.compare_plan(db, trip, contexts, items, payload.activity_ids, day)
    result["generated_at"] = result["generated_at"].isoformat()
    return result


@router.post("/{trip_id}/twin/propose", status_code=201)
async def twin_propose(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: TwinProposeIn,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    day = payload.day or trip.start_date
    _within_trip(trip, day)
    if len(set(payload.activity_ids)) != len(payload.activity_ids):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Duplicate activities in the alternative")
    activities = [_activity_in_trip(db, trip, activity_id) for activity_id in payload.activity_ids]
    proposal, impact = _create_proposal(
        db,
        trip,
        user,
        kind="twin_adopt",
        title="Adopt a Trip Twin alternative",
        summary=(
            f"Replaces {day.isoformat()} with: "
            + ", ".join(activity.name for activity in activities)
            + ". Read-only comparison only; adoption needs group approval."
        ),
        day=day,
        payload={
            "day": day.isoformat(),
            "items": [
                {"activity_id": activity.id, "day": day.isoformat(), "start_time": "09:00"}
                for activity in activities
            ],
        },
    )
    db.commit()
    await manager.broadcast(
        trip.id,
        event_payload("proposal.created", trip_id=trip.id, proposal_id=proposal.id),
    )
    return {**proposal_out(db, proposal, user.id), "impact": impact}

@router.post("/{trip_id}/rescue/propose", status_code=201)
async def rescue_propose(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: RescueProposeIn,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    if not payload.items:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=422,
            detail="Select at least one replacement from the rescue analysis.",
        )
    items = []
    for entry in payload.items:
        _within_trip(trip, entry.day)
        item = db.get(ItineraryItem, entry.item_id)
        if not item or item.trip_id != trip.id or item.status != "confirmed":
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="A rescue target item was not found")
        activity = _activity_in_trip(db, trip, entry.activity_id)
        items.append(
            {
                "item_id": item.id,
                "activity_id": activity.id,
                "day": entry.day.isoformat(),
                "start_time": entry.start_time,
                "notes": f"Trip Rescue ({payload.kind}) replacement",
                "title": item.title,
            }
        )
    title = f"Trip Rescue: {payload.kind.replace('_', ' ').title()}"
    summary = (
        payload.note
        or "Replaces affected activities after a disruption. Shown as changes only; nothing is applied until approved."
    )
    pact = db.query(JourneyPact).filter(JourneyPact.trip_id == trip.id).first()
    proposal, impact = _create_proposal(
        db,
        trip,
        user,
        kind="rescue",
        title=title,
        summary=summary,
        day=payload.items[0].day,
        payload={
            "kind": payload.kind,
            "extra_minutes": payload.extra_minutes,
            "note": payload.note,
            "items": items,
        },
    )
    db.commit()
    await manager.broadcast(
        trip.id,
        event_payload("proposal.created", trip_id=trip.id, proposal_id=proposal.id),
    )
    response = {**proposal_out(db, proposal, user.id), "impact": impact}
    if pact:
        response["pact"] = {
            "must_do": pact.must_do or [],
            "flexible": pact.flexible or [],
            "note": "Pact conflicts block approval until the group adds an exception.",
        }
    return response

def _memory_for_trip(db: Session, trip: Trip, memory_id: str, viewer_id: str) -> TripMemory:
    memory = db.get(TripMemory, memory_id)
    if not memory or memory.trip_id != trip.id or memory.deleted_at is not None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Memory not found")
    if not memory_service.can_view_memory(db, memory, viewer_id):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Memory not found")
    return memory
