@router.post("/{trip_id}/memories", status_code=201)
def create_memory(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: MemoryCreate,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    _validate_memory_content(payload.kind, payload.text_content, payload.media_url)
    captured_at = _naive_utc(payload.captured_at)
    if captured_at > utcnow() + timedelta(minutes=5):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Capture time cannot be in the future")
    memory = TripMemory(
        trip_id=trip.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        kind=payload.kind,
        text_content=payload.text_content,
        media_url=payload.media_url,
        media_type=payload.media_type,
        caption=payload.caption,
        captured_at=captured_at,
        lat=payload.lat,
        lon=payload.lon,
        visibility=payload.visibility,
        ai_generated=False,
        approved=True,
    )
    db.add(memory)
    db.flush()
    audit(
        db,
        action="memory.create",
        entity_type="trip_memory",
        entity_id=memory.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
        detail={"kind": memory.kind, "visibility": memory.visibility},
    )
    notify_trip_members(
        db,
        trip,
        kind="memory_added",
        title=f"{user.display_name} added a memory",
        body="Photos, notes and voice memories stay visible only as each contributor allows."
        if payload.visibility == "trip"
        else None,
        link=f"/trips/{trip.id}/memories",
        exclude_user_id=user.id,
    )
    db.commit()
    return memory_out(memory, user)

def _safe_media_url(url: str | None) -> str | None:
    if not url:
        return None
    if url.startswith("/media/") or url.startswith("https://"):
        return url
    return None


@router.get("/{trip_id}/travel-book")
def travel_book(
    trip_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    replay = memory_service.replay(db, trip, user.id)
    sections = []
    for day in replay["days"]:
        blocks = []
        for item in day["items"]:
            blocks.append(
                f"<li class='plan'>{escape(item['start_time'])} — {escape(item['title'])}</li>"
            )
        for memory in day["memories"]:
            media = _safe_media_url(memory.get("media_url"))
            media_html = ""
            if media:
                src = escape(media, quote=True)
                if memory["kind"] == "photo":
                    media_html = f"<img src='{src}' alt='{escape(memory.get('caption') or 'Trip memory', quote=True)}'>"
                elif memory["kind"] == "video":
                    media_html = f"<video controls src='{src}'></video>"
                elif memory["kind"] == "voice":
                    media_html = f"<audio controls src='{src}'></audio>"
            caption = memory.get("caption") if memory.get("approved") else None
            body = escape((caption or memory.get("text_content") or "")[:1200])
            author = escape((memory.get("author") or {}).get("display_name") or "Traveller")
            blocks.append(
                f"<figure class='memory'>{media_html}<figcaption>{body}"
                f"<span class='byline'>— {author}</span></figcaption></figure>"
            )
        for event in day["events"]:
            blocks.append(
                f"<h3 class='event'>{escape(event['title'])}</h3>"
                f"<p class='event-summary'>{escape(event.get('summary') or '')}</p>"
            )
        sections.append(
            f"<section><h2>{escape(day['date'])}</h2><ul>{''.join(blocks)}</ul></section>"
        )
    html = f"""<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8">
<title>{escape(trip.name)} — SAFAR travel book</title>
<style>
body{{font-family:Georgia,serif;max-width:760px;margin:40px auto;padding:0 20px;color:#1d1d1f;line-height:1.6}}
h1{{font-size:2.4rem;margin-bottom:.2rem}} .meta{{color:#666;margin-bottom:2rem}}
h2{{border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;padding-bottom:.4rem;margin-top:3rem}}
ul{{list-style:none;padding:0}} .plan{{padding:.3rem 0;color:#444}}
figure{{margin:1.2rem 0}} img,video{{max-width:100%;border-radius:8px}} audio{{width:100%}}
figcaption{{font-size:.95rem;margin-top:.4rem}} .byline{{display:block;color:#777;font-size:.85rem}}
.event{{margin:1.6rem 0 .2rem}} .event-summary{{color:#555;margin-top:0}}
footer{{margin-top:4rem;color:#777;font-size:.85rem}}
</style></head><body>
<h1>{escape(trip.name)}</h1>
<p class="meta">{escape(trip.destination_name or '')} · {trip.start_date} → {trip.end_date}</p>
{''.join(sections) or '<p>No recorded days yet.</p>'}
<footer>Generated by SAFAR journey replay. Only permitted media and approved captions are included.</footer>
</body></html>"""
    return HTMLResponse(content=html)

@router.get("/{trip_id}/offline")
def offline_snapshot(
    trip_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    from app.models import Activity, Itinerary, ItineraryItem, Place

    items = (
        db.query(ItineraryItem)
        .filter(ItineraryItem.trip_id == trip.id, ItineraryItem.status == "confirmed")
        .order_by(ItineraryItem.day, ItineraryItem.sort_order, ItineraryItem.start_time)
        .all()
    )
    activities = {}
    places = {}
    if items:
        activity_ids = [item.activity_id for item in items if item.activity_id]
        activities = {
            activity.id: activity
            for activity in db.query(Activity).filter(Activity.id.in_(activity_ids)).all()
        } if activity_ids else {}
        place_ids = [activity.place_id for activity in activities.values() if activity.place_id]
        places = {
            place.id: place
            for place in db.query(Place).filter(Place.id.in_(place_ids)).all()
        } if place_ids else {}
    itinerary = db.query(Itinerary).filter(Itinerary.trip_id == trip.id).first()
    pact = db.query(JourneyPact).filter(JourneyPact.trip_id == trip.id).first()
    members = (
        db.query(TripMember)
        .filter(TripMember.trip_id == trip.id, TripMember.status == "active")
        .all()
    )
    return {
        "generated_at": utcnow().isoformat(),
        "stale_after": (datetime.combine(trip.end_date, datetime.min.time()) + timedelta(days=7)).isoformat(),
        "trip": {
            "id": trip.id,
            "name": trip.name,
            "destination": trip.destination_name,
            "start_date": trip.start_date,
            "end_date": trip.end_date,
            "currency": trip.currency,
            "base": {"lat": trip.base_lat, "lon": trip.base_lon},
        },
        "confirmed_version": itinerary.confirmed_version if itinerary else 0,
        "items": [
            {
                "id": item.id,
                "day": item.day,
                "start_time": item.start_time,
                "title": item.title,
                "cost_estimate": item.cost_estimate,
                "is_protected": item.is_protected,
                "place": (
                    {
                        "name": places[activities[item.activity_id].place_id].name,
                        "address": places[activities[item.activity_id].place_id].address,
                        "lat": places[activities[item.activity_id].place_id].lat,
                        "lon": places[activities[item.activity_id].place_id].lon,
                    }
                    if item.activity_id in activities
                    and activities[item.activity_id].place_id in places
                    else None
                ),
            }
            for item in items
        ],
        "members": [
            {"id": member.id, "display_name": member.display_name, "role": member.role}
            for member in members
        ],
        "pact": (
            {
                "must_do": pact.must_do or [],
                "flexible": pact.flexible or [],
                "confirmed_times": pact.confirmed_times or {},
            }
            if pact
            else None
        ),
        "disclosure": (
            "Offline snapshot of the confirmed plan only. Private budgets, accessibility needs "
            "and private memories are excluded. Check staleness before relying on it."
        ),
    }

@router.get("/trips/{trip_id}/nearby")
def nearby(
    trip_id: str,
    lat: float | None = Query(default=None, ge=-90, le=90),
    lon: float | None = Query(default=None, ge=-180, le=180),
    radius_km: float = Query(default=5, gt=0, le=50),
    category: str | None = Query(default=None, max_length=60),
    limit: int = Query(default=20, ge=1, le=60),
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    base_lat = lat if lat is not None else trip.base_lat
    base_lon = lon if lon is not None else trip.base_lon
    activities = (
        db.query(Activity).filter(Activity.destination_id == trip.destination_id).all()
        if trip.destination_id
        else []
    )
    place_map, destination_map = _activity_place_maps(db, activities)
    items = []
    for activity in activities:
        place = place_map.get(activity.place_id)
        if not place:
            continue
        if category and place.category.lower() != category.lower():
            continue
        distance = haversine_km(base_lat, base_lon, place.lat, place.lon)
        if distance > radius_km:
            continue
        items.append(
            {
                "activity": activity_out(
                    activity, place, destination_map.get(activity.destination_id)
                ),
                "distance_km": round(distance, 2),
                "travel_minutes": travel_minutes(distance),
                "provenance": "ESTIMATED",
            }
        )
    items.sort(key=lambda item: item["distance_km"])
    return {
        "base": {"lat": base_lat, "lon": base_lon, "source": "shared trip base" if lat is None else "requested point"},
        "radius_km": radius_km,
        "items": items[:limit],
        "disclosure": (
            "Distances are straight-line estimates and travel time is not a live routed ETA. "
            "No live member location is exposed."
        ),
    }


def _activity_for_trip(db: Session, trip: Trip, activity_id: str) -> Activity:
    activity = db.get(Activity, activity_id)
    if not activity:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Activity not found")
    if activity.destination_id != trip.destination_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Activity not found for this trip")
    return activity

    activity = _activity_for_trip(db, trip, activity_id)
    place = db.get(Place, activity.place_id) if activity.place_id else None
    return {

    for report in rows:
        score = place_service.freshness(report.observed_at, report.source_type, report.verified)
        payload = report_out(db, report, score)
        payload["provenance"] = place_service.provenance(report.source_type, report.verified)
        payload["freshness_label"] = place_service.freshness_label(score)
        items.append(payload)
    return {
        "items": items,
        "window_days": days,
        "disclosure": "Older reports lose weight. Provenance is shown per report.",
    }

@router.post("/trips/{trip_id}/inspirations", status_code=201)
def import_inspiration(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: InspirationIn,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    if payload.trip_id and payload.trip_id != trip.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Trip mismatch")
    inspiration = SavedInspiration(
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
        source_type=payload.source_type,
        content=payload.content,
        status="pending",
    )
    db.add(inspiration)
    db.flush()
    extraction = discovery_service.dream_import(db, user.id, inspiration)
    inspiration.status = "extracted"
    audit(
        db,
        action="inspiration.import",
        entity_type="saved_inspiration",
        entity_id=inspiration.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
        detail={"source_type": payload.source_type},
    )
    db.commit()
    return {
        "id": inspiration.id,
        "source_type": inspiration.source_type,
        "status": inspiration.status,
        "extraction": extraction,
        "disclosure": (
            "Candidates are suggestions only. Confirm them before adding anything to the itinerary."
        ),
    }


def _blocked_ids(db: Session, user_id: str) -> set[str]:
    rows = (
        db.query(UserBlock)
        .filter((UserBlock.blocker_id == user_id) | (UserBlock.blocked_id == user_id))
        .all()
    )
    blocked: set[str] = set()
    for row in rows:
        blocked.add(row.blocker_id)
        blocked.add(row.blocked_id)
    blocked.discard(user_id)

        db.query(TripMember)

        .all()

    result = []
    for membership in memberships:
        trip = db.get(Trip, membership.trip_id)
        if not trip or trip.deleted_at:

        result.append(trip_out(db, trip, membership))

@router.post("", status_code=201)
async def create_trip(
    payload: TripCreate,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    _validate_dates(payload.start_date, payload.end_date)
    destination = db.get(Destination, payload.destination_id) if payload.destination_id else None
    if payload.destination_id and not destination:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Destination not found")
    trip = Trip(
        name=payload.name.strip(),
        description=payload.description,
        destination_id=destination.id if destination else None,
        destination_name=(destination.name if destination else payload.destination_name or "").strip(),
        start_date=payload.start_date,
        end_date=payload.end_date,
        group_size=payload.group_size,
        budget_total=payload.budget_total,
        currency=payload.currency.upper()[:8],
        base_lat=destination.lat if destination else 0.0,
        base_lon=destination.lon if destination else 0.0,
        created_by=user.id,
        privacy="private",
    )
    db.add(trip)
    db.flush()
    db.add(Itinerary(trip_id=trip.id, confirmed_version=0))
    membership = TripMember(
        trip_id=trip.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        role="owner",
        status="active",
        display_name=user.display_name,
    )
    db.add(membership)
    audit(
        db,
        action="trip.create",
        entity_type="trip",
        entity_id=trip.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
        detail={"name": trip.name},
    )
    db.commit()
    return trip_out(db, trip, membership)

@router.patch("/{trip_id}")
async def update_trip(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: TripUpdate,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, member = _trip(db, trip_id, user, {"owner", "admin"})
    data = payload.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
    if "start_date" in data or "end_date" in data:
        _validate_dates(
            data.get("start_date", trip.start_date), data.get("end_date", trip.end_date)
        )
    for field, value in data.items():
        setattr(trip, field, value)
    audit(
        db,
        action="trip.update",
        entity_type="trip",
        entity_id=trip.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
        detail=data,
    )
    db.commit()
    await manager.broadcast(
        trip.id,
        event_payload("trip.updated", trip_id=trip.id, by=user.display_name),
    )
    return trip_out(db, trip, member)

@router.patch("/{trip_id}/members/{member_id}")
async def update_member_role(
    trip_id: str,
    member_id: str,
    payload: MemberRoleUpdate,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, actor = _trip(db, trip_id, user, {"owner", "admin"})
    target = db.get(TripMember, member_id)
    if not target or target.trip_id != trip.id or target.status != "active":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Member not found")
    if target.role == "owner":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Transfer ownership explicitly; it cannot be overwritten")
    if payload.role == "owner":
        if actor.role != "owner":
            raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Only the owner can transfer ownership")
        actor.role = "admin"
        target.role = "owner"
    else:
        if target.user_id == user.id:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="You cannot change your own role")
        target.role = payload.role
    audit(
        db,
        action="member.role_update",
        entity_type="trip_member",
        entity_id=target.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
        detail={"role": payload.role},
    )
    db.commit()
    await manager.broadcast(
        trip.id,
        event_payload(
            "member.role_updated",
            trip_id=trip.id,
            member_id=target.id,
            role=target.role,
        ),
    )
    return member_out(db, target, user.id)


@router.delete("/{trip_id}/members/{member_id}")
async def remove_member(
    trip_id: str,
    member_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, actor = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    target = db.get(TripMember, member_id)
    if not target or target.trip_id != trip.id or target.status != "active":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Member not found")
    if target.id == actor.id and target.role == "owner":
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail="Transfer ownership to another member before leaving the trip.",
        )
    if target.id != actor.id and actor.role not in {"owner", "admin"}:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Only owners and admins can remove members")
    if target.role == "owner":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="The owner cannot be removed")
    target.status = "left"
    audit(
        db,
        action="member.remove",
        entity_type="trip_member",
        entity_id=target.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
    )
    if target.user_id and target.id != actor.id:
        db.add(
            Notification(
                user_id=target.user_id,
                trip_id=trip.id,
                kind="member_removed",
                title=f"You were removed from {trip.name}",
                link=f"/dashboard",
            )
        )
    db.commit()
    await manager.broadcast(
        trip.id, event_payload("member.removed", trip_id=trip.id, member_id=target.id)
    )
    return {"ok": True}

@router.get("/admin/abuse-reports")
def list_abuse_reports(
    status: str = Query(default="open", pattern=r"^(open|resolved|dismissed|all)$"),
    user: User = Depends(require_admin),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    query = db.query(AbuseReport)
    if status != "all":
        query = query.filter(AbuseReport.status == status)
    rows = query.order_by(AbuseReport.created_at.desc()).limit(200).all()
    users = {
        person.id: person
        for person in db.query(User)
        .filter(User.id.in_({row.reporter_id for row in rows} | {row.target_user_id for row in rows if row.target_user_id}))
        .all()
    } if rows else {}
    return {
        "items": [
            {
                "id": row.id,
                "reporter": (
                    {
                        "id": users[row.reporter_id].id,
                        "display_name": users[row.reporter_id].display_name,
                    }
                    if row.reporter_id in users
                    else None
                ),
                "target_type": row.target_type,
                "target_id": row.target_id,
                "target_user_id": row.target_user_id,
                "reason": row.reason,
                "status": row.status,
                "reviewed_by": row.reviewed_by,
                "reviewed_at": row.reviewed_at,
                "created_at": row.created_at,
            }
            for row in rows
        ]
    }


@router.post("/admin/abuse-reports/{report_id}/decide")
def decide_abuse_report(
    report_id: str,
    payload: AbuseDecisionIn,
    user: User = Depends(require_admin),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    report = db.get(AbuseReport, report_id)
    if not report:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Report not found")
    if report.status != "open":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="This report was already reviewed")
    hidden = False
    if payload.decision == "hide_content":
        if report.target_type == "post" and report.target_id:
            post = db.get(CirclePost, report.target_id)
            if post:
                post.status = "removed"
                hidden = True
        elif report.target_type == "memory" and report.target_id:
            memory = db.get(TripMemory, report.target_id)
            if memory and memory.deleted_at is None:
                memory.visibility = "private"
                memory.approved = False
                hidden = True
        else:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=422,
                detail="Content can only be hidden for posts and memories; use warn otherwise",
            )
    report.status = "resolved" if payload.decision in {"hide_content", "warn"} else "dismissed"
    report.reviewed_by = user.id
    report.reviewed_at = utcnow()
    db.add(
        Notification(
            user_id=report.reporter_id,
            kind="moderation_update",
            title="Your report was reviewed",
            body="Moderators reviewed your report and recorded an outcome.",
            link="/settings",
        )
    )
    if payload.decision == "warn" and report.target_user_id:
        db.add(
            Notification(
                user_id=report.target_user_id,
                kind="moderation_warning",
                title="Community guidelines reminder",
                body=payload.note or "A moderator reviewed content connected to your account.",
                link="/settings",
            )
        )
    audit(
        db,
        action="abuse.decide",
        entity_type="abuse_report",
        entity_id=report.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        detail={"decision": payload.decision, "hidden": hidden},
    )
    db.commit()
    return {
        "ok": True,
        "status": report.status,
        "content_hidden": hidden,
        "note": "Reporter is notified without exposing reviewer identity.",
    }

1	export const API_URL =
2	  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL?.replace(/\/$/, "") || "http://localhost:8000";

4	export class ApiError extends Error {
5	  status: number;
6	  detail: unknown;
7	
8	  constructor(status: number, detail: unknown) {
9	    const message =
10	      typeof detail === "string"
11	        ? detail
12	        : Array.isArray(detail)
13	          ? detail
14	              .map((item) =>
15	                typeof item === "object" && item && "msg" in item
16	                  ? String((item as { msg: unknown }).msg)
17	                  : String(item),
18	              )
19	              .join(" · ")
20	          : detail && typeof detail === "object" && "message" in detail
21	            ? String((detail as { message: unknown }).message)
22	            : `Request failed (${status})`;
23	    super(message);
24	    this.name = "ApiError";
25	    this.status = status;
26	    this.detail = detail;
27	  }
28	}

30	export function tokenFromStore(): string | null {
31	  if (typeof window === "undefined") return null;
32	  try {
33	    const raw = window.localStorage.getItem("safar-auth");
34	    if (!raw) return null;
35	    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as { state?: { token?: string | null } };
36	    return parsed.state?.token || null;
37	  } catch {
38	    return null;
39	  }
40	}
41	
42	type Options = Omit<RequestInit, "body"> & { body?: unknown; raw?: boolean };
43	
44	export async function api<T>(path: string, options: Options = {}): Promise<T> {
45	  const token = tokenFromStore();
46	  const headers = new Headers(options.headers);
47	  if (options.body !== undefined && !(options.body instanceof FormData)) {
48	    headers.set("Content-Type", "application/json");
49	  }
50	  headers.set("Accept", "application/json");
51	  if (token) headers.set("Authorization", `Bearer ${token}`);
52	
53	  const response = await fetch(`${API_URL}${path}`, {
54	    ...options,
55	    headers,
56	    body:
57	      options.body === undefined
58	        ? undefined
59	        : options.body instanceof FormData
60	          ? options.body
61	          : JSON.stringify(options.body),
62	    cache: "no-store",
63	  });
64	
65	  if (response.status === 401 && typeof window !== "undefined") {
66	    window.dispatchEvent(new Event("safar:unauthorized"));
67	  }
68	
69	  if (!response.ok) {
70	    let detail: unknown = response.statusText;
71	    try {
72	      const data = await response.json();
73	      detail = data.detail ?? data;
74	    } catch {
75	      try {
76	        detail = await response.text();
77	      } catch {
78	        /* ignore */
79	      }
80	    }
81	    throw new ApiError(response.status, detail);
82	  }
83	
84	  if (response.status === 204) return undefined as T;
85	  const contentType = response.headers.get("content-type") || "";
86	  if (options.raw || contentType.includes("text/html") || contentType.includes("text/csv")) {
87	    return (await response.text()) as T;
88	  }
89	  return (await response.json()) as T;
90	}

92	export function wsUrl(tripId: string): string | null {
93	  const token = tokenFromStore();
94	  if (!token) return null;
95	  const base = API_URL.replace(/^http/, "ws");
96	  return `${base}/ws/trips/${tripId}?token=${encodeURIComponent(token)}`;
97	}

"""Grounded travel assistant (F22) with explicit capability disclosure."""

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.core.deps import get_current_user, get_db, get_trip_and_member
from app.models import Trip, TripMember, User
from app.schemas.schemas import ChatIn
from app.services.assistant import GENERATOR, answer

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/assistant", tags=["assistant"])


def _answer_with_trip(db: Session, user: User, trip: Trip, message: str) -> dict:
    return answer(db, user, trip, message)


@router.get("/capabilities")
def capabilities():
    return {
        "generator": GENERATOR,
        "type": "grounded retrieval",
        "external_llm": False,
        "translation": False,
        "weather": False,
        "answer_sources": [
            "confirmed itinerary",
            "trip expenses and settlement suggestions",
            "trip members and roles",
            "open proposals",
            "latest recommendation batches",
            "catalog activity records and recent traveller reports",
        ],
        "disclosure": (
            "No external AI, weather or translation provider is configured. "
            "Answers state only what SAFAR has recorded and label limitations."
        ),
    }


@router.post("/chat")
def chat(
    payload: ChatIn,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    if payload.trip_id:
        trip, _member = get_trip_and_member(payload.trip_id, db, user)
        return {**_answer_with_trip(db, user, trip, payload.message), "trip_id": trip.id}
    trips = (
        db.query(Trip)
        .join(TripMember, TripMember.trip_id == Trip.id)
        .filter(
            TripMember.user_id == user.id,
            TripMember.status == "active",
            Trip.deleted_at.is_(None),
        )
        .order_by(Trip.start_date.desc())
        .all()
    )
    return {
        "intent": "general",
        "answer": (
            "Choose a trip workspace and ask about its itinerary, budget, members, "
            "open proposals or recommendations. I only state what SAFAR has recorded."
        ),
        "citations": [],
        "grounding": "product",
        "limitations": ["No trip selected."],
        "suggested_actions": [
            {"label": "Open a trip", "href": f"/trips/{trip.id}"} for trip in trips[:3]
        ],
        "generated_by": GENERATOR,
        "trip_id": None,
    }


trip_router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/trips", tags=["assistant"])


@trip_router.post("/{trip_id}/assistant")
def trip_chat(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: ChatIn,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = get_trip_and_member(trip_id, db, user)
    if payload.trip_id and payload.trip_id != trip.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Trip mismatch")
    return {**_answer_with_trip(db, user, trip, payload.message), "trip_id": trip.id}

@router.post("/{trip_id}/itinerary/items", status_code=201)
async def add_item(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: ItemCreate,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user, ADMIN_ROLES)
    _within_trip(trip, payload.day)
    itinerary = _get_itinerary(db, trip)
    activity = db.get(Activity, payload.activity_id) if payload.activity_id else None
    if payload.activity_id and not activity:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Activity not found")
    if activity and activity.destination_id != trip.destination_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Activity is not in this trip's destination")
    title = payload.title or (activity.name if activity else None)
    if not title:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="A title is required")
    item = ItineraryItem(
        itinerary_id=itinerary.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
        day=payload.day,
        start_time=payload.start_time,
        title=title,
        activity_id=activity.id if activity else None,
        place_id=activity.place_id if activity else None,
        notes=payload.notes,
        cost_estimate=(
            payload.cost_estimate
            if payload.cost_estimate is not None
            else (activity.price_estimate if activity else 0.0)
        ),
        is_protected=payload.is_protected,
        created_by=user.id,
        sort_order=_next_sort_order(db, trip.id, payload.day),
    )
    db.add(item)
    db.flush()
    record_itinerary_version(
        db, itinerary, user_id=user.id, note=f"Added {item.title}"
    )
    audit(
        db,
        action="itinerary.item_add",
        entity_type="itinerary_item",
        entity_id=item.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
        detail={"title": item.title},
    )
    notify_trip_members(
        db,
        trip,
        kind="itinerary_updated",
        title=f"{user.display_name} added {item.title}",
        link=f"/trips/{trip.id}/itinerary",
        exclude_user_id=user.id,
    )
    db.commit()
    await manager.broadcast(
        trip.id,
        event_payload("itinerary.updated", trip_id=trip.id, by=user.display_name),
    )
    return _serialize_items(db, [item], user.id)[0]


@router.patch("/{trip_id}/itinerary/items/{item_id}")
async def update_item(
    trip_id: str,
    item_id: str,
    payload: ItemUpdate,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user, ADMIN_ROLES)
    item = db.get(ItineraryItem, item_id)
    if not item or item.trip_id != trip.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Itinerary item not found")
    data = payload.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
    if "day" in data:
        _within_trip(trip, data["day"])
    for field, value in data.items():
        setattr(item, field, value)
    db.flush()
    itinerary = _get_itinerary(db, trip)
    record_itinerary_version(
        db, itinerary, user_id=user.id, note=f"Updated {item.title}"
    )
    audit(
        db,
        action="itinerary.item_update",
        entity_type="itinerary_item",
        entity_id=item.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
        detail={"fields": list(data.keys())},
    )
    notify_trip_members(
        db,
        trip,
        kind="itinerary_updated",
        title=f"{user.display_name} updated {item.title}",
        link=f"/trips/{trip.id}/itinerary",
        exclude_user_id=user.id,
    )
    db.commit()
    await manager.broadcast(
        trip.id, event_payload("itinerary.updated", trip_id=trip.id)
    )
    return _serialize_items(db, [item], user.id)[0]


@router.delete("/{trip_id}/itinerary/items/{item_id}")
async def delete_item(
    trip_id: str,
    item_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user, ADMIN_ROLES)
    item = db.get(ItineraryItem, item_id)
    if not item or item.trip_id != trip.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Itinerary item not found")
    item.status = "cancelled"
    db.flush()
    itinerary = _get_itinerary(db, trip)
    record_itinerary_version(
        db, itinerary, user_id=user.id, note=f"Removed {item.title}"
    )
    audit(
        db,
        action="itinerary.item_remove",
        entity_type="itinerary_item",
        entity_id=item.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
    )
    notify_trip_members(
        db,
        trip,
        kind="itinerary_updated",
        title=f"{user.display_name} removed {item.title}",
        link=f"/trips/{trip.id}/itinerary",
        exclude_user_id=user.id,
    )
    db.commit()
    await manager.broadcast(
        trip.id, event_payload("itinerary.updated", trip_id=trip.id)

@router.post("/{trip_id}/proposals/{proposal_id}/reject")
async def reject_proposal(
    trip_id: str,
    proposal_id: str,
    reason: str | None = Query(default=None, max_length=500),
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user, ADMIN_ROLES)
    proposal = db.get(ItineraryProposal, proposal_id)
    if not proposal or proposal.trip_id != trip.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Proposal not found")
    if proposal.status != "open":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="This proposal is no longer open")
    proposal.status = "rejected"
    proposal.decided_by = user.id
    proposal.decided_at = utcnow()
    if reason:
        proposal.summary = f"{proposal.summary or ''}\nRejected: {reason}".strip()
    audit(
        db,
        action="proposal.reject",
        entity_type="itinerary_proposal",
        entity_id=proposal.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
        detail={"reason": reason},
    )
    notify_trip_members(
        db,
        trip,
        kind="proposal_rejected",
        title=f"Not this time: {proposal.title}",
        body=reason,
        link=f"/trips/{trip.id}/voting",
        exclude_user_id=user.id,
    )
    db.commit()
    await manager.broadcast(
        trip.id,
        event_payload("proposal.rejected", trip_id=trip.id, proposal_id=proposal.id),
    )
    return proposal_out(db, proposal, user.id)

def _pact_conflicts(db: Session, trip: Trip, operations: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
    pact = db.query(JourneyPact).filter(JourneyPact.trip_id == trip.id).first()
    if not pact:
        return []
    must_do = {str(title).strip().lower() for title in (pact.must_do or [])}
    exceptions = {str(title).strip().lower() for title in (pact.exceptions or [])}
    conflicts = []
    for operation in operations:
        if operation["op"] != "cancel":
            continue
        title = (operation.get("title") or "").strip().lower()
        if not title:
            continue
        for rule in must_do:
            if rule and (rule in title or title in rule):
                if any(exception in title or title in exception for exception in exceptions):
                    continue
                conflicts.append(
                    {
                        "item": operation["title"],
                        "rule": "Agreed must-do activity (Journey Pact)",
                        "resolution": "Add a Journey Pact exception or keep the item.",
                    }
                )
    return conflicts

def recommendation_out(rec: Recommendation, activity: Activity | None) -> dict:
    return {
        "id": rec.id,
        "activity_id": rec.activity_id,
        "rank": rec.rank,
        "score": rec.score,
        "average_fit": rec.average_fit,
        "minimum_fit": rec.minimum_fit,
        "fairness_spread": rec.fairness_spread,
        "novelty": rec.novelty,
        "penalties": rec.penalties or {},
        "explanation": rec.explanation or {},
        "status": rec.status,
        "activity": activity_out(activity) if activity else None,
    }


def expense_out(
    db: Session, expense: Expense, participant_rows: list[ExpenseParticipant] | None = None
) -> dict:
    rows = participant_rows or []
    participants = []
    user_cache: dict[str, User | None] = {}
    for row in rows:
        user = None
        if row.user_id:
            if row.user_id not in user_cache:
                user_cache[row.user_id] = db.get(User, row.user_id)
            user = user_cache[row.user_id]
        participants.append(
            {
                "id": row.id,
                "user": user_public(user),
                "guest_name": row.guest_name,
                "weight": row.weight,
                "share_amount": row.share_amount,
            }
        )
    payer = db.get(User, expense.paid_by)
    return {
        "id": expense.id,
        "title": expense.title,
        "category": expense.category,
        "amount": expense.amount,
        "currency": expense.currency,
        "paid_by": expense.paid_by,
        "payer": user_public(payer),
        "incurred_on": expense.incurred_on,
        "notes": expense.notes,
        "participants": participants,
        "created_at": expense.created_at,
    }

def _explanation(
    ranked: RankedActivity,
    contexts: list[MemberContext],
    mode: str,
    target: MemberContext | None,
) -> dict:
    activity = ranked.activity
    tags = [normalize_tag(tag) for tag in (activity.tags or [])][:5]
    tag_text = ", ".join(tags) if tags else "mixed interests"

    why: list[str] = []
    if mode == "everyone_wins":
        why.append(
            f"Balances the group: average fit {ranked.average_fit:.0f}/100 with the least-served member at {ranked.minimum_fit:.0f}/100."
        )
    elif mode == "your_turn":
        why.append(
            "Gives extra weight to a member whose interests the confirmed plan represents least."
        )
        if ranked.target_fit is not None:
            why.append(f"Fit for that member is {ranked.target_fit:.0f}/100.")
    else:
        why.append(
            f"Unfamiliar but relevant: novelty {round(ranked.novelty * 100):.0f}/100 while every member stays above {ranked.minimum_fit:.0f}/100."
        )
    why.append(f"Matches group interests in {tag_text}.")
    if ranked.penalties["total"] > 0:
        why.append(
            f"Penalties applied for time, budget and uncertainty: {ranked.penalties['total']:.0f} points total."
        )

    suits = [f"Members interested in {tag_text}"]
    if activity.indoor:
        suits.append("Members who prefer indoor experiences")
    if activity.effort <= 2:
        suits.append("Members looking for a lower-effort option")
    if activity.price_estimate <= 15:
        suits.append("Budget-conscious members")

    may_not = []
    low_fits = [ctx for ctx, fit in zip(contexts, ranked.fits) if fit < 55]
    if low_fits:
        may_not.append("Members whose interests are not aligned with these tags")
    if activity.effort >= 4:
        may_not.append("Members with low energy today")
    if activity.price_estimate >= 60:
        may_not.append("Members near their budget comfort level")
    if not may_not:
        may_not.append("No strong mismatch identified for the current group")

    constraints = [
        {
            "constraint": "Budget",
            "status": "satisfied",
            "detail": f"Estimated {activity.currency} {activity.price_estimate:.0f} per person is within every stated limit.",
        },
        {
            "constraint": "Accessibility",
            "status": (
                "satisfied"
                if not any(ctx.needs_wheelchair_access for ctx in contexts)
                else ("satisfied" if activity.wheelchair_accessible else "unknown")
            ),
            "detail": (
                "Step-free access confirmed in the catalog."
                if activity.wheelchair_accessible is True
                else (
                    "No accessibility requirement stated by members."
                    if not any(ctx.needs_wheelchair_access for ctx in contexts)
                    else "Accessibility is not confirmed for this place; treat as unknown."
                )
            ),
        target_index = hardest
        target_ctx = contexts[hardest]
        for result in ranked:
            result.target_fit = result.fits[hardest]
            result.score = round(
                clamp(
                    0.45 * result.average_fit
                    + 0.20 * result.minimum_fit
                    + 0.30 * result.fits[hardest]
                    + 0.05 * result.novelty * 100
                    - result.penalties["total"],
                    0,
                    100,
                ),
                1,
            )

    ranked.sort(key=lambda item: item.score, reverse=True)
    top = ranked[:limit]
    alternatives = ranked[limit : limit + 3]

    for result in top:
        explanation = _explanation(result, contexts, mode, target_ctx)
        explanation["alternatives"] = [
            {
                "activity_id": alt.activity.id,
                "name": alt.activity.name,
                "score_delta": round(result.score - alt.score, 1),
            }
            for alt in alternatives
        ]
        result.explanation = explanation

    top_scores = [item.score for item in top]
    close_call = len(top_scores) >= 2 and (top_scores[0] - top_scores[1]) < 4
    missing_pulse = [ctx for ctx in contexts if ctx.pulse is None]
    clarifying_question = None
    if close_call and missing_pulse:
        clarifying_question = (
            f"{len(missing_pulse)} of {len(contexts)} members haven't shared a Trip Pulse today. "
            "Knowing their available time and energy could change the top result."
        )

    return {
        "mode": mode,
        "mode_meta": MODE_META[mode],
        "for_date": for_date,
        "items": top,
        "contexts": contexts,
        "target": target_ctx,
        "meta": {
            "model_version": ENGINE_VERSION,
            "candidate_count": len(activities),

            "pulse_coverage": f"{len(contexts) - len(missing_pulse)}/{len(contexts)}",
            "hard_constraints": [

                "wheelchair accessibility requirements",
                "today's available time",
                "today's travel radius",
            ],
            "ranking_formula": (
                "mode-weighted average fit + minimum fit + novelty - time, budget and uncertainty penalties"
            ),
            "disclosure": (
                "Catalog attributes are curated seed data. Travel times are estimates. "
                "Private budgets and preferences are used for filtering but never exposed."
            ),
        },
        "exclusion_reasons": exclusion_reasons,
        "clarifying_question": clarifying_question,
        "all_ranked_ids": [item.activity.id for item in ranked],
    }

    db: Session,
    trip: Trip,
    members: list[TripMember],
    *,
    mode: str,
    for_date: date,
    limit: int = 6,
) -> dict:
    if mode not in MODE_META:
        mode = "everyone_wins"
    contexts = build_member_contexts(db, trip, members, for_date)
    if not contexts:
        return {"items": [], "error": "No active members to personalise for."}
    if not trip.destination_id:
        return {
            "items": [],
            "error": "Set a destination for this trip before generating group recommendations.",
        }

    activities = (
        db.query(Activity)
        .filter(Activity.destination_id == trip.destination_id)
        .order_by(Activity.name)
        .all()

"""Trip Twin (F08): compare alternatives without touching the confirmed plan."""

from datetime import date

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.models import Activity, ItineraryItem, Place, Trip, TripMember
from app.services.engine import rank_activity
from app.services.geo import haversine_km, travel_minutes


def _activity_coords(db: Session, activity: Activity) -> tuple[float, float]:
    if not activity.place_id:
        return (0.0, 0.0)
    place = db.get(Place, activity.place_id)
    return (place.lat, place.lon) if place else (0.0, 0.0)


def _metrics_for_activities(
    db: Session,
    trip: Trip,
    contexts,
    activities: list[Activity],
    fallback_costs: dict[str, float] | None = None,
    fallback_durations: dict[str, int] | None = None,
) -> dict:
    fits: list[list[float]] = [[] for _ in contexts]
    total_cost = 0.0
    total_duration = 0
    total_travel = 0
    details = []
    for activity in activities:
        coords = _activity_coords(db, activity)
        distance = haversine_km(trip.base_lat, trip.base_lon, *coords) if coords != (0.0, 0.0) else 0.0
        leg = travel_minutes(distance)
        ranked = rank_activity(
            activity,
            contexts,
            base_lat=trip.base_lat,
            base_lon=trip.base_lon,
            coords=coords,
            target_member_index=None,
            mode="everyone_wins",
        )
        if ranked:
            for index, fit in enumerate(ranked.fits):
                fits[index].append(fit)
        total_cost += activity.price_estimate
        total_duration += activity.duration_minutes
        total_travel += leg
        details.append(
            {
                "activity_id": activity.id,
                "name": activity.name,
                "cost": activity.price_estimate,
                "duration": activity.duration_minutes,
                "distance_km": distance,
                "travel_minutes": leg,
                "eligible": ranked is not None,
            }
        )
    per_member = [sum(values) / len(values) for values in fits if values]
    return {
        "total_cost": round(total_cost, 2),
        "total_duration_minutes": total_duration,
        "total_travel_minutes": total_travel,
        "average_group_fit": round(sum(per_member) / len(per_member), 1) if per_member else None,
        "minimum_member_fit": round(min(per_member), 1) if per_member else None,
        "items": details,
    }

@router.post("/trips/{trip_id}/place-reports", status_code=201)
def create_place_report(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: PlaceReportIn,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    if not payload.activity_id and not payload.place_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Provide an activity or place for this report")
    activity = None
    place = None
    if payload.activity_id:
        activity = _activity_for_trip(db, trip, payload.activity_id)
        place = db.get(Place, activity.place_id) if activity.place_id else None
    if payload.place_id:
        if place and payload.place_id != place.id:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Activity and place do not match")
        place = db.get(Place, payload.place_id)
        if not place or place.destination_id != trip.destination_id:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Place not found for this trip")
        if not activity:
            activity = (
                db.query(Activity)
                .filter(Activity.place_id == place.id)
                .first()
            )
    if payload.source_type == "official" and not user.is_admin:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=403,
            detail="Only platform moderators can mark a report as officially sourced",
        )
    if len(json.dumps(payload.value)) > 2000:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Report value is too large")
    observed_at = _naive_utc(payload.observed_at)
    if observed_at > utcnow() + timedelta(minutes=5):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Observation time cannot be in the future")
    confidence = payload.confidence
    if confidence is None:
        confidence = {"official": 0.8, "community": 0.6, "estimated": 0.4, "unknown": 0.2}[
            payload.source_type
        ]
    report = PlaceReport(
        activity_id=activity.id if activity else None,
        place_id=place.id if place else None,
        trip_id=trip.id,
        reporter_id=user.id,
        category=payload.category,
        value=payload.value,
        note=payload.note,
        observed_at=observed_at,
        source_type=payload.source_type,
        confidence=confidence,
        verified=False,
    )
    db.add(report)
    audit(
        db,
        action="place_report.create",
        entity_type="place_report",
        entity_id=report.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
        detail={"category": payload.category, "source_type": payload.source_type},
    )
    if member.role in {"owner", "admin"}:
        notify_trip_members(
            db,
            trip,
            kind="place_report",
            title=f"New {payload.category} report",
            body=f"{user.display_name} shared what they observed.",
            link=f"/trips/{trip.id}/places",
            exclude_user_id=user.id,
        )
    db.commit()
    result = report_out(
        db, report, place_service.freshness(report.observed_at, report.source_type)
    )
    result["provenance"] = place_service.provenance(report.source_type, report.verified)
    result["disclosure"] = "Community reports are unverified observations, not official facts."
    return result

7	
8	import {
9	  Badge,
10	  Card,
11	  EmptyState,
12	  ErrorState,
13	  Field,
14	  FlowNote,
15	  Input,

17	  Progress,
18	  Select,

20	import { useSearch, useTrip } from "@/lib/hooks";

22	
23	const TAGS = ["culture", "food", "nature", "history", "adventure", "relaxation", "shopping", "iconic"];
24	const LENSES = [
25	  { value: "balanced", label: "Balanced" },
26	  { value: "local", label: "Local life" },
27	  { value: "quiet", label: "Quiet" },
28	  { value: "iconic", label: "Iconic" },
29	];
30	
31	export default function PlacesPage() {
32	  const params = useParams<{ tripId: string }>();
33	  const tripId = typeof params?.tripId === "string" ? params.tripId : "";
34	  const trip = useTrip(tripId);
35	  const [q, setQ] = useState("");
36	  const [lens, setLens] = useState("balanced");
37	  const [maxBudget, setMaxBudget] = useState("");
38	  const [maxDuration, setMaxDuration] = useState("");
39	  const [tags, setTags] = useState<string[]>([]);
40	  const [indoor, setIndoor] = useState(false);
41	  const [accessible, setAccessible] = useState(false);
42	
43	  const results = useSearch({
44	    destination_id: trip.data?.destination_id || undefined,
45	    q,
46	    lens,
47	    max_budget: maxBudget ? Number(maxBudget) : undefined,
48	    max_duration: maxDuration ? Number(maxDuration) : undefined,
49	    tags: tags.length ? tags.join(",") : undefined,
50	    indoor,
51	    accessible,
52	    limit: 24,
53	  });
54	
55	  const items = useMemo(() => results.data?.items || [], [results.data]);
56	
57	  if (trip.isLoading) return <PageSkeleton />;
58	  if (trip.error || !trip.data) {
59	    return <ErrorState error={trip.error || new Error("Trip not found")} retry={() => trip.refetch()} />;
60	  }
61	
62	  return (
63	    <div className="space-y-5">
64	      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
65	        <div>
66	          <p className="eyebrow">Catalog search</p>
67	          <h2 className="mt-1 text-2xl">Find something for {trip.data.destination_name || "the journey"}</h2>
68	          <p className="mt-1 max-w-prose text-sm text-muted">
69	            Search activities in this destination. Personal fit is an estimate from your Journey DNA,
70	            not a live provider score.
71	          </p>
72	        </div>
73	        {trip.data.destination_id ? null : (
74	          <Badge tone="ember">Set a destination to search</Badge>
75	        )}
76	      </div>
77	
78	      <Card className="space-y-4">
79	        <div className="relative">
80	          <SearchIcon size={16} className="absolute left-3.5 top-3.5 text-faint" />
81	          <Input
82	            value={q}
83	            onChange={(event) => setQ(event.target.value)}
84	            placeholder="Museum, viewpoint, food tour…"
85	            className="h-11 pl-10"
86	          />
87	        </div>
88	
89	        <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-4">
90	          <Field label="Lens">
91	            <Select value={lens} onChange={(event) => setLens(event.target.value)}>
92	              {LENSES.map((entry) => (
93	                <option key={entry.value} value={entry.value}>
94	                  {entry.label}
95	                </option>
96	              ))}
97	            </Select>
98	          </Field>
99	          <Field label="Max price" hint={`${trip.data.currency} per person`}>
100	            <Input
101	              type="number"
102	              min="0"
103	              value={maxBudget}
104	              onChange={(event) => setMaxBudget(event.target.value)}
105	              placeholder="Any"
106	            />
107	          </Field>
108	          <Field label="Max duration" hint="minutes">
109	            <Input
110	              type="number"
111	              min="0"
112	              value={maxDuration}
113	              onChange={(event) => setMaxDuration(event.target.value)}
114	              placeholder="Any"
115	            />
116	          </Field>
117	          <div className="space-y-1.5">
118	            <span className="text-[13px] font-medium text-ink">Hard filters</span>
119	            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
120	              <button
121	                onClick={() => setIndoor((value) => !value)}
122	                className={cn(
123	                  "rounded-full border px-2.5 py-1 text-[11.5px]",
124	                  indoor ? "border-ember bg-ember-soft text-ember" : "border-line bg-surface text-muted",
125	                )}
126	              >
127	                Indoor
128	              </button>
129	              <button
130	                onClick={() => setAccessible((value) => !value)}
131	                className={cn(
132	                  "rounded-full border px-2.5 py-1 text-[11.5px]",
133	                  accessible ? "border-jade bg-jade-soft text-jade" : "border-line bg-surface text-muted",
134	                )}
135	              >
136	                Step-free
137	              </button>
138	            </div>
139	          </div>
140	        </div>
141	
142	        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
143	          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] text-faint">
144	            <SlidersHorizontal size={11} /> Tags
145	          </span>
146	          {TAGS.map((tag) => (
147	            <button
148	              key={tag}
149	              onClick={() =>
150	                setTags((current) =>
151	                  current.includes(tag) ? current.filter((entry) => entry !== tag) : [...current, tag],
152	                )
153	              }
154	              className={cn(
155	                "rounded-full border px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px]",
156	                tags.includes(tag)
157	                  ? "border-ink bg-ink text-paper"
158	                  : "border-line bg-surface text-muted hover:border-ink/30 hover:text-ink",
159	              )}
160	            >
161	              {titleCase(tag)}
162	            </button>
163	          ))}
164	        </div>
165	      </Card>
166	
167	      {results.isLoading ? (
168	        <PageSkeleton />
169	      ) : results.error ? (
170	        <ErrorState error={results.error} retry={() => results.refetch()} />
171	      ) : items.length === 0 ? (
172	        <EmptyState
173	          title="No matches"
174	          description="Loosen a filter or try a different lens. The catalog only contains places in this destination."
175	          icon={<SearchIcon size={24} />}
176	        />
177	      ) : (
178	        <div className="space-y-3">
179	          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
180	            <p className="text-[11px] text-faint">{items.length} result(s)</p>
181	            {results.data?.personalised ? (
182	              <Badge tone="jade">
183	                <Sparkles size={10} /> Personalised fit
184	              </Badge>
185	            ) : (
186	              <Badge tone="outline">Catalog fit</Badge>
187	            )}
188	          </div>
189	          {items.map((entry) => (
190	            <Card key={entry.activity.id} className="space-y-3">
191	              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
192	                <div className="min-w-0">
193	                  <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
194	                    <Badge tone="outline">{entry.provenance || "ESTIMATED"}</Badge>
195	                    {entry.activity.fragile ? <Badge tone="rose">Fragile place</Badge> : null}
196	                    {entry.activity.wheelchair_accessible === true ? (
197	                      <Badge tone="jade">Step-free</Badge>
198	                    ) : null}
199	                  </div>
200	                  <h3 className="mt-1.5 text-lg leading-snug">
201	                    <Link href={`/trips/${tripId}/places/${entry.activity.id}`} className="hover:text-ember">
202	                      {entry.activity.name}
203	                    </Link>
204	                  </h3>
205	                  <p className="mt-1 max-w-prose line-clamp-2 text-[13px] leading-5 text-muted">
206	                    {entry.activity.description}
207	                  </p>
208	                  <p className="mt-1.5 flex flex-wrap gap-x-3 text-[11px] text-faint">
209	                    <span>{formatMoney(entry.activity.price_estimate, entry.activity.currency)}</span>
210	                    <span>{entry.activity.duration_minutes} min</span>
211	                    <span>effort {entry.activity.effort}/5</span>
212	                    {entry.activity.place?.name ? <span>{entry.activity.place.name}</span> : null}
213	                  </p>
214	                </div>
215	                <div className="w-32 shrink-0">
216	                  <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between text-[11px]">
217	                    <span className="text-faint">Personal fit</span>
218	                    <span className="font-mono text-ink">{entry.personal_fit.toFixed(0)}</span>
219	                  </div>
220	                  <Progress
221	                    value={pct(entry.personal_fit)}
222	                    tone={entry.personal_fit >= 65 ? "jade" : "ember"}
223	                    className="mt-1"
224	                  />
225	                  {entry.similar_to ? (
226	                    <p className="mt-1.5 text-[10px] text-faint">Similar to {entry.similar_to}</p>
227	                  ) : null}
228	                </div>
229	              </div>
230	              {entry.respect_note ? (
231	                <p className="rounded-xl border border-ember/20 bg-ember-soft/40 px-3 py-2 text-[11.5px] leading-5 text-ember">
232	                  {entry.respect_note}
233	                </p>
234	              ) : null}
235	              <div className="flex justify-end border-t border-line pt-2.5">
236	                <Link
237	                  href={`/trips/${tripId}/places/${entry.activity.id}`}
238	                  className="text-[12px] text-ember hover:underline"
239	                >
240	                  Evidence, access & reports →
241	                </Link>
242	              </div>
243	            </Card>
244	          ))}
245	        </div>
246	      )}
247	
248	      <FlowNote>
249	        {results.data?.disclosure ||
250	          "Catalog attributes are curated data. Personal fit is an estimate, not a live provider score."}
251	      </FlowNote>
252	    </div>
253	  );
254	}

210	  Object.entries(params).forEach(([key, value]) => {
211	    if (value !== undefined && value !== "" && value !== false) query.set(key, String(value));
212	  });
213	  const qs = query.toString();
214	  return useQuery({
215	    queryKey: ["search", qs],
216	    queryFn: () => api<{ lens: string; items: SearchItem[]; personalised: boolean; disclosure: string }>(`/api/activities/search?${qs}`),
217	    enabled: Boolean(params.destination_id),
218	  });
219	}

371	export function Modal({
372	  open,
373	  onClose,
374	  title,
375	  children,
376	  wide,
377	}: {
378	  open: boolean;
379	  onClose: () => void;
380	  title: string;
381	  children: ReactNode;
382	  wide?: boolean;
383	}) {
384	  useEffect(() => {
385	    if (!open) return;
386	    const handler = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
387	      if (event.key === "Escape") onClose();
388	    };
389	    window.addEventListener("keydown", handler);
390	    document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
391	    return () => {
392	      window.removeEventListener("keydown", handler);
393	      document.body.style.overflow = "";
394	    };
395	  }, [open, onClose]);
396	
397	  return (
398	    <AnimatePresence>
399	      {open ? (
400	        <motion.div
401	          className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-end justify-center bg-ink/40 p-0 backdrop-blur-sm sm:items-center sm:p-6"
402	          initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
403	          animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
404	          exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
405	          onClick={onClose}
406	        >
407	          <motion.div
408	            role="dialog"
409	            aria-modal="true"
410	            aria-label={title}
411	            initial={{ y: 40, opacity: 0 }}
412	            animate={{ y: 0, opacity: 1 }}
413	            exit={{ y: 24, opacity: 0 }}
414	            transition={{ duration: 0.28, ease: [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1] }}
415	            className={cn(
416	              "max-h-[92vh] w-full overflow-y-auto rounded-t-3xl border border-line bg-paper p-5 shadow-lift sm:rounded-3xl sm:p-6",
417	              wide ? "sm:max-w-2xl" : "sm:max-w-lg",
418	            )}
419	            onClick={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
420	          >
421	            <div className="mb-4 flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
422	              <h2 className="text-xl">{title}</h2>
423	              <button
424	                type="button"
425	                onClick={onClose}
426	                className="rounded-full p-1.5 text-muted hover:bg-ink/5"
427	                aria-label="Close"
428	              >
429	                <X size={18} />
430	              </button>
431	            </div>
432	            {children}
433	          </motion.div>
434	        </motion.div>
435	      ) : null}
436	    </AnimatePresence>
437	  );
438	}

125	def crowd_forecast(db: Session, activity_id: str) -> dict:
126	    reports = relevant_reports(db, activity_id, days=180)
127	    crowd = [r for r in reports if r.category == "crowd" and r.source_type in {"community", "official"}]
128	    if len(crowd) < 8:
129	        latest = crowd[0] if crowd else None
130	        return {
131	            "activity_id": activity_id,
132	            "status": "insufficient_data",
133	            "required_reports": 8,
134	            "available_reports": len(crowd),
135	            "latest_observation": (
136	                {
137	                    "observed_at": latest.observed_at,
138	                    "source_type": latest.source_type,
139	                    "source_label": SOURCE_LABELS.get(latest.source_type),
140	                    "value": latest.value,
141	                }
142	                if latest
143	                else None
144	            ),
145	            "message": (
146	                "Not enough reliable observations to forecast crowds. "
147	                "Showing the latest report instead of inventing a prediction."
148	            ),
149	        }
150	
151	    buckets: dict[str, list[float]] = {}
152	    for report in crowd:
153	        value = report.value or {}
154	        raw = value.get("score", value.get("level"))
155	        if isinstance(raw, str):
156	            raw = {"low": 0.25, "moderate": 0.5, "medium": 0.5, "high": 0.8, "very_high": 0.95}.get(raw, 0.5)
157	        try:
158	            score = float(raw)
159	        except (TypeError, ValueError):
160	            continue
161	        key = f"{report.observed_at.weekday()}-{count_bucket(report.observed_at.hour)}"
162	        buckets.setdefault(key, []).append(score)
163	    if not buckets:
164	        return {
165	            "activity_id": activity_id,
166	            "status": "insufficient_data",
167	            "message": "Crowd reports exist but do not contain a usable level or score.",
168	        }
169	    forecasts = []
170	    for key, scores in buckets.items():
171	        weekday, bucket = key.split("-")
172	        if len(scores) < 3:
173	            continue
174	        mean = sum(scores) / len(scores)
175	        variance = sum((score - mean) ** 2 for score in scores) / len(scores)
176	        forecasts.append(
177	            {
178	                "weekday": int(weekday),
179	                "bucket": bucket,
180	                "expected_level": round(mean, 2),
181	                "spread": round(variance**0.5, 2),
182	                "reports": len(scores),
183	                "confidence": round(min(0.85, 0.35 + len(scores) * 0.04), 2),
184	            }
185	        )
186	    if not forecasts:
187	        return {
188	            "activity_id": activity_id,
189	            "status": "insufficient_data",
190	            "message": "Each time bucket needs at least 3 reports before a forecast is shown.",
191	        }
192	    return {
193	        "activity_id": activity_id,
194	        "status": "predicted",
195	        "model": "bucket-mean-v1",
196	        "forecasts": sorted(forecasts, key=lambda f: (-f["confidence"], f["weekday"])),
197	        "disclosure": (
198	            "PREDICTED from historical community/official observations. "
199	            "Confidence reflects sample size and spread, not a guarantee."
200	        ),
201	    }

351	            status = raw.get("status", "reported")
352	            detail = raw.get("detail")
353	        elif isinstance(raw, str):
354	            status, detail = "reported", raw
355	        else:
356	            status, detail = "unknown", "No information recorded."
357	        entries.append(
358	            {

363	                "source": "catalog" if raw else None,
364	            }
365	        )
366	    verified = [entry for entry in entries if entry["status"] == "verified"]
367	    barriers = [entry for entry in entries if entry["status"] in {"barrier", "limited"}]
368	    return {

(\n                <p className=\"text-sm text-muted\">No recorded evidence matches this claim.</p>\n              ) : (\n                expectation.evidence.map((item) => (\n                  <div key={item.item} className=\"rounded-xl border border-line bg-surface px-3 py-2\">\n                    <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between gap-2\">\n                      <p className=\"text-[13px] font-medium text-ink\">{item.item}</p>\n                      <Badge tone={STATUS_TONE[item.status] || \"outline\"}>{item.status}</Badge>\n                    </div>\n                    <p className=\"mt-1 text-[11.5px] leading-5 text-muted\">{item.detail}</p>\n                  </div>\n                ))\n              )}\n            </div>\n            <div className=\"grid gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2\">\n              <div>\n                <p className=\"text-[11px] uppercase tracking-editorial text-faint\">Limitations</p>\n                <ul className=\"mt-1 space-y-1\">\n                  {expectation.limitations.map((item) => (\n                    <li key={item} className=\"text-[11.5px] leading-5 text-muted\">\n                      · {item}\n                    </li>\n                  ))}\n                </ul>\n              </div>\n              <div>\n                <p className=\"text-[11px] uppercase tracking-editorial text-faint\">Unknowns</p>\n                <ul className=\"mt-1 space-y-1\">\n                  {expectation.unknowns.map((item) => (\n                    <li key={item} className=\"text-[11.5px] leading-5 text-muted\">\n                      · {item}\n                    </li>\n                  ))}\n                </ul>\n              </div>\n            </div>\n          </div>\n        ) : (\n          <FlowNote icon={<CircleHelp size={14} />}>\n            Try a claim like &quot;it is free&quot;, &quot;it is crowded&quot;, &quot;it is open today&quot; or &quot;it is\n            step-free&quot; to see which parts are supported, estimated or unknown.\n          </FlowNote>\n        )}\n      </Card>\n\n      <Modal open={proposeOpen} onClose={() => setProposeOpen(false)} title={`Propose ${activity.name}`}>\n        <form\n          className=\"space-y-3\"\n          onSubmit={(event) => {\n            event.preventDefault();\n            proposeActivity.mutate();\n          }}\n        >\n          <div className=\"grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2\">\n            <Field label=\"Day\">\n              <Input\n                type=\"date\"\n                min={trip.data?.start_date?.slice(0, 10)}\n                max={trip.data?.end_date?.slice(0, 10)}\n                value={proposeDay}\n                onChange={(event) => setProposeDay(event.target.value)}\n              />\n            </Field>\n            <Field label=\"Start time\">\n              <Input type=\"time\" value={proposeTime} onChange={(event) => setProposeTime(event.target.value)} />\n            </Field>\n          </div>\n          <Textarea\n            value={detailText}\n            onChange={(event) => setDetailText(event.target.value)}\n            placeholder=\"Why this? (optional note for the group)\"\n          />\n          <div className=\"flex justify-end gap-2\">\n            <Button type=\"button\" variant=\"secondary\" onClick={() => setProposeOpen(false)}>\n              Cancel\n            </Button>\n            <Button type=\"submit\" loading={proposeActivity.isPending} disabled={!proposeDay}>\n              <Sparkles size={14} /> Create proposal\n            </Button>\n          </div>\n          <p className=\"text-[11px] leading-5 text-faint\">\n            This creates a proposal. The confirmed plan only changes after group voting and owner/admin approval.\n          </p>\n        </form>\n      </Modal>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n\nfunction ReportCategoryBlock({\n  entry,\n  isAdmin,\n  onHelpful,\n  onVerify,\n}: {\n  entry: PlaceReportCategory;\n  isAdmin: boolean;\n  onHelpful: (id: string) => void;\n  onVerify: (id: string) => void;\n}) {\n  return (\n    <div className=\"rounded-2xl border border-line bg-surface p-3.5\">\n      <div className=\"flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2\">\n        <p className=\"text-[13px] font-medium capitalize text-ink\">{entry.category}</p>\n        <div className=\"flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5\">\n          <Badge tone={STATUS_TONE[entry.status] || \"outline\"}>{entry.status}</Badge>\n          <Badge tone=\"outline\">{entry.reports_count} report(s)</Badge>\n          <Badge tone=\"outline\">{entry.freshness_label}</Badge>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n      <p className=\"mt-1 text-[11px] text-faint\">\n        {entry.source_label} · latest {formatDate(entry.latest_observed_at)}\n      </p>\n      <div className=\"mt-2 space-y-2\">\n        {entry.reports.map((report) => (\n          <div key={report.id} className=\"rounded-xl border border-line bg-paper px-3 py-2\">\n            <div className=\"flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2\">\n              <span className=\"text-[11.5px] text-muted\">\n                {describeValue(report.value)} {report.note ? `· ${report.note}` : \"\"}\n              </span>\n              <div className=\"flex items-center gap-1.5\">\n                {report.verified ? <Badge tone=\"jade\">verified</Badge> : null}\n                <button\n                  type=\"button\"\n                  onClick={() => onHelpful(report.id)}\n                  className=\"inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full border border-line px-2 py-0.5 text-[10.5px] text-muted hover:border-ink/30 hover:text-ink\"\n                >\n                  <ThumbsUp size={10} /> Helpful\n                </button>\n                {isAdmin && !report.verified ? (\n                  <button\n                    type=\"button\"\n                    onClick={() => onVerify(report.id)}\n                    className=\"inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full border border-jade/30 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10.5px] text-jade hover:bg-jade-soft\"\n                  >\n                    <BadgeCheck size={10} /> Verify\n                  </button>\n                ) : null}\n              </div>\n            </div>\n            <p className=\"mt-0.5 text-[10.5px] text-faint\">\n              {report.provenance} · {formatDate(report.observed_at)} · confidence {Math.round(report.confidence * 100)}%\n            </p>\n          </div>\n        ))}\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n\nfunction describeValue(value: Record<string, unknown>) {\n  if (\"level\" in value) return `Level: ${String(value.level)}`;\n  if (\"minutes\" in value) return `Wait: ${String(value.minutes)} min`;\n  if (\"closed\" in value) return value.closed ? \"Closed\" : \"Open\";\n  if (\"amount\" in value) return `Price: ${String(value.amount)}`;\n  if (\"status\" in value) return `Status: ${String(value.status)}`;\n  if (\"detail\" in value) return String(value.detail);\n  const keys = Object.keys(value);\n  if (keys.length === 0) return \"Observation\";\n  return keys.map((key) => `${key}: ${String(value[key])}`).join(\", \");\n}\n"

#### Thinking

Important: PUT pact sets `individual_limits` wholesale from payload. So if non-owner members can't PUT (owner/admin only), and owner submits, they'd overwrite everyone's private limits. The UI should preserve existing individual_limits. But GET only returns the viewer's own limit.
