[];\n  const open = items.filter((task) => task.status !== \"done\");\n  const done = items.filter((task) => task.status === \"done\");\n\n  const load = useMemo(() => {\n    const counts = new Map<string, number>();\n    open.forEach((task) => {\n      const key = task.assignee_id || \"unassigned\";\n      counts.set(key, (counts.get(key) || 0) + 1);\n    });\n    return Array.from(counts.entries()).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);\n  }, [open]);\n\n  if (tasks.isLoading) return <PageSkeleton />;\n  if (tasks.error) {\n    return <ErrorState error={tasks.error} retry={() => tasks.refetch()} />;\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"space-y-5\">\n      <div>\n        <p className=\"eyebrow\">Planner load</p>\n        <h2 className=\"mt-1 text-2xl\">Share the planning work</h2>\n        <p className=\"mt-1 max-w-prose text-sm text-muted\">\n          Tasks keep the invisible work visible. Assign owners so one person does not carry the whole plan.\n        </p>\n      </div>\n\n      <Card className=\"space-y-3\">\n        <SectionTitle\n          title=\"Load balance\"\n          hint=\"Open tasks per person — a nudge, not a score\"\n          action={<Scale size={16} className=\"text-faint\" />}\n        />\n        {load.length === 0 ? (\n          <p className=\"text-sm text-muted\">No open tasks.</p>\n        ) : (\n          <div className=\"flex flex-wrap gap-1.5\">\n            {load.map(([key, count]) => (\n              <Badge key={key} tone={count >= 3 ? \"ember\" : \"outline\"}>\n                {key === \"unassigned\" ? \"Unassigned\" : nameFor(key)} · {count}\n              </Badge>\n            ))}\n          </div>\n        )}\n      </Card>\n\n      <Card className=\"space-y-3\">\n        <SectionTitle title=\"Add task\" />\n        <form\n          className=\"space-y-3\"\n          onSubmit={(event) => {\n            event.preventDefault();\n            if (!title.trim()) return;\n            createTask.mutate();\n          }}\n        >\n          <div className=\"grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2\">\n            <Field label=\"Title\">\n              <Input value={title} onChange={(event) => setTitle(event.target.value)} placeholder=\"Book the museum tickets\" />\n            </Field>\n            <Field label=\"Assign to\" hint=\"Optional\">\n              <Select value={assignee} onChange={(event) => setAssignee(event.target.value)}>\n                <option value=\"\">Unassigned</option>\n                {people.map((person) => (\n                  <option key={person.id} value={person.id}>\n                    {person.name}\n                  </option>\n                ))}\n              </Select>\n            </Field>\n          </div>\n          <Field label=\"Details\" hint=\"Optional\">\n            <Textarea value={description} onChange={(event) => setDescription(event.target.value)} />\n          </Field>\n          <Button type=\"submit\" loading={createTask.isPending} disabled={!title.trim()}>\n            <Plus size={14} /> Add task\n          </Button>\n        </form>\n      </Card>\n\n      <div className=\"grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-2\">\n        <Card className=\"space-y-3\">\n          <SectionTitle title=\"Open\" action={<Badge tone=\"ember\">{open.length}</Badge>} />\n          {open.length === 0 ? (\n            <EmptyState title=\"Nothing open\" description=\"All caught up.\" icon={<ListChecks size={22} />} />\n          ) : (\n            <div className=\"space-y-2\">\n              {open.map((task) => (\n                <TaskRow\n                  key={task.id}\n                  title={task.title}\n                  description={task.description}\n                  assignee={nameFor(task.assignee_id)}\n                  done={false}\n                  onToggle={() => updateTask.mutate({ taskId: task.id, body: { status: \"done\" } })}\n                  onAssign={(value) => updateTask.mutate({ taskId: task.id, body: { assignee_id: value || null } })}\n                  people={people}\n                />\n              ))}\n            </div>\n          )}\n        </Card>\n\n        <Card className=\"space-y-3\">\n          <SectionTitle title=\"Done\" action={<Badge tone=\"jade\">{done.length}</Badge>} />\n          {done.length === 0 ? (\n            <p className=\"text-sm text-muted\">Nothing completed yet.</p>\n          ) : (\n            <div className=\"space-y-2\">\n              {done.map((task) => (\n                <TaskRow\n                  key={task.id}\n                  title={task.title}\n                  description={task.description}\n                  assignee={nameFor(task.assignee_id)}\n                  done\n                  onToggle={() => updateTask.mutate({ taskId: task.id, body: { status: \"open\" } })}\n                  onAssign={(value) => updateTask.mutate({ taskId: task.id, body: { assignee_id: value || null } })}\n                  people={people}\n                />\n              ))}\n            </div>\n          )}\n        </Card>\n      </div>\n\n      <FlowNote icon={<UserRound size={14} />}>\n        Anyone can add a task. Only the assignee or an owner/admin can update it. Load counts are derived from\n        open tasks, not a productivity score.\n      </FlowNote>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n\nfunction TaskRow({\n  title,\n  description,\n  assignee,\n  done,\n  onToggle,\n  onAssign,\n  people,\n}: {\n  title: string;\n  description: string | null;\n  assignee: string;\n  done: boolean;\n  onToggle: () => void;\n  onAssign: (value: string) => void;\n  people: { id: string; name: string }[];\n}) {\n  return (\n    <div className=\"rounded-2xl border border-line bg-surface p-3\">\n      <div className=\"flex items-start gap-2.5\">\n        <button type=\"button\" onClick={onToggle} className={cn(\"mt-0.5\", done ? \"text-jade\" : \"text-faint hover:text-ink\")}>\n          {done ? <CheckCircle2 size={18} /> : <Circle size={18} />}\n        </button>\n        <div className=\"min-w-0 flex-1\">\n          <p className={cn(\"text-[13px] font-medium\", done ? \"text-muted line-through\" : \"text-ink\")}>{title}</p>\n          {description ? <p className=\"mt-0.5 text-[11.5px] leading-5 text-muted\">{description}</p> : null}\n          <div className=\"mt-1.5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5\">\n            <span className=\"text-[10.5px] text-faint\">{assignee}</span>\n            {!done ? (\n              <select\n                value={people.find((person) => person.name === assignee)?.id || \"\"}\n                onChange={(event) => onAssign(event.target.value)}\n                className=\"rounded-full border border-line bg-paper px-2 py-0.5 text-[10.5px] text-muted\"\n                aria-label=\"Reassign\"\n              >\n                <option value=\"\">Unassigned</option>\n                {people.map((person) => (\n                  <option key={person.id} value={person.id}>\n                    {person.name}\n                  </option>\n                ))}\n              </select>\n            ) : null}\n          </div>\n        </div>\n        {done ? <Send size={12} className=\"text-jade\" /> : null}\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"

146	def _timing_alternatives(entries: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:

164	def domino_map(
165	    db: Session,
166	    items: list[ItineraryItem],
167	    disrupted_item_id: str,
168	    delay_minutes: int,
169	) -> dict | None:
170	    by_day: dict[date, list[ItineraryItem]] = {}
171	    for item in items:
172	        by_day.setdefault(item.day, []).append(item)
173	    target = next((item for item in items if item.id == disrupted_item_id), None)
174	    if not target:
175	        return None
176	    day_items = sorted(by_day.get(target.day, []), key=lambda item: day_minutes(item.start_time))
177	    entries = analyse_day(db, day_items)
178	    target_index = next(
179	        (index for index, entry in enumerate(entries) if entry["item"].id == disrupted_item_id),
180	        None,
181	    )
182	    if target_index is None:
183	        return None
184	
185	    affected = []
186	    unaffected = []
187	    carry = delay_minutes
188	    for index, entry in enumerate(entries):
189	        if index < target_index:
190	            unaffected.append(
191	                {"item_id": entry["item"].id, "title": entry["item"].title, "reason": "before the disruption"}
192	            )
193	            continue
194	        if index == target_index:
195	            carry = delay_minutes
196	            affected.append(
197	                {
198	                    "item_id": entry["item"].id,
199	                    "title": entry["item"].title,
200	                    "slip_minutes": delay_minutes,
201	                    "new_start": minutes_to_hhmm(entry["start"] + delay_minutes),
202	                    "is_source": True,
203	                    "protected": entry["item"].is_protected,
204	                }
205	            )
206	            continue
207	        # Absorb delay with any buffer, then propagate the remainder.
208	        absorb = max(0, entry.get("buffer_minutes") or 0)
209	        absorbed = min(carry, absorb)
210	        net_slip = carry - absorbed
211	        if net_slip > 0:
212	            affected.append(
213	                {
214	                    "item_id": entry["item"].id,
215	                    "title": entry["item"].title,
216	                    "slip_minutes": net_slip,
217	                    "new_start": minutes_to_hhmm(entry["start"] + net_slip),
218	                    "is_source": False,
219	                    "protected": entry["item"].is_protected,
220	                }
221	            )
222	            carry = net_slip
223	        else:
224	            unaffected.append(
225	                {"item_id": entry["item"].id, "title": entry["item"].title, "reason": "buffer absorbs the delay"}
226	            )
227	            carry = 0
228	
229	    repairs = []
230	    for entry in affected:
231	        if entry["is_source"]:
232	            continue
233	        repairs.append(
234	            {
235	                "item_id": entry["item_id"],
236	                "title": entry["title"],
237	                "options": [
238	                    f"Shorten by {entry['slip_minutes']} minutes.",
239	                    f"Move to {entry['new_start']} and confirm with the group.",
240	                    "Replace with its Shadowplan backup." if not entry["protected"] else "Protected time: ask the group before changing.",
241	                ],
242	            }
243	        )
244	
245	    return {
246	        "day": target.day,
247	        "disruption": {
248	            "item_id": target.id,
249	            "title": target.title,
250	            "delay_minutes": delay_minutes,
251	        },
252	        "affected": affected,
253	        "unaffected": unaffected,
254	        "minimum_repairs_needed": len(repairs),
255	        "repair_options": repairs,
256	        "disclosure": "Propagation uses planned durations and estimated travel time.",
257	    }

catalog.data?.items.find((entry) => entry.activity.id === id)?.activity.name || \"Activity\" : \"Place\";\n\n  const refresh = () => queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [\"ground\", tripId] });\n\n  const ask = useMutation({\n    mutationFn: () =>\n      api(`/api/trips/${tripId}/ground-requests`, {\n        method: \"POST\",\n        body: { activity_id: activityId, question },\n      }),\n    onSuccess: () => {\n      push(\"Question sent\", \"Local contributors can answer with observations.\", \"success\");\n      setQuestion(\"\");\n      setActivityId(\"\");\n      refresh();\n    },\n    onError: (error) => push(\"Could not ask\", errorMessage(error), \"error\"),\n  });\n\n  const respond = useMutation({\n    mutationFn: (requestId: string) =>\n      api(`/api/trips/${tripId}/ground-requests/${requestId}/responses`, {\n        method: \"POST\",\n        body: { observation, confidence: Number(confidence) || 0.5 },\n      }),\n    onSuccess: () => {\n      push(\"Observation shared\", \"It stays unverified until moderated.\", \"success\");\n      setObservation(\"\");\n      setAnswerFor(null);\n      refresh();\n    },\n    onError: (error) => push(\"Could not answer\", errorMessage(error), \"error\"),\n  });\n\n  if (requests.isLoading) return <PageSkeleton />;\n  if (requests.error || !requests.data) {\n    return <ErrorState error={requests.error || new Error(\"Ground requests unavailable\")} retry={() => requests.refetch()} />;\n  }\n\n  const items = requests.data.items;\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"space-y-5\">\n      <div>\n        <p className=\"eyebrow\">Ask the ground</p>\n        <h2 className=\"mt-1 text-2xl\">Questions for people who are there</h2>\n        <p className=\"mt-1 max-w-prose text-sm text-muted\">\n          Opt-in local contributors for this destination can answer with observations. Answers are unverified\n          until moderated.\n        </p>\n      </div>\n\n      <Card className=\"space-y-3\">\n        <SectionTitle title=\"Ask a question\" hint=\"Be specific and answerable\" />\n        <form\n          className=\"space-y-3\"\n          onSubmit={(event) => {\n            event.preventDefault();\n            if (!activityId || question.trim().length < 5) return;\n            ask.mutate();\n          }}\n        >\n          <Field label=\"About which activity?\">\n            <Select value={activityId} onChange={(event) => setActivityId(event.target.value)}>\n              <option value=\"\">Choose an activity…</option>\n              {(catalog.data?.items ?? []).map((entry) => (\n                <option key={entry.activity.id} value={entry.activity.id}>\n                  {entry.activity.name}\n                </option>\n              ))}\n            </Select>\n          </Field>\n          <Field label=\"Question\">\n            <Textarea\n              value={question}\n              onChange={(event) => setQuestion(event.target.value)}\n              placeholder=\"Is the north entrance open on Sundays?\"\n            />\n          </Field>\n          <Button type=\"submit\" loading={ask.isPending} disabled={!activityId || question.trim().length < 5}>\n            <Send size={14} /> Send question\n          </Button>\n        </form>\n      </Card>\n\n      {items.length === 0 ? (\n        <EmptyState\n          title=\"No questions yet\"\n          description=\"Ask the ground when you need a current, local observation.\"\n          icon={<HelpCircle size={24} />}\n        />\n      ) : (\n        <div className=\"space-y-3\">\n          {items.map((request) => (\n            <Card key={request.id} className=\"space-y-3\">\n              <div className=\"flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-2\">\n                <div className=\"min-w-0\">\n                  <p className=\"text-[14px] font-medium text-ink\">{request.question}</p>\n                  <p className=\"text-[11px] text-faint\">\n                    {activityName(request.activity_id)} · {formatDateTime(request.created_at)}\n                  </p>\n                </div>\n                <Badge tone={request.status === \"answered\" ? \"jade\" : \"ember\"}>{request.status}</Badge>\n              </div>\n\n              {request.responses.length ? (\n                <div className=\"space-y-2\">\n                  {request.responses.map((response) => (\n                    <div key={response.id} className=\"rounded-xl border border-line bg-surface px-3 py-2\">\n                      <div className=\"flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2\">\n                        <Badge tone={response.verified ? \"jade\" : \"ember\"}>{response.provenance}</Badge>\n                        <span className=\"text-[10.5px] text-faint\">\n                          {formatDateTime(response.observed_at)} · confidence {Math.round(response.confidence * 100)}%\n                        </span>\n                      </div>\n                      <p className=\"mt-1 text-[12px] leading-5 text-muted\">{response.observation}</p>\n                    </div>\n                  ))}\n                </div>\n              ) : (\n                <p className=\"text-[12px] text-faint\">Waiting for a local contributor.</p>\n              )}\n\n              {answerFor === request.id ? (\n                <form\n                  className=\"space-y-2 rounded-xl border border-line bg-raised/40 p-3\"\n                  onSubmit={(event) => {\n                    event.preventDefault();\n                    if (observation.trim().length < 5) return;\n                    respond.mutate(request.id);\n                  }}\n                >\n                  <Field label=\"What did you observe?\">\n                    <Textarea value={observation} onChange={(event) => setObservation(event.target.value)} />\n                  </Field>\n                  <Field label=\"Confidence\">\n                    <Select value={confidence} onChange={(event) => setConfidence(event.target.value)}>\n                      <option value=\"0.4\">Low</option>\n                      <option value=\"0.6\">Medium</option>\n                      <option value=\"0.8\">High</option>\n                    </Select>\n                  </Field>\n                  <div className=\"flex gap-2\">\n                    <Button type=\"submit\" size=\"sm\" loading={respond.isPending}>\n                      Share observation\n                    </Button>\n                    <Button type=\"button\" size=\"sm\" variant=\"secondary\" onClick={() => setAnswerFor(null)}>\n                      Cancel\n                    </Button>\n                  </div>\n                </form>\n              ) : (\n                <Button size=\"sm\" variant=\"secondary\" onClick={() => setAnswerFor(request.id)}>\n                  <MessageCircle size={13} /> Answer as a local contributor\n                </Button>\n              )}\n            </Card>\n          ))}\n        </div>\n      )}\n\n      <FlowNote icon={<ShieldQuestion size={14} />}>\n        Only opted-in contributors for this destination can answer. A single observation never becomes verified\n        information automatically, and exact live locations are never exposed.\n      </FlowNote>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}

"""SAFAR API entrypoint."""

from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
from pathlib import Path

from fastapi import FastAPI
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from fastapi.middleware.gzip import GZipMiddleware
from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles
from sqlalchemy import text

from app.core.config import settings
from app.core.ratelimit import RateLimitMiddleware
from app.db.session import Base, SessionLocal, engine
from app.routers import (
    admin,
    assistant,
    auth,
    engine as engine_router,
    expenses,
    itinerary,
    memories,
    places,
    pulse,
    trips,
    users,
    ws,
)

MEDIA_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "storage"


@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
    Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
    MEDIA_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if settings.auto_seed:
        from app.seed import seed_if_needed

        db = SessionLocal()
        try:
            seed_if_needed(db)
        finally:
            db.close()
    yield


app = FastAPI(
    title="SAFAR API",
    description=(
        "The Living Journey Network — journey intelligence, group decisions and shared memories. "
        "The engine recommends; the group decides."
    ),
    version="1.0.0",
    docs_url="/api/docs",
    redoc_url=None,
    openapi_url="/api/openapi.json",
    lifespan=lifespan,
)

app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=settings.cors_origins,
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["GET", "POST", "PUT", "PATCH", "DELETE", "OPTIONS"],
    allow_headers=["Authorization", "Content-Type", "Accept", "X-Requested-With"],
)
app.add_middleware(GZipMiddleware, minimum_size=1024)
app.add_middleware(RateLimitMiddleware)

app.include_router(auth.router)
app.include_router(users.router)
app.include_router(trips.router)
app.include_router(trips.invitations_router)
app.include_router(itinerary.router)
app.include_router(pulse.router)
app.include_router(engine_router.router)

"use client";

import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";

import { api } from "./api";
import type {
  AdminStats,
  AssistantAnswer,
  Branch,
  Circle,
  CircleDetail,

  ThreadResponse,

} from "./types";

export function useMe(enabled = true) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ["me"],
    queryFn: () => api<Me>("/api/users/me"),
    enabled,
    staleTime: 60_000,
  });
}

export function useTrips() {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ["trips"],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const data = await api<{ items: Trip[] } | Trip[]>("/api/trips");
      return Array.isArray(data) ? data : data.items;
    },
  });
}

export function useTrip(tripId: string | undefined) {

export function useSearch(params: Record<string, string | number | boolean | undefined>) {
  const query = new URLSearchParams();
  Object.entries(params).forEach(([key, value]) => {
    if (value !== undefined && value !== "" && value !== false) query.set(key, String(value));
  });
  const qs = query.toString();
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ["search", qs],
    queryFn: () => api<{ lens: string; items: SearchItem[]; personalised: boolean; disclosure: string }>(`/api/activities/search?${qs}`),
    enabled: Boolean(params.destination_id),
  });
}

def _bool(name: str, default: bool) -> bool:
    raw = os.getenv(name)
    if raw is None:
        return default
    return raw.strip().lower() in {"1", "true", "yes", "on"}


class Settings:

)

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.core.config import settings
from app.core.deps import get_current_user, get_db
from app.core.security import create_access_token, hash_password, verify_password
from app.models import ConsentRecord, JourneyDNA, Profile, User
from app.schemas.schemas import LoginIn, RegisterIn
from app.services.common import default_dna
from app.services.serializers import user_out

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/auth", tags=["auth"])


@router.post("/register", status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
def register(payload: RegisterIn, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    email = payload.email.lower().strip()
    if db.query(User).filter(User.email == email).first():
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="An account with this email already exists")
    user = User(
        email=email,
        password_hash=hash_password(payload.password),
        display_name=payload.display_name.strip(),
    )
    db.add(user)
    db.flush()
    db.add(Profile(user_id=user.id, interests=[]))
    db.add(JourneyDNA(user_id=user.id, scores=default_dna(), source="explicit"))
    db.add(
        ConsentRecord(
            user_id=user.id,
            kind="terms",
            granted=True,
            policy_version=settings.policy_version,
        )
    )
    for kind in ("personalization", "analytics", "location", "marketing"):
        db.add(
            ConsentRecord(
                user_id=user.id,
                kind=kind,
                granted=False,
                policy_version=settings.policy_version,
            )
        )
    db.commit()
    token = create_access_token(user.id, user.email)
    return {"access_token": token, "token_type": "bearer", "user": user_out(user)}


@router.post("/login")
def login(payload: LoginIn, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    email = payload.email.lower().strip()
    user = db.query(User).filter(User.email == email).first()
    if not user or not verify_password(payload.password, user.password_hash):
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, detail="Incorrect email or password"
        )
    if not user.is_active or user.deleted_at:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="This account is no longer active")
    token = create_access_token(user.id, user.email)
    return {"access_token": token, "token_type": "bearer", "user": user_out(user)}


@router.get("/me")
def me(user: User = Depends(get_current_user)):
    return user_out(user)


@router.post("/logout")
def logout(user: User = Depends(get_current_user)):
    # Tokens are stateless; the client discards its copy. Documented in README.
    return {"ok": True}

from collections.abc import Callable

from fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.security import HTTPAuthorizationCredentials, HTTPBearer
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.core.security import decode_access_token
from app.db.session import SessionLocal
from app.models import Trip, TripMember, User

bearer = HTTPBearer(auto_error=False)


def get_db():
    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()


def _user_from_token(token: str, db: Session) -> User:
    payload = decode_access_token(token)
    if not payload or not payload.get("sub"):
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            detail="Invalid or expired session",
            headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"},
        )
    user = db.get(User, payload["sub"])
    if not user or not user.is_active or user.deleted_at:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, detail="Account unavailable"
        )
    return user


def get_current_user(
    credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials | None = Depends(bearer),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
) -> User:
    if credentials is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            detail="Authentication required",
            headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"},
        )
    return _user_from_token(credentials.credentials, db)


def get_optional_user(
    credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials | None = Depends(bearer),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
) -> User | None:
    if credentials is None:
        return None
    try:
        return _user_from_token(credentials.credentials, db)
    except HTTPException:
        return None


def require_admin(user: User = Depends(get_current_user)) -> User:
    if not user.is_admin:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Administrator access required")
    return user

def _trip(db, trip_id, user, roles=None):

def _validate_dates(start: date, end: date) -> None:
    if end < start:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="End date must be on or after the start date")


def _active_member(db: Session, trip_id: str, user_id: str | None) -> TripMember | None:
    if not user_id:
        return None
    return (
        db.query(TripMember)
        .filter(
            TripMember.trip_id == trip_id,
            TripMember.user_id == user_id,
            TripMember.status == "active",
        )
        .first()
    )


@router.get("")
def list_trips(user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    memberships = (
        db.query(TripMember)
        .filter(TripMember.user_id == user.id, TripMember.status == "active")
        .all()
    )
    result = []
    for membership in memberships:
        trip = db.get(Trip, membership.trip_id)
        if not trip or trip.deleted_at:
            continue
        result.append(trip_out(db, trip, membership))
    result.sort(key=lambda item: (item["start_date"] or date.max))
    return {"items": result}


@router.post("", status_code=201)
async def create_trip(
    payload: TripCreate,

):
    _validate_dates(payload.start_date, payload.end_date)
    destination = db.get(Destination, payload.destination_id) if payload.destination_id else None
    if payload.destination_id and not destination:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Destination not found")
    trip = Trip(
        name=payload.name.strip(),
        description=payload.description,
        destination_id=destination.id if destination else None,

        start_date=payload.start_date,
        end_date=payload.end_date,
        group_size=payload.group_size,
        budget_total=payload.budget_total,
        currency=payload.currency.upper()[:8],
        base_lat=destination.lat if destination else 0.0,
        base_lon=destination.lon if destination else 0.0,
        created_by=user.id,
        privacy="private",
    )

"""Group Experience Engine, Trip Twin, Trip Rescue and Fair Trade APIs.

Every recommendation, alternative and repair is persisted or returned as a
proposal. None of these endpoints mutate the confirmed itinerary: adoption
always goes through the voting and approval workflow in the itinerary router.

from datetime import date

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/trips", tags=["engine"])


def _trip(db, trip_id, user, roles=None):
    return get_trip_and_member(trip_id, db, user, roles)


def _active_members(db: Session, trip_id: str) -> list[TripMember]:
    return (
        db.query(TripMember)
        .filter(TripMember.trip_id == trip_id, TripMember.status == "active")
        .all()
    )


def _within_trip(trip: Trip, day: date) -> None:
    if day < trip.start_date or day > trip.end_date:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=422,
            detail=(
                f"{day.isoformat()} is outside the trip dates "
                f"({trip.start_date.isoformat()} to {trip.end_date.isoformat()})."
            ),
        )


def _activity_in_trip(db: Session, trip: Trip, activity_id: str) -> Activity:
    activity = db.get(Activity, activity_id)
    if not activity:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Activity not found")
    if activity.destination_id != trip.destination_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Activity is outside this trip's destination")
    return activity


def _batch_out(db: Session, batch: RecommendationBatch, viewer_id: str) -> dict:
    recs = (
        db.query(Recommendation)
        .filter(Recommendation.batch_id == batch.id)
        .order_by(Recommendation.rank)
        .all()
    )
    activity_ids = [rec.activity_id for rec in recs]
    activities = (
        db.query(Activity).filter(Activity.id.in_(activity_ids)).all() if activity_ids else []
    )
    activity_map = {activity.id: activity for activity in activities}
    feedback_rows = (
        db.query(RecommendationFeedback)
        .filter(
            RecommendationFeedback.recommendation_id.in_([rec.id for rec in recs]),
            RecommendationFeedback.user_id == viewer_id,
        )
        .all()
        if recs
        else []
    )
    my_feedback = {row.recommendation_id: row.sentiment for row in feedback_rows}
    return {
        "id": batch.id,
        "mode": batch.mode,
        "mode_meta": MODE_META.get(batch.mode, {}),
        "for_date": batch.for_date,
        "model_version": batch.model_version,
        "meta": batch.meta or {},
        "created_at": batch.created_at,
        "created_by": batch.created_by,
        "items": [
            {
                **recommendation_out(rec, activity_map.get(rec.activity_id)),
                "my_feedback": my_feedback.get(rec.id),
            }
            for rec in recs
        ],
    }


@router.post("/{trip_id}/engine/recommend", status_code=201)
async def recommend(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: RecommendIn,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    for_date = payload.for_date or date.today()
    _within_trip(trip, for_date)
    members = _active_members(db, trip.id)
    result = generate_recommendations(
        db,
        trip,
        members,
        mode=payload.mode,
        for_date=for_date,
        limit=payload.limit,
    )
    if result.get("error"):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=result["error"])
    if not result["items"]:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=422,
            detail=(
                "No activity passes every hard constraint for this group today. "
                "Adjust a Trip Pulse, budget limit or radius and try again."
            ),
        )

    meta = {
        **result["meta"],
        "mode_meta": result["mode_meta"],
        "clarifying_question": result.get("clarifying_question"),
        "exclusion_reasons": result.get("exclusion_reasons", {}),
        "target_member": result["target"].label if result.get("target") else None,
        "alternative_count": len(result.get("all_ranked_ids", [])) - len(result["items"]),
    }
    batch = RecommendationBatch(
        trip_id=trip.id,
        mode=payload.mode,
        for_date=for_date,
        model_version=ENGINE_VERSION,
        meta=meta,
        created_by=user.id,
    )
    db.add(batch)
    db.flush()
    for rank, ranked in enumerate(result["items"], start=1):
        db.add(
            Recommendation(
                batch_id=batch.id,
                trip_id=trip.id,
                activity_id=ranked.activity.id,
                rank=rank,
                score=ranked.score,
                average_fit=ranked.average_fit,
                minimum_fit=ranked.minimum_fit,
                fairness_spread=ranked.fairness_spread,
                novelty=ranked.novelty,
                penalties=ranked.penalties,
                explanation=ranked.explanation,
                status="suggested",
            )
        )
    audit(
        db,
        action="engine.recommend",
        entity_type="recommendation_batch",
        entity_id=batch.id,

def expenses_csv(db: Session, trip: Trip) -> str:
    buffer = io.StringIO()
    writer = csv.writer(buffer)
    writer.writerow(
        ["date", "title", "category", "amount", "currency", "paid_by", "participants"]
    )
    expenses = (
        db.query(Expense)
        .filter(Expense.trip_id == trip.id, Expense.deleted_at.is_(None))
        .order_by(Expense.incurred_on, Expense.created_at)
        .all()
    )
    users = {user.id: user.display_name for user in active_member_users(db, trip)}
    for expense in expenses:
        rows = participant_rows(db, expense.id)
        parts = ", ".join(
            f"{(users.get(row.user_id) or row.guest_name or 'Guest')} {row.share_amount:.2f}"
            for row in rows
        )
        writer.writerow(
            [
                expense.incurred_on.isoformat() if isinstance(expense.incurred_on, date) else expense.incurred_on,
                expense.title,
                expense.category,
                f"{expense.amount:.2f}",
                expense.currency,
                users.get(expense.paid_by, expense.paid_by),
                parts,
            ]
        )
    return buffer.getvalue()

PUT payload needs must_do/flexible etc.; if omitted defaults empty → wipes those lists! The schema defaults to [] so sending only individual_limits would wipe must_do. 14	      maximumFractionDigits: 2,
15	    }).format(value);

24	  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return "—";
25	  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en", {
26	    day: "numeric",
27	    month: "short",
28	    year: "numeric",
29	    ...options,
30	  }).format(date);
31	}

34	  const date = typeof value === "string" ? new Date(`${value.slice(0, 10)}T12:00:00`) : value;

36	    weekday: "long",

52	  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en", {

60	export function daysBetween(start: string, end: string) {
61	  const a = new Date(`${start.slice(0, 10)}T12:00:00`).getTime();
62	  const b = new Date(`${end.slice(0, 10)}T12:00:00`).getTime();
63	  return Math.max(1, Math.round((b - a) / 86400000) + 1);
64	}

66	export function todayIso() {
67	  const now = new Date();
68	  const offset = now.getTimezoneOffset() * 60000;
69	  return new Date(now.getTime() - offset).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
70	}

72	export function daysUntil(start: string) {
73	  const target = new Date(`${start.slice(0, 10)}T12:00:00`).getTime();
74	  const today = new Date(`${todayIso()}T12:00:00`).getTime();
75	  return Math.round((target - today) / 86400000);
76	}

81	  const end = daysUntil(trip.end_date);
82	  if (start > 0) return `In ${start} day${start === 1 ? "" : "s"}`;
83	  if (end >= 0) return "Happening now";
84	  return "Past";

"use client";

import { create } from "zustand";
import { persist } from "zustand/middleware";

import type { User } from "./types";

interface AuthState {
  token: string | null;
  user: User | null;
  hydrated: boolean;
  setSession: (token: string, user: User) => void;
  setUser: (user: User) => void;
  logout: () => void;
  setHydrated: (value: boolean) => void;
}

export const useAuth = create<AuthState>()(
  persist(
    (set) => ({
      token: null,
      user: null,
      hydrated: false,
      setSession: (token, user) => set({ token, user }),
      setUser: (user) => set({ user }),
      logout: () => set({ token: null, user: null }),
      setHydrated: (value) => set({ hydrated: value }),
    }),
    {
      name: "safar-auth",
      partialize: (state) => ({ token: state.token, user: state.user }),
      onRehydrateStorage: () => (state) => {
        state?.setHydrated(true);
      },
    },
  ),
);

type Theme = "light" | "dark";

interface ThemeState {
  theme: Theme;
  setTheme: (theme: Theme) => void;
  toggle: () => void;
}

function applyTheme(theme: Theme) {
  if (typeof document === "undefined") return;
  document.documentElement.classList.toggle("dark", theme === "dark");
}

export const useTheme = create<ThemeState>()(
  persist(
    (set, get) => ({
      theme: "light",
      setTheme: (theme) => {
        applyTheme(theme);
        set({ theme });
      },
      toggle: () => {
        const next = get().theme === "light" ? "dark" : "light";
        applyTheme(next);
        set({ theme: next });
      },
    }),
    {
      name: "safar-theme",
      onRehydrateStorage: () => (state) => {
        if (state) applyTheme(state.theme);
      },
    },
  ),
);

export function applyStoredTheme() {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return;
  try {
    const raw = window.localStorage.getItem("safar-theme");
    if (!raw) return;
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as { state?: { theme?: Theme } };
    const theme = parsed.state?.theme;
    if (theme) document.documentElement.classList.toggle("dark", theme === "dark");
  } catch {
    /* ignore */
  }
}

interface Toast {
  id: number;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  tone: "success" | "error" | "info";
}

interface ToastState {
  toasts: Toast[];
  push: (title: string, description?: string, tone?: Toast["tone"]) => void;
  dismiss: (id: number) => void;
}

export const useToasts = create<ToastState>((set) => ({
  toasts: [],
  push: (title, description, tone = "info") => {
    const id = Date.now() + Math.random();
    set((state) => ({ toasts: [...state.toasts, { id, title, description, tone }] }));
    if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
      window.setTimeout(() => {
        set((state) => ({ toasts: state.toasts.filter((toast) => toast.id !== id) }));
      }, 4200);
    }
  },
  dismiss: (id) =>
    set((state) => ({ toasts: state.toasts.filter((toast) => toast.id !== id) })),
}));

interface OfflineState {
  queue: {
    client_id: string;
    operation: "memory_create";
    payload: Record<string, unknown>;
    trip_id: string;
    created_at: string;
  }[];
  enqueue: (tripId: string, payload: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
  clear: (ids: string[]) => void;
}

export const useOffline = create<OfflineState>()(
  persist(
    (set) => ({
      queue: [],
      enqueue: (tripId, payload) =>
        set((state) => ({
          queue: [
            ...state.queue,
            {
              client_id: `offline-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`,
              operation: "memory_create",
              payload,
              trip_id: tripId,
              created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
            },
          ],
        })),
      clear: (ids) =>
        set((state) => ({
          queue: state.queue.filter((item) => !ids.includes(item.client_id)),
        })),
    }),
    { name: "safar-offline" },
  ),
);

export class ApiError extends Error {
  status: number;
  detail: unknown;

  constructor(status: number, detail: unknown) {
    const message =
      typeof detail === "string"
        ? detail
        : Array.isArray(detail)
          ? detail
              .map((item) =>
                typeof item === "object" && item && "msg" in item
                  ? String((item as { msg: unknown }).msg)
                  : String(item),
              )
              .join(" · ")
          : detail && typeof detail === "object" && "message" in detail

Use evaluate_script to perform login fetch and set localStorage, then navigate. The script can be async? It says function declaration executed. Likely supports async functions with await. We'll do:

```js
async function() {
  const res = await fetch('http://localhost:8010/api/auth/login', {method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: JSON.stringify({email:'mira@safar.demo',password:'safar-demo-123'})});
  const data = await res.json();
  localStorage.setItem('safar-auth', JSON.stringify({state:{token:data.access_token,user:data.user},version:0}));
  return data.user.email;
}
```

CORS: page origin localhost:3010, API allows it. Good.

}

For the watch value formatter, add to page:

```ts
const DAY_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  mon: "Mon", tue: "Tue", wed: "Wed", thu: "Thu", fri: "Fri", sat: "Sat", sun: "Sun",
};

function describeWatchValue(field: string, raw: unknown): string {
  const value =
    raw && typeof raw === "object" && !Array.isArray(raw) && "value" in raw
      ? (raw as Record<string, unknown>).value
      : raw;

  if (value === null || value === undefined) return "unknown";
  if (field === "wheelchair_accessible") {
    return value === true ? "step-free" : value === false ? "not step-free" : "unknown";
  }
  if (field === "price_estimate") {
    return typeof value === "number" ? formatMoney(value) : String(value);
  }
  if (value && typeof value === "object" && !Array.isArray(value)) {
    const entries = Object.entries(value as Record<string, unknown>);
    const hours = entries.filter(([key]) => key in DAY_LABELS);
    if (hours.length) {
      const distinct = new Set(hours.map(([, hours]) => String(hours)));
      if (distinct.size === 1) return `Every day ${hours[0][1]}`;
      return hours.map(([day, hours]) => `${DAY_LABELS[day]} ${hours}`).join(" · ");
    }
    return entries.map(([key, v]) => `${titleCase(key)} ${String(v)}`).join(" · ");
  }
  return String(value);
}
```

Note: `formatMoney` imported. `titleCase` imported.

139	                    .slice(0, 5)

142	                        <span className="text-ink">{titleCase(stage)}:</span>{" "}
143	                        {typeof value === "string"

148	                </ul>
149	              ) : (

151	              )}
152	            </div>
153	          </div>
154	          <div className="mt-3">
155	            <p className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-editorial text-faint">Opening hours</p>
156	            {activity.opening_hours ? (

158	                {Object.entries(activity.opening_hours)

164	            )}

167	            Personal fit is an estimate from Journey DNA, not a live provider score. Verify hours
168	            before relying on them.

172	    </Card>

182	  const [maxBudget, setMaxBudget] = useState("");
183	  const [maxDuration, setMaxDuration] = useState("");
184	  const [indoor, setIndoor] = useState(false);
185	  const [accessible, setAccessible] = useState(false);
186	  const [tags, setTags] = useState("");
187	
188	  const searchParams = useMemo(
189	    () => ({

191	      q: q || undefined,
192	      lens,
193	      max_budget: maxBudget || undefined,
194	      max_duration: maxDuration || undefined,
195	      indoor: indoor || undefined,
196	      accessible: accessible || undefined,
197	      tags: tags || undefined,
198	      limit: 30,
199	    }),
200	    [destinationId, q, lens, maxBudget, maxDuration, indoor, accessible, tags],
201	  );
202	  const search = useSearch(searchParams);
203	
204	  if (destination.isLoading) return <PageSkeleton />;
205	  if (destination.error || !destination.data) {
206	    return (

208	    );

210	  const data = destination.data.destination;

212	  return (
213	    <div className="space-y-7">

215	        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-5">
216	          <div className="max-w-2xl">
217	            <p className="eyebrow">
218	              {data.country}
219	              {data.region ? ` · ${data.region}` : ""}
220	            </p>

222	            <p className="mt-3 max-w-xl text-sm leading-6 text-muted">{data.description}</p>
223	            <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
224	              {data.tags.map((tag) => (
225	                <Badge key={tag}>{tag}</Badge>
226	              ))}
227	            </div>
228	            <p className="mt-4 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11.5px] text-faint">
229	              <CalendarDays size={13} />
230	              Best months:{" "}
231	              {data.best_months.length
232	                ? data.best_months.map((month) => MONTHS[month - 1]).join(", ")
233	                : "year-round"}
234	            </p>
235	          </div>
236	          <LinkButton
237	            href={`/trips/new?destination_id=${data.id}&destination_name=${encodeURIComponent(data.name)}`}
238	            size="lg"
239	          >
240	            <Compass size={16} /> Plan a journey here
241	          </LinkButton>
242	        </div>
243	      </div>
244	
245	      <div className="grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-[280px_1fr]">
246	        <Card className="h-fit space-y-4 lg:sticky lg:top-6">
247	          <div>
248	            <p className="text-[13px] font-medium">Filter the catalog</p>
249	            <p className="mt-0.5 text-[11.5px] text-faint">Filters apply before ranking.</p>
250	          </div>
251	          <Field label="Search">
252	            <div className="relative">
253	              <Search size={14} className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-faint" />
254	              <Input
255	                className="pl-9"
256	                value={q}
257	                onChange={(event) => setQ(event.target.value)}
258	                placeholder="Tea, garden, market…"
259	              />
260	            </div>
261	          </Field>
262	          <Field label="Lens">

266	              <option value="similar">Similar finds</option>
267	            </Select>
268	          </Field>
269	          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
270	            <Field label="Max price">

272	                type="number"
273	                min={0}
274	                value={maxBudget}
275	                onChange={(event) => setMaxBudget(event.target.value)}
276	                placeholder="Any"
277	              />
278	            </Field>

281	                type="number"

286	                placeholder="Any"

292	          </Field>

300	            />
301	          </div>
302	        </Card>
303	
304	        <div className="space-y-4">
305	          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
306	            <p className="text-[12px] text-faint">
307	              {search.isLoading
308	                ? "Searching the catalog…"
309	                : `${search.data?.items.length ?? 0} activities · lens ${search.data?.lens || lens}`}
310	            </p>
311	            <Badge tone="outline">
312	              <Ticket size={10} /> Group decision required
313	            </Badge>
314	          </div>

316	          {!search.isLoading && (search.data?.items.length ?? 0) === 0 ? (
317	            <EmptyState
318	              icon={<Search size={24} />}
319	              title="No activities match these filters"
320	              description="Relax a filter or clear the search. Unknown accessibility is never shown as step-free."
321	            />
322	          ) : null}
323	          <div className="space-y-4">
324	            {(search.data?.items ?? []).map((item) => (
325	              <ActivityCard key={item.activity.id} item={item} />
326	            ))}
327	          </div>
328	          {search.data?.disclosure ? (
329	            <p className="rounded-2xl border border-line bg-raised/50 px-4 py-3 text-[11.5px] leading-5 text-muted">
330	              {search.data.disclosure}
331	            </p>
332	          ) : null}
333	        </div>
334	      </div>
335	    </div>
336	  );

"""SAFAR API entrypoint."""

from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
from pathlib import Path

from fastapi import FastAPI
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from fastapi.middleware.gzip import GZipMiddleware
from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles
from sqlalchemy import text

from app.core.config import settings
from app.core.ratelimit import RateLimitMiddleware
from app.db.session import Base, SessionLocal, engine
from app.routers import (
    admin,
    assistant,
    auth,
    engine as engine_router,
    expenses,
    itinerary,
    memories,
    places,
    pulse,
    trips,
    users,
    ws,
)

MEDIA_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "storage"


@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
    Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
    MEDIA_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if settings.auto_seed:
        from app.seed import seed_if_needed

        db = SessionLocal()
        try:
            seed_if_needed(db)
        finally:
            db.close()
    yield


app = FastAPI(
    title="SAFAR API",
    description=(
        "The Living Journey Network — journey intelligence, group decisions and shared memories. "
        "The engine recommends; the group decides."
    ),
    version="1.0.0",
    docs_url="/api/docs",
    redoc_url=None,
    openapi_url="/api/openapi.json",
    lifespan=lifespan,
)

app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=settings.cors_origins,
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["GET", "POST", "PUT", "PATCH", "DELETE", "OPTIONS"],
    allow_headers=["Authorization", "Content-Type", "Accept", "X-Requested-With"],
)
app.add_middleware(GZipMiddleware, minimum_size=1024)
app.add_middleware(RateLimitMiddleware)

app.include_router(auth.router)
app.include_router(users.router)
app.include_router(trips.router)
app.include_router(trips.invitations_router)
app.include_router(itinerary.router)
app.include_router(pulse.router)
app.include_router(engine_router.router)
app.include_router(expenses.router)
app.include_router(places.router)
app.include_router(memories.router)
app.include_router(assistant.router)
app.include_router(assistant.trip_router)
app.include_router(admin.router)
app.include_router(ws.router)

MEDIA_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
app.mount("/media", StaticFiles(directory=str(MEDIA_DIR)), name="media")


@app.get("/")

"""Trip workspace WebSocket channel for collaborative updates (F05).

Browsers cannot set Authorization headers on WebSocket handshakes, so the
short-lived access token is passed as a query parameter and verified before
the connection is accepted. Membership is re-checked on every connection.
"""

from fastapi import APIRouter, Query, WebSocket, WebSocketDisconnect

from app.core.realtime import manager
from app.core.security import decode_access_token
from app.db.session import SessionLocal
from app.models import Trip, TripMember, User
from app.services.common import event_payload

router = APIRouter()


@router.websocket("/ws/trips/{trip_id}")
async def trip_socket(
    websocket: WebSocket,
    trip_id: str,
    token: str = Query(..., min_length=20),
):
    payload = decode_access_token(token)
    if not payload or not payload.get("sub"):
        await websocket.close(code=4401)
        return

    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        user = db.get(User, payload["sub"])
        if not user or not user.is_active or user.deleted_at:
            await websocket.close(code=4401)
            return
        trip = db.get(Trip, trip_id)
        if not trip or trip.deleted_at:
            await websocket.close(code=4404)
            return
        member = (
            db.query(TripMember)
            .filter(
                TripMember.trip_id == trip.id,
                TripMember.user_id == user.id,
                TripMember.status == "active",
            )
            .first()

55	
56	    In this scenario we need to create an Engine

58	
59	    """

  "content": "\"\"\"Alembic environment for SAFAR.\n\nMigrations target the same DATABASE_URL the API uses, so SQLite works for\nlocal development and PostgreSQL/Supabase works in production. SQLite cannot\nALTER most constraints in place, so batch mode is enabled for it.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom logging.config import fileConfig\n\nfrom sqlalchemy import engine_from_config, pool\n\nfrom alembic import context\nfrom app.core.config import settings\nfrom app.db.session import Base\nimport app.models  # noqa: F401 — registers every model on Base.metadata\n\nconfig = context.config\n\nif config.config_file_name is not None:\n    fileConfig(config.config_file_name)\n\nconfig.set_main_option(\"sqlalchemy.url\", settings.database_url)\ntarget_metadata = Base.metadata\n\n\ndef _configure(connection) -> None:\n    context.configure(\n        connection=connection,\n        target_metadata=target_metadata,\n        render_as_batch=connection.dialect.name == \"sqlite\",\n        compare_type=True,\n    )\n\n\ndef run_migrations_offline() -> None:\n    context.configure(\n        url=config.get_main_option(\"sqlalchemy.url\"),\n        target_metadata=target_metadata,\n        literal_binds=True,\n        dialect_opts={\"paramstyle\": \"named\"},\n    )\n    with context.begin_transaction():\n        context.run_migrations()\n\n\ndef run_migrations_online() -> None:\n    connectable = engine_from_config(\n        config.get_section(config.config_ini_section, {}),\n        prefix=\"sqlalchemy.\",\n        poolclass=pool.NullPool,\n    )\n    with connectable.connect() as connection:\n        _configure(connection)\n        with context.begin_transaction():\n            context.run_migrations()\n\n\nif context.is_offline_mode():\n    run_migrations_offline()\nelse:\n    run_migrations_online()\n"

services:

  api:
    build: ./services/api
    environment:

      SECRET_KEY: ${SECRET_KEY:?set SECRET_KEY}

      SAFAR_SEED: ${SAFAR_SEED:-true}

    depends_on:
      db: {condition: service_healthy}
    volumes: [media:/app/storage]

  web:

      args:
        NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL: ${NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL:-http://localhost:8000}

    ports: ["3000:3000"]
volumes: {pgdata: {}, media: {}}

One Intelligent Journey.*\n\nSAFAR is a two-service monorepo: a FastAPI/SQLAlchemy API and a Next.js App Router\nfrontend. Every recommendation is produced by deterministic, inspectable Python\nservices; nothing is generated by an external model. The product rule is enforced\neverywhere: **the engine recommends, the group decides.**\n\n---\n\n## 1. System overview\n\n```\n┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│  apps/web — Next.js 15 (App Router, React 19, TypeScript)         │\n│                                                                  │\n│  Public:  /  /login  /register                                   │\n│  App:     (app)/layout  → RequireAuth + AppShell                 │\n│           (app)/trips/[tripId]/layout → TripShell + WebSocket     │\n│                                                                  │\n│  State:   Zustand (auth token, theme, toasts, offline queue) Leaflet (OSM)      │\n│  PWA:     manifest + service worker (public/sw.js)                │\n└───────────────▲──────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n                │ HTTPS/JSON +                                    │\n│  Routers   auth · users · trips/invitations · itinerary · pulse   │\n│            engine · expenses · places · memories · assistant      │\n│            admin ·     rescue · fairness · impact · governance · safety       │\n│  Security  JWT (HS256) · rate limit middleware · audit log        │\n│  Storage   local /media (static) — object storage not configured  │\n│  DB        SQLite (dev/test) · PostgreSQL/Supabase (production)   │\n└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n```\n\nThe API also exposes OpenAPI at `/api/docs` and `/api/openapi.json`, and a\nmachine-readable capability disclosure at `/api/assistant/capabilities`.\n\n---\n\n## 2. Frontend structure\n\n```\napps/web/\n  app/\n    (app)/                     authenticated shell\n      dashboard/               Decision Load Governor home\n      discover/, discover/[destinationId]/\n      trips/new/\n      trips/[tripId]/          TripShell pages:\n        page.tsx               overview + next action\n        itinerary, voting, pulse, engine, twin, rescue, insights,\n        map, places, places/[activityId], evidence/[activityId],\n        memories, memories/studio, memories/replay,\n        expenses, members, pact, tasks, branches, watch,\n        inspirations, ground, missions, offline, assistant, more\n      assistant, profile, settings, notifications, thread,\n      circles, circles/[circleId], contributors, connections, admin\n    invite/[token]/\n    login, register, page.tsx (landing)\n  components/                  AppShell, ui primitives (Card, Badge, Stat,\n                               Toggle, PageHeader, FlowNote, EmptyState…)\n  lib/\n    api.ts                     fetch wrapper; token from Zustand; 401 event\n    hooks.ts                   TanStack Query hooks per endpoint\n    realtime.ts                WebSocket client with heartbeat + invalidation\n    store.ts                   auth (persist), theme, toasts, offline queue\n    types.ts                   shared API response types\n    utils.ts                   formatting, phase, DNA labels\n  tests/                       Vitest unit tests\n```\n\nEvery trip page is a client component that reads `useParams()` and fetches\nthrough `lib/hooks.ts`. Mutations invalidate the relevant query keys, and the\nWebSocket channel additionally invalidates on server events.\n\n---\n\n## 3. Backend structure\n\n```\nservices/api/\n  app/\n    main.py                    app factory, CORS, gzip, rate limit, lifespan\n    core/                      config, security, deps, rate limit, realtime hub\n    models/models.py           52 tables, UUID string keys, timestamps\n    schemas/schemas.py         Pydantic request/response models\n    routers/                   REST + WebSocket endpoints\n    services/                  domain logic (see §4)\n    seed.py                    deterministic demo dataset (idempotent)\n  migrations/                  Alembic env + baseline revision\n  tests/                       pytest (TestClient, temp SQLite, seeded)\n  alembic.ini\n```\n\n### Authorization model\n\n* `get_current_user` verifies the JWT and rejects inactive/deleted users.\n* `get_trip_and_member` loads the trip and the caller's active membership;\n  `require_role(owner|admin)` gates mutations that rewrite confirmed plans.\n* Private fields are filtered in serializers, not only in the UI:\n  member budget limits and access need details are returned only for the\n  viewer's own membership; pact `individual_limits` are returned per-member;\n  private memories are filtered by visibility rules in every read path\n  (timeline, replay, travel book, offline snapshot).\n* Row Level Security is **not** shipped as SQL; isolation is enforced in the\n  application layer for every query. See the limitations section.\n\n---\n\n## 4. Intelligence layer (deterministic, explainable)\n\nThe prompt forbids routing everything through one LLM. SAFAR instead implements\nseparate services, each with explicit inputs and labelled outputs:\n\n| Capability | Module | Behaviour |\n|---|---|---|\n| Personal preference model | `services/dna.py`, `services/feedback.py` | DNA scores 0–10, explicit edits; feedback updates only with consent + personalisation consent |\n| Destination recommender | `services/ranking.py`, `services/discovery.py` | tag/fit scoring, lens (balanced/iconic/similar), freshness labels |\n| Group recommendation model | `services/engine.py` (Everyone Wins / Your Turn / Surprise Us) | hard constraints filter first (budget, access, time, radius), fairness metrics, per-activity explanation |\n| Journey optimiser | `services/engine.py`, `services/rescue.py`, `services/impact.py` | alternative-day comparison, rescue recovery, cost impact |\n| Traveller matching | `services/discovery.py` (serendipity) | opt-in, reciprocal, heuristic overlap |\n| Place intelligence | `services/places.py` | provenance, freshness, access chain, crowd forecast (needs ≥8 reports), reports |\n| Memory intelligence | `services/memory.py` | session grouping + grounded caption drafts requiring approval |\n| Conversational AI | `services/assistant.py` | intent detection over trip data + catalog; no external model |\n\nAll outputs carry explicit labels: `VERIFIED` / `REPORTED` / `ESTIMATED` /\n`UNKNOWN`, freshness ages, and uncertainty notes. The assistant advertises\n`external_llm: false`, `weather: false`, `translation: false` and explains any\nlimitation in the answer itself.\n\n### Hard-constraint semantics\n\nRanking is filter-then-score. A member's hard budget limit, declared\naccessibility needs, available time and travel radius remove activities before\nscoring. A proposal that would break the Journey Pact or a member's hard budget\nlimit is rejected at approval time with `409`. Private values are used as\nfilters but never returned to other members.\n\n---\n\n## 5. Data model\n\n52 tables grouped by domain:\n\n* **Identity & consent** — users, profiles, user_preferences, journey_dna,\n  consent_records, blocks, notifications, audit_logs\n* **Trips** — trips, trip_members, trip_invitations, journey_pacts,\n  planner_tasks, trip_branches, material_watch, journey_capsules\n* **Catalog** — destinations, places, activities, place_sources, place_reports\n* **Planning** — itinerary_items, itinerary_versions, itinerary_proposals,\n  activity_votes, itinerary_attendance, shadowplans\n* **Intelligence** — recommendation_batches, recommendations,\n  recommendation_feedback, activity_feedback\n* **Pulse & ground** — trip_pulse, ground_requests, ground_responses\n* **Money** — expenses, expense_participants, expense_settlements\n* **Memory** — trip_memories, media_assets, memory_events, memory_permissions\n* **Social** — travel_circles, circle_members, circle_posts,\n  local_contributors, connection_requests, saved_inspiration\n* **Offline** — offline_sync_queue (represented as synced memory rows with\n  client-generated ids; sync is idempotent)\n\nCoordinates are stored as `lat`/`lon` floats and distances use the haversine\nformula. PostGIS is available in the compose database image but no geometry\ncolumns are used yet; this is a documented limitation, not a hidden claim.\n\nMigrations: `services/api/migrations` (Alembic, one baseline revision,\n`alembic check` clean). Development and tests use `create_all`; production uses\n`alembic upgrade head`.\n\n---\n\n## 6. Real time\n\n`core/realtime.py` keeps an in-process connection manager. Clients connect to\n`/ws/trips/{trip_id}?token=…`; the token is verified and membership re-checked\nbefore acceptance. Writers (proposals, votes, itinerary changes, expenses,\nmemories, pulse updates) publish events; `lib/realtime.ts` invalidates the\nmatching TanStack Query keys, so open screens refresh without polling.\n\nThe websocket only broadcasts identifiers and event names — never private\nmember data — and all reads still pass through the HTTP authorization layer.\n\n---\n\n## 7. Trust, privacy and honesty invariants\n\n* No confirmed itinerary is modified by an engine, rescue, twin or branch; all\n  changes become proposals requiring owner/admin approval.\n* No live member locations are stored or exposed; meeting points are explicit\n  trip fields.\n* Community observations remain `REPORTED` until a moderator verifies a source;\n  a single report never becomes `VERIFIED`.\n* Crowd forecasts and travel times are labelled predictions/estimates; when the\n  data is insufficient the UI says so and shows the latest observation instead.\n* The assistant never invents facts; it cites recorded trip data and states\n  missing providers (weather, translation, live availability).\n* Error and empty states are explicit everywhere; there is no fake data path.\n\n---\n\n## 8. Deployment topology\n\n```\nbrowser ──▶ web (Next.js, :3000) ──▶ api (:8000) ──▶ PostgreSQL + PostGIS\n                                         └──▶ /media volume (local storage)\n```\n\n`docker-compose.yml` builds both images, runs `alembic upgrade head` before the\nAPI starts, seeds idempotently when `SAFAR_SEED=true`, and wires health checks\n(`/api/health`) between services. Media is a named volume; production object\nstorage (S3/Supabase Storage) is not configured — the upload path validates\ntype/size and writes to local disk.\n\nLogging is uvicorn/FastAPI standard output plus the audit log table. Error\nmonitoring (Sentry et al.) is not configured; this is listed in the audit.\n",

- PARTIALLY COMPLETE — Some functionality works, but gaps remain.
- UI ONLY — Interface exists, but actual functionality is missing.
- NOT IMPLEMENTED — Feature does not exist.
- BLOCKED — Depends on unavailable services, credentials or data.

Never mark a feature COMPLETE based only on its interface.

## 3. TEST REAL USER WORKFLOWS

- External AI APIs.

- Your Turn identifies overlooked preferences.
- Surprise Us generates relevant alternatives.
- Hard constraints are respected.

- Missing data does not create fabricated results.

## 5. DATABASE AND SECURITY AUDIT

- Navigation.
- Mobile responsiveness.
- Accessibility.

3	from fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, status
4	from fastapi.security import HTTPAuthorizationCredentials, HTTPBearer
5	from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
6	
7	from app.core.security import decode_access_token
8	from app.db.session import SessionLocal
9	from app.models import Trip, TripMember, User
10	
11	bearer = HTTPBearer(auto_error=False)
12	
13	
14	def get_db():
15	    db = SessionLocal()
16	    try:
17	        yield db
18	    finally:
19	        db.close()
20	
21	
22	def _user_from_token(token: str, db: Session) -> User:
23	    payload = decode_access_token(token)
24	    if not payload or not payload.get("sub"):
25	        raise HTTPException(
26	            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
27	            detail="Invalid or expired session",
28	            headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"},
29	        )
30	    user = db.get(User, payload["sub"])
31	    if not user or not user.is_active or user.deleted_at:
32	        raise HTTPException(
33	            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, detail="Account unavailable"
34	        )
35	    return user
36	
37	
38	def get_current_user(
39	    credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials | None = Depends(bearer),
40	    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
41	) -> User:
42	    if credentials is None:
43	        raise HTTPException(
44	            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
45	            detail="Authentication required",
46	            headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"},
47	        )
48	    return _user_from_token(credentials.credentials, db)
49	
50	
51	def get_optional_user(
52	    credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials | None = Depends(bearer),
53	    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
54	) -> User | None:
55	    if credentials is None:
56	        return None
57	    try:
58	        return _user_from_token(credentials.credentials, db)
59	    except HTTPException:
60	        return None
61	
62	
63	def require_admin(user: User = Depends(get_current_user)) -> User:
64	    if not user.is_admin:
65	        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Administrator access required")
66	    return user
67	
68	
69	def get_trip_and_member(
70	    trip_id: str,
71	    db: Session,
72	    user: User,
73	    roles: set[str] | None = None,
74	) -> tuple[Trip, TripMember]:
75	    trip = db.get(Trip, trip_id)
76	    if not trip or trip.deleted_at:
77	        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Trip not found")
78	    member = (
79	        db.query(TripMember)
80	        .filter(
81	            TripMember.trip_id == trip_id,
82	            TripMember.user_id == user.id,
83	            TripMember.status == "active",
84	        )
85	        .first()
86	    )
87	    if not member:
88	        # Deliberately 404 rather than 403 so private trip existence is not leaked.
89	        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Trip not found")
90	    if roles and member.role not in roles:
91	        raise HTTPException(
92	            status_code=403, detail="Your trip role does not allow this action"
93	        )
94	    return trip, member
95	
96	
97	def trip_dependency(roles: set[str] | None = None) -> Callable:
98	    """Build a FastAPI dependency that resolves trip + membership."""
99	
100	    def dependency(
101	        trip_id: str,
102	        db: Session = Depends(get_db),
103	        user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
104	    ) -> tuple[Trip, TripMember]:
105	        return get_trip_and_member(trip_id, db, user, roles)
106	
107	    return dependency

10	_SCRYPT_N = 2**14
11	_SCRYPT_R = 8
12	_SCRYPT_P = 1
13	_SCRYPT_LEN = 32
14	
15	
16	def hash_password(password: str) -> str:
17	    salt = secrets.token_bytes(16)
18	    digest = hashlib.scrypt(
19	        password.encode("utf-8"),
20	        salt=salt,
21	        n=_SCRYPT_N,
22	        r=_SCRYPT_R,
23	        p=_SCRYPT_P,
24	        dklen=_SCRYPT_LEN,
25	    )
26	    return f"scrypt${_SCRYPT_N}${_SCRYPT_R}${_SCRYPT_P}${salt.hex()}${digest.hex()}"
27	
28	
29	def verify_password(password: str, stored: str) -> bool:
30	    try:
31	        algorithm, n, r, p, salt_hex, digest_hex = stored.split("$")
32	        if algorithm != "scrypt":
33	            return False
34	        digest = hashlib.scrypt(
35	            password.encode("utf-8"),
36	            salt=bytes.fromhex(salt_hex),
37	            n=int(n),
38	            r=int(r),
39	            p=int(p),
40	            dklen=len(bytes.fromhex(digest_hex)),
41	        )
42	        return hmac.compare_digest(digest, bytes.fromhex(digest_hex))
43	    except (ValueError, TypeError):
44	        return False
45	
46	
47	def create_access_token(user_id: str, email: str) -> str:
48	    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
49	    payload = {
50	        "sub": user_id,
51	        "email": email,
52	        "iat": now,
53	        "exp": now + timedelta(minutes=settings.access_token_expire_minutes),
54	        "iss": "safar",
55	    }
56	    return jwt.encode(payload, settings.secret_key, algorithm="HS256")
57	
58	
59	def decode_access_token(token: str) -> dict | None:
60	    try:
61	        return jwt.decode(
62	            token, settings.secret_key, algorithms=["HS256"], issuer="safar"
63	        )
64	    except jwt.PyJWTError:
65	        return None

15	@router.post("/register", status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
16	def register(payload: RegisterIn, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
17	    email = payload.email.lower().strip()
18	    if db.query(User).filter(User.email == email).first():
19	        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="An account with this email already exists")
20	    user = User(
21	        email=email,
22	        password_hash=hash_password(payload.password),
23	        display_name=payload.display_name.strip(),
24	    )
25	    db.add(user)
26	    db.flush()
27	    db.add(Profile(user_id=user.id, interests=[]))
28	    db.add(JourneyDNA(user_id=user.id, scores=default_dna(), source="explicit"))
29	    db.add(
30	        ConsentRecord(
31	            user_id=user.id,
32	            kind="terms",
33	            granted=True,
34	            policy_version=settings.policy_version,
35	        )
36	    )
37	    for kind in ("personalization", "analytics", "location", "marketing"):
38	        db.add(
39	            ConsentRecord(
40	                user_id=user.id,
41	                kind=kind,
42	                granted=False,
43	                policy_version=settings.policy_version,
44	            )
45	        )
46	    db.commit()
47	    token = create_access_token(user.id, user.email)
48	    return {"access_token": token, "token_type": "bearer", "user": user_out(user)}

53	    email = payload.email.lower().strip()
54	    user = db.query(User).filter(User.email == email).first()
55	    if not user or not verify_password(payload.password, user.password_hash):
56	        raise HTTPException(
57	            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, detail="Incorrect email or password"
58	        )
59	    if not user.is_active or user.deleted_at:
60	        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="This account is no longer active")
61	    token = create_access_token(user.id, user.email)
62	    return {"access_token": token, "token_type": "bearer", "user": user_out(user)}

1	import time
2	from collections import defaultdict, deque
3	
4	from starlette.middleware.base import BaseHTTPMiddleware
5	from starlette.requests import Request
6	from starlette.responses import JSONResponse
7	
8	from .config import settings
9	
10	
11	class RateLimitMiddleware(BaseHTTPMiddleware):
12	    """Simple sliding-window limiter keyed by client IP.
13	
14	    Sufficient for a single-instance deployment; use a gateway or Redis
15	    limiter when scaling horizontally.
16	    """
17	
18	    def __init__(self, app):
19	        super().__init__(app)
20	        self._hits: dict[str, deque[float]] = defaultdict(deque)
21	
22	    async def dispatch(self, request: Request, call_next):
23	        if not request.url.path.startswith("/api") or request.method == "OPTIONS":
24	            return await call_next(request)
25	
26	        client = request.client.host if request.client else "unknown"
27	        now = time.monotonic()
28	        window = self._hits[client]
29	        while window and now - window[0] > 60:
30	            window.popleft()
31	        if len(window) >= settings.rate_limit_per_minute:
32	            return JSONResponse(
33	                status_code=429,
34	                content={"detail": "Too many requests. Please slow down."},
35	            )
36	        window.append(now)
37	        return await call_next(request)
38

- `TripInvitation.token` unique, but no max uses.

- `TripMember.status` default active.
- `TripInvitation.scope` default full, maybe view-only not enforced? Check invitations.
- No RLS (SQLite local, Postgres compose) — authorization at app layer. The prompt asked verify RLS. Need document as not used; app-level enforced.

240	def proposal_out(
241	    db: Session,
242	    proposal: ItineraryProposal,
243	    viewer_id: str | None = None,
244	) -> dict:
245	    votes = db.query(Vote).filter(Vote.proposal_id == proposal.id).all()
246	    counts = {"yes": 0, "no": 0, "abstain": 0}
247	    my_vote = None
248	    comments: list[dict] = []
249	    user_cache: dict[str, User | None] = {}
250	    for vote in votes:
251	        counts[vote.value] = counts.get(vote.value, 0) + 1
252	        if vote.user_id not in user_cache:
253	            user_cache[vote.user_id] = db.get(User, vote.user_id)
254	        author = user_cache[vote.user_id]
255	        if vote.comment:
256	            comments.append(
257	                {
258	                    "id": vote.id,
259	                    "user": user_public(author),
260	                    "comment": vote.comment,
261	                    "value": vote.value,
262	                    "created_at": vote.created_at,
263	                }
264	            )
265	        if viewer_id and vote.user_id == viewer_id:
266	            my_vote = vote.value
267	    author = db.get(User, proposal.created_by)
268	    return {
269	        "id": proposal.id,
270	        "kind": proposal.kind,
271	        "title": proposal.title,
272	        "summary": proposal.summary,

102	def notify_trip_members(
103	    db: Session,
104	    trip: Trip,
105	    *,
106	    kind: str,
107	    title: str,
108	    body: str | None = None,
109	    link: str | None = None,
110	    exclude_user_id: str | None = None,
111	    urgent: bool = False,
112	) -> list[str]:
113	    """Create in-app notifications for active members.
114	
115	    Quiet mode (F49) suppresses non-urgent notifications. Every feature remains
116	    reachable in-app; quiet mode only removes the interruption.
117	    """
118	    members = (
119	        db.query(TripMember)
120	        .filter(TripMember.trip_id == trip.id, TripMember.status == "active")
121	        .all()
122	    )
123	    notified: list[str] = []
124	    for member in members:
125	        if not member.user_id or member.user_id == exclude_user_id:
126	            continue
127	        user = db.get(User, member.user_id)
128	        if not user:
129	            continue
130	        if user.quiet_mode and not urgent:
131	            continue
132	        db.add(
133	            Notification(
134	                user_id=user.id,
135	                trip_id=trip.id,
136	                kind=kind,
137	                title=title,
138	                body=body,
139	                link=link,
140	            )
141	        )
142	        notified.append(user.id)
143	    return notified

#### Thinking

Schemas seem reasonable but missing: TripCreate doesn't validate end >= start; ItemCreate date within trip? ItemUpdate? Proposal etc.

Key potential security issues:
- `update_profile`: public profiles? Need inspect users.py.
- `memory_out` includes lat/lon exposed to trip members; fine if trip members, but private filter needed.
- `invitation_out` exposes token to members; who can list invitations? must be owner/admin.
- `PactUpsert.individual_limits` privacy must be filtered.
- Assistant privacy.

540	    today = date.today()
