10	def active_member_users(db: Session, trip: Trip) -> list[User]:
11	    members = (
12	        db.query(TripMember)
13	        .filter(TripMember.trip_id == trip.id, TripMember.status == "active")
14	        .all()
15	    )
16	    user_ids = [member.user_id for member in members if member.user_id]
17	    if not user_ids:
18	        return []
19	    return db.query(User).filter(User.id.in_(user_ids)).all()
20	
21	
22	def resolve_shares(
23	    amount: float,
24	    participants: list[dict],
25	    split: str,
26	) -> list[dict]:
27	    """Return participants with normalised share_amount values.
28	
29	    Raises ValueError when custom shares do not reconcile exactly.
30	    """
31	    cleaned = [
32	        {
33	            "user_id": participant.get("user_id"),
34	            "guest_name": participant.get("guest_name"),
35	            "weight": max(0.01, float(participant.get("weight") or 1)),
36	            "share_amount": participant.get("share_amount"),
37	        }
38	        for participant in participants
39	    ]
40	    if not cleaned:
41	        raise ValueError("At least one participant is required.")
42	
43	    if split == "custom":
44	        total = 0.0
45	        for participant in cleaned:
46	            if participant["share_amount"] is None:
47	                raise ValueError("Custom split requires a share for every participant.")
48	            participant["share_amount"] = round(float(participant["share_amount"]), 2)
49	            total += participant["share_amount"]
50	        if abs(total - amount) > 0.01:
51	            raise ValueError(
52	                f"Custom shares total {total:.2f}, which does not match the expense amount {amount:.2f}."
53	            )
54	        return cleaned
55	
56	    if split == "weights":
57	        weight_sum = sum(participant["weight"] for participant in cleaned)
58	        running = 0.0
59	        for index, participant in enumerate(cleaned):
60	            if index == len(cleaned) - 1:
61	                participant["share_amount"] = round(amount - running, 2)
62	            else:
63	                share = round(amount * participant["weight"] / weight_sum, 2)
64	                participant["share_amount"] = share
65	                running += share
66	        return cleaned
67	
68	    count = len(cleaned)
69	    base = round(amount / count, 2)
70	    running = 0.0
71	    for index, participant in enumerate(cleaned):
72	        if index == count - 1:
73	            participant["share_amount"] = round(amount - running, 2)
74	        else:
75	            participant["share_amount"] = base
76	            running += base
77	    return cleaned
78	
79	
80	def participant_rows(db: Session, expense_id: str) -> list[ExpenseParticipant]:
81	    return (
82	        db.query(ExpenseParticipant)
83	        .filter(ExpenseParticipant.expense_id == expense_id)
84	        .all()
85	    )
86	
87	
88	def balances(db: Session, trip: Trip) -> dict:
89	    expenses = (
90	        db.query(Expense)
91	        .filter(Expense.trip_id == trip.id, Expense.deleted_at.is_(None))
92	        .all()
93	    )
94	    net: dict[str, float] = {}
95	    spent_total = 0.0
96	    for expense in expenses:
97	        spent_total += expense.amount
98	        net[expense.paid_by] = round(net.get(expense.paid_by, 0.0) + expense.amount, 2)
99	        for row in participant_rows(db, expense.id):
100	            if row.user_id:
101	                net[row.user_id] = round(net.get(row.user_id, 0.0) - row.share_amount, 2)
102	
103	    user_ids = (
104	        db.query(TripMember.user_id)
105	        .filter(
106	            TripMember.trip_id == trip.id,
107	            TripMember.status == "active",
108	            TripMember.user_id.isnot(None),
109	        )
110	        .all()
111	    )
112	    ids = [row[0] for row in user_ids]
113	    users = db.query(User).filter(User.id.in_(ids)).all() if ids else []
114	    names = {user.id: user.display_name for user in users}
115	    for user_id in ids:
116	        net.setdefault(user_id, 0.0)
117	
118	    creditors = sorted(
119	        [(uid, amt) for uid, amt in net.items() if amt > 0.01],
120	        key=lambda item: item[1],
121	        reverse=True,
122	    )
123	    debtors = sorted(
124	        [(uid, -amt) for uid, amt in net.items() if amt < -0.01],
125	        key=lambda item: item[1],
126	        reverse=True,
127	    )
128	    settlements = []
129	    creditors = [list(item) for item in creditors]
130	    debtors = [list(item) for item in debtors]
131	    ci = di = 0
132	    while ci < len(creditors) and di < len(debtors):
133	        amount = min(creditors[ci][1], debtors[di][1])
134	        if amount > 0.01:
135	            settlements.append(
136	                {
137	                    "from_user_id": debtors[di][0],
138	                    "from_name": names.get(debtors[di][0], "Member"),
139	                    "to_user_id": creditors[ci][0],
140	                    "to_name": names.get(creditors[ci][0], "Member"),
141	                    "amount": round(amount, 2),
142	                }
143	            )
144	        creditors[ci][1] -= amount
145	        debtors[di][1] -= amount
146	        if creditors[ci][1] <= 0.01:
147	            ci += 1
148	        if debtors[di][1] <= 0.01:
149	            di += 1
150	
151	    return {
152	        "total_spent": round(spent_total, 2),
153	        "currency": trip.currency,
154	        "balances": [
155	            {
156	                "user_id": user_id,
157	                "display_name": names.get(user_id, "Member"),
158	                "net": round(net.get(user_id, 0.0), 2),
159	            }
160	            for user_id in sorted(net, key=lambda uid: net[uid], reverse=True)
161	        ],
162	        "settlements": [
163	            {**settlement, "status": "suggested"} for settlement in settlements
164	        ],
165	        "disclosure": "Tracking only — SAFAR does not move money.",
166	    }
167	
168	
169	def expenses_csv(db: Session, trip: Trip) -> str:
170	    buffer = io.StringIO()
171	    writer = csv.writer(buffer)
172	    writer.writerow(
173	        ["date", "title", "category", "amount", "currency", "paid_by", "participants"]
174	    )
175	    expenses = (
176	        db.query(Expense)
177	        .filter(Expense.trip_id == trip.id, Expense.deleted_at.is_(None))
178	        .order_by(Expense.incurred_on, Expense.created_at)
179	        .all()
180	    )
181	    users = {user.id: user.display_name for user in active_member_users(db, trip)}
182	    for expense in expenses:
183	        rows = participant_rows(db, expense.id)
184	        parts = ", ".join(
185	            f"{(users.get(row.user_id) or row.guest_name or 'Guest')} {row.share_amount:.2f}"
186	            for row in rows
187	        )
188	        writer.writerow(
189	            [
190	                expense.incurred_on.isoformat() if isinstance(expense.incurred_on, date) else expense.incurred_on,
191	                expense.title,
192	                expense.category,
193	                f"{expense.amount:.2f}",
194	                expense.currency,
195	                users.get(expense.paid_by, expense.paid_by),
196	                parts,
197	            ]
198	        )
199	    return buffer.getvalue()

205	        ),

216	            ),

219	        },
220	    }
221

#### Thinking

Pulse privacy: get_pulse returns all pulses for trip with pulse_out; for others, budget_comfort and note hidden. It still exposes `available_minutes`, `energy`, `radius_km`, interests. This is probably intended group pulse. Prompt "Never expose private member preferences or budgets" — interests/energy are shared pulse by design; budget hidden. Fine.

BUT `_affected_items` can reveal another user's constraints? It's returned only to the author of the pulse, not other members. Good.

Expenses: good, but balances expose everyone's net. Fine for group expense tracking. "private budgets" refers member budget limits, not shared expenses.

`create_expense`: if payer not user and participant list default includes all active; fine. `ExpenseCreate.currency` default EUR; if trip currency is not EUR and client omits currency, it raises error. Frontend likely sends trip currency. Minor UX: default should be trip.currency. Could fix.

Now admin.py, ws.py, assistant, discovery, places service.

2	
3	Browsers cannot set Authorization headers on WebSocket handshakes, so the
4	short-lived access token is passed as a query parameter and verified before
5	the connection is accepted. Membership is re-checked on every connection.
6	"""
7	
8	from fastapi import APIRouter, Query, WebSocket, WebSocketDisconnect
9	
10	from app.core.realtime import manager
11	from app.core.security import decode_access_token
12	from app.db.session import SessionLocal
13	from app.models import Trip, TripMember, User
14	from app.services.common import event_payload

16	router = APIRouter()

18	
19	@router.websocket("/ws/trips/{trip_id}")
20	async def trip_socket(
21	    websocket: WebSocket,
22	    trip_id: str,
23	    token: str = Query(..., min_length=20),
24	):
25	    payload = decode_access_token(token)
26	    if not payload or not payload.get("sub"):
27	        await websocket.close(code=4401)
28	        return
29	
30	    db = SessionLocal()
31	    try:
32	        user = db.get(User, payload["sub"])
33	        if not user or not user.is_active or user.deleted_at:
34	            await websocket.close(code=4401)
35	            return
36	        trip = db.get(Trip, trip_id)
37	        if not trip or trip.deleted_at:
38	            await websocket.close(code=4404)
39	            return
40	        member = (
41	            db.query(TripMember)
42	            .filter(
43	                TripMember.trip_id == trip.id,
44	                TripMember.user_id == user.id,
45	                TripMember.status == "active",
46	            )
47	            .first()
48	        )
49	        if not member:
50	            await websocket.close(code=4404)
51	            return
52	        display_name = user.display_name
53	    finally:
54	        db.close()
55	
56	    await manager.connect(trip_id, websocket)
57	    await websocket.send_json(
58	        event_payload(
59	            "connected",
60	            trip_id=trip_id,
61	            user=display_name,
62	            note="Live updates for this trip workspace only.",
63	        )
64	    )
65	    try:
66	        while True:
67	            message = await websocket.receive_text()
68	            if message.strip().lower() == "ping":
69	                await websocket.send_json(event_payload("pong", trip_id=trip_id))
70	    except WebSocketDisconnect:
71	        pass
72	    finally:
73	        await manager.disconnect(trip_id, websocket)

41	def _detect_intent(message: str) -> str:

49	def _today_or_next(items: list[ItineraryItem]) -> tuple[date | None, list[ItineraryItem]]:

53	    upcoming = [item for item in items if item.day >= today]
54	    pool = upcoming or items
55	    day = sorted({item.day for item in pool})[0]

#### Thinking

Admin issues:
- Material watch can be created/deleted/checked by any trip member, not just owner/admin. Feature may be group-wide. Fine.
- `decide_abuse_report` "hide_content" for memory sets private but not deleted; memory_out still seen by owner. Fine.
- `verify_place_report` provenance: if verified community report, returns "REPORTED" not VERIFIED due to source_type check; but report.verified True and `place_service.provenance` may return VERIFIED? Need check. Inconsistent maybe.

Assistant issue: `_detect_intent` order weather before itinerary. Good. It can leak budget/expenses to any trip member — group expenses are shared. Fine. Members list shows roles/names. Fine. It doesn't expose private budgets. Good.

But note: assistant `budget` intent returns `data["balances"]` only uses current user's net. Good.

Now discovery.py, places.py service. Specifically fairness, "AI" claims, serendipity privacy.

27	def _cosine(a: dict[str, float], b: dict[str, float]) -> float:
28	    if not a or not b:
29	        return 0.0
30	    dot = sum(value * b.get(key, 0.0) for key, value in a.items())
31	    na = sqrt(sum(value * value for value in a.values()))
32	    nb = sqrt(sum(value * value for value in b.values()))
33	    return dot / (na * nb) if na and nb else 0.0

36	def dna_for_user(db: Session, user_id: str | None) -> dict[str, float]:
37	    if not user_id:
38	        return {dim: 5.0 for dim in DNA_DIMENSIONS}
39	    row = db.query(JourneyDNA).filter(JourneyDNA.user_id == user_id).first()
40	    if row and row.scores:
41	        return {dim: float(row.scores.get(dim, 5)) for dim in DNA_DIMENSIONS}
42	    profile = db.query(Profile).filter(Profile.user_id == user_id).first()
43	    scores = {dim: 5.0 for dim in DNA_DIMENSIONS}
44	    if profile:
45	        for interest in profile.interests or []:
46	            key = normalize_tag(interest)
47	            if key in scores:
48	                scores[key] = 8.0
49	    return scores

52	def activity_tags(activity: Activity) -> dict[str, float]:
53	    tags: dict[str, float] = {}
54	    for tag in activity.tags or []:
55	        key = normalize_tag(tag)
56	        tags[key] = tags.get(key, 0.0) + 1.0
57	    return tags

60	def search_activities(
61	    db: Session,
62	    *,
63	    q: str | None = None,
64	    destination_id: str | None = None,
65	    tags: list[str] | None = None,
66	    max_budget: float | None = None,
67	    max_duration: int | None = None,
68	    indoor: bool | None = None,
69	    accessible: bool = False,
70	    lens: str = "balanced",
71	    dna: dict[str, float] | None = None,
72	    limit: int = 40,
73	) -> list[dict]:
74	    query = db.query(Activity)
75	    if destination_id:
76	        query = query.filter(Activity.destination_id == destination_id)
77	    if q:
78	        like = f"%{q.lower()}%"
79	        query = query.filter(Activity.name.ilike(like) | Activity.description.ilike(like))
80	    activities = query.all()
81	    places = {place.id: place for place in db.query(Place).all()}
82	    destinations = {dest.id: dest for dest in db.query(Destination).all()}
83	    wanted = {normalize_tag(tag) for tag in (tags or [])}
84	    dna = dna or {}
85	
86	    scored = []
87	    for activity in activities:
88	        activity_tag_map = activity_tags(activity)
89	        if wanted and not wanted.intersection(activity_tag_map):
90	            continue
91	        if max_budget is not None and activity.price_estimate > max_budget:
92	            continue
93	        if max_duration is not None and activity.duration_minutes > max_duration:
94	            continue
95	        if indoor is not None and activity.indoor != indoor:
96	            continue
97	        if accessible and activity.wheelchair_accessible is not True:
98	            # Unknown accessibility is not treated as accessible (F41 honesty).
99	            continue
100	        personal = 0.25 + 0.75 * _cosine(activity_tag_map, dna) if dna else 0.5
101	        scored.append(
102	            {
103	                "activity": activity,
104	                "place": places.get(activity.place_id),
105	                "destination": destinations.get(activity.destination_id),
106	                "personal_fit": round(personal * 100, 1),
107	                "tag_map": activity_tag_map,
108	            }
109	        )
110	
111	    if lens == "iconic":
112	        scored.sort(
113	            key=lambda item: (
114	                item["activity"].iconic,
115	                item["activity"].popularity,
116	                item["personal_fit"],
117	            ),
118	            reverse=True,
119	        )
120	    elif lens == "similar":
121	        iconic = [item for item in scored if item["activity"].iconic]
122	        alternatives = [item for item in scored if not item["activity"].iconic]
123	        for item in alternatives:
124	            best = 0.0
125	            best_name = None
126	            for anchor in iconic:
127	                similarity = _cosine(item["tag_map"], anchor["tag_map"])
128	                if similarity > best:
129	                    best = similarity
130	                    best_name = anchor["activity"].name
131	            item["similar_to"] = best_name if best >= 0.35 else None
132	            item["similarity"] = round(best, 2)
133	        alternatives.sort(
134	            key=lambda item: (item.get("similarity", 0), item["personal_fit"]), reverse=True
135	        )
136	        others = [item for item in scored if not item["activity"].iconic]
137	        scored = others
138	    elif lens == "balanced":
139	        iconic = sorted(
140	            [item for item in scored if item["activity"].iconic],
141	            key=lambda item: item["personal_fit"],
142	            reverse=True,
143	        )
144	        other = sorted(
145	            [item for item in scored if not item["activity"].iconic],
146	            key=lambda item: item["personal_fit"],
147	            reverse=True,
148	        )
149	        mixed = []
150	        while iconic or other:
151	            if iconic:
152	                mixed.append(iconic.pop(0))
153	            if other:
154	                mixed.append(other.pop(0))
155	        scored = mixed
156	    else:
157	        scored.sort(key=lambda item: item["personal_fit"], reverse=True)
158	
159	    return [
160	        {
161	            "activity": item["activity"],
162	            "place": item["place"],
163	            "destination": item["destination"],
164	            "personal_fit": item["personal_fit"],
165	            "similar_to": item.get("similar_to"),
166	            "similarity": item.get("similarity"),

177	def dream_import(db: Session, user_id: str, inspiration: SavedInspiration) -> dict:
178	    text = inspiration.content or ""

216	                }
217	            )
218	    for profile_tag in ["food", "temple", "beach", "hiking", "art", "market", "museum", "nature"]:
219	        if profile_tag in lowered and not any(m["name"].lower() == profile_tag for m in matches):
220	            matches.append(

227	                }
228	            )
229	
230	    seen = set()
231	    deduped = []
232	    for match in sorted(matches, key=lambda item: item["confidence"], reverse=True):
233	        key = (match["type"], match["name"])
234	        if key in seen:

236	        seen.add(key)
237	        deduped.append(match)

253	            "Link fetching is not configured. Only the URL string you provided was inspected."
254	        )
255	    inspiration.extracted = extraction

259	def serendipity_suggestions(db: Session, user: User) -> dict:
260	    profile = db.query(Profile).filter(Profile.user_id == user.id).first()
261	    if not profile or not profile.allow_discovery:
262	        return {
263	            "eligible": False,
264	            "reason": "Enable traveller discovery in Privacy settings to see compatible travellers.",
265	            "matches": [],
266	        }
267	    my_trips = (
268	        db.query(Trip)
269	        .join(TripMember, TripMember.trip_id == Trip.id)
270	        .filter(TripMember.user_id == user.id, Trip.deleted_at.is_(None))
271	        .all()
272	    )
273	    my_destinations = {trip.destination_id for trip in my_trips if trip.destination_id}
274	    my_dates = [(trip.start_date, trip.end_date) for trip in my_trips]
275	    my_dna = dna_for_user(db, user.id)
276	    my_interests = {normalize_tag(tag) for tag in (profile.interests or [])}
277	
278	    candidates = (
279	        db.query(Profile)
280	        .filter(
281	            Profile.allow_discovery.is_(True),
282	            Profile.user_id != user.id,
283	            Profile.public_profile.is_(True),
284	        )
285	        .all()
286	    )
287	    results = []
288	    for candidate in candidates:
289	        candidate_user = db.get(User, candidate.user_id)
290	        if not candidate_user or candidate_user.deleted_at:
291	            continue
292	        their_trips = (
293	            db.query(Trip)
294	            .join(TripMember, TripMember.trip_id == Trip.id)
295	            .filter(TripMember.user_id == candidate.user_id, Trip.deleted_at.is_(None))
296	            .all()
297	        )
298	        their_destinations = {trip.destination_id for trip in their_trips if trip.destination_id}
299	        shared_destinations = my_destinations.intersection(their_destinations)
300	        shared_interests = my_interests.intersection(
301	            {normalize_tag(tag) for tag in (candidate.interests or [])}
302	        )
303	        date_overlap = any(
304	            not (trip.end_date < start or trip.start_date > end)
305	            for trip in their_trips
306	            for start, end in my_dates
307	        )
308	        if not shared_destinations and not shared_interests and not date_overlap:
309	            continue
310	        their_dna = dna_for_user(db, candidate.user_id)
311	        dna_similarity = _cosine(my_dna, their_dna)
312	        score = round(
313	            35
314	            * (1 if shared_destinations else 0)
315	            + 25 * min(1, len(shared_interests) / 3)
316	            + 25 * dna_similarity
317	            + (15 if date_overlap else 0),
318	            1,
319	        )
320	        reasons = []
321	        if shared_destinations:
322	            reasons.append("Destination overlap")
323	        if shared_interests:
324	            reasons.append("Shared interests: " + ", ".join(sorted(shared_interests)[:4]))
325	        if date_overlap:
326	            reasons.append("Overlapping travel dates")
327	        results.append(
328	            {
329	                "user": {
330	                    "id": candidate_user.id,
331	                    "display_name": candidate_user.display_name,
332	                    "avatar_url": candidate_user.avatar_url,
333	                    "headline": candidate.headline,
334	                    "home_city": candidate.home_city,
335	                },
336	                "score": score,
337	                "reasons": reasons,
338	                "shared_interests": sorted(shared_interests),
339	                "privacy": "No exact locations or contact details are shared. Contact requires mutual acceptance.",
340	            }
341	        )
342	    results.sort(key=lambda item: item["score"], reverse=True)
343	    for result in results[:10]:
344	        existing = (
345	            db.query(TravellerMatch)
346	            .filter(
347	                TravellerMatch.user_a_id == user.id,
348	                TravellerMatch.user_b_id == result["user"]["id"],
349	            )
350	            .first()
351	        )
352	        if not existing:
353	            db.add(
354	                TravellerMatch(
355	                    user_a_id=user.id,
356	                    user_b_id=result["user"]["id"],
357	                    overlap_score=result["score"],
358	                    reasons=result["reasons"],
359	                )
360	            )
361	    return {
362	        "eligible": True,
363	        "matches": results[:10],
364	        "disclosure": "Matching is opt-in and reciprocal. No private location is ever exposed.",
365	    }

19	def freshness(observed_at: datetime, source_type: str, verified: bool = False) -> float:
20	    age_days = max(0.0, (utcnow() - observed_at).total_seconds() / 86400)
21	    half_life = 90 if source_type == "official" else 30 if verified else 7
22	    score = exp(-log(2) * age_days / half_life)
23	    if verified:
24	        score = min(1.0, score * 1.15)
25	    return round(score, 3)

28	def provenance(source_type: str, verified: bool) -> str:
29	    if source_type == "official" and verified:
30	        return "VERIFIED"
31	    if source_type == "official":
32	        return "REPORTED"
33	    return {
34	        "community": "REPORTED",
35	        "estimated": "ESTIMATED",
36	        "unknown": "UNKNOWN",
37	    }.get(source_type, "UNKNOWN")
38

40	def freshness_label(score: float) -> str:
41	    if score >= 0.75:
42	        return "fresh"
43	    if score >= 0.4:
44	        return "recent but fading"
45	    if score >= 0.15:
46	        return "old — treat with caution"
47	    return "stale — do not rely on it alone"

50	def relevant_reports(db: Session, activity_id: str, days: int = 90) -> list[PlaceReport]:
51	    cutoff = utcnow() - timedelta(days=days)
52	    return (
53	        db.query(PlaceReport)
54	        .filter(
55	            PlaceReport.activity_id == activity_id,
56	            PlaceReport.observed_at >= cutoff,
57	        )
58	        .order_by(PlaceReport.observed_at.desc())
59	        .all()
60	    )

63	def aggregate_reports(db: Session, activity_id: str) -> dict:
64	    reports = relevant_reports(db, activity_id)
65	    categories: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
66	    for report in reports:
67	        weight = freshness(report.observed_at, report.source_type, report.verified) * report.confidence
68	        categories.setdefault(report.category, []).append(
69	            {
70	                "id": report.id,
71	                "value": report.value or {},
72	                "note": report.note,
73	                "observed_at": report.observed_at,
74	                "source_type": report.source_type,
75	                "source_label": SOURCE_LABELS.get(report.source_type, "Unknown"),
76	                "provenance": provenance(report.source_type, report.verified),
77	                "verified": report.verified,
78	                "confidence": report.confidence,
79	                "freshness": freshness(report.observed_at, report.source_type, report.verified),
80	                "weight": round(weight, 3),
81	            }
82	        )
83	    summary = []
84	    for category, entries in categories.items():
85	        entries.sort(key=lambda entry: entry["weight"], reverse=True)
86	        leader = entries[0]
87	        summary.append(
88	            {
89	                "category": category,
90	                "status": leader["provenance"],
91	                "source_type": leader["source_type"],
92	                "source_label": leader["source_label"],
93	                "latest_observed_at": leader["observed_at"],
94	                "freshness": leader["freshness"],
95	                "freshness_label": freshness_label(leader["freshness"]),
96	                "confidence": leader["confidence"],
97	                "reports_count": len(entries),
98	                "weighted_support": round(sum(entry["weight"] for entry in entries), 3),
99	                "reports": entries,
100	            }
101	        )
102	    summary.sort(key=lambda item: item["weighted_support"], reverse=True)
103	    return {
104	        "activity_id": activity_id,
105	        "window_days": 90,
106	        "has_data": bool(reports),
107	        "categories": summary,
108	        "disclosure": (
109	            "Community observations are not official facts. Freshness decays over time; "
110	            "verified official sources rank above community reports."
111	        ),
112	    }

115	def count_bucket(hour: int) -> str:
116	    if 8 <= hour < 12:
117	        return "morning"
118	    if 12 <= hour < 16:
119	        return "afternoon"
120	    if 16 <= hour < 20:
121	        return "evening"
122	    return "night"

125	def crowd_forecast(db: Session, activity_id: str) -> dict:
126	    reports = relevant_reports(db, activity_id, days=180)
127	    crowd = [r for r in reports if r.category == "crowd" and r.source_type in {"community", "official"}]
128	    if len(crowd) < 8:
129	        latest = crowd[0] if crowd else None
130	        return {
131	            "activity_id": activity_id,
132	            "status": "insufficient_data",
133	            "required_reports": 8,
134	            "available_reports": len(crowd),
135	            "latest_observation": (
136	                {
137	                    "observed_at": latest.observed_at,
138	                    "source_type": latest.source_type,
139	                    "source_label": SOURCE_LABELS.get(latest.source_type),
140	                    "value": latest.value,
141	                }
142	                if latest
143	                else None
144	            ),
145	            "message": (
146	                "Not enough reliable observations to forecast crowds. "
147	                "Showing the latest report instead of inventing a prediction."
148	            ),
149	        }
150	
151	    buckets: dict[str, list[float]] = {}
152	    for report in crowd:
153	        value = report.value or {}
154	        raw = value.get("score", value.get("level"))
155	        if isinstance(raw, str):
156	            raw = {"low": 0.25, "moderate": 0.5, "medium": 0.5, "high": 0.8, "very_high": 0.95}.get(raw, 0.5)
157	        try:
158	            score = float(raw)
159	        except (TypeError, ValueError):
160	            continue
161	        key = f"{report.observed_at.weekday()}-{count_bucket(report.observed_at.hour)}"
162	        buckets.setdefault(key, []).append(score)
163	    if not buckets:
164	        return {
165	            "activity_id": activity_id,
166	            "status": "insufficient_data",
167	            "message": "Crowd reports exist but do not contain a usable level or score.",
168	        }
169	    forecasts = []
170	    for key, scores in buckets.items():
171	        weekday, bucket = key.split("-")
172	        if len(scores) < 3:
173	            continue
174	        mean = sum(scores) / len(scores)
175	        variance = sum((score - mean) ** 2 for score in scores) / len(scores)
176	        forecasts.append(
177	            {
178	                "weekday": int(weekday),
179	                "bucket": bucket,
180	                "expected_level": round(mean, 2),
181	                "spread": round(variance**0.5, 2),
182	                "reports": len(scores),
183	                "confidence": round(min(0.85, 0.35 + len(scores) * 0.04), 2),
184	            }
185	        )
186	    if not forecasts:
187	        return {
188	            "activity_id": activity_id,
189	            "status": "insufficient_data",
190	            "message": "Each time bucket needs at least 3 reports before a forecast is shown.",
191	        }
192	    return {
193	        "activity_id": activity_id,
194	        "status": "predicted",
195	        "model": "bucket-mean-v1",
196	        "forecasts": sorted(forecasts, key=lambda f: (-f["confidence"], f["weekday"])),
197	        "disclosure": (
198	            "PREDICTED from historical community/official observations. "
199	            "Confidence reflects sample size and spread, not a guarantee."
200	        ),
201	    }

336	def access_chain(activity: Activity) -> dict:
337	    chain = activity.access_chain or {}
338	    stages = ["transport_stop", "path", "entrance", "experience_area", "facilities", "return"]
339	    labels = {
340	        "transport_stop": "Transport stop",
341	        "path": "Path to entrance",
342	        "entrance": "Entrance",
343	        "experience_area": "Experience area",
344	        "facilities": "Facilities",
345	        "return": "Return journey",
346	    }
347	    entries = []
348	    for stage in stages:
349	        raw = chain.get(stage)
350	        if isinstance(raw, dict):
351	            status = raw.get("status", "reported")
352	            detail = raw.get("detail")
353	        elif isinstance(raw, str):
354	            status, detail = "reported", raw
355	        else:

357	        entries.append(

362	                "detail": detail,
363	                "source": "catalog" if raw else None,
364	            }

1	export const API_URL =
2	  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL?.replace(/\/$/, "") || "http://localhost:8000";
3	
4	export class ApiError extends Error {
5	  status: number;
6	  detail: unknown;
7	
8	  constructor(status: number, detail: unknown) {
9	    const message =
10	      typeof detail === "string"
11	        ? detail
12	        : Array.isArray(detail)
13	          ? detail
14	              .map((item) =>
15	                typeof item === "object" && item && "msg" in item
16	                  ? String((item as { msg: unknown }).msg)
17	                  : String(item),
18	              )
19	              .join(" · ")
20	          : detail && typeof detail === "object" && "message" in detail
21	            ? String((detail as { message: unknown }).message)
22	            : `Request failed (${status})`;
23	    super(message);
24	    this.name = "ApiError";
25	    this.status = status;
26	    this.detail = detail;
27	  }
28	}
29	
30	export function tokenFromStore(): string | null {
31	  if (typeof window === "undefined") return null;
32	  try {
33	    const raw = window.localStorage.getItem("safar-auth");
34	    if (!raw) return null;
35	    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as { state?: { token?: string | null } };
36	    return parsed.state?.token || null;
37	  } catch {
38	    return null;
39	  }
40	}
41	
42	type Options = Omit<RequestInit, "body"> & { body?: unknown; raw?: boolean };
43	
44	export async function api<T>(path: string, options: Options = {}): Promise<T> {
45	  const token = tokenFromStore();
46	  const headers = new Headers(options.headers);
47	  if (options.body !== undefined && !(options.body instanceof FormData)) {
48	    headers.set("Content-Type", "application/json");
49	  }
50	  headers.set("Accept", "application/json");
51	  if (token) headers.set("Authorization", `Bearer ${token}`);
52	
53	  const response = await fetch(`${API_URL}${path}`, {
54	    ...options,
55	    headers,
56	    body:
57	      options.body === undefined
58	        ? undefined
59	        : options.body instanceof FormData
60	          ? options.body
61	          : JSON.stringify(options.body),
62	    cache: "no-store",
63	  });
64	
65	  if (response.status === 401 && typeof window !== "undefined") {
66	    window.dispatchEvent(new Event("safar:unauthorized"));
67	  }
68	
69	  if (!response.ok) {
70	    let detail: unknown = response.statusText;
71	    try {
72	      const data = await response.json();
73	      detail = data.detail ?? data;
74	    } catch {
75	      try {
76	        detail = await response.text();
77	      } catch {
78	        /* ignore */
79	      }
80	    }
81	    throw new ApiError(response.status, detail);
82	  }
83	
84	  if (response.status === 204) return undefined as T;
85	  const contentType = response.headers.get("content-type") || "";
86	  if (options.raw || contentType.includes("text/html") || contentType.includes("text/csv")) {
87	    return (await response.text()) as T;
88	  }
89	  return (await response.json()) as T;
90	}
91	
92	export function wsUrl(tripId: string): string | null {
93	  const token = tokenFromStore();
94	  if (!token) return null;
95	  const base = API_URL.replace(/^http/, "ws");
96	  return `${base}/ws/trips/${tripId}?token=${encodeURIComponent(token)}`;
97	}

1	"use client";
2	
3	import { useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
4	import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
5	
6	import { wsUrl } from "@/lib/api";
7	
8	type Status = "idle" | "connecting" | "live" | "closed";
9	
10	export function useTripSocket(tripId: string | undefined) {
11	  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
12	  const [status, setStatus] = useState<Status>("idle");
13	  const [lastEvent, setLastEvent] = useState<{ type: string; at: number } | null>(null);
14	  const retry = useRef(0);
15	
16	  useEffect(() => {
17	    if (!tripId) return;
18	    let socket: WebSocket | null = null;
19	    let heartbeat: number | undefined;
20	    let reconnect: number | undefined;
21	    let disposed = false;
22	
23	    const connect = () => {
24	      const url = wsUrl(tripId);
25	      if (!url) return;
26	      setStatus("connecting");
27	      socket = new WebSocket(url);
28	
29	      socket.onopen = () => {
30	        retry.current = 0;
31	        setStatus("live");
32	        heartbeat = window.setInterval(() => {
33	          if (socket?.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) socket.send("ping");
34	        }, 30_000);
35	      };
36	
37	      socket.onmessage = (event) => {
38	        try {
39	          const payload = JSON.parse(event.data) as { type?: string };
40	          const type = payload.type || "update";
41	          if (type === "pong" || type === "connected") return;
42	          setLastEvent({ type, at: Date.now() });
43	          queryClient.invalidateQueries({
44	            predicate: (query) =>
45	              query.queryKey[1] === tripId ||
46	              query.queryKey[0] === "trips" ||
47	              query.queryKey[0] === "notifications",
48	          });
49	        } catch {
50	          /* ignore malformed frames */
51	        }
52	      };
53	
54	      socket.onclose = () => {
55	        window.clearInterval(heartbeat);
56	        if (disposed) return;
57	        setStatus("closed");
58	        retry.current = Math.min(retry.current + 1, 5);
59	        reconnect = window.setTimeout(connect, 1500 * retry.current);
60	      };
61	
62	      socket.onerror = () => {
63	        socket?.close();
64	      };
65	    };
66	
67	    connect();
68	    return () => {
69	      disposed = true;
70	      window.clearInterval(heartbeat);
71	      window.clearTimeout(reconnect);
72	      socket?.close();
73	      setStatus("idle");
74	    };
75	  }, [tripId, queryClient]);
76	
77	  return { status, lastEvent };
78	}

4	import { usePathname, useRouter } from "next/navigation";
5	
6	import { PageSkeleton } from "@/components/ui";
7	import { useAuth } from "@/lib/store";
8	
9	export function RequireAuth({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
10	  const router = useRouter();
11	  const pathname = usePathname();
12	  const token = useAuth((state) => state.token);
13	  const hydrated = useAuth((state) => state.hydrated);
14	  const [waited, setWaited] = useState(false);
15	
16	  useEffect(() => {
17	    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => setWaited(true), 700);
18	    return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
19	  }, []);
20	
21	  useEffect(() => {
22	    if (!hydrated && !waited) return;
23	    if (!token) {
24	      const next = encodeURIComponent(pathname || "/dashboard");
25	      router.replace(`/login?next=${next}`);
26	    }
27	  }, [hydrated, waited, token, pathname, router]);
28	
29	  if (!token) {
30	    return (
31	      <div className="mx-auto max-w-wide px-4 py-12">
32	        <PageSkeleton />
33	      </div>
34	    );
35	  }
36	
37	  return <>{children}</>;
38	}

#### Thinking

Confirmed:
- Invite reuse: yes, any authenticated user can accept multiple times; no check of email; no single-use enforcement.
- Media: `/media/{trip_id}/{filename}` static unauthenticated, but filenames are random UUIDs. Still, anyone with URL (member of trip) can share publicly — media has no auth. Since memory visibility controls (private memories) are bypassed by direct file URL if known. This is P1 storage permission issue. Fix: serve media through authenticated endpoint that checks membership + memory visibility. But media_url stored as `/media/...`; replays/travel book embed it in HTML. Changing to authenticated downloads may break `<img src>`. Options: keep `/media` mount but add a dependency? StaticFiles can't do per-trip auth easily. Could implement an authenticated media endpoint `/api/trips/{trip_id}/media/{filename}` and update serializers to emit that URL... but `<img>` tags can't send Authorization header. Alternative: sign media URLs with short-lived token (HMAC) in memory_out; then StaticFiles can't validate either without custom app. Could mount a custom ASGI app that validates a signed token query param. That's a reasonable fix: media URL includes `?t=<signed>` and custom media app validates signature. But DB values store raw path; serializers can append signature at read time. Upload response should return path without signature maybe.

Given scope and time, a simpler and robust fix: replace StaticFiles mount with a FastAPI route `GET /media/{trip_id}/{filename}` that requires a signature token generated in serializers via HMAC of trip_id/filename with SECRET_KEY and expiry. But media_url stored is raw; replay HTML generated on server can sign. Frontend memory_out serializer can include signed URL field. Hmm, changing `media_url` output would alter stored URLs? Only output. But `_safe_media_url` and other places.

Let me weigh: The task is a deep audit with fixes. Need to prioritize P0/P1. Media unauthenticated is a P1 privacy issue. A minimal fix:
1. Implement a media-serving APIRouter/route with token signature validation (HMAC + expiry), mounted at `/media`.
2. Serializer `memory_out` returns signed `media_url` (sign when serializing).
3. Upload response returns signed URL too.
4. Replay HTML signs URLs server-side.
5. Travel book signs too.
Signature includes trip_id and filename and expiry. Membership checking isn't possible in static file route without DB per request — but signing requires being a member (signature issued only through authenticated API responses). This satisfies "can't guess/shared URL forever"; signed URL works without header but expires. Still, a member could share the signed URL during validity; that's acceptable and consistent with typical presigned URL model, documented.

However, this is significant work with many touch points and tests. Alternative simpler: require `Authorization` header via a normal FastAPI route and update frontend to fetch media as blob? Too invasive for images.

Maybe acceptable to implement signed media URLs. Let me look at serializers.memory_out and usages to gauge. Also check tests referencing /media.

- engine inferred cap: test via API to show an activity excluded? Hard to prove directly; code inspection is enough with a unit-style test.

99	def _dna_from_profile(profile: Profile | None) -> dict[str, float]:
100	    scores = {dimension: 5.0 for dimension in DNA_DIMENSIONS}
101	    if not profile:

103	    for interest in profile.interests or []:
104	        key = normalize_tag(interest)
105	        if key in scores:
106	            scores[key] = 8.0
107	    if profile.budget_level == "budget":
108	        scores["budget"] = 8.0
109	        scores["luxury"] = 3.0
110	    elif profile.budget_level == "luxury":
111	        scores["luxury"] = 9.0
112	        scores["budget"] = 3.0
113	    elif profile.budget_level == "comfort":
114	        scores["luxury"] = 7.0

178	def _activity_vector(activity: Activity) -> dict[str, float]:
179	    vector: dict[str, float] = {}
180	    for tag in activity.tags or []:
181	        key = normalize_tag(tag)
182	        vector[key] = vector.get(key, 0.0) + 1.0
183	    return vector

185	
186	def _cosine(a: dict[str, float], b: dict[str, float]) -> float:
187	    if not a or not b:
188	        return 0.0
189	    dot = sum(value * b.get(key, 0.0) for key, value in a.items())
190	    norm_a = sqrt(sum(value * value for value in a.values()))
191	    norm_b = sqrt(sum(value * value for value in b.values()))
192	    if norm_a == 0 or norm_b == 0:
193	        return 0.0
194	    return dot / (norm_a * norm_b)

197	def _member_dna_for_today(ctx: MemberContext) -> dict[str, float]:
198	    dna = dict(ctx.dna)
199	    if ctx.pulse:
200	        for interest in list(ctx.pulse.interests or []) + list(ctx.pulse.activity_prefs or []):
201	            key = normalize_tag(interest)
202	            if key in dna:
203	                # Today's mood boosts a dimension without mutating Journey DNA (F06).
204	                dna[key] = max(dna[key], 8.5)
205	    if ctx.pulse and ctx.pulse.energy <= 2:
206	        dna["relaxation"] = max(dna.get("relaxation", 5), 7.5)
207	        dna["adventure"] = min(dna.get("adventure", 5), 3)
208	    return dna

211	def rank_activity(
212	    activity: Activity,
213	    contexts: list[MemberContext],
214	    *,
215	    base_lat: float,
216	    base_lon: float,
217	    coords: tuple[float, float],
218	    target_member_index: int | None,
219	    mode: str,
220	) -> RankedActivity | None:
221	    if not contexts:
222	        return None
223	    lat, lon = coords
224	    distance = haversine_km(base_lat, base_lon, lat, lon) if (lat or lon) else 0.0
225	    travel = travel_minutes(distance)
226	    round_trip = travel * 2
227	    vector = _activity_vector(activity)
228	    exclusions: dict[str, str] = {}
229	    fits: list[float] = []
230	
231	    for ctx in contexts:
232	        needed_time = activity.duration_minutes + round_trip
233	        hard_budget = ctx.hard_budget
234	        if hard_budget is not None and activity.price_estimate > hard_budget:
235	            exclusions[ctx.label] = "budget"
236	            continue
237	        if ctx.radius_km is not None and distance > ctx.radius_km:
238	            exclusions[ctx.label] = "radius"
239	            continue
240	        if ctx.available_minutes is not None and needed_time > ctx.available_minutes:
241	            exclusions[ctx.label] = "time"
242	            continue
243	        if ctx.needs_wheelchair_access and activity.wheelchair_accessible is False:
244	            exclusions[ctx.label] = "accessibility"
245	            continue
246	
247	        interest = 0.2 + 0.8 * _cosine(vector, _member_dna_for_today(ctx))
248	        if hard_budget:
249	            budget_fit = clamp(1 - (activity.price_estimate / hard_budget), 0, 1)
250	        else:
251	            budget_fit = clamp(1 - activity.price_estimate / 150, 0, 1)
252	        energy_fit = clamp(1 - max(0, activity.effort - ctx.energy) / 4, 0, 1)
253	        if ctx.available_minutes:
254	            time_fit = clamp(1 - (needed_time / ctx.available_minutes) * 0.85, 0.1, 1)
255	        else:
256	            time_fit = clamp(1 - round_trip / 180, 0.2, 1)
257	        if not ctx.accessibility:
258	            access_fit = 1.0
259	        elif activity.wheelchair_accessible is True:
260	            access_fit = 1.0
261	        elif activity.wheelchair_accessible is None:
262	            access_fit = 0.45
263	        else:
264	            access_fit = 1.0  # non-wheelchair needs are not matched to a field yet
265	
266	        fit = 100 * (
267	            0.58 * interest
268	            + 0.16 * budget_fit
269	            + 0.10 * energy_fit
270	            + 0.10 * time_fit
271	            + 0.06 * access_fit
272	        )
273	        fits.append(round(fit, 1))
274	
275	    if exclusions:
276	        return None
277	
278	    average = sum(fits) / len(fits)
279	    minimum = min(fits)
280	    spread = max(fits) - minimum
281	    novelty = clamp(1 - activity.popularity, 0, 1)
282	
283	    uncertainty = 0.0
284	    if any(ctx.needs_wheelchair_access for ctx in contexts) and activity.wheelchair_accessible is None:
285	        uncertainty += 8.0
286	    if activity.source_type.startswith("seed"):
287	        uncertainty += 4.0
288	    if not activity.last_verified_at or (
289	        utcnow() - activity.last_verified_at
290	    ).days > 365:
291	        uncertainty += 3.0
292	
293	    time_penalty = clamp(round_trip / max(1, min(ctx.available_minutes or 240 for ctx in contexts)) * 10, 0, 12)
294	    avg_cap = sum(ctx.hard_budget or 150 for ctx in contexts) / len(contexts)
295	    budget_penalty = clamp(activity.price_estimate / max(1, avg_cap) * 6, 0, 8)
296	    penalties = {
297	        "time": round(time_penalty, 2),
298	        "budget": round(budget_penalty, 2),
299	        "uncertainty": round(uncertainty, 2),
300	        "total": round(time_penalty + budget_penalty + uncertainty, 2),
301	    }
302	
303	    novelty_points = novelty * 100
304	    if mode == "your_turn" and target_member_index is not None:
305	        target_fit = fits[target_member_index]
306	        score = (
307	            0.45 * average
308	            + 0.20 * minimum
309	            + 0.30 * target_fit
310	            + 0.05 * novelty_points
311	            - penalties["total"]
312	        )
313	    elif mode == "surprise_us":
314	        surprise_bonus = 6.0 if not activity.iconic else -3.0
315	        score = (
316	            0.45 * average
317	            + 0.20 * minimum
318	            + 0.35 * novelty_points
319	            + surprise_bonus
320	            - penalties["total"]
321	        )
322	    else:
323	        score = (
324	            0.55 * average
325	            + 0.30 * minimum
326	            + 0.15 * novelty_points
327	            - penalties["total"]
328	        )
329	
330	    return RankedActivity(
331	        activity=activity,
332	        score=round(clamp(score, 0, 100), 1),
333	        average_fit=round(average, 1),
334	        minimum_fit=round(minimum, 1),
335	        fairness_spread=round(spread, 1),
336	        novelty=round(novelty, 3),
337	        fits=fits,
338	        penalties=penalties,
339	        distance_km=distance,
340	        travel_minutes=travel,
341	        exclusions=exclusions,
342	        target_fit=(
343	            round(fits[target_member_index], 1)
344	            if target_member_index is not None and target_member_index < len(fits)
345	            else None
346	        ),
347	    )

350	def _representation_scores(

354	) -> list[float]:
355	    """Average personal interest fit of the confirmed plan per member."""
356	    if not confirmed_items:

359	    activities = (

371	            for item in confirmed_items

524	def generate_recommendations(
525	    db: Session,
526	    trip: Trip,
527	    members: list[TripMember],
528	    *,
529	    mode: str,
530	    for_date: date,
531	    limit: int = 6,
532	) -> dict:
533	    if mode not in MODE_META:
534	        mode = "everyone_wins"
535	    contexts = build_member_contexts(db, trip, members, for_date)
536	    if not contexts:
537	        return {"items": [], "error": "No active members to personalise for."}
538	    if not trip.destination_id:
539	        return {
540	            "items": [],
541	            "error": "Set a destination for this trip before generating group recommendations.",
542	        }
543	
544	    activities = (
545	        db.query(Activity)
546	        .filter(Activity.destination_id == trip.destination_id)
547	        .order_by(Activity.name)
548	        .all()
549	    )
550	    place_cache: dict[str, Place | None] = {}
551	
552	    def coords_for(activity: Activity) -> tuple[float, float]:
553	        if activity.place_id not in place_cache:
554	            place_cache[activity.place_id] = (
555	                db.get(Place, activity.place_id) if activity.place_id else None
556	            )
557	        place = place_cache[activity.place_id]
558	        return (place.lat, place.lon) if place else (0.0, 0.0)
559	
560	    confirmed = (
561	        db.query(ItineraryItem)
562	        .filter(
563	            ItineraryItem.trip_id == trip.id,
564	            ItineraryItem.status == "confirmed",
565	        )
566	        .all()
567	    )
568	    planned_activity_ids = {item.activity_id for item in confirmed if item.activity_id}
569	
570	    target_index: int | None = None
571	    target_ctx: MemberContext | None = None
572	    if mode == "your_turn":
573	        representation = _representation_scores(db, contexts, confirmed)
574	        if any(score > 0 for score in representation):
575	            target_index = min(range(len(contexts)), key=lambda i: representation[i])
576	        target_ctx = contexts[target_index] if target_index is not None else None
577	
578	    ranked: list[RankedActivity] = []
579	    exclusion_reasons: dict[str, int] = {}
580	    seen: dict[str, int] = {}
581	    for activity in activities:
582	        if activity.id in planned_activity_ids:
583	            continue
584	        result = rank_activity(
585	            activity,
586	            contexts,
587	            base_lat=trip.base_lat,
588	            base_lon=trip.base_lon,
589	            coords=coords_for(activity),
590	            target_member_index=target_index,
591	            mode=mode,
592	        )
593	        if result is None:
594	            exclusion_reasons["hard_constraint"] = (
595	                exclusion_reasons.get("hard_constraint", 0) + 1
596	            )
597	            continue
598	        ranked.append(result)
599	
600	    if mode == "your_turn" and target_index is None and ranked:
601	        # No plan yet: target the member whose interests are hardest to serve.
602	        hardest = min(range(len(contexts)), key=lambda i: sum(r.fits[i] for r in ranked) / len(ranked))
603	        target_index = hardest
604	        target_ctx = contexts[hardest]
605	        for result in ranked:
606	            result.target_fit = result.fits[hardest]
607	            result.score = round(
608	                clamp(
609	                    0.45 * result.average_fit
610	                    + 0.20 * result.minimum_fit
611	                    + 0.30 * result.fits[hardest]
612	                    + 0.05 * result.novelty * 100
613	                    - result.penalties["total"],
614	                    0,
615	                    100,
616	                ),
617	                1,
618	            )
619	
620	    ranked.sort(key=lambda item: item.score, reverse=True)
621	    top = ranked[:limit]
622	    alternatives = ranked[limit : limit + 3]
623	
624	    for result in top:
625	        explanation = _explanation(result, contexts, mode, target_ctx)
626	        explanation["alternatives"] = [
627	            {
628	                "activity_id": alt.activity.id,
629	                "name": alt.activity.name,
630	                "score_delta": round(result.score - alt.score, 1),
631	            }
632	            for alt in alternatives
633	        ]
634	        result.explanation = explanation
635	
636	    top_scores = [item.score for item in top]
637	    close_call = len(top_scores) >= 2 and (top_scores[0] - top_scores[1]) < 4
638	    missing_pulse = [ctx for ctx in contexts if ctx.pulse is None]
639	    clarifying_question = None
640	    if close_call and missing_pulse:
641	        clarifying_question = (
642	            f"{len(missing_pulse)} of {len(contexts)} members haven't shared a Trip Pulse today. "
643	            "Knowing their available time and energy could change the top result."
644	        )
645	
646	    return {
647	        "mode": mode,
648	        "mode_meta": MODE_META[mode],
649	        "for_date": for_date,
650	        "items": top,
651	        "contexts": contexts,
652	        "target": target_ctx,
653	        "meta": {
654	            "model_version": ENGINE_VERSION,
655	            "candidate_count": len(activities),
656	            "eligible_count": len(ranked),
657	            "excluded_count": sum(exclusion_reasons.values()),
658	            "planned_excluded": len(planned_activity_ids),
659	            "members_count": len(contexts),
660	            "pulse_coverage": f"{len(contexts) - len(missing_pulse)}/{len(contexts)}",
661	            "hard_constraints": [
662	                "stated budget limits",
663	                "wheelchair accessibility requirements",
664	                "today's available time",
665	                "today's travel radius",
666	            ],
667	            "ranking_formula": (
668	                "mode-weighted average fit + minimum fit + novelty - time, budget and uncertainty penalties"
669	            ),
670	            "disclosure": (
671	                "Catalog attributes are curated seed data. Travel times are estimates. "
672	                "Private budgets and preferences are used for filtering but never exposed."
673	            ),
674	        },
675	        "exclusion_reasons": exclusion_reasons,
676	        "clarifying_question": clarifying_question,
677	        "all_ranked_ids": [item.activity.id for item in ranked],
678	    }

#### Thinking

No fake static data in frontend (only placeholders and toasts). Engine confirmed. Important extra finding: `_explanation` budget detail says "within every stated limit" even when the cap is inferred from comfort (not stated) — misleading. And hard filter uses inferred default comfort=3 → 70 cap, quietly excluding activities >70 even when no member stated a budget. This violates "missing data does not fabricate results". Fix:
- `hard_budget` should only return explicit `budget_limit`. Keep comfort as soft budget fit/penalty.
- Budget fit should use explicit limit if any, else fall back to comfort cap? Comfort is a soft preference; we can use `soft_budget` for scoring. Add `budget_comfort_cap` property for scoring/penalty only.
- Explanation detail should state whether limit was explicit or comfort-based: "within every stated budget limit" only if all contexts with limits? Actually all contexts must pass each own hard limit; if no explicit limit, phrase "within stated group budget limits" may still be wrong. Better: "Estimated ... ; no member stated a lower hard budget limit." Hmm. Simpler accurate wording: f"Estimated ... per person — checked against any stated budget limits." That's true regardless.

Also `avg_cap = sum(ctx.hard_budget or 150 ...)` after fix would use 150 for all no-limit members; fine for penalties. But could use comfort cap for soft penalty. Let's add `soft_budget_cap` property returning budget_limit or comfort cap; use for budget_fit and avg_cap. Hard filter only budget_limit.

But wait: if member sets budget_comfort=1 (15) in pulse, should activity of 60 be allowed? It's explicitly stated today ("budget comfort"), so arguably it is a stated preference, but "comfort" is not a hard limit. The original design says hard constraints include "stated budget limits". Budget comfort is stated but soft. Safer: only `budget_limit` (a member field labeled limit) is hard; comfort affects ranking strongly through budget_fit. However with budget_fit formula `1 - price/soft_cap` and clamp, price 60 with cap 15 → 0, big fit loss but eligible. That preserves fairness and no silent exclusion.

Also `_explanation` accessibility status logic: `"satisfied" if activity.wheelchair_accessible else "unknown"` — if False and members need wheelchair access, activity would have been excluded, so fine; but if no requirement, status "satisfied" even when accessibility False. Acceptable. Actually when any member needs wheelchair and activity.wheelchair_accessible is False, activity was excluded, so no explanation. When None → "unknown". OK.

Next findings to verify:
- memories.py memory_studio events leak. Let's read 309-400.
- `_next_action` broken replay link.
- expenses currency default.
- config SECRET_KEY production fallback.
- main.py schema creation only non-prod; alembic migrations exist?
- `OfflineSyncQueue` etc.

Let me read memories studio and the memories router sections + check main/config. Also run memory probe with private memory.

36	            salt=bytes.fromhex(salt_hex),
37	            n=int(n),
38	            r=int(r),
39	            p=int(p),
40	            dklen=len(bytes.fromhex(digest_hex)),
41	        )
42	        return hmac.compare_digest(digest, bytes.fromhex(digest_hex))
43	    except (ValueError, TypeError):
44	        return False

47	def create_access_token(user_id: str, email: str) -> str:
48	    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
49	    payload = {
50	        "sub": user_id,
51	        "email": email,
52	        "iat": now,
53	        "exp": now + timedelta(minutes=settings.access_token_expire_minutes),
54	        "iss": "safar",
55	    }
56	    return jwt.encode(payload, settings.secret_key, algorithm="HS256")
57	
58	
59	def decode_access_token(token: str) -> dict | None:
60	    try:
61	        return jwt.decode(
62	            token, settings.secret_key, algorithms=["HS256"], issuer="safar"
63	        )
64	    except jwt.PyJWTError:
65	        return None

22	def _user_from_token(token: str, db: Session) -> User:
23	    payload = decode_access_token(token)
24	    if not payload or not payload.get("sub"):
25	        raise HTTPException(
26	            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
27	            detail="Invalid or expired session",
28	            headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"},

31	    if not user or not user.is_active or user.deleted_at:

34	        )
35	    return user

38	def get_current_user(
39	    credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials | None = Depends(bearer),
40	    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
41	) -> User:
42	    if credentials is None:
43	        raise HTTPException(
44	            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
45	            detail="Authentication required",
46	            headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"},
47	        )
48	    return _user_from_token(credentials.credentials, db)
49	
50	
51	def get_optional_user(
52	    credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials | None = Depends(bearer),
53	    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
54	) -> User | None:
55	    if credentials is None:
56	        return None
57	    try:
58	        return _user_from_token(credentials.credentials, db)
59	    except HTTPException:

63	def require_admin(user: User = Depends(get_current_user)) -> User:

66	    return user

69	def get_trip_and_member(
70	    trip_id: str,
71	    db: Session,
72	    user: User,
73	    roles: set[str] | None = None,
74	) -> tuple[Trip, TripMember]:
75	    trip = db.get(Trip, trip_id)
76	    if not trip or trip.deleted_at:
77	        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Trip not found")
78	    member = (
79	        db.query(TripMember)
80	        .filter(
81	            TripMember.trip_id == trip_id,
82	            TripMember.user_id == user.id,
83	            TripMember.status == "active",
84	        )
85	        .first()
86	    )
87	    if not member:
88	        # Deliberately 404 rather than 403 so private trip existence is not leaked.
89	        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Trip not found")
90	    if roles and member.role not in roles:
91	        raise HTTPException(
92	            status_code=403, detail="Your trip role does not allow this action"
93	        )
94	    return trip, member

98	    """Build a FastAPI dependency that resolves trip + membership."""

100	    def dependency(

102	        db: Session = Depends(get_db),
103	        user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
104	    ) -> tuple[Trip, TripMember]:
105	        return get_trip_and_member(trip_id, db, user, roles)
106	
107	    return dependency

@app.get("/media/{trip_id}/{filename}")
def media_file(trip_id: str, filename: str, request: Request):
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{32}", trip_id) or not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9._-]+", filename):

    path = f"/media/{trip_id}/{filename}"
    if not verify_media_request(path, dict(request.query_params)):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Media link is missing or expired")
    candidate = (MEDIA_DIR / trip_id / filename).resolve()
    if MEDIA_DIR.resolve() not in candidate.parents or not candidate.is_file():
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Media not found")
    return FileResponse(candidate)

103	|---|---|---|
104	| LLM provider | No generative answers, no AI captions | Deterministic grounded retrieval; caption drafts are template-based and require approval |

107	| Live routing/traffic | No routed ETAs | Travel times are estimates, always labelled |
108	| Live availability/ticketing | No booking | Catalog is curated seed data, labelled ESTIMATED unless a verified source exists |
109	| Object storage | Media on local disk | Type/size validation; media served from `/media` |
110	| Email/SMS delivery | No outbound messages | Invitations are shareable links; in-app notifications only |

"""Trip Rescue (F09) and Fair Trade negotiation (F45).

Rescue only produces a proposal. Nothing is applied until the group approves.
"""

from datetime import date

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.models import (
    Activity,
    ItineraryItem,
    JourneyPact,
    Place,
    Shadowplan,
    Trip,
    TripMember,
)
from app.services.common import normalize_tag
from app.services.engine import generate_recommendations
from app.services.geo import haversine_km, travel_minutes

KIND_LABELS = {
    "rain": "Rain or bad weather",
    "closure": "Unexpected closure",
    "traffic": "Traffic delay",
    "fatigue": "Fatigue or low energy",
    "budget": "Budget change",
    "time": "Time constraint",
}


def _activity_map(db: Session, items: list[ItineraryItem]) -> dict[str, Activity]:
    ids = [item.activity_id for item in items if item.activity_id]
    if not ids:
        return {}
    return {a.id: a for a in db.query(Activity).filter(Activity.id.in_(ids)).all()}


def _place_coords(db: Session, activity: Activity | None) -> tuple[float, float]:
    if not activity or not activity.place_id:
        return (0.0, 0.0)
    place = db.get(Place, activity.place_id)
    return (place.lat, place.lon) if place else (0.0, 0.0)


def _pick_affected(db: Session, items: list[ItineraryItem], kind: str, item_id: str | None) -> list[dict]:
    if item_id:
        target = next((item for item in items if item.id == item_id), None)
        return [{"item": target, "reason": "The group flagged this item."}] if target else []

    if not items:
        return []
    day = sorted({item.day for item in items})[0]
    day_items = [item for item in items if item.day == day]
    activities = _activity_map(db, day_items)

    def activity_of(item: ItineraryItem) -> Activity | None:
        return activities.get(item.activity_id) if item.activity_id else None

    selected: list[ItineraryItem] = []
    reason = ""
    if kind == "rain":
        selected = [item for item in day_items if activity_of(item) and not activity_of(item).indoor]
        reason = "Outdoor activities are exposed to rain."
    elif kind == "closure":
        selected = day_items[:1]
        reason = "The first item of the day is affected by a closure."
    elif kind == "traffic":
        selected = [item for item in day_items if item.start_time >= "12:00"] or day_items[-1:]
        reason = "Later items are likely to slip because of traffic."
    elif kind == "fatigue":
        selected = [item for item in day_items if activity_of(item) and activity_of(item).effort >= 3]
        if not selected:
            selected = sorted(day_items, key=lambda item: activity_of(item).effort if activity_of(item) else 0, reverse=True)[:1]
        reason = "High-effort items are a poor fit for low energy."
    elif kind == "budget":
        selected = sorted(day_items, key=lambda item: item.cost_estimate, reverse=True)[:2]
        reason = "The most expensive items put pressure on the budget."
    elif kind == "time":
        selected = day_items[-1:]
        reason = "The last item is at risk of not fitting the available time."
    return [{"item": item, "reason": reason} for item in selected if item]

But the first item day is 2026-11-17, which is *past* (today 2026-11-19), and `upcoming = [item for item in all_items if item.day >= today]` → pool excludes it, then `if not item_id` false, so pool = upcoming [11-19, 11-20, 11-21]. Target 11-17 not in pool → affected []. So my test used items[0] which is in the past. In real usage, rescue targets days ≥ today. Test should choose an upcoming item (day >= today). @router.delete("/me")
def delete_account(
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db)
):
    from app.models import Notification

    if user.is_admin:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail="Administrator accounts must be transferred before deletion.",
        )
    now = utcnow()
    profile = db.query(Profile).filter(Profile.user_id == user.id).first()
    if profile:
        profile.headline = None
        profile.bio = None
        profile.home_city = None
        profile.interests = []
        profile.accessibility_needs = []
        profile.dietary = []
        profile.languages = []
        profile.public_profile = False
        profile.allow_discovery = False
        profile.location_sharing = False
        profile.budget_limit = None
    db.query(TripMemory).filter(
        TripMemory.user_id == user.id, TripMemory.deleted_at.is_(None)
    ).update({TripMemory.deleted_at: now, TripMemory.visibility: "private"})
    db.query(Notification).filter(Notification.user_id == user.id).delete()
    db.query(UserBlock).filter(
        (UserBlock.blocker_id == user.id) | (UserBlock.blocked_id == user.id)
    ).delete()
    db.add(
        ConsentRecord(
            user_id=user.id,
            kind="terms",
            granted=False,
            policy_version=settings.policy_version,
        )
    )
    user.deleted_at = now
    user.is_active = False
    user.email = f"deleted+{user.id}@safar.invalid"
    user.display_name = "Former traveller"
    user.avatar_url = None
    user.password_hash = "deleted-account"
    user.quiet_mode = True
    audit(
        db,
        action="account.delete",
        entity_type="user",
        entity_id=user.id,
        user_id=user.id,
    )
    db.commit()
    return {"ok": True, "note": "Account anonymised. Media owned by this account is hidden."}

from collections.abc import Callable

from fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.security import HTTPAuthorizationCredentials, HTTPBearer
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.core.security import decode_access_token
from app.db.session import SessionLocal
from app.models import Trip, TripMember, User

bearer = HTTPBearer(auto_error=False)


def get_db():
    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()


def _user_from_token(token: str, db: Session) -> User:
    payload = decode_access_token(token)
    if not payload or not payload.get("sub"):
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            detail="Invalid or expired session",
            headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"},
        )
    user = db.get(User, payload["sub"])
    if not user or not user.is_active or user.deleted_at:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, detail="Account unavailable"
        )
    return user

"""Trip workspace WebSocket channel for collaborative updates (F05).

Browsers cannot set Authorization headers on WebSocket handshakes, so the
short-lived access token is passed as a query parameter and verified before
the connection is accepted. Membership is re-checked on every connection.
"""

from fastapi import APIRouter, Query, WebSocket, WebSocketDisconnect

from app.core.realtime import manager
from app.core.security import decode_access_token
from app.db.session import SessionLocal
from app.models import Trip, TripMember, User
from app.services.common import event_payload

router = APIRouter()


@router.websocket("/ws/trips/{trip_id}")
async def trip_socket(
    websocket: WebSocket,
    trip_id: str,
    token: str = Query(..., min_length=20),
):
    payload = decode_access_token(token)
    if not payload or not payload.get("sub"):
        await websocket.close(code=4401)
        return

    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        user = db.get(User, payload["sub"])
        if not user or not user.is_active or user.deleted_at:
            await websocket.close(code=4401)
            return
        trip = db.get(Trip, trip_id)
        if not trip or trip.deleted_at:
            await websocket.close(code=4404)
            return
        member = (
            db.query(TripMember)
            .filter(
                TripMember.trip_id == trip.id,
                TripMember.user_id == user.id,
                TripMember.status == "active",
            )
            .first()
        )
        if not member:
            await websocket.close(code=4404)
            return
        display_name = user.display_name
    finally:
        db.close()

    await manager.connect(trip_id, websocket)
    await websocket.send_json(
        event_payload(
            "connected",
            trip_id=trip_id,
            user=display_name,
            note="Live updates for this trip workspace only.",
        )
    )
    try:
        while True:
            message = await websocket.receive_text()
            if message.strip().lower() == "ping":
                await websocket.send_json(event_payload("pong", trip_id=trip_id))
    except WebSocketDisconnect:

@router.get("/me/dna")
def get_dna(user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    dna = _get_dna(db, user.id)
    return {
        "scores": dna.scores,
        "source": dna.source,
        "updated_at": dna.updated_at,
        "dimensions": DNA_DIMENSIONS,
        "note": "Journey DNA is editable and never a permanent personality label.",
    }


@router.put("/me/dna")
def update_dna(
    payload: DNAUpdate,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    unknown = set(payload.scores) - set(DNA_DIMENSIONS)
    if unknown:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=f"Unknown DNA dimensions: {', '.join(sorted(unknown))}")
    dna = _get_dna(db, user.id)
    scores = dict(dna.scores or default_dna())
    for dimension, value in payload.scores.items():
        scores[dimension] = clamp(float(value), 0, 10)
    dna.scores = scores
    dna.source = "explicit"
    audit(db, action="dna.update", entity_type="journey_dna", entity_id=dna.id, user_id=user.id)
    db.commit()
    return {"scores": dna.scores, "source": dna.source, "updated_at": dna.updated_at}

@router.put("/me/consents")
def update_consents(
    payload: ConsentUpdate,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    unknown = set(payload.consents) - CONSENT_KINDS
    if unknown:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=f"Unknown consent types: {', '.join(sorted(unknown))}")
    for kind, granted in payload.consents.items():
        db.add(
            ConsentRecord(
                user_id=user.id,
                kind=kind,
                granted=bool(granted),
                policy_version=settings.policy_version,
            )
        )
    audit(
        db,
        action="consent.update",
        entity_type="consent",
        user_id=user.id,
        detail=payload.consents,
    )
    db.commit()
    return {"consents": _consent_map(db, user.id), "policy_version": settings.policy_version}

"""Consented outcome learning (F33) shared by engine and place endpoints."""

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.models import Activity, ActivityFeedback, ConsentRecord, JourneyDNA, User
from app.services.common import DNA_DIMENSIONS, clamp, default_dna, normalize_tag

DNA_SENTIMENT = {
    "loved": 2.0,
    "would_return": 1.5,
    "okay": 0.0,
    "not_for_me": -1.5,
    "too_expensive": -1.0,
    "too_far": -0.5,
}


def personalization_allowed(db: Session, user_id: str) -> bool:
    row = (
        db.query(ConsentRecord)
        .filter(
            ConsentRecord.user_id == user_id,
            ConsentRecord.kind == "personalization",
        )
        .order_by(ConsentRecord.created_at.desc())
        .first()
    )
    return not row or row.granted


def upsert_activity_feedback(
    db: Session,
    *,
    user_id: str,
    trip_id: str | None,
    activity: Activity,
    sentiment: str,
    consented: bool,
) -> ActivityFeedback:
    row = (
        db.query(ActivityFeedback)
        .filter(
            ActivityFeedback.user_id == user_id,
            ActivityFeedback.activity_id == activity.id,
            ActivityFeedback.trip_id == trip_id,
        )
        .first()
    )
    if row:
        row.sentiment = sentiment
        row.consented = consented
        return row
    row = ActivityFeedback(
        user_id=user_id,
        trip_id=trip_id,
        activity_id=activity.id,
        sentiment=sentiment,
        consented=consented,
    )
    db.add(row)
    return row


def apply_feedback_to_dna(
    db: Session,
    user: User,
    activity: Activity,
    sentiment: str,
    *,
    consented: bool,
) -> dict | None:
    delta = DNA_SENTIMENT.get(sentiment, 0.0)
    if not consented or delta == 0:
        return None
    if not personalization_allowed(db, user.id):
        return None
    dna = db.query(JourneyDNA).filter(JourneyDNA.user_id == user.id).first()
    if not dna:
        dna = JourneyDNA(user_id=user.id, scores=default_dna(), source="feedback")
        db.add(dna)
        db.flush()
    scores = dict(dna.scores or default_dna())
    changed: list[str] = []
    for tag in activity.tags or []:
        key = normalize_tag(tag)
        if key in DNA_DIMENSIONS:
            scores[key] = round(clamp(float(scores.get(key, 5)) + delta, 0, 10), 2)
            changed.append(key)
    if not changed:
        return None
    dna.scores = scores
    dna.source = "feedback+explicit"
    return {"dimensions": sorted(set(changed)), "scores": scores}

@router.post("/{trip_id}/proposals/{proposal_id}/withdraw")
async def withdraw_proposal(
    trip_id: str,
    proposal_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    proposal = db.get(ItineraryProposal, proposal_id)
    if not proposal or proposal.trip_id != trip.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Proposal not found")
    if proposal.created_by != user.id and member.role not in ADMIN_ROLES:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Only the author or an admin can withdraw")
    if proposal.status != "open":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="This proposal is no longer open")
    proposal.status = "withdrawn"
    proposal.decided_at = utcnow()
    db.commit()
    await manager.broadcast(
        trip.id,
        event_payload("proposal.withdrawn", trip_id=trip.id, proposal_id=proposal.id),
    )
    return proposal_out(db, proposal, user.id)


@router.post("/{trip_id}/itinerary/items/{item_id}/attendance")
def update_attendance(
    trip_id: str,
    item_id: str,
    payload: AttendanceUpdate,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    item = db.get(ItineraryItem, item_id)
    if not item or item.trip_id != trip.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Itinerary item not found")
    row = (
        db.query(ItineraryAttendance)
        .filter(ItineraryAttendance.item_id == item.id, ItineraryAttendance.user_id == user.id)
        .first()
    )
    if not row:
        row = ItineraryAttendance(item_id=item.id, user_id=user.id, status=payload.status)
        db.add(row)
    else:
        row.status = payload.status
    audit(
        db,
        action="itinerary.attendance",
        entity_type="itinerary_item",
        entity_id=item.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
        detail={"status": payload.status},
    )
    db.commit()
    return {"ok": True, "status": row.status, "note": "No reason is required or recorded."}

105	## 5. Security and privacy review
106	
107	* All mutating trip routes resolve membership and role before acting.
108	* Private member fields are omitted by serializers, not just concealed.
109	* Proposal approval re-checks pact and per-member hard budget; conflicts 409.
110	* JWT verified on every request and on the WebSocket handshake; inactive,
111	  deleted and non-member users are rejected.
112	* Rate limiting middleware applies per client; CORS is an explicit allow-list.
113	* Media upload validates MIME type and size before writing.
114	* No secret is read by the client bundle; only `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL` is public.
115	* Audit rows are written for approvals, verification, blocks, joins and
116	  moderation.
117	* Remaining gaps: no email verification/password reset (no mail provider), no
118	  RLS SQL policies, no APM/error monitoring, no CSRF token (JWT is sent in an
119	  Authorization header, not a cookie).
