#### Thinking

Toasts lack `role="status"`/`aria-live`, though the dismiss button has aria-label. This is a legitimate P3 accessibility fix: add `role="status"` (or alert for errors) and `aria-live="polite"` to the container. Low-risk, meaningful. Let's implement it: container gets `aria-live="polite"` and `role="status"`; for error toasts, role alert? Simpler: add `aria-live="polite"` and `role="status"` to container. Error tone could use `role="alert"` per toast. Implement:

```tsx
<div ... aria-live="polite" role="status">
```
Nested role=status might be okay. Better: each motion.div gets role={toast.tone === "error" ? "alert" : "status"} and aria-live accordingly. But aria-live on dynamically inserted nodes works only if the live region exists before insertion. The container is always there; setting aria-live on container makes additions announced. Keep it simple: container `aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="false"`. For errors, polite is acceptable but alert is better; without per-toast live regions, polite works.

## SAFAR — Deep Technical Audit: Final Report

Full detail lives in [docs/AUDIT.md](file:///C:/Users/siddharth/Documents/Qoder/2026-11-19/7c4196d9/docs/AUDIT.md); per-feature evidence is in [docs/FEATURE_REGISTRY.md](file:///C:/Users/siddharth/Documents/Qoder/2026-11-19/7c4196d9/docs/FEATURE_REGISTRY.md).

### Overall assessment

SAFAR is a genuinely functional application, not a UI shell. Every feature judged COMPLETE has a working backend path exercised by a test or a live call — 115 OpenAPI paths / 143 operations, 46 page routes, 43 features complete end-to-end. Nothing is faked: no LLM, no weather, no translation, no OCR, and where the data does not exist the API refuses rather than inventing.

### Feature status (F01–F49)

| Status | Count | Which |
|---|---|---|
| COMPLETE | 43 | all others |
| PARTIALLY COMPLETE | 4 | F17 keyword-only inspiration import; F21 crowd forecast needs ≥8 reports before estimating; F22 assistant answers English only; F39 protected items have no dedicated wizard |
| NOT IMPLEMENTED | 2 | F24 Opportunity Clock; F26 One-Link Companion |
| UI ONLY / BLOCKED | 0 | — |

Each partial/missing item is labelled in the UI or documented — none is presented as working.

### AI/ML authenticity

There is **no machine learning and no LLM**. The engine is a deterministic constraint solver (`safar-group-engine-1.0`) and the assistant is grounded retrieval (`safar-grounded-retrieval-1.0`); `external_ai` is reported as false. Everyone Wins / Your Turn / Surprise Us all produce real ranked batches with hard constraints, fairness spread, uncertainty bands, and provenance labels (VERIFIED / REPORTED / ESTIMATED / UNKNOWN) — verified by test across all three modes, including that the confirmed itinerary is never mutated. Missing data yields 422 or `insufficient_data`, never fabricated output. OpenAI keys exist in config but drive nothing.

### Defects found and fixed

| Fix | Location |
|---|---|
| Invite link email binding (403) and single-use (409) | [services/api/app/routers/trips.py:492](file:///C:/Users/siddharth/Documents/Qoder/2026-11-19/7c4196d9/services/api/app/routers/trips.py#L492) |
| Signed media route serving only HMAC-valid URLs | [services/api/app/main.py:97](file:///C:/Users/siddharth/Documents/Qoder/2026-11-19/7c4196d9/services/api/app/main.py#L97) |
| Private memory metadata leaking into timeline | [services/api/app/services/memory.py:48](file:///C:/Users/siddharth/Documents/Qoder/2026-11-19/7c4196d9/services/api/app/services/memory.py#L48) |
| Hard vs soft budget both capped at comfort ceiling | [services/api/app/services/engine.py:81](file:///C:/Users/siddharth/Documents/Qoder/2026-11-19/7c4196d9/services/api/app/services/engine.py#L81) |
| Currency defaulting, replay-link handling, production secret guard | routers / config |
| Skip-to-content link + `main` landmark | [apps/web/components/AppShell.tsx:153](file:///C:/Users/siddharth/Documents/Qoder/2026-11-19/7c4196d9/apps/web/components/AppShell.tsx#L153) |
| Polite live region on toasts | [apps/web/components/ui.tsx:508](file:///C:/Users/siddharth/Documents/Qoder/2026-11-19/7c4196d9/apps/web/components/ui.tsx#L508) |

### Security and database

Relationships and constraints are enforced at the model layer; API auth is JWT with per-trip membership checks. Verified denials: cross-user private trip → 404, member preference/budget fields hidden from non-owners, circle/pact privacy, admin endpoints → 403 for non-admins, reused and mis-addressed invites rejected. Account deletion anonymises the row (`deleted+{id}@safar.invalid`, "Former traveller") and invalidates the token ([services/api/app/routers/users.py:428](file:///C:/Users/siddharth/Documents/Qoder/2026-11-19/7c4196d9/services/api/app/routers/users.py#L428)). No secrets in frontend code. Known gap: Supabase RLS policies are not shipped — application-level checks are the current defence.

### UI/UX

Shared design system, consistent editorial typography and colour tokens, route-level skeletons, empty states, and `ErrorState` with retry everywhere. Responsive verified at 403–459 px (bottom nav shown, sidebar hidden, no horizontal overflow). Network-failure simulation produced a toast with the UI still usable. Remaining P3 suggestions: raise 11 px metadata text to 12 px, add an automated axe/Playwright pass, add an `alert` live region for destructive errors, capture visual regressions. No redesign was performed.

### Verification evidence

- `pytest` — **32 passed** (20 in `test_audit_fixes.py`, covering engine modes, twin, rescue, invites, RBAC, deletion, DNA consent, realtime broadcast)
- `vitest run` — **12 passed**
- `tsc --noEmit` — clean
- `next build` — exit 0
- 67-endpoint live smoke — all pass (two initial probes were my own malformed requests, not defects, and are now pinned by tests)
- Browser — skip link, `main#main-content`, and `role="status"` confirmed in a freshly rebuilt production server

### External dependencies not exercised

Docker was unavailable so the compose stack was not built; the service worker caches shell only in production and was not exercised offline; no weather, translation, object-storage, or APM provider is wired — all sit behind existing service interfaces.

### Next phase

1. F24 Opportunity Clock over activity hours and departure windows.
2. F26 One-Link Companion with signed, single-purpose, expiring tokens.
3. Real providers behind the existing interfaces (weather, translation, storage).
4. Sentry/APM, structured JSON logs, backup/restore runbook.
5. Playwright end-to-end suite.
6. Supabase RLS policies reviewed against the app-level checks.

No commits were made and ports 3000/8000 (DARWIN) were left untouched; the project web server runs on 3010.

import uuid
from datetime import date, datetime, timezone

from sqlalchemy import (
    JSON,
    Boolean,
    Date,
    DateTime,
    Float,
    ForeignKey,
    Index,
    Integer,
    String,
    Text,
    UniqueConstraint,
)
from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, mapped_column

from app.db.session import Base


def new_id() -> str:
    return uuid.uuid4().hex


def utcnow() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).replace(tzinfo=None)


class TimestampMixin:
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime, default=utcnow)
    updated_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(
        DateTime, default=utcnow, onupdate=utcnow
    )


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Identity, profile, consent, Journey DNA
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------


class User(Base, TimestampMixin):
    __tablename__ = "users"

    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(32), primary_key=True, default=new_id)
    email: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(320), unique=True, index=True)
    password_hash: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(255))
    display_name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(120))
    is_admin: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, default=False)
    is_active: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, default=True)

Now, understand how routes are registered, app structure (deps, auth helpers) and seed data for opening hours. Also inspect `services/api/app/routers/itinerary.py` beginnings and `services/api/app/services/common.py` for member checks.

Then plan F24/F26 implementation.

F24 Opportunity Clock design (real, deterministic):
- Input: trip, date, and optionally per-member availability from pulse (available_minutes, radius) — but opportunity clock is typically about "is now a good time to do X" — based on opening hours of activities and departure windows.
- Endpoint: GET /api/trips/{trip_id}/opportunity-clock?on=YYYY-MM-DD
- Compute for each candidate activity (from destination catalog, or from trip's shortlist/proposals): 
  - opening window for that weekday from `opening_hours` JSON.
  - travel estimate to the place using existing geo travel estimate (services/geo.py has haversine; engine has travel minutes).
  - items already confirmed that day: find free windows between confirmed items.
  - feasibility: can fit duration + travel into a free window within opening hours; status "open_now"/"closes_soon"/"next_window"/"closed_today".
- Return ranked list with explanation, provenance ESTIMATED for opening hours from seed catalog (source_type), never modifies plan. Honest: if no opening hours data, status "unknown".

UI: add a card/page "Opportunity Clock" under trip /opportunity (or /clock) reachable from More hub. Show current time feasibility for candidate activities with badges.

F26 One-Link Companion design:
- New table CompanionLink: id, trip_id, created_by, purpose ("vote"|"checkin"), target_id (proposal id or itinerary item id), token hash, token? (store hash only, return raw once), expires_at, max_uses (1), used_at, revoked_at, created_at.
- Response table CompanionResponse: id, link_id, action/value, comment, anonymous (no user), created_at, ip hash maybe (avoid PII).
- Endpoints (authenticated to create, public to read/respond):
  - POST /api/trips/{trip_id}/companion-links {purpose, target_id, ttl_minutes} → returns url/token (only creator sees).
  - GET /api/companion/{token} → context summary only: trip name? Careful privacy: link should show minimal context for one vote or check-in. E.g. proposal title + summary, or itinerary item title + day/time, no member info, no budgets.
  - POST /api/companion/{token}/respond {value, comment?} → records anonymous response, marks used if single-use.
  - GET /api/trips/{trip_id}/companion-links → list own links + response counts (no raw token again).
- Signature: use HMAC with SECRET_KEY or random secrets stored hashed (sha256) — simpler and safer: token = secrets.token_urlsafe(32), store sha256; lookup by hash. That's "signed, single-purpose, expiring tokens" effectively. Could also add HMAC signature but hash lookup is sufficient and standard.
- Public page /companion/[token] in app: fetch context, choose response. Must not require auth (public route group). Need to ensure api client handles public calls without token.
- Anonymous response audit: CompanionResponse has created_at and value; audit log entry with user_id null? AuditLog requires user? Let me check AuditLog fields.

Need migration: alembic versions. Let me check migrations dir and how tables are created (probably Base.metadata.create_all on startup). Adding tables likely automatic if create_all runs; but check alembic.

from math import asin, cos, radians, sin, sqrt


def haversine_km(lat1: float, lon1: float, lat2: float, lon2: float) -> float:
    if not all(isinstance(v, (int, float)) for v in (lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2)):
        return 0.0
    r = 6371.0
    dlat = radians(lat2 - lat1)
    dlon = radians(lon2 - lon1)
    a = sin(dlat / 2) ** 2 + cos(radians(lat1)) * cos(radians(lat2)) * sin(dlon / 2) ** 2
    return round(2 * r * asin(sqrt(a)), 2)


def travel_minutes(distance_km: float) -> int:
    """Honest estimate, not a routed ETA.

    Urban trips assume 25 km/h door-to-door; longer hops assume 45 km/h.
    A 6 minute access overhead is added. The UI labels this as an estimate.
    """
    if distance_km <= 0:
        return 0
    speed = 25.0 if distance_km <= 10 else 45.0
    return int(round((distance_km / speed) * 60 + 6))


def day_minutes(hhmm: str) -> int:
    try:
        hours, minutes = hhmm.split(":")
        return int(hours) * 60 + int(minutes)
    except (ValueError, AttributeError):
        return 9 * 60


def minutes_to_hhmm(total: int) -> str:
    total = total % (24 * 60)
    return f"{total // 60:02d}:{total % 60:02d}"

@router.post("/trips/{trip_id}/places/{activity_id}/expectation")
def expectation_check(
    trip_id: str,
    activity_id: str,
    payload: ExpectationIn,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    activity = _activity_for_trip(db, trip, activity_id)
    return place_service.expectation_check(db, activity, payload.claim)


@router.get("/trips/{trip_id}/inspirations")
def list_inspirations(
    trip_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    rows = (
        db.query(SavedInspiration)
        .filter(
            SavedInspiration.trip_id == trip.id,
            SavedInspiration.user_id == user.id,
        )
        .order_by(SavedInspiration.created_at.desc())
        .all()
    )
    return {
        "items": [
            {
                "id": row.id,
                "source_type": row.source_type,
                "content": row.content,
                "status": row.status,
                "extracted": row.extracted or {},
                "created_at": row.created_at,
            }
            for row in rows
        ]
    }


@router.post("/trips/{trip_id}/inspirations", status_code=201)
def import_inspiration(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: InspirationIn,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    if payload.trip_id and payload.trip_id != trip.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Trip mismatch")
    inspiration = SavedInspiration(
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
        source_type=payload.source_type,
        content=payload.content,
        status="pending",
    )
    db.add(inspiration)
    db.flush()
    extraction = discovery_service.dream_import(db, user.id, inspiration)
    inspiration.status = "extracted"
    audit(
        db,
        action="inspiration.import",
        entity_type="saved_inspiration",
        entity_id=inspiration.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
        detail={"source_type": payload.source_type},
    )
    db.commit()
    return {
        "id": inspiration.id,
        "source_type": inspiration.source_type,
        "status": inspiration.status,
        "extraction": extraction,
        "disclosure": (
            "Candidates are suggestions only. Confirm them before adding anything to the itinerary."
        ),
    }


def _blocked_ids(db: Session, user_id: str) -> set[str]:
    rows = (
        db.query(UserBlock)
        .filter((UserBlock.blocker_id == user_id) | (UserBlock.blocked_id == user_id))
        .all()
    )
    blocked: set[str] = set()
    for row in rows:
        blocked.add(row.blocker_id)
        blocked.add(row.blocked_id)
    blocked.discard(user_id)

    db: Session,
    destination: Destination,
    place: Place,
    *,
    name: str,
    description: str,
    tags: list[str],
    price: float,
    duration: int,
    effort: int,
    indoor: bool,
    wheelchair: bool | None,
    iconic: bool,
    popularity: float,
    opening_hours: dict | None = None,
    access_chain: dict | None = None,
    verified_days_ago: int | None = None,
    fragile: bool = False,
) -> Activity:
    activity = Activity(
        place_id=place.id,
        destination_id=destination.id,
        name=name,
        description=description,
        tags=tags,
        price_estimate=price,
        currency="EUR",

        last_verified_at=_ago(verified_days_ago) if verified_days_ago is not None else None,
    )
    db.add(activity)

    return activity

1	export const API_URL =
2	  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL?.replace(/\/$/, "") || "http://localhost:8000";
3	
4	export class ApiError extends Error {
5	  status: number;
6	  detail: unknown;
7	
8	  constructor(status: number, detail: unknown) {
9	    const message =
10	      typeof detail === "string"
11	        ? detail
12	        : Array.isArray(detail)
13	          ? detail
14	              .map((item) =>
15	                typeof item === "object" && item && "msg" in item
16	                  ? String((item as { msg: unknown }).msg)
17	                  : String(item),
18	              )
19	              .join(" · ")
20	          : detail && typeof detail === "object" && "message" in detail
21	            ? String((detail as { message: unknown }).message)
22	            : `Request failed (${status})`;
23	    super(message);
24	    this.name = "ApiError";
25	    this.status = status;
26	    this.detail = detail;
27	  }
28	}
29	
30	export function tokenFromStore(): string | null {
31	  if (typeof window === "undefined") return null;
32	  try {
33	    const raw = window.localStorage.getItem("safar-auth");
34	    if (!raw) return null;
35	    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as { state?: { token?: string | null } };
36	    return parsed.state?.token || null;
37	  } catch {
38	    return null;
39	  }
40	}
41	
42	type Options = Omit<RequestInit, "body"> & { body?: unknown; raw?: boolean };
43	
44	export async function api<T>(path: string, options: Options = {}): Promise<T> {
45	  const token = tokenFromStore();
46	  const headers = new Headers(options.headers);
47	  if (options.body !== undefined && !(options.body instanceof FormData)) {
48	    headers.set("Content-Type", "application/json");
49	  }
50	  headers.set("Accept", "application/json");
51	  if (token) headers.set("Authorization", `Bearer ${token}`);
52	
53	  const response = await fetch(`${API_URL}${path}`, {
54	    ...options,
55	    headers,
56	    body:
57	      options.body === undefined
58	        ? undefined
59	        : options.body instanceof FormData
60	          ? options.body
61	          : JSON.stringify(options.body),
62	    cache: "no-store",
63	  });
64	
65	  if (response.status === 401 && typeof window !== "undefined") {
66	    window.dispatchEvent(new Event("safar:unauthorized"));
67	  }
68	
69	  if (!response.ok) {
70	    let detail: unknown = response.statusText;
71	    try {
72	      const data = await response.json();
73	      detail = data.detail ?? data;
74	    } catch {
75	      try {
76	        detail = await response.text();
77	      } catch {
78	        /* ignore */
79	      }
80	    }
81	    throw new ApiError(response.status, detail);
82	  }
83	
84	  if (response.status === 204) return undefined as T;
85	  const contentType = response.headers.get("content-type") || "";
86	  if (options.raw || contentType.includes("text/html") || contentType.includes("text/csv")) {
87	    return (await response.text()) as T;
88	  }
89	  return (await response.json()) as T;
90	}
91	
92	export function wsUrl(tripId: string): string | null {
93	  const token = tokenFromStore();
94	  if (!token) return null;
95	  const base = API_URL.replace(/^http/, "ws");
96	  return `${base}/ws/trips/${tripId}?token=${encodeURIComponent(token)}`;
97	}

Migrations target the same DATABASE_URL the API uses, so SQLite works for
local development and PostgreSQL/Supabase works in production. SQLite cannot

target_metadata = Base.metadata

`clock(db, trip, member, on: date, now: datetime | None)`:
- Determine whether `on` is within trip dates.
- Gather confirmed items for `on`, ordered by start; each with start/end minutes (end_time or start+duration).
- Free windows: from day start 08:00 (or earliest item) to 22:00, excluding confirmed item spans (+ travel buffer 15?). Actually use confirmed items only.
- Candidate activities: activities for trip.destination_id; exclude ones already confirmed on that day. If no destination → return `available: False, reason`.
- For each activity:
  - hours = activity.opening_hours.get(weekday); weekday key from date: mon..sun.
  - status:
    - if no hours or unknown → `unknown`, feasibility None.
    - if closed → `closed`, next_window None.
    - else compute window intersection with free windows and opening window.
  - travel from base (trip.base_lat/lon) using haversine + travel_minutes; need duration + travel ≤ window length.
  - `feasible_now`: if today and current time within opening and fits in remaining window; else next feasible start.
  - Output: activity id/name/duration/price, opening_hours_today, is_open_now, fits_now (bool|null), next_start, free_window_minutes, travel_minutes, status, explanation, provenance "ESTIMATED" for travel, "REPORTED" for hours? Use `ESTIMATED` for travel, `REPORTED` for hours.
  - Sort: open_now first, then next_start.
- Summary: count of open now, count fitting; explanation text.
- Include `disclosure` stating deterministic estimate, not live opening status; `plan_unchanged: True`.

For "signed", I can include HMAC using SECRET_KEY: token = base64url(payload).signature where payload = link id + expiry? But DB stores hash anyway. Simpler and robust: opaque random token, stored SHA-256; docs can call it "signed (HMAC-sealed)" only if actually HMAC. Let's make it truly signed and single-purpose without needing DB lookup by id? We can make token = `linkid.expiry.hmac` using SECRET_KEY, so verification does not require storing token at all. But DB lookup by id + HMAC verification + expiry check is elegant:
- token payload: `{link_id}.{expires_ts}` + HMAC-SHA256 over f"{link_id}.{expires_ts}.{purpose}.{target_id}" truncated 32 chars.
- GET: parse, recompute HMAC with SECRET_KEY, then load link by id, check not revoked, expiry, uses.
- No token_hash storage needed! But if SECRET_KEY rotates, all links invalidate — acceptable and arguably good.
- However deployment SECRET_KEY is stable. Tests use test secret.
- Replay resistance: each link single-use anyway.

But token in URL path with dots is fine. Use base64url? IDs are hex 32 and expiry unix int; token format `{id}.{exp}.{sig}` works in path with `/api/companion/{token}` and dots are path-safe.

2	
3	Trip media is private by default. Files are only served with a short-lived
4	HMAC signature that is issued to authenticated trip members through API

16	MEDIA_TTL_SECONDS = 12 * 60 * 60

18	
19	def _signature(path: str, expires: int) -> str:
20	    message = f"{path}:{expires}".encode("utf-8")
21	    return hmac.new(
22	        settings.secret_key.encode("utf-8"), message, hashlib.sha256
23	    ).hexdigest()
24

26	def canonical_media_url(url: str | None) -> str | None:
27	    """Strip any signature so only the stored path is persisted."""
28	    if not url or not url.startswith("/media/"):
29	        return url
30	    parts = urlsplit(url)
31	    return urlunsplit((parts.scheme, parts.netloc, parts.path, "", ""))
32	
33	
34	def sign_media_url(url: str | None, ttl: int = MEDIA_TTL_SECONDS) -> str | None:
35	    if not url or not url.startswith("/media/"):
36	        return url
37	    path = canonical_media_url(url)
38	    assert path is not None
39	    expires = int(time.time()) + ttl
40	    separator = "&" if "?" in path else "?"
41	    return f"{path}{separator}exp={expires}&sig={_signature(path, expires)}"
42	
43	
44	def verify_media_request(path: str, query: dict[str, str]) -> bool:
45	    try:
46	        expires = int(query.get("exp", "0"))
47	    except ValueError:
48	        return False
49	    signature = query.get("sig", "")
50	    if not signature or expires < int(time.time()):
51	        return False
52	    return hmac.compare_digest(signature, _signature(path, expires))

interface Toast {
  id: number;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  tone: "success" | "error" | "info";
}

interface ToastState {
  toasts: Toast[];
  push: (title: string, description?: string, tone?: Toast["tone"]) => void;
  dismiss: (id: number) => void;
}

export const useToasts = create<ToastState>((set) => ({
  toasts: [],
  push: (title, description, tone = "info") => {
    const id = Date.now() + Math.random();
    set((state) => ({ toasts: [...state.toasts, { id, title, description, tone }] }));
    if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
      window.setTimeout(() => {
        set((state) => ({ toasts: state.toasts.filter((toast) => toast.id !== id) }));
      }, 4200);
    }
  },
  dismiss: (id) =>
    set((state) => ({ toasts: state.toasts.filter((toast) => toast.id !== id) })),
}));

"""Regression tests for issues found in the deep audit.

Each test pins one previously broken rule so it cannot regress silently.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import uuid
from datetime import date
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

from app.services.engine import MemberContext, rank_activity


def _register(client, email: str) -> dict[str, str]:
    response = client.post(
        "/api/auth/register",
        json={
            "email": email,
            "password": "audit-pass-123",
            "display_name": "Audit Probe",
        },
    )
    assert response.status_code == 201, response.text
    return {"Authorization": f"Bearer {response.json()['access_token']}"}


def test_invitation_is_single_use_and_email_bound(client, mira, kyoto):
    trip_id = kyoto["id"]
    created = client.post(
        f"/api/trips/{trip_id}/invitations",
        headers=mira,
        json={"email": None, "role": "member", "scope": "full"},
    )
    assert created.status_code == 201, created.text
    token = created.json()["token"]

    first = _register(client, f"first-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}@example.com")
    assert client.post(f"/api/invitations/{token}/accept", headers=first).status_code == 200

    second = _register(client, f"second-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}@example.com")
    reused = client.post(f"/api/invitations/{token}/accept", headers=second)
    assert reused.status_code == 409, reused.text

    bound_email = f"bound-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}@example.com"
    bound = client.post(
        f"/api/trips/{trip_id}/invitations",
        headers=mira,
        json={"email": bound_email, "role": "member", "scope": "full"},
    )
    assert bound.status_code == 201, bound.text
    bound_token = bound.json()["token"]

    wrong = _register(client, f"wrong-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}@example.com")
    assert (
        client.post(f"/api/invitations/{bound_token}/accept", headers=wrong).status_code
        == 403
    )

def test_all_three_engine_modes_explain_and_never_mutate(client, mira, kyoto):
    trip_id = kyoto["id"]
    before = client.get(f"/api/trips/{trip_id}/itinerary", headers=mira).json()

    for mode, marker in (
        ("everyone_wins", "everyone wins pick"),
        ("your_turn", "your turn pick"),
        ("surprise_us", "surprise us pick"),
    ):
        response = client.post(
            f"/api/trips/{trip_id}/engine/recommend",
            headers=mira,
            json={"mode": mode, "for_date": kyoto["start_date"], "limit": 5},
        )
        assert response.status_code == 201, response.text
        batch = response.json()
        assert batch["mode"] == mode
        assert batch["meta"]["model_version"] == "safar-group-engine-1.0"
        assert batch["meta"]["hard_constraints"]
        assert "estimates" in batch["meta"]["disclosure"]
        assert batch["items"], f"{mode} returned no recommendations"
        assert marker in batch["items"][0]["explanation"]["summary"]
        assert batch["items"][0]["explanation"]["uncertainties"] is not None
        assert batch["items"][0]["fairness_spread"] is not None
        assert batch["items"][0]["status"] == "suggested"
        assert "/" in batch["meta"]["pulse_coverage"]
        assert "clarifying_question" in batch["meta"]

    after = client.get(f"/api/trips/{trip_id}/itinerary", headers=mira).json()
    assert after["confirmed_version"] == before["confirmed_version"]
    assert [item["id"] for item in after["items"]] == [item["id"] for item in before["items"]]

def test_trip_twin_compares_read_only_and_adoption_becomes_a_proposal(client, mira, kyoto):
    trip_id = kyoto["id"]
    before = client.get(f"/api/trips/{trip_id}/itinerary", headers=mira).json()

    batch = client.post(
        f"/api/trips/{trip_id}/engine/recommend",
        headers=mira,
        json={"mode": "everyone_wins", "for_date": kyoto["start_date"], "limit": 4},
    ).json()
    alternatives = [item["activity"]["id"] for item in batch["items"][:2]]
    assert len(alternatives) == 2

    comparison = client.post(
        f"/api/trips/{trip_id}/twin/compare",
        headers=mira,
        json={"activity_ids": alternatives, "day": kyoto["start_date"]},
    )
    assert comparison.status_code == 200, comparison.text
    body = comparison.json()
    assert body["requires_approval"] is True
    assert "read-only" in body["disclosure"]
    assert body["alternative_plan"]["items"]

    unchanged = client.get(f"/api/trips/{trip_id}/itinerary", headers=mira).json()
    assert unchanged["confirmed_version"] == before["confirmed_version"]

    adoption = client.post(
        f"/api/trips/{trip_id}/twin/propose",
        headers=mira,
        json={"activity_ids": alternatives, "day": kyoto["start_date"]},
    )
    assert adoption.status_code == 201, adoption.text
    assert adoption.json()["kind"] == "twin_adopt"

export function useOpportunityClock(tripId: string | undefined, on?: string) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ["opportunity-clock", tripId, on || "auto"],
    queryFn: () =>
      api<OpportunityClock>(
        `/api/trips/${tripId}/opportunity-clock${on ? `?on=${encodeURIComponent(on)}` : ""}`,
      ),
    enabled: Boolean(tripId),
  });
}

export function useCompanionLinks(tripId: string | undefined) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ["companion-links", tripId],
    queryFn: () =>
      api<{ items: CompanionLink[]; disclosure: string }>(
        `/api/trips/${tripId}/companion-links`,
      ),
    enabled: Boolean(tripId),
  });
}

#### Thinking

Page renders. But there's a logic bug: for today at 18:48, several items show "Window passed" with explanation "Open 10:00–17:00, but today's remaining free gaps are too short." Yet free window 13:15–22:00 exists and opening 10–17; now=18:48, so the intersection 13:15–17:00 passed; no upcoming feasible. Explanation "free gaps too short" is inaccurate — the real reason is the window has passed. The `no_window` branch is used when `feasible` (full day) is empty, but here feasible exists (13:15–17:00 fits) and upcoming is empty → `window_missed` status with explanation "remaining free gaps are too short", which is wrong. We set status `window_missed` but explanation says too short. Fix explanation for window_missed: "Open 10:00–17:00, but that window has already closed for today." That's accurate.

Also, for 24-hour activities at 18:48, "open_now" is fine.

Another issue: "Window passed" items sorted after open. Fine.

Also note "5 option(s) fit right now and 0 fit later today." consistent.

Fix explanation.

Also for `no_window` case with now later than opening, could report "window passed" rather than no gap. But no_window only when feasible empty (window too short all day), which is accurate.

Update service.

The page renders correctly, but one explanation is inaccurate when a window has already closed. Fixing that wording.

119	| Invitation tokens were reusable and not bound to the invited email | An intercepted link let any account join the trip | accept returns 409 after first use and 403 for a different email; preview reports `accepted_by_you` |
120	| `/media/...` was served unauthenticated to anyone who guessed a path | Private trip media could leak | HMAC-signed URLs with 12 h expiry; unsigned/tampered requests 403 |
121	| Memory Studio events leaked metadata of private memories | Other members saw event titles/dates referencing hidden memories | `visible_events()` filters events unless every referenced memory is visible (studio and replay) |
122	| Default budget comfort was treated as a hard budget cap | Members who never stated a limit silently lost affordable results | only a stated `budget_limit` filters; comfort is a soft preference used for ranking |
123	| Expense currency was required | Expenses failed when the trip currency should apply | currency defaults to the trip's currency |
124	| Completed-trip next action linked to a non-existent route | Dead link from the dashboard | links to `/trips/{id}/memories/replay` |

147	## 5. Security and privacy review
148	
149	* All mutating trip routes resolve membership and role before acting. A
150	  non-member receives 404 on every trip-scoped route (verified live).
151	* Private member fields are omitted by serializers, not just concealed.
152	* Proposal approval re-checks pact and per-member hard budget; conflicts 409
153	  without revealing amounts.
154	* JWT verified on every request and on the WebSocket handshake; inactive,
155	  deleted and non-member users are rejected before `accept`.
156	* Deletion anonymises profile, memories, notifications, blocks and email, and
157	  revokes the existing token (test).
158	* Admin endpoints require `is_admin`; a normal user gets 403 (test).
159	* Rate limiting middleware applies per client; CORS is an explicit allow-list.
160	* Media upload validates MIME type and size; reads require a valid HMAC
161	  signature and expire after 12 h.
162	* No secret is read by the client bundle; only `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL` is public.
163	  `OPENAI_API_KEY` exists but no service uses it; health reports `external_ai: false`.
164	* Audit rows are written for approvals, verification, blocks, joins and
165	  moderation.
166	* Remaining gaps: no email verification/password reset (no mail provider), no
167	  RLS SQL policies, no APM/error monitoring, JWT in `localStorage` (XSS
168	  exposure), no CSRF token (header token mitigates).

231	## 7. AI/ML authenticity audit
232	
233	| Component | What it actually is | External AI? | Honesty controls |
234	|---|---|---|---|
235	| Group Experience Engine | Deterministic weighted scoring over curated attributes, member DNA, pulse, budget and distance; explicit hard filters | No | `model_version`, ranking formula, excluded count, uncertainties, disclosure that travel times are estimates |
236	| Everyone Wins / Your Turn / Surprise Us | Three weightings of the same deterministic ranker | No | Mode label and explanation prefix match the actual mode |
237	| Trip Twin / Rescue / Domino / Fragility / Effort | Deterministic comparisons and heuristics over catalog + itinerary | No | Every output says comparison-only or proposal-only; estimates labelled |
238	| Assistant / multilingual answers | Grounded retrieval over trip and catalog rows with citations | No | `external_ai: false`; limitations and “translation not configured” notes |
239	| Memory Studio captions | Template composition from memory metadata | No | Drafts require approval; no generated claims |
240	| Dream import | Keyword/tag matching against destinations and activities | No | Image/link understanding explicitly reported as not configured |
241	| Crowd forecast | Bucket mean over timestamped reports | No | Requires ≥8 reports; otherwise `insufficient_data` with the latest observation |
242	| Journey DNA | Explicit edits plus consented sentiment deltas | No | Feedback changes DNA only with feedback + personalisation consent |
243	
244	Data honesty: the catalog is curated seed data labelled `ESTIMATED` unless a
245	verified source exists; community input is labelled `REPORTED (unverified)`;
246	demo accounts and trips are seeded demo data, not presented as production
247	activity. No advertised AI capability is static or hardcoded to fake a result,
248	and no endpoint invents a response when inputs are missing (engine returns 422,
249	forecast returns `insufficient_data`, assistant states unknowns).

272	
273	Strengths: one shared design system (`Card`, `Button`, `Badge`, `ErrorState`,
274	`PageSkeleton`, `FlowNote`), consistent editorial typography and colour tokens,
275	route-level loading skeletons, empty states, human-readable error states with
276	retry, responsive navigation with a bottom bar on small screens, and progressive
277	disclosure through the “More” hub instead of an overloaded header.
278	
279	Improvements made in this pass: skip-to-content link, `main` landmark id, and a
280	polite live region for toasts.
281	
282	Remaining P3 suggestions: raise 11 px metadata text to at least 12 px for
283	legibility; add an automated axe/Playwright accessibility pass; consider an
284	`alert` live region specifically for destructive errors; capture visual
285	regression screenshots once a real browser viewport is available.
286	
287	No unnecessary redesign was performed. Existing working screens were preserved.
288	
289	## 10. Honest status summary
290	
291	* **COMPLETE: 43 features.** F01–F16, F18–F20, F23, F25, F27–F38, F40–F49.
292	* **PARTIAL: 4 features.** F17 (keyword-only import), F21 (needs ≥8 reports),
293	  F22 (English-only answers), F39 (protected items without a dedicated wizard).
294	* **NOT IMPLEMENTED: 2 features.** F24 Opportunity Clock, F26 One-Link
295	  Companion. Neither is claimed anywhere in the UI.
296	* Every partial/missing capability is labelled in the UI or documented; none is
297	  faked.
298	* Docker configuration is provided but was not built here (Docker unavailable).
299	
300	See `docs/FEATURE_REGISTRY.md` for the per-feature evidence table.
301	
302	## 11. Remaining external dependencies (intentionally absent)
303	
304	| Dependency | Effect | Product behaviour |
305	|---|---|---|
306	| LLM provider | No generative answers/captions | Deterministic retrieval; template captions with approval |
307	| Weather API | No real forecast | Assistant/rescue state weather is unknown; rescue is user-driven |
308	| Translation service | No translated answers | Locale stored; answers English with explicit note |
309	| Live routing/traffic | No routed ETAs | Travel times are estimates, always labelled |
310	| Live availability/ticketing | No booking | Curated catalog labelled `ESTIMATED` unless verified |
311	| Object storage | Media on local disk | Type/size validation; signed, expiring URLs |
312	| Email/SMS delivery | No outbound messages | Invitations are shareable links; in-app notifications only |
313	
314	## 12. Recommended next steps
315	
316	1. Implement F24 (Opportunity Clock) as a service over activity hours and
317	   departure windows, surfacing feasibility through the engine's travel
318	   estimates.
319	2. Implement F26 (One-Link Companion) with signed, single-purpose, expiring
320	   tokens scoped to one vote or check-in, plus an anonymous response audit.
321	3. Add external providers behind the existing service interfaces: weather for
322	   rescue and assistant, translation for F22, object storage for media.
323	4. Add Sentry/APM, structured JSON logging and a backup/restore runbook.
324	5. Add Playwright end-to-end tests (including offline and visual regression).
325	6. Ship RLS policies for Supabase and review them with the application-level
326	   checks as defence in depth.
327	7. Move the JWT out of `localStorage` (httpOnly cookie + CSRF token) if the
328	   deployment’s XSS posture requires it.
329	
330	See `docs/FEATURE_REGISTRY.md` for the per-feature registry and the deep-audit
331	addendum.

150	## 5. Data model
151	
152	52 tables grouped by domain:
153	
154	* **Identity & consent** — users, profiles, user_preferences, journey_dna,
155	  consent_records, blocks, notifications, audit_logs
156	* **Trips** — trips, trip_members, trip_invitations, journey_pacts,
157	  planner_tasks, trip_branches, material_watch, journey_capsules
158	* **Catalog** — destinations, places, activities, place_sources, place_reports
159	* **Planning** — itinerary_items, itinerary_versions, itinerary_proposals,
160	  activity_votes, itinerary_attendance, shadowplans
161	* **Intelligence** — recommendation_batches, recommendations,
162	  recommendation_feedback, activity_feedback
163	* **Pulse & ground** — trip_pulse, ground_requests, ground_responses
164	* **Money** — expenses, expense_participants, expense_settlements
165	* **Memory** — trip_memories, media_assets, memory_events, memory_permissions
166	* **Social** — travel_circles, circle_members, circle_posts,
167	  local_contributors, connection_requests, saved_inspiration
168	* **Offline** — offline_sync_queue (client-generated ids; replaying the same
169	  entry returns the stored status instead of creating duplicates, and a reused
170	  client id with different content is rejected)
171	
172	Coordinates are stored as `lat`/`lon` floats and distances use the haversine
173	formula. PostGIS is available in the compose database image but no geometry
174	columns are used yet; this is a documented limitation, not a hidden claim.
175	
176	Migrations: `services/api/migrations` (Alembic, one baseline revision,
177	`alembic check` clean). Development and tests use `create_all`; production uses
178	`alembic upgrade head`.

182	## 6. Real time
183	
184	`core/realtime.py` keeps an in-process connection manager. Clients connect to
185	`/ws/trips/{trip_id}?token=…`; the token is verified and membership re-checked
186	before acceptance. Writers (proposals, votes, itinerary changes, expenses,
187	memories, pulse updates) publish events; `lib/realtime.ts` invalidates the
188	matching TanStack Query keys, so open screens refresh without polling.

## SAFAR — Implementation Fix & Stabilisation Report

### 1. Issues identified → fixed

| Priority | Issue | Fix | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| P3 | Metadata text at 11/11.5 px was hard to read | Raised `.eyebrow` and inline labels to 12 px in [globals.css](file:///C:/Users/siddharth/Documents/Qoder/2026-11-19/7c4196d9/apps/web/app/globals.css) | `tsc`, production build, browser |
| P3 | Error toasts were only polite announcements | Each toast now gets `role="alert"` for errors, `role="status"` otherwise, inside the labelled live region in [ui.tsx](file:///C:/Users/siddharth/Documents/Qoder/2026-11-19/7c4196d9/apps/web/components/ui.tsx) | browser DOM check |
| P2 | Dream import used raw substring matching (false positives on links/words) | Structural parsing in [discovery.py](file:///C:/Users/siddharth/Documents/Qoder/2026-11-19/7c4196d9/services/api/app/services/discovery.py): word-boundary phrases, URL text stripped before entity matching, link-path matches, hashtags, currency budgets, travel windows | `test_inspiration_import_parses_structure_and_avoids_false_positives` |
| P2 / missing | F24 Opportunity Clock did not exist | New read-only [opportunity.py](file:///C:/Users/siddharth/Documents/Qoder/2026-11-19/7c4196d9/services/api/app/services/opportunity.py), [router](file:///C:/Users/siddharth/Documents/Qoder/2026-11-19/7c4196d9/services/api/app/routers/opportunity.py), [page](file:///C:/Users/siddharth/Documents/Qoder/2026-11-19/7c4196d9/apps/web/app/(app)/trips/[tripId]/opportunity/page.tsx) | test, live API (16 candidates / 5 open now), browser |
| P2 / missing | F26 One-Link Companion did not exist | Signed, scoped, single-use, expiring links with anonymous responses: [service](file:///C:/Users/siddharth/Documents/Qoder/2026-11-19/7c4196d9/services/api/app/services/companion.py), [routers](file:///C:/Users/siddharth/Documents/Qoder/2026-11-19/7c4196d9/services/api/app/routers/companion.py), [migration](file:///C:/Users/siddharth/Documents/Qoder/2026-11-19/7c4196d9/services/api/migrations/versions/b1f6c2d84e71_companion_links.py), [organiser page](file:///C:/Users/siddharth/Documents/Qoder/2026-11-19/7c4196d9/apps/web/app/(app)/trips/[tripId]/companion/page.tsx), [public page](file:///C:/Users/siddharth/Documents/Qoder/2026-11-19/7c4196d9/apps/web/app/companion/[token]/page.tsx) | two tests, live create/respond/reuse, browser answer + success + 410 + 404 |

### 2. Features successfully tested (this pass)

- **F17**: pasted text produces structured candidates; link paths, hashtags and budgets parse; a destination name inside an unrelated URL no longer false-matches.
- **F24**: date-bounded page; open/closed/unknown/passed states; free gaps and travel estimates; correct “window has already closed for today” copy; explicit read-only disclosure; no itinerary mutation.
- **F26 organiser**: create link, one-time URL, list with used/revoked status, revoke.
- **F26 recipient (anonymous)**: select answer → submit → “Answer recorded” screen; reuse → friendly 410 page; tampered token → friendly 404 page; no account anywhere.
- **Navigation**: both features reachable from trip “More” with correct links.

### 3. Automated and infrastructure verification

```
services/api$ python -m pytest -q        → 36 passed
apps/web$ npx vitest run                 → 12 passed (2 files)
apps/web$ npx tsc --noEmit               → clean
apps/web$ npm run build (API_URL=8010)   → exit 0

```

API `127.0.0.1:8010` and production web build `localhost:3010` were left running.

### 4. Security and database verification

- Companion tokens are HMAC-SHA256 signed (`{link_id}.{expiry}.{sig}`), scoped to one vote/check-in, single-use, revocable, TTL 5 min–7 days.
- Public context never returns member identity, private preferences or budgets.
- `companion_responses` has only `id, link_id, value, comment, created_at` — no user id, IP or user agent.
- Companion audit rows were confirmed to carry `user_id = NULL`.
- Invalid/tampered → 404, expired/revoked/used → 410, closed target → 409, invalid value → 422.
- Opportunity Clock performs no writes and reports `plan_unchanged: true` with the confirmed version.
- No new secrets; only `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL` is public; `external_ai` remains `false`.

### 5. Mock data and AI/ML honesty

- The catalog remains curated seed data labelled `ESTIMATED`; community input is `REPORTED (unverified)`; demo accounts/trips are seeded demo data.
- No feature was moved to mock data. F24 and F26 use real database rows and real computation.
- AI/ML is unchanged: deterministic engine `safar-group-engine-1.0`, grounded retrieval assistant, rule-based DNA and forecasts. No LLM, no invented responses, no hardcoded results.

### 6. Unresolved / honestly partial

- **F17** — still no OCR, image understanding or link fetching; the UI states this.
- **F21** — crowd forecast still needs ≥8 reports, otherwise returns `insufficient_data`.
- **F22** — answers remain English-only; locale is stored with an explicit note.
- **F39** — protected items work, but there is no dedicated “reserve free time” wizard.
- No external providers (weather, translation, storage, email), no RLS policies, no APM, `localStorage` JWT, Docker not built here, and the offline service-worker shell was not exercised offline.

- [FEATURE_REGISTRY.md](file:///C:/Users/siddharth/Documents/Qoder/2026-11-19/7c4196d9/docs/FEATURE_REGISTRY.md): F17/F24/F26, counts now **45 implemented / 4 partial / 0 not implemented**, plus a stabilisation addendum.

- [ARCHITECTURE.md](file:///C:/Users/siddharth/Documents/Qoder/2026-11-19/7c4196d9/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): 54 tables, companion tables and the new migration revision.

# SAFAR — Phase 3: Complete Feature Validation & Integration Testing

You have completed the initial audit and implementation stabilisation of SAFAR.

The current FEATURE_REGISTRY.md reports:
- 45 implemented features
- 4 partially implemented features
- 0 unimplemented features

Your next responsibility is to conduct a comprehensive feature-by-feature validation of the entire SAFAR application.

IMPORTANT: Do not start adding new features or redesigning the application. This phase is strictly for validation, integration testing and identifying functional gaps.

## 1. Validate all 49 features

Read the complete FEATURE_REGISTRY.md and relevant project documentation.

For every feature from F01 to F49:

- Understand its intended purpose.
- Identify its frontend implementation.
- Identify its backend implementation.
- Identify its database dependencies.
- Test the actual user workflow.
- Verify that data is saved and retrieved correctly.
- Test invalid inputs and edge cases.
- Verify permissions and privacy boundaries.
- Check loading, empty, success and failure states.
- Verify that the feature works with related SAFAR features.

Do not mark a feature as working just because its page or button exists.

## 2. Test complete user journeys

Test realistic workflows across the application.

### Journey A — Individual traveller
Discover a destination → explore places → create a trip → generate a plan → customise the itinerary → save memories.

### Journey B — Group travel
Create a group → invite members → collect preferences → use the Group Experience Engine → evaluate Everyone Wins, Your Turn and Surprise Us → finalise a shared itinerary.

### Journey C — Trip management
Create an itinerary → modify activities → manage expenses → track changes → use Trip Rescue → verify that updates persist correctly.

### Journey D — During travel
Use the trip interface → check available opportunities → capture experiences → use relevant offline capabilities → verify that data synchronises correctly when connectivity returns.

### Journey E — Post-trip experience
Upload memories → organise them → use Memory Constellation → generate Journey Replay → verify that privacy settings are respected.

These are testing scenarios, not permission to invent missing functionality. Follow the actual product specifications.

## 3. Test feature integrations

Pay particular attention to interactions between:

- Journey DNA and recommendations.
- Group preferences and the Group Experience Engine.
- Trip Twin and itinerary updates.
- Trip Rescue and itinerary constraints.
- Place Pulse and destination discovery.
- Memory Constellation and Journey Replay.
- Group expenses and trip members.
- Travel Circles and social connections.
- Opportunity Clock and existing itinerary data.
- One-Link Companion and group participation.

Verify that information flows correctly between these systems.

## 4. Validate the four partially implemented features

Investigate F17, F21, F22 and F39 individually.

For each one:
- Identify exactly what is complete.
- Identify exactly what is missing.
- Determine what is needed to finish it.
- Check whether the missing functionality is essential to its intended purpose.
- Recommend a realistic implementation approach.

Do not silently change their status to implemented.

## 5. Test reliability

Test:
- Empty database scenarios.
- New user accounts.
- Multiple users accessing the same group trip.
- Concurrent itinerary updates.
- Invalid and expired invitations.
- Network failures.
- API failures.
- Duplicate submissions.
- Session expiry.
- Large datasets where practical.

Check for broken navigation, inconsistent data and unexpected application crashes.

## 6. Produce an evidence-based report

Update AUDIT.md and FEATURE_REGISTRY.md.

For each F01–F49, report:

| Field | Required information |
|---|---|
| Feature | F01–F49 |
| Status | Implemented / Partial / Not implemented |
| Frontend | Verified or not |
| Backend | Verified or not |
| Database | Verified or not |
| Integration | Verified or not |
| Tests | Passing / Failing / Not tested |
| Issues | Exact remaining problems |

Separate verified functionality from assumptions.

## 7. Final output

Provide:
1. Overall feature validation results.
2. A complete F01–F49 status table.
3. User journeys successfully tested.
4. Integration failures.
5. Features that need further implementation.
6. Critical bugs and their severity.
7. Recommended next development phase.

Do not add unnecessary features. Do not use mock data to pass tests. Do not claim successful testing without evidence.

The objective is to establish whether SAFAR works as one complete, integrated travel platform.

#### Thinking

Important: tests mutate persistent state of the *shared seeded test DB* within a session (e.g., DNA food=10 for aiko, pulse, votes, expenses, proposals). That's fine for tests but it means my live DB has leftover state. The live dev DB has been used for smoke tests. For validation I should ideally use a fresh seeded DB so results are deterministic and I can exercise mutations without affecting the running demo. But the running API uses safar.db. I can spin up a second API on port 8011 with a fresh temp DB seeded (SAFAR_SEED=1) and run validation there, leaving the demo DB untouched. That's the cleanest: an isolated validation environment.

But the frontend is built pointing at 8010. For browser tests, I'll keep using 8010. Backend validation can run on 8011 with fresh DB. However, mutations through 8011 won't affect browser demo. Good.

Actually, for integration validation, backend on 8011 is enough. Browser is for frontend verified/not.

Let me create a fresh validation DB and start API on 8011. Need `SAFAR_SEED=1` and `ENVIRONMENT=test`? ENVIRONMENT=test may alter create_all behavior. main.py: create_all skipped in production only. Use ENVIRONMENT=development, SAFAR_SEED=1. But auto_seed maybe seeds if empty. Let me check main.py startup quickly.

"""SAFAR API entrypoint."""

import re
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
from pathlib import Path

from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, Request
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from fastapi.middleware.gzip import GZipMiddleware
from fastapi.responses import FileResponse
from sqlalchemy import text

from app.core.config import settings
from app.core.ratelimit import RateLimitMiddleware
from app.db.session import Base, SessionLocal, engine
from app.services.media import verify_media_request
from app.routers import (
    admin,
    assistant,
    auth,
    companion,
    engine as engine_router,
    expenses,
    itinerary,
    memories,
    opportunity,
    places,
    pulse,
    trips,
    users,
    ws,
)

MEDIA_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "storage"


@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
    # Development and tests let SQLAlchemy create the schema. Production must
    # run `alembic upgrade head` first so schema changes are versioned.
    if not settings.is_production:
        Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
    MEDIA_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if settings.auto_seed:
        from app.seed import seed_if_needed

        db = SessionLocal()
        try:
            seed_if_needed(db)
        finally:
            db.close()
    yield


app = FastAPI(
    title="SAFAR API",
    description=(
        "The Living Journey Network — journey intelligence, group decisions and shared memories. "
        "The engine recommends; the group decides."
    ),
    version="1.0.0",
    docs_url="/api/docs",
    redoc_url=None,
    openapi_url="/api/openapi.json",
    lifespan=lifespan,
)

app.add_middleware(

    allow_origins=settings.cors_origins,

)
app.add_middleware(GZipMiddleware, minimum_size=1024)

app.include_router(users.router)
app.include_router(trips.router)
app.include_router(trips.invitations_router)

app.include_router(memories.router)
app.include_router(assistant.router)
app.include_router(assistant.trip_router)
app.include_router(admin.router)
app.include_router(companion.router)
app.include_router(companion.public_router)
app.include_router(opportunity.router)
app.include_router(ws.router)

MEDIA_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
TRIP_ID_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^[0-9a-f]{32}$")
MEDIA_NAME_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$")


@app.get("/media/{trip_id}/{filename}")
def media_file(trip_id: str, filename: str, request: Request):
    """Serve trip media only with an unexpired HMAC signature."""
    if not TRIP_ID_PATTERN.match(trip_id) or not MEDIA_NAME_PATTERN.match(filename):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Media not found")
    path = f"/media/{trip_id}/{filename}"
    if not verify_media_request(path, dict(request.query_params)):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Media link is missing or expired")
    candidate = (MEDIA_DIR / trip_id / filename).resolve()
    if MEDIA_DIR.resolve() not in candidate.parents or not candidate.is_file():
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Media not found")
    return FileResponse(candidate)

import os
from pathlib import Path

from dotenv import load_dotenv

API_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
REPO_ROOT = API_DIR.parents[1]

load_dotenv(API_DIR / ".env")
load_dotenv(REPO_ROOT / ".env")


def _bool(name: str, default: bool) -> bool:
    raw = os.getenv(name)
    if raw is None:
        return default
    return raw.strip().lower() in {"1", "true", "yes", "on"}


class Settings:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        default_db = f"sqlite:///{(API_DIR / 'safar.db').as_posix()}"
        self.database_url: str = os.getenv("DATABASE_URL", default_db)
        self.environment: str = os.getenv("ENVIRONMENT", "development")
        default_secret = "safar-dev-secret-change-me-in-production"
        self.secret_key: str = os.getenv("SECRET_KEY", default_secret)
        if self.environment == "production" and (
            self.secret_key == default_secret or len(self.secret_key) < 32

**Input:**

```json
{
  "command": "cd /c/Users/siddharth/Documents/Qoder/2026-11-19/7c4196d9/services/api && ./.venv/Scripts/python.exe - <<'EOF'\nfrom app.main import app\ns=app.openapi()\ncomps=s.get('components',{}).get('schemas',{})\ndef resolve(ref):\n    return comps.get(ref.split('/')[-1],{})\nfor path,ops in sorted(s['paths'].items()):\n    for m in ('post','put','patch'):\n        if m not in ops: continue\n        op=ops[m]\n        rb=op.get('requestBody')\n        if not rb: \n            print(f\"{m.upper()} {op.get('operationId','?')} {path} :: no body\")\n            continue\n        content=rb.get('content',{})\n        sch=None\n        for ct,v in content.items():\n            sch=v.get('schema',{}); break\n        if '$ref' in sch: sch=resolve(sch['$ref'])\n        req=sch.get('required',[])\n        props=sch.get('properties',{})\n        def fmt(p):\n            t=p.get('type') or p.get('anyOf') or p.get('allOf') or p.get('$ref')\n            if isinstance(t,list):\n                t='|'.join(x.get('type','?') for x in t)\n            if p.get('type')=='array': t='array['+str((p.get('items') or {}).get('type') or (p.get('items') or {}).get('$ref','?'))+']'\n            return f\"{p.get('title','')}\" if False else str(t)\n        fields=', '.join(f\"{k}{'*' if k in req else ''}:{fmt(v)}\" for k,v in props.items())\n        print(f\"{m.upper()} {path} [{op.get('operationId')}] :: {fields}\")\nEOF",
  "description": "Dump mutation request schemas"
}
```

@router.put("/{trip_id}/pact")
def upsert_pact(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: PactUpsert,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user, {"owner", "admin"})
    pact = db.query(JourneyPact).filter(JourneyPact.trip_id == trip.id).first()
    if not pact:
        pact = JourneyPact(trip_id=trip.id, created_by=user.id)
        db.add(pact)
    pact.must_do = payload.must_do
    pact.flexible = payload.flexible
    # Individual limits are private. Merge rather than replace so an editor who
    # cannot see other members' limits never wipes them.
    merged_limits = dict(pact.individual_limits or {})
    merged_limits.update(payload.individual_limits or {})
    pact.individual_limits = merged_limits
    pact.confirmed_times = payload.confirmed_times
    pact.exceptions = payload.exceptions
    audit(
        db,
        action="pact.update",
        entity_type="journey_pact",
        entity_id=pact.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
    )
    db.commit()
    return {"ok": True}


@router.get("/{trip_id}/capsules")
def list_capsules(
    trip_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    rows = (
        db.query(JourneyCapsule)
        .filter(JourneyCapsule.trip_id == trip.id)
        .order_by(JourneyCapsule.created_at.desc())
        .limit(10)

def _pact_conflicts(db: Session, trip: Trip, operations: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
    pact = db.query(JourneyPact).filter(JourneyPact.trip_id == trip.id).first()
    if not pact:
        return []
    must_do = {str(title).strip().lower() for title in (pact.must_do or [])}
    exceptions = {str(title).strip().lower() for title in (pact.exceptions or [])}
    conflicts = []
    for operation in operations:
        if operation["op"] != "cancel":
            continue
        title = (operation.get("title") or "").strip().lower()
        if not title:
            continue
        for rule in must_do:
            if rule and (rule in title or title in rule):
                if any(exception in title or title in exception for exception in exceptions):
                    continue
                conflicts.append(
                    {
                        "item": operation["title"],
                        "rule": "Agreed must-do activity (Journey Pact)",
                        "resolution": "Add a Journey Pact exception or keep the item.",
                    }
                )
    return conflicts


def _proposal_impact(db: Session, trip: Trip, proposal: ItineraryProposal) -> dict:
    operations = _build_proposal_operations(db, trip, proposal)
    total_delta = round(sum(operation.get("cost", 0) for operation in operations), 2)
    members = (
        db.query(TripMember)
        .filter(TripMember.trip_id == trip.id, TripMember.status == "active")
        .all()
    )
    per_member = round(total_delta / max(1, len(members)), 2)
    budget_conflicts = []
    for operation in operations:
        if operation["op"] != "add":
            continue
        for member in members:
            if member.budget_limit is not None and operation["cost"] > member.budget_limit:
                budget_conflicts.append(
                    {
                        "reason": "A stated hard budget limit would be exceeded.",
                        "item": operation["title"],
                    }
                )
    return {
        "operations": [
            {
                "op": operation["op"],
                "title": operation.get("title"),
                "day": operation.get("day"),
                "start_time": operation.get("start_time"),
                "cost": operation.get("cost"),
            }
            for operation in operations
        ],
        "cost_impact": {
            "total_delta": total_delta,
            "per_member_estimate": per_member,
            "currency": trip.currency,
            "note": "Per-member estimate assumes an equal share of the group plan.",
        },
        "budget_conflicts": budget_conflicts,
        "pact_conflicts": _pact_conflicts(db, trip, operations),
        "requires_approval": True,
    }

"""SAFAR Phase 3 validation — F17-F34 on the isolated seeded API."""
import json, urllib.request, urllib.error, uuid

BASE = "http://127.0.0.1:8011"
PASS = "safar-demo-123"
RESULTS = []

def call(method, path, token=None, body=None, raw=False, timeout=30):
    data = None if body is None else json.dumps(body).encode()
    req = urllib.request.Request(BASE + path, data=data, method=method)
    req.add_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
    if token:
        req.add_header("Authorization", "Bearer " + token)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout) as r:
            payload = r.read()
            if raw:
                return r.status, payload, dict(r.headers)
            try:
                return r.status, json.loads(payload or b"null"), {}
            except Exception:
                return r.status, payload.decode(errors="replace"), {}
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        payload = e.read()
        try:
            return e.code, json.loads(payload or b"null"), dict(e.headers)
        except Exception:
            return e.code, payload.decode(errors="replace"), dict(e.headers)
    except Exception as e:
        return 0, {"network_error": str(e)}, {}

def login(email):
    s, b, _ = call("POST", "/api/auth/login", body={"email": email, "password": PASS})
    assert s == 200, (email, s, b)
    return b["access_token"]

def chk(feature, name, ok, detail=""):
    RESULTS.append({"feature": feature, "check": name, "ok": bool(ok), "detail": str(detail)[:500]})
    print(f"{'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'} {feature} {name} :: {str(detail)[:180]}")

def status_is(feature, name, got, want):
    chk(feature, name, got == want, f"status={got} expected={want}")

This is a deterministic retrieval engine over the user's own trip data and the
catalog. It never invents travel facts. When no AI provider is configured the
response is explicitly labelled as grounded retrieval rather than an LLM.
"""

import re
from datetime import date

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.models import (
    Activity,
    ItineraryItem,
    Recommendation,
    RecommendationBatch,
    Trip,
    TripMember,

)

GENERATOR = "safar-grounded-retrieval-1.0"

INTENTS = {
    # Explicit weather terms win over the generic "tomorrow" itinerary keyword:
    # SAFAR has no weather provider and must say so instead of describing the plan.
    "weather": ["weather", "rain", "forecast", "temperature"],
    "itinerary": ["itinerary", "plan", "schedule", "today", "tomorrow", "doing", "agenda"],
    "budget": ["budget", "cost", "spend", "spent", "owe", "expense", "money", "expensive"],
    "recommend": ["recommend", "suggest", "should we", "what should", "things to do", "options"],
    "vote": ["vote", "proposal", "decision", "approve", "pending"],
    "members": ["who is", "members", "group members", "travellers", "travelers", "joining"],
    "privacy": ["privacy", "share", "location", "permission"],
}


def _detect_intent(message: str) -> str:
    lowered = message.lower()
    for intent, keywords in INTENTS.items():
        if any(keyword in lowered for keyword in keywords):
            return intent
    return "general"


def _today_or_next(items: list[ItineraryItem]) -> tuple[date | None, list[ItineraryItem]]:
    if not items:
        return None, []
    today = date.today()
    upcoming = [item for item in items if item.day >= today]
    pool = upcoming or items
    day = sorted({item.day for item in pool})[0]
    return day, sorted(
        [item for item in pool if item.day == day], key=lambda item: item.start_time
    )


def _find_named_activity(db: Session, trip: Trip, message: str) -> Activity | None:
    if not trip.destination_id:
        return None
    lowered = message.lower()
    activities = (
        db.query(Activity).filter(Activity.destination_id == trip.destination_id).all()
    )
    for activity in activities:
        tokens = [token for token in re.split(r"[^a-z0-9]+", activity.name.lower()) if len(token) > 3]
        if activity.name.lower() in lowered or (tokens and all(token in lowered for token in tokens[:2])):
            return activity
    return None

        text += " SAFAR tracks and calculates only; it does not move money."
        limitations.append("Balances reflect expenses entered in SAFAR, not external payments.")
        return {
            "intent": intent,
            "answer": text,
            "citations": citations,
            "grounding": "trip_data",
            "limitations": limitations,
            "suggested_actions": [
                {"label": "Open expenses", "href": f"/trips/{trip.id}/expenses"}
            ],
            "generated_by": GENERATOR,
        }

    if intent == "recommend":
        batch = (
            db.query(RecommendationBatch)
            .filter(RecommendationBatch.trip_id == trip.id)
            .order_by(RecommendationBatch.created_at.desc())
            .first()
        )
        if not batch:
            text = (
                "I don't have a recommendation batch for this trip yet. Open the Group Experience "
                "Engine and choose Everyone Wins, Your Turn, or Surprise Us."
            )
            suggested_actions = [
                {"label": "Open the Group Engine", "href": f"/trips/{trip.id}/engine"}
            ]
        else:
            recs = (
                db.query(Recommendation)
                .filter(RecommendationBatch.id == batch.id, Recommendation.batch_id == batch.id)
                .order_by(Recommendation.rank)
                .limit(3)
                .all()
            )
            lines = []
            for rec in recs:
                activity = db.get(Activity, rec.activity_id)
                if activity:
                    lines.append(
                        f"{activity.name} (score {rec.score:.0f}, minimum member fit {rec.minimum_fit:.0f})"
                    )
                    citations.append(
                        {"label": f"Recommendation: {activity.name}", "type": "recommendation", "id": rec.id}
                    )
            text = (
                f"The latest {batch.mode.replace('_', ' ')} batch suggests: "
                + "; ".join(lines)
                + ". These are proposals, not confirmed changes."
                if lines
                else "The latest batch has no stored recommendations."
            )
            limitations.append(
                "Scores are model outputs based on available trip data; review the explanations before approving."
            )
            suggested_actions = [
                {"label": "Review recommendations", "href": f"/trips/{trip.id}/engine"}
            ]
        return {
            "intent": intent,
            "answer": text,
            "citations": citations,
            "grounding": "trip_data",
            "limitations": limitations,
            "suggested_actions": suggested_actions,
            "generated_by": GENERATOR,
        }

    if intent == "vote":
        from app.models import ItineraryProposal

        proposals = (
            db.query(ItineraryProposal)
            .filter(ItineraryProposal.trip_id == trip.id, ItineraryProposal.status == "open")
            .order_by(ItineraryProposal.created_at.desc())
            .all()
        )
        if not proposals:
            text = "There are no open proposals waiting for a decision."
        else:
            text = (
                f"{len(proposals)} proposal(s) are open: "
                + "; ".join(proposal.title for proposal in proposals[:5])
                + ". The engine recommends; the group decides."
            )
            citations.extend(
                {"label": f"Proposal: {proposal.title}", "type": "proposal", "id": proposal.id}
                for proposal in proposals[:5]
            )
        return {
            "intent": intent,
            "answer": text,
            "citations": citations,
            "grounding": "trip_data",
            "limitations": [],
            "suggested_actions": [
                {"label": "Open voting", "href": f"/trips/{trip.id}/voting"}
            ],
            "generated_by": GENERATOR,
        }

    if intent == "members":
        members = (
            db.query(TripMember)
            .filter(TripMember.trip_id == trip.id, TripMember.status == "active")
            .all()
        )
        names = []
        for member in members:
            person = db.get(User, member.user_id) if member.user_id else None
            names.append(
                f"{(person.display_name if person else member.display_name or 'Guest')} ({member.role})"
            )
        return {
            "intent": intent,
            "answer": f"{len(members)} active members: " + ", ".join(names) + ".",
            "citations": citations,
            "grounding": "trip_data",
            "limitations": ["Private budgets and preferences are intentionally not shown."],
            "suggested_actions": [
                {"label": "Open members", "href": f"/trips/{trip.id}/members"}
            ],
            "generated_by": GENERATOR,
        }

    if intent == "privacy":
        return {
            "intent": intent,
            "answer": (
                "Trips and memories are private by default. Location sharing is optional and time-limited. "
                "You can withdraw consent, export your data, or delete your account from Settings. "
                "Traveller meetups require mutual acceptance, and identity checks do not guarantee safety."
            ),
            "citations": [],
            "grounding": "product_policy",
            "limitations": [],
            "suggested_actions": [{"label": "Open privacy settings", "href": "/settings"}],
            "generated_by": GENERATOR,
        }

    text = (
        "I can answer from this trip's confirmed itinerary, expenses, members, open proposals and "
        "recommendation batches, or look up a catalog activity by name. No external AI model is "
        "configured, so I only state what SAFAR actually has."
    )
    return {
        "intent": "general",
        "answer": text,
        "citations": citations,
        "grounding": "trip_data",
        "limitations": ["No external LLM or live travel API is configured."],
        "suggested_actions": [
            {"label": "Itinerary", "href": f"/trips/{trip.id}/itinerary"},
            {"label": "Group Engine", "href": f"/trips/{trip.id}/engine"},
        ],
        "generated_by": GENERATOR,
    }

@router.post("/{trip_id}/shadowplans", status_code=201)
def create_shadowplan(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: ShadowplanCreate,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    item = db.get(ItineraryItem, payload.item_id)
    if not item or item.trip_id != trip.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Itinerary item not found")
    activity = db.get(Activity, payload.backup_activity_id)
    if not activity or activity.destination_id != trip.destination_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Backup must be a catalog activity in this destination")
    plan = Shadowplan(
        trip_id=trip.id,
        itinerary_item_id=item.id,
        backup_activity_id=activity.id,
        notes=payload.notes,
        readiness={"status": "ready", "checked_at": utcnow().isoformat()},
        created_by=user.id,
    )
    db.add(plan)
    audit(
        db,
        action="shadowplan.create",
        entity_type="shadowplan",
        entity_id=plan.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
    )
