def fragility_report(db: Session, trip: Trip, items: list[ItineraryItem]) -> dict:
    if not items:
        return {
            "resilience_score": None,
            "label": "No confirmed itinerary items to analyse",
            "days": [],
            "summary": {"comfortable": 0, "tight": 0, "risky": 0},
        }
    by_day: dict[date, list[ItineraryItem]] = {}
    for item in items:
        by_day.setdefault(item.day, []).append(item)

    days = []
    totals = {"comfortable": 0, "tight": 0, "risky": 0}
    for day, day_items in sorted(by_day.items()):
        entries = analyse_day(db, day_items)
        for entry in entries:
            status = entry["buffer_status"]
            if status in totals:
                totals[status] += 1
        days.append(
            {
                "day": day,
                "legs": [
                    {
                        "item_id": entry["item"].id,
                        "title": entry["item"].title,
                        "start_time": entry["item"].start_time,
                        "end_time": minutes_to_hhmm(entry["end"]),
                        "buffer_minutes": entry["buffer_minutes"],
                        "buffer_status": entry["buffer_status"],
                        "travel_minutes": entry["leg_minutes"],
                        "travel_km": entry["leg_km"],
                        "protected": entry["item"].is_protected,
                    }
                    for entry in entries
                ],
                "alternative_timings": _timing_alternatives(entries),
            }
        )

    checks = totals["comfortable"] + totals["tight"] + totals["risky"]
    weighted = totals["comfortable"] * 1.0 + totals["tight"] * 0.55 + totals["risky"] * 0.1
    score = round(100 * weighted / max(1, checks))
    if score >= 75:
        label = "Resilient — comfortable buffers across the plan"
    elif score >= 45:
        label = "Moderate — some legs need attention"
    else:
        label = "Fragile — tight or negative buffers are likely"
    return {
        "resilience_score": score,
        "label": label,
        "days": days,
        "summary": totals,
        "disclosure": "Buffers use estimated travel times, not live traffic.",
    }


def _timing_alternatives(entries: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
    alternatives = []
    for entry in entries:
        buffer = entry.get("buffer_minutes")
        if buffer is None:
            continue
        if buffer < 15:
            shift = max(5, 15 - buffer)
            alternatives.append(
                {
                    "item_id": entry["item"].id,
                    "suggestion": f"Move {entry['item'].title} later or shorten it by about {shift} minutes.",
                    "minutes": shift,
                }
            )
    return alternatives


def domino_map(
    db: Session,
    items: list[ItineraryItem],
    disrupted_item_id: str,
    delay_minutes: int,
) -> dict | None:
    by_day: dict[date, list[ItineraryItem]] = {}
    for item in items:
        by_day.setdefault(item.day, []).append(item)
    target = next((item for item in items if item.id == disrupted_item_id), None)
    if not target:
        return None
    day_items = sorted(by_day.get(target.day, []), key=lambda item: day_minutes(item.start_time))
    entries = analyse_day(db, day_items)
    target_index = next(
        (index for index, entry in enumerate(entries) if entry["item"].id == disrupted_item_id),
        None,
    )
    if target_index is None:
        return None

    affected = []
    unaffected = []
    carry = delay_minutes
    for index, entry in enumerate(entries):
        if index < target_index:
            unaffected.append(
                {"item_id": entry["item"].id, "title": entry["item"].title, "reason": "before the disruption"}
            )
            continue
        if index == target_index:
            carry = delay_minutes
            affected.append(
                {
                    "item_id": entry["item"].id,
                    "title": entry["item"].title,
                    "slip_minutes": delay_minutes,
                    "new_start": minutes_to_hhmm(entry["start"] + delay_minutes),
                    "is_source": True,
                    "protected": entry["item"].is_protected,
                }
            )
            continue
        # Absorb delay with any buffer, then propagate the remainder.
        absorb = max(0, entry.get("buffer_minutes") or 0)
        absorbed = min(carry, absorb)
        net_slip = carry - absorbed
        if net_slip > 0:
            affected.append(
                {
                    "item_id": entry["item"].id,
                    "title": entry["item"].title,
                    "slip_minutes": net_slip,
                    "new_start": minutes_to_hhmm(entry["start"] + net_slip),
                    "is_source": False,
                    "protected": entry["item"].is_protected,
                }
            )
            carry = net_slip
        else:
            unaffected.append(
                {"item_id": entry["item"].id, "title": entry["item"].title, "reason": "buffer absorbs the delay"}
            )
            carry = 0

    repairs = []
    for entry in affected:
        if entry["is_source"]:
            continue
        repairs.append(
            {
                "item_id": entry["item_id"],
                "title": entry["title"],
                "options": [
                    f"Shorten by {entry['slip_minutes']} minutes.",
                    f"Move to {entry['new_start']} and confirm with the group.",
                    "Replace with its Shadowplan backup." if not entry["protected"] else "Protected time: ask the group before changing.",
                ],
            }
        )

    return {
        "day": target.day,
        "disruption": {
            "item_id": target.id,
            "title": target.title,
            "delay_minutes": delay_minutes,
        },
        "affected": affected,
        "unaffected": unaffected,
        "minimum_repairs_needed": len(repairs),
        "repair_options": repairs,
        "disclosure": "Propagation uses planned durations and estimated travel time.",
    }

def compromise(
    db: Session,
    trip: Trip,
    members: list[TripMember],
    option_a: list[str],
    option_b: list[str],
) -> dict:
    """Build a fair-trade compromise from two competing options (F45)."""

    by_id = {
        activity.id: activity
        for activity in db.query(Activity).filter(Activity.id.in_(set(option_a + option_b) or {""})).all()
    }
    a = [by_id[aid] for aid in option_a if aid in by_id]
    b = [by_id[aid] for aid in option_b if aid in by_id]
    if not a or not b:
        return {
            "status": "needs_options",
            "message": "Provide at least one activity for each side of the negotiation.",
        }

    rec = generate_recommendations(
        db, trip, members, mode="everyone_wins", for_date=date.today(), limit=12
    )
    ranked = {item.activity.id: item for item in rec.get("items", [])}

    def best(pool: list[Activity]):
        scored = [ranked[activity.id] for activity in pool if activity.id in ranked]
        return max(scored, key=lambda item: item.minimum_fit) if scored else None

    best_a = best(a)
    best_b = best(b)
    if not best_a or not best_b:
        return {
            "status": "no_feasible_option",
            "message": "One or both options violate a hard constraint for at least one member.",
        }

    compromise_choice = best_a if best_a.minimum_fit >= best_b.minimum_fit else best_b
    other = best_b if compromise_choice is best_a else best_a
    benefits = sorted(
        {
            normalize_tag(tag)
            for tag in (compromise_choice.activity.tags or [])
            if tag
        }
    )[:3]
    return {
        "status": "compromise_ready",
        "compromise": {
            "activity_id": compromise_choice.activity.id,
            "name": compromise_choice.activity.name,
            "minimum_fit": compromise_choice.minimum_fit,
            "average_fit": compromise_choice.average_fit,
        },
        "alternative": {
            "activity_id": other.activity.id,
            "name": other.activity.name,
            "minimum_fit": other.minimum_fit,
            "average_fit": other.average_fit,
        },
        "who_benefits": f"Members interested in {', '.join(benefits) or 'the activity themes'}.",
        "who_compromises": "Members whose first choice was the other option; the protected minimum fit stays highest here.",
        "trade_offs": [
            f"Protected minimum fit {compromise_choice.minimum_fit}/100 versus {other.minimum_fit}/100 for the alternative.",
            f"Average fit {compromise_choice.average_fit}/100 versus {other.average_fit}/100.",
            "Private constraints stayed private; only aggregate suitability is shown.",
        ],
        "feasible": True,
        "disclosure": "Apply only with group approval. No private budget or preference is exposed.",
    }

    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)

    if not pact:

    return {

            "individual_limits": (

                if user.id in (pact.individual_limits or {})
                else {}

            "exceptions": pact.exceptions,
            "updated_at": pact.updated_at,

    for membership in memberships:
        trip = db.get(Trip, membership.trip_id)
        if trip and not trip.deleted_at and (
            trip.status == "completed" or trip.end_date < today
        ):
            completed_ids.append(trip.id)
    loved = (
        db.query(ActivityFeedback)
        .filter(
            ActivityFeedback.user_id == user.id,
            ActivityFeedback.sentiment.in_(["loved", "would_return"]),
            ActivityFeedback.consented.is_(True),
        )
        .order_by(ActivityFeedback.created_at.desc())
        .all()
    )
    activities = {}
    for row in loved:
        activity = db.get(Activity, row.activity_id)
        if not activity:
            continue
        key = activity.id
        entry = activities.setdefault(
            key,
            {
                "activity_id": key,
                "name": activity.name,
                "price_estimate": activity.price_estimate,
                "duration_minutes": activity.duration_minutes,
                "sentiments": [],
            },
        )
        entry["sentiments"].append(row.sentiment)
    return {
        "completed_trips": len(completed_ids),
        "traditions": sorted(
            activities.values(), key=lambda entry: len(entry["sentiments"]), reverse=True
        )[:10],
        "note": (
            "Only outcomes you consented to share are used. You can repeat, modify or avoid "
            "any of these in a new journey."
        ),
    }

@router.get("/trips/{trip_id}/material-watch")
def list_watches(
    trip_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = get_trip_and_member(trip_id, db, user)
    rows = (
        db.query(MaterialWatch)
        .filter(MaterialWatch.trip_id == trip.id)
        .order_by(MaterialWatch.created_at.desc())
        .all()
    )
    activities = {
        activity.id: activity
        for activity in db.query(Activity)
        .filter(Activity.id.in_({row.activity_id for row in rows if row.activity_id}))
        .all()
    } if rows else {}
    return {
        "items": [
            {
                "id": row.id,
                "activity_id": row.activity_id,
                "activity_name": (
                    activities[row.activity_id].name
                    if row.activity_id in activities
                    else None
                ),
                "field": row.field,
                "last_value": row.last_value,
                "status": row.status,
                "last_checked_at": row.last_checked_at,
            }
            for row in rows
        ],
        "note": "Material watches only alert when the tracked field actually changes.",
    }


@router.post("/trips/{trip_id}/material-watch", status_code=201)
def create_watch(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: MaterialWatchIn,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = get_trip_and_member(trip_id, db, user)
    activity = db.get(Activity, payload.activity_id)
    if not activity or activity.destination_id != trip.destination_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Activity not found for this trip")
    existing = (
        db.query(MaterialWatch)
        .filter(
            MaterialWatch.trip_id == trip.id,
            MaterialWatch.activity_id == activity.id,
            MaterialWatch.field == payload.field,
        )
        .first()
    )
    if existing:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="This field is already being watched")
    watch = MaterialWatch(
        trip_id=trip.id,
        activity_id=activity.id,
        field=payload.field,
        last_value={"value": _watch_value(activity, payload.field)},
        status="watching",
    )
    db.add(watch)
    audit(
        db,
        action="material_watch.create",
        entity_type="material_watch",
        entity_id=watch.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
        detail={"field": payload.field},
    )
    db.commit()
    return {
        "id": watch.id,
        "field": watch.field,
        "last_value": watch.last_value,
        "status": watch.status,
    }


@router.delete("/trips/{trip_id}/material-watch/{watch_id}")
def delete_watch(
    trip_id: str,
    watch_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, member = get_trip_and_member(trip_id, db, user)
    watch = db.get(MaterialWatch, watch_id)
    if not watch or watch.trip_id != trip.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Watch not found")
    db.delete(watch)
    audit(
        db,
        action="material_watch.delete",
        entity_type="material_watch",
        entity_id=watch_id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
    )
    db.commit()
    return {"ok": True}


@router.post("/trips/{trip_id}/material-watch/check")
def check_watches(
    trip_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = get_trip_and_member(trip_id, db, user)
    rows = db.query(MaterialWatch).filter(MaterialWatch.trip_id == trip.id).all()
    changed = []
    unchanged = 0
    for watch in rows:
        activity = db.get(Activity, watch.activity_id) if watch.activity_id else None
        if not activity:
            watch.status = "target_missing"
            watch.last_checked_at = utcnow()
            continue
        current = _watch_value(activity, watch.field)
        previous = (watch.last_value or {}).get("value")
        watch.last_checked_at = utcnow()
        if current != previous:
            watch.status = "changed"
            watch.last_value = {"value": current, "previous": previous}
            changed.append(
                {
                    "watch_id": watch.id,
                    "activity_id": activity.id,
                    "activity_name": activity.name,
                    "field": watch.field,
                    "previous": previous,
                    "current": current,
                }

@router.get("/activities/search")
def search_activities(
    q: str | None = Query(default=None, max_length=120),
    destination_id: str | None = None,
    tags: str | None = Query(default=None, max_length=200),
    max_budget: float | None = Query(default=None, ge=0),
    max_duration: int | None = Query(default=None, ge=15, le=1440),
    indoor: bool | None = None,
    accessible: bool = False,
    lens: str = Query(default="balanced", pattern=r"^(balanced|iconic|similar)$"),
    limit: int = Query(default=24, ge=1, le=60),
    user: User | None = Depends(get_optional_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    dna = discovery_service.dna_for_user(db, user.id) if user else None
    tag_list = [tag.strip() for tag in (tags or "").split(",") if tag.strip()]
    results = discovery_service.search_activities(
        db,
        q=q,
        destination_id=destination_id,
        tags=tag_list,
        max_budget=max_budget,
        max_duration=max_duration,
        indoor=indoor,
        accessible=accessible,
        lens=lens,
        dna=dna,
        limit=limit,
    )
    return {
        "lens": lens,
        "items": [
            {
                "activity": activity_out(item["activity"], item["place"], item["destination"]),
                "personal_fit": item["personal_fit"],
                "similar_to": item["similar_to"],
                "similarity": item["similarity"],
                "respect_note": item["respect_note"],
                "provenance": (
                    "ESTIMATED"
                    if (item["activity"].source_type or "").startswith("seed")
                    else "REPORTED"
                ),
                "catalog_freshness": _catalog_freshness(item["activity"]),
            }
            for item in results
        ],
        "personalised": bool(dna),
        "disclosure": (
            "Catalog attributes are curated data. Personal fit is an estimate from your Journey DNA, "
            "not a live provider score."
        ),
    }

                title=title,
                body=body,
                link=link,
            )
        )
        notified.append(user.id)

def effort_budget(db: Session, items: list[ItineraryItem]) -> dict:
    activities = _activity_map(db, items)
    coords = _coords_map(db, activities)
    ordered = sorted(items, key=lambda item: (item.day, day_minutes(item.start_time)))
    walking_km = 0.0
    effort_points = 0
    rest_minutes = 0
    transitions = 0
    previous = None
    for item in ordered:
        activity = activities.get(item.activity_id) if item.activity_id else None
        if item.is_protected:
            rest_minutes += 60
        elif activity:
            effort_points += activity.effort
        if previous and item.activity_id and previous.activity_id and item.day == previous.day:
            prev_coords = coords.get(previous.activity_id, (0.0, 0.0))
            cur_coords = coords.get(item.activity_id, (0.0, 0.0))
            if prev_coords != (0.0, 0.0) and cur_coords != (0.0, 0.0):
                walking_km += haversine_km(*prev_coords, *cur_coords) * 1.25
                transitions += 1
        previous = item
    walking_minutes = int(round(walking_km * 12))
    effort_level = "light" if effort_points <= 6 else "moderate" if effort_points <= 12 else "demanding"
    return {
        "effort_points": effort_points,
        "effort_level": effort_level,
        "walking_km_estimate": round(walking_km, 2),
        "walking_minutes_estimate": walking_minutes,
        "transitions": transitions,
        "protected_rest_minutes": rest_minutes,
        "heat_exposure": "unknown — no weather source is configured",
        "accessibility_note": "Hard accessibility requirements are never traded for a lower effort score.",
        "disclosure": "Effort points derive from catalog intensity; walking distance is a straight-line estimate adjusted for streets.",
    }

elif lens == "similar":
        iconic = [item for item in scored if item["activity"].iconic]
        alternatives = [item for item in scored if not item["activity"].iconic]
        for item in alternatives:
            best = 0.0
            best_name = None
            for anchor in iconic:
                similarity = _cosine(item["tag_map"], anchor["tag_map"])
                if similarity > best:
                    best = similarity
                    best_name = anchor["activity"].name
            item["similar_to"] = best_name if best >= 0.35 else None
            item["similarity"] = round(best, 2)
        alternatives.sort(
            key=lambda item: (item.get("similarity", 0), item["personal_fit"]), reverse=True
        )
        others = [item for item in scored if not item["activity"].iconic]
        scored = others
    elif lens == "balanced":
        iconic = sorted(
            [item for item in scored if item["activity"].iconic],
            key=lambda item: item["personal_fit"],
            reverse=True,
        )
        other = sorted(
            [item for item in scored if not item["activity"].iconic],
            key=lambda item: item["personal_fit"],
            reverse=True,
        )
        mixed = []
        while iconic or other:
            if iconic:
                mixed.append(iconic.pop(0))
            if other:
                mixed.append(other.pop(0))
        scored = mixed
    else:
        scored.sort(key=lambda item: item["personal_fit"], reverse=True)

    return [
        {
            "activity": item["activity"],
            "place": item["place"],
            "destination": item["destination"],
            "personal_fit": item["personal_fit"],
            "similar_to": item.get("similar_to"),
            "similarity": item.get("similarity"),
            "respect_note": (
                item["place"].respect_note
                if item["place"] and item["place"].fragile
                else None
            ),
        }
        for item in scored[:limit]
    ]

@router.get("/me/notifications")
def notifications(
    limit: int = Query(default=30, ge=1, le=100),
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    from app.models import Notification

    rows = (
        db.query(Notification)
        .filter(Notification.user_id == user.id)
        .order_by(Notification.created_at.desc())
        .limit(limit)
        .all()
    )
    unread = (
        db.query(Notification)
        .filter(Notification.user_id == user.id, Notification.read_at.is_(None))
        .count()
    )
    return {
        "unread": unread,
        "items": [
            {
                "id": row.id,
                "trip_id": row.trip_id,
                "kind": row.kind,
                "title": row.title,
                "body": row.body,
                "link": row.link,
                "read": row.read_at is not None,
                "created_at": row.created_at,
            }
            for row in rows
        ],
    }

@router.get("/{trip_id}/ground-requests")
def list_ground_requests(
    trip_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    rows = (
        db.query(GroundRequest)
        .filter(GroundRequest.trip_id == trip.id)
        .order_by(GroundRequest.created_at.desc())
        .all()
    )
    items = []
    for row in rows:
        responses = db.query(GroundResponse).filter(GroundResponse.request_id == row.id).all()
        items.append(
            {
                "id": row.id,
                "question": row.question,
                "place_id": row.place_id,
                "activity_id": row.activity_id,
                "status": row.status,
                "created_at": row.created_at,
                "responses": [
                    {
                        "id": response.id,
                        "observation": response.observation,
                        "observed_at": response.observed_at,
                        "confidence": response.confidence,
                        "verified": response.verified,
                        "provenance": "REPORTED (unverified)" if not response.verified else "VERIFIED",
                        "contributor_id": response.contributor_id,
                    }
                    for response in responses
                ],
            }
        )
    return {"items": items}

@router.post("/{trip_id}/ground-requests/{request_id}/responses", status_code=201)
def respond_ground_request(
    trip_id: str,
    request_id: str,
    payload: GroundResponseIn,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    # Local contributors are not trip members. They answer as opted-in locals
    # for the destination, so this endpoint checks contributor status rather
    # than membership; it never returns trip details to them.
    trip = db.get(Trip, trip_id)
    if not trip or trip.deleted_at:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Trip not found")
    request = db.get(GroundRequest, request_id)
    if not request or request.trip_id != trip.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Request not found")
    contributor = (
        db.query(LocalContributor)
        .filter(
            LocalContributor.user_id == user.id,
            LocalContributor.accepts_requests.is_(True),
        )
        .first()
    )
    if not contributor:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=403,
            detail="Only opt-in local contributors can answer ground requests",
        )
    if contributor.destination_id != trip.destination_id:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=403,
            detail="Only contributors for this destination can answer",
        )
    response = GroundResponse(
        request_id=request.id,
        contributor_id=user.id,
        observation=payload.observation,
        confidence=payload.confidence,
        verified=False,
    )
    db.add(response)
    db.flush()
    request.status = "answered"
    audit(
        db,
        action="ground.response",
        entity_type="ground_response",
        entity_id=response.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
    )
    db.commit()
    return {
        "id": response.id,
        "provenance": "REPORTED (unverified)",
        "note": "One traveller observation never becomes verified information automatically.",
    }

def _create_proposal(
    db: Session,
    trip: Trip,
    user: User,
    *,
    kind: str,
    title: str,
    summary: str | None,
    day: date | None,
    payload: dict,
) -> tuple[ItineraryProposal, dict]:
    proposal = ItineraryProposal(
        trip_id=trip.id,
        kind=kind,
        title=title,
        summary=summary,
        target_day=day,
        created_by=user.id,
        payload=payload,
    )
    db.add(proposal)
    db.flush()
    impact = _proposal_impact(db, trip, proposal)
    audit(
        db,
        action="proposal.create",
        entity_type="itinerary_proposal",
        entity_id=proposal.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
        detail={"kind": kind, "title": title, "origin": "engine"},
    )
    notify_trip_members(
        db,
        trip,
        kind="proposal_created",
        title=f"New proposal: {title}",
        body=f"{user.display_name} turned an engine suggestion into a group decision.",
        link=f"/trips/{trip.id}/voting",
        exclude_user_id=user.id,
    )
    return proposal, impact

@router.get("/circles")
def list_circles(
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db)
):
    circles = discovery_service.ensure_seed_circles(db, user.id)
    db.commit()

        "items": [_circle_out(db, circle, user.id) for circle in circles],

@router.get("/circles/{circle_id}")
def get_circle(
    circle_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    circle = db.get(TravelCircle, circle_id)
    if not circle:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Circle not found")
    posts = (
        db.query(CirclePost)
        .filter(CirclePost.circle_id == circle.id, CirclePost.status == "published")
        .order_by(CirclePost.created_at.desc())
        .limit(50)
        .all()
    )
    authors = {
        person.id: person
        for person in db.query(User)
        .filter(User.id.in_({post.user_id for post in posts}))
        .all()
    } if posts else {}
    # Display names and roles are public inside a circle; no contact details
    # or personal preferences are ever included.
    members = (
        db.query(CircleMember, User)
        .join(User, User.id == CircleMember.user_id)
        .filter(CircleMember.circle_id == circle.id)
        .order_by(CircleMember.joined_at.asc())
        .all()
    )
    return {
        **_circle_out(db, circle, user.id),
        "members": [
            {
                "user_id": member.user_id,
                "display_name": person.display_name,
                "role": member.role,
            }
            for member, person in members
        ],
        "posts": [
            {
                "id": post.id,
                "title": post.title,
                "body": post.body,
                "activity_id": post.activity_id,
                "status": post.status,
                "author": user_public(authors.get(post.user_id)),
                "created_at": post.created_at,
            }
            for post in posts
        ],
    }


@router.post("/circles/{circle_id}/join")
def join_circle(
    circle_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    circle = db.get(TravelCircle, circle_id)
    if not circle:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Circle not found")
    existing = (
        db.query(CircleMember)
        .filter(CircleMember.circle_id == circle.id, CircleMember.user_id == user.id)
        .first()
    )
    if not existing:
        db.add(CircleMember(circle_id=circle.id, user_id=user.id))
        audit(
            db,
            action="circle.join",
            entity_type="travel_circle",
            entity_id=circle.id,
            user_id=user.id,
        )
        db.commit()
    return {"ok": True, "joined": True, "member_count": _circle_out(db, circle, user.id)["member_count"]}


@router.delete("/circles/{circle_id}/join")
def leave_circle(
    circle_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    circle = db.get(TravelCircle, circle_id)
    if not circle:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Circle not found")
    db.query(CircleMember).filter(
        CircleMember.circle_id == circle.id, CircleMember.user_id == user.id
    ).delete()
    db.commit()
    return {"ok": True, "joined": False}

):

    membership = (
        db.query(CircleMember)
        .filter(CircleMember.circle_id == circle.id, CircleMember.user_id == user.id)
        .first()
    )
    if not membership:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Join the circle before posting")
    if payload.activity_id:
        activity = db.get(Activity, payload.activity_id)
        if not activity:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Activity not found")
    post = CirclePost(
        circle_id=circle.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        title=payload.title,
        body=payload.body,
        activity_id=payload.activity_id,
    )
    db.add(post)

"""One-Link Companion (F26).

Short-lived, single-purpose links let somebody answer exactly one question —
one vote or one check-in — without an account. Tokens are HMAC-signed and
carry the link id, expiry, purpose and target, so a token cannot be repointed
at another trip, proposal or item. Responses are anonymous: no user id, IP
address or user agent is stored.
"""

import hashlib
import hmac
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

from sqlalchemy import func
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.core.config import settings
from app.models import (
    CompanionLink,
    CompanionResponse,
    ItineraryItem,
    ItineraryProposal,
    Trip,
    Vote,
)
from app.models.models import utcnow

MAX_TTL_MINUTES = 7 * 24 * 60
MIN_TTL_MINUTES = 5

VOTE_VALUES = ("yes", "no", "abstain")
CHECKIN_VALUES = ("in", "out", "join_later")
PURPOSES = ("vote", "checkin")


def _epoch(value: datetime) -> int:
    if value.tzinfo is None:
        value = value.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    return int(value.timestamp())


def _signature(link_id: str, expires: int, purpose: str, target_id: str) -> str:
    message = f"{link_id}.{expires}.{purpose}.{target_id}".encode("utf-8")
    return hmac.new(
        settings.secret_key.encode("utf-8"), message, hashlib.sha256
    ).hexdigest()[:40]


def issue_token(link: CompanionLink) -> str:
    expires = _epoch(link.expires_at)
    return f"{link.id}.{expires}.{_signature(link.id, expires, link.purpose, link.target_id)}"


def parse_token(token: str) -> tuple[str, int, str] | None:
    parts = (token or "").split(".")
    if len(parts) != 3:
        return None
    link_id, raw_expires, signature = parts
    if len(link_id) != 32 or not link_id.isalnum():
        return None
    try:
        expires = int(raw_expires)
    except ValueError:
        return None
    return link_id, expires, signature


def token_valid(link: CompanionLink, expires: int, signature: str) -> bool:
    if expires != _epoch(link.expires_at):
        return False
    expected = _signature(link.id, expires, link.purpose, link.target_id)
    return hmac.compare_digest(signature, expected)


def link_status(link: CompanionLink, now: datetime | None = None) -> str:
    now = now or utcnow()
    if link.revoked_at:
        return "revoked"
    if _epoch(link.expires_at) <= _epoch(now):
        return "expired"
    if link.used_count >= link.max_uses:
        return "used"
    return "active"


def expires_from_now(minutes: int) -> datetime:
    minutes = max(MIN_TTL_MINUTES, min(MAX_TTL_MINUTES, minutes))
    return utcnow() + timedelta(minutes=minutes)


def resolve_active(db: Session, token: str) -> tuple[CompanionLink, str | None]:
    """Return (link, None) or (link/None, error message)."""
    parsed = parse_token(token)
    if not parsed:
        return None, "This link is not valid."
    link_id, expires, signature = parsed
    link = db.get(CompanionLink, link_id)
    if not link or not token_valid(link, expires, signature):
        return None, "This link is not valid."
    status = link_status(link)
    if status == "revoked":
        return link, "This link was revoked by its creator."
    if status == "expired":
        return link, "This link has expired."
    if status == "used":
        return link, "This link has already been used."
    return link, None


def context(db: Session, link: CompanionLink) -> dict:
    trip = db.get(Trip, link.trip_id)
    base = {
        "purpose": link.purpose,
        "trip": {
            "name": trip.name if trip else "Journey",
            "destination_name": trip.destination_name if trip else "",
        },
        "expires_at": link.expires_at,
        "remaining_uses": max(0, link.max_uses - link.used_count),
        "disclosure": (
            "This page answers one question without an account. Your identity is not recorded."
        ),
    }
    anonymous_count = (
        db.query(func.count(CompanionResponse.id))
        .filter(CompanionResponse.link_id == link.id)
        .scalar()
        or 0
    )
    base["anonymous_responses"] = anonymous_count

    if link.purpose == "vote":
        proposal = db.get(ItineraryProposal, link.target_id)
        counts = {"yes": 0, "no": 0, "abstain": 0}
        if proposal:
            for value, count in (
                db.query(Vote.value, func.count(Vote.id))
                .filter(Vote.proposal_id == proposal.id)
                .group_by(Vote.value)
                .all()
            ):
                counts[value] = count
        base["target"] = {
            "kind": "proposal",
            "id": link.target_id,
            "title": proposal.title if proposal else "Decision unavailable",
            "summary": proposal.summary if proposal else None,
            "status": proposal.status if proposal else "missing",
            "registered_votes": counts,
        }
        base["question"] = "Do you support this decision?"
        base["options"] = list(VOTE_VALUES)
    else:
        item = db.get(ItineraryItem, link.target_id)
        base["target"] = {
            "kind": "checkin",
            "id": link.target_id,
            "title": item.title if item else "Item unavailable",
            "day": item.day.isoformat() if item else None,
            "start_time": item.start_time if item else None,
            "status": item.status if item else "missing",
        }
        base["question"] = "Will you join this confirmed item?"
        base["options"] = list(CHECKIN_VALUES)
    return base

def _link_brief(db: Session, link: CompanionLink) -> dict:
    responses = (
        db.query(func.count(CompanionResponse.id))
        .filter(CompanionResponse.link_id == link.id)
        .scalar()
        or 0
    )
    values = {
        value: count
        for value, count in (
            db.query(CompanionResponse.value, func.count(CompanionResponse.id))
            .filter(CompanionResponse.link_id == link.id)
            .group_by(CompanionResponse.value)
            .all()
        )
    }
    target = None
    if link.purpose == "vote":
        proposal = db.get(ItineraryProposal, link.target_id)
        target = {
            "kind": "proposal",
            "id": link.target_id,
            "title": proposal.title if proposal else "Decision removed",
            "status": proposal.status if proposal else "missing",
        }
    else:
        item = db.get(ItineraryItem, link.target_id)
        target = {
            "kind": "checkin",
            "id": link.target_id,
            "title": item.title if item else "Item removed",
            "day": item.day.isoformat() if item else None,
            "status": item.status if item else "missing",
        }
    return {
        "id": link.id,
        "purpose": link.purpose,
        "target": target,
        "status": companion_service.link_status(link),
        "expires_at": link.expires_at,
        "max_uses": link.max_uses,
        "used_count": link.used_count,
        "anonymous_responses": responses,
        "response_values": values,
        "created_at": link.created_at,
    }

@router.get("/me/dna")
def get_dna(user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    dna = _get_dna(db, user.id)
    return {
        "scores": dna.scores,
        "source": dna.source,
        "updated_at": dna.updated_at,
        "dimensions": DNA_DIMENSIONS,
        "note": "Journey DNA is editable and never a permanent personality label.",
    }


@router.put("/me/dna")
def update_dna(
    payload: DNAUpdate,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    unknown = set(payload.scores) - set(DNA_DIMENSIONS)
    if unknown:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=f"Unknown DNA dimensions: {', '.join(sorted(unknown))}")
    dna = _get_dna(db, user.id)
    scores = dict(dna.scores or default_dna())
    for dimension, value in payload.scores.items():
        scores[dimension] = clamp(float(value), 0, 10)
    dna.scores = scores
    dna.source = "explicit"
    audit(db, action="dna.update", entity_type="journey_dna", entity_id=dna.id, user_id=user.id)
    db.commit()
    return {"scores": dna.scores, "source": dna.source, "updated_at": dna.updated_at}


@router.get("/me/consents")
@router.patch("/{trip_id}/members/me")
def update_my_membership(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: MemberSelfUpdate,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    data = payload.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
    for field, value in data.items():
        setattr(member, field, value)
    audit(
        db,
        action="member.update_self",
        entity_type="trip_member",
        entity_id=member.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
        detail={"fields": list(data.keys())},
    )
    db.commit()
    return member_out(db, member, user.id)

def create_place_report(

    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    if not payload.activity_id and not payload.place_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Provide an activity or place for this report")
    activity = None
    place = None
    if payload.activity_id:
        activity = _activity_for_trip(db, trip, payload.activity_id)
        place = db.get(Place, activity.place_id) if activity.place_id else None
    if payload.place_id:
        if place and payload.place_id != place.id:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Activity and place do not match")
        place = db.get(Place, payload.place_id)
        if not place or place.destination_id != trip.destination_id:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Place not found for this trip")
        if not activity:
            activity = (
                db.query(Activity)
                .filter(Activity.place_id == place.id)
                .first()
            )
    if payload.source_type == "official" and not user.is_admin:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=403,
            detail="Only platform moderators can mark a report as officially sourced",
        )
    if len(json.dumps(payload.value)) > 2000:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Report value is too large")
    observed_at = _naive_utc(payload.observed_at)
    if observed_at > utcnow() + timedelta(minutes=5):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Observation time cannot be in the future")

@router.post("/{trip_id}/companion-links", status_code=201)
def create_companion_link(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: CompanionLinkIn,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = get_trip_and_member(trip_id, db, user)

    if payload.purpose == "vote":
        target = db.get(ItineraryProposal, payload.target_id)
        if not target or target.trip_id != trip.id:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Decision not found")
        if target.status != "open":
            raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Only open decisions can be shared.")
    else:
        target = db.get(ItineraryItem, payload.target_id)
        if not target or target.trip_id != trip.id:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Itinerary item not found")
        if target.status != "confirmed":
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=422, detail="Only confirmed itinerary items can be shared."
            )

    link = CompanionLink(
        trip_id=trip.id,
        created_by=user.id,
        purpose=payload.purpose,
        target_id=payload.target_id,
        expires_at=companion_service.expires_from_now(payload.ttl_minutes),
        max_uses=1,
        used_count=0,
    )
    db.add(link)
    db.flush()
    token = companion_service.issue_token(link)
    audit(
        db,
        action="companion.create",
        entity_type="companion_link",
        entity_id=link.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
        detail={"purpose": link.purpose, "target_id": link.target_id},
    )
    db.commit()
    return {
        "link": _link_brief(db, link),
        "token": token,
        "url": f"/companion/{token}",
        "disclosure": (
            "Anyone with this link can answer once, without an account. Their identity is not recorded. "
            "The link expires on its own and can be revoked."
        ),
    }

"""SAFAR Phase 3 validation harness — runs against an isolated seeded API."""
import json, urllib.request, urllib.error, uuid, threading

BASE = "http://127.0.0.1:8011"
PASS = "safar-demo-123"
RESULTS = []

def call(method, path, token=None, body=None, raw=False, timeout=30):
    data = None if body is None else json.dumps(body).encode()
    req = urllib.request.Request(BASE + path, data=data, method=method)
    req.add_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
    if token:
        req.add_header("Authorization", "Bearer " + token)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout) as r:
            payload = r.read()
            if raw:
                return r.status, payload, dict(r.headers)
            try:
                return r.status, json.loads(payload or b"null"), {}
            except Exception:
                return r.status, payload.decode(errors="replace"), {}
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        payload = e.read()
        try:
            return e.code, json.loads(payload or b"null"), dict(e.headers)
        except Exception:
            return e.code, payload.decode(errors="replace"), dict(e.headers)
    except Exception as e:  # network/connection failure
        return 0, {"network_error": str(e)}, {}

def login(email):
    s, b, _ = call("POST", "/api/auth/login", body={"email": email, "password": PASS})
    assert s == 200, (email, s, b)
    return b["access_token"]

def chk(feature, name, ok, detail=""):
    RESULTS.append({"feature": feature, "check": name, "ok": bool(ok), "detail": str(detail)[:400]})
    print(f"{'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'} {feature} {name} :: {str(detail)[:180]}")

def status_is(feature, name, got, want):
    chk(feature, name, got == want, f"status={got} expected={want}")

def reg(name="Probe"):
    email = f"val-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:10]}@example.com"
    s, b, _ = call("POST", "/api/auth/register", body={"email": email, "password": "val-pass-123", "display_name": name})
    assert s == 201, (s, b)
    return email, {"Authorization": f"Bearer {b['access_token']}"}

def H(tok):
    return {"Authorization": f"Bearer {tok}"}

tokens = {n: login(n + "@safar.demo") for n in ["mira", "jonas", "aiko", "leo", "noor"]}
AUTH = {n: H(t) for n, t in tokens.items()}

trips = call("GET", "/api/trips", tokens["mira"])[1]["items"]
KYOTO = next(t for t in trips if t["name"] == "Kyoto in Slow Bloom")
LISBON = next(t for t in trips if t["name"] == "Lisbon, Unscheduled")
REY = next(t for t in trips if t["name"] == "Reykjavik in Winter Light")
T = KYOTO["id"]

class CompanionLink(Base):
    """A signed, single-purpose, expiring link for one vote or check-in (F26).

    The token itself is never stored: it is an HMAC over the link id, expiry,
    purpose and target. Responses are anonymous by design and are recorded
    separately so no traveller identity is attached to them.
    """

    __tablename__ = "companion_links"
    __table_args__ = (Index("ix_companion_links_trip", "trip_id", "created_at"),)

    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(32), primary_key=True, default=new_id)
    trip_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(
        ForeignKey("trips.id", ondelete="CASCADE"), index=True

export function tokenFromStore(): string | null {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return null;
  try {
    const raw = window.localStorage.getItem("safar-auth");
    if (!raw) return null;
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as { state?: { token?: string | null } };
    return parsed.state?.token || null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

# SAFAR — Feature Registry (F01–F49)

Honest status for every feature in the master prompt. "Implemented" means the
UI, API, persistence, permissions and at least one verification path exist.
"Partial" means a real, working subset ships but a named capability is missing.
"Not implemented" means no product surface claims to do it.

Legend: ✅ Implemented · 🟡 Partial · ⛔ Not implemented

Verification sources:

* **T** — automated tests in `services/api/tests/test_api.py` +
  `services/api/tests/test_audit_fixes.py` + `services/api/tests/test_stabilisation.py`
  (36 tests) or `apps/web/tests/*.test.ts` (12 tests).
* **B** — manually exercised in a production build in a browser against the
  seeded demo data (every `(app)` route was loaded and checked for runtime
  errors and content).

All automated tests pass on the commit this registry describes.

### Known external dependencies that are intentionally absent

| Dependency | Effect | Product behaviour |
|---|---|---|
| LLM provider | No generative answers, no AI captions | Deterministic grounded retrieval; caption drafts are template-based and require approval |
| Weather API | No real forecast | Assistant and rescue state that weather is unknown; rescue is user-driven |
| Translation service | No translated answers | UI locale preference is stored; answers are English with an explicit note |
| Live routing/traffic | No routed ETAs | Travel times are estimates, always labelled |
| Live availability/ticketing | No booking | Catalog is curated seed data, labelled ESTIMATED unless a verified source exists |
| Object storage | Media on local disk | Type/size validation; media served via expiring HMAC-signed URLs |
| Email/SMS delivery | No outbound messages | Invitations are shareable links; in-app notifications only |

## Deep audit addendum (2026-11-19)

Defects found by runtime probes and fixed, each now pinned by a regression test:

| Defect | Impact | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| Invitation tokens were reusable and not bound to the invited email | An intercepted link let any account join the trip | accept returns 409 after first use and 403 for a different email; preview reports `accepted_by_you` |
| `/media/...` was served unauthenticated to anyone who guessed a path | Private trip media could leak | HMAC-signed URLs with 12 h expiry; unsigned/tampered requests 403 |
| Memory Studio events leaked metadata of private memories | Other members saw event titles/dates referencing hidden memories | `visible_events()` filters events unless every referenced memory is visible (studio and replay) |
| Default budget comfort was treated as a hard budget cap | Members who never stated a limit silently lost affordable results | only a stated `budget_limit` filters; comfort is a soft preference used for ranking |
| Expense currency was required | Expenses failed when the trip currency should apply | currency defaults to the trip's currency |
| Completed-trip next action linked to a non-existent route | Dead link from the dashboard | links to `/trips/{id}/memories/replay` |
| OpenAI settings existed but nothing used them | Risk of implying generative AI | health/capabilities report `external_ai: false`; key is inert (now documented) |

Verification added in `services/api/tests/test_audit_fixes.py`: invite single-use and
email binding, signed media, private event metadata, engine budget semantics,
expense currency, rescue proposal validation and non-mutation, trip-scoped
inspiration import, admin rejection for non-admins, anonymising deletion with token
revocation, Journey DNA consent gating, three engine modes, explicit no-destination
failure, Trip Twin read-only adoption, constraint compass, reason-free independent
time, WebSocket broadcast to other members, and replay link correctness.

## 3. Journeys tested

- **A Individual** — discover Kyoto → create future trip → engine batch (plan untouched) → approve proposal → versioned itinerary → memory persisted.
- **B Group** — invite accepted → member pulse re-orders results → all three modes → approval finalises.
- **C Management** — edit item (new version) → equal split reconciles → rescue proposes without editing → confirmed plan persists.
- **D During travel** — read-only opportunity clock → capture → offline snapshot → sync retry skipped.
- **E Post-trip** — studio grouping + approval → private memory hidden from replay → travel book generated.

## 4. Integration failures

**One:** F48 — `recommendation_out` calls `activity_out` without the place, so engine recommendations carry no `respect_note`, and `/engine` cannot display respect guidance. The other nine integrations passed. F39 is not an integration failure but a documented enforcement gap.

69	def _within_trip(trip: Trip, day: date) -> None:
70	    if day < trip.start_date or day > trip.end_date:

72	            status_code=422,
73	            detail=(
74	                f"{day.isoformat()} is outside the trip dates "
75	                f"({trip.start_date.isoformat()} to {trip.end_date.isoformat()})."
76	            ),
77	        )

80	def _activity_in_trip(db: Session, trip: Trip, activity_id: str) -> Activity:
81	    activity = db.get(Activity, activity_id)
82	    if not activity:
83	        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Activity not found")
84	    if activity.destination_id != trip.destination_id:
85	        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Activity is outside this trip's destination")
86	    return activity

89	def _batch_out(db: Session, batch: RecommendationBatch, viewer_id: str) -> dict:
90	    recs = (
91	        db.query(Recommendation)
92	        .filter(Recommendation.batch_id == batch.id)
93	        .order_by(Recommendation.rank)
94	        .all()
95	    )
96	    activity_ids = [rec.activity_id for rec in recs]
97	    activities = (
98	        db.query(Activity).filter(Activity.id.in_(activity_ids)).all() if activity_ids else []
99	    )
100	    activity_map = {activity.id: activity for activity in activities}
101	    feedback_rows = (
102	        db.query(RecommendationFeedback)
103	        .filter(
104	            RecommendationFeedback.recommendation_id.in_([rec.id for rec in recs]),
105	            RecommendationFeedback.user_id == viewer_id,
106	        )
107	        .all()
108	        if recs
109	        else []
110	    )
111	    my_feedback = {row.recommendation_id: row.sentiment for row in feedback_rows}
112	    return {
113	        "id": batch.id,
114	        "mode": batch.mode,
115	        "mode_meta": MODE_META.get(batch.mode, {}),
116	        "for_date": batch.for_date,
117	        "model_version": batch.model_version,
118	        "meta": batch.meta or {},
119	        "created_at": batch.created_at,
120	        "created_by": batch.created_by,
121	        "items": [
122	            {
123	                **recommendation_out(rec, activity_map.get(rec.activity_id)),
124	                "my_feedback": my_feedback.get(rec.id),
125	            }
126	            for rec in recs
127	        ],
128	    }

131	@router.post("/{trip_id}/engine/recommend", status_code=201)
132	async def recommend(
133	    trip_id: str,
134	    payload: RecommendIn,
135	    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
136	    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
137	):
138	    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
139	    for_date = payload.for_date or date.today()
140	    _within_trip(trip, for_date)
141	    members = _active_members(db, trip.id)
142	    result = generate_recommendations(
143	        db,
144	        trip,
145	        members,
146	        mode=payload.mode,
147	        for_date=for_date,
148	        limit=payload.limit,
149	    )
150	    if result.get("error"):
151	        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=result["error"])
152	    if not result["items"]:
153	        raise HTTPException(
154	            status_code=422,
155	            detail=(
156	                "No activity passes every hard constraint for this group today. "
157	                "Adjust a Trip Pulse, budget limit or radius and try again."
158	            ),
159	        )
160	
161	    meta = {
162	        **result["meta"],
163	        "mode_meta": result["mode_meta"],
164	        "clarifying_question": result.get("clarifying_question"),
165	        "exclusion_reasons": result.get("exclusion_reasons", {}),
166	        "target_member": result["target"].label if result.get("target") else None,
167	        "alternative_count": len(result.get("all_ranked_ids", [])) - len(result["items"]),
168	    }
169	    batch = RecommendationBatch(
170	        trip_id=trip.id,
171	        mode=payload.mode,
172	        for_date=for_date,
173	        model_version=ENGINE_VERSION,
174	        meta=meta,
175	        created_by=user.id,
176	    )
177	    db.add(batch)
178	    db.flush()
179	    for rank, ranked in enumerate(result["items"], start=1):
180	        db.add(
181	            Recommendation(
182	                batch_id=batch.id,
183	                trip_id=trip.id,
184	                activity_id=ranked.activity.id,
185	                rank=rank,
186	                score=ranked.score,
187	                average_fit=ranked.average_fit,
188	                minimum_fit=ranked.minimum_fit,
189	                fairness_spread=ranked.fairness_spread,
190	                novelty=ranked.novelty,
191	                penalties=ranked.penalties,
192	                explanation=ranked.explanation,
193	                status="suggested",
194	            )
195	        )
196	    audit(
197	        db,
198	        action="engine.recommend",
199	        entity_type="recommendation_batch",
200	        entity_id=batch.id,
201	        user_id=user.id,
202	        trip_id=trip.id,
203	        detail={"mode": payload.mode, "for_date": for_date.isoformat()},
204	    )
205	    db.commit()
206	    await manager.broadcast(
207	        trip.id,
208	        event_payload("engine.updated", trip_id=trip.id, mode=payload.mode),
209	    )
210	    return _batch_out(db, batch, user.id)

#### Thinking

Engine ranks activities but doesn't consider the day's schedule at all (time windows). For F39 "cannot accidentally recommend an activity that violates protected time", we need to define semantics:

Protected time = confirmed itinerary items flagged `is_protected`. Semantics: protected blocks are reserved (rest/free time). The engine recommends *activities* (not times), so an activity recommendation alone doesn't violate protected time until scheduled. But the requirement says engine cannot recommend an activity that violates protected time. A principled implementation:

1. Compute protected intervals for `for_date` from confirmed items on that day with `is_protected=True`.
2. Compute the "candidate window" — the free time remaining on that day (08:00–22:00 minus all confirmed items, with travel buffer?). If an activity's `duration_minutes` cannot fit in any remaining free window, exclude it as a hard constraint (`protected_time` exclusion reason) — because scheduling it would necessarily overlap protected/planned time.
3. Also exclude candidates whose duration exceeds total remaining free time on that day.

This is meaningful: if the day is fully protected, no recommendation can be scheduled → engine returns explicit error (existing "no activity passes..." message or a specific one). But careful: if no confirmed items on that day (empty plan), free window = 08:00–22:00 = 840 min, all fit. Good.

But wait: users can schedule engine recommendations on any day via propose (payload.day). Engine batch is per `for_date`. Propose could target a different day. `propose_recommendation` should also validate overlap with that day's protected items (F39 "cannot accidentally ... violates protected time"). Add check there: compute proposed start_time + activity duration vs protected intervals; reject 409 with clear message. Also rescue propose: replacement items must not overlap protected windows — validate each replacement against that day's protected intervals (excluding the target item being replaced, since it may itself be... hmm target item could itself be protected? Rescue shouldn't target protected items at all. Currently rescue analyze can accept item_id of any confirmed item, including protected. Fix: if target item is protected → 422 "Protected time cannot be rescued/replaced". And proposals for replacements overlapping other protected items → 422/409.

Also proposal approval could reintroduce overlap? Add guard in `_proposal_impact` or approval? Requirement focuses engine and rescue; but "Test edge cases involving overlapping activities and schedule changes." Approval of a rescue proposal replacing items: server should validate at propose time; at approve time schedule could change. There's approval logic in itinerary router. Let me inspect how proposals apply and whether they validate overlaps. Adding overlap validation at approval might break existing proposals (e.g., twin replacements with items at 09:00 — could overlap confirmed items?). Careful: approval currently removes/replaces target items. Twin proposal day replacement deletes day items then adds? Let me inspect `_apply_proposal`/approve.

- Added activities must not overlap protected blocks that remain.

#### Thinking

Rescue uses engine recommendations for pool day — once engine excludes candidates that cannot fit around protected windows, rescue automatically benefits. But replacement window is the item's own slot; the engine's day-level free window check may allow a candidate that doesn't fit *the item's specific slot* (it fits somewhere else that day). Requirement: rescue cannot override protected time. Add per-replacement slot check: candidate duration ≤ item slot duration (end_time or original duration) OR start+duration doesn't overlap next protected item. Simplest robust: for each affected item (non-protected), compute available slot from item.start_time until the next confirmed item's start (excluding the affected item) — replacement must fit. Use end_time if present. Reject/skip candidate otherwise, appearing as none/keep.

Also if target item is protected: `_pick_affected` should skip protected items and return message "Protected time is not eligible for rescue." Add in analyse and propose.

Now F45: `compromise` uses `date.today()`. Add `for_date` param to service and router query/body. Check NegotiateIn schema and UI call.

def compromise(
    db: Session,
    trip: Trip,
    members: list[TripMember],
    option_a: list[str],
    option_b: list[str],
) -> dict:
    """Build a fair-trade compromise from two competing options (F45)."""

    by_id = {
        activity.id: activity
        for activity in db.query(Activity).filter(Activity.id.in_(set(option_a + option_b) or {""})).all()
    }
    a = [by_id[aid] for aid in option_a if aid in by_id]
    b = [by_id[aid] for aid in option_b if aid in by_id]
    if not a or not b:
        return {
            "status": "needs_options",
            "message": "Provide at least one activity for each side of the negotiation.",
        }

    rec = generate_recommendations(
        db, trip, members, mode="everyone_wins", for_date=date.today(), limit=12
    )
    ranked = {item.activity.id: item for item in rec.get("items", [])}

    def best(pool: list[Activity]):
        scored = [ranked[activity.id] for activity in pool if activity.id in ranked]
        return max(scored, key=lambda item: item.minimum_fit) if scored else None

    best_a = best(a)
    best_b = best(b)
    if not best_a or not best_b:
        return {
            "status": "no_feasible_option",
            "message": "One or both options violate a hard constraint for at least one member.",
        }

    compromise_choice = best_a if best_a.minimum_fit >= best_b.minimum_fit else best_b
    other = best_b if compromise_choice is best_a else best_a
    benefits = sorted(
        {
            normalize_tag(tag)
            for tag in (compromise_choice.activity.tags or [])
            if tag
        }
    )[:3]
    return {
        "status": "compromise_ready",
        "compromise": {
            "activity_id": compromise_choice.activity.id,
            "name": compromise_choice.activity.name,
            "minimum_fit": compromise_choice.minimum_fit,
            "average_fit": compromise_choice.average_fit,
        },
        "alternative": {
            "activity_id": other.activity.id,
            "name": other.activity.name,
            "minimum_fit": other.minimum_fit,
            "average_fit": other.average_fit,
        },
        "who_benefits": f"Members interested in {', '.join(benefits) or 'the activity themes'}.",
        "who_compromises": "Members whose first choice was the other option; the protected minimum fit stays highest here.",
        "trade_offs": [
            f"Protected minimum fit {compromise_choice.minimum_fit}/100 versus {other.minimum_fit}/100 for the alternative.",
            f"Average fit {compromise_choice.average_fit}/100 versus {other.average_fit}/100.",
            "Private constraints stayed private; only aggregate suitability is shown.",
        ],
        "feasible": True,
        "disclosure": "Apply only with group approval. No private budget or preference is exposed.",
    }

#### Thinking

Pulse page day state is local and doesn't read query params. For F36 answer link, add `?date=` support to pulse page (small, focused): initialize `day` from `searchParams` (useSearchParams) if within trip. Next 15 client page can use `useSearchParams`; requires Suspense? In app router, useSearchParams in client component is allowed but triggers CSR bailout; simplest: `new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("date")` in useState initializer guarded by typeof window. But SSR hydration mismatch potential; app pages are client-rendered; useState initializer runs both server (no window) and client (window with date) → hydration mismatch text (formatDate(day)). Could use useEffect to set day from URL after mount. That's safe. Add:

```tsx
useEffect(() => {
  const requested = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("date");
  if (requested && /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(requested)) setDay(requested);
}, []);
```

Then F36 link `/pulse?date=${batch.for_date}`. Also add dismiss button with localStorage.

"use client";

import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { CheckCircle2, Circle, ListChecks, Plus, Scale, Send, UserRound } from "lucide-react";
import { useParams } from "next/navigation";
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";

import {
  Badge,
  Button,
  Card,
  EmptyState,
  ErrorState,
  Field,
  FlowNote,
  Input,
  PageSkeleton,
  SectionTitle,
  Select,
  Textarea,
} from "@/components/ui";
import { api } from "@/lib/api";
import { useMembers, useTasks } from "@/lib/hooks";
import { useToasts } from "@/lib/store";
import { cn, errorMessage } from "@/lib/utils";

export default function TasksPage() {
  const params = useParams<{ tripId: string }>();
  const tripId = typeof params?.tripId === "string" ? params.tripId : "";
  const tasks = useTasks(tripId);
  const members = useMembers(tripId);
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const { push } = useToasts();

  const [title, setTitle] = useState("");
  const [description, setDescription] = useState("");
  const [assignee, setAssignee] = useState("");

  const people = useMemo(
    () => (members.data?.items ?? []).map((member) => ({ id: member.user?.id || "", name: member.display_name })).filter((entry) => entry.id),
    [members.data],
  );

  const nameFor = (id: string | null) => people.find((person) => person.id === id)?.name || "Unassigned";

  const refresh = () => queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["tasks", tripId] });

  const createTask = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () =>
      api(`/api/trips/${tripId}/tasks`, {
        method: "POST",
        body: { title, description: description || null, assignee_id: assignee || null },
      }),
    onSuccess: () => {
      push("Task added", "Assignees can mark it done.", "success");
      setTitle("");
      setDescription("");
      setAssignee("");
      refresh();
    },
    onError: (error) => push("Could not add task", errorMessage(error), "error"),
  });

  const updateTask = useMutation({
    mutationFn: ({ taskId, body }: { taskId: string; body: Record<string, unknown> }) =>
      api(`/api/trips/${tripId}/tasks/${taskId}`, { method: "PATCH", body }),
    onSuccess: () => refresh(),
    onError: (error) => push("Could not update task", errorMessage(error), "error"),
  });

  const items = tasks.data?.items ?? [];
  const open = items.filter((task) => task.status !== "done");
  const done = items.filter((task) => task.status === "done");

  const load = useMemo(() => {
    const counts = new Map<string, number>();
    open.forEach((task) => {
      const key = task.assignee_id || "unassigned";
      counts.set(key, (counts.get(key) || 0) + 1);
    });
    return Array.from(counts.entries()).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);
  }, [open]);

  if (tasks.isLoading) return <PageSkeleton />;
  if (tasks.error) {
    return <ErrorState error={tasks.error} retry={() => tasks.refetch()} />;
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5">
      <div>
        <p className="eyebrow">Planner load</p>
        <h2 className="mt-1 text-2xl">Share the planning work</h2>
        <p className="mt-1 max-w-prose text-sm text-muted">
          Tasks keep the invisible work visible. Assign owners so one person does not carry the whole plan.
        </p>
      </div>

      <Card className="space-y-3">
        <SectionTitle
          title="Load balance"
          hint="Open tasks per person — a nudge, not a score"
          action={<Scale size={16} className="text-faint" />}
        />
        {load.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-muted">No open tasks.</p>
        ) : (
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
            {load.map(([key, count]) => (
              <Badge key={key} tone={count >= 3 ? "ember" : "outline"}>
                {key === "unassigned" ? "Unassigned" : nameFor(key)} · {count}
              </Badge>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </Card>

      <Card className="space-y-3">
        <SectionTitle title="Add task" />
        <form
          className="space-y-3"
          onSubmit={(event) => {
            event.preventDefault();
            if (!title.trim()) return;
            createTask.mutate();
          }}
        >
          <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
            <Field label="Title">
              <Input value={title} onChange={(event) => setTitle(event.target.value)} placeholder="Book the museum tickets" />

#### Thinking

Now let me update `recommendation_out` for F48. Design:
- Signature: `recommendation_out(rec, activity, place=None, destination=None)`.
- Derive place from activity if place not given? Better: keep explicit. But the serializer can fall back to `activity.place`? No, no relationship defined probably. Let's check discovery semantics: `respect_note` present only when place.fragile. Also need honest representation of fragile place with no note: UI shows "No respect guidance recorded yet." I'll include `fragile` in place already. For top-level, add `respect` dict:

```python
def recommendation_out(rec, activity, place=None, destination=None):
    return {
        ...,
        "activity": activity_out(activity, place, destination) if activity else None,
        "respect": _respect_out(activity, place),
    }

def _respect_out(activity, place):
    fragile = bool(activity.fragile or (place and place.fragile))
    if not fragile:
        return {
            "fragile": False,
            "guidance": None,
            "status": "not_applicable",
            "note": "This activity is not flagged as a fragile place.",
        }
    guidance = place.respect_note if place else None
    if guidance:
        return {"fragile": True, "guidance": guidance, "status": "guidance_available", "source": "place record"}
    return {
        "fragile": True,
        "guidance": None,
        "status": "no_guidance_recorded",
        "note": "This place is flagged as fragile but has no respect guidance recorded yet.",
    }
```

Hmm, "not_applicable" note may be noisy. Keep the top-level minimal for non-fragile: `{"fragile": False, "guidance": None, "status": "not_applicable"}`. Avoid overengineering? The user asks "represent missing information honestly", "avoid exposing sensitive local info". Respect note is public place info (already exposed via place_out). Fine.

Then `_batch_out` bulk loads places by `activity.place_id`.

219	def rank_activity(
220	    activity: Activity,
221	    contexts: list[MemberContext],
222	    *,
223	    base_lat: float,
224	    base_lon: float,
225	    coords: tuple[float, float],
226	    target_member_index: int | None,
227	    mode: str,
228	) -> RankedActivity | None:
229	    if not contexts:
230	        return None
231	    lat, lon = coords
232	    distance = haversine_km(base_lat, base_lon, lat, lon) if (lat or lon) else 0.0
233	    travel = travel_minutes(distance)
234	    round_trip = travel * 2
235	    vector = _activity_vector(activity)
236	    exclusions: dict[str, str] = {}
237	    fits: list[float] = []
238	
239	    for ctx in contexts:
240	        needed_time = activity.duration_minutes + round_trip
241	        hard_budget = ctx.hard_budget
242	        if hard_budget is not None and activity.price_estimate > hard_budget:
243	            exclusions[ctx.label] = "budget"
244	            continue
245	        if ctx.radius_km is not None and distance > ctx.radius_km:
246	            exclusions[ctx.label] = "radius"
247	            continue
248	        if ctx.available_minutes is not None and needed_time > ctx.available_minutes:
249	            exclusions[ctx.label] = "time"
250	            continue
251	        if ctx.needs_wheelchair_access and activity.wheelchair_accessible is False:
252	            exclusions[ctx.label] = "accessibility"
253	            continue
254	
255	        interest = 0.2 + 0.8 * _cosine(vector, _member_dna_for_today(ctx))
256	        soft_budget = ctx.soft_budget
257	        if soft_budget:
258	            budget_fit = clamp(1 - (activity.price_estimate / soft_budget), 0, 1)
259	        else:
260	            budget_fit = clamp(1 - activity.price_estimate / 150, 0, 1)
261	        energy_fit = clamp(1 - max(0, activity.effort - ctx.energy) / 4, 0, 1)
262	        if ctx.available_minutes:
263	            time_fit = clamp(1 - (needed_time / ctx.available_minutes) * 0.85, 0.1, 1)
264	        else:
265	            time_fit = clamp(1 - round_trip / 180, 0.2, 1)
266	        if not ctx.accessibility:
267	            access_fit = 1.0
268	        elif activity.wheelchair_accessible is True:
269	            access_fit = 1.0
270	        elif activity.wheelchair_accessible is None:
271	            access_fit = 0.45
272	        else:
273	            access_fit = 1.0  # non-wheelchair needs are not matched to a field yet

275	        fit = 100 * (

278	            + 0.10 * energy_fit
279	            + 0.10 * time_fit

281	        )
282	        fits.append(round(fit, 1))

286	
287	    average = sum(fits) / len(fits)

291	
292	    uncertainty = 0.0

294	        uncertainty += 8.0

304	    budget_penalty = clamp(activity.price_estimate / max(1, avg_cap) * 6, 0, 8)

536	def generate_recommendations(
537	    db: Session,
538	    trip: Trip,
539	    members: list[TripMember],
540	    *,
541	    mode: str,
542	    for_date: date,
543	    limit: int = 6,
544	) -> dict:
545	    if mode not in MODE_META:
546	        mode = "everyone_wins"
547	    contexts = build_member_contexts(db, trip, members, for_date)
548	    if not contexts:

550	    if not trip.destination_id:

552	            "items": [],
553	            "error": "Set a destination for this trip before generating group recommendations.",
554	        }

561	    )

567	                db.get(Place, activity.place_id) if activity.place_id else None
568	            )
569	        place = place_cache[activity.place_id]
570	        return (place.lat, place.lon) if place else (0.0, 0.0)
571	
572	    confirmed = (
573	        db.query(ItineraryItem)
574	        .filter(
575	            ItineraryItem.trip_id == trip.id,
576	            ItineraryItem.status == "confirmed",
577	        )
578	        .all()
579	    )
580	    planned_activity_ids = {item.activity_id for item in confirmed if item.activity_id}
581	
582	    target_index: int | None = None
583	    target_ctx: MemberContext | None = None
584	    if mode == "your_turn":
585	        representation = _representation_scores(db, contexts, confirmed)
586	        if any(score > 0 for score in representation):
587	            target_index = min(range(len(contexts)), key=lambda i: representation[i])
588	        target_ctx = contexts[target_index] if target_index is not None else None
589	
590	    ranked: list[RankedActivity] = []
591	    exclusion_reasons: dict[str, int] = {}
592	    seen: dict[str, int] = {}

86	def _replacement_filter(kind: str, original: Activity | None):
87	    def predicate(activity: Activity) -> bool:
88	        if kind == "rain" and not activity.indoor:
89	            return False
90	        if kind == "fatigue" and activity.effort > 2:
91	            return False
92	        if kind == "budget":
93	            if original and original.price_estimate > 0:
94	                return activity.price_estimate <= max(original.price_estimate * 0.75, 12)
95	            return activity.price_estimate <= 20
96	        if kind == "time" and original:
97	            return activity.duration_minutes <= max(30, original.duration_minutes)
98	        return True
99	
100	    return predicate

309	def compromise(
310	    db: Session,
311	    trip: Trip,
312	    members: list[TripMember],
313	    option_a: list[str],
314	    option_b: list[str],
315	) -> dict:
316	    """Build a fair-trade compromise from two competing options (F45)."""
317	
318	    by_id = {
319	        activity.id: activity
320	        for activity in db.query(Activity).filter(Activity.id.in_(set(option_a + option_b) or {""})).all()
321	    }
322	    a = [by_id[aid] for aid in option_a if aid in by_id]
323	    b = [by_id[aid] for aid in option_b if aid in by_id]
324	    if not a or not b:
325	        return {
326	            "status": "needs_options",
327	            "message": "Provide at least one activity for each side of the negotiation.",
328	        }
329	
330	    rec = generate_recommendations(
331	        db, trip, members, mode="everyone_wins", for_date=date.today(), limit=12
332	    )
333	    ranked = {item.activity.id: item for item in rec.get("items", [])}
334	
335	    def best(pool: list[Activity]):
336	        scored = [ranked[activity.id] for activity in pool if activity.id in ranked]
337	        return max(scored, key=lambda item: item.minimum_fit) if scored else None
338	
339	    best_a = best(a)
340	    best_b = best(b)
341	    if not best_a or not best_b:
342	        return {
343	            "status": "no_feasible_option",
344	            "message": "One or both options violate a hard constraint for at least one member.",
345	        }
346	
347	    compromise_choice = best_a if best_a.minimum_fit >= best_b.minimum_fit else best_b
348	    other = best_b if compromise_choice is best_a else best_a
349	    benefits = sorted(
350	        {
351	            normalize_tag(tag)
352	            for tag in (compromise_choice.activity.tags or [])
353	            if tag
354	        }
355	    )[:3]
356	    return {
357	        "status": "compromise_ready",
358	        "compromise": {
359	            "activity_id": compromise_choice.activity.id,
360	            "name": compromise_choice.activity.name,
361	            "minimum_fit": compromise_choice.minimum_fit,
362	            "average_fit": compromise_choice.average_fit,
363	        },
364	        "alternative": {
365	            "activity_id": other.activity.id,
366	            "name": other.activity.name,
367	            "minimum_fit": other.minimum_fit,
368	            "average_fit": other.average_fit,
369	        },
