371	export function Modal({
372	  open,
373	  onClose,
374	  title,
375	  children,
376	  wide,
377	}: {
378	  open: boolean;
379	  onClose: () => void;
380	  title: string;
381	  children: ReactNode;
382	  wide?: boolean;
383	}) {
384	  useEffect(() => {
385	    if (!open) return;
386	    const handler = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
387	      if (event.key === "Escape") onClose();
388	    };
389	    window.addEventListener("keydown", handler);
390	    document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
391	    return () => {
392	      window.removeEventListener("keydown", handler);
393	      document.body.style.overflow = "";
394	    };
395	  }, [open, onClose]);
396	
397	  return (
398	    <AnimatePresence>
399	      {open ? (
400	        <motion.div
401	          className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-end justify-center bg-ink/40 p-0 backdrop-blur-sm sm:items-center sm:p-6"
402	          initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
403	          animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
404	          exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
405	          onClick={onClose}
406	        >
407	          <motion.div
408	            role="dialog"
409	            aria-modal="true"
410	            aria-label={title}
411	            initial={{ y: 40, opacity: 0 }}
412	            animate={{ y: 0, opacity: 1 }}
413	            exit={{ y: 24, opacity: 0 }}
414	            transition={{ duration: 0.28, ease: [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1] }}
415	            className={cn(
416	              "max-h-[92vh] w-full overflow-y-auto rounded-t-3xl border border-line bg-paper p-5 shadow-lift sm:rounded-3xl sm:p-6",
417	              wide ? "sm:max-w-2xl" : "sm:max-w-lg",
418	            )}
419	            onClick={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
420	          >
421	            <div className="mb-4 flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
422	              <h2 className="text-xl">{title}</h2>
423	              <button
424	                type="button"
425	                onClick={onClose}
426	                className="rounded-full p-1.5 text-muted hover:bg-ink/5"
427	                aria-label="Close"
428	              >
429	                <X size={18} />
430	              </button>
431	            </div>
432	            {children}
433	          </motion.div>
434	        </motion.div>
435	      ) : null}
436	    </AnimatePresence>
437	  );
438	}

For Modal focus trap:
```tsx
const panelRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
const titleId = useId();
const restoreRef = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null);

useEffect(() => {
  if (!open) return;
  restoreRef.current = document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null;
  const panel = panelRef.current;
  const focusables = () => panel?.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('a[href],button:not([disabled]),textarea:not([disabled]),input:not([disabled]),select:not([disabled]),[tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])') ?? [];
  const first = focusables()[0];
  // focus after paint
  requestAnimationFrame(() => (first ?? panel)?.focus({ preventScroll: true }));
  const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (e.key === "Escape") { e.stopPropagation(); onClose(); return; }
    if (e.key !== "Tab") return;
    const nodes = Array.from(focusables()).filter(n => n.offsetParent !== null);
    if (!nodes.length) { e.preventDefault(); return; }
    const idx = nodes.indexOf(document.activeElement as HTMLElement);
    if (e.shiftKey && (idx <= 0)) { e.preventDefault(); nodes[nodes.length-1].focus(); }
    else if (!e.shiftKey && (idx === -1 || idx === nodes.length-1)) { e.preventDefault(); nodes[0].focus(); }
  };
  window.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
  const prevOverflow = document.body.style.overflow;
  const prevPad = document.body.style.paddingRight;
  const sbw = window.innerWidth - document.documentElement.clientWidth;
  document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
  if (sbw > 0) document.body.style.paddingRight = `${sbw}px`;
  return () => {
    window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    document.body.style.overflow = prevOverflow;
    document.body.style.paddingRight = prevPad;
    restoreRef.current?.focus?.();
  };
}, [open, onClose]);
```

Now run typecheck to catch errors in ui.tsx early (Card no longer motion — but `motion` still used in Modal/Toasts so import fine). Check `LinkButton` type with `Omit<React.ComponentProps<typeof Link>...>` — React namespace needs import? We use `React.ComponentProps` — `React` is available via global JSX? In TS with `react-jsx`, `React` namespace is available only if imported. The file imports named types from "react" but not the `React` default. Using `React.ComponentProps` requires the React UMD global type, which is available if `allowUmdGlobalAccess` or via `@types/react` global namespace. In Next.js TS, `React` namespace is globally declared by @types/react, so `React.ComponentProps` works without import in most setups. Also `React.KeyboardEvent` used in SegmentedControl. It typically works because @types/react declares `declare global { namespace React {...} }`? Actually @types/react declares `declare namespace React` at module scope and also `declare global { namespace JSX }`. Using `React.X` without import relies on the UMD global declaration `export = React; export as namespace React;` which TS allows in non-module files only... but our file is a module. With `export as namespace React`, TS permits UMD global access in modules only if `allowUmdGlobalAccess` is true. Risky.

Safer: import type { ComponentProps, KeyboardEvent as ReactKeyboardEvent } from "react". Let me do that and replace usages.

const DESTINATION_IMAGES = [
  "/images/destinations/kyoto.jpg",
  "/images/destinations/lisbon.jpg",
  "/images/destinations/reykjavik.jpg",
  "/images/destinations/coast.jpg",
];

const MATCHERS: { test: RegExp; src: string }[] = [
  { test: /kyoto|japan|kansai/i, src: "/images/destinations/kyoto.jpg" },
  { test: /lisbon|lisboa|portugal/i, src: "/images/destinations/lisbon.jpg" },
  { test: /reykjav|iceland/i, src: "/images/destinations/reykjavik.jpg" },
  { test: /coast|shore|sea|island/i, src: "/images/destinations/coast.jpg" },
];

function hash(value: string) {
  let total = 0;
  for (let index = 0; index < value.length; index += 1) {
    total = (total * 31 + value.charCodeAt(index)) >>> 0;
  }
  return total;
}

export const HERO_IMAGE = "/images/hero-journey.jpg";

export function destinationImage(
  name?: string | null,
  country?: string | null,
  heroImage?: string | null,
) {
  if (heroImage) return heroImage;
  const haystack = `${name ?? ""} ${country ?? ""}`;
  const match = MATCHERS.find((entry) => entry.test.test(haystack));
  if (match) return match.src;
  return DESTINATION_IMAGES[hash(haystack || "safar") % DESTINATION_IMAGES.length];
}

export function destinationAlt(name?: string | null, country?: string | null) {
  if (!name) return "Destination";
  return country ? `${name}, ${country}` : name;
}

export function DestinationImage({
  name,
  country,
  heroImage,
  sizes,
  priority,
  className,
  overlay,
}: {
  name?: string | null;
  country?: string | null;
  heroImage?: string | null;

}) {

      <Image

        <span
          aria-hidden
          className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-ink/75 via-ink/15 to-transparent"
        />
      ) : null}

@router.get("/{trip_id}/activity")
def trip_activity(
    trip_id: str,
    limit: int = Query(default=30, ge=1, le=100),
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    rows = (
        db.query(AuditLog)
        .filter(AuditLog.trip_id == trip.id)
        .order_by(AuditLog.created_at.desc())
        .limit(limit)
        .all()
    )
    return {
        "items": [
            {
                "id": row.id,
                "action": row.action,
                "entity_type": row.entity_type,
                "entity_id": row.entity_id,
                "detail": row.detail,
                "created_at": row.created_at,
            }
            for row in rows
        ]
    }


@router.get("/{trip_id}/pact")
def get_pact(
    trip_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    pact = db.query(JourneyPact).filter(JourneyPact.trip_id == trip.id).first()
    if not pact:
        return {"pact": None}
    return {
        "pact": {
            "id": pact.id,
            "must_do": pact.must_do,
            "flexible": pact.flexible,
            # Budget limits are private. A member only ever sees their own.
            "individual_limits": (
                {user.id: pact.individual_limits[user.id]}
                if user.id in (pact.individual_limits or {})
                else {}
            ),
            "confirmed_times": pact.confirmed_times,
            "exceptions": pact.exceptions,
            "updated_at": pact.updated_at,
        }
    }


@router.put("/{trip_id}/pact")
def upsert_pact(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: PactUpsert,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user, {"owner", "admin"})
    pact = db.query(JourneyPact).filter(JourneyPact.trip_id == trip.id).first()
    if not pact:
        pact = JourneyPact(trip_id=trip.id, created_by=user.id)
        db.add(pact)
    pact.must_do = payload.must_do
    pact.flexible = payload.flexible
    # Individual limits are private. Merge rather than replace so an editor who
    # cannot see other members' limits never wipes them.
    merged_limits = dict(pact.individual_limits or {})
    merged_limits.update(payload.individual_limits or {})
    pact.individual_limits = merged_limits

44	function eachDay(start: string, end: string) {
45	  const days: string[] = [];
46	  const cursor = new Date(`${start.slice(0, 10)}T12:00:00`);
47	  const last = new Date(`${end.slice(0, 10)}T12:00:00`);
48	  while (cursor <= last && days.length < 60) {
49	    days.push(cursor.toISOString().slice(0, 10));
50	    cursor.setDate(cursor.getDate() + 1);
51	  }
52	  return days;
53	}

            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <LinkButton href={`${base}/assistant`} variant="secondary" size="sm">

345	                      "target_member",
346	                    ].includes(key),
347	                  )
348	                  .map(([key, value]) => (
349	                    <div key={key} className="rounded-xl border border-line bg-raised/60 px-3 py-2">
350	                      <p className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-editorial text-faint">
351	                        {titleCase(key)}
352	                      </p>
353	                      <p className="mt-0.5 text-[12.5px] text-muted">{String(value)}</p>
354	                    </div>
355	                  ))}
356	              </div>
357	              {(batch.meta.hard_constraints || []).length ? (
358	                <p className="text-[12px] leading-5 text-faint">
359	                  Hard constraints always applied: {(batch.meta.hard_constraints || []).join(", ")}.
360	                </p>
361	              ) : null}
362	              {batch.meta.protected_time?.protected_items?.length ? (
363	                <div className="rounded-xl border border-jade/30 bg-jade-soft/30 px-3 py-2">
364	                  <p className="text-[12px] font-medium text-jade">Protected time kept</p>

366	                    {batch.meta.protected_time.protected_items
367	                      .map((entry) => `${entry.start}–${entry.end} ${entry.title}`)
368	                      .join(" · ")}
369	                  </p>
370	                  <p className="mt-1 text-[11.5px] text-faint">
371	                    Suggestions only use the free windows left in the day
372	                    {batch.meta.protected_time.free_windows.length
373	                      ? `: ${batch.meta.protected_time.free_windows
374	                          .map((entry) => `${entry.start}–${entry.end}`)
375	                          .join(", ")}`
376	                      : "."}
377	                  </p>
378	                </div>
379	              ) : null}
380	              {batch.meta.exclusion_reasons && Object.keys(batch.meta.exclusion_reasons).length ? (

385	                    </Badge>

387	                </div>

390	          ) : null}
391	        </>
392	      )}

394	      <FlowNote icon={<Compass size={15} />}>
395	        The engine recommends; the group decides. Proposing an option opens a vote — the confirmed
396	        itinerary changes only after an owner or admin approves.
397	      </FlowNote>

399	      <Modal

403	      >
404	        {proposing ? (

441	            >
442	              Open proposal
443	            </Button>

451	function RecommendationCard({

#### Thinking

Engine redesign focused on clarity, not a rewrite:

1. Header → PageHeader (as h2, md) with mode explanation.
2. Mode cards → segmented large cards with icons in circles, numbered, check indicator, aria-pressed, shared description below.
3. Generation bar → card with fields + button. Add "Made at" info? Fine.

   - rank badge big number, title, compare metrics grid.
   - Add score bars already.
   - Add disclosure toggle with aria-expanded + aria-controls, chevron.
   - Feedback chips aria-pressed, disabled while pending? feedback mutation is not per-item; use `feedback.isPending` prop. Could pass `pending` to card. Simpler: pass `feedbackPending` and disable.
   - Consent toggle labelled; button "Consent" with aria-expanded.
   - Propose primary action.
5. Comparison: add a "compare" summary? Keep.
6. "How this was ranked" card looks fine — improve typography/labels.

Also the page currently has no "score" explanation legend. Add a small legend under modes: "Average fit = group mean; minimum fit = the member least served; fairness spread = gap." That explains trade-offs. Good.

104	  const handleUpload = async (file: File) => {
105	    setUploading(true);
106	    try {
107	      const form = new FormData();
108	      form.append("file", file);
109	      const result = await api<{ media_url: string; media_type: string }>(
110	        `/api/trips/${tripId}/media`,
111	        { method: "POST", body: form },
112	      );
113	      setMedia({ url: result.media_url, type: result.media_type });
114	      if (result.media_type.startsWith("image/")) setKind("photo");
115	      else if (result.media_type.startsWith("video/")) setKind("video");
116	      else setKind("voice");
117	      push("Uploaded", "Attach a memory to share it.", "success");
118	    } catch (error) {
119	      push("Upload failed", errorMessage(error), "error");
120	    } finally {
121	      setUploading(false);
122	    }
123	  };
124	
125	  const handleSubmit = () => {
126	    const isOffline = typeof navigator !== "undefined" && !navigator.onLine;
127	    if (saveOffline || isOffline) {
128	      offline.enqueue(tripId, {
129	        kind,
130	        text_content: text || null,
131	        media_url: media?.url || null,
132	        media_type: media?.type || null,
133	        visibility,
134	        captured_at: new Date().toISOString(),
135	        client_id: `offline-${Date.now()}`,
136	      });
137	      push("Saved offline", "It will sync when you reconnect from the Offline page.", "info");
138	      setText("");
139	      setMedia(null);
140	      setKind("text");
141	      return;
142	    }
143	    createMemory.mutate();
144	  };

149	  }

152

172	        </div>

174

177	        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
178	          {KINDS.map((entry) => (

180	              key={entry.value}
181	              type="button"
182	              onClick={() => setKind(entry.value)}

185	                kind === entry.value

320	function memoryIcon(kind: string) {
321	  if (kind === "photo") return <ImageIcon size={13} />;
322	  if (kind === "voice") return <Mic size={13} />;
323	  if (kind === "video") return <PlayCircle size={13} />;
324	  return <NotebookPen size={13} />;
325	}
326	
327	function MemoryCard({
328	  memory,
329	  isMine,
330	  onDelete,
331	}: {
332	  memory: Memory;
333	  isMine: boolean;
334	  onDelete: () => void;
335	}) {
336	  const mediaUrl =
337	    memory.media_url && memory.media_url.startsWith("/media/") ? `${API_URL}${memory.media_url}` : memory.media_url;
338	  const isImage = memory.media_type?.startsWith("image/") && mediaUrl;
339	
340	  return (
341	    <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-line bg-surface">
342	      {isImage ? (
343	        // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
344	        <img src={mediaUrl} alt={memory.caption || "Trip memory"} className="h-44 w-full object-cover" />
345	      ) : mediaUrl ? (
346	        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-line bg-raised px-3 py-2 text-[12px] text-muted">
347	          {memoryIcon(memory.kind)} {memory.media_type || "Attachment"}
348	        </div>
349	      ) : null}
350	      <div className="space-y-2 p-3.5">
351	        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
352	          <Badge tone="outline">{titleCase(memory.kind)}</Badge>
353	          {memory.visibility === "private" ? (
354	            <Badge tone="ember">
355	              <Lock size={10} /> Private
356	            </Badge>
357	          ) : (
358	            <Badge tone="jade">
359	              <Users size={10} /> Trip
360	            </Badge>
361	          )}
362	          {memory.ai_generated ? <Badge tone="neutral">AI captioned</Badge> : null}
363	        </div>
364	        {memory.text_content ? (
365	          <p className="whitespace-pre-line text-[13px] leading-6 text-ink">{memory.text_content}</p>
366	        ) : null}
367	        {memory.caption ? (
368	          <p className="rounded-lg bg-raised/60 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-[12px] italic leading-5 text-muted">
369	            {memory.caption}
370	          </p>
371	        ) : null}
372	        <p className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-1 text-[10.5px] text-faint">
373	          <span>{memory.author?.display_name || "Traveller"}</span>
374	          <span>{formatDateTime(memory.captured_at)}</span>
375	          {memory.lat !== null && memory.lon !== null ? (
376	            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5">
377	              <MapPin size={10} /> pinned
378	            </span>
379	          ) : null}
380	        </p>
381	        {isMine ? (
382	          <div className="flex justify-end border-t border-line pt-2">
383	            <button
384	              type="button"
385	              onClick={onDelete}
386	              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[12px] text-rose hover:underline"
387	            >
388	              <Trash2 size={11} /> Remove
389	            </button>
390	          </div>
391	        ) : null}
392	      </div>
393	    </div>
394	  );
395	}

474	function ProposalImpact({ tripId, proposalId }: { tripId: string; proposalId: string }) {
475	  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
476	  const detail = useQuery({
477	    queryKey: ["proposal-detail", tripId, proposalId],
478	    queryFn: () =>
479	      api<Proposal & {
480	        impact?: {
481	          cost_impact?: { total_delta: number; per_member_estimate: number; currency: string };
482	          budget_conflicts?: { reason: string; item: string }[];
483	          pact_conflicts?: { item: string; rule: string; resolution: string }[];
484	          schedule_conflicts?: {
485	            item: string;
486	            proposed?: string;
487	            reason: string;
488	            protected: boolean;
489	          }[];
490	        };
491	      }>(`/api/trips/${tripId}/proposals/${proposalId}`),
492	    enabled: open,
493	  });
494	
495	  return (
496	    <div className="border-t border-line pt-3">
497	      <button
498	        onClick={() => setOpen((value) => !value)}
499	        className="flex w-full items-center justify-between text-[12px] text-muted hover:text-ink"
500	      >
501	        <span>Impact if approved</span>
502	        <ChevronDown
503	          size={14}
504	          className={cn("transition-transform", open ? "rotate-180" : "")}
505	        />
506	      </button>
507	      {open ? (
508	        detail.isLoading ? (
509	          <p className="mt-2 text-[12px] text-faint">Calculating…</p>
510	        ) : detail.error ? (
511	          <p className="mt-2 text-[12px] text-rose">{(detail.error as Error).message}</p>
512	        ) : detail.data?.impact ? (
513	          <div className="mt-2 space-y-2 rounded-xl bg-raised/60 p-3 text-[12px] text-muted">
514	            {detail.data.impact.cost_impact ? (
515	              <p>
516	                Cost change:{" "}
517	                <span className="font-mono text-ink">
518	                  {formatMoney(
519	                    detail.data.impact.cost_impact.total_delta,
520	                    detail.data.impact.cost_impact.currency,
521	                  )}
522	                </span>{" "}
523	                total · {formatMoney(detail.data.impact.cost_impact.per_member_estimate, detail.data.impact.cost_impact.currency)} per member (estimate)
524	              </p>
525	            ) : null}
526	            {(detail.data.impact.pact_conflicts || []).map((conflict, index) => (
527	              <p key={`pact-${index}`} className="text-rose">
528	                Pact conflict: {conflict.item} — {conflict.resolution}
529	              </p>
530	            ))}
531	            {(detail.data.impact.budget_conflicts || []).map((conflict, index) => (
532	              <p key={`budget-${index}`} className="text-rose">
533	                Budget: {conflict.item} — {conflict.reason}
534	              </p>
535	            ))}
536	            {(detail.data.impact.schedule_conflicts || []).map((conflict, index) => (
537	              <p key={`schedule-${index}`} className="text-rose">
538	                {conflict.protected ? "Protected time" : "Schedule"}: {conflict.item}
539	                {conflict.proposed ? ` vs ${conflict.proposed}` : ""} — {conflict.reason}
540	              </p>
541	            ))}
542	            {!detail.data.impact.cost_impact ? (
543	              <p>No cost impact recorded for this proposal.</p>
544	            ) : null}
545	          </div>
546	        ) : (
547	          <p className="mt-2 text-[12px] text-faint">No impact data returned.</p>
548	        )
549	      ) : null}
550	    </div>
551	  );
552	}

const buttonSizes: Record<ButtonSize, string> = {
  sm: "h-8 px-3 text-[12.5px] rounded-full gap-1.5",
  md: "h-10 px-4 text-sm rounded-full gap-2",
  lg: "h-12 px-6 text-[15px] rounded-full gap-2",
};

export function Button({
  variant = "primary",
  size = "md",
  className,
  loading,
  children,
  type = "button",
  ...props
}: ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> & {
  variant?: ButtonVariant;
  size?: ButtonSize;
  loading?: boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <button
      type={type}
      aria-busy={loading || undefined}
      className={cn(
        "inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center whitespace-nowrap font-medium transition-[background-color,border-color,color,transform,opacity] duration-200 ease-editorial disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50",
        buttonVariants[variant],
        buttonSizes[size],
        className,
      )}
      disabled={props.disabled || loading}
      {...props}
    >
      {loading ? (
        <span
          aria-hidden
          className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin rounded-full border-2 border-current border-t-transparent"
        />
      ) : null}
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}

"use client";

import { zodResolver } from "@hookform/resolvers/zod";
import { ArrowRight, Compass, ShieldCheck } from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useRouter, useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";
import { Suspense, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useForm } from "react-hook-form";
import { z } from "zod";

import { Brand, ThemeToggle } from "@/components/AppShell";
import { Button, Field, Input } from "@/components/ui";
import { api } from "@/lib/api";
import { useAuth } from "@/lib/store";
import { errorMessage } from "@/lib/utils";
import type { User } from "@/lib/types";

const schema = z.object({
  email: z.string().email("Enter a valid email"),
  password: z.string().min(1, "Enter your password"),
});

type FormValues = z.infer<typeof schema>;

function LoginForm() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const next = searchParams.get("next") || "/dashboard";
  const setSession = useAuth((state) => state.setSession);
  const token = useAuth((state) => state.token);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (token) router.replace(next);
  }, [token, router, next]);

  const form = useForm<FormValues>({
    resolver: zodResolver(schema),
    defaultValues: { email: "", password: "" },
  });

  const onSubmit = async (values: FormValues) => {
    setSubmitting(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const result = await api<{ access_token: string; csrf_token: string; user: User }>(
        "/api/auth/login",
        { method: "POST", body: values },
      );
      setSession(result.access_token, result.user, result.csrf_token);
      router.replace(next.startsWith("/") ? next : "/dashboard");
    } catch (err) {
      setError(errorMessage(err));
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (

#### Thinking

Same chunk hashes failing even after clean rebuild — and the browser requests a `register/page-579c7e95555f184b.js` from `/login`?? That's bizarre. These look like stale prefetch requests cached by the *service worker*? Wait — maybe a service worker is installed from earlier offline feature and serving stale HTML for chunk paths! The app has `/offline` feature and likely a service worker (next-pwa or custom). A stale SW intercepts chunk requests and returns cached HTML with 400? Actually 400 comes from server (SW passthrough). But requests from /login for /register chunk indicate prefetching of routes (speculation rules) — plausible.

Key question: why does curl get 200 but Chrome 400? Maybe Chrome sends `Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, br` and no `RSC` header... Next static handler returns 400 if URL contains encoded parentheses? Chrome may percent-encode them: `app/(app)` becomes `app/%28app%29`. Hmm, in error text it shows `app/(app)` unencoded though.

Let me reproduce with curl using Chrome's UA and Accept-Encoding: br.

#### Tool: Bash

**Input:**

```json
{
  "command": "curl -s -o /dev/null -w \"ua:%{http_code}\\n\" -H \"User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/140.0.0.0 Safari/537.36\" -H \"Accept: */*\" -H \"Referer: http://localhost:3010/login\" \"http://localhost:3010/_next/static/chunks/app/(app)/layout-1ab449aaec2374c2.js\"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w \"br:%{http_code}\\n\" -H \"Accept-Encoding: br\" \"http://localhost:3010/_next/static/chunks/app/(app)/layout-1ab449aaec2374c2.js\"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w \"enc:%{http_code}\\n\" \"http://localhost:3010/_next/static/chunks/app/%28app%29/layout-1ab449aaec2374c2.js\"",
  "description": "Reproduce browser chunk request variants"
}
```

**Response:**

ua:200
br:200
enc:200

#### Thinking

All 200 from curl. So the 400 must come from something else in the browser — most likely a **service worker** with a stale precache that intercepts and returns a 400 response. Check navigator.serviceWorker registrations.

function eachDay(start: string, end: string) {
  const days: string[] = [];
  const cursor = new Date(`${start.slice(0, 10)}T12:00:00`);
  const last = new Date(`${end.slice(0, 10)}T12:00:00`);
  while (cursor <= last && days.length < 60) {
    days.push(cursor.toISOString().slice(0, 10));
    cursor.setDate(cursor.getDate() + 1);
  }
  return days;
}

## Phase 5 — Production security & infrastructure hardening (2026-11-19)

No new travel features. The 49 product features keep their status; this phase
changes how they are protected, persisted and operated. Full report:
`docs/SECURITY.md`; audit trail: `docs/AUDIT.md` §15; runbook:
`docs/DEPLOYMENT.md`.

| Area | Implementation | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Sessions | HttpOnly access/refresh cookies, server-side `auth_sessions`, rotation with reuse detection, revocation, 2-minute WS ticket | `test_refresh_rotation_rejects_a_replayed_token`, `test_logout_revokes_the_session_for_existing_tokens`; browser login/logout |
| CSRF | Double-submit `safar_csrf` + `X-CSRF-Token`, constant-time compare | `test_cookie_sessions_require_csrf_for_writes` |
| Database isolation | RLS on 55 tables, 220 policies, FORCE, fail-closed GUCs, non-owner role | direct SQL probes; 68 tests on PG |
| API hardening | Security headers, TrustedHost, body limit, per-bucket rate limits, harmless errors, docs off in production | 19 hardening tests |
| Uploads | Magic-byte sniffing; oversized/spoofed files rejected | `test_media_upload_rejects_a_spoofed_content_type` |
| Privacy | Erasure expanded, retention job, location consent required for precise coordinates | `test_account_deletion_erases_personal_data`, `test_retention_removes_only_expired_rows`, `test_precise_location_requires_the_privacy_toggle` |
| Secrets/config | No committed secrets; production guards for `SECRET_KEY`, CORS, cookies, docs, seeding; accurate `.env.example` | config review; `.env.example` |
| Recovery | `pg_dump -Fc` / `pg_restore` drill with schema, policy, row and RLS parity | `docs/DEPLOYMENT.md` §6 |

Phase 5 totals: `pytest` **68 passed on SQLite** and **68 passed on PostgreSQL
16.4 under FORCE RLS** · `vitest` 12 · `tsc` clean · `next build` clean.

### 15.4 Session changes and browser evidence

Cookies: HttpOnly `safar_access` (15 min, `/`), HttpOnly `safar_refresh`
(30 days, `/api/auth`, rotated), readable `safar_csrf` + `X-CSRF-Token`.
`Secure` in production, `SameSite=lax` default, `none` requires `Secure`.
WebSocket uses a two-minute `typ: ws` ticket bound to the session.

Production build, 2026-11-19: login at `/login` → `POST /api/auth/login` 200 →
`/dashboard` → `/trips/<id>/itinerary` renders the confirmed plan.
`document.cookie` contains only `safar_csrf`. Sign out → `/login?next=%2Fprofile`,
cookies cleared, `/api/auth/me` **401**, `/api/auth/refresh` **401**.

### 15.5 Remaining risks

External review not performed; Docker images not built (no Docker CLI); TLS
and proxy path untested; rate limiter is per-process; WebSocket token is in the
query string (2-minute ticket, WSS/proxy redaction required); no load testing;
no PITR; prepared PG test mode needs a fresh database; optional monitoring not
configured; seeded demo credentials must stay disabled in production. Full
severity/mitigation table: `docs/SECURITY.md` §7.

### 15.6 Production readiness verdict

**Hardened and PostgreSQL-verified, not production-certified.** The
application-level and database-level controls are implemented and tested on
both engines. Docker/TLS/CI execution, external review, PITR and load
testing remain outstanding, and the claim of production readiness is withheld
until they are completed. Conditions are listed in `docs/SECURITY.md` §8.

export function Button({
  variant = "primary",
  size = "md",
  className,
  loading,
  children,
  type = "button",
  ...props
}: ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> & {
  variant?: ButtonVariant;
  size?: ButtonSize;
  loading?: boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <button
      type={type}
      aria-busy={loading || undefined}
      className={cn(
        "inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center whitespace-nowrap font-medium transition-[background-color,border-color,color,transform,opacity] duration-200 ease-editorial disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50",
        buttonVariants[variant],
        buttonSizes[size],
        className,
      )}
      disabled={props.disabled || loading}
      {...props}
    >
      {loading ? (
        <span
          aria-hidden
          className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin rounded-full border-2 border-current border-t-transparent"
        />
      ) : null}
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}

export function LinkButton({
  href,
  variant = "primary",
  size = "md",
  className,
  children,
  ...rest
}: {
  href: string;
  variant?: ButtonVariant;
  size?: ButtonSize;
  className?: string;
  children: ReactNode;
} & Omit<ComponentProps<typeof Link>, "href" | "className" | "children">) {
  return (
    <Link
      href={href}
      className={cn(
        "inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center whitespace-nowrap font-medium transition-[background-color,border-color,color,transform] duration-200 ease-editorial",

        buttonSizes[size],
        className,
      )}
      {...rest}
    >

    </Link>
  );
}

export function PageHeader({
  eyebrow,
  title,
  description,
  actions,
  meta,
  className,
  size = "lg",
  as: Heading = "h1",
}: {
  eyebrow?: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  actions?: ReactNode;
  meta?: ReactNode;
  className?: string;
  size?: "lg" | "md";
  as?: "h1" | "h2";
}) {
  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        "flex flex-col gap-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-end sm:justify-between",
        size === "lg" ? "gap-5" : "gap-3",
        className,
      )}
    >
      <div className="min-w-0 space-y-2">
        {eyebrow ? <p className="eyebrow">{eyebrow}</p> : null}
        <Heading
          className={cn(
            "text-balance leading-[1.08]",
            size === "lg" ? "text-[1.9rem] sm:text-[2.4rem]" : "text-2xl sm:text-[1.7rem]",
          )}
        >
          {title}
        </Heading>
        {description ? (
          <p className="max-w-prose text-sm leading-6 text-muted">{description}</p>
        ) : null}
        {meta ? <div className="pt-0.5">{meta}</div> : null}
      </div>
      {actions ? (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 sm:justify-end">{actions}</div>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

export function SectionTitle({
  title,
  hint,
  action,
  level = 2,
  className,
}: {
  title: string;
  hint?: string;
  action?: ReactNode;
  level?: 2 | 3;
  className?: string;
}) {
  const Heading = level === 2 ? "h2" : "h3";
  return (
    <div className={cn("mb-4 flex items-end justify-between gap-4", className)}>
      <div className="min-w-0">
        <Heading className={level === 2 ? "text-xl leading-tight" : "text-lg leading-tight"}>
          {title}
        </Heading>
        {hint ? <p className="mt-1 text-[12.5px] leading-5 text-muted">{hint}</p> : null}
      </div>
      {action ? <div className="shrink-0">{action}</div> : null}
    </div>
  );
}

## 2. Frontend structure

```
apps/web/

    (app)/                     authenticated shell
      dashboard/               Decision Load Governor home
      discover/, discover/[destinationId]/
      trips/new/
      trips/[tripId]/          TripShell pages:
        page.tsx               overview + next action
        itinerary, voting, pulse, engine, twin, rescue, insights,
        map, places, places/[activityId], evidence/[activityId],
        memories, memories/studio, memories/replay,
        expenses, members, pact, tasks, branches, watch,
        inspirations, ground, missions, offline, assistant, more
      assistant, profile, settings, notifications, thread,
      circles, circles/[circleId], contributors, connections, admin
    invite/[token]/
    login, register, page.tsx (landing)
  components/                  AppShell, ui primitives (Card, Badge, Stat,
                               Toggle, PageHeader, FlowNote, EmptyState…)
  lib/
    api.ts                     fetch wrapper; token from Zustand; 401 event
    hooks.ts                   TanStack Query hooks per endpoint
    realtime.ts                WebSocket client with heartbeat + invalidation
    store.ts                   auth (persist), theme, toasts, offline queue
    types.ts                   shared API response types
    utils.ts                   formatting, phase, DNA labels
  tests/                       Vitest unit tests
```

Every trip page is a client component that reads `useParams()` and fetches
through `lib/hooks.ts`. Mutations invalidate the relevant query keys, and the
WebSocket channel additionally invalidates on server events.

services/api/

    core/                      config, security, deps, logging, middleware,
                               rate limit, cookies, realtime hub
    db/                        engine/session + per-transaction RLS context

# SAFAR — Phase 7: Advanced AI/ML Intelligence & Real-World Integrations

SAFAR has completed six major development phases:

1. Technical audit and stabilisation.
2. Feature validation and integration testing.
3. Functional gap completion.
4. Production security hardening.
5. Premium UI/UX transformation.
6. Responsive and accessibility improvements.

Your next task is to strengthen SAFAR's actual AI/ML capabilities and introduce carefully selected real-world integrations.

This is NOT a request to add superficial AI features.

The objective is to make SAFAR genuinely intelligent, context-aware, adaptive and useful.

IMPORTANT:
- Inspect the existing architecture before making changes.
- Preserve all existing working features.
- Do not replace deterministic systems that already work well.
- Do not introduce fake AI responses or hardcoded predictions.
- Do not send private user information to external AI providers without explicit consent.
- Do not expose API keys to the frontend.
- Do not introduce paid services without documenting costs and obtaining approval.
- Every AI-generated result must be distinguishable from verified information.

## 1. AI architecture assessment

First inspect the existing AI/ML architecture.

Review:
- Journey DNA.
- Group Experience Engine.
- Recommendation ranking.
- Grounded retrieval assistant.
- Crowd forecasting.
- Place Pulse.
- Dream Import.
- Memory Studio.
- Journey Replay.
- Trip Rescue.
- Decision Load Governor.

Identify which systems genuinely benefit from machine learning or LLM integration.

Create an AI architecture proposal before implementation.

For each component specify:
- Current implementation.
- Proposed improvement.
- Model or algorithm.
- Required dataset.
- Training or inference requirements.
- Privacy implications.
- Evaluation metrics.
- Fallback behaviour.

## 2. F17 — Advanced Dream Import

Current limitation: structural text parsing only.

Investigate adding:
- OCR for screenshots.
- Image understanding for travel inspiration.
- Extraction of destinations, activities, dates and budgets.
- Link metadata extraction where permitted.
- Structured candidate generation.

Requirements:
- Treat extracted information as suggestions, not verified facts.
- Allow users to review and approve extracted candidates.
- Preserve source references.
- Handle unsupported links gracefully.
- Avoid uploading private images to external services without consent.

## 3. F22 — Multilingual Assistant

Current limitation: English-only answers.

Implement a proper multilingual architecture.

Requirements:
- Detect the user's language.
- Support translation of user queries.
- Generate responses in the requested language.
- Preserve destination names and important travel terminology.
- Handle mixed-language messages.
- Allow users to select their preferred language.
- Provide a graceful fallback when a language is unsupported.

Do not simply translate interface labels and claim the assistant is multilingual.

Test actual multilingual conversations.

## 4. Improve the Grounded Travel Assistant

Make the assistant more context-aware.

It should understand:
- Current trip.
- Travel dates.
- Destination.
- User preferences.
- Group preferences where consent permits.
- Existing itinerary.
- Budget constraints.
- Protected time.

It should:
- Answer questions using available trusted information.
- Explain recommendation reasoning.
- Distinguish facts from estimates.
- Identify missing information.
- Ask clarifying questions when necessary.
- Never invent opening hours, prices, availability or safety conditions.

Consequential itinerary changes must always require user approval.

## 5. Improve the Recommendation Intelligence

Investigate improvements to:
- Journey DNA ranking.
- Group fairness scoring.
- Context-aware recommendations.
- Preference adaptation.
- Feedback-based ranking.
- Constraint optimisation.

Evaluate recommendations using measurable metrics.

For the Group Experience Engine, preserve:
- Everyone Wins.
- Your Turn.
- Surprise Us.

Measure fairness, preference satisfaction, constraint violations and recommendation diversity.

Do not sacrifice explainability for model complexity.

## 6. F21 — Crowd Forecasting

Improve the existing forecasting system.

Requirements:
- Evaluate the existing minimum-report threshold.
- Investigate time-aware and location-aware features.
- Implement confidence calibration where sufficient data exists.
- Detect stale and anomalous reports.
- Separate observed data from predicted data.
- Provide honest insufficient-data states.

Do not invent crowd observations.

## 7. External provider integrations

Evaluate suitable providers for:

- Weather forecasts.
- Maps and geospatial information.
- Translation.
- OCR and image understanding.
- Image storage.
- Email notifications.

Create a provider abstraction layer.

Requirements:
- Secure server-side API keys.
- Request timeouts.
- Rate limits.
- Caching where appropriate.
- Error handling.
- Provider failure fallbacks.
- Data provenance.
- Clear estimated/reported/verified/predicted labels.

Do not depend on one external provider for the entire application.

## 8. AI evaluation and testing

Create an evaluation suite.

Test:
- Hallucination resistance.
- Recommendation relevance.
- Group fairness.
- Multilingual response quality.
- Extraction accuracy.
- Forecast calibration.
- Privacy leakage.
- Latency.
- Provider failures.

Use controlled test datasets and documented evaluation criteria.

## 9. Documentation

Update:
- ARCHITECTURE.md.
- AUDIT.md.
- FEATURE_REGISTRY.md.
- AI_ML_ARCHITECTURE.md.
- .env.example.

Document:
- Models used.
- Providers used.
- Data flow.
- Training requirements.
- Inference process.
- Evaluation results.
- Privacy safeguards.
- Operating costs.
- Known limitations.

## 10. Final report

Provide:
1. AI systems improved.
2. Models and algorithms used.
3. External providers integrated.
4. F17 and F22 status.
5. Recommendation evaluation results.
6. Forecasting evaluation results.
7. Privacy and security verification.
8. Test results.
9. Remaining limitations.
10. Recommended deployment architecture.

Do not mark an AI feature complete simply because an LLM API has been connected.

The goal is to make SAFAR's intelligence genuinely useful, grounded, explainable and measurable.

def dream_import(db: Session, user_id: str, inspiration: SavedInspiration) -> dict:
    text = inspiration.content or ""
    destinations = db.query(Destination).all()
    activities = db.query(Activity).all()
    matches: list[dict] = []

    urls = _URL_PATTERN.findall(text)
    url_tokens: set[str] = set()
    for url in urls:
        url_tokens.update(_url_tokens(url))
    # Match names in prose, not inside URLs: a link's path is handled separately
    # so its evidence is reported honestly.
    prose = _URL_PATTERN.sub(" ", text)

    for destination in destinations:
        name_pattern = _phrase_pattern(destination.name)
        slug_pattern = _phrase_pattern((destination.slug or "").replace("-", " "))
        if _mentions(name_pattern, prose) or _mentions(slug_pattern, prose):
            matches.append(
                {
                    "type": "destination",
                    "id": destination.id,
                    "name": destination.name,
                    "confidence": 0.9,
                    "evidence": "Destination name appears in the text.",
                }
            )
        elif url_tokens and _name_in_url(destination.name, url_tokens):
            matches.append(
                {
                    "type": "destination",
                    "id": destination.id,
                    "name": destination.name,
                    "confidence": 0.7,
                    "evidence": "Destination name appears in the link path; the page itself was not read.",
                }
            )
        else:
            for tag in destination.tags or []:
                if _mentions(_phrase_pattern(str(tag)), prose):
                    matches.append(
                        {
                            "type": "destination_hint",
                            "id": destination.id,
                            "name": destination.name,
                            "confidence": 0.55,
                            "evidence": f"Interest keyword '{tag}' matches this destination.",
                        }
                    )
                    break

    for activity in activities:
        if _mentions(_phrase_pattern(activity.name), prose):
            matches.append(
                {
                    "type": "activity",
                    "id": activity.id,
                    "name": activity.name,
                    "confidence": 0.85,
                    "evidence": "Activity name appears in the text.",
                }
            )

    interest_terms = {
        "food",
        "temple",
        "beach",
        "hiking",
        "art",
        "market",
        "museum",
        "nature",
        "shopping",
        "nightlife",
        "photography",
        "street food",
    }
    for raw_tag in _HASHTAG_PATTERN.findall(text):
        interest_terms.add(raw_tag.replace("-", " ").replace("_", " "))
    for term in sorted(interest_terms):
        if _mentions(_phrase_pattern(term), prose) and not any(
            match["name"].lower() == term for match in matches
        ):
            matches.append(
                {
                    "type": "interest",
                    "id": None,
                    "name": term,
                    "confidence": 0.4,
                    "evidence": f"Keyword '{term}' found; requires your confirmation.",
                }
            )

    for match in _BUDGET_PATTERN.finditer(text):
        symbol, amount, bare_amount, code = match.groups()
        value = amount or bare_amount
        if not value:
            continue
        label = f"{symbol or code.upper()} {value}".replace("  ", " ")
        matches.append(
            {
                "type": "budget_hint",
                "id": None,
                "name": label,
                "confidence": 0.5,
                "evidence": "Budget mention found; confirm it before using it as a filter.",
            }
        )

    lowered = prose.lower()
    for month in _MONTHS:
        if _mentions(_phrase_pattern(month), lowered):
            matches.append(
                {
                    "type": "travel_window",
                    "id": None,
                    "name": month.capitalize(),
                    "confidence": 0.35,
                    "evidence": "Month mentioned; add exact dates yourself.",
                }
            )

    seen = set()
    deduped = []
    for match in sorted(matches, key=lambda item: item["confidence"], reverse=True):
        key = (match["type"], match["name"])
        if key in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(key)
        deduped.append(match)

    extraction = {
        "matches": deduped[:40],
        "status": "needs_confirmation",
        "notes": [
            "Extraction reads the text you supplied with word-boundary matching, URL paths, hashtags, budget mentions and month names. It only proposes candidates; nothing is added to a trip automatically.",
        ],
        "limitations": [],
        "metadata": {
            "source_hosts": sorted(
                {url.split("//", 1)[-1].split("/", 1)[0] for url in urls}
            ),
            "hashtags": sorted({tag.lower() for tag in _HASHTAG_PATTERN.findall(text)}),
        },
    }
    if inspiration.source_type == "image_url":
        extraction["limitations"].append(
            "Image understanding / OCR is not configured on this deployment. The image itself was not analysed."
        )
    if inspiration.source_type == "link":
        extraction["limitations"].append(
            "Link fetching is not configured. Only the URL string you provided was inspected."
        )
    inspiration.extracted = extraction
    return extraction

from datetime import date

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.core.deps import get_current_user, get_db, get_trip_and_member
from app.core.realtime import manager
from app.models import (
    Activity,
    ItineraryItem,
    Place,
    Profile,
    Trip,
    TripMember,
    TripPulse,
    User,
)
from app.schemas.schemas import PulseIn
from app.services.common import audit, event_payload, normalize_tag
from app.services.engine import BUDGET_COMFORT_CAP
from app.services.geo import haversine_km, travel_minutes
from app.services.serializers import pulse_out

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/trips", tags=["pulse"])


def _pulse_rows(db: Session, trip_id: str, day: date) -> list[TripPulse]:
    return (
        db.query(TripPulse)
        .filter(TripPulse.trip_id == trip_id, TripPulse.pulse_date == day)
        .order_by(TripPulse.created_at)
        .all()
    )


def _affected_items(db: Session, trip: Trip, member: TripMember, pulse: TripPulse) -> list[dict]:
    """Constraint Compass (F35): exactly what today's change puts at risk."""
    profile = db.query(Profile).filter(Profile.user_id == member.user_id).first()
    accessibility = list(member.accessibility_needs or [])
    if not accessibility and profile:
        accessibility = list(profile.accessibility_needs or [])
    needs_wheelchair = any(
        "wheel" in need.lower() or "mobility" in need.lower() for need in accessibility
    )
    items = (
        db.query(ItineraryItem)
        .filter(
            ItineraryItem.trip_id == trip.id,
            ItineraryItem.day == pulse.pulse_date,
            ItineraryItem.status == "confirmed",
        )
        .order_by(ItineraryItem.start_time)
        .all()
    )
    affected = []
    for item in items:
        if item.is_protected:
            continue
        activity = db.get(Activity, item.activity_id) if item.activity_id else None
        if not activity:
            continue
        place = db.get(Place, activity.place_id) if activity.place_id else None
        distance = (
            haversine_km(trip.base_lat, trip.base_lon, place.lat, place.lon)
            if place
            else 0.0
        )
        travel = travel_minutes(distance)
        reasons = []
        if pulse.radius_km is not None and distance > pulse.radius_km:
            reasons.append(
                f"{distance:.1f} km away, beyond today's {pulse.radius_km:.0f} km radius."
            )
        if (
            pulse.available_minutes is not None
            and activity.duration_minutes + travel * 2 > pulse.available_minutes
        ):
            reasons.append(
                f"Needs about {activity.duration_minutes + travel * 2} minutes including travel; "
                f"you have {pulse.available_minutes}."
            )
        cap = BUDGET_COMFORT_CAP.get(pulse.budget_comfort)
        if cap is not None and activity.price_estimate > cap:
            reasons.append(
                f"Estimated cost {activity.currency} {activity.price_estimate:.0f} is above today's comfort level."
            )
        if activity.effort > pulse.energy + 1:
            reasons.append(
                f"Effort {activity.effort}/5 is high for today's energy {pulse.energy}/5."
            )
        if needs_wheelchair and activity.wheelchair_accessible is not True:
            reasons.append(
                "Accessibility is not confirmed for this activity, which your profile requires."
            )
        if reasons:
            affected.append(
                {
                    "item_id": item.id,
                    "title": item.title,
                    "start_time": item.start_time,
                    "reasons": reasons,
                }
            )
    return affected


@router.get("/{trip_id}/pulse")
def get_pulse(
    trip_id: str,
    day: date | None = Query(default=None),
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = get_trip_and_member(trip_id, db, user)
    pulse_date = day or date.today()
    rows = _pulse_rows(db, trip.id, pulse_date)
    members = {
        member.user_id: member
        for member in db.query(TripMember)
        .filter(TripMember.trip_id == trip.id, TripMember.status == "active")

41	def _detect_intent(message: str) -> str:

49	def _today_or_next(items: list[ItineraryItem]) -> tuple[date | None, list[ItineraryItem]]:
50	    if not items:
51	        return None, []
52	    today = date.today()
53	    upcoming = [item for item in items if item.day >= today]
54	    pool = upcoming or items
55	    day = sorted({item.day for item in pool})[0]
56	    return day, sorted(
57	        [item for item in pool if item.day == day], key=lambda item: item.start_time
58	    )

61	def _find_named_activity(db: Session, trip: Trip, message: str) -> Activity | None:
62	    if not trip.destination_id:
63	        return None
64	    lowered = message.lower()
65	    activities = (
66	        db.query(Activity).filter(Activity.destination_id == trip.destination_id).all()
67	    )
68	    for activity in activities:
69	        tokens = [token for token in re.split(r"[^a-z0-9]+", activity.name.lower()) if len(token) > 3]
70	        if activity.name.lower() in lowered or (tokens and all(token in lowered for token in tokens[:2])):
71	            return activity
72	    return None

109	def _dna_from_profile(profile: Profile | None) -> dict[str, float]:
110	    scores = {dimension: 5.0 for dimension in DNA_DIMENSIONS}
111	    if not profile:
112	        return scores
113	    for interest in profile.interests or []:
114	        key = normalize_tag(interest)
115	        if key in scores:
116	            scores[key] = 8.0
117	    if profile.budget_level == "budget":
118	        scores["budget"] = 8.0
119	        scores["luxury"] = 3.0
120	    elif profile.budget_level == "luxury":
121	        scores["luxury"] = 9.0
122	        scores["budget"] = 3.0
123	    elif profile.budget_level == "comfort":
124	        scores["luxury"] = 7.0
125	    return scores

194	def _activity_vector(activity: Activity) -> dict[str, float]:
195	    vector: dict[str, float] = {}
196	    for tag in activity.tags or []:

198	        vector[key] = vector.get(key, 0.0) + 1.0

202	def _cosine(a: dict[str, float], b: dict[str, float]) -> float:
203	    if not a or not b:
204	        return 0.0
205	    dot = sum(value * b.get(key, 0.0) for key, value in a.items())
206	    norm_a = sqrt(sum(value * value for value in a.values()))
207	    norm_b = sqrt(sum(value * value for value in b.values()))
208	    if norm_a == 0 or norm_b == 0:
209	        return 0.0
210	    return dot / (norm_a * norm_b)

213	def _member_dna_for_today(ctx: MemberContext) -> dict[str, float]:
214	    dna = dict(ctx.dna)
215	    if ctx.pulse:
216	        for interest in list(ctx.pulse.interests or []) + list(ctx.pulse.activity_prefs or []):
217	            key = normalize_tag(interest)
218	            if key in dna:
219	                # Today's mood boosts a dimension without mutating Journey DNA (F06).
220	                dna[key] = max(dna[key], 8.5)
221	    if ctx.pulse and ctx.pulse.energy <= 2:
222	        dna["relaxation"] = max(dna.get("relaxation", 5), 7.5)
223	        dna["adventure"] = min(dna.get("adventure", 5), 3)
224	    return dna

233	    coords: tuple[float, float],
234	    target_member_index: int | None,
235	    mode: str,
236	) -> RankedActivity | None:
237	    if not contexts:
238	        return None
239	    lat, lon = coords
240	    distance = haversine_km(base_lat, base_lon, lat, lon) if (lat or lon) else 0.0
241	    travel = travel_minutes(distance)
242	    round_trip = travel * 2
243	    vector = _activity_vector(activity)
244	    exclusions: dict[str, str] = {}
245	    fits: list[float] = []
246	
247	    for ctx in contexts:
248	        needed_time = activity.duration_minutes + round_trip
249	        hard_budget = ctx.hard_budget
250	        if hard_budget is not None and activity.price_estimate > hard_budget:
251	            exclusions[ctx.label] = "budget"
252	            continue
253	        if ctx.radius_km is not None and distance > ctx.radius_km:
254	            exclusions[ctx.label] = "radius"
255	            continue
256	        if ctx.available_minutes is not None and needed_time > ctx.available_minutes:
257	            exclusions[ctx.label] = "time"
258	            continue
259	        if ctx.needs_wheelchair_access and activity.wheelchair_accessible is False:
260	            exclusions[ctx.label] = "accessibility"
261	            continue
262	
263	        interest = 0.2 + 0.8 * _cosine(vector, _member_dna_for_today(ctx))
264	        soft_budget = ctx.soft_budget
265	        if soft_budget:
266	            budget_fit = clamp(1 - (activity.price_estimate / soft_budget), 0, 1)
267	        else:
268	            budget_fit = clamp(1 - activity.price_estimate / 150, 0, 1)
269	        energy_fit = clamp(1 - max(0, activity.effort - ctx.energy) / 4, 0, 1)
270	        if ctx.available_minutes:
271	            time_fit = clamp(1 - (needed_time / ctx.available_minutes) * 0.85, 0.1, 1)
272	        else:
273	            time_fit = clamp(1 - round_trip / 180, 0.2, 1)
274	        if not ctx.accessibility:
275	            access_fit = 1.0
276	        elif activity.wheelchair_accessible is True:
277	            access_fit = 1.0
278	        elif activity.wheelchair_accessible is None:
279	            access_fit = 0.45
280	        else:
281	            access_fit = 1.0  # non-wheelchair needs are not matched to a field yet
282	
283	        fit = 100 * (
284	            0.58 * interest
285	            + 0.16 * budget_fit
286	            + 0.10 * energy_fit
287	            + 0.10 * time_fit
288	            + 0.06 * access_fit
289	        )
290	        fits.append(round(fit, 1))
291	
292	    if exclusions:
293	        return None
294	
295	    average = sum(fits) / len(fits)
296	    minimum = min(fits)
297	    spread = max(fits) - minimum
298	    novelty = clamp(1 - activity.popularity, 0, 1)
299	
300	    uncertainty = 0.0
301	    if any(ctx.needs_wheelchair_access for ctx in contexts) and activity.wheelchair_accessible is None:
302	        uncertainty += 8.0
303	    if activity.source_type.startswith("seed"):
304	        uncertainty += 4.0
305	    if not activity.last_verified_at or (
306	        utcnow() - activity.last_verified_at
307	    ).days > 365:
308	        uncertainty += 3.0
309	
310	    time_penalty = clamp(round_trip / max(1, min(ctx.available_minutes or 240 for ctx in contexts)) * 10, 0, 12)
311	    avg_cap = sum(ctx.soft_budget or 150 for ctx in contexts) / len(contexts)
312	    budget_penalty = clamp(activity.price_estimate / max(1, avg_cap) * 6, 0, 8)
313	    penalties = {
314	        "time": round(time_penalty, 2),
315	        "budget": round(budget_penalty, 2),
316	        "uncertainty": round(uncertainty, 2),
317	        "total": round(time_penalty + budget_penalty + uncertainty, 2),
318	    }
319	
320	    novelty_points = novelty * 100
321	    if mode == "your_turn" and target_member_index is not None:
322	        target_fit = fits[target_member_index]
323	        score = (
324	            0.45 * average
325	            + 0.20 * minimum
326	            + 0.30 * target_fit
327	            + 0.05 * novelty_points
328	            - penalties["total"]
329	        )
330	    elif mode == "surprise_us":
331	        surprise_bonus = 6.0 if not activity.iconic else -3.0
332	        score = (
333	            0.45 * average
334	            + 0.20 * minimum
335	            + 0.35 * novelty_points
336	            + surprise_bonus
337	            - penalties["total"]
338	        )
339	    else:
340	        score = (
341	            0.55 * average
342	            + 0.30 * minimum
343	            + 0.15 * novelty_points
344	            - penalties["total"]
345	        )
346	
347	    return RankedActivity(
348	        activity=activity,
349	        score=round(clamp(score, 0, 100), 1),
350	        average_fit=round(average, 1),
351	        minimum_fit=round(minimum, 1),
352	        fairness_spread=round(spread, 1),
353	        novelty=round(novelty, 3),
354	        fits=fits,
355	        penalties=penalties,
356	        distance_km=distance,
357	        travel_minutes=travel,
358	        exclusions=exclusions,
359	        target_fit=(
360	            round(fits[target_member_index], 1)

367	def _representation_scores(
368	    db: Session,
369	    contexts: list[MemberContext],
370	    confirmed_items: list[ItineraryItem],
371	) -> list[float]:
372	    """Average personal interest fit of the confirmed plan per member."""
373	    if not confirmed_items:
374	        return [0.0 for _ in contexts]
375	    activity_ids = [item.activity_id for item in confirmed_items if item.activity_id]
376	    activities = (
377	        db.query(Activity).filter(Activity.id.in_(activity_ids)).all()
378	        if activity_ids
379	        else []
380	    )
381	    by_id = {activity.id: activity for activity in activities}
382	    vectors = {aid: _activity_vector(act) for aid, act in by_id.items()}
383	    scores: list[float] = []
384	    for ctx in contexts:
385	        dna = _member_dna_for_today(ctx)
386	        fits = [
387	            0.2 + 0.8 * _cosine(vectors[item.activity_id], dna)
388	            for item in confirmed_items
389	            if item.activity_id in vectors
390	        ]
391	        scores.append(sum(fits) / len(fits) if fits else 0.0)
392	    return scores

544	def generate_recommendations(
545	    db: Session,
546	    trip: Trip,
547	    members: list[TripMember],
548	    *,
549	    mode: str,
550	    for_date: date,
551	    limit: int = 6,
552	) -> dict:
553	    if mode not in MODE_META:
554	        mode = "everyone_wins"
555	    contexts = build_member_contexts(db, trip, members, for_date)
556	    if not contexts:
557	        return {"items": [], "error": "No active members to personalise for."}
558	    if not trip.destination_id:
559	        return {
560	            "items": [],
561	            "error": "Set a destination for this trip before generating group recommendations.",
562	        }
563	
564	    activities = (
565	        db.query(Activity)
566	        .filter(Activity.destination_id == trip.destination_id)
567	        .order_by(Activity.name)
568	        .all()
569	    )
570	    place_cache: dict[str, Place | None] = {}
571	
572	    def coords_for(activity: Activity) -> tuple[float, float]:
573	        if activity.place_id not in place_cache:
574	            place_cache[activity.place_id] = (
575	                db.get(Place, activity.place_id) if activity.place_id else None
576	            )
577	        place = place_cache[activity.place_id]
578	        return (place.lat, place.lon) if place else (0.0, 0.0)
579	
580	    confirmed = (
581	        db.query(ItineraryItem)
582	        .filter(
583	            ItineraryItem.trip_id == trip.id,
584	            ItineraryItem.status == "confirmed",
585	        )
586	        .all()
587	    )
588	    planned_activity_ids = {item.activity_id for item in confirmed if item.activity_id}
589	    day_items = [item for item in confirmed if item.day == for_date]
590	    schedule = schedule_summary(db, day_items)
591	
592	    target_index: int | None = None
593	    target_ctx: MemberContext | None = None
594	    if mode == "your_turn":
595	        representation = _representation_scores(db, contexts, confirmed)
596	        if any(score > 0 for score in representation):
597	            target_index = min(range(len(contexts)), key=lambda i: representation[i])
598	        target_ctx = contexts[target_index] if target_index is not None else None
599	
600	    ranked: list[RankedActivity] = []
601	    exclusion_reasons: dict[str, int] = {}
602	    seen: dict[str, int] = {}
603	    for activity in activities:
604	        if activity.id in planned_activity_ids:
605	            continue
606	        coords = coords_for(activity)
607	        distance = (
608	            haversine_km(trip.base_lat, trip.base_lon, coords[0], coords[1])
609	            if (coords[0] or coords[1])
610	            else 0.0
611	        )
612	        needed = activity.duration_minutes + travel_minutes(distance) * 2
613	        if needed > schedule["max_free_minutes"]:
614	            key = "protected_time" if schedule["protected_count"] else "day_schedule"
615	            exclusion_reasons[key] = exclusion_reasons.get(key, 0) + 1
616	            continue
617	        result = rank_activity(
618	            activity,
619	            contexts,
620	            base_lat=trip.base_lat,
621	            base_lon=trip.base_lon,
622	            coords=coords,
623	            target_member_index=target_index,
624	            mode=mode,
625	        )
626	        if result is None:
627	            exclusion_reasons["hard_constraint"] = (
628	                exclusion_reasons.get("hard_constraint", 0) + 1
629	            )
630	            continue
631	        ranked.append(result)
632	
633	    if mode == "your_turn" and target_index is None and ranked:
634	        # No plan yet: target the member whose interests are hardest to serve.
635	        hardest = min(range(len(contexts)), key=lambda i: sum(r.fits[i] for r in ranked) / len(ranked))
636	        target_index = hardest
637	        target_ctx = contexts[hardest]
638	        for result in ranked:
639	            result.target_fit = result.fits[hardest]
640	            result.score = round(
641	                clamp(
642	                    0.45 * result.average_fit
643	                    + 0.20 * result.minimum_fit
644	                    + 0.30 * result.fits[hardest]
645	                    + 0.05 * result.novelty * 100
646	                    - result.penalties["total"],
647	                    0,
648	                    100,
649	                ),
650	                1,
651	            )
652	
653	    ranked.sort(key=lambda item: item.score, reverse=True)
654	    top = ranked[:limit]
655	    alternatives = ranked[limit : limit + 3]
656	
657	    for result in top:
658	        explanation = _explanation(result, contexts, mode, target_ctx)
659	        explanation["alternatives"] = [
660	            {
661	                "activity_id": alt.activity.id,
662	                "name": alt.activity.name,
663	                "score_delta": round(result.score - alt.score, 1),
664	            }
665	            for alt in alternatives
666	        ]
667	        result.explanation = explanation
668	
669	    top_scores = [item.score for item in top]

671	    missing_pulse = [ctx for ctx in contexts if ctx.pulse is None]

676	            "Knowing their available time and energy could change the top result."
677	        )
678	
679	    return {

#### Thinking

Engine is heuristic, transparent, good. Phase 7 asks to improve with feedback-based ranking, calibration, fairness metrics, context-aware recommendations. We can:

1. Feedback-based personalization: use existing RecommendationFeedback (feedback service) to adjust member DNA weights via a bounded Bayesian/k-nearest style update. Need to read feedback.py.
2. Fairness metric evaluation: add evaluation module computing metrics on batches (min fit, spread, Gini, constraint violations, diversity via tag Jaccard), and expose in meta (already some). Add tests.
3. Context-aware: incorporate time of day/week, season? Weather integration could adjust indoor preference. But no fake data; only if provider configured/live.
4. Constraint optimization: maybe implement a greedy diversified reranking (MMR) preserving explainability—ensuring diversity without sacrificing min fit. Add `diversify` step and document.

But careful: preserve Everyone Wins/Your Turn/Surprise Us behavior and explainability. Add feedback as a small bounded additive term with explicit explanation ("Your group's feedback history nudges activities liked before by +X"). Make sure no private data leaks: feedback is per-user; engine uses aggregate likes (with consent? feedback is group-visible votes on recommendations—check feedback model visibility).

Read feedback.py + model.

87	            scores[key] = round(clamp(float(scores.get(key, 5)) + delta, 0, 10), 2)
88	            changed.append(key)
89	    if not changed:
90	        return None
91	    dna.scores = scores
92	    dna.source = "feedback+explicit"
93	    return {"dimensions": sorted(set(changed)), "scores": scores}

11	SOURCE_LABELS = {

15	    "unknown": "Unknown",

19	def freshness(observed_at: datetime, source_type: str, verified: bool = False) -> float:
20	    age_days = max(0.0, (utcnow() - observed_at).total_seconds() / 86400)
21	    half_life = 90 if source_type == "official" else 30 if verified else 7
22	    score = exp(-log(2) * age_days / half_life)
23	    if verified:
24	        score = min(1.0, score * 1.15)
25	    return round(score, 3)
26	
27	
28	def provenance(source_type: str, verified: bool) -> str:
29	    if source_type == "official" and verified:
30	        return "VERIFIED"
31	    if source_type == "official":
32	        return "REPORTED"
33	    return {
34	        "community": "REPORTED",
35	        "estimated": "ESTIMATED",
36	        "unknown": "UNKNOWN",
37	    }.get(source_type, "UNKNOWN")
38	
39	
40	def freshness_label(score: float) -> str:
41	    if score >= 0.75:
42	        return "fresh"
43	    if score >= 0.4:
44	        return "recent but fading"
45	    if score >= 0.15:
46	        return "old — treat with caution"
47	    return "stale — do not rely on it alone"

50	def relevant_reports(db: Session, activity_id: str, days: int = 90) -> list[PlaceReport]:
51	    cutoff = utcnow() - timedelta(days=days)
52	    return (
53	        db.query(PlaceReport)
54	        .filter(
55	            PlaceReport.activity_id == activity_id,
56	            PlaceReport.observed_at >= cutoff,
57	        )
58	        .order_by(PlaceReport.observed_at.desc())
59	        .all()
60	    )

63	def aggregate_reports(db: Session, activity_id: str) -> dict:
64	    reports = relevant_reports(db, activity_id)
65	    categories: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
66	    for report in reports:
67	        weight = freshness(report.observed_at, report.source_type, report.verified) * report.confidence
68	        categories.setdefault(report.category, []).append(
69	            {
70	                "id": report.id,
71	                "value": report.value or {},
72	                "note": report.note,
73	                "observed_at": report.observed_at,
74	                "source_type": report.source_type,
75	                "source_label": SOURCE_LABELS.get(report.source_type, "Unknown"),
76	                "provenance": provenance(report.source_type, report.verified),
77	                "verified": report.verified,

79	                    "official_verified"

81	                    else "moderator_verified"
82	                    if report.verified
83	                    else "unverified"
84	                ),
85	                "confidence": report.confidence,
86	                "freshness": freshness(report.observed_at, report.source_type, report.verified),
87	                "weight": round(weight, 3),
88	            }
89	        )
90	    summary = []
91	    for category, entries in categories.items():
92	        entries.sort(key=lambda entry: entry["weight"], reverse=True)
93	        leader = entries[0]
94	        summary.append(
95	            {
96	                "category": category,
97	                "status": leader["provenance"],
98	                "source_type": leader["source_type"],
99	                "source_label": leader["source_label"],
100	                "latest_observed_at": leader["observed_at"],
101	                "freshness": leader["freshness"],
102	                "freshness_label": freshness_label(leader["freshness"]),
103	                "confidence": leader["confidence"],
104	                "reports_count": len(entries),
105	                "weighted_support": round(sum(entry["weight"] for entry in entries), 3),
106	                "reports": entries,
107	            }
108	        )
109	    summary.sort(key=lambda item: item["weighted_support"], reverse=True)
110	    return {
111	        "activity_id": activity_id,
112	        "window_days": 90,
113	        "has_data": bool(reports),
114	        "categories": summary,
115	        "disclosure": (
116	            "Community observations are not official facts. Freshness decays over time; "
117	            "verified official sources rank above community reports."
118	        ),
119	    }

122	def count_bucket(hour: int) -> str:
123	    if 8 <= hour < 12:
124	        return "morning"
125	    if 12 <= hour < 16:
126	        return "afternoon"
127	    if 16 <= hour < 20:
128	        return "evening"
129	    return "night"

132	def crowd_forecast(db: Session, activity_id: str) -> dict:
133	    reports = relevant_reports(db, activity_id, days=180)
134	    crowd = [r for r in reports if r.category == "crowd" and r.source_type in {"community", "official"}]
135	    if len(crowd) < 8:
136	        latest = crowd[0] if crowd else None
137	        return {
138	            "activity_id": activity_id,
139	            "status": "insufficient_data",
140	            "required_reports": 8,
141	            "available_reports": len(crowd),
142	            "latest_observation": (
143	                {
144	                    "observed_at": latest.observed_at,
145	                    "source_type": latest.source_type,
146	                    "source_label": SOURCE_LABELS.get(latest.source_type),
147	                    "value": latest.value,
148	                }
149	                if latest
150	                else None
151	            ),
152	            "message": (
153	                "Not enough reliable observations to forecast crowds. "
154	                "Showing the latest report instead of inventing a prediction."
155	            ),
156	        }
157	
158	    buckets: dict[str, list[tuple[float, datetime]]] = {}
159	    for report in crowd:
160	        value = report.value or {}
161	        raw = value.get("score", value.get("level"))
162	        if isinstance(raw, str):
163	            raw = {"low": 0.25, "moderate": 0.5, "medium": 0.5, "high": 0.8, "very_high": 0.95}.get(raw, 0.5)
164	        try:
165	            score = float(raw)
166	        except (TypeError, ValueError):
167	            continue
168	        key = f"{report.observed_at.weekday()}-{count_bucket(report.observed_at.hour)}"
169	        buckets.setdefault(key, []).append((score, report.observed_at))
170	    if not buckets:
171	        return {
172	            "activity_id": activity_id,
173	            "status": "insufficient_data",
174	            "message": "Crowd reports exist but do not contain a usable level or score.",
175	        }
176	    now = utcnow()
177	    forecasts = []
178	    for key, observations in buckets.items():
179	        weekday, bucket = key.split("-")
180	        if len(observations) < 3:
181	            continue
182	        scores = [score for score, _observed_at in observations]
183	        mean = sum(scores) / len(scores)
184	        variance = sum((score - mean) ** 2 for score in scores) / len(scores)
185	        spread = variance**0.5
186	        ages = [max(0.0, (now - observed_at).total_seconds() / 86400) for _score, observed_at in observations]
187	        mean_age_days = sum(ages) / len(ages)
188	        freshness = max(0.0, min(1.0, 1 - mean_age_days / 180))
189	        # Confidence combines evidence volume, agreement between reports, and
190	        # recency so the number matches the disclosure rather than sample size alone.
191	        sample_component = min(1.0, len(scores) / 12)
192	        stability = max(0.0, min(1.0, 1 - spread * 4))
193	        confidence = min(0.9, 0.25 + 0.35 * sample_component + 0.2 * stability + 0.1 * freshness)
194	        forecasts.append(
195	            {
196	                "weekday": int(weekday),
197	                "bucket": bucket,
198	                "expected_level": round(mean, 2),
199	                "spread": round(spread, 2),
200	                "reports": len(scores),
201	                "freshness": round(freshness, 2),
202	                "mean_report_age_days": round(mean_age_days, 1),
203	                "confidence": round(confidence, 2),
204	            }
205	        )
206	    if not forecasts:
207	        return {
208	            "activity_id": activity_id,
209	            "status": "insufficient_data",
210	            "message": "Each time bucket needs at least 3 reports before a forecast is shown.",
211	        }
212	    return {
213	        "activity_id": activity_id,
214	        "status": "predicted",
215	        "model": "bucket-mean-v1",
216	        "provenance": "ESTIMATED",
217	        "forecasts": sorted(forecasts, key=lambda f: (-f["confidence"], f["weekday"])),
218	        "disclosure": (
219	            "PREDICTED from historical community/official observations. This is an estimate, "
220	            "not a verified measurement. Confidence reflects sample size, agreement between "
221	            "reports and recency, not a guarantee."
222	        ),
223	    }

#### Thinking

Good. Forecast improvements:
- Anomaly detection: robust median/MAD per bucket; exclude outliers; recompute mean; mark anomalies.
- Stale reports: exclude reports older than a staleness cutoff from forecasts (but keep counts), or weight below threshold; expose excluded counts.
- Confidence calibration: use an empirical calibration mapping driven by observed leave-one-out errors? With limited data, can compute interval via t/normal and calibrate confidence with a monotone mapping of effective sample size and dispersion. Could implement "calibrated confidence" using Wilson-like bounds? For crowd level (continuous), use standard error of weighted mean and confidence as 1 - normalized margin of error. Document as heuristic calibration, not learned. Evaluation: coverage test on synthetic controlled dataset (simulate known distributions; check that predicted intervals cover). But no invented observations—test data only in tests.
- Separate observed vs predicted: return `observed` (aggregate stats, latest report) separate from `predicted`.
- Insufficient data honest states: keep threshold 8 but bucket threshold 3; maybe raise to 4? Evaluate existing threshold: with 8 reports total, per bucket often <3 → no forecasts. Could implement hierarchical fallback: bucket → weekday-level → overall mean with provenance "coarse". But must remain honest and confidence lower. That's a genuine improvement: hierarchical forecasting (partial pooling) using weekday and overall. Use only if sufficient data (e.g., overall ≥8) and mark resolution.

Evaluation metrics: MAE, coverage, calibration error (Brier-like) on synthetic simulation. We can write tests that generate reports in DB (test DB) and compute.
