`C:/Users/siddharth/Documents/Qoder/2026-11-19/7c4196d9/apps/mobile/lib/features/trip/trip_overview_screen.dart` is a `CustomScrollView` of `SliverAppBar` + `SliverList`; a private `_refresh(WidgetRef)` invalidates every trip-scoped provider. Sections: hero card → `SectionHeader(eyebrow: 'The plan', title: 'Itinerary')` → big tappable `SafarCard` → engine tile → expenses tile → **`SectionHeader(eyebrow: 'Workspace', title: 'Everything for this trip')`** followed by `GridView.count(crossAxisCount: 3, shrinkWrap: true, physics: NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(), mainAxisSpacing: 10, crossAxisSpacing: 10, childAspectRatio: 0.98)` of `_Tool` entries:

`_Tool` (line 528) is a private `SafarCard(padding: EdgeInsets.all(12), radius: 18, onTap:)` with an `emberSoft` 38x38 icon box + `labelSmall` text. For a dozen modules, add `_Tool`s to that grid (it wraps rows automatically) and/or promote key ones to full-width `SafarCard`/`SafarActionTile` rows above the grid. Add new providers to `_refresh`.

## 6. Theme and shared widgets

`lib/core/theme/safar_theme.dart`: extension `SafarThemeContext on BuildContext` gives:
- `context.safar` → `SafarPalette`: `paper`, `surface`, `raised`, `ink`, `muted`, `faint`, `line`, `ember`, `emberSoft`, `jade`, `jadeSoft`, `rose`, `shadow` (light/dark definitions at lines 37-67). Use `.withValues(alpha: 0.x)` (not `withOpacity`).
- `context.texts` → `TextTheme`: `displayLarge/Medium/Small`, `headlineLarge/Medium/Small`, `titleLarge/Medium/Small`, `bodyLarge/Medium/Small`, `labelLarge/Medium/Small` (serif = `SafarSerif`/Lora for display+headline+titleLarge).
- `context.colors` → `ColorScheme`.

`safar_widgets.dart` signatures: `Eyebrow(String text, {Color? color, int? maxLines})`; `SafarCard({required Widget child, EdgeInsetsGeometry padding = EdgeInsets.all(18), VoidCallback? onTap, Color? color, Color? borderColor, double radius = 22})`; `SectionHeader({required String title, String? eyebrow, String? action, VoidCallback? onAction})`; `StatusChip(String label, {ChipTone tone = ChipTone.neutral, IconData? icon})` with `enum ChipTone { neutral, ember, jade, rose }` (auto title-cases labels); `StatTile({required label, required value, hint, icon})`; `InfoBanner({required String text, IconData icon = Icons.info_outline, ChipTone tone = ChipTone.neutral})`; `SafarErrorView({required String message, VoidCallback? onRetry})`; `SafarEmpty({required String title, String? message, IconData icon = Icons.explore_outlined, Widget? action})`; `SkeletonBox({height = 14, width, radius = 10})`; `SkeletonList({count = 3, itemHeight = 92})`; `AsyncView<T>({required AsyncValue<T> value, required Widget Function(T) builder, VoidCallback? onRetry, Widget? skeleton, EdgeInsetsGeometry? padding})`; `SafarSheetHeader({required title, subtitle})`; `showSafarSheet<T>(context, {required WidgetBuilder builder, bool isScrollControlled = true})`; `SafarActionTile({required icon, required label, caption, onTap})`; `SafarAvatar({required name, size = 40, imageUrl, highlight})`; `SafarImage({required url, height = 180, radius = 22, fit, label})`; `SourceLabel({source, confidence})`.

Formatting helpers in `lib/core/utils/format.dart`: `formatDate`, `formatDateShort`, `formatWeekday`, `formatTime`, `formatClock`, `formatMoney(double?, [currency])`, `timeAgo`, `titleCase`, `clockLabel`, `tripDays(start,end)`, `isoDate(DateTime)`, `compactNumber`.

## 7. Trip-scoped providers

`providers.dart` lines 95-161. Plain list provider without family for the collection, `.family<TripT, String tripId>` for everything trip-scoped, always reading the repository:

```dart
final tripProvider = FutureProvider.family<Trip, String>(
  (ref, tripId) => ref.watch(tripRepositoryProvider).get(tripId),
);

final memoriesProvider = FutureProvider.family<MemoriesResponse, String>(
  (ref, tripId) => ref.watch(memoryRepositoryProvider).list(tripId),
);
```

- 404-as-null pattern: `engineProvider` wraps in `try/on ApiException { if (error.statusCode == 404) return null; rethrow; }` — reuse for "not generated yet" endpoints.
- Multi-arg keys: either a value class with `==`/`hashCode` (`ActivitySearchQuery`, lines 173-217) or a record typedef `typedef PlaceRecord = ({String tripId, String activityId});` (line 233). Prefer the record typedef.
- Invalidation is manual at call sites: `ref.invalidate(proposalsProvider(widget.tripId)); ref.invalidate(itineraryProvider(widget.tripId)); ref.invalidate(tripProvider(widget.tripId));`. For await-then-refresh, `await ref.read(tripProvider(tripId).future)` inside try/catch (overview `_refresh`). No streams, no `ref.listen` for data, no polling.
- Non-async config state uses `StateNotifierProvider` (`theme_controller.dart`). Auth is `authControllerProvider` in `lib/features/auth/auth_controller.dart`.

## 8. Realtime, offline, dependencies

- No WebSocket/SSE/stream/polling code anywhere in `lib` (grep for `WebSocket|socket|realtime|Stream<|poll` returns nothing). Everything is request/response via `ApiClient`; "live" behaviour = `RefreshIndicator` + `ref.invalidate`.
- Local storage: `lib/core/storage/json_store.dart` — abstract `JsonStore` (`read/write/delete`), `SecureJsonStore` (flutter_secure_storage) and `MemoryJsonStore` (tests/web), exposed as `jsonStoreProvider` which returns `MemoryJsonStore()` when `kIsWeb`. Only used by `SafarCookieJar` for the refresh cookie. There is **no** response cache/offline layer. `shared_preferences` is used only for theme + onboarding flags.
- `pubspec.yaml` deps: `flutter_riverpod ^2.6.1`, `go_router ^17.5.0`, `dio ^5.11.1`, `cookie_jar ^4.0.9`, `dio_cookie_manager ^3.5.0`, `flutter_secure_storage ^11.2.0`, `intl ^0.20.3`, `cached_network_image ^3.4.1`, `shared_preferences ^2.5.6`, `cupertino_icons`; dev: `flutter_test`, `flutter_lints ^6.0.0`. Dart SDK `^3.11.1` (records, patterns, null-aware elements `?x` are all in use).

## 9. Test conventions

- `test/widget_test.dart`: pure widget tests, no network. Wrapper helper `Widget _wrap(Widget child) => ProviderScope(child: MaterialApp(theme: SafarTheme.light(), home: child));`, `testWidgets` + `find.text` / `find.widgetWithText(FilledButton, 'Sign in')` / `find.byTooltip('Show password')`, `await tester.pump()` after taps. No mocks, no provider overrides.
- `test/ui_fixes_test.dart`: mixed plain `test()` for pure functions plus `testWidgets` that pump widgets directly with `MaterialApp(theme: SafarTheme.light(), home: Scaffold(body: Center(child: SafarImage(url: ''))))`. Public helpers are exported for testability, e.g. `import 'package:safar_mobile/features/trip/pulse_screen.dart' show formatDayLabel;` — so keep pure formatters (like `formatDayLabel`) as top-level functions in the screen file.
- `test/format_test.dart`: unit tests for `lib/core/utils/format.dart`.
- `test/integration/live_api_test.dart`: opt-in against a real backend, gated by `Platform.environment['SAFAR_LIVE_API']` with a `_skipReason`; builds `ApiClient` with `MemoryJsonStore`. Skip-gated, not part of normal runs.

### Checklist for one new module (e.g. "Ledger")
1. `lib/core/models/ledger.dart` — classes + `fromJson` using `json.dart` helpers.
2. `lib/core/repositories/ledger_repository.dart` — `class LedgerRepository { LedgerRepository(this._api); final ApiClient _api; ... }` hitting `/api/trips/$tripId/ledger`.
3. `providers.dart` — `ledgerRepositoryProvider` (Provider) + `ledgerProvider` (`FutureProvider.family<Ledger, String>`).
4. `lib/features/trip/ledger_screen.dart` — `ConsumerStatefulWidget(tripId)`, `Scaffold(appBar: AppBar(title: Text('Ledger')))`, `AsyncView`, `showSafarSheet` forms, snackbars, `ref.invalidate`.
5. `router.dart` — import + `GoRoute(path: 'ledger', parentNavigatorKey: _rootNavigator, builder: ...)` inside the `/trips/:tripId` children.
6. `trip_overview_screen.dart` — new `_Tool(...)` in the Workspace grid and `ref.invalidate(ledgerProvider(tripId))` in `_refresh`.
7. `test/` — pure-function `test()`s and a `MaterialApp(theme: SafarTheme.light())` widget test.

3	  if (value is Map) {
4	    return value.map((key, item) => MapEntry('$key', item));
5	  }
6	  return const {};
7	}
8	
9	List<dynamic> jsonList(dynamic value) => value is List ? value : const [];
10	
11	String? jsonString(dynamic value) {
12	  if (value == null) return null;
13	  if (value is String) return value;
14	  if (value is num || value is bool) return '$value';
15	  return null;
16	}
17	
18	String jsonText(dynamic value, [String fallback = '']) =>
19	    jsonString(value) ?? fallback;
20	
21	int jsonInt(dynamic value, [int fallback = 0]) {
22	  if (value is int) return value;
23	  if (value is num) return value.toInt();
24	  if (value is String) return int.tryParse(value) ?? fallback;
25	  return fallback;
26	}
27	
28	int? jsonIntOrNull(dynamic value) {
29	  if (value == null) return null;
30	  if (value is int) return value;
31	  if (value is num) return value.toInt();
32	  if (value is String) return int.tryParse(value);
33	  return null;
34	}
35	
36	double jsonDouble(dynamic value, [double fallback = 0]) {
37	  if (value is num) return value.toDouble();
38	  if (value is String) return double.tryParse(value) ?? fallback;
39	  return fallback;
40	}
41	
42	double? jsonDoubleOrNull(dynamic value) {
43	  if (value == null) return null;
44	  if (value is num) return value.toDouble();
45	  if (value is String) return double.tryParse(value);
46	  return null;
47	}
48	
49	bool jsonBool(dynamic value, [bool fallback = false]) {
50	  if (value is bool) return value;
51	  if (value is num) return value != 0;
52	  if (value is String) return value.toLowerCase() == 'true';
53	  return fallback;
54	}
55	
56	List<String> jsonStringList(dynamic value) =>
57	    jsonList(value).map((item) => jsonText(item)).where((s) => s.isNotEmpty).toList();
58	
59	List<T> jsonObjects<T>(
60	  dynamic value,
61	  T Function(Map<String, dynamic> json) decode,
62	) => jsonList(value).map((item) => decode(jsonMap(item))).toList();
63	
64	DateTime? jsonDate(dynamic value) =>
65	    value is String ? DateTime.tryParse(value) : null;
66	
67	/// Parses a `YYYY-MM-DD` calendar date without applying a timezone.
68	DateTime? shortDate(String? value) {
69	  if (value == null || value.isEmpty) return null;
70	  final parts = value.split('-');
71	  if (parts.length != 3) return DateTime.tryParse(value);
72	  final year = int.tryParse(parts[0]);
73	  final month = int.tryParse(parts[1]);
74	  final day = int.tryParse(parts[2]);
75	  if (year == null || month == null || day == null) return null;
76	  return DateTime(year, month, day);
77	}

@router.post("/{trip_id}/twin/compare")
def twin_compare(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: TwinCompareIn,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    if not payload.activity_ids:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=422,
            detail="Provide at least one alternative activity to compare.",
        )
    for activity_id in payload.activity_ids:
        _activity_in_trip(db, trip, activity_id)
    if len(set(payload.activity_ids)) != len(payload.activity_ids):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Duplicate activities in the alternative")
    day = payload.day or date.today()
    _within_trip(trip, day)
    items = (
        db.query(ItineraryItem)
        .filter(
            ItineraryItem.trip_id == trip.id,
            ItineraryItem.day == day,
            ItineraryItem.status == "confirmed",
        )
        .all()
    )
    contexts = build_member_contexts(db, trip, _active_members(db, trip.id), day)
    result = twin_service.compare_plan(db, trip, contexts, items, payload.activity_ids, day)
    result["generated_at"] = result["generated_at"].isoformat()
    return result


@router.post("/{trip_id}/twin/propose", status_code=201)
async def twin_propose(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: TwinProposeIn,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    day = payload.day or trip.start_date
    _within_trip(trip, day)
    if len(set(payload.activity_ids)) != len(payload.activity_ids):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Duplicate activities in the alternative")
    activities = [_activity_in_trip(db, trip, activity_id) for activity_id in payload.activity_ids]
    proposal, impact = _create_proposal(
        db,
        trip,
        user,
        kind="twin_adopt",
        title="Adopt a Trip Twin alternative",
        summary=(
            f"Replaces {day.isoformat()} with: "
            + ", ".join(activity.name for activity in activities)
            + ". Read-only comparison only; adoption needs group approval."
        ),
        day=day,
        payload={
            "day": day.isoformat(),
            "items": [
                {"activity_id": activity.id, "day": day.isoformat(), "start_time": "09:00"}
                for activity in activities
            ],
        },
    )
    db.commit()
    await manager.broadcast(
        trip.id,
        event_payload("proposal.created", trip_id=trip.id, proposal_id=proposal.id),
    )
    return {**proposal_out(db, proposal, user.id), "impact": impact}


@router.post("/{trip_id}/rescue/analyze")
def rescue_analyze(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: RescueIn,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    return rescue_service.analyse_rescue(
        db,
        trip,
        _active_members(db, trip.id),
    response = {**proposal_out(db, proposal, user.id), "impact": impact}
    if pact:
        response["pact"] = {
            "must_do": pact.must_do or [],
            "flexible": pact.flexible or [],
            "note": "Pact conflicts block approval until the group adds an exception.",
        }
    return response


@router.post("/{trip_id}/negotiate")
def negotiate(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: NegotiateIn,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    for activity_id in set(payload.option_a + payload.option_b):
        _activity_in_trip(db, trip, activity_id)
    if payload.for_date:
        _within_trip(trip, payload.for_date)
    return rescue_service.compromise(
        db,
        trip,
        _active_members(db, trip.id),
        payload.option_a,
        payload.option_b,
        for_date=payload.for_date,
    )

@router.post("/{trip_id}/shadowplans", status_code=201)
def create_shadowplan(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: ShadowplanCreate,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    item = db.get(ItineraryItem, payload.item_id)
    if not item or item.trip_id != trip.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Itinerary item not found")
    activity = db.get(Activity, payload.backup_activity_id)
    if not activity or activity.destination_id != trip.destination_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Backup must be a catalog activity in this destination")
    plan = Shadowplan(
        trip_id=trip.id,
        itinerary_item_id=item.id,
        backup_activity_id=activity.id,
        notes=payload.notes,
        readiness={"status": "ready", "checked_at": utcnow().isoformat()},
        created_by=user.id,
    )
    db.add(plan)
    audit(
        db,
        action="shadowplan.create",
        entity_type="shadowplan",
        entity_id=plan.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
    )
    db.commit()
    return {"id": plan.id, "backup_activity_id": activity.id, "readiness": plan.readiness}


@router.get("/{trip_id}/shadowplans")
def list_shadowplans(
    trip_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    rows = db.query(Shadowplan).filter(Shadowplan.trip_id == trip.id).all()
    return {
        "items": [
            {
                "id": row.id,
                "item_id": row.itinerary_item_id,
                "backup_activity_id": row.backup_activity_id,
                "notes": row.notes,
                "readiness": row.readiness,
                "created_at": row.created_at,
            }
            for row in rows
        ]
    }
from datetime import date

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.core.deps import get_current_user, get_db, get_trip_and_member
from app.models import User
from app.services.opportunity import clock

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/trips", tags=["opportunity"])


@router.get("/{trip_id}/opportunity-clock")
def opportunity_clock(
    trip_id: str,
    on: date | None = Query(default=None),
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = get_trip_and_member(trip_id, db, user)
    target = on or (date.today() if trip.start_date <= date.today() <= trip.end_date else trip.start_date)
    if target < trip.start_date or target > trip.end_date:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=422,
            detail="Chosen date is outside this trip's dates",
        )
    return clock(db, trip, target)

3	import { useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
4	import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
5	
6	import { wsUrl } from "@/lib/api";
7	
8	type Status = "idle" | "connecting" | "live" | "closed";
9	
10	export function useTripSocket(tripId: string | undefined) {
11	  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
12	  const [status, setStatus] = useState<Status>("idle");
13	  const [lastEvent, setLastEvent] = useState<{ type: string; at: number } | null>(null);
14	  const retry = useRef(0);
15	
16	  useEffect(() => {
17	    if (!tripId) return;
18	    let socket: WebSocket | null = null;
19	    let heartbeat: number | undefined;
20	    let reconnect: number | undefined;
21	    let disposed = false;
22	
23	    const connect = async () => {
24	      setStatus("connecting");
25	      const url = await wsUrl(tripId);
26	      if (!url || disposed) {
27	        setStatus("closed");
28	        return;
29	      }
30	      socket = new WebSocket(url);
31	
32	      socket.onopen = () => {
33	        retry.current = 0;
34	        setStatus("live");
35	        heartbeat = window.setInterval(() => {
36	          if (socket?.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) socket.send("ping");
37	        }, 30_000);
38	      };
39	
40	      socket.onmessage = (event) => {
41	        try {
42	          const payload = JSON.parse(event.data) as { type?: string };
43	          const type = payload.type || "update";
44	          if (type === "pong" || type === "connected") return;
45	          setLastEvent({ type, at: Date.now() });
46	          queryClient.invalidateQueries({
47	            predicate: (query) =>
48	              query.queryKey[1] === tripId ||
49	              query.queryKey[0] === "trips" ||
50	              query.queryKey[0] === "notifications",
51	          });
52	        } catch {
53	          /* ignore malformed frames */
54	        }
55	      };
56	
57	      socket.onclose = () => {
58	        window.clearInterval(heartbeat);
59	        if (disposed) return;
60	        setStatus("closed");
61	        retry.current = Math.min(retry.current + 1, 5);
62	        reconnect = window.setTimeout(connect, 1500 * retry.current);
63	      };
64	
65	      socket.onerror = () => {
66	        socket?.close();
67	      };
68	    };
69	
70	    connect();
71	    return () => {
72	      disposed = true;
73	      window.clearInterval(heartbeat);
74	      window.clearTimeout(reconnect);
75	      socket?.close();
76	      setStatus("idle");
77	    };
78	  }, [tripId, queryClient]);
79	
80	  return { status, lastEvent };
81	}

611	class AsyncView<T> extends StatelessWidget {
612	  const AsyncView({
613	    super.key,
614	    required this.value,
615	    required this.builder,
616	    this.onRetry,
617	    this.skeleton,
618	    this.padding,
619	  });
620	
621	  final AsyncValue<T> value;
622	  final Widget Function(T data) builder;
623	  final VoidCallback? onRetry;
624	  final Widget? skeleton;
625	  final EdgeInsetsGeometry? padding;
626	
627	  @override
628	  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
629	    return value.when(
630	      data: builder,
631	      loading: () => padding == null
632	          ? (skeleton ?? const SkeletonList())
633	          : Padding(padding: padding!, child: skeleton ?? const SkeletonList()),
634	      error: (error, stack) => Padding(
635	        padding: padding ?? EdgeInsets.zero,
636	        child: SafarErrorView(
637	          message: error.toString(),
638	          onRetry: onRetry,
639	        ),
640	      ),
641	    );
642	  }
643	}

178	    final values = (

197	          .addItem(
198	            widget.tripId,
199	            day: isoDate(values.day),

201	            startTime: values.start,
202	            endTime: values.end.isEmpty ? null : values.end,

218	      if (mounted) setState(() => _busy = false);
219	    }

378	  Future<void> _deleteItem(ItineraryItem item) async {
379	    final confirmed = await showDialog<bool>(
380	      context: context,
381	      builder: (context) => AlertDialog(
382	        title: const Text('Remove this item?'),
383	        content: Text(
384	          '“${item.title}” will be removed from the confirmed itinerary. '
385	          'The change is recorded in the trip history.',
386	        ),
387	        actions: [
388	          TextButton(
389	            onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(false),
390	            child: const Text('Keep'),
391	          ),
392	          FilledButton(
393	            onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(true),
394	            style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
395	              backgroundColor: context.safar.rose,
396	            ),
397	            child: const Text('Remove'),
398	          ),
399	        ],
400	      ),
401	    );
402	    if (confirmed != true) return;
403	    setState(() => _busy = true);
404	    try {
405	      await ref
406	          .read(itineraryRepositoryProvider)
407	          .deleteItem(widget.tripId, item.id);
408	      await _refresh();
409	    } on Object catch (error) {
410	      if (!mounted) return;
411	      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
412	        SnackBar(content: Text(error.toString())),
413	      );
414	    } finally {
415	      if (mounted) setState(() => _busy = false);
416	    }
417	  }

419	  @override
420	  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
421	    final palette = context.safar;
422	    final itinerary = ref.watch(itineraryProvider(widget.tripId));
423	    final trip = ref.watch(tripProvider(widget.tripId)).valueOrNull;
424	
425	    return Scaffold(
426	      appBar: AppBar(
427	        leading: IconButton(
428	          tooltip: 'Back',
429	          onPressed: () => context.pop(),
430	          icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back),
431	        ),
432	        title: const Text('Itinerary'),
433	        actions: [
434	          IconButton(
435	            tooltip: 'Group proposals',
436	            onPressed: () => context.push('/trips/${widget.tripId}/proposals'),
437	            icon: const Icon(Icons.how_to_vote_outlined),
438	          ),
439	          const SizedBox(width: 4),
440	        ],
441	      ),
442	      floatingActionButton: itinerary.valueOrNull == null || trip == null
443	          ? null
444	          : FloatingActionButton.extended(
445	              onPressed: _busy
446	                  ? null
447	                  : () => _addItem(
448	                      trip,
449	                      _day ?? isoDate(DateTime.now()),
450	                    ),
451	              icon: const Icon(Icons.add),
452	              label: const Text('Add item'),
453	            ),
454	      body: SafeArea(
455	        child: AsyncView(
456	          value: itinerary,
457	          onRetry: () => ref.invalidate(itineraryProvider(widget.tripId)),
458	          builder: (data) {
459	            final days = trip == null
460	                ? (data.items.map((item) => item.day).toSet().toList()..sort())
461	                : tripDays(trip.startDate, trip.endDate)
462	                      .map(isoDate)
463	                      .toList();
464	            if (days.isEmpty) {
465	              return const SafarEmpty(
466	                title: 'No days to plan',
467	                message: 'The trip dates are missing.',
468	                icon: Icons.event_busy_outlined,
469	              );
470	            }
471	            final today = isoDate(DateTime.now());
472	            final selected = _day ?? (days.contains(today) ? today : days.first);
473	            final items = data.forDay(selected)
474	              ..sort((a, b) => a.startTime.compareTo(b.startTime));
475	            return RefreshIndicator(
476	              onRefresh: _refresh,
477	              child: ListView(
478	                physics: const AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(),
479	                padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 8, 20, 110),
480	                children: [
481	                  Row(
482	                    children: [
483	                      Expanded(
484	                        child: Column(
485	                          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
486	                          children: [
487	                            const Eyebrow('Timeline'),
488	                            const SizedBox(height: 6),
489	                            Text(
490	                              '${data.totals.items} items · v${data.confirmedVersion}',
491	                              style: context.texts.headlineSmall,
492	                            ),
493	                          ],
494	                        ),
495	                      ),
496	                      StatusChip(
497	                        data.myRole,
498	                        tone: data.myRole == 'owner'
499	                            ? ChipTone.ember
500	                            : ChipTone.neutral,
501	                      ),
502	                    ],
503	                  ),
504	                  const SizedBox(height: 6),
505	                  Text(
506	                    '${formatMoney(data.totals.cost, data.totals.currency)} planned · '
507	                    '${formatMoney(data.totals.perPerson, data.totals.currency)} per person',
508	                    style: context.texts.bodySmall,
509	                  ),
510	                  if (data.openProposals > 0) ...[
511	                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
512	                    InfoBanner(
513	                      text:
514	                          '${data.openProposals} group ${data.openProposals == 1 ? 'proposal is' : 'proposals are'} waiting for votes. '
515	                          'The confirmed plan does not change until approval.',
516	                      icon: Icons.how_to_vote_outlined,
517	                      tone: ChipTone.ember,
518	                    ),
519	                  ],
520	                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
521	                  SingleChildScrollView(
522	                    scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
523	                    child: Row(
524	                      children: [
525	                        for (var i = 0; i < days.length; i++)
526	                          Padding(
527	                            padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 8),
528	                            child: ChoiceChip(
529	                              label: Text(
530	                                'Day ${i + 1} · ${formatDateShort(days[i])}',
531	                              ),
532	                              selected: days[i] == selected,
533	                              onSelected: (_) => setState(() => _day = days[i]),
534	                            ),
535	                          ),
536	                      ],
537	                    ),
538	                  ),
539	                  const SizedBox(height: 18),
540	                  if (items.isEmpty)
541	                    SafarEmpty(
542	                      title: 'A clear day',
543	                      message:
544	                          'Nothing planned yet. Add an item or use the engine to find group options.',
545	                      icon: Icons.wb_sunny_outlined,
546	                      action: trip == null
547	                          ? null
548	                          : FilledButton(
549	                              onPressed: _busy ? null : () => _addItem(trip, selected),
550	                              child: const Text('Add first item'),
551	                            ),
552	                    )
553	                  else ...[
554	                    Text(
555	                      '${formatWeekday(selected)} · ${formatDate(selected)}',
556	                      style: context.texts.labelMedium,
557	                    ),
558	                    const SizedBox(height: 10),
559	                    for (var index = 0; index < items.length; index++)
560	                      _TimelineItem(
561	                        item: items[index],
562	                        currency: data.totals.currency,
563	                        isLast: index == items.length - 1,
564	                        busy: _busy,
565	                        onAttendance: (status) =>
566	                            _setAttendance(items[index], status),
567	                        onEdit: trip == null
568	                            ? null
569	                            : () => _editItem(items[index], trip),
570	                        onDelete: () => _deleteItem(items[index]),
571	                      ),
572	                  ],
573	                  if (data.versions.isNotEmpty) ...[
574	                    const SizedBox(height: 20),
575	                    SafarCard(
576	                      child: Row(
577	                        children: [
578	                          Icon(
579	                            Icons.history,
580	                            size: 18,
581	                            color: palette.faint,
582	                          ),
583	                          const SizedBox(width: 10),
584	                          Expanded(
585	                            child: Text(
586	                              '${data.versions.length} recorded version${data.versions.length == 1 ? '' : 's'} · '
587	                              'latest ${timeAgo(data.versions.first.createdAt)}',
588	                              style: context.texts.bodySmall,
589	                            ),
590	                          ),
591	                        ],
592	                      ),
593	                    ),
594	                  ],
595	                ],
596	              ),
597	            );
598	          },
599	        ),
600	      ),
601	    );
602	  }
603	}

"""Trip Twin (F08): compare alternatives without touching the confirmed plan."""

from datetime import date

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.models import Activity, ItineraryItem, Place, Trip, TripMember
from app.services.engine import rank_activity
from app.services.geo import haversine_km, travel_minutes


def _activity_coords(db: Session, activity: Activity) -> tuple[float, float]:
    if not activity.place_id:
        return (0.0, 0.0)
    place = db.get(Place, activity.place_id)
    return (place.lat, place.lon) if place else (0.0, 0.0)


def _metrics_for_activities(
    db: Session,
    trip: Trip,
    contexts,
    activities: list[Activity],
    fallback_costs: dict[str, float] | None = None,
    fallback_durations: dict[str, int] | None = None,
) -> dict:
    fits: list[list[float]] = [[] for _ in contexts]
    total_cost = 0.0
    total_duration = 0
    total_travel = 0
    details = []
    for activity in activities:
        coords = _activity_coords(db, activity)
        distance = haversine_km(trip.base_lat, trip.base_lon, *coords) if coords != (0.0, 0.0) else 0.0
        leg = travel_minutes(distance)
        ranked = rank_activity(
            activity,
            contexts,
            base_lat=trip.base_lat,
            base_lon=trip.base_lon,
            coords=coords,
            target_member_index=None,
            mode="everyone_wins",
        )
        if ranked:
            for index, fit in enumerate(ranked.fits):
                fits[index].append(fit)
        total_cost += activity.price_estimate
        total_duration += activity.duration_minutes
        total_travel += leg
        details.append(
            {
                "activity_id": activity.id,
                "name": activity.name,
                "cost": activity.price_estimate,
                "duration": activity.duration_minutes,
                "distance_km": distance,
                "travel_minutes": leg,
                "eligible": ranked is not None,
            }
        )
    per_member = [sum(values) / len(values) for values in fits if values]
    return {
        "total_cost": round(total_cost, 2),
        "total_duration_minutes": total_duration,
        "total_travel_minutes": total_travel,
        "average_group_fit": round(sum(per_member) / len(per_member), 1) if per_member else None,
        "minimum_member_fit": round(min(per_member), 1) if per_member else None,
        "items": details,
    }


def compare_plan(
    db: Session,
    trip: Trip,
    contexts,
    items: list[ItineraryItem],
    candidate_ids: list[str],
    day: date | None = None,
) -> dict:
    from app.services.common import utcnow

    day = day or date.today()
    confirmed_activities = []
    by_id = {}
    activity_ids = [item.activity_id for item in items if item.activity_id]
    if activity_ids:
        by_id = {a.id: a for a in db.query(Activity).filter(Activity.id.in_(activity_ids)).all()}
        for item in sorted(items, key=lambda i: (i.day, i.start_time)):
            if item.activity_id and item.activity_id in by_id:
                confirmed_activities.append(by_id[item.activity_id])

    candidate_activities = (
        db.query(Activity).filter(Activity.id.in_(candidate_ids)).all()
        if candidate_ids
        else []
    )
    order = {activity_id: index for index, activity_id in enumerate(candidate_ids)}
    candidate_activities.sort(key=lambda activity: order.get(activity.id, 999))

    current = _metrics_for_activities(db, trip, contexts, confirmed_activities)
    alternative = _metrics_for_activities(db, trip, contexts, candidate_activities)

    current_ids = [activity.id for activity in confirmed_activities]
    alt_ids = [activity.id for activity in candidate_activities]
    removed = [
        {"activity_id": activity.id, "name": activity.name}
        for activity in confirmed_activities
        if activity.id not in alt_ids
    ]
    added = [
        {"activity_id": activity.id, "name": activity.name}
        for activity in candidate_activities
        if activity.id not in current_ids
    ]
    kept = [
        {"activity_id": activity.id, "name": activity.name}
        for activity in candidate_activities
        if activity.id in current_ids
    ]

    tradeoffs = []
    if current["average_group_fit"] is not None and alternative["average_group_fit"] is not None:
        delta = alternative["average_group_fit"] - current["average_group_fit"]
        tradeoffs.append(
            f"Average group fit {'improves' if delta >= 0 else 'drops'} by {abs(delta):.1f} points."
        )
    if current["minimum_member_fit"] is not None and alternative["minimum_member_fit"] is not None:
        delta = alternative["minimum_member_fit"] - current["minimum_member_fit"]
        tradeoffs.append(
            f"The least-served member's fit {'improves' if delta >= 0 else 'drops'} by {abs(delta):.1f} points."
        )
    cost_delta = round(alternative["total_cost"] - current["total_cost"], 2)
    tradeoffs.append(
        f"Estimated cost {'rises' if cost_delta > 0 else 'falls'} by {abs(cost_delta):.2f}."
    )
    time_delta = alternative["total_duration_minutes"] - current["total_duration_minutes"]
    tradeoffs.append(
        f"Activity time {'increases' if time_delta > 0 else 'decreases'} by {abs(time_delta)} minutes."
    )
    if alternative["minimum_member_fit"] is not None and alternative["minimum_member_fit"] < 45:
        tradeoffs.append("Caution: at least one member is below 45/100 on this alternative.")

    return {
        "day": day,
        "confirmed_plan": {"name": "Confirmed plan", **current},
        "alternative_plan": {"name": "Trip Twin alternative", **alternative},
        "diff": {"added": added, "removed": removed, "kept": kept},
        "trade_offs": tradeoffs,
        "requires_approval": True,
        "disclosure": (
            "This comparison is read-only. Adopting it creates a proposal; "
            "the confirmed itinerary is only changed after group approval."
        ),
        "generated_at": utcnow(),
    }
"""Opportunity Clock (F24).

Answers one honest question for a single day: which catalog activities still
fit the day that is already planned, given today's opening hours and an
estimated door-to-door travel time?

It is a read-only deterministic calculation. It never writes to the database,
never touches the confirmed itinerary and never claims to know live opening
status: hours come from the catalog, travel is an estimate, and a missing
window is reported as unknown rather than guessed.
"""

import re
from datetime import date, datetime

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.models import Activity, Itinerary, ItineraryItem, Place, Trip
from app.services.geo import haversine_km, travel_minutes

DAY_START = 8 * 60
DAY_END = 22 * 60
WEEKDAY_KEYS = ("mon", "tue", "wed", "thu", "fri", "sat", "sun")
_RANGE = re.compile(r"(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})\s*-\s*(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})")

STATUS_ORDER = {
    "open_now": 0,
    "later_today": 1,
    "no_window": 2,
    "closed_today": 3,
    "unknown": 4,
}


def _hhmm_to_minutes(value: str) -> int | None:
    try:
        hours, minutes = value.split(":")
        return int(hours) * 60 + int(minutes)
    except (ValueError, AttributeError):
        return None


def _minutes_to_hhmm(total: int) -> str:
    total = max(0, min(24 * 60 - 1, total))
    return f"{total // 60:02d}:{total % 60:02d}"


def parse_opening_window(raw: str | None) -> tuple[str, tuple[int, int] | None]:
    """Return (kind, window) where kind is open/closed/unknown."""
    if raw is None or not str(raw).strip():
        return "unknown", None
    value = str(raw).strip().lower()
    if value in {"closed", "closed today", "shut"}:
        return "closed", None
    if "24" in value and ("hour" in value or "open" in value):
        return "open", (0, 24 * 60)
    match = _RANGE.search(value)
    if match:
        start = int(match.group(1)) * 60 + int(match.group(2))
        end = int(match.group(3)) * 60 + int(match.group(4))
        if end <= start:
            return "unknown", None
        return "open", (start, end)
    return "unknown", None


def _confirmed_spans(db: Session, trip: Trip, on: date) -> list[tuple[int, int, str]]:
    rows = (
        db.query(ItineraryItem)
        .filter(
            ItineraryItem.trip_id == trip.id,
            ItineraryItem.day == on,
            ItineraryItem.status == "confirmed",
        )
        .order_by(ItineraryItem.start_time)
        .all()
    )
    spans: list[tuple[int, int, str]] = []
    for item in rows:
        start = _hhmm_to_minutes(item.start_time) or DAY_START
        end = _hhmm_to_minutes(item.end_time or "") if item.end_time else None
        if end is None:
            activity = db.get(Activity, item.activity_id) if item.activity_id else None
            duration = activity.duration_minutes if activity else 90
            end = start + (duration or 90)
        spans.append((start, max(start + 15, end), item.title))
    return spans


def _free_windows(spans: list[tuple[int, int, str]]) -> list[tuple[int, int]]:
    cursor = DAY_START
    windows: list[tuple[int, int]] = []
    for start, end, _title in sorted(spans):
        if start > cursor:
            windows.append((cursor, min(start, DAY_END)))
        cursor = max(cursor, end)
        if cursor >= DAY_END:
            break
    if cursor < DAY_END:
        windows.append((cursor, DAY_END))
    return [(start, end) for start, end in windows if end - start >= 30]


def _intersect(
    free: list[tuple[int, int]], opening: tuple[int, int]
) -> list[tuple[int, int]]:
    result = []
    for f_start, f_end in free:
        start = max(f_start, opening[0])
        end = min(f_end, opening[1])
        if end - start >= 30:
            result.append((start, end))
    return result


def clock(db: Session, trip: Trip, on: date) -> dict:
    itinerary = db.query(Itinerary).filter(Itinerary.trip_id == trip.id).first()
    confirmed_version = itinerary.confirmed_version if itinerary else None

    if not trip.destination_id:
        return {
            "date": on.isoformat(),
            "available": False,
            "reason": "Set a destination for this trip before using the Opportunity Clock.",
            "items": [],
            "summary": {"candidates": 0, "open_now": 0, "later_today": 0, "unknown_hours": 0},
            "disclosure": (
                "The clock only reads the catalog and the confirmed plan. It never changes either."
            ),
            "plan_unchanged": True,
            "confirmed_version": confirmed_version,
        }

    spans = _confirmed_spans(db, trip, on)
    free = _free_windows(spans)
    confirmed_activity_ids = {
        row[0]
        for row in db.query(ItineraryItem.activity_id)
        .filter(
            ItineraryItem.trip_id == trip.id,
            ItineraryItem.day == on,
            ItineraryItem.status == "confirmed",
            ItineraryItem.activity_id.isnot(None),
        )
        .all()
    }

    activities = (
        db.query(Activity)
        .filter(Activity.destination_id == trip.destination_id)
        .order_by(Activity.popularity.desc())
        .all()
    )
    today = date.today()
    now_minutes = datetime.now().hour * 60 + datetime.now().minute if on == today else None
    weekday = WEEKDAY_KEYS[on.weekday()]

    items = []
    for activity in activities:
        if activity.id in confirmed_activity_ids:
            continue
        place = db.get(Place, activity.place_id)
        distance = (
            haversine_km(trip.base_lat, trip.base_lon, place.lat, place.lon)
            if place
            else 0.0
        )
        travel = travel_minutes(distance)
        duration = activity.duration_minutes or 90
        needed = travel + duration

        raw_hours = (activity.opening_hours or {}).get(weekday)
        kind, opening = parse_opening_window(raw_hours)
        next_start: int | None = None
        status = "unknown"
        explanation = ""

        if kind == "open" and opening:
            windows = _intersect(free, opening)
            feasible = [
                (start, end)
                for start, end in windows
                if end - start >= needed
            ]
            if not feasible:
                status = "no_window"
                explanation = (
                    f"Open {_minutes_to_hhmm(opening[0])}–{_minutes_to_hhmm(opening[1])}, "
                    f"but no free gap today fits {duration} min plus about {travel} min travel."
                )
            else:
                starts = [start for start, _end in feasible]
                if now_minutes is not None:
                    upcoming = [
                        (start, end) for start, end in feasible if end - now_minutes >= needed
                    ]
                    if upcoming:
                        next_start = max(upcoming[0][0], now_minutes)
                        fits_now = (
                            opening[0] <= now_minutes <= opening[1]
                            and upcoming[0][0] <= now_minutes
                        )
                        status = "open_now" if fits_now else "later_today"
                        explanation = (
                            f"Open now and a free gap runs until {_minutes_to_hhmm(upcoming[0][1])}; "
                            f"{duration} min plus about {travel} min travel fits."
                            if fits_now
                            else f"Next feasible start is {_minutes_to_hhmm(next_start)}."
                        )
                    else:
                        status = "window_missed"
                        explanation = (
                            f"Open {_minutes_to_hhmm(opening[0])}–{_minutes_to_hhmm(opening[1])}, "
                            "but that window has already closed for today."
                        )
                else:
                    next_start = starts[0]
                    status = "later_today"
                    explanation = (
                        f"Fits from {_minutes_to_hhmm(next_start)} inside "
                        f"{_minutes_to_hhmm(feasible[0][1])}."
                    )
        elif kind == "closed":
            status = "closed_today"
            explanation = "The catalog lists this place as closed on this weekday."
        else:
            status = "unknown"
            explanation = (
                "No usable opening hours are recorded for this weekday, so feasibility cannot be estimated."
            )

        items.append(
            {
                "activity_id": activity.id,
                "name": activity.name,
                "place_name": place.name if place else None,
                "duration_minutes": duration,
                "price_estimate": activity.price_estimate,
                "currency": activity.currency,
                "opening_hours_today": raw_hours,
                "opening_source": activity.source_type,
                "last_verified_at": activity.last_verified_at.isoformat()
                if activity.last_verified_at
                else None,
                "travel_minutes_estimate": travel,
                "status": status,
                "next_start": _minutes_to_hhmm(next_start) if next_start is not None else None,
                "explanation": explanation,
                "provenance": "ESTIMATED",
            }
        )

    items.sort(key=lambda row: (STATUS_ORDER.get(row["status"], 9), row["name"]))
    summary = {
        "candidates": len(items),
        "open_now": len([row for row in items if row["status"] == "open_now"]),
        "later_today": len([row for row in items if row["status"] == "later_today"]),
        "closed_today": len([row for row in items if row["status"] == "closed_today"]),
        "unknown_hours": len([row for row in items if row["status"] == "unknown"]),
    }
    planned = [title for _start, _end, title in spans]
    explanation = (
        "Nothing fit the remaining gaps of this day."
        if not summary["open_now"] and not summary["later_today"]
        else f"{summary['open_now']} option(s) fit right now and {summary['later_today']} fit later today."
    )
    return {
        "date": on.isoformat(),
        "available": True,
        "weekday": weekday,
        "now": _minutes_to_hhmm(now_minutes) if now_minutes is not None else None,
        "planned_count": len(spans),
        "planned_titles": planned,
        "free_windows": [
            {
                "start": _minutes_to_hhmm(start),
                "end": _minutes_to_hhmm(end),
                "minutes": end - start,
            }
            for start, end in free
        ],
        "items": items,
        "summary": summary,
        "explanation": explanation,
        "disclosure": (
            "Opening hours come from the catalog and may be stale; travel time is an estimate, "
            "not a routed ETA. This view is read-only and never changes the confirmed itinerary."
        ),
        "plan_unchanged": True,
        "confirmed_version": confirmed_version,
    }

159	class _AuthInterceptor extends Interceptor {

162	  final ApiClient client;

164	  @override
165	  void onRequest(RequestOptions options, RequestInterceptorHandler handler) {
166	    if (options.extra['skipAuth'] != true) {
167	      final token = client.accessToken;
168	      if (token != null && token.isNotEmpty) {
169	        options.headers['Authorization'] = 'Bearer $token';
170	      }
171	      final csrf = client.csrfToken;
172	      if (_unsafeMethods.contains(options.method.toUpperCase()) &&
173	          csrf != null &&
174	          csrf.isNotEmpty) {
175	        options.headers['X-CSRF-Token'] = csrf;
176	      }
177	    }
178	    handler.next(options);
179	  }
180	
181	  @override
182	  Future<void> onError(
183	    DioException err,
184	    ErrorInterceptorHandler handler,
185	  ) async {
186	    final options = err.requestOptions;
187	    final status = err.response?.statusCode;
188	    final isAuthPath = options.path.startsWith('/api/auth/');
189	    final retried = options.extra['retried'] == true;
190	    if (status == 401 && !retried && !isAuthPath) {
191	      try {
192	        final refreshed = await client.refreshSession();
193	        if (refreshed) {
194	          final headers = Map<String, dynamic>.from(options.headers);
195	          final token = client.accessToken;
196	          if (token != null) headers['Authorization'] = 'Bearer $token';
197	          final csrf = client.csrfToken;
198	          if (_unsafeMethods.contains(options.method.toUpperCase()) &&
199	              csrf != null) {
200	            headers['X-CSRF-Token'] = csrf;
201	          }
202	          final retryOptions = options.copyWith(
203	            headers: headers,
204	            extra: {...options.extra, 'retried': true},
205	          );
206	          final response = await client.dio.fetch<dynamic>(retryOptions);
207	          return handler.resolve(response);
208	        }
209	        client.notifyUnauthorized();
210	      } on Object {
211	        // A network failure while refreshing must not sign the user out.
212	      }
213	    }
214	    handler.next(err);
215	  }

3	/// Small key/value contract so the cookie jar and session logic are testable
4	/// without platform plugins.
5	abstract class JsonStore {
6	  Future<String?> read(String key);
7	  Future<void> write(String key, String value);
8	  Future<void> delete(String key);
9	}
10	
11	/// Native storage uses Keychain (iOS) and encrypted shared preferences
12	/// (Android). The refresh cookie is never written to plain shared preferences.
13	class SecureJsonStore implements JsonStore {
14	  SecureJsonStore([FlutterSecureStorage? storage])
15	    : _storage = storage ?? const FlutterSecureStorage();
16	
17	  final FlutterSecureStorage _storage;
18	
19	  @override
20	  Future<String?> read(String key) => _storage.read(key: key);
21	
22	  @override
23	  Future<void> write(String key, String value) =>
24	      _storage.write(key: key, value: value);
25	
26	  @override
27	  Future<void> delete(String key) => _storage.delete(key: key);
28	}
29	
30	/// Used by unit tests and by the web verification target, where the browser
31	/// owns HttpOnly cookies and the Dart layer must not persist them.
32	class MemoryJsonStore implements JsonStore {
33	  final Map<String, String> _values = {};
34	
35	  @override
36	  Future<String?> read(String key) async => _values[key];
37	
38	  @override
39	  Future<void> write(String key, String value) async => _values[key] = value;
40	
41	  @override
42	  Future<void> delete(String key) async => _values.remove(key);
43	}

3	import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";

11	  EmptyState,

14	  PageSkeleton,

17	import { api } from "@/lib/api";

19	import { useToasts } from "@/lib/store";
20	import { errorMessage, titleCase } from "@/lib/utils";
21	
22	const CONSTRAINT_CHIPS: Record<string, (value: unknown) => string | null> = {
23	  max_cost: (value) => (typeof value === "number" ? `Cost ≤ ${value}` : null),
24	  max_effort: (value) => (typeof value === "number" ? `Effort ≤ ${value}/5` : null),
25	  tag: (value) => (typeof value === "string" && value ? `Focus: ${titleCase(value)}` : null),
26	  respect_accessibility: (value) => (value === true ? "Respects access needs" : null),
27	  // Already shown as a badge or spelled out in the description.
28	  optional: () => null,
29	  suggested_activity: () => null,
30	};
31	
32	function constraintChips(constraints: Record<string, unknown>): string[] {
33	  return Object.entries(constraints)
34	    .map(([key, value]) => {
35	      const formatter = CONSTRAINT_CHIPS[key];
36	      if (formatter) return formatter(value);
37	      return typeof value === "object" && value !== null ? null : `${titleCase(key)}: ${String(value)}`;
38	    })
39	    .filter((chip): chip is string => Boolean(chip));
40	}
41	
42	export default function MissionsPage() {
43	  const params = useParams<{ tripId: string }>();
44	  const tripId = typeof params?.tripId === "string" ? params.tripId : "";
45	  const missions = useMissions(tripId);
46	  const trip = useTrip(tripId);
47	  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
48	  const { push } = useToasts();
49	  const canDisable = trip.data?.my_role === "owner" || trip.data?.my_role === "admin";
50	
51	  const refresh = () => queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["missions", tripId] });
52	
53	  const act = useMutation({
54	    mutationFn: ({ missionId, action }: { missionId: string; action: "join" | "complete" | "disable" }) =>
55	      api(`/api/trips/${tripId}/missions/${missionId}/${action}`, { method: "POST" }),
56	    onSuccess: (_result, variables) => {
57	      const copy = {
58	        join: "Mission joined — optional, never required.",
59	        complete: "Marked complete (self-reported).",
60	        disable: "Mission disabled for this trip.",
61	      } as const;
62	      push("Mission updated", copy[variables.action], "success");
63	      refresh();
64	    },
65	    onError: (error) => push("Could not update mission", errorMessage(error), "error"),
66	  });
67	
68	  if (missions.isLoading) return <PageSkeleton />;
69	  if (missions.error || !missions.data) {
70	    return <ErrorState error={missions.error || new Error("Missions unavailable")} retry={() => missions.refetch()} />;
71	  }
72	
73	  const items = missions.data.items;
74	
75	  return (
76	    <div className="space-y-5">
77	      <div>
78	        <p className="eyebrow">Optional missions</p>
79	        <h2 className="mt-1 text-2xl">Small challenges, low pressure</h2>
80	        <p className="mt-1 max-w-prose text-sm text-muted">
81	          Missions are generated from this trip and are always optional. Completion is self-reported — SAFAR
82	          never verifies it.
83	        </p>
84	      </div>
85	
86	      <FlowNote icon={<Sparkles size={14} />}>{missions.data.note}</FlowNote>
87	
88	      {items.length === 0 ? (
89	        <EmptyState
90	          title="No missions right now"
91	          description="Missions appear as the trip takes shape. They are never mandatory."
92	          icon={<Compass size={24} />}
93	        />
94	      ) : (
95	        <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
96	          {items.map((mission) => {
97	            const done = mission.my_status === "completed";
98	            const joined = mission.my_status === "joined" || done;
99	            const disabled = mission.status === "disabled";
100	            const chips = constraintChips(mission.constraints ?? {});
101	            return (
102	              <Card key={mission.id} className="space-y-3">
103	                <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
104	                  <div className="min-w-0">
105	                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
106	                      {mission.optional ? <Badge tone="outline">optional</Badge> : null}
107	                      {mission.self_reported ? <Badge tone="neutral">self-reported</Badge> : null}
108	                      {disabled ? <Badge tone="rose">disabled</Badge> : null}
109	                    </div>
110	                    <p className="mt-1.5 text-[14px] font-medium text-ink">{mission.title}</p>
111	                    <p className="mt-0.5 text-[12px] leading-5 text-muted">{mission.description}</p>
112	                  </div>
113	                  <Target size={18} className="shrink-0 text-faint" />
114	                </div>
115	
116	                {chips.length ? (
117	                  <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
118	                    {chips.map((chip) => (
119	                      <Badge key={chip} tone="neutral">
120	                        {chip}
121	                      </Badge>
122	                    ))}
123	                  </div>
124	                ) : null}
125	
126	                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 border-t border-line pt-2.5">
127	                  {done ? (
128	                    <Badge tone="jade">
129	                      <BadgeCheck size={11} /> completed
130	                    </Badge>
131	                  ) : (
132	                    <>
133	                      {!joined ? (
134	                        <Button
135	                          size="sm"
136	                          variant="secondary"
137	                          onClick={() => act.mutate({ missionId: mission.id, action: "join" })}
138	                          disabled={disabled}
139	                        >
140	                          <UserPlus size={13} /> Join
141	                        </Button>
142	                      ) : null}
143	                      <Button
144	                        size="sm"
145	                        onClick={() => act.mutate({ missionId: mission.id, action: "complete" })}
146	                        disabled={disabled}
147	                      >
148	                        <BadgeCheck size={13} /> Mark done
149	                      </Button>
150	                    </>
151	                  )}
152	                  {canDisable && !disabled ? (
153	                    <Button
154	                      size="sm"
155	                      variant="ghost"
156	                      className="ml-auto text-muted"
157	                      onClick={() => act.mutate({ missionId: mission.id, action: "disable" })}
158	                    >
159	                      <CircleSlash size={13} /> Disable
160	                    </Button>
161	                  ) : null}
162	                </div>
163	              </Card>
164	            );
165	          })}
166	        </div>
167	      )}
168	
169	      <SectionTitle title="How missions stay honest" hint="" />
170	      <FlowNote icon={<BadgeCheck size={14} />}>
171	        Missions are generated from recorded trip data. Joining and completing are personal actions; nothing is
172	        shared as verified information, and any mission can be disabled by an owner or admin.
173	      </FlowNote>
174	    </div>
175	  );
176	}

def fragility_report(db: Session, trip: Trip, items: list[ItineraryItem]) -> dict:
    if not items:
        return {
            "resilience_score": None,
            "label": "No confirmed itinerary items to analyse",
            "days": [],
            "summary": {"comfortable": 0, "tight": 0, "risky": 0},
        }
    by_day: dict[date, list[ItineraryItem]] = {}
    for item in items:
        by_day.setdefault(item.day, []).append(item)

    days = []
    totals = {"comfortable": 0, "tight": 0, "risky": 0}
    for day, day_items in sorted(by_day.items()):
        entries = analyse_day(db, day_items)
        for entry in entries:
            status = entry["buffer_status"]
            if status in totals:
                totals[status] += 1
        days.append(
            {
                "day": day,
                "legs": [
                    {
                        "item_id": entry["item"].id,
                        "title": entry["item"].title,
                        "start_time": entry["item"].start_time,
                        "end_time": minutes_to_hhmm(entry["end"]),
                        "buffer_minutes": entry["buffer_minutes"],
                        "buffer_status": entry["buffer_status"],
                        "travel_minutes": entry["leg_minutes"],
                        "travel_km": entry["leg_km"],
                        "protected": entry["item"].is_protected,
                    }
                    for entry in entries
                ],
                "alternative_timings": _timing_alternatives(entries),
            }
        )

    checks = totals["comfortable"] + totals["tight"] + totals["risky"]
    weighted = totals["comfortable"] * 1.0 + totals["tight"] * 0.55 + totals["risky"] * 0.1
    score = round(100 * weighted / max(1, checks))
    if score >= 75:
        label = "Resilient — comfortable buffers across the plan"
    elif score >= 45:
        label = "Moderate — some legs need attention"
    else:
        label = "Fragile — tight or negative buffers are likely"
    return {
        "resilience_score": score,
        "label": label,
        "days": days,
        "summary": totals,
        "disclosure": "Buffers use estimated travel times, not live traffic.",
    }


def _timing_alternatives(entries: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
    alternatives = []
    for entry in entries:
        buffer = entry.get("buffer_minutes")
        if buffer is None:
            continue
        if buffer < 15:
            shift = max(5, 15 - buffer)
            alternatives.append(
                {
                    "item_id": entry["item"].id,
                    "suggestion": f"Move {entry['item'].title} later or shorten it by about {shift} minutes.",
                    "minutes": shift,
                }
            )
    return alternatives


def domino_map(
    db: Session,
    items: list[ItineraryItem],
    disrupted_item_id: str,
    delay_minutes: int,
) -> dict | None:
    by_day: dict[date, list[ItineraryItem]] = {}
    for item in items:
        by_day.setdefault(item.day, []).append(item)
    target = next((item for item in items if item.id == disrupted_item_id), None)
    if not target:
        return None
    day_items = sorted(by_day.get(target.day, []), key=lambda item: day_minutes(item.start_time))
    entries = analyse_day(db, day_items)
    target_index = next(
        (index for index, entry in enumerate(entries) if entry["item"].id == disrupted_item_id),
        None,
    )
    if target_index is None:
        return None

    affected = []
    unaffected = []
    carry = delay_minutes
    for index, entry in enumerate(entries):
        if index < target_index:
            unaffected.append(
                {"item_id": entry["item"].id, "title": entry["item"].title, "reason": "before the disruption"}
            )
            continue
        if index == target_index:
            carry = delay_minutes
            affected.append(
                {
                    "item_id": entry["item"].id,
                    "title": entry["item"].title,
                    "slip_minutes": delay_minutes,
                    "new_start": minutes_to_hhmm(entry["start"] + delay_minutes),
                    "is_source": True,
                    "protected": entry["item"].is_protected,
                }
            )
            continue
        # Absorb delay with any buffer, then propagate the remainder.
        absorb = max(0, entry.get("buffer_minutes") or 0)
        absorbed = min(carry, absorb)
        net_slip = carry - absorbed
        if net_slip > 0:
            affected.append(
                {
                    "item_id": entry["item"].id,
                    "title": entry["item"].title,
                    "slip_minutes": net_slip,
                    "new_start": minutes_to_hhmm(entry["start"] + net_slip),
                    "is_source": False,
                    "protected": entry["item"].is_protected,
                }
            )
            carry = net_slip
        else:
            unaffected.append(
                {"item_id": entry["item"].id, "title": entry["item"].title, "reason": "buffer absorbs the delay"}
            )
            carry = 0

    repairs = []
    for entry in affected:
        if entry["is_source"]:
            continue
        repairs.append(
            {
                "item_id": entry["item_id"],
                "title": entry["title"],
                "options": [
                    f"Shorten by {entry['slip_minutes']} minutes.",
                    f"Move to {entry['new_start']} and confirm with the group.",
                    "Replace with its Shadowplan backup." if not entry["protected"] else "Protected time: ask the group before changing.",
                ],
            }
        )

    return {
        "day": target.day,
        "disruption": {
            "item_id": target.id,
            "title": target.title,
            "delay_minutes": delay_minutes,
        },
        "affected": affected,
        "unaffected": unaffected,
        "minimum_repairs_needed": len(repairs),
        "repair_options": repairs,
        "disclosure": "Propagation uses planned durations and estimated travel time.",
    }


def effort_budget(db: Session, items: list[ItineraryItem]) -> dict:
    activities = _activity_map(db, items)
    coords = _coords_map(db, activities)
    ordered = sorted(items, key=lambda item: (item.day, day_minutes(item.start_time)))
    walking_km = 0.0
    effort_points = 0
    rest_minutes = 0
    transitions = 0
    previous = None
    for item in ordered:
        activity = activities.get(item.activity_id) if item.activity_id else None
        if item.is_protected:
            rest_minutes += 60
        elif activity:
            effort_points += activity.effort
        if previous and item.activity_id and previous.activity_id and item.day == previous.day:
            prev_coords = coords.get(previous.activity_id, (0.0, 0.0))
            cur_coords = coords.get(item.activity_id, (0.0, 0.0))
            if prev_coords != (0.0, 0.0) and cur_coords != (0.0, 0.0):
                walking_km += haversine_km(*prev_coords, *cur_coords) * 1.25
                transitions += 1
        previous = item
    walking_minutes = int(round(walking_km * 12))
    effort_level = "light" if effort_points <= 6 else "moderate" if effort_points <= 12 else "demanding"
    return {
        "effort_points": effort_points,
        "effort_level": effort_level,
        "walking_km_estimate": round(walking_km, 2),
        "walking_minutes_estimate": walking_minutes,
        "transitions": transitions,
        "protected_rest_minutes": rest_minutes,
        "heat_exposure": "unknown — no weather source is configured",
        "accessibility_note": "Hard accessibility requirements are never traded for a lower effort score.",
        "disclosure": "Effort points derive from catalog intensity; walking distance is a straight-line estimate adjusted for streets.",
    }

def compromise(
    db: Session,
    trip: Trip,
    members: list[TripMember],
    option_a: list[str],
    option_b: list[str],
    for_date: date | None = None,
) -> dict:
    """Build a fair-trade compromise from two competing options (F45).

    Feasibility is evaluated for the day being negotiated, not the server's
    current date, so past and future trip days behave consistently.
    """

    by_id = {
        activity.id: activity
        for activity in db.query(Activity).filter(Activity.id.in_(set(option_a + option_b) or {""})).all()
    }
    a = [by_id[aid] for aid in option_a if aid in by_id]
    b = [by_id[aid] for aid in option_b if aid in by_id]
    if not a or not b:
        return {
            "status": "needs_options",
            "message": "Provide at least one activity for each side of the negotiation.",
        }

    target_date = for_date or date.today()
    rec = generate_recommendations(
        db, trip, members, mode="everyone_wins", for_date=target_date, limit=12
    )
    ranked = {item.activity.id: item for item in rec.get("items", [])}

    def best(pool: list[Activity]):
        scored = [ranked[activity.id] for activity in pool if activity.id in ranked]
        return max(scored, key=lambda item: item.minimum_fit) if scored else None

    best_a = best(a)
    best_b = best(b)
    if not best_a or not best_b:
        return {
            "status": "no_feasible_option",
            "message": "One or both options violate a hard constraint for at least one member.",
        }

    compromise_choice = best_a if best_a.minimum_fit >= best_b.minimum_fit else best_b
    other = best_b if compromise_choice is best_a else best_a
    benefits = sorted(
        {
            normalize_tag(tag)
            for tag in (compromise_choice.activity.tags or [])
            if tag
        }
    )[:3]
    return {
        "status": "compromise_ready",
        "compromise": {
            "activity_id": compromise_choice.activity.id,
            "name": compromise_choice.activity.name,
            "minimum_fit": compromise_choice.minimum_fit,
            "average_fit": compromise_choice.average_fit,
        },
        "alternative": {
            "activity_id": other.activity.id,
            "name": other.activity.name,
            "minimum_fit": other.minimum_fit,
            "average_fit": other.average_fit,
        },
        "who_benefits": f"Members interested in {', '.join(benefits) or 'the activity themes'}.",
        "who_compromises": "Members whose first choice was the other option; the protected minimum fit stays highest here.",
        "trade_offs": [
            f"Protected minimum fit {compromise_choice.minimum_fit}/100 versus {other.minimum_fit}/100 for the alternative.",
            f"Average fit {compromise_choice.average_fit}/100 versus {other.average_fit}/100.",
            "Private constraints stayed private; only aggregate suitability is shown.",
        ],
        "feasible": True,
        "disclosure": "Apply only with group approval. No private budget or preference is exposed.",
    }
        "notes": item.notes,
        "cost_estimate": item.cost_estimate,
        "status": item.status,
        "is_protected": item.is_protected,
        "sort_order": item.sort_order,
        "created_by": item.created_by,
        "created_at": item.created_at,
        "activity": activity_out(activity) if activity else None,
    }


def proposal_out(
    db: Session,
    proposal: ItineraryProposal,
    viewer_id: str | None = None,
) -> dict:
    votes = db.query(Vote).filter(Vote.proposal_id == proposal.id).all()
    counts = {"yes": 0, "no": 0, "abstain": 0}
    my_vote = None
    comments: list[dict] = []
    user_cache: dict[str, User | None] = {}
    for vote in votes:
        counts[vote.value] = counts.get(vote.value, 0) + 1
        if vote.user_id not in user_cache:
            user_cache[vote.user_id] = db.get(User, vote.user_id)
        author = user_cache[vote.user_id]
        if vote.comment:
            comments.append(
                {
                    "id": vote.id,
                    "user": user_public(author),
                    "comment": vote.comment,
                    "value": vote.value,
                    "created_at": vote.created_at,
                }
            )
        if viewer_id and vote.user_id == viewer_id:
            my_vote = vote.value
    author = db.get(User, proposal.created_by)
    return {
        "id": proposal.id,
        "kind": proposal.kind,
        "title": proposal.title,
        "summary": proposal.summary,
        "payload": proposal.payload or {},
        "status": proposal.status,
        "target_day": proposal.target_day,
        "created_by": proposal.created_by,
        "author": user_public(author),
        "created_at": proposal.created_at,
        "decided_at": proposal.decided_at,
        "votes": counts,
        "vote_count": len(votes),
        "my_vote": my_vote,
        "comments": comments,
    }


def version_out(version: ItineraryVersion) -> dict:
    return {
        "id": version.id,
        "version": version.version,
        "snapshot": version.snapshot or [],
        "note": version.note,
        "created_at": version.created_at,
        "created_by": version.created_by,

25	const FIELDS = [
26	  { value: "opening_hours", label: "Opening hours" },
27	  { value: "price_estimate", label: "Price" },
28	  { value: "wheelchair_accessible", label: "Step-free access" },
29	];

31	const DAY_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
32	  mon: "Mon",
33	  tue: "Tue",
34	  wed: "Wed",
35	  thu: "Thu",
36	  fri: "Fri",
37	  sat: "Sat",
38	  sun: "Sun",

41	// Seeded rows store the raw value, new rows store {value}, changed rows store
42	// {value, previous}. Normalise both shapes so the card never shows raw JSON.
43	function describeWatchValue(field: string, raw: Record<string, unknown>): string {
44	  const stored = "value" in raw ? raw.value : raw;
45	  if (stored === null || stored === undefined) return "unknown";
46	  if (field === "wheelchair_accessible") {
47	    if (stored === true) return "step-free";
48	    if (stored === false) return "not step-free";
49	    return "unknown";
50	  }
51	  if (field === "price_estimate") {
52	    if (typeof stored === "number") return formatMoney(stored);
53	    if (stored === null) return "unknown";
54	    return String(stored);
55	  }
56	  if (typeof stored === "object" && !Array.isArray(stored)) {
57	    const entries = Object.entries(stored as Record<string, unknown>);
58	    const hours = entries.filter(([key]) => key in DAY_LABELS);
59	    if (hours.length) {
60	      const distinct = new Set(hours.map(([, value]) => String(value)));
61	      if (distinct.size === 1) return `Every day ${hours[0][1]}`;
62	      return hours.map(([day, value]) => `${DAY_LABELS[day]} ${value}`).join(" · ");
63	    }
64	    if (!entries.length) return "unknown";
65	    return entries.map(([key, value]) => `${titleCase(key)} ${String(value)}`).join(" · ");
66	  }
67	  return String(stored);
68	}

3	const _months = [

5	  'Feb',
6	  'Mar',

28	String formatDate(String? raw, {String fallback = '—'}) {
29	  if (raw == null || raw.isEmpty) return fallback;
30	  final date = DateTime.tryParse(raw);
31	  if (date == null) return raw;
32	  return '${date.day} ${_months[date.month - 1]} ${date.year}';
33	}
34	
35	String formatDateShort(String? raw, {String fallback = '—'}) {
36	  if (raw == null || raw.isEmpty) return fallback;
37	  final date = DateTime.tryParse(raw);
38	  if (date == null) return raw;
39	  return '${date.day} ${_months[date.month - 1]}';
40	}
41	
42	String formatWeekday(String? raw) {
43	  if (raw == null || raw.isEmpty) return '';
44	  final date = DateTime.tryParse(raw);
45	  if (date == null) return '';
46	  return _weekdays[date.weekday - 1];
47	}
48	
49	String formatTime(String? raw) {
50	  if (raw == null || raw.isEmpty) return '';
51	  final parts = raw.split(':');
52	  if (parts.length < 2) return raw;
53	  final hour = int.tryParse(parts[0]);
54	  final minute = int.tryParse(parts[1]);
55	  if (hour == null || minute == null) return raw;
56	  final suffix = hour >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
57	  final display = hour % 12 == 0 ? 12 : hour % 12;
58	  return '$display:${minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0')} $suffix';
59	}
60	
61	/// Formats an ISO timestamp or `HH:MM` value as a 12-hour clock time.
62	String formatClock(String? raw) {
63	  if (raw == null || raw.isEmpty) return '';
64	  final date = raw.contains('T') ? DateTime.tryParse(raw) : null;
65	  if (date == null) return formatTime(raw);
66	  final local = date.toLocal();
67	  return formatTime(
68	    '${local.hour.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}:'
69	    '${local.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}',
70	  );
71	}
72	
73	String formatMoney(double? amount, [String currency = 'EUR']) {
74	  if (amount == null) return '—';
75	  try {
76	    return NumberFormat.simpleCurrency(
77	      name: currency,
78	      decimalDigits: amount == amount.roundToDouble() ? 0 : 2,
79	    ).format(amount);
80	  } on Object {
81	    return '${amount.toStringAsFixed(2)} $currency';
82	  }
83	}
84	
85	String timeAgo(String? raw) {
86	  if (raw == null || raw.isEmpty) return '';
87	  final date = DateTime.tryParse(raw);
88	  if (date == null) return '';
89	  final diff = DateTime.now().toUtc().difference(date.toUtc());
90	  if (diff.inSeconds < 60) return 'just now';
91	  if (diff.inMinutes < 60) return '${diff.inMinutes}m ago';
92	  if (diff.inHours < 24) return '${diff.inHours}h ago';
93	  if (diff.inDays < 7) return '${diff.inDays}d ago';
94	  return formatDateShort(raw);
95	}

97	String titleCase(String value) {
98	  if (value.isEmpty) return value;
99	  return value
100	      .split(RegExp(r'[_\s-]+'))
101	      .where((word) => word.isNotEmpty)
102	      .map((word) => '${word[0].toUpperCase()}${word.substring(1)}')
103	      .join(' ');
104	}

108	/// Inclusive list of calendar days between [start] and [end].
109	List<DateTime> tripDays(String startDate, String endDate, {int cap = 60}) {
110	  final start = DateTime.tryParse(startDate);
111	  final end = DateTime.tryParse(endDate);
112	  if (start == null || end == null || end.isBefore(start)) {
113	    return start == null ? const [] : [start];
114	  }
115	  final days = <DateTime>[];
116	  var cursor = DateTime(start.year, start.month, start.day);
117	  final last = DateTime(end.year, end.month, end.day);
118	  while (!cursor.isAfter(last) && days.length < cap) {
119	    days.add(cursor);
120	    cursor = cursor.add(const Duration(days: 1));
121	  }
122	  return days;
123	}

126	    '${date.year.toString().padLeft(4, '0')}-${date.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-${date.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
127

@router.get("/{trip_id}/pact")
def get_pact(
    trip_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    pact = db.query(JourneyPact).filter(JourneyPact.trip_id == trip.id).first()
    if not pact:
        return {"pact": None}
    return {
        "pact": {
            "id": pact.id,
            "must_do": pact.must_do,
            "flexible": pact.flexible,
            # Budget limits are private. A member only ever sees their own.
            "individual_limits": (
                {user.id: pact.individual_limits[user.id]}
                if user.id in (pact.individual_limits or {})
                else {}
            ),
            "confirmed_times": pact.confirmed_times,
            "exceptions": pact.exceptions,
            "updated_at": pact.updated_at,
        }
    }


@router.put("/{trip_id}/pact")
def upsert_pact(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: PactUpsert,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user, {"owner", "admin"})
    pact = db.query(JourneyPact).filter(JourneyPact.trip_id == trip.id).first()
    if not pact:
        pact = JourneyPact(trip_id=trip.id, created_by=user.id)
        db.add(pact)
    pact.must_do = payload.must_do
    pact.flexible = payload.flexible
    # Individual limits are private. Merge rather than replace so an editor who
    # cannot see other members' limits never wipes them.
    merged_limits = dict(pact.individual_limits or {})
    merged_limits.update(payload.individual_limits or {})
    pact.individual_limits = merged_limits
    pact.confirmed_times = payload.confirmed_times
    pact.exceptions = payload.exceptions
    audit(
        db,
        action="pact.update",
        entity_type="journey_pact",
        entity_id=pact.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
    )
    db.commit()
    return {"ok": True}
