@router.post("/{trip_id}/capsules", status_code=201)
def create_capsule(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: CapsuleCreate,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    items = (
        db.query(ItineraryItem)
        .filter(ItineraryItem.trip_id == trip.id, ItineraryItem.status == "confirmed")
        .order_by(ItineraryItem.day, ItineraryItem.sort_order)
        .all()
    )
    pact = db.query(JourneyPact).filter(JourneyPact.trip_id == trip.id).first()
    snapshot = {
        "trip": {
            "name": trip.name,
            "destination": trip.destination_name,
            "start_date": trip.start_date.isoformat(),
            "end_date": trip.end_date.isoformat(),
        },
        "items": snapshot_items(items),
        "meeting_arrangements": pact.confirmed_times if pact else {},
        "generated_by": user.display_name,
    }
    capsule = JourneyCapsule(
        trip_id=trip.id,
        snapshot=snapshot,
        stale_after=utcnow() + timedelta(hours=payload.ttl_hours),
        created_by=user.id,
    )
    db.add(capsule)
    audit(
        db,
        action="capsule.create",
        entity_type="journey_capsule",
        entity_id=capsule.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
    )
    db.commit()
    return {"id": capsule.id, "stale_after": capsule.stale_after, "snapshot": snapshot}

@router.get("/{trip_id}/tasks/summary")
def task_summary(
    trip_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    """Server-side planner load summary (F27).

    Mirrors the planner's client-side calculation so every screen agrees.
    Only counts and display names are returned; task text stays private.
    """
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    rows = db.query(PlannerTask).filter(PlannerTask.trip_id == trip.id).all()
    members = (
        db.query(TripMember)
        .filter(TripMember.trip_id == trip.id, TripMember.status == "active")
        .all()
    )
    names: dict[str, str] = {}
    for member in members:
        if not member.user_id:
            continue
        name = member.display_name
        if not name:
            account = db.get(User, member.user_id)
            name = account.display_name if account else None
        if name:
            names[member.user_id] = name

    totals = {"open": 0, "done": 0, "total": 0}
    counts: dict[str | None, dict[str, int]] = {}
    for row in rows:
        bucket = counts.setdefault(row.assignee_id, {"open": 0, "done": 0, "total": 0})
        bucket["total"] += 1
        totals["total"] += 1
        if row.status == "done":
            bucket["done"] += 1
            totals["done"] += 1
        else:
            bucket["open"] += 1
            totals["open"] += 1

    unassigned = counts.pop(None, {"open": 0, "done": 0, "total": 0})
    by_assignee = [
        {
            "user_id": assignee_id,
            "display_name": names.get(assignee_id) or "Former member",
            "open": bucket["open"],
            "done": bucket["done"],
            "total": bucket["total"],
        }
        for assignee_id, bucket in counts.items()
    ]
    by_assignee.sort(key=lambda entry: (-entry["open"], entry["display_name"]))

    load = [
        {"key": entry["user_id"], "display_name": entry["display_name"], "open": entry["open"]}
        for entry in by_assignee
        if entry["open"]
    ]
    if unassigned["open"]:
        load.append({"key": "unassigned", "display_name": "Unassigned", "open": unassigned["open"]})
    load.sort(key=lambda entry: -entry["open"])

    return {
        "trip_id": trip.id,
        "totals": totals,
        "by_assignee": by_assignee,
        "unassigned": unassigned,
        "load": load,
        "disclosure": (
            "Counts only — task titles, notes and private member details stay in the planner."
        ),
    }


@router.post("/{trip_id}/tasks", status_code=201)
def create_task(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: TaskCreate,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    if payload.assignee_id and not _active_member(db, trip.id, payload.assignee_id):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Assignee must be an active trip member")
    task = PlannerTask(
        trip_id=trip.id,
        title=payload.title,
        description=payload.description,
        assignee_id=payload.assignee_id,
        created_by=user.id,
    )
    db.add(task)
    audit(
        db,
        action="task.create",
        entity_type="planner_task",
        entity_id=task.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
    )
    db.commit()
    return {"id": task.id, "title": task.title, "status": task.status}


@router.patch("/{trip_id}/tasks/{task_id}")
def update_task(
    trip_id: str,
    task_id: str,
    payload: TaskUpdate,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    task = db.get(PlannerTask, task_id)
    if not task or task.trip_id != trip.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Task not found")
    if task.assignee_id and task.assignee_id != user.id and member.role not in {"owner", "admin"}:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Only the assignee or an admin can update this task")
    data = payload.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
    if data.get("assignee_id") and not _active_member(db, trip.id, data["assignee_id"]):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Assignee must be an active trip member")
    for field, value in data.items():
        setattr(task, field, value)
    db.commit()
    return {"id": task.id, "status": task.status, "assignee_id": task.assignee_id}

732	function describeValue(value: Record<string, unknown>) {
733	  if ("level" in value) return `Level: ${String(value.level)}`;
734	  if ("minutes" in value) return `Wait: ${String(value.minutes)} min`;
735	  if ("closed" in value) return value.closed ? "Closed" : "Open";
736	  if ("amount" in value) return `Price: ${String(value.amount)}`;
737	  if ("status" in value) return `Status: ${String(value.status)}`;
738	  if ("detail" in value) return String(value.detail);
739	  const keys = Object.keys(value);
740	  if (keys.length === 0) return "Observation";
741	  return keys.map((key) => `${key}: ${String(value[key])}`).join(", ");
742	}

# SAFAR mobile — implementation guide for new trip screens/repositories

## 1. Repositories and provider wiring

Repositories are plain classes: constructor takes `ApiClient`, private `_api` field, methods are `Future<Model>` / `Future<List<Model>>` with no state, no codegen, no caching. File: `C:/Users/siddharth/Documents/Qoder/2026-11-19/7c4196d9/apps/mobile/lib/core/repositories/trip_repository.dart`

```dart
class TripRepository {
  TripRepository(this._api);
  final ApiClient _api;

  Future<List<TripActivityEvent>> activity(String tripId) async {
    final data = await _api.get('/api/trips/$tripId/activity');
    final raw = data is Map ? data['items'] : data;
    return jsonObjects(raw, TripActivityEvent.fromJson);
  }
}
```

Conventions worth copying exactly:
- Single-object endpoints: `Future<X> get(...) async => X.fromJson(jsonMap(await _api.get('/api/...')));`
- List endpoints: tolerant envelope unwrap `data is Map ? data['items'] : data` then `jsonObjects(raw, X.fromJson)`.
- Nullable payloads: `final pact = jsonMap(data['pact']); return pact.isEmpty ? null : Pact.fromJson(pact);` (see `pact()` in `trip_repository.dart`).
- Write bodies omit empty strings with `if (description != null && description.isNotEmpty) 'description': description,`; newer code uses the Dart 3 null-aware map entry `'item_id': ?itemId` (see `engine_repository.dart` lines 29-34). Both styles exist; prefer `?value` for optional scalars, the `if` form for "skip when empty".
- Mutations return `Future<void>` and just `await _api.post/patch/put/delete(...)`.
- Query params: `query: day == null ? null : {'day': day}`.

Registration in `C:/Users/siddharth/Documents/Qoder/2026-11-19/7c4196d9/apps/mobile/lib/core/providers.dart` (add import + one line, alphabetically near the other repositories ~line 57-83):

```dart
final tripRepositoryProvider = Provider<TripRepository>(
  (ref) => TripRepository(ref.watch(apiClientProvider)),
);
```

`ApiClient` API: `get(path, {query, raw})`, `post(path, {data, query, raw})`, `put`, `patch`, `delete`, plus `mediaUrl(String?)`. Errors surface as `ApiException` (`lib/core/network/api_exception.dart`) with `.message` and `.statusCode`; the interceptor handles 401 refresh + CSRF automatically.

## 2. Models

Pure Dart, `const` constructors, all `final` fields, `factory X.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json)`, no `toJson`, no json_serializable. Helpers in `lib/core/models/json.dart`:

`jsonMap`, `jsonList`, `jsonString`, `jsonText(value,[fallback])`, `jsonInt(value,[fallback])`, `jsonIntOrNull`, `jsonDouble`, `jsonDoubleOrNull`, `jsonBool`, `jsonStringList`, `jsonObjects(raw, X.fromJson)`, `jsonDate`, `shortDate`.

Representative model — `C:/Users/siddharth/Documents/Qoder/2026-11-19/7c4196d9/apps/mobile/lib/core/models/memories.dart`:

```dart
factory Memory.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
  final authorJson = jsonMap(json['author']);
  return Memory(
    id: jsonText(json['id']),
    kind: jsonText(json['kind'], 'text'),           // server default fallback
    aiGenerated: jsonBool(json['ai_generated']),
    author: authorJson.isEmpty ? null : User.fromJson(authorJson),
    textContent: jsonString(json['text_content']),   // nullable => jsonString
    lat: jsonDoubleOrNull(json['lat']),
  );
}
```

Rules: required scalars use `jsonText`/`jsonInt` with a sensible default; genuinely optional use `jsonString`/`jsonIntOrNull`/`jsonDoubleOrNull`; lists-of-objects use `jsonObjects`; `List<String>` uses `jsonStringList`; list fields get `= const []` defaults in the constructor; nested objects are decoded via `jsonMap` + `.isEmpty ? null :` guard; maps of scalars loop over `jsonMap(...).forEach` (see `Pact.fromJson`, `trip.dart` lines 184-198). Dates are kept as `String` and formatted at the UI edge; `shortDate()` exists for timezone-free `YYYY-MM-DD`.

Two shapes, both `ConsumerStatefulWidget`/`ConsumerWidget` with `const XScreen({super.key, required this.tripId}); final String tripId;`.

- Read-only screen (`trip_overview_screen.dart`): `ConsumerWidget`, `Scaffold(body: AsyncView(...))`.
- Interactive screen (`itinerary_screen.dart`, `rescue_screen.dart`): `ConsumerStatefulWidget` with local `_busy` / `_error` / selection fields, `AppBar` + `SafeArea` + `AsyncView` or `ListView`.

Mutation feedback: `setState(() => _busy = true)` → await repo → `ref.invalidate(...)` (or `await _refresh()`) → `if (!mounted) return;` → `ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(const SnackBar(content: Text('Item added.')))` on success, `SnackBar(content: Text(error.toString()))` or `error.message` on `ApiException`; `finally { if (mounted) setState(() => _busy = false); }`. Destructive confirmation uses `showDialog<bool>` + `AlertDialog` with `FilledButton.styleFrom(backgroundColor: context.safar.rose)`.

## 4. Routing

`C:/Users/siddharth/Documents/Qoder/2026-11-19/7c4196d9/apps/mobile/lib/app/router.dart` lines 106-188: `/trips/:tripId` is a top-level `GoRoute` (root navigator) with child routes. Add a sibling block and an import at the top:

```dart
GoRoute(
  path: 'memories',                       // relative => /trips/:tripId/memories
  parentNavigatorKey: _rootNavigator,
  builder: (context, state) =>
      MemoriesScreen(tripId: state.pathParameters['tripId']!),
),
```

Parameterised child: `path: 'places/:activityId'` + `state.pathParameters['activityId']!`. All trip subroutes live on the **root** navigator (they cover the bottom shell). Navigation: `context.push('/trips/$tripId/studio')` for drill-in from overview/sheets; `context.pop()` for back; `context.go(...)` only for tab resets (`/dashboard`). Back buttons guard with `context.canPop() ? context.pop() : context.go('/dashboard')` (overview) or plain `context.pop()` (sub-screens). The shell tabs live in `StatefulShellRoute.indexedStack` at lines 211-261 (`/dashboard`, `/discover`, `/trips`, `/assistant`, `/profile`).

`C:/Users/siddharth/Documents/Qoder/2026-11-19/7c4196d9/apps/mobile/lib/features/trip/trip_overview_screen.dart` is a `CustomScrollView` of `SliverAppBar` + `SliverList`; a private `_refresh(WidgetRef)` invalidates every trip-scoped provider. For a dozen modules, add `_Tool`s to that grid (it wraps rows automatically) and/or promote key ones to full-width `SafarCard`/`SafarActionTile` rows above the grid. Add new providers to `_refresh`.

## 6. Theme and shared widgets

`lib/core/theme/safar_theme.dart`: extension `SafarThemeContext on BuildContext` gives:
- `context.safar` → `SafarPalette`: `paper`, `surface`, `raised`, `ink`, `muted`, `faint`, `line`, `ember`, `emberSoft`, `jade`, `jadeSoft`, `rose`, `shadow` (light/dark definitions at lines 37-67). Use `.withValues(alpha: 0.x)` (not `withOpacity`).
- `context.texts` → `TextTheme`: `displayLarge/Medium/Small`, `headlineLarge/Medium/Small`, `titleLarge/Medium/Small`, `bodyLarge/Medium/Small`, `labelLarge/Medium/Small` (serif = `SafarSerif`/Lora for display+headline+titleLarge).
- `context.colors` → `ColorScheme`.

## 7. Trip-scoped providers

`providers.dart` lines 95-161. Plain list provider without family for the collection, `.family<TripT, String tripId>` for everything trip-scoped, always reading the repository:

```dart
final tripProvider = FutureProvider.family<Trip, String>(
  (ref, tripId) => ref.watch(tripRepositoryProvider).get(tripId),
);

final memoriesProvider = FutureProvider.family<MemoriesResponse, String>(
  (ref, tripId) => ref.watch(memoryRepositoryProvider).list(tripId),
);
```

- 404-as-null pattern: `engineProvider` wraps in `try/on ApiException { if (error.statusCode == 404) return null; rethrow; }` — reuse for "not generated yet" endpoints.
- Multi-arg keys: either a value class with `==`/`hashCode` (`ActivitySearchQuery`, lines 173-217) or a record typedef `typedef PlaceRecord = ({String tripId, String activityId});` (line 233). Prefer the record typedef.
- Invalidation is manual at call sites: `ref.invalidate(proposalsProvider(widget.tripId)); ref.invalidate(itineraryProvider(widget.tripId)); ref.invalidate(tripProvider(widget.tripId));`. For await-then-refresh, `await ref.read(tripProvider(tripId).future)` inside try/catch (overview `_refresh`). No streams, no `ref.listen` for data, no polling.
- Non-async config state uses `StateNotifierProvider` (`theme_controller.dart`). Auth is `authControllerProvider` in `lib/features/auth/auth_controller.dart`.

## 8. Realtime, offline, dependencies

- No WebSocket/SSE/stream/polling code anywhere in `lib` (grep for `WebSocket|socket|realtime|Stream<|poll` returns nothing). Everything is request/response via `ApiClient`; "live" behaviour = `RefreshIndicator` + `ref.invalidate`.
- Local storage: `lib/core/storage/json_store.dart` — abstract `JsonStore` (`read/write/delete`), `SecureJsonStore` (flutter_secure_storage) and `MemoryJsonStore` (tests/web), exposed as `jsonStoreProvider` which returns `MemoryJsonStore()` when `kIsWeb`. Only used by `SafarCookieJar` for the refresh cookie. There is **no** response cache/offline layer. `shared_preferences` is used only for theme + onboarding flags.
- `pubspec.yaml` deps: `flutter_riverpod ^2.6.1`, `go_router ^17.5.0`, `dio ^5.11.1`, `cookie_jar ^4.0.9`, `dio_cookie_manager ^3.5.0`, `flutter_secure_storage ^11.2.0`, `intl ^0.20.3`, `cached_network_image ^3.4.1`, `shared_preferences ^2.5.6`, `cupertino_icons`; dev: `flutter_test`, `flutter_lints ^6.0.0`. Dart SDK `^3.11.1` (records, patterns, null-aware elements `?x` are all in use).

## 9. Test conventions

- `test/widget_test.dart`: pure widget tests, no network. Wrapper helper `Widget _wrap(Widget child) => ProviderScope(child: MaterialApp(theme: SafarTheme.light(), home: child));`, `testWidgets` + `find.text` / `find.widgetWithText(FilledButton, 'Sign in')` / `find.byTooltip('Show password')`, `await tester.pump()` after taps. No mocks, no provider overrides.
- `test/ui_fixes_test.dart`: mixed plain `test()` for pure functions plus `testWidgets` that pump widgets directly with `MaterialApp(theme: SafarTheme.light(), home: Scaffold(body: Center(child: SafarImage(url: ''))))`. Public helpers are exported for testability, e.g. `import 'package:safar_mobile/features/trip/pulse_screen.dart' show formatDayLabel;` — so keep pure formatters (like `formatDayLabel`) as top-level functions in the screen file.
- `test/format_test.dart`: unit tests for `lib/core/utils/format.dart`.
- `test/integration/live_api_test.dart`: opt-in against a real backend, gated by `Platform.environment['SAFAR_LIVE_API']` with a `_skipReason`; builds `ApiClient` with `MemoryJsonStore`. Skip-gated, not part of normal runs.

### Checklist for one new module (e.g. "Ledger")
1. `lib/core/models/ledger.dart` — classes + `fromJson` using `json.dart` helpers.
2. `lib/core/repositories/ledger_repository.dart` — `class LedgerRepository { LedgerRepository(this._api); final ApiClient _api; ... }` hitting `/api/trips/$tripId/ledger`.
3. `providers.dart` — `ledgerRepositoryProvider` (Provider) + `ledgerProvider` (`FutureProvider.family<Ledger, String>`).
4. `lib/features/trip/ledger_screen.dart` — `ConsumerStatefulWidget(tripId)`, `Scaffold(appBar: AppBar(title: Text('Ledger')))`, `AsyncView`, `showSafarSheet` forms, snackbars, `ref.invalidate`.
5. `router.dart` — import + `GoRoute(path: 'ledger', parentNavigatorKey: _rootNavigator, builder: ...)` inside the `/trips/:tripId` children.
6. `trip_overview_screen.dart` — new `_Tool(...)` in the Workspace grid and `ref.invalidate(ledgerProvider(tripId))` in `_refresh`.
7. `test/` — pure-function `test()`s and a `MaterialApp(theme: SafarTheme.light())` widget test.

573	function ProposalImpact({ tripId, proposalId }: { tripId: string; proposalId: string }) {
574	  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
575	  const panelId = useId();
576	  const detail = useQuery({
577	    queryKey: ["proposal-detail", tripId, proposalId],
578	    queryFn: () =>
579	      api<Proposal & {
580	        impact?: {
581	          cost_impact?: { total_delta: number; per_member_estimate: number; currency: string };
582	          budget_conflicts?: { reason: string; item: string }[];
583	          pact_conflicts?: { item: string; rule: string; resolution: string }[];
584	          schedule_conflicts?: {
585	            item: string;
586	            proposed?: string;
587	            reason: string;
588	            protected: boolean;
589	          }[];
590	        };
591	      }>(`/api/trips/${tripId}/proposals/${proposalId}`),
592	    enabled: open,
593	  });
594	
595	  return (
596	    <div className="border-t border-line pt-3">
597	      <button
598	        type="button"
599	        onClick={() => setOpen((value) => !value)}
600	        aria-expanded={open}
601	        aria-controls={panelId}
602	        className="flex w-full items-center justify-between text-[12px] text-muted transition-colors hover:text-ink"
603	      >
604	        <span>Impact if approved</span>
605	        <ChevronDown
606	          size={14}
607	          className={cn("transition-transform", open ? "rotate-180" : "")}
608	        />
609	      </button>
610	      {open ? (
611	        <div id={panelId}>
612	        {detail.isLoading ? (
613	          <p className="mt-2 text-[12px] text-faint">Calculating…</p>
614	        ) : detail.error ? (
615	          <p className="mt-2 text-[12px] text-rose">{(detail.error as Error).message}</p>
616	        ) : detail.data?.impact ? (
617	          <div className="mt-2 space-y-2 rounded-xl bg-raised/60 p-3 text-[12px] text-muted">
618	            {detail.data.impact.cost_impact ? (
619	              <p>
620	                Cost change:{" "}
621	                <span className="font-mono text-ink">
622	                  {formatMoney(
623	                    detail.data.impact.cost_impact.total_delta,
624	                    detail.data.impact.cost_impact.currency,
625	                  )}
626	                </span>{" "}
627	                total · {formatMoney(detail.data.impact.cost_impact.per_member_estimate, detail.data.impact.cost_impact.currency)} per member (estimate)
628	              </p>
629	            ) : null}
630	            {(detail.data.impact.pact_conflicts || []).map((conflict, index) => (
631	              <p key={`pact-${index}`} className="text-rose">
632	                Pact conflict: {conflict.item} — {conflict.resolution}
633	              </p>
634	            ))}
635	            {(detail.data.impact.budget_conflicts || []).map((conflict, index) => (
636	              <p key={`budget-${index}`} className="text-rose">
637	                Budget: {conflict.item} — {conflict.reason}
638	              </p>
639	            ))}
640	            {(detail.data.impact.schedule_conflicts || []).map((conflict, index) => (
641	              <p key={`schedule-${index}`} className="text-rose">
642	                {conflict.protected ? "Protected time" : "Schedule"}: {conflict.item}
643	                {conflict.proposed ? ` vs ${conflict.proposed}` : ""} — {conflict.reason}
644	              </p>
645	            ))}
646	            {!detail.data.impact.cost_impact ? (
647	              <p>No cost impact recorded for this proposal.</p>
648	            ) : null}
649	          </div>
650	        ) : (
651	          <p className="mt-2 text-[12px] text-faint">No impact data returned.</p>
652	        )}
653	        </div>
654	      ) : null}
655	    </div>
656	  );
657	}

def _proposal_impact(db: Session, trip: Trip, proposal: ItineraryProposal) -> dict:
    operations = _build_proposal_operations(db, trip, proposal)
    total_delta = round(sum(operation.get("cost", 0) for operation in operations), 2)
    members = (
        db.query(TripMember)
        .filter(TripMember.trip_id == trip.id, TripMember.status == "active")
        .all()
    )
    per_member = round(total_delta / max(1, len(members)), 2)
    budget_conflicts = []
    for operation in operations:
        if operation["op"] != "add":
            continue
        for member in members:
            if member.budget_limit is not None and operation["cost"] > member.budget_limit:
                budget_conflicts.append(
                    {
                        "reason": "A stated hard budget limit would be exceeded.",
                        "item": operation["title"],
                    }
                )
    return {
        "operations": [
            {
                "op": operation["op"],
                "title": operation.get("title"),
                "day": operation.get("day"),
                "start_time": operation.get("start_time"),
                "cost": operation.get("cost"),
            }
            for operation in operations
        ],
        "cost_impact": {
            "total_delta": total_delta,
            "per_member_estimate": per_member,
            "currency": trip.currency,
            "note": "Per-member estimate assumes an equal share of the group plan.",
        },
        "budget_conflicts": budget_conflicts,
        "pact_conflicts": _pact_conflicts(db, trip, operations),
        "schedule_conflicts": _schedule_conflicts(db, trip, operations),
        "requires_approval": True,
    }

@router.post("/{trip_id}/branches", status_code=201)
def create_branch(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: BranchCreate,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    for member_id in payload.member_ids:
        member = db.get(TripMember, member_id)
        if not member or member.trip_id != trip.id or member.status != "active":
            raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Branches can only include active members")
    activity = db.get(Activity, payload.activity_id) if payload.activity_id else None
    if payload.activity_id and not activity:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Activity not found")
    feasibility = {
        "status": "unknown",
        "note": "Reunion travel feasibility is not verified unless the reunion place is a catalog activity.",
    }
    if activity and payload.reunion_place and payload.reunion_at:
        reunion_activity = (
            db.query(Activity)
            .filter(Activity.destination_id == trip.destination_id, Activity.name.ilike(payload.reunion_place))
            .first()
        )
        if reunion_activity and activity.place_id and reunion_activity.place_id:
            origin = db.get(Place, activity.place_id)
            target = db.get(Place, reunion_activity.place_id)
            if origin and target:
                distance = haversine_km(origin.lat, origin.lon, target.lat, target.lon)
                minutes = travel_minutes(distance)
                feasibility = {
                    "status": "estimated",
                    "distance_km": distance,
                    "travel_minutes": minutes,
                    "note": "Estimated from straight-line distance, not live routing.",
                }
    branch = TripBranch(
        trip_id=trip.id,
        name=payload.name,
        member_ids=payload.member_ids,
        activity_id=payload.activity_id,
        reunion_at=payload.reunion_at,
        reunion_place=payload.reunion_place,
        created_by=user.id,
    )
    db.add(branch)
    audit(
        db,
        action="branch.create",
        entity_type="trip_branch",
        entity_id=branch.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
    )
    db.commit()
    return {"id": branch.id, "feasibility": feasibility}

@router.post("/{trip_id}/ground-requests", status_code=201)
def create_ground_request(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: GroundRequestIn,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    if not payload.place_id and not payload.activity_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="A place or activity is required")
    if payload.activity_id:
        activity = db.get(Activity, payload.activity_id)
        if not activity:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Activity not found")
    request = GroundRequest(
        trip_id=trip.id,
        place_id=payload.place_id,
        activity_id=payload.activity_id,
        question=payload.question,
        requested_by=user.id,
    )
    db.add(request)
    db.commit()
    return {"id": request.id, "status": request.status}


@router.post("/{trip_id}/ground-requests/{request_id}/responses", status_code=201)
def respond_ground_request(
    trip_id: str,
    request_id: str,
    payload: GroundResponseIn,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    # Local contributors are not trip members. They answer as opted-in locals
    # for the destination, so this endpoint checks contributor status rather
    # than membership; it never returns trip details to them.
    if db.get_bind().dialect.name == "postgresql":
        # Security-definer helper returns only the destination id, so the
        # contributor never gains row access to unrelated trip data.
        destination_id = db.execute(
            text("SELECT safar_ground_request_destination(:rid)"),
            {"rid": request_id},
        ).scalar()
        if not destination_id:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Trip not found")
    else:
        trip = db.get(Trip, trip_id)
        if not trip or trip.deleted_at:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Trip not found")
        destination_id = trip.destination_id
    contributor = (
        db.query(LocalContributor)
        .filter(
            LocalContributor.user_id == user.id,
            LocalContributor.accepts_requests.is_(True),
        )
        .first()
    )
    if not contributor:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=403,
            detail="Only opt-in local contributors can answer ground requests",
        )
    if contributor.destination_id != destination_id:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=403,
            detail="Only contributors for this destination can answer",
        )
    request = db.get(GroundRequest, request_id)
    if not request or request.trip_id != trip_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Request not found")
    response = GroundResponse(
        request_id=request.id,
        contributor_id=user.id,
        observation=payload.observation,
        confidence=payload.confidence,
        verified=False,
    )
    db.add(response)
    db.flush()
    request.status = "answered"
    audit(
        db,
        action="ground.response",
        entity_type="ground_response",
        entity_id=response.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip_id,
    )
    db.commit()
    return {
        "id": response.id,
        "provenance": "REPORTED (unverified)",
        "note": "One traveller observation never becomes verified information automatically.",
    }

@router.get("/trips/{trip_id}/nearby")
def nearby(
    trip_id: str,
    lat: float | None = Query(default=None, ge=-90, le=90),
    lon: float | None = Query(default=None, ge=-180, le=180),
    radius_km: float = Query(default=5, gt=0, le=50),
    category: str | None = Query(default=None, max_length=60),
    limit: int = Query(default=20, ge=1, le=60),
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    if lat is not None or lon is not None:
        profile = db.query(Profile).filter(Profile.user_id == user.id).first()
        if not profile or not profile.location_sharing:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=403,
                detail=(
                    "Enable precise location in your privacy settings to use "
                    "your current position for nearby suggestions."
                ),
            )
        if lat is None or lon is None:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=422, detail="Provide both lat and lon, or neither"
            )
    base_lat = lat if lat is not None else trip.base_lat
    base_lon = lon if lon is not None else trip.base_lon
    activities = (
        db.query(Activity).filter(Activity.destination_id == trip.destination_id).all()
        if trip.destination_id
        else []
    )
    place_map, destination_map = _activity_place_maps(db, activities)
    items = []
    for activity in activities:
        place = place_map.get(activity.place_id)
        if not place:
            continue
        if category and place.category.lower() != category.lower():
            continue
        distance = haversine_km(base_lat, base_lon, place.lat, place.lon)
        if distance > radius_km:
            continue
        items.append(
            {
                "activity": activity_out(
                    activity, place, destination_map.get(activity.destination_id)
                ),
                "distance_km": round(distance, 2),
                "travel_minutes": travel_minutes(distance),
                "provenance": "ESTIMATED",
            }
        )
    items.sort(key=lambda item: item["distance_km"])
    return {
        "base": {"lat": base_lat, "lon": base_lon, "source": "shared trip base" if lat is None else "requested point"},
        "radius_km": radius_km,
        "items": items[:limit],
        "disclosure": (
            "Distances are straight-line estimates and travel time is not a live routed ETA. "
            "No live member location is exposed."
        ),
    }


def _activity_for_trip(db: Session, trip: Trip, activity_id: str) -> Activity:
    activity = db.get(Activity, activity_id)
    if not activity:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Activity not found")
    if activity.destination_id != trip.destination_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Activity not found for this trip")
    return activity

@router.post("/trips/{trip_id}/places/{activity_id}/expectation")
def expectation_check(
    trip_id: str,

@router.get("/serendipity/requests")
def list_connection_requests(
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db)
):
    rows = (
        db.query(ConnectionRequest)
        .filter(
            (ConnectionRequest.from_user_id == user.id)
            | (ConnectionRequest.to_user_id == user.id)
        )
        .order_by(ConnectionRequest.created_at.desc())
        .all()
    )
    users = {
        person.id: person
        for person in db.query(User)
        .filter(User.id.in_({row.from_user_id for row in rows} | {row.to_user_id for row in rows}))
        .all()
    }
    return {
        "items": [
            {
                "id": row.id,
                "direction": "outgoing" if row.from_user_id == user.id else "incoming",
                "from_user": user_public(users.get(row.from_user_id)),
                "to_user": user_public(users.get(row.to_user_id)),
                "message": row.message,
                "status": row.status,
                "created_at": row.created_at,
                "decided_at": row.decided_at,
            }
            for row in rows
        ],
        "disclosure": "Contact requires mutual acceptance. Exact locations are never shared.",
    }


@router.post("/serendipity/requests", status_code=201)
def create_connection_request(
    payload: ConnectionCreate,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    if payload.to_user_id == user.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="You cannot connect with yourself")
    target = db.get(User, payload.to_user_id)
    if not target or target.deleted_at or not target.is_active:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Traveller not found")
    target_profile = db.query(Profile).filter(Profile.user_id == target.id).first()
    my_profile = db.query(Profile).filter(Profile.user_id == user.id).first()
    if not my_profile or not my_profile.allow_discovery:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=403,
            detail="Enable traveller discovery in your privacy settings first",
        )
    if not target_profile or not target_profile.allow_discovery or not target_profile.public_profile:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="This traveller is not open to contact")
    if target.id in _blocked_ids(db, user.id):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="This traveller is not open to contact")
    existing = (
        db.query(ConnectionRequest)
        .filter(
            ConnectionRequest.status.in_(["pending", "accepted"]),
            (
                ((ConnectionRequest.from_user_id == user.id) & (ConnectionRequest.to_user_id == target.id))
                | ((ConnectionRequest.from_user_id == target.id) & (ConnectionRequest.to_user_id == user.id))
            ),
        )
        .first()
    )
    if existing:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=409,
            detail="A request already exists between you two",
        )
    if payload.trip_id:
        _trip(db, payload.trip_id, user)
    request = ConnectionRequest(
        from_user_id=user.id,
        to_user_id=target.id,
        trip_id=payload.trip_id,
        message=payload.message,
    )
    db.add(request)
    db.add(
        Notification(
            user_id=target.id,
            kind="connection_request",
            title=f"{user.display_name} would like to connect",
            body="Accept only if you are comfortable. Exact locations are never shared.",
            link="/connections",
        )
    )
    audit(
        db,
        action="connection.request",
        entity_type="connection_request",
        entity_id=request.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=payload.trip_id,
    )
    db.commit()
    return {
        "id": request.id,
        "status": request.status,
        "note": "The other traveller must accept before contact details are exchanged.",
    }


@router.post("/serendipity/requests/{request_id}/decide")
def decide_connection_request(
    request_id: str,
    payload: ConnectionDecision,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    request = db.get(ConnectionRequest, request_id)
    if not request or request.to_user_id != user.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Request not found")
    if request.status != "pending":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="This request was already decided")
    request.status = "accepted" if payload.accept else "declined"
    request.decided_at = utcnow()
    match = (
        db.query(TravellerMatch)
        .filter(
            TravellerMatch.user_a_id == request.from_user_id,
            TravellerMatch.user_b_id == user.id,
        )
        .first()
    )
    if match:
        match.status = "connected" if payload.accept else "declined"
    db.add(
        Notification(
            user_id=request.from_user_id,
            kind="connection_decision",
            title=(
                f"{user.display_name} accepted your connection"
                if payload.accept
                else f"{user.display_name} declined your connection"
            ),
            body="Meet only in public places and share only what you choose." if payload.accept else None,
            link="/connections",
        )
    )
    audit(
        db,
        action="connection.decide",
        entity_type="connection_request",
        entity_id=request.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        detail={"accept": payload.accept},
    )
    db.commit()
    return {
        "ok": True,
        "status": request.status,
        "disclosure": "Both travellers have now agreed. Keep meetups in public places.",
    }


def _circle_out(db: Session, circle: TravelCircle, viewer_id: str | None) -> dict:
    member_count = db.query(CircleMember).filter(CircleMember.circle_id == circle.id).count()
    joined = (
        db.query(CircleMember)
        .filter(CircleMember.circle_id == circle.id, CircleMember.user_id == viewer_id)
        .first()
        if viewer_id
        else None
    )
    return {
        "id": circle.id,
        "slug": circle.slug,
        "name": circle.name,
        "description": circle.description,
        "interests": circle.interests or [],
        "cover_image": circle.cover_image,
        "member_count": member_count,
        "joined": bool(joined),
        "created_at": circle.created_at,
    }

1	"""Trip workspace WebSocket channel for collaborative updates (F05).
2	
3	Browsers cannot set Authorization headers on WebSocket handshakes, so the
4	short-lived access token is passed as a query parameter and verified before
5	the connection is accepted. Membership is re-checked on every connection.
6	"""
7	
8	from fastapi import APIRouter, Query, WebSocket, WebSocketDisconnect
9	
10	from app.core.realtime import manager
11	from app.core.security import decode_token
12	from app.db.context import set_user_context
13	from app.db.session import SessionLocal
14	from app.models import Trip, TripMember, User
15	from app.services.auth_sessions import session_is_active
16	from app.services.common import event_payload
17	
18	router = APIRouter()
19	
20	
21	@router.websocket("/ws/trips/{trip_id}")
22	async def trip_socket(
23	    websocket: WebSocket,
24	    trip_id: str,
25	    token: str = Query(..., min_length=20),
26	):
27	    payload = decode_token(token, "ws") or decode_token(token, "access")
28	    if not payload or not payload.get("sub"):
29	        await websocket.close(code=4401)
30	        return
31	
32	    db = SessionLocal()
33	    try:
34	        set_user_context(db, payload["sub"])
35	        user = db.get(User, payload["sub"])
36	        if not user or not user.is_active or user.deleted_at:
37	            await websocket.close(code=4401)
38	            return
39	        session_id = payload.get("sid")
40	        if session_id and not session_is_active(db, session_id, user.id):
41	            await websocket.close(code=4401)
42	            return
43	        trip = db.get(Trip, trip_id)
44	        if not trip or trip.deleted_at:
45	            await websocket.close(code=4404)
46	            return
47	        member = (
48	            db.query(TripMember)
49	            .filter(
50	                TripMember.trip_id == trip.id,
51	                TripMember.user_id == user.id,
52	                TripMember.status == "active",
53	            )
54	            .first()
55	        )
56	        if not member:
57	            await websocket.close(code=4404)
58	            return
59	        display_name = user.display_name
60	    finally:
61	        db.close()
62	
63	    await manager.connect(trip_id, websocket)
64	    await websocket.send_json(
65	        event_payload(
66	            "connected",
67	            trip_id=trip_id,
68	            user=display_name,
69	            note="Live updates for this trip workspace only.",
70	        )
71	    )
72	    try:
73	        while True:
74	            message = await websocket.receive_text()
75	            if message.strip().lower() == "ping":
76	                await websocket.send_json(event_payload("pong", trip_id=trip_id))
77	    except WebSocketDisconnect:
78	        pass
79	    finally:
80	        await manager.disconnect(trip_id, websocket)

@router.get("/circles/{circle_id}")
def get_circle(
    circle_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    circle = db.get(TravelCircle, circle_id)
    if not circle:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Circle not found")
    posts = (
        db.query(CirclePost)
        .filter(CirclePost.circle_id == circle.id, CirclePost.status == "published")
        .order_by(CirclePost.created_at.desc())
        .limit(50)
        .all()
    )
    authors = {
        person.id: person
        for person in db.query(User)
        .filter(User.id.in_({post.user_id for post in posts}))
        .all()
    } if posts else {}
    # Display names and roles are public inside a circle; no contact details
    # or personal preferences are ever included.
    members = (
        db.query(CircleMember, User)
        .join(User, User.id == CircleMember.user_id)
        .filter(CircleMember.circle_id == circle.id)
        .order_by(CircleMember.joined_at.asc())
        .all()
    )
    return {
        **_circle_out(db, circle, user.id),
        "members": [
            {
                "user_id": member.user_id,
                "display_name": person.display_name,
                "role": member.role,
            }
            for member, person in members
        ],
        "posts": [
            {
                "id": post.id,
                "title": post.title,
                "body": post.body,
                "activity_id": post.activity_id,
                "status": post.status,
                "author": user_public(authors.get(post.user_id)),
                "created_at": post.created_at,
            }
            for post in posts
        ],
    }


@router.post("/circles/{circle_id}/join")
def join_circle(
    circle_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    circle = db.get(TravelCircle, circle_id)
    if not circle:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Circle not found")
    existing = (
        db.query(CircleMember)
        .filter(CircleMember.circle_id == circle.id, CircleMember.user_id == user.id)
        .first()
    )
    if not existing:
        db.add(CircleMember(circle_id=circle.id, user_id=user.id))
        audit(
            db,
            action="circle.join",
            entity_type="travel_circle",
            entity_id=circle.id,
            user_id=user.id,
        )
        db.commit()
    return {"ok": True, "joined": True, "member_count": _circle_out(db, circle, user.id)["member_count"]}


@router.delete("/circles/{circle_id}/join")
def leave_circle(
    circle_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    circle = db.get(TravelCircle, circle_id)
    if not circle:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Circle not found")
    db.query(CircleMember).filter(
        CircleMember.circle_id == circle.id, CircleMember.user_id == user.id
    ).delete()
    db.commit()
    return {"ok": True, "joined": False}


@router.post("/circles/{circle_id}/posts", status_code=201)
def create_circle_post(
    circle_id: str,
    payload: CirclePostCreate,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    circle = db.get(TravelCircle, circle_id)
    if not circle:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Circle not found")
    membership = (
        db.query(CircleMember)
        .filter(CircleMember.circle_id == circle.id, CircleMember.user_id == user.id)
        .first()
    )
    if not membership:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Join the circle before posting")
    if payload.activity_id:
        activity = db.get(Activity, payload.activity_id)
        if not activity:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Activity not found")
    post = CirclePost(
        circle_id=circle.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        title=payload.title,
        body=payload.body,
        activity_id=payload.activity_id,
    )
    db.add(post)
    audit(
        db,
        action="circle.post",
        entity_type="circle_post",
        entity_id=post.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        detail={"circle_id": circle.id},
    )
    db.commit()
    return {
        "id": post.id,
        "title": post.title,
        "body": post.body,
        "status": post.status,
        "created_at": post.created_at,
        "moderation": "Posts are published immediately and can be reported for review.",
    }


@router.get("/contributors")
def list_contributors(
    destination_id: str | None = None,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    query = db.query(LocalContributor)
    if destination_id:
        query = query.filter(LocalContributor.destination_id == destination_id)
    rows = query.all()
    users = {
        person.id: person
        for person in db.query(User)
        .filter(User.id.in_({row.user_id for row in rows}))
        .all()
    } if rows else {}
    destinations = {
        destination.id: destination
        for destination in db.query(Destination)
        .filter(Destination.id.in_({row.destination_id for row in rows}))
        .all()
    } if rows else {}
    return {
        "items": [
            {
                "id": row.id,
                "user": user_public(users.get(row.user_id)),
                "destination": (
                    destination_out(destinations[row.destination_id])
                    if row.destination_id in destinations
                    else None
                ),
                "bio": row.bio,
                "expertise": row.expertise or [],
                "verified": row.verified,
                "accepts_requests": row.accepts_requests,
            }
            for row in rows
        ],
        "disclosure": "Contributors are opt-in travellers, not official tourism authorities.",
    }


@router.post("/contributors")
def upsert_contributor(
    payload: ContributorIn,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    destination = db.get(Destination, payload.destination_id)
    if not destination:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Destination not found")
    row = db.query(LocalContributor).filter(LocalContributor.user_id == user.id).first()
    if not row:
        row = LocalContributor(user_id=user.id, destination_id=destination.id)
        db.add(row)
    row.destination_id = destination.id
    row.bio = payload.bio
    row.expertise = payload.expertise
    row.accepts_requests = payload.accepts_requests
    audit(
        db,
        action="contributor.upsert",
        entity_type="local_contributor",
        entity_id=row.id,
        user_id=user.id,
    )
    db.commit()
    return {
        "id": row.id,
        "destination_id": row.destination_id,
        "accepts_requests": row.accepts_requests,
        "verified": row.verified,
        "note": "Verification is granted by moderators, never self-declared.",
    }

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException
from sqlalchemy import func
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.core.deps import get_current_user, get_db, get_trip_and_member
from app.db.context import companion_context
from app.models import (
    CompanionLink,
    CompanionResponse,
    ItineraryItem,
    ItineraryProposal,
    User,
)
from app.models.models import utcnow
from app.schemas.schemas import CompanionLinkIn, CompanionResponseIn
from app.services import companion as companion_service
from app.services.common import audit

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/trips", tags=["companion"])
public_router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/companion", tags=["companion"])


def _link_brief(db: Session, link: CompanionLink) -> dict:
    responses = (
        db.query(func.count(CompanionResponse.id))
        .filter(CompanionResponse.link_id == link.id)
        .scalar()
        or 0
    )
    values = {
        value: count
        for value, count in (
            db.query(CompanionResponse.value, func.count(CompanionResponse.id))
            .filter(CompanionResponse.link_id == link.id)
            .group_by(CompanionResponse.value)
            .all()
        )
    }
    target = None
    if link.purpose == "vote":
        proposal = db.get(ItineraryProposal, link.target_id)
        target = {
            "kind": "proposal",
            "id": link.target_id,
            "title": proposal.title if proposal else "Decision removed",
            "status": proposal.status if proposal else "missing",
        }
    else:
        item = db.get(ItineraryItem, link.target_id)
        target = {
            "kind": "checkin",
            "id": link.target_id,
            "title": item.title if item else "Item removed",
            "day": item.day.isoformat() if item else None,
            "status": item.status if item else "missing",
        }
    return {
        "id": link.id,
        "purpose": link.purpose,
        "target": target,
        "status": companion_service.link_status(link),
        "expires_at": link.expires_at,
        "max_uses": link.max_uses,
        "used_count": link.used_count,
        "anonymous_responses": responses,
        "response_values": values,
        "created_at": link.created_at,
    }


@router.post("/{trip_id}/companion-links", status_code=201)
def create_companion_link(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: CompanionLinkIn,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = get_trip_and_member(trip_id, db, user)

    if payload.purpose == "vote":
        target = db.get(ItineraryProposal, payload.target_id)
        if not target or target.trip_id != trip.id:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Decision not found")
        if target.status != "open":
            raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Only open decisions can be shared.")
    else:
        target = db.get(ItineraryItem, payload.target_id)
        if not target or target.trip_id != trip.id:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Itinerary item not found")
        if target.status != "confirmed":
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=422, detail="Only confirmed itinerary items can be shared."
            )

    link = CompanionLink(
        trip_id=trip.id,
        created_by=user.id,
        purpose=payload.purpose,
        target_id=payload.target_id,
        expires_at=companion_service.expires_from_now(payload.ttl_minutes),
        max_uses=1,
        used_count=0,
    )
    db.add(link)
    db.flush()
    token = companion_service.issue_token(link)
    audit(
        db,
        action="companion.create",
        entity_type="companion_link",
        entity_id=link.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
        detail={"purpose": link.purpose, "target_id": link.target_id},
    )
    db.commit()
    return {
        "link": _link_brief(db, link),
        "token": token,
        "url": f"/companion/{token}",
        "disclosure": (
            "Anyone with this link can answer once, without an account. Their identity is not recorded. "
            "The link expires on its own and can be revoked."
        ),
    }


@router.get("/{trip_id}/companion-links")
def list_companion_links(
    trip_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, member = get_trip_and_member(trip_id, db, user)
    query = db.query(CompanionLink).filter(CompanionLink.trip_id == trip.id)
    if member.role not in {"owner", "admin"}:
        query = query.filter(CompanionLink.created_by == user.id)
    links = query.order_by(CompanionLink.created_at.desc()).all()
    return {
        "items": [_link_brief(db, link) for link in links],
        "disclosure": "Tokens are shown once when created and are never listed again.",
    }


@router.post("/{trip_id}/companion-links/{link_id}/revoke")
def revoke_companion_link(
    trip_id: str,
    link_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, member = get_trip_and_member(trip_id, db, user)
    link = db.get(CompanionLink, link_id)
    if not link or link.trip_id != trip.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Link not found")
    if link.created_by != user.id and member.role not in {"owner", "admin"}:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Only the creator or an owner can revoke this link")
    if not link.revoked_at:
        link.revoked_at = utcnow()
        audit(
            db,
            action="companion.revoke",
            entity_type="companion_link",
            entity_id=link.id,
            user_id=user.id,
            trip_id=trip.id,
        )
        db.commit()
    return {"id": link.id, "status": companion_service.link_status(link)}


@router.get("/{trip_id}/companion-links/{link_id}/responses")
def list_companion_responses(
    trip_id: str,
    link_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, member = get_trip_and_member(trip_id, db, user)
    link = db.get(CompanionLink, link_id)
    if not link or link.trip_id != trip.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Link not found")
    if link.created_by != user.id and member.role not in {"owner", "admin"}:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Only the creator or an owner can read responses")
    rows = (
        db.query(CompanionResponse)
        .filter(CompanionResponse.link_id == link.id)
        .order_by(CompanionResponse.created_at)
        .all()
    )
    return {
        "items": [
            {"id": row.id, "value": row.value, "comment": row.comment, "created_at": row.created_at}
            for row in rows
        ],
        "anonymous": True,
        "disclosure": "No respondent identity, IP address or device identifier is stored.",
    }


@public_router.get("/{token}")
def companion_view(token: str, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    parsed = companion_service.parse_token(token)
    if parsed:
        companion_context(db, parsed[0])
    link, error = companion_service.resolve_active(db, token)
    if error:
        status_code = 404 if link is None else 410
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status_code, detail=error)
    return companion_service.context(db, link)


@public_router.post("/{token}/respond")
def respond(token: str, payload: CompanionResponseIn, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    parsed = companion_service.parse_token(token)
    if parsed:
        companion_context(db, parsed[0])
    link, error = companion_service.resolve_active(db, token)
    if error:
        status_code = 404 if link is None else 410
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status_code, detail=error)

    allowed = (
        companion_service.VOTE_VALUES
        if link.purpose == "vote"
        else companion_service.CHECKIN_VALUES
    )
    if payload.value not in allowed:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=422,
            detail=f"Choose one of: {', '.join(allowed)}",
        )
    ok, reason = companion_service.target_open(db, link)
    if not ok:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=reason)

    db.add(
        CompanionResponse(
            link_id=link.id,
            value=payload.value,
            comment=(payload.comment or "").strip() or None,
        )
    )
    link.used_count += 1
    audit(
        db,
        action="companion.response",
        entity_type="companion_link",
        entity_id=link.id,
        user_id=None,
        trip_id=link.trip_id,
        detail={"purpose": link.purpose, "value": payload.value},
    )
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(link)
    return {
        "ok": True,
        "recorded": payload.value,
        "anonymous": True,
        "remaining_uses": max(0, link.max_uses - link.used_count),
        "message": "Thank you — your answer was recorded without an account.",
    }

@router.get("/{trip_id}/offline")
def offline_snapshot(
    trip_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    from app.models import Activity, Itinerary, ItineraryItem, Place

    items = (
        db.query(ItineraryItem)
        .filter(ItineraryItem.trip_id == trip.id, ItineraryItem.status == "confirmed")
        .order_by(ItineraryItem.day, ItineraryItem.sort_order, ItineraryItem.start_time)
        .all()
    )
    activities = {}
    places = {}
    if items:
        activity_ids = [item.activity_id for item in items if item.activity_id]
        activities = {
            activity.id: activity
            for activity in db.query(Activity).filter(Activity.id.in_(activity_ids)).all()
        } if activity_ids else {}
        place_ids = [activity.place_id for activity in activities.values() if activity.place_id]
        places = {
            place.id: place
            for place in db.query(Place).filter(Place.id.in_(place_ids)).all()
        } if place_ids else {}
    itinerary = db.query(Itinerary).filter(Itinerary.trip_id == trip.id).first()
    pact = db.query(JourneyPact).filter(JourneyPact.trip_id == trip.id).first()
    members = (
        db.query(TripMember)
        .filter(TripMember.trip_id == trip.id, TripMember.status == "active")
        .all()
    )
    return {
        "generated_at": utcnow().isoformat(),
        "stale_after": (datetime.combine(trip.end_date, datetime.min.time()) + timedelta(days=7)).isoformat(),
        "trip": {
            "id": trip.id,
            "name": trip.name,
            "destination": trip.destination_name,
            "start_date": trip.start_date,
            "end_date": trip.end_date,
            "currency": trip.currency,
            "base": {"lat": trip.base_lat, "lon": trip.base_lon},
        },
        "confirmed_version": itinerary.confirmed_version if itinerary else 0,
        "items": [
            {
                "id": item.id,
                "day": item.day,
                "start_time": item.start_time,
                "title": item.title,
                "cost_estimate": item.cost_estimate,
                "is_protected": item.is_protected,
                "place": (
                    {
                        "name": places[activities[item.activity_id].place_id].name,
                        "address": places[activities[item.activity_id].place_id].address,
                        "lat": places[activities[item.activity_id].place_id].lat,
                        "lon": places[activities[item.activity_id].place_id].lon,
                    }
                    if item.activity_id in activities
                    and activities[item.activity_id].place_id in places
                    else None
                ),
            }
            for item in items
        ],
        "members": [
            {"id": member.id, "display_name": member.display_name, "role": member.role}
            for member in members
        ],
        "pact": (
            {
                "must_do": pact.must_do or [],
                "flexible": pact.flexible or [],
                "confirmed_times": pact.confirmed_times or {},
            }
            if pact
            else None
        ),
        "disclosure": (
            "Offline snapshot of the confirmed plan only. Private budgets, accessibility needs "
            "and private memories are excluded. Check staleness before relying on it."
        ),
    }

    )
    if existing:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="This field is already being watched")
    watch = MaterialWatch(
        trip_id=trip.id,
        activity_id=activity.id,
        field=payload.field,
        last_value={"value": _watch_value(activity, payload.field)},
        status="watching",
    )
    db.add(watch)
    audit(
        db,
        action="material_watch.create",
        entity_type="material_watch",
        entity_id=watch.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
        detail={"field": payload.field},
    )
    db.commit()
    return {
        "id": watch.id,
        "field": watch.field,
        "last_value": watch.last_value,
        "status": watch.status,
    }


@router.delete("/trips/{trip_id}/material-watch/{watch_id}")
def delete_watch(
    trip_id: str,
    watch_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, member = get_trip_and_member(trip_id, db, user)
    watch = db.get(MaterialWatch, watch_id)
    if not watch or watch.trip_id != trip.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Watch not found")
    db.delete(watch)
    audit(
        db,
        action="material_watch.delete",
        entity_type="material_watch",
        entity_id=watch_id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
    )
    db.commit()
    return {"ok": True}


@router.post("/trips/{trip_id}/material-watch/check")
def check_watches(
    trip_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = get_trip_and_member(trip_id, db, user)
    rows = db.query(MaterialWatch).filter(MaterialWatch.trip_id == trip.id).all()
    changed = []
    unchanged = 0
    for watch in rows:
        activity = db.get(Activity, watch.activity_id) if watch.activity_id else None
        if not activity:
            watch.status = "target_missing"
            watch.last_checked_at = utcnow()
            continue
        current = _watch_value(activity, watch.field)
        previous = (watch.last_value or {}).get("value")
        watch.last_checked_at = utcnow()
        if current != previous:
            watch.status = "changed"
            watch.last_value = {"value": current, "previous": previous}
            changed.append(
                {
                    "watch_id": watch.id,
                    "activity_id": activity.id,
                    "activity_name": activity.name,
                    "field": watch.field,
                    "previous": previous,
                    "current": current,
                }
            )
        else:
            watch.status = "watching"
            unchanged += 1
    if changed:
        notify_trip_members(
            db,
            trip,
            kind="material_change",
            title=f"{len(changed)} tracked fact(s) changed",
            body="Open Material Change Watch to review the differences. Nothing was changed in your plan.",
            link=f"/trips/{trip.id}/watch",
            exclude_user_id=None,
        )
    audit(
        db,
        action="material_watch.check",
        entity_type="trip",
        entity_id=trip.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
        detail={"changed": len(changed), "unchanged": unchanged},
    )
    db.commit()
    return {
        "checked": len(rows),
        "changed": changed,
        "unchanged": unchanged,
        "note": "Alerts are only sent when a value changes. Your confirmed plan is untouched.",
    }
