## Cross-cutting shell (TripShell)
Header: breadcrumb Dashboard / destination; trip title; date range; destination; phase badge; realtime dot (Live / Connecting / Solo view). Avatars (5 + "+N more"), "Ask SAFAR" + "N · Invite"/"N members" buttons. Tabs: Overview, Plan, Decide, Pulse, Engine, Map, Memories, Money, More. Global nav: Dashboard, Discover, Connections, Circles, Assistant (+ Notifications, Journey DNA, Settings). `/thread` only linked from dashboard; `/contributors` has no nav link (direct URL).

## 1. Trip Twin + Fair Trade (`/trips/[id]/twin`)
Two stacked sections. **Twin**: date picker (clamped to trip dates), activity search (catalog, limit 12), confirmed-day chips (toggled), "Alternative (n/16)" chip row with remove, catalog tile list (name + price). "Compare" button disabled until ≥1 selected. Result: two plan cards (confirmed vs alternative) with item count, group fit, min fit, total cost, travel minutes; per-item list (cost · travel); "Trade-offs" list; diff badges +added/−removed/kept; "Propose this alternative" button + disclosure. **Fair Trade**: Option A / Option B cards, chips added from catalog (duplicates removed), "Find the fair compromise" disabled until both sides non-empty. Success card: "Compromise: {name}", min/avg fit (x/100) vs alternative, who_benefits, who_compromises, trade-offs, disclosure; else amber card with `message`. Toasts: "Comparison ready" (read-only), "Proposal opened" (group decides). Errors: ErrorState only for trip; mutations are toasts. Footer note: read-only analytics; adoption requires group approval. APIs: `POST /twin/compare`, `POST /twin/propose`, `POST /negotiate`, search. No realtime-specific handling (passive invalidation).

## 2. Plan intelligence (`/trips/[id]/insights`)
Header "Fragility, effort, dominoes and backups" + "none of them change it". Cards:
- **Fragility radar**: score n/100 or "—", label, badges comfy/tight/risky, progress bar (jade ≥70 else ember), per-day `<details>` (legs: time, title, "protected", buffer mins coloured), alternative-timing suggestions, disclosure. Loading "Analysing buffers…".
- **Effort budget**: Effort level (+points), Walking km (+min), Transitions, Protected rest minutes, accessibility note, disclosure. Loading "Measuring effort…".
- **Domino map**: item select + delay minutes (0–600); empty "Pick an item to see how a delay propagates."; loading "Tracing the chain…"; result: disruption badge, affected/absorbed counts, affected rows (+slip → new start, protected badge, source highlighted), "Absorbed by buffers: …", repair options, disclosure.
- **Shadowplans**: list "If {item} fails → {backup}", readiness status + created, notes; empty "No backups yet." Form: item, backup activity, optional note, "Save shadowplan".
- **Journey capsules**: list id prefix, fresh/stale badge, created + stale_after; empty "No capsules yet." TTL hours (1–720) + "Create capsule"; note: snapshots confirmed plan/meeting points only, no private budgets or memories.
- Bottom link card → Material Change Watch ("Open" badge).
APIs: `GET /fragility`, `/effort`, `/domino?item_id&delay_minutes`, `/shadowplans` (POST/GET), `/capsules` (POST/GET).

## 3. Opportunity Clock (`/trips/[id]/opportunity`, linked only from More → "Decide & adapt")
Date picker defaults to today if inside trip else start date. Badges: date, "Local check at HH:MM", "n planned item(s)". Stats: Open now / Later today / Closed / Unknown hours. "Free gaps" badges (start–end · mins, 08:00–22:00) or "No usable gap remains on this day." + explanation. "Catalog options" cards: name, status badge (open_now, later_today, no_window, window_missed, closed_today, unknown), provenance, place, duration, ~travel, price, explanation, catalog hours today + verified date or "not independently verified". Empty "Nothing to compare" (all catalog activities already planned). Unavailable state: "No destination yet" + reason. Disclosure footer. API `GET /opportunity-clock?on=`.

## 4. Branches (`/trips/[id]/branches`)
Header "Split the group, keep the plan" + "New branch" button. Latest-feasibility note (status, km, ~min, note). Cards: name, reunion datetime, status badge (proposed=amber else jade), member badges ("No members yet"), activity, "Rejoin at {place}". Empty: "No branches yet". Modal: name (required), member toggles, optional activity select, rejoin datetime + place, Cancel/Create. Note: "Reunion travel time is estimated, not live routed"; branches never change confirmed itinerary. API `GET/POST /branches` (response includes `feasibility`).

## 5. Expectation Reality Check (`/trips/[id]/places/[activityId]`; `/evidence/[activityId]` redirects here)
Sections: header (freshness badge, Fragile place, Step-free, Indoor, name, description, place/duration/effort/price/verified, "Propose to group", "Estimates only · not live data"); **Evidence passport** (sources with Live/Recorded/Unverified, cost assumption, travel assumption, "Still unknown" list, disclosure); **Access chain** (verified/barrier/unknown counts, staged dots verified/reported/barrier/limited/unknown, "No information recorded."); **Crowd forecast** (predicted vs message + reports_used/seen, latest observation; per-weekday/bucket bar 0–100%, interval, stale/fallback badges, confidence); **What travellers reported** (per-category blocks: status, count, freshness, value, verification badges, Helpful button, admin Verify; empty "No reports yet"); **Share an observation** form (category crowd/queue/closure/accessibility/price/parking/road/quality, source community/estimated/unknown [+ official for admins], category-specific value input, observed date ≤ today, optional note) with "unverified community observations, not official facts"; **Expectation check** (claim input, "Check claim"; result verdict badge, evidence items with VERIFIED/REPORTED/ESTIMATED/UNKNOWN, Limitations and Unknowns lists; hint copy with example claims). Propose modal: day, start time, optional note, "This creates a proposal…". APIs: `/places/{id}`, `/place-reports` (POST, `?activity_id&days`), `/{id}/helpful`, `POST /admin/place-reports/{id}/verify`, `/places/{id}/expectation`, `POST /proposals`.

## 6. Thread (`/thread`)
Header "Journey Thread / What you carry forward" + "Find a place". Stats: Completed journeys, Traditions, Consent = "Opt-in". Tradition cards: index number, name, "n signals", duration · price, "Signals: loved, would_return", external-link icon to /discover. Empty: "Your thread is still blank" + "Open your journeys". "How the thread works" card with server `note` + "No private preference is exposed". API `GET /api/users/me/thread` (completed_trips, traditions[], note).

## 7. Map & nearby (`/trips/[id]/map`)
Radar: radius select (2/5/10/20/35 km), category select (museum, park, market, viewpoint, restaurant, landmark). Map card: no base → "This journey has no destination base yet." Legend (ember = confirmed plan, jade = nearby catalog, base lat/lon). "Nearby places" grid with name filter: category, distance badge, description, price · duration, "Details →". Loading skeleton, ErrorState, empty "Nothing in the catalog matches this filter. Try a larger radius." Footer: straight-line estimates, no live member location. API `/nearby?radius_km=`. Access chain lives on place detail (see 5), not the map.

## 8. Ground requests (`/trips/[id]/ground`)
"Ask a question" form: activity select, question textarea (≥5 chars), "Send question". Request cards: question, activity · created, status badge (answered/…), responses (provenance badge verified/not, observed_at, confidence %, observation) or "Waiting for a local contributor."; "Answer as a local contributor" inline form (observation ≥5, confidence Low/Medium/High, Share/Cancel). Empty "No questions yet". Copy: opt-in local contributors; unverified until moderated; single observation never auto-verified; no live locations. Toasts "Question sent", "Observation shared — stays unverified until moderated". API `GET/POST /ground-requests`, `POST /ground-requests/{id}/responses`.

## 9. Circles / Contributors
**Circles** (`/circles`): grid cards (Orbit icon, Joined/Open badge, name, description, ≤3 interests, member count). Empty "No circles yet". "What a circle is not" three cards (not broadcasting, not a location feed, not popularity).
**Circle detail** (`/circles/[id]`): back link; hero (name, description, interests, member count, Join/Leave button, toasts "Joined circle"/"Left circle"); posts feed (author avatar, name, datetime, non-published status badge, title, body) empty "No posts yet"; "New post" form (title ≤160, body, Publish disabled <2 chars, toast "Visible to circle members."); Members list (avatar, name, "You" badge, role). APIs `GET /circles`, `/circles/{id}`, `POST|DELETE /join`, `POST /posts`.
**Contributors** (`/contributors`): "Become a contributor" toggle form (destination select, comma expertise, bio, toggle "Accept ground requests", Save). Cards: avatar, name + verified check, destination, bio ("No bio yet."), expertise, "Verified contributor"/"Unverified", "Open to questions"/"Not accepting". Empty "No contributors yet". Disclosure from API. Copy: observations stay REPORTED until moderated; verification granted by moderators, not self-declared.

## 10. Missions (`/trips/[id]/missions`)
Header + server `note` FlowNote. Cards: optional / self-reported / disabled badges, title, description, constraint chips (Cost ≤ n, Effort ≤ n/5, Focus: tag, Respects access needs), actions: "Join" (if not joined), "Mark done", "Disable" (owner/admin only, ghost). Completed → "completed" badge. Empty "No missions right now". Toasts "optional, never required", "Marked complete (self-reported)". APIs `GET /missions`, `POST /missions/{id}/join|complete|disable`.

## 11. Companion links (`/trips/[id]/companion`) + public `/companion/[token]`
Trip side: stats Links/Active/Anonymous answers. Purpose toggle Vote|Check-in; target select (open proposals vs confirmed items) with "Only open decisions/confirmed items can be shared"; expiry select 1h/24h/7d; "Create link". One-time reveal panel: URL in `<code>`, Copy button (clipboard, error toast with raw URL), "The token is not stored in readable form and is never shown again." Empty-target copy variants. Link rows: purpose badge, target title, status badge (active/used/expired/revoked), used/max, expires, anonymous answers, response_values counts, Revoke (active only). Empty "No links yet". Disclosure: signed, scoped, single-use, expiring, no account/email/IP/device stored, never changes plan. APIs `GET/POST /companion-links`, `POST /companion-links/{id}/revoke`.
Public page (no account, no auth shell): SAFAR mark, "No account needed" badge; card with "One decision"/"One check-in", trip name, destination, target title/summary, day · time, registered_votes counts; question + option buttons (yes/no/abstain/in/out/join_later), optional note (≤500), "Send my answer"; privacy line "answered once… name, email, IP address and device are not recorded"; disclosure. Success: "Answer recorded" + message + "Nothing about you was stored". Error: "This link cannot be used" + "single-use and expire" copy + retry. APIs `GET /api/companion/{token}`, `POST /respond`.

## 12. Offline (`/trips/[id]/offline`)
Header + Online/Offline badge, "Download JSON", "Sync queue" (disabled when empty/offline). Stats: Confirmed items, Members, Queued, Version vN. Stale note (generated/stale_after; "This snapshot is stale — refresh before relying on it."). "Waiting to sync" list (operation badge, created, payload text_content) with per-item result statuses; empty "Nothing queued". Snapshot list (day · time · title, place, cost, protected badge), pact must-do + confirmed_times badges, disclosure, "Refresh". "Sync history" from server (operation, client id, applied/rejected/pending). APIs `/offline`, `/sync` (GET/POST batch; applied|skipped cleared locally, rejected kept). Copy: private budgets, access needs, private memories excluded.

## 13. Tasks (`/trips/[id]/tasks`)
"Load balance" card: chips per person (Unassigned or name · open; amber if ≥3) or "No open tasks."; subtitle shows totals.open. "Add task" form (title, optional assignee, optional details). Two columns Open (count badge; empty "Nothing open / All caught up.") and Done ("Nothing completed yet."). Row: check toggle (aria "Mark as done/not done"), title (strikethrough when done), description, assignee name, reassign select (open only). Note: anyone can add; only assignee/owner/admin can update; load is a nudge, not a score. APIs `/tasks` (POST), `/tasks/{id}` (PATCH status|assignee_id), `/tasks/summary`.

## 14. Watch (`/trips/[id]/watch`)
Header with server `note` and "Check now" button. Result note: Checked n · changed n · unchanged n + note. "Add a watch": activity select, field (Opening hours / Price / Step-free access), "Watch". Rows: status badge (changed amber / target_missing rose / else jade), field badge, activity name, "Last value: …" (hours summarised per day or "Every day HH…"; price formatted; step-free/not/unknown) + checked time or "never checked", trash icon (immediate remove). Empty "Nothing watched yet". Copy: alerts only on actual change; never changes plan. APIs `/material-watch` GET/POST, DELETE `/{id}`, POST `/check`.

## 15. Pact (`/trips/[id]/pact`)
Header + "Updated {date}" badge. No pact → "No pact exists yet." + role-dependent copy. Sections: Must-do, Flexible, Confirmed meeting points (label + time rows, add/remove), Exceptions, "Your private limit" (budget limit in trip currency, blank = no limit). Editor for owner/admin, read-only checklists otherwise ("The pact is read-only for your role."). Notes: saving merges your limit without wiping others; individual limits never shown to members; saving does not change itinerary, only engine proposals/approval rules. Save toast: "Conflicts with this pact will now block plan approval." API `GET/PUT /pact`. No confirmation dialog.

## 16. Serendipity (`/connections`)
Header + "Discovery settings" link. If ineligible: "Discovery is currently off" card + reason + link to /profile. "Waiting for your answer" (incoming pending): avatar, name, date, quoted message, Decline/Accept. "Suggested travellers": cards with score badge, headline/home_city, reasons list, shared interests, lock-privacy line, "Request contact". Empty "No compatible travellers yet". Request-contact modal: person, optional message (≤500; hint no phone/live location), "Contact details are only exchanged after mutual acceptance. Meet in public places.", Send. "Your requests": direction, status badge; empty "No connection requests yet." Footer copy: matches heuristic, blocks remove from discovery. APIs `/serendipity/matches`, `/serendipity/requests` (+`/{id}/decide`).

## 17. Voting cost impact (`/trips/[id]/voting`)
Proposal card shows "est. {money}" from payload, vote counts/percentages/bar, comments, then collapsible **"Impact if approved"** disclosure. Lazy fetch `GET /proposals/{id}` on expand; loading "Calculating…"; error text in rose; content: "Cost change: {delta} total · {per member} per member (estimate)", pact conflicts ("Pact conflict: item — resolution"), budget conflicts, schedule conflicts (protected vs schedule), fallback "No cost impact recorded for this proposal." / "No impact data returned." Approval is a two-step confirm modal ("Approve and apply?" / "Reject this proposal?") with copy about rewriting the confirmed itinerary as a new version and pact/budget blocking; buttons "Not yet"/"Keep it open"; "Approval blocked" error toast.

## 18. `/more` grouping (mirror this)
- **Decide & adapt** — "Change the plan without losing trust": Trip Twin, Trip Rescue (`/rescue`), Opportunity Clock, Plan intelligence, Material Change Watch.
- **Group** — "Roles, expectations and shared work": Members & invites, One-Link Companion, Journey pact, Planner tasks, Branch & rejoin.
- **Explore** — "Discovery grounded in evidence": Catalog search, Map & nearby, Dream import, Ask the ground, Missions.
- **Record & remember** — "The journey after the journey": Memory timeline, Memory Studio, Journey replay & book, Offline & sync, Ask SAFAR.
Cards: 2-col, circular icon, title, description. Footer note that main tabs cover Overview/Plan/Decide/Pulse/Engine/Map/Memories/Money.

## 19. Realtime (`lib/realtime.ts` + `services/api/app/routers/ws.py`)
`useTripSocket(tripId)` (used once in TripShell). URL built async from `wsUrl(tripId)`; token passed as query param (WS can't send headers); membership re-checked server-side (close 4401 auth / 4404 not member). Status: idle → connecting → live → closed; header shows Live / Connecting / Solo view. Heartbeat "ping" every 30s, server replies `pong`. On message: parse JSON, `type` defaults to "update"; ignore `connected`/`pong`; then **invalidate everything** — any query whose key[1] === tripId, or key[0] in `trips`, `notifications` (no per-event routing). Reconnect: on close, retry counter +1 (max 5), delay `1500 * retry` ms; success resets to 0; cleanup clears timers and sets idle. Server event types: `connected`, `pong`, `itinerary.updated`, `proposal.created|voted|approved|rejected|withdrawn`, `engine.updated`, `expenses.updated`, `pulse.updated`, `trip.updated`, `trip.deleted`, `member.joined`, `member.removed`, `member.role_updated`. No realtime events exist for branches, twin, insights, ground, missions, tasks, watch, companion, or offline — those rely on mutation-driven invalidation/refetch. Optional tripId means no socket (solo view).

@router.get("/me/thread")
def journey_thread(user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    """Carry favourites and traditions from previous trips (F47)."""
    today = date.today()
    memberships = db.query(TripMember).filter(TripMember.user_id == user.id).all()
    completed_ids = []
    for membership in memberships:
        trip = db.get(Trip, membership.trip_id)
        if trip and not trip.deleted_at and (
            trip.status == "completed" or trip.end_date < today
        ):
            completed_ids.append(trip.id)
    loved = (
        db.query(ActivityFeedback)
        .filter(
            ActivityFeedback.user_id == user.id,
            ActivityFeedback.sentiment.in_(["loved", "would_return"]),
            ActivityFeedback.consented.is_(True),
        )
        .order_by(ActivityFeedback.created_at.desc())
        .all()
    )
    activities = {}
    for row in loved:
        activity = db.get(Activity, row.activity_id)
        if not activity:
            continue
        key = activity.id
        entry = activities.setdefault(
            key,
            {
                "activity_id": key,
                "name": activity.name,
                "price_estimate": activity.price_estimate,
                "duration_minutes": activity.duration_minutes,
                "sentiments": [],
            },
        )
        entry["sentiments"].append(row.sentiment)
    return {
        "completed_trips": len(completed_ids),
        "traditions": sorted(
            activities.values(), key=lambda entry: len(entry["sentiments"]), reverse=True
        )[:10],
        "note": (
            "Only outcomes you consented to share are used. You can repeat, modify or avoid "
            "any of these in a new journey."

"""Trip workspace WebSocket channel for collaborative updates (F05).

Browsers cannot set Authorization headers on WebSocket handshakes, so the
short-lived access token is passed as a query parameter and verified before
the connection is accepted. Membership is re-checked on every connection.
"""

from fastapi import APIRouter, Query, WebSocket, WebSocketDisconnect

from app.core.realtime import manager
from app.core.security import decode_token
from app.db.context import set_user_context
from app.db.session import SessionLocal
from app.models import Trip, TripMember, User
from app.services.auth_sessions import session_is_active
from app.services.common import event_payload

router = APIRouter()


@router.websocket("/ws/trips/{trip_id}")
async def trip_socket(
    websocket: WebSocket,
    trip_id: str,
    token: str = Query(..., min_length=20),
):
    payload = decode_token(token, "ws") or decode_token(token, "access")
    if not payload or not payload.get("sub"):
        await websocket.close(code=4401)
        return

    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        set_user_context(db, payload["sub"])
        user = db.get(User, payload["sub"])
        if not user or not user.is_active or user.deleted_at:
            await websocket.close(code=4401)
            return
        session_id = payload.get("sid")
        if session_id and not session_is_active(db, session_id, user.id):
            await websocket.close(code=4401)
            return
        trip = db.get(Trip, trip_id)
        if not trip or trip.deleted_at:
            await websocket.close(code=4404)
            return
        member = (
            db.query(TripMember)
            .filter(
                TripMember.trip_id == trip.id,
                TripMember.user_id == user.id,
                TripMember.status == "active",
            )
            .first()
        )
        if not member:
            await websocket.close(code=4404)
            return
        display_name = user.display_name
    finally:
        db.close()

    await manager.connect(trip_id, websocket)
    await websocket.send_json(
        event_payload(
            "connected",
            trip_id=trip_id,
            user=display_name,
            note="Live updates for this trip workspace only.",
        )
    )
    try:
        while True:
            message = await websocket.receive_text()
            if message.strip().lower() == "ping":
                await websocket.send_json(event_payload("pong", trip_id=trip_id))
    except WebSocketDisconnect:
        pass
    finally:
        await manager.disconnect(trip_id, websocket)
        "access_token": access_token,
        "token_type": "bearer",
        "expires_in": settings.access_token_expire_minutes * 60,
        "csrf_token": csrf_token,
        "user": user_out(user),
    }


@router.get("/me")
def me(user: User = Depends(get_current_user)):
    return user_out(user)


@router.post("/ws-ticket")
def ws_ticket(
    request: Request,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials | None = Depends(bearer),
):
    from app.core.deps import _token_from_request

    token, _ = _token_from_request(request, credentials)
    payload = decode_access_token(token or "")
    session_id = payload.get("sid") if payload else None
    if not session_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Sign in again to open live updates")
    return {"ticket": create_ws_ticket(user.id, session_id), "expires_in": 120}


@router.post("/logout")
def logout(
    request: Request,
    response: Response,
    credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials | None = Depends(bearer),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    from app.core.deps import _token_from_request

    auth_context(db)
    token, source = _token_from_request(request, credentials)
    if source == "cookie" and not csrf_valid(request):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="CSRF validation failed")

    revoked = False
    refresh_token = request.cookies.get(settings.refresh_cookie)
    if refresh_token:
        session_id = refresh_token.partition(".")[0]
        if session_id:
            revoke_session(db, session_id)
            revoked = True
    if token:
        payload = decode_access_token(token)
        session_id = payload.get("sid") if payload else None
        if session_id:
            revoke_session(db, session_id)
            revoked = True
    clear_auth_cookies(response)
    # Idempotent on purpose: logging out an already-cleared browser must not fail.
    return {"ok": True, "revoked": revoked}

        ),
    }


@router.post("/chat")
def chat(
    payload: ChatIn,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    if payload.trip_id:
        trip, _member = get_trip_and_member(payload.trip_id, db, user)
        return {
            **_answer_with_trip(db, user, trip, payload.message, payload.language),
            "trip_id": trip.id,
        }
    trips = (
        db.query(Trip)
        .join(TripMember, TripMember.trip_id == Trip.id)
        .filter(
            TripMember.user_id == user.id,
            TripMember.status == "active",
            Trip.deleted_at.is_(None),
        )
        .order_by(Trip.start_date.desc())
        .all()
    )
    resolution = resolve_language(
        payload.message, requested=payload.language, preferred=_preferred_language(db, user)
    )
    return {
        "intent": "general",
        "answer": t("general.no_trip", resolution["code"]),
        "citations": [],
        "grounding": "product",
        "limitations": ["No trip selected."],
        "suggested_actions": [
            {"label": "Open a trip", "href": f"/trips/{trip.id}"} for trip in trips[:3]
        ],
        "generated_by": GENERATOR,
        "language": {
            "code": resolution["code"],
            "name": resolution["name"],
            "source": resolution["source"],
        },
        "mutation": "none",
        "trip_id": None,
    }


trip_router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/trips", tags=["assistant"])


@trip_router.post("/{trip_id}/assistant")
def trip_chat(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: ChatIn,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = get_trip_and_member(trip_id, db, user)
    if payload.trip_id and payload.trip_id != trip.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Trip mismatch")
    return {
        **_answer_with_trip(db, user, trip, payload.message, payload.language),
        "trip_id": trip.id,
    }

Details to compile:

1. Trip Twin
- POST /api/trips/{trip_id}/twin/compare — body TwinCompareIn: activity_ids: list[str] (default [], max 16, required non-empty at runtime -> 422), day: date|None. No query params. Response: day, confirmed_plan{name + metrics}, alternative_plan{name + metrics}, diff{added[],removed[],kept[] each {activity_id,name}}, trade_offs[str], requires_approval bool, disclosure str, generated_at ISO str. metrics: total_cost float, total_duration_minutes int, total_travel_minutes int, average_group_fit float|None, minimum_member_fit float|None, items[]{activity_id,name,cost,duration,distance_km,travel_minutes,eligible}.
- POST .../twin/propose — TwinProposeIn activity_ids required min1 max16, day optional. Returns proposal_out + impact. proposal_out keys. state mutation: creates proposal (kind twin_adopt), broadcasts proposal.created.
- Auth: any active member (get_trip_and_member).

2. Shadowplans POST body ShadowplanCreate: item_id, backup_activity_id, notes? -> {id, backup_activity_id, readiness{status,checked_at}}. GET -> {items[]{id,item_id,backup_activity_id,notes,readiness,created_at}}. Any member; POST mutates.

3. Opportunity clock GET query on; response keys as in clock(); 422 out of range; read-only.

4. Branches GET {items[]{id,name,member_ids,activity_id,reunion_at,reunion_place,status}}; POST body BranchCreate -> {id, feasibility{status, note, distance_km?, travel_minutes?}}; mutates.

5. Effort GET -> effort_points, effort_level, walking_km_estimate, walking_minutes_estimate, transitions, protected_rest_minutes, heat_exposure, accessibility_note, disclosure. read-only.

6. Expectation POST body ExpectationIn{claim 3-300} -> activity_id, claim, evidence[]{item,status,detail}, recent_reports (categories array as in aggregate_reports), limitations[], unknowns[], verdict. Non-mutating? expectation_check only reads (aggregate_reports read-only). Yes read-only.

7. Negotiate POST NegotiateIn{option_a[], option_b[], for_date?} -> status, compromise{activity_id,name,minimum_fit,average_fit}, alternative{same}, who_benefits, who_compromises, trade_offs[], feasible, disclosure. Or {status:"needs_options"|"no_feasible_option", message}. read-only.

8. Thread GET /api/users/me/thread -> completed_trips int, traditions[]{activity_id,name,price_estimate,duration_minutes,sentiments[]}, note. read-only, self only.

9. Nearby GET query lat, lon (both or neither; requires location_sharing else 403), radius_km default 5 (0-50), category str, limit 1-60 default 20. Response: base{lat,lon,source}, radius_km, items[]{activity(activity_out),distance_km,travel_minutes,provenance}, disclosure. read-only.

10. Ground requests: GET {items[]{id,question,place_id,activity_id,status,created_at,responses[]{id,observation,observed_at,confidence,verified,provenance,contributor_id}}}. POST body GroundRequestIn{place_id?,activity_id?,question 5-1000} at least one of place/activity; -> {id,status}. POST responses body GroundResponseIn{observation 5-2000, confidence 0-1 default .5}; permission: NOT trip membership — must be opt-in LocalContributor with accepts_requests and matching destination, else 403. -> {id, provenance, note}. Mutates.

11. Circles: GET /api/circles -> {items[]{id,slug,name,description,interests[],cover_image,member_count,joined,created_at},disclosure}. GET /api/circles/{id} -> circle fields + members[]{user_id,display_name,role} + posts[]{id,title,body,activity_id,status,author(user_public),created_at}. POST join -> {ok,joined:true,member_count}; DELETE join -> {ok,joined:false}. POST posts (member-only 403) body CirclePostCreate{title 2-160, body 2-4000, activity_id?} -> {id,title,body,status,created_at,moderation}. Contributors GET ?destination_id= -> {items[]{id,user,destination(exists keys?),bio,expertise[],verified,accepts_requests},disclosure}; POST body ContributorIn{destination_id,bio?,expertise[],accepts_requests=true} -> {id,destination_id,accepts_requests,verified,note}. Mutates.

12. Missions GET -> items[]{id,title,description,constraints{max_cost,max_effort,tag,respect_accessibility,optional,suggested_activity},status,my_status,optional,self_reported} + note; GET mutates (generates missions + commit — state mutation on first call!). join POST -> {ok,status}; complete -> {ok,status,self_reported}; disable requires owner/admin -> {ok}.

13. Companion: POST body CompanionLinkIn{purpose vote|checkin,target_id,ttl_minutes default 1440 (5-10080)} -> {link{...},token,url,disclosure}. GET list (non-admin only own links) -> items[]{id,purpose,target{kind,id,title,status} for vote / target{kind,id,title,day,status} for checkin, status, expires_at, max_uses, used_count, anonymous_responses int, response_values dict[str,int], created_at}. POST revoke -> {id,status}. GET responses creator/owner-admin -> items[]{id,value,comment,created_at}, anonymous, disclosure. Public: GET /api/companion/{token} -> purpose, trip{name,destination_name}, expires_at, remaining_uses, disclosure, anonymous_responses, target(+summary,registered_votes for vote or day,start_time for checkin), question, options[]. POST /api/companion/{token}/respond body {value, comment?} -> {ok,recorded,anonymous,remaining_uses,message}.

14. Offline GET -> generated_at, stale_after, trip{id,name,destination,start_date,end_date,currency,base{lat,lon}}, confirmed_version, items[]{id,day,start_time,title,cost_estimate,is_protected,place{name,address,lat,lon}|null}, members[]{id,display_name,role}, pact{must_do,flexible,confirmed_times}|null, disclosure. Sync GET -> {items[]{client_id,operation,status,applied_at,created_at}}. POST body is a JSON array of OfflineSyncItem{client_id 6-80, operation:"memory_create", payload(dict -> MemoryCreate)}; max 100; idempotency on client_id; response {applied,skipped,rejected,results[]{client_id,status,id?,reason?,errors?},note}. Mutates.

15. Capsules GET -> {items[]{id,created_at,stale_after,stale,snapshot},...} snapshot{trip{},items[],meeting_arrangements,generated_by}. POST body CapsuleCreate{ttl_hours 1-720 default 72} -> {id,stale_after,snapshot}. Mutates.

16. Fragility -> resilience_score int|None, label, days[]{day,legs[]{item_id,title,start_time,end_time,buffer_minutes,buffer_status,travel_minutes,travel_km,protected}, alternative_timings[]{item_id,suggestion,minutes}}, summary{comfortable,tight,risky}, disclosure. read-only.

17. Domino GET query item_id required, delay_minutes default 45 (0-600) -> day, disruption{item_id,title,delay_minutes}, affected[]{item_id,title,slip_minutes,new_start,is_source,protected}, unaffected[]{item_id,title,reason}, minimum_repairs_needed, repair_options[]{item_id,title,options[]}, disclosure. 404 if item not found.

18. Tasks GET -> {items[]{id,title,description,assignee_id,status,created_at}}. POST body TaskCreate{title 2-160, description?, assignee_id?} -> {id,title,status}. PATCH /api/trips/{trip_id}/tasks/{task_id} body TaskUpdate{status open|done?, assignee_id?} -> {id,status,assignee_id}; only assignee or owner/admin. GET summary -> trip_id, totals{open,done,total}, by_assignee[]{user_id,display_name,open,done,total}, unassigned{open,done,total}, load[]{key,display_name,open}, disclosure.

19. Material watch GET -> items[]{id,activity_id,activity_name,field,last_value,status,last_checked_at} + note. POST body {activity_id, field ∈ opening_hours|price_estimate|wheelchair_accessible} -> {id,field,last_value,status}; 409 dup. DELETE -> {ok}. POST check -> {checked, changed[]{watch_id,activity_id,activity_name,field,previous,current}, unchanged, note}. Mutates (check sets statuses). Any member.

20. Pact GET -> {pact: null} or {pact{id,must_do,flexible,individual_limits(dict only own user id),confirmed_times,exceptions,updated_at}}. PUT requires owner/admin body PactUpsert -> {ok:true}. Mutates.

21. Serendipity GET /api/serendipity/matches -> eligible bool, matches[]{user{id,display_name,avatar_url,headline,home_city},score,reasons[],shared_interests[],privacy}, disclosure; if not opted in: {eligible:false,reason,matches:[]}. Mutates (writes TravellerMatch). GET requests -> items[]{id,direction outgoing|incoming,from_user,to_user,message,status,created_at,decided_at} + disclosure. POST requests body ConnectionCreate{to_user_id,trip_id?,message?} -> {id,status,note}; requires own allow_discovery; 409 existing. POST decide body {accept: bool} only recipient -> {ok,status,disclosure}.

22. Cost impact: impact dict from _proposal_impact: operations[]{op,title,day,start_time,cost}, cost_impact{total_delta,per_member_estimate,currency,note}, budget_conflicts[]{reason,item}, pact_conflicts, schedule_conflicts, requires_approval. Present in twin/propose, recommendations/propose, rescue/propose responses as "impact" (sibling of proposal fields). Note budget_conflicts has no per-member identity (privacy) — per-member cost is scalar equal-split, not a map.

23. WS: ws://.../ws/trips/{trip_id}?token=... ; ticket: POST /api/auth/ws-ticket (Bearer/cookie) -> {ticket, expires_in:120}; ticket is JWT with type "ws" (decode_token(token,"ws") or "access"). Close codes 4401 (bad/expired token, inactive user/session) and 4404 (trip missing or not active member). Envelope: {event, at, ...data}. Events: connected{event,at,trip_id,user,note}, pong{trip_id}, proposal.created{trip_id,proposal_id}, proposal.withdrawn/rejected{presumably ids}, itinerary.updated, expenses.updated, trip.updated, trip.deleted, member.joined, member.removed, engine.updated. Heartbeat: client sends text "ping" → server "pong".

24. Assistant POST /api/assistant/chat body ChatIn{message 1-2000, trip_id?, language?} -> intent, answer, citations[]{label,type,id,provenance}, grounding, limitations[], suggested_actions[]{label,href}, generated_by, language{code,name,source,detected,confidence,mixed[],unsupported}, mutation, requires_approval, trip_id, context. Trip variant POST /api/trips/{id}/assistant.

## SAFAR API contracts (all paths relative to `services/api`)

Key files: `app/routers/{engine,itinerary,trips,places,companion,memories,admin,users,assistant,auth,ws}.py`, `app/schemas/schemas.py`, `app/services/{twin,optimizer,rescue,opportunity,discovery,places,companion,assistant}.py`, `app/services/serializers.py`.

**Auth helper (applies everywhere):** `get_trip_and_member()` — non-member / deleted trip returns **404** (deliberately, not 403); wrong role returns **403**. All endpoints below require `Authorization: Bearer`.

**1. Trip Twin** (`routers/engine.py:474,508`; `services/twin.py`)
- `POST /api/trips/{trip_id}/twin/compare` — body `TwinCompareIn`: `activity_ids: list[str]` (default `[]`, max 16; empty → 422), `day: date|None` (defaults today). No query params. Response: `day`, `confirmed_plan` / `alternative_plan` (each: `name` + `total_cost: float`, `total_duration_minutes: int`, `total_travel_minutes: int`, `average_group_fit: float|None`, `minimum_member_fit: float|None`, `items: [{activity_id,name,cost,duration,distance_km,travel_minutes,eligible}]`), `diff{added[],removed[],kept[]}` (items `{activity_id,name}`), `trade_offs: list[str]`, `requires_approval: true`, `disclosure`, `generated_at` (ISO string). Read-only.
- `POST .../twin/propose` — body `TwinProposeIn`: `activity_ids` **required** (1–16), `day?`. Creates proposal `kind="twin_adopt"`, broadcasts `proposal.created`. Response = `proposal_out` + `impact` (see 22). Tests: `test_audit_fixes.py` (compare), `test_phase4.py::test_f39_twin_adoption_cannot_remove_protected_block`, `test_audit_fixes.py` (propose).

**2. Shadowplans** (`itinerary.py:1159,1194`)
- `POST` body `{item_id, backup_activity_id, notes?}` → `{id, backup_activity_id, readiness{status, checked_at}}`. Mutates.
- `GET` → `{items: [{id, item_id, backup_activity_id, notes, readiness, created_at}]}`.
Any member. No pytest coverage.

**3. Opportunity Clock** (`opportunity.py:13`, `services/opportunity.py`)
- `GET .../opportunity-clock?on=YYYY-MM-DD` (`on: date|None`; out of trip range → 422). Response: `date`, `available`, `weekday`, `now`, `planned_count`, `planned_titles[]`, `free_windows[{start,end,minutes}]`, `items[{activity_id,name,place_name,duration_minutes,price_estimate,currency,opening_hours_today,opening_source,last_verified_at,travel_minutes_estimate,status,next_start,explanation,provenance}]` (`status` ∈ open_now/later_today/no_window/window_missed/closed_today/unknown), `summary{candidates,open_now,later_today,closed_today,unknown_hours}`, `explanation`, `disclosure`, `plan_unchanged`, `confirmed_version`. Read-only. Test: `test_stabilisation.py`.

**4. Branches** (`trips.py:986,1015`)
- `GET` → `{items: [{id,name,member_ids,activity_id,reunion_at,reunion_place,status}]}`.
- `POST` body `{name, member_ids[], activity_id?, reunion_at?, reunion_place?}` → `{id, feasibility{status, note, distance_km?, travel_minutes?}}`. Mutates. No tests.

**5. Effort** (`itinerary.py:1144`) — `GET` → `{effort_points, effort_level(light|moderate|demanding), walking_km_estimate, walking_minutes_estimate, transitions, protected_rest_minutes, heat_exposure, accessibility_note, disclosure}`. Read-only. No tests.

**6. Expectation** (`places.py:525`; `services/places.expectation_check`)
- `POST .../places/{activity_id}/expectation` body `{claim: str (3–300)}` → `{activity_id, claim, evidence[{item,status,detail}], recent_reports[categories from aggregate_reports], limitations[], unknowns[], verdict(insufficient_evidence|partially_supported|supported_by_recorded_sources)}`. `recent_reports[]` items: `{category,status,source_type,source_label,latest_observed_at,freshness,freshness_label,confidence,reports_count,weighted_support,reports[{id,value,note,observed_at,source_type,source_label,provenance,verified,verification,confidence,freshness,weight}]}`. Read-only. Test: `test_api.py`.

**7. Negotiator** (`engine.py:670`) — `POST .../negotiate` body `{option_a[], option_b[], for_date?}` → `{status, compromise{activity_id,name,minimum_fit,average_fit}, alternative{…same}, who_benefits, who_compromises, trade_offs[], feasible, disclosure}`; degenerate cases return `{status:"needs_options"|"no_feasible_option", message}`. Read-only. Test: `test_phase4.py::test_f45_negotiation_uses_the_requested_trip_date`.

**8. Thread** (`users.py:544`) — `GET /api/users/me/thread` → `{completed_trips: int, traditions[{activity_id,name,price_estimate,duration_minutes,sentiments[]}], note}`. Self only, read-only. No tests.

**9. Nearby** (`places.py:228`) — `GET .../nearby?lat&lon&radius_km&category&limit`. `lat/lon` both-or-neither (giving them without `profile.location_sharing` → 403); `radius_km` default 5 (0–50); `category` ≤60 chars; `limit` 1–60 default 20. Response `{base{lat,lon,source}, radius_km, items[{activity(activity_out), distance_km, travel_minutes, provenance}], disclosure}`. `activity_out` keys: `id, place_id, destination_id, name, description, tags[], price_estimate, currency, duration_minutes, effort, indoor, wheelchair_accessible, iconic, popularity, fragile, opening_hours{}, access_chain{}, image_url, source_type, last_verified_at, place, destination`. Read-only. Test: `test_security_hardening.py`.

**10. Ground requests** (`trips.py:1074,1115,1141`)
- `GET` → `{items[{id,question,place_id,activity_id,status,created_at,responses[{id,observation,observed_at,confidence,verified,provenance,contributor_id}]}]}`.
- `POST` body `{place_id?, activity_id?, question(5–1000)}` — at least one of place/activity else 422 → `{id,status}`. Mutates.
- `POST .../{request_id}/responses` body `{observation(5–2000), confidence(0–1, default .5)}`. **Permission is contributor-based, not membership**: caller must be a `LocalContributor` with `accepts_requests=true` for this trip's destination (else 403). → `{id, provenance, note}`. Test: `test_api.py`.

**11. Circles / contributors** (`places.py:932–1160`)
- `GET /api/circles` → `{items[{id,slug,name,description,interests[],cover_image,member_count,joined,created_at}], disclosure}`.
- `GET /api/circles/{id}` → same fields + `members[{user_id,display_name,role}]`, `posts[{id,title,body,activity_id,status,author{id,display_name,avatar_url,locale},created_at}]`.
- `POST .../join` → `{ok,joined:true,member_count}`; `DELETE .../join` → `{ok,joined:false}`. Mutating.
- `POST .../posts` (must have joined, else 403) body `{title(2–160), body(2–4000), activity_id?}` → `{id,title,body,status,created_at,moderation}`. Mutating.
- `GET /api/contributors?destination_id=` → `{items[{id,user,bio,expertise[],verified,accepts_requests}], disclosure}`; `POST /api/contributors` body `{destination_id, bio?, expertise[], accepts_requests=true}` → `{id,destination_id,accepts_requests,verified,note}`. Mutating. Test: `test_api.py` (circles).

**12. Missions** (`trips.py:1213–1307`)
- `GET` → `{items[{id,title,description,constraints{max_cost,max_effort,tag,respect_accessibility,optional,suggested_activity},status,my_status,optional,self_reported}], note}`. **Note: GET writes** (lazily generates missions and commits).
- `POST .../{mission_id}/join` → `{ok,status}`; `/complete` → `{ok,status,self_reported}`; `/disable` requires **owner/admin** → `{ok}`. Mutating. No tests.

**13. Companion links** (`companion.py`)
- `POST .../companion-links` body `{purpose: vote|checkin, target_id, ttl_minutes(5–10080, default 1440)}` → `{link{id,purpose,target,status,expires_at,max_uses,used_count,anonymous_responses,response_values{value:count},created_at}, token, url:"/companion/{token}", disclosure}`. `target` for vote `{kind,id,title,status}`; for checkin adds `day`.
- `GET .../companion-links` — members see only their own links unless owner/admin.
- `POST .../{link_id}/revoke` → `{id,status}`; `GET .../{link_id}/responses` (creator/owner-admin, else 403) → `{items[{id,value,comment,created_at}], anonymous:true, disclosure}`.
- Public: `GET /api/companion/{token}` → `{purpose, trip{name,destination_name}, expires_at, remaining_uses, disclosure, anonymous_responses, target(...+summary,registered_votes for vote; +day,start_time for checkin), question, options[]}`; `POST /api/companion/{token}/respond` body `{value, comment?}` (vote: yes|no|abstain; checkin: in|out|join_later) → `{ok,recorded,anonymous,remaining_uses,message}`. 410 when expired/revoked/used. Test: `test_stabilisation.py`.

**14. Offline / sync** (`memories.py:554,644,672`)
- `GET .../offline` → `{generated_at, stale_after, trip{id,name,destination,start_date,end_date,currency,base{lat,lon}}, confirmed_version, items[{id,day,start_time,title,cost_estimate,is_protected,place{name,address,lat,lon}|null}], members[{id,display_name,role}], pact{must_do,flexible,confirmed_times}|null, disclosure}`.
- `GET .../sync` → `{items[{client_id,operation,status,applied_at,created_at}]}`.
- `POST .../sync` — **body is a bare JSON array** (max 100) of `{client_id(6–80), operation:"memory_create", payload:<MemoryCreate>}`. Idempotent on `client_id`: same content → `skipped`; same id different content/owner → `rejected` with `reason:"Client id reused with different content"`. → `{applied, skipped, rejected, results[{client_id,status,id?,reason?,errors?}], note}`. Mutates. Test: `test_api.py` (idempotency).

**15. Capsules** (`trips.py:755,784`) — `GET` → `{items[{id,created_at,stale_after,stale,snapshot}]}`; `POST` body `{ttl_hours(1–720, default 72)}` → `{id,stale_after,snapshot{trip{name,destination,start_date,end_date},items[],meeting_arrangements,generated_by}}`. Mutating. No tests.

**16. Fragility** (`itinerary.py:1109`) — `{resilience_score:int|None, label, days[{day, legs[{item_id,title,start_time,end_time,buffer_minutes,buffer_status,travel_minutes,travel_km,protected}], alternative_timings[{item_id,suggestion,minutes}]}], summary{comfortable,tight,risky}, disclosure}`. Read-only, no tests.

**17. Domino** (`itinerary.py:1124`) — `GET .../domino?item_id=<required>&delay_minutes=<0–600, default 45>` → `{day, disruption{item_id,title,delay_minutes}, affected[{item_id,title,slip_minutes,new_start,is_source,protected}], unaffected[{item_id,title,reason}], minimum_repairs_needed, repair_options[{item_id,title,options[]}], disclosure}`; 404 if item not in plan. Read-only, no tests.

**18. Tasks** (`trips.py:829,857,933,963`)
- `GET` → `{items[{id,title,description,assignee_id,status,created_at}]}`; `POST` body `{title(2–160), description?, assignee_id?}` → `{id,title,status}` (assignee must be active member, else 422); `PATCH /api/trips/{trip_id}/tasks/{task_id}` body `{status:open|done?, assignee_id?}` → `{id,status,assignee_id}` — **only the assignee or owner/admin** (403 otherwise).
- `GET .../tasks/summary` → `{trip_id, totals{open,done,total}, by_assignee[{user_id,display_name,open,done,total}], unassigned{open,done,total}, load[{key,display_name,open}], disclosure}` (counts only, no task titles). Tests: `test_phase4.py` (summary), `/tasks` matched in `test_phase4.py`.

**19. Material watch** (`admin.py:43–215`) — `GET` → `{items[{id,activity_id,activity_name,field,last_value,status,last_checked_at}], note}`; `POST` body `{activity_id, field: opening_hours|price_estimate|wheelchair_accessible}` → `{id,field,last_value,status}` (409 if already watched); `DELETE .../material-watch/{watch_id}` → `{ok:true}`; `POST .../material-watch/check` → `{checked, changed[{watch_id,activity_id,activity_name,field,previous,current}], unchanged, note}`. All mutate (check updates statuses). No tests.

**20. Pact** (`trips.py:694,722`) — `GET` → `{pact: null}` or `{pact{id,must_do[],flexible[],individual_limits(dict: only caller's user_id→limit),confirmed_times{},exceptions[],updated_at}}` (other members' limits are filtered out). `PUT` requires **owner/admin**, body `{must_do[], flexible[], individual_limits{}, confirmed_times{}, exceptions[]}` → `{ok:true}`. Mutates. Test: `test_api.py` (privacy filtering).

**21. Serendipity** (`places.py:735–930`, `services/discovery.serendipity_suggestions`)
- `GET /api/serendipity/matches` → `{eligible: bool, matches[{user{id,display_name,avatar_url,headline,home_city}, score, reasons[], shared_interests[], privacy}], disclosure}`; not opted in → `{eligible:false, reason, matches:[]}`. Writes TravellerMatch rows. Blocked users filtered.
- `GET /api/serendipity/requests` → `{items[{id,direction:outgoing|incoming,from_user,to_user,message,status,created_at,decided_at}], disclosure}`.
- `POST /api/serendipity/requests` body `{to_user_id, trip_id?, message?}` → `{id,status,note}` (403 if discovery not enabled, 409 if a pending/accepted request exists).
- `POST /api/serendipity/requests/{request_id}/decide` body `{accept: bool}`, recipient only (404 otherwise) → `{ok,status,disclosure}`. No tests.

**22. Cost shock / proposal `impact`** (`itinerary.py:665`) — appears as top-level `impact` beside `proposal_out` fields in `twin/propose`, `recommendations/{id}/propose`, `rescue/propose`:
`{operations[{op,title,day,start_time,cost}], cost_impact{total_delta, per_member_estimate, currency, note}, budget_conflicts[{reason,item}], pact_conflicts[], schedule_conflicts[], requires_approval}`. `per_member_estimate` is a **single equal-split float**, not a per-user map (budget limits are private); `budget_conflicts` names the item, never the member. `proposal_out` keys: `id, kind, title, summary, payload{}, status, target_day, created_by, author, created_at, decided_at, votes{yes,no,abstain}, vote_count, my_vote, comments[{id,user,comment,value,created_at}]`.

**23. WebSocket** (`ws.py`, `auth.py:143`) — connect `ws(s)://<host>/ws/trips/{trip_id}?token=<ticket|access_token>` (`token` min 20 chars; `decode_token(token,"ws")` falls back to `"access"`). Ticket: `POST /api/auth/ws-ticket` (Bearer or cookie) → `{ticket, expires_in: 120}`; 400 if session id missing. Close codes: **4401** invalid/expired token, inactive user, dead session; **4404** trip missing/deleted or caller not an active member. Envelope: `{"event": str, "at": iso8601, ...data}`. Event types: `connected{trip_id,user,note}`, `pong{trip_id}`, `proposal.created{trip_id,proposal_id}`, `proposal.withdrawn`, `proposal.rejected`, `itinerary.updated`, `expenses.updated`, `member.joined`, `member.removed`, `trip.updated`, `trip.deleted`, `engine.updated`. Heartbeat: client sends the text frame `"ping"`, server replies `pong`. Tests: `test_api.py`, `test_audit_fixes.py` (no ws-ticket test).

**24. Assistant** (`assistant.py:76`) — `POST /api/assistant/chat` body `{message(1–2000), trip_id?, language?}`; per-trip variant `POST /api/trips/{trip_id}/assistant`. Response: `intent`, `answer`, `citations[{label,type,id,provenance}]`, `grounding`, `limitations[]`, `suggested_actions[{label,href}]`, `generated_by`, `context`, `language{code,name,source,detected,confidence,mixed[],unsupported}`, `mutation:"none"`, `requires_approval`, `trip_id`. Read-only. Tests: `test_api.py`, `test_phase7_evaluation.py`, `test_phase7_multilingual.py`, `test_security_hardening.py`.

**Gaps for Dart work:** no pytest exists for shadowplans, branches, effort, fragility, domino, capsules, missions, material-watch, serendipity, thread, contributors, or ws-ticket — treat those contracts as unverified against tests.

67	/// Parses a `YYYY-MM-DD` calendar date without applying a timezone.
68	DateTime? shortDate(String? value) {
69	  if (value == null || value.isEmpty) return null;
70	  final parts = value.split('-');
71	  if (parts.length != 3) return DateTime.tryParse(value);
72	  final year = int.tryParse(parts[0]);
73	  final month = int.tryParse(parts[1]);
74	  final day = int.tryParse(parts[2]);
75	  if (year == null || month == null || day == null) return null;
76	  return DateTime(year, month, day);
77	}

13	class ApiClient {
14	  ApiClient({
15	    required this.baseUrl,
16	    required SafarCookieJar jar,
17	    required JsonStore store,
18	    this.onUnauthorized,
19	  }) : _jar = jar,
20	       _store = store {
21	    dio = Dio(
22	      BaseOptions(
23	        baseUrl: baseUrl,
24	        connectTimeout: const Duration(seconds: 12),
25	        receiveTimeout: const Duration(seconds: 45),
26	        sendTimeout: const Duration(seconds: 30),
27	        contentType: Headers.jsonContentType,
28	        responseType: ResponseType.json,
29	        headers: const {'Accept': 'application/json'},
30	      ),
31	    );
32	    if (!kIsWeb) {
33	      // Native clients need a persistent jar so the HttpOnly refresh cookie
34	      // survives restarts. Browsers own cookies for the web verification build.
35	      dio.interceptors.add(CookieManager(_jar));
36	    } else {
37	      enableBrowserCredentials(dio);
38	    }
39	    dio.interceptors.add(_AuthInterceptor(this));
40	  }

42	  final String baseUrl;
43	  final SafarCookieJar _jar;
44	  // ignore: unused_field
45	  final JsonStore _store;
46	  late final Dio dio;
47	
48	  String? accessToken;
49	  String? csrfToken;
50	  void Function()? onUnauthorized;
51	
52	  Future<bool>? _refreshInFlight;
53	
54	  bool get hasSession => accessToken != null;
55	
56	  Future<bool> refreshSession() {
57	    return _refreshInFlight ??= _refresh().whenComplete(() {
58	      _refreshInFlight = null;
59	    });
60	  }
61	
62	  Future<bool> _refresh() async {
63	    try {
64	      final response = await dio.post<dynamic>(
65	        '/api/auth/refresh',
66	        options: Options(extra: const {'skipAuth': true}),
67	      );
68	      final data = response.data;
69	      if (data is! Map) return false;
70	      final access = data['access_token'];
71	      final csrf = data['csrf_token'];
72	      if (access is! String || access.isEmpty) return false;
73	      accessToken = access;
74	      csrfToken = csrf is String ? csrf : null;
75	      return true;
76	    } on DioException catch (error) {
77	      final status = error.response?.statusCode;

81	      }

83	    }
84	  }

127	  Future<dynamic> _request(
128	    String method,
129	    String path, {
130	    Object? data,
131	    Map<String, dynamic>? query,
132	    bool raw = false,
133	  }) async {
134	    try {
135	      final response = await dio.request<dynamic>(
136	        path,
137	        data: data,
138	        queryParameters: query,
139	        options: Options(method: method),
140	      );
141	      if (raw) return response.data;
142	      return response.data;
143	    } on DioException catch (error) {
144	      throw ApiException.fromDio(error);
145	    }
146	  }

148	  /// Absolute URL for seeded imagery and locally issued media paths.
149	  String mediaUrl(String? raw) {
150	    if (raw == null || raw.trim().isEmpty) return '';
151	    final value = raw.trim();
152	    if (value.startsWith('http://') || value.startsWith('https://')) {
153	      return value;
154	    }
155	    return value.startsWith('/') ? '$baseUrl$value' : '$baseUrl/$value';
156	  }
157	}

159	class _AuthInterceptor extends Interceptor {
160	  _AuthInterceptor(this.client);
161	
162	  final ApiClient client;
163	
164	  @override
165	  void onRequest(RequestOptions options, RequestInterceptorHandler handler) {
166	    if (options.extra['skipAuth'] != true) {
167	      final token = client.accessToken;
168	      if (token != null && token.isNotEmpty) {
169	        options.headers['Authorization'] = 'Bearer $token';
170	      }
171	      final csrf = client.csrfToken;
172	      if (_unsafeMethods.contains(options.method.toUpperCase()) &&
173	          csrf != null &&
174	          csrf.isNotEmpty) {
175	        options.headers['X-CSRF-Token'] = csrf;
176	      }
177	    }
178	    handler.next(options);
179	  }
180	
181	  @override
182	  Future<void> onError(
183	    DioException err,
184	    ErrorInterceptorHandler handler,
185	  ) async {
186	    final options = err.requestOptions;
187	    final status = err.response?.statusCode;
188	    final isAuthPath = options.path.startsWith('/api/auth/');
189	    final retried = options.extra['retried'] == true;
190	    if (status == 401 && !retried && !isAuthPath) {
191	      try {
192	        final refreshed = await client.refreshSession();
193	        if (refreshed) {
194	          final headers = Map<String, dynamic>.from(options.headers);
195	          final token = client.accessToken;
196	          if (token != null) headers['Authorization'] = 'Bearer $token';
197	          final csrf = client.csrfToken;
198	          if (_unsafeMethods.contains(options.method.toUpperCase()) &&
199	              csrf != null) {
200	            headers['X-CSRF-Token'] = csrf;
201	          }
202	          final retryOptions = options.copyWith(
203	            headers: headers,
204	            extra: {...options.extra, 'retried': true},
205	          );
206	          final response = await client.dio.fetch<dynamic>(retryOptions);
207	          return handler.resolve(response);
208	        }
209	        client.notifyUnauthorized();
210	      } on Object {
211	        // A network failure while refreshing must not sign the user out.
212	      }
213	    }
214	    handler.next(err);
215	  }
216	}

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException
from sqlalchemy import func
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.core.deps import get_current_user, get_db, get_trip_and_member
from app.db.context import companion_context
from app.models import (
    CompanionLink,
    CompanionResponse,
    ItineraryItem,
    ItineraryProposal,
    User,
)
from app.models.models import utcnow
from app.schemas.schemas import CompanionLinkIn, CompanionResponseIn
from app.services import companion as companion_service
from app.services.common import audit

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/trips", tags=["companion"])
public_router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/companion", tags=["companion"])


def _link_brief(db: Session, link: CompanionLink) -> dict:
    responses = (
        db.query(func.count(CompanionResponse.id))
        .filter(CompanionResponse.link_id == link.id)
        .scalar()
        or 0
    )
    values = {
        value: count
        for value, count in (
            db.query(CompanionResponse.value, func.count(CompanionResponse.id))
            .filter(CompanionResponse.link_id == link.id)
            .group_by(CompanionResponse.value)
            .all()
        )
    }
    target = None
    if link.purpose == "vote":
        proposal = db.get(ItineraryProposal, link.target_id)
        target = {
            "kind": "proposal",
            "id": link.target_id,
            "title": proposal.title if proposal else "Decision removed",
            "status": proposal.status if proposal else "missing",
        }
    else:
        item = db.get(ItineraryItem, link.target_id)
        target = {
            "kind": "checkin",
            "id": link.target_id,
            "title": item.title if item else "Item removed",
            "day": item.day.isoformat() if item else None,
            "status": item.status if item else "missing",
        }
    return {
        "id": link.id,
        "purpose": link.purpose,
        "target": target,
        "status": companion_service.link_status(link),
        "expires_at": link.expires_at,
        "max_uses": link.max_uses,
        "used_count": link.used_count,
        "anonymous_responses": responses,
        "response_values": values,
        "created_at": link.created_at,
    }


@router.post("/{trip_id}/companion-links", status_code=201)
def create_companion_link(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: CompanionLinkIn,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = get_trip_and_member(trip_id, db, user)

    if payload.purpose == "vote":
        target = db.get(ItineraryProposal, payload.target_id)
        if not target or target.trip_id != trip.id:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Decision not found")
        if target.status != "open":
            raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Only open decisions can be shared.")
    else:
        target = db.get(ItineraryItem, payload.target_id)
        if not target or target.trip_id != trip.id:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Itinerary item not found")
        if target.status != "confirmed":
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=422, detail="Only confirmed itinerary items can be shared."
            )

    link = CompanionLink(
        trip_id=trip.id,
        created_by=user.id,
        purpose=payload.purpose,
        target_id=payload.target_id,
        expires_at=companion_service.expires_from_now(payload.ttl_minutes),
        max_uses=1,
        used_count=0,
    )
    db.add(link)
    db.flush()
    token = companion_service.issue_token(link)
    audit(
        db,
        action="companion.create",
        entity_type="companion_link",
        entity_id=link.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
        detail={"purpose": link.purpose, "target_id": link.target_id},
    )
    db.commit()
    return {
        "link": _link_brief(db, link),
        "token": token,
        "url": f"/companion/{token}",
        "disclosure": (
            "Anyone with this link can answer once, without an account. Their identity is not recorded. "
            "The link expires on its own and can be revoked."
        ),
    }


@router.get("/{trip_id}/companion-links")
def list_companion_links(
    trip_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, member = get_trip_and_member(trip_id, db, user)
    query = db.query(CompanionLink).filter(CompanionLink.trip_id == trip.id)
    if member.role not in {"owner", "admin"}:
        query = query.filter(CompanionLink.created_by == user.id)
    links = query.order_by(CompanionLink.created_at.desc()).all()
    return {
        "items": [_link_brief(db, link) for link in links],
        "disclosure": "Tokens are shown once when created and are never listed again.",
    }


@router.post("/{trip_id}/companion-links/{link_id}/revoke")
def revoke_companion_link(
    trip_id: str,
    link_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, member = get_trip_and_member(trip_id, db, user)
    link = db.get(CompanionLink, link_id)
    if not link or link.trip_id != trip.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Link not found")
    if link.created_by != user.id and member.role not in {"owner", "admin"}:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Only the creator or an owner can revoke this link")
    if not link.revoked_at:
        link.revoked_at = utcnow()
        audit(
            db,
            action="companion.revoke",
            entity_type="companion_link",
            entity_id=link.id,
            user_id=user.id,
            trip_id=trip.id,
        )
        db.commit()
    return {"id": link.id, "status": companion_service.link_status(link)}


@router.get("/{trip_id}/companion-links/{link_id}/responses")
def list_companion_responses(
    trip_id: str,
    link_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, member = get_trip_and_member(trip_id, db, user)
    link = db.get(CompanionLink, link_id)
    if not link or link.trip_id != trip.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Link not found")
    if link.created_by != user.id and member.role not in {"owner", "admin"}:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Only the creator or an owner can read responses")
    rows = (
        db.query(CompanionResponse)
        .filter(CompanionResponse.link_id == link.id)
        .order_by(CompanionResponse.created_at)
        .all()
    )
    return {
        "items": [
            {"id": row.id, "value": row.value, "comment": row.comment, "created_at": row.created_at}
            for row in rows
        ],
        "anonymous": True,
        "disclosure": "No respondent identity, IP address or device identifier is stored.",
    }


@public_router.get("/{token}")
def companion_view(token: str, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    parsed = companion_service.parse_token(token)
    if parsed:
        companion_context(db, parsed[0])
    link, error = companion_service.resolve_active(db, token)
    if error:
        status_code = 404 if link is None else 410
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status_code, detail=error)
    return companion_service.context(db, link)

@router.post("/{trip_id}/twin/compare")
def twin_compare(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: TwinCompareIn,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    if not payload.activity_ids:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=422,
            detail="Provide at least one alternative activity to compare.",
        )
    for activity_id in payload.activity_ids:
        _activity_in_trip(db, trip, activity_id)
    if len(set(payload.activity_ids)) != len(payload.activity_ids):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Duplicate activities in the alternative")
    day = payload.day or date.today()
    _within_trip(trip, day)
    items = (
        db.query(ItineraryItem)
        .filter(
            ItineraryItem.trip_id == trip.id,
            ItineraryItem.day == day,
            ItineraryItem.status == "confirmed",
        )
        .all()
    )
    contexts = build_member_contexts(db, trip, _active_members(db, trip.id), day)
    result = twin_service.compare_plan(db, trip, contexts, items, payload.activity_ids, day)
    result["generated_at"] = result["generated_at"].isoformat()
    return result


@router.post("/{trip_id}/twin/propose", status_code=201)
async def twin_propose(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: TwinProposeIn,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    day = payload.day or trip.start_date
    _within_trip(trip, day)
    if len(set(payload.activity_ids)) != len(payload.activity_ids):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Duplicate activities in the alternative")
    activities = [_activity_in_trip(db, trip, activity_id) for activity_id in payload.activity_ids]
    proposal, impact = _create_proposal(
        db,
        trip,
        user,
        kind="twin_adopt",
        title="Adopt a Trip Twin alternative",
        summary=(
            f"Replaces {day.isoformat()} with: "
            + ", ".join(activity.name for activity in activities)
            + ". Read-only comparison only; adoption needs group approval."
        ),
        day=day,
        payload={
            "day": day.isoformat(),
            "items": [
                {"activity_id": activity.id, "day": day.isoformat(), "start_time": "09:00"}
                for activity in activities
            ],
        },
    )
    db.commit()
    await manager.broadcast(
        trip.id,
        event_payload("proposal.created", trip_id=trip.id, proposal_id=proposal.id),
    )
    return {**proposal_out(db, proposal, user.id), "impact": impact}

@router.post("/{trip_id}/rescue/propose", status_code=201)
async def rescue_propose(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: RescueProposeIn,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    if not payload.items:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=422,
            detail="Select at least one replacement from the rescue analysis.",
        )
    items = []
    for entry in payload.items:
        _within_trip(trip, entry.day)
        item = db.get(ItineraryItem, entry.item_id)
        if not item or item.trip_id != trip.id or item.status != "confirmed":
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="A rescue target item was not found")
        if item.is_protected:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=409,
                detail=f"\"{item.title}\" is protected time and cannot be replaced by Trip Rescue.",
            )
        activity = _activity_in_trip(db, trip, entry.activity_id)
        start = parse_hhmm(entry.start_time)
        if start is None:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="start_time must use HH:MM")
        day_items = (
            db.query(ItineraryItem)
            .filter(
                ItineraryItem.trip_id == trip.id,
                ItineraryItem.day == entry.day,
                ItineraryItem.status == "confirmed",
            )
            .all()
        )
        conflict = find_conflict(
            db,
            day_items,
            start_minutes=start,
            duration_minutes=activity.duration_minutes or 90,
            ignore_item_ids={item.id},
        )
        if conflict:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=409,
                detail={
                    "message": (
                        f"The replacement would overlap protected time ({conflict['title']})."
                        if conflict["protected"]
                        else f"The replacement would overlap {conflict['title']}."
                    ),
                    "conflict": conflict,
                },
            )
        items.append(
            {
                "item_id": item.id,
                "activity_id": activity.id,
                "day": entry.day.isoformat(),
                "start_time": entry.start_time,
                "notes": f"Trip Rescue ({payload.kind}) replacement",
                "title": item.title,
            }
        )
    title = f"Trip Rescue: {payload.kind.replace('_', ' ').title()}"
    summary = (
        payload.note
        or "Replaces affected activities after a disruption. Shown as changes only; nothing is applied until approved."
    )
    pact = db.query(JourneyPact).filter(JourneyPact.trip_id == trip.id).first()
    proposal, impact = _create_proposal(
        db,
        trip,
        user,
        kind="rescue",
        title=title,
        summary=summary,
        day=payload.items[0].day,
        payload={
            "kind": payload.kind,
            "extra_minutes": payload.extra_minutes,
            "note": payload.note,
            "items": items,
        },
    )
    db.commit()
    await manager.broadcast(
        trip.id,
        event_payload("proposal.created", trip_id=trip.id, proposal_id=proposal.id),
    )
    response = {**proposal_out(db, proposal, user.id), "impact": impact}
    if pact:
        response["pact"] = {
            "must_do": pact.must_do or [],
            "flexible": pact.flexible or [],
            "note": "Pact conflicts block approval until the group adds an exception.",
        }
    return response

"""Trip Twin (F08): compare alternatives without touching the confirmed plan."""

from datetime import date

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.models import Activity, ItineraryItem, Place, Trip, TripMember
from app.services.engine import rank_activity
from app.services.geo import haversine_km, travel_minutes


def _activity_coords(db: Session, activity: Activity) -> tuple[float, float]:
    if not activity.place_id:
        return (0.0, 0.0)
    place = db.get(Place, activity.place_id)
    return (place.lat, place.lon) if place else (0.0, 0.0)


def _metrics_for_activities(
    db: Session,
    trip: Trip,
    contexts,
    activities: list[Activity],
    fallback_costs: dict[str, float] | None = None,
    fallback_durations: dict[str, int] | None = None,
) -> dict:
    fits: list[list[float]] = [[] for _ in contexts]
    total_cost = 0.0
    total_duration = 0
    total_travel = 0
    details = []
    for activity in activities:
        coords = _activity_coords(db, activity)
        distance = haversine_km(trip.base_lat, trip.base_lon, *coords) if coords != (0.0, 0.0) else 0.0
        leg = travel_minutes(distance)
        ranked = rank_activity(
            activity,
            contexts,
            base_lat=trip.base_lat,
            base_lon=trip.base_lon,
            coords=coords,
            target_member_index=None,
            mode="everyone_wins",
        )
        if ranked:
            for index, fit in enumerate(ranked.fits):
                fits[index].append(fit)
        total_cost += activity.price_estimate
        total_duration += activity.duration_minutes
        total_travel += leg
        details.append(
            {
                "activity_id": activity.id,
                "name": activity.name,
                "cost": activity.price_estimate,
                "duration": activity.duration_minutes,
                "distance_km": distance,
                "travel_minutes": leg,
                "eligible": ranked is not None,
            }
        )
    per_member = [sum(values) / len(values) for values in fits if values]

from datetime import date

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.core.deps import get_current_user, get_db, get_trip_and_member
from app.models import User
from app.services.opportunity import clock

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/trips", tags=["opportunity"])


@router.get("/{trip_id}/opportunity-clock")
def opportunity_clock(
    trip_id: str,
    on: date | None = Query(default=None),
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = get_trip_and_member(trip_id, db, user)
    target = on or (date.today() if trip.start_date <= date.today() <= trip.end_date else trip.start_date)
    if target < trip.start_date or target > trip.end_date:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=422,
            detail="Chosen date is outside this trip's dates",
        )
    return clock(db, trip, target)

@router.post("/{trip_id}/shadowplans", status_code=201)
def create_shadowplan(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: ShadowplanCreate,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    item = db.get(ItineraryItem, payload.item_id)
    if not item or item.trip_id != trip.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Itinerary item not found")
    activity = db.get(Activity, payload.backup_activity_id)
    if not activity or activity.destination_id != trip.destination_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Backup must be a catalog activity in this destination")
    plan = Shadowplan(
        trip_id=trip.id,
        itinerary_item_id=item.id,
        backup_activity_id=activity.id,
        notes=payload.notes,
        readiness={"status": "ready", "checked_at": utcnow().isoformat()},
        created_by=user.id,
    )
    db.add(plan)
    audit(
        db,
        action="shadowplan.create",
        entity_type="shadowplan",
        entity_id=plan.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
    )
    db.commit()
    return {"id": plan.id, "backup_activity_id": activity.id, "readiness": plan.readiness}


@router.get("/{trip_id}/shadowplans")
def list_shadowplans(

):

@router.get("/{trip_id}/offline")
def offline_snapshot(
    trip_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    from app.models import Activity, Itinerary, ItineraryItem, Place

    items = (
        db.query(ItineraryItem)
        .filter(ItineraryItem.trip_id == trip.id, ItineraryItem.status == "confirmed")
        .order_by(ItineraryItem.day, ItineraryItem.sort_order, ItineraryItem.start_time)
        .all()
    )
    activities = {}
    places = {}
    if items:
        activity_ids = [item.activity_id for item in items if item.activity_id]
        activities = {
            activity.id: activity
            for activity in db.query(Activity).filter(Activity.id.in_(activity_ids)).all()
        } if activity_ids else {}
        place_ids = [activity.place_id for activity in activities.values() if activity.place_id]
        places = {
            place.id: place
            for place in db.query(Place).filter(Place.id.in_(place_ids)).all()
        } if place_ids else {}
    itinerary = db.query(Itinerary).filter(Itinerary.trip_id == trip.id).first()
    pact = db.query(JourneyPact).filter(JourneyPact.trip_id == trip.id).first()
    members = (
        db.query(TripMember)
        .filter(TripMember.trip_id == trip.id, TripMember.status == "active")
        .all()
    )
    return {
        "generated_at": utcnow().isoformat(),
        "stale_after": (datetime.combine(trip.end_date, datetime.min.time()) + timedelta(days=7)).isoformat(),
        "trip": {
            "id": trip.id,
            "name": trip.name,
            "destination": trip.destination_name,
            "start_date": trip.start_date,
            "end_date": trip.end_date,
            "currency": trip.currency,
            "base": {"lat": trip.base_lat, "lon": trip.base_lon},
        },
        "confirmed_version": itinerary.confirmed_version if itinerary else 0,
        "items": [
            {
                "id": item.id,
                "day": item.day,
                "start_time": item.start_time,
                "title": item.title,
                "cost_estimate": item.cost_estimate,
                "is_protected": item.is_protected,
                "place": (
                    {
                        "name": places[activities[item.activity_id].place_id].name,
                        "address": places[activities[item.activity_id].place_id].address,
                        "lat": places[activities[item.activity_id].place_id].lat,
                        "lon": places[activities[item.activity_id].place_id].lon,
                    }
                    if item.activity_id in activities
                    and activities[item.activity_id].place_id in places
                    else None
                ),
            }
            for item in items
        ],
        "members": [
            {"id": member.id, "display_name": member.display_name, "role": member.role}
            for member in members
        ],
        "pact": (
            {
                "must_do": pact.must_do or [],
                "flexible": pact.flexible or [],
                "confirmed_times": pact.confirmed_times or {},
            }
            if pact
            else None
        ),
        "disclosure": (
            "Offline snapshot of the confirmed plan only. Private budgets, accessibility needs "
            "and private memories are excluded. Check staleness before relying on it."
        ),
    }

"""Moderation, report verification and Material Change Watch (F14, F44).

Moderation decisions are attributed, audited and communicated to the reporter.
Material watches alert only when a tracked value actually changes.
