from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query
from sqlalchemy import func
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.core.deps import get_current_user, get_db, get_trip_and_member, require_admin
from app.models import (
    AbuseReport,
    Activity,
    AuditLog,
    CirclePost,
    Expense,
    ItineraryProposal,
    MaterialWatch,
    Notification,
    PlaceReport,
    RecommendationBatch,
    Trip,
    TripMember,
    TripMemory,
    User,
)
from app.models.models import utcnow
from app.schemas.schemas import AbuseDecisionIn, MaterialWatchIn
from app.services.common import audit, notify_trip_members

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api", tags=["admin"])
ADMIN_ROLES = {"owner", "admin"}


def _watch_value(activity: Activity, field: str):
    value = getattr(activity, field, None)
    if hasattr(value, "isoformat"):
        return value.isoformat()
    return value


@router.get("/trips/{trip_id}/material-watch")
def list_watches(
    trip_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = get_trip_and_member(trip_id, db, user)
    rows = (
        db.query(MaterialWatch)
        .filter(MaterialWatch.trip_id == trip.id)
        .order_by(MaterialWatch.created_at.desc())
        .all()
    )
    activities = {
        activity.id: activity
        for activity in db.query(Activity)
        .filter(Activity.id.in_({row.activity_id for row in rows if row.activity_id}))
        .all()
    } if rows else {}
    return {
        "items": [
            {
                "id": row.id,
                "activity_id": row.activity_id,
                "activity_name": (
                    activities[row.activity_id].name
                    if row.activity_id in activities
                    else None
                ),
                "field": row.field,
                "last_value": row.last_value,
                "status": row.status,
                "last_checked_at": row.last_checked_at,
            }
            for row in rows
        ],
        "note": "Material watches only alert when the tracked field actually changes.",
    }


@router.post("/trips/{trip_id}/material-watch", status_code=201)
def create_watch(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: MaterialWatchIn,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = get_trip_and_member(trip_id, db, user)
    activity = db.get(Activity, payload.activity_id)
    if not activity or activity.destination_id != trip.destination_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Activity not found for this trip")
    existing = (
        db.query(MaterialWatch)
        .filter(
            MaterialWatch.trip_id == trip.id,
            MaterialWatch.activity_id == activity.id,
            MaterialWatch.field == payload.field,
        )
        .first()
    )
    if existing:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="This field is already being watched")
    watch = MaterialWatch(
        trip_id=trip.id,
        activity_id=activity.id,
        field=payload.field,
        last_value={"value": _watch_value(activity, payload.field)},
        status="watching",
    )
    db.add(watch)
    audit(
        db,
        action="material_watch.create",
        entity_type="material_watch",
        entity_id=watch.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
        detail={"field": payload.field},
    )
    db.commit()
    return {
        "id": watch.id,
        "field": watch.field,
        "last_value": watch.last_value,
        "status": watch.status,
    }


@router.delete("/trips/{trip_id}/material-watch/{watch_id}")
def delete_watch(
    trip_id: str,
    watch_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, member = get_trip_and_member(trip_id, db, user)
    watch = db.get(MaterialWatch, watch_id)
    if not watch or watch.trip_id != trip.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Watch not found")
    db.delete(watch)
    audit(
        db,
        action="material_watch.delete",
        entity_type="material_watch",
        entity_id=watch_id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
    )
    db.commit()
    return {"ok": True}


@router.post("/trips/{trip_id}/material-watch/check")
def check_watches(
    trip_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = get_trip_and_member(trip_id, db, user)
    rows = db.query(MaterialWatch).filter(MaterialWatch.trip_id == trip.id).all()
    changed = []
    unchanged = 0
    for watch in rows:
        activity = db.get(Activity, watch.activity_id) if watch.activity_id else None
        if not activity:
            watch.status = "target_missing"
            watch.last_checked_at = utcnow()
            continue
        current = _watch_value(activity, watch.field)
        previous = (watch.last_value or {}).get("value")
        watch.last_checked_at = utcnow()
        if current != previous:
            watch.status = "changed"
            watch.last_value = {"value": current, "previous": previous}
            changed.append(
                {
                    "watch_id": watch.id,
                    "activity_id": activity.id,
                    "activity_name": activity.name,
                    "field": watch.field,
                    "previous": previous,
                    "current": current,
                }
            )
        else:
            watch.status = "watching"
            unchanged += 1
    if changed:
        notify_trip_members(
            db,
            trip,
            kind="material_change",
            title=f"{len(changed)} tracked fact(s) changed",
            body="Open Material Change Watch to review the differences. Nothing was changed in your plan.",
            link=f"/trips/{trip.id}/watch",
            exclude_user_id=None,
        )
    audit(
        db,
        action="material_watch.check",
        entity_type="trip",
        entity_id=trip.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
        detail={"changed": len(changed), "unchanged": unchanged},
    )
    db.commit()
    return {
        "checked": len(rows),
        "changed": changed,
        "unchanged": unchanged,
        "note": "Alerts are only sent when a value changes. Your confirmed plan is untouched.",
    }

@router.post("/{trip_id}/branches", status_code=201)
def create_branch(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: BranchCreate,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    for member_id in payload.member_ids:
        member = db.get(TripMember, member_id)
        if not member or member.trip_id != trip.id or member.status != "active":
            raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Branches can only include active members")
    activity = db.get(Activity, payload.activity_id) if payload.activity_id else None
    if payload.activity_id and not activity:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Activity not found")
    feasibility = {
        "status": "unknown",
        "note": "Reunion travel feasibility is not verified unless the reunion place is a catalog activity.",
    }
    if activity and payload.reunion_place and payload.reunion_at:
        reunion_activity = (
            db.query(Activity)
            .filter(Activity.destination_id == trip.destination_id, Activity.name.ilike(payload.reunion_place))
            .first()
        )
        if reunion_activity and activity.place_id and reunion_activity.place_id:
            origin = db.get(Place, activity.place_id)
            target = db.get(Place, reunion_activity.place_id)
            if origin and target:
                distance = haversine_km(origin.lat, origin.lon, target.lat, target.lon)
                minutes = travel_minutes(distance)
                feasibility = {
                    "status": "estimated",
                    "distance_km": distance,
                    "travel_minutes": minutes,
                    "note": "Estimated from straight-line distance, not live routing.",
                }
    branch = TripBranch(
        trip_id=trip.id,
        name=payload.name,
        member_ids=payload.member_ids,
        activity_id=payload.activity_id,
        reunion_at=payload.reunion_at,
        reunion_place=payload.reunion_place,
        created_by=user.id,
    )
    db.add(branch)
    audit(
        db,
        action="branch.create",
        entity_type="trip_branch",
        entity_id=branch.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
    )
    db.commit()
    return {"id": branch.id, "feasibility": feasibility}

@router.get("/{trip_id}/tasks/summary")
def task_summary(
    trip_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    """Server-side planner load summary (F27).

    Mirrors the planner's client-side calculation so every screen agrees.
    Only counts and display names are returned; task text stays private.
    """
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    rows = db.query(PlannerTask).filter(PlannerTask.trip_id == trip.id).all()
    members = (
        db.query(TripMember)
        .filter(TripMember.trip_id == trip.id, TripMember.status == "active")
        .all()
    )
    names: dict[str, str] = {}
    for member in members:
        if not member.user_id:
            continue
        name = member.display_name
        if not name:
            account = db.get(User, member.user_id)
            name = account.display_name if account else None
        if name:
            names[member.user_id] = name

    totals = {"open": 0, "done": 0, "total": 0}
    counts: dict[str | None, dict[str, int]] = {}
    for row in rows:
        bucket = counts.setdefault(row.assignee_id, {"open": 0, "done": 0, "total": 0})
        bucket["total"] += 1
        totals["total"] += 1
        if row.status == "done":
            bucket["done"] += 1
            totals["done"] += 1
        else:
            bucket["open"] += 1
            totals["open"] += 1

    unassigned = counts.pop(None, {"open": 0, "done": 0, "total": 0})
    by_assignee = [
        {
            "user_id": assignee_id,
            "display_name": names.get(assignee_id) or "Former member",
            "open": bucket["open"],
            "done": bucket["done"],
            "total": bucket["total"],
        }
        for assignee_id, bucket in counts.items()
    ]
    by_assignee.sort(key=lambda entry: (-entry["open"], entry["display_name"]))

    load = [
        {"key": entry["user_id"], "display_name": entry["display_name"], "open": entry["open"]}
        for entry in by_assignee
        if entry["open"]
    ]
    if unassigned["open"]:
        load.append({"key": "unassigned", "display_name": "Unassigned", "open": unassigned["open"]})
    load.sort(key=lambda entry: -entry["open"])

    return {
        "trip_id": trip.id,
        "totals": totals,
        "by_assignee": by_assignee,
        "unassigned": unassigned,
        "load": load,
        "disclosure": (
            "Counts only — task titles, notes and private member details stay in the planner."
        ),
    }

@router.patch("/{trip_id}/tasks/{task_id}")
def update_task(
    trip_id: str,
    task_id: str,
    payload: TaskUpdate,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    task = db.get(PlannerTask, task_id)
    if not task or task.trip_id != trip.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Task not found")
    if task.assignee_id and task.assignee_id != user.id and member.role not in {"owner", "admin"}:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Only the assignee or an admin can update this task")
    data = payload.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
    if data.get("assignee_id") and not _active_member(db, trip.id, data["assignee_id"]):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Assignee must be an active trip member")
    for field, value in data.items():
        setattr(task, field, value)
    db.commit()
    return {"id": task.id, "status": task.status, "assignee_id": task.assignee_id}

@router.get("/trips/{trip_id}/nearby")
def nearby(
    trip_id: str,
    lat: float | None = Query(default=None, ge=-90, le=90),
    lon: float | None = Query(default=None, ge=-180, le=180),
    radius_km: float = Query(default=5, gt=0, le=50),
    category: str | None = Query(default=None, max_length=60),
    limit: int = Query(default=20, ge=1, le=60),
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    if lat is not None or lon is not None:
        profile = db.query(Profile).filter(Profile.user_id == user.id).first()
        if not profile or not profile.location_sharing:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=403,
                detail=(
                    "Enable precise location in your privacy settings to use "
                    "your current position for nearby suggestions."
                ),
            )
        if lat is None or lon is None:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=422, detail="Provide both lat and lon, or neither"
            )
    base_lat = lat if lat is not None else trip.base_lat
    base_lon = lon if lon is not None else trip.base_lon
    activities = (
        db.query(Activity).filter(Activity.destination_id == trip.destination_id).all()
        if trip.destination_id
        else []
    )
    place_map, destination_map = _activity_place_maps(db, activities)
    items = []
    for activity in activities:
        place = place_map.get(activity.place_id)
        if not place:
            continue
        if category and place.category.lower() != category.lower():
            continue
        distance = haversine_km(base_lat, base_lon, place.lat, place.lon)
        if distance > radius_km:
            continue
        items.append(
            {
                "activity": activity_out(
                    activity, place, destination_map.get(activity.destination_id)
                ),
                "distance_km": round(distance, 2),
                "travel_minutes": travel_minutes(distance),
                "provenance": "ESTIMATED",
            }
        )
    items.sort(key=lambda item: item["distance_km"])
    return {
        "base": {"lat": base_lat, "lon": base_lon, "source": "shared trip base" if lat is None else "requested point"},
        "radius_km": radius_km,
        "items": items[:limit],
        "disclosure": (
            "Distances are straight-line estimates and travel time is not a live routed ETA. "
            "No live member location is exposed."
        ),
    }

@router.post("/contributors")
def upsert_contributor(
    payload: ContributorIn,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    destination = db.get(Destination, payload.destination_id)
    if not destination:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Destination not found")
    row = db.query(LocalContributor).filter(LocalContributor.user_id == user.id).first()
    if not row:
        row = LocalContributor(user_id=user.id, destination_id=destination.id)
        db.add(row)
    row.destination_id = destination.id
    row.bio = payload.bio
    row.expertise = payload.expertise
    row.accepts_requests = payload.accepts_requests
    audit(
        db,
        action="contributor.upsert",
        entity_type="local_contributor",
        entity_id=row.id,
        user_id=user.id,
    )
    db.commit()
    return {
        "id": row.id,
        "destination_id": row.destination_id,
        "accepts_requests": row.accepts_requests,
        "verified": row.verified,
        "note": "Verification is granted by moderators, never self-declared.",
    }

@router.get("/me/thread")
def journey_thread(user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    """Carry favourites and traditions from previous trips (F47)."""
    today = date.today()
    memberships = db.query(TripMember).filter(TripMember.user_id == user.id).all()
    completed_ids = []
    for membership in memberships:
        trip = db.get(Trip, membership.trip_id)
        if trip and not trip.deleted_at and (
            trip.status == "completed" or trip.end_date < today
        ):
            completed_ids.append(trip.id)
    loved = (
        db.query(ActivityFeedback)
        .filter(
            ActivityFeedback.user_id == user.id,
            ActivityFeedback.sentiment.in_(["loved", "would_return"]),
            ActivityFeedback.consented.is_(True),
        )
        .order_by(ActivityFeedback.created_at.desc())
        .all()
    )
    activities = {}
    for row in loved:
        activity = db.get(Activity, row.activity_id)
        if not activity:
            continue
        key = activity.id
        entry = activities.setdefault(
            key,
            {
                "activity_id": key,
                "name": activity.name,
                "price_estimate": activity.price_estimate,
                "duration_minutes": activity.duration_minutes,
                "sentiments": [],
            },
        )
        entry["sentiments"].append(row.sentiment)
    return {
        "completed_trips": len(completed_ids),
        "traditions": sorted(
            activities.values(), key=lambda entry: len(entry["sentiments"]), reverse=True
        )[:10],
        "note": (
            "Only outcomes you consented to share are used. You can repeat, modify or avoid "
            "any of these in a new journey."
        ),
    }

def access_chain(activity: Activity) -> dict:
    chain = activity.access_chain or {}
    stages = ["transport_stop", "path", "entrance", "experience_area", "facilities", "return"]
    labels = {
        "transport_stop": "Transport stop",
        "path": "Path to entrance",
        "entrance": "Entrance",
        "experience_area": "Experience area",
        "facilities": "Facilities",
        "return": "Return journey",
    }
    entries = []
    for stage in stages:
        raw = chain.get(stage)
        if isinstance(raw, dict):
            status = raw.get("status", "reported")
            detail = raw.get("detail")
        elif isinstance(raw, str):
            status, detail = "reported", raw
        else:
            status, detail = "unknown", "No information recorded."
        entries.append(
            {
                "stage": stage,
                "label": labels[stage],
                "status": status,
====

                "operation": row.operation,
                "status": row.status,
                "applied_at": row.applied_at,
                "created_at": row.created_at,
            }
            for row in rows
        ]
    }


@router.post("/{trip_id}/sync")
def sync_offline(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: list[OfflineSyncItem],
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    if len(payload) > 100:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Sync at most 100 items per request")
    results = []
    applied = 0
    skipped = 0
    rejected = 0
    for entry in payload:
        existing = (
            db.query(OfflineSyncQueue)
            .filter(OfflineSyncQueue.client_id == entry.client_id)
            .first()
        )
        if existing:
            if existing.user_id != user.id or existing.trip_id != trip.id:
                rejected += 1
                results.append(
                    {"client_id": entry.client_id, "status": "rejected", "reason": "Client id conflict"}
                )
            elif existing.operation != entry.operation or existing.payload != entry.payload:
                rejected += 1
                results.append(
                    {
                        "client_id": entry.client_id,
                        "status": "rejected",
                        "reason": "Client id reused with different content",
                    }
                )
            else:
                skipped += 1
                results.append(
                    {"client_id": entry.client_id, "status": existing.status, "id": None}
                )
            continue
        try:
            memory_payload = MemoryCreate(**entry.payload)
        except ValidationError as exc:
            rejected += 1
            results.append(
                {
                    "client_id": entry.client_id,
                    "status": "rejected",
                    "reason": "Invalid payload",
                    "errors": exc.errors(include_url=False),
                }
            )
            continue
        _validate_memory_content(
            memory_payload.kind, memory_payload.text_content, memory_payload.media_url
        )
        captured_at = _naive_utc(memory_payload.captured_at)
        memory = TripMemory(
            trip_id=trip.id,
            user_id=user.id,
            kind=memory_payload.kind,
            text_content=memory_payload.text_content,
            media_url=canonical_media_url(memory_payload.media_url),
            media_type=memory_payload.media_type,
            caption=memory_payload.caption,
            captured_at=captured_at,
            lat=memory_payload.lat,
            lon=memory_payload.lon,
            visibility=memory_payload.visibility,
        )
        db.add(memory)
        db.flush()
        db.add(
            OfflineSyncQueue(
                user_id=user.id,
                trip_id=trip.id,
                client_id=entry.client_id,
                operation=entry.operation,
                payload=entry.payload,
                status="applied",
                applied_at=utcnow(),
            )
        )
        applied += 1
        results.append(
            {"client_id": entry.client_id, "status": "applied", "id": memory.id}
        )

def _proposal_impact(db: Session, trip: Trip, proposal: ItineraryProposal) -> dict:
    operations = _build_proposal_operations(db, trip, proposal)
    total_delta = round(sum(operation.get("cost", 0) for operation in operations), 2)
    members = (
        db.query(TripMember)
        .filter(TripMember.trip_id == trip.id, TripMember.status == "active")
        .all()
    )
    per_member = round(total_delta / max(1, len(members)), 2)
    budget_conflicts = []
    for operation in operations:
        if operation["op"] != "add":
            continue
        for member in members:
            if member.budget_limit is not None and operation["cost"] > member.budget_limit:
                budget_conflicts.append(
                    {
                        "reason": "A stated hard budget limit would be exceeded.",
                        "item": operation["title"],
                    }
                )
    return {
        "operations": [
            {
                "op": operation["op"],
                "title": operation.get("title"),
                "day": operation.get("day"),
                "start_time": operation.get("start_time"),
                "cost": operation.get("cost"),
            }
            for operation in operations
        ],
        "cost_impact": {
            "total_delta": total_delta,
            "per_member_estimate": per_member,
            "currency": trip.currency,

28	String formatDate(String? raw, {String fallback = '—'}) {
29	  if (raw == null || raw.isEmpty) return fallback;
30	  final date = DateTime.tryParse(raw);
31	  if (date == null) return raw;
32	  return '${date.day} ${_months[date.month - 1]} ${date.year}';
33	}
34	
35	String formatDateShort(String? raw, {String fallback = '—'}) {
36	  if (raw == null || raw.isEmpty) return fallback;
37	  final date = DateTime.tryParse(raw);
38	  if (date == null) return raw;
39	  return '${date.day} ${_months[date.month - 1]}';
40	}
41	
42	String formatWeekday(String? raw) {
43	  if (raw == null || raw.isEmpty) return '';
44	  final date = DateTime.tryParse(raw);
45	  if (date == null) return '';
46	  return _weekdays[date.weekday - 1];
47	}
48	
49	String formatTime(String? raw) {
50	  if (raw == null || raw.isEmpty) return '';
51	  final parts = raw.split(':');
52	  if (parts.length < 2) return raw;
53	  final hour = int.tryParse(parts[0]);
54	  final minute = int.tryParse(parts[1]);
55	  if (hour == null || minute == null) return raw;
56	  final suffix = hour >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
57	  final display = hour % 12 == 0 ? 12 : hour % 12;
58	  return '$display:${minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0')} $suffix';
59	}
60	
61	/// Formats an ISO timestamp or `HH:MM` value as a 12-hour clock time.
62	String formatClock(String? raw) {
63	  if (raw == null || raw.isEmpty) return '';
64	  final date = raw.contains('T') ? DateTime.tryParse(raw) : null;
65	  if (date == null) return formatTime(raw);
66	  final local = date.toLocal();
67	  return formatTime(
68	    '${local.hour.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}:'
69	    '${local.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}',
70	  );
71	}
72	
73	String formatMoney(double? amount, [String currency = 'EUR']) {
74	  if (amount == null) return '—';
75	  try {
76	    return NumberFormat.simpleCurrency(
77	      name: currency,
78	      decimalDigits: amount == amount.roundToDouble() ? 0 : 2,
79	    ).format(amount);
80	  } on Object {
81	    return '${amount.toStringAsFixed(2)} $currency';
82	  }
83	}
84	
85	String timeAgo(String? raw) {
86	  if (raw == null || raw.isEmpty) return '';
87	  final date = DateTime.tryParse(raw);
88	  if (date == null) return '';
89	  final diff = DateTime.now().toUtc().difference(date.toUtc());
90	  if (diff.inSeconds < 60) return 'just now';
91	  if (diff.inMinutes < 60) return '${diff.inMinutes}m ago';
92	  if (diff.inHours < 24) return '${diff.inHours}h ago';
93	  if (diff.inDays < 7) return '${diff.inDays}d ago';
94	  return formatDateShort(raw);
95	}

97	String titleCase(String value) {
98	  if (value.isEmpty) return value;
99	  return value
100	      .split(RegExp(r'[_\s-]+'))
101	      .where((word) => word.isNotEmpty)
102	      .map((word) => '${word[0].toUpperCase()}${word.substring(1)}')
103	      .join(' ');
104	}

108	/// Inclusive list of calendar days between [start] and [end].
109	List<DateTime> tripDays(String startDate, String endDate, {int cap = 60}) {
110	  final start = DateTime.tryParse(startDate);
111	  final end = DateTime.tryParse(endDate);
112	  if (start == null || end == null || end.isBefore(start)) {
113	    return start == null ? const [] : [start];
114	  }
115	  final days = <DateTime>[];
116	  var cursor = DateTime(start.year, start.month, start.day);
117	  final last = DateTime(end.year, end.month, end.day);
118	  while (!cursor.isAfter(last) && days.length < cap) {
119	    days.add(cursor);
120	    cursor = cursor.add(const Duration(days: 1));
121	  }
122	  return days;
123	}

  final NextAction? nextAction;

  bool get isOwner => myRole == 'owner';
  bool get canManage => myRole == 'owner' || myRole == 'admin';

  String get dateRangeLabel {
    final start = shortDate(startDate);
    final end = shortDate(endDate);
    if (start == null || end == null) return '$startDate → $endDate';
    const months = [
      'Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun',
      'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec',
    ];
    final startLabel = '${months[start.month - 1]} ${start.day}';
    final endLabel = end.year == start.year
        ? '${months[end.month - 1]} ${end.day}'
        : '${months[end.month - 1]} ${end.day}, ${end.year}';
    return '$startLabel → $endLabel';
  }

  int get dayCount {
    final start = shortDate(startDate);
    final end = shortDate(endDate);
    if (start == null || end == null) return 1;
    final days = end.difference(start).inDays + 1;
    return days < 1 ? 1 : days;
  }

class EngineScreen extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const EngineScreen({super.key, required this.tripId});

  final String tripId;

  @override
  ConsumerState<EngineScreen> createState() => _EngineScreenState();
}

class _EngineScreenState extends ConsumerState<EngineScreen> {
  static const _modes = [
    ('everyone_wins', 'Everyone wins', 'Protects the least-served traveller'),
    ('your_turn', 'Your turn', 'Lifts members least represented'),
    ('surprise_us', 'Surprise us', 'Familiar enough, still new'),
  ];

  String _mode = 'everyone_wins';
  EngineBatch? _batch;
  bool _busy = false;

  Future<void> _run() async {
    setState(() => _busy = true);
    try {
      final batch = await ref
          .read(engineRepositoryProvider)
          .recommend(widget.tripId, mode: _mode, limit: 6);
      setState(() => _batch = batch);
      ref.invalidate(engineProvider(widget.tripId));
      if (!mounted) return;
      if (batch.items.isEmpty) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(
            content: Text(
              'No options fit every hard constraint. Loosen a filter or add ideas.',
            ),
          ),
        );
      }
    } on Object catch (error) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(content: Text(error.toString())),
      );
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _busy = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _propose(RecommendationItem item, Trip trip) async {
    final days = tripDays(trip.startDate, trip.endDate);
    if (days.isEmpty) return;
    var day = days.first;
    final time = TextEditingController(text: '09:00');
    final submitted = await showSafarSheet<bool>(
      context,
      builder: (sheetContext) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (sheetContext, setSheetState) => Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            SafarSheetHeader(
              title: 'Propose to the group',
              subtitle:
                  '“${item.activity?.name ?? 'This option'}” becomes a vote. '
                  'The confirmed itinerary stays unchanged until approval.',
            ),
            Text('Day', style: context.texts.labelMedium),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            Wrap(
              spacing: 8,
              runSpacing: 8,
              children: [
                for (final option in days)
                  ChoiceChip(
                    label: Text(formatDateShort(isoDate(option))),
                    selected: isoDate(day) == isoDate(option),
                    onSelected: (_) => setSheetState(() => day = option),
                  ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 14),
            TextField(
              controller: time,
              keyboardType: TextInputType.datetime,
              decoration: const InputDecoration(
                labelText: 'Start time',
                hintText: '09:00',
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 18),
            Row(
              children: [
                Expanded(
                  child: OutlinedButton(
                    onPressed: () => Navigator.of(sheetContext).pop(false),
                    child: const Text('Cancel'),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 10),
                Expanded(
                  child: FilledButton(
                    onPressed: () => Navigator.of(sheetContext).pop(true),
                    child: const Text('Create proposal'),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
    final startTime = time.text.trim();
    time.dispose();
    if (submitted != true) return;
    if (!RegExp(r'^\d{2}:\d{2}$').hasMatch(startTime)) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(content: Text('Use a 24-hour time such as 09:30.')),
      );

class ActivitySearchQuery {
  const ActivitySearchQuery({
    required this.destinationId,
    this.query,
    this.lens = 'balanced',
    this.maxBudget,
    this.indoor = false,
    this.accessible = false,
    this.tags,
    this.limit = 30,
  });

  final String destinationId;
  final String? query;
  final String lens;
  final double? maxBudget;
  final bool indoor;
  final bool accessible;
  final String? tags;
  final int limit;

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
      other is ActivitySearchQuery &&
      other.destinationId == destinationId &&
      other.query == query &&
      other.lens == lens &&
      other.maxBudget == maxBudget &&
      other.indoor == indoor &&
      other.accessible == accessible &&
      other.tags == tags &&
      other.limit == limit;

  @override
  int get hashCode => Object.hash(
    destinationId,
    query,
    lens,
    maxBudget,
    indoor,
    accessible,
    tags,
    limit,
  );
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';

import '../../../core/models/discovery.dart';
import '../../../core/providers.dart';
import '../../../core/theme/safar_theme.dart';
import '../../../core/utils/format.dart';
import '../../../core/widgets/safar_widgets.dart';

/// Searchable catalog list used by planning tools. Selection state lives in
/// the parent; this widget only renders results and reports taps.
class ActivitySearchList extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const ActivitySearchList({
    super.key,
    required this.destinationId,
    required this.trailing,
    required this.onTap,
  });

  final String? destinationId;
  final Widget Function(Activity activity) trailing;
  final ValueChanged<Activity> onTap;

  @override
  ConsumerState<ActivitySearchList> createState() => _ActivitySearchListState();
}

class _ActivitySearchListState extends ConsumerState<ActivitySearchList> {
  final _controller = TextEditingController();
  String? _query;

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final destinationId = widget.destinationId;
    if (destinationId == null || destinationId.isEmpty) {
      return const InfoBanner(
        text: 'Set a destination for this trip before comparing catalog '
            'activities. The confirmed plan is never changed here.',
        icon: Icons.place_outlined,
      );
    }
    final search = ref.watch(
      activitySearchProvider(
        ActivitySearchQuery(
          destinationId: destinationId,
          query: _query,
          limit: 30,
        ),
      ),
    );
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        TextField(
          controller: _controller,
          textInputAction: TextInputAction.search,
          decoration: InputDecoration(
            hintText: 'Search this destination',
            prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.search, size: 20),
            suffixIcon: _controller.text.isEmpty
                ? null
                : IconButton(
                    tooltip: 'Clear',
                    onPressed: () {
                      _controller.clear();
                      setState(() => _query = null);
                    },
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.close, size: 18),
                  ),
          ),
          onSubmitted: (value) => setState(
            () => _query = value.trim().isEmpty ? null : value.trim(),
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 12),
        AsyncView<SearchResult>(
          value: search,
          onRetry: () => ref.invalidate(
            activitySearchProvider(
              ActivitySearchQuery(
                destinationId: destinationId,
                query: _query,
                limit: 30,
              ),
            ),
          ),
          skeleton: const SkeletonList(count: 3, itemHeight: 58),
          builder: (data) {
            if (data.items.isEmpty) {
              return Text(
                'No catalog activity matches this search.',
                style: context.texts.bodySmall,
              );
            }
            return Column(
              children: [
                for (final item in data.items)
                  _ActivityTile(
                    item: item,
                    trailing: widget.trailing(item.activity),
                    onTap: () => widget.onTap(item.activity),
                  ),
                if (data.disclosure.isNotEmpty) ...[
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  SourceLabel(source: data.disclosure),
                ],
              ],
            );
          },
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

class _ActivityTile extends StatelessWidget {
  const _ActivityTile({
    required this.item,
    required this.trailing,
    required this.onTap,
  });

  final SearchItem item;
  final Widget trailing;
  final VoidCallback onTap;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final palette = context.safar;
    final activity = item.activity;
    final meta = [
      if (activity.durationMinutes > 0)
        '${activity.durationMinutes} min',
      if (activity.priceEstimate > 0)
        formatMoney(activity.priceEstimate, activity.currency),
      if (activity.tags.isNotEmpty) activity.tags.first,
    ].join(' · ');
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
      child: SafarCard(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 10),
        radius: 16,
        onTap: onTap,
        child: Row(
          children: [
            Container(
              width: 34,
              height: 34,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: palette.raised,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
              ),
              child: Icon(
                activity.indoor
                    ? Icons.home_work_outlined
                    : Icons.explore_outlined,
                size: 17,
                color: palette.muted,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 10),
            Expanded(
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Text(
                    activity.name,
                    maxLines: 1,
                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                    style: context.texts.titleSmall,
                  ),
                  if (meta.isNotEmpty)
                    Text(
                      meta,
                      maxLines: 1,
                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                      style: context.texts.labelSmall,
                    ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
            trailing,
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class StatusChip extends StatelessWidget {
  const StatusChip(this.label, {super.key, this.tone = ChipTone.neutral, this.icon});

  final String label;
  final ChipTone tone;
  final IconData? icon;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final palette = context.safar;
    final (bg, fg) = switch (tone) {
      ChipTone.neutral => (palette.raised, palette.muted),
      ChipTone.ember => (palette.emberSoft, palette.ember),
      ChipTone.jade => (palette.jadeSoft, palette.jade),
      ChipTone.rose => (
        palette.rose.withValues(alpha: 0.12),
        palette.rose,
      ),
    };
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 9, vertical: 5),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: bg,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
        border: Border.all(color: fg.withValues(alpha: 0.25)),
      ),
      child: Row(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        children: [
          if (icon != null) ...[
            Icon(icon, size: 12, color: fg),
            const SizedBox(width: 4),
          ],
          Text(
            titleCaseLabel(label),
            style: TextStyle(
              fontSize: 11,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
              color: fg,
              letterSpacing: 0.1,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  static String titleCaseLabel(String value) {
    if (value.isEmpty) return value;
    final cleaned = value.replaceAll('_', ' ');
    return '${cleaned[0].toUpperCase()}${cleaned.substring(1)}';
  }
}

class AsyncView<T> extends StatelessWidget {
  const AsyncView({
    super.key,
    required this.value,
    required this.builder,
    this.onRetry,
    this.skeleton,
    this.padding,
  });

  final AsyncValue<T> value;
  final Widget Function(T data) builder;
  final VoidCallback? onRetry;
  final Widget? skeleton;
  final EdgeInsetsGeometry? padding;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return value.when(
      data: builder,
      loading: () => padding == null
          ? (skeleton ?? const SkeletonList())
          : Padding(padding: padding!, child: skeleton ?? const SkeletonList()),
      error: (error, stack) => Padding(
        padding: padding ?? EdgeInsets.zero,
        child: SafarErrorView(
          message: error.toString(),
          onRetry: onRetry,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class SafarSheetHeader extends StatelessWidget {
  const SafarSheetHeader({super.key, required this.title, this.subtitle});

  final String title;
  final String? subtitle;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 16),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Text(title, style: context.texts.headlineSmall),
          if (subtitle != null) ...[
            const SizedBox(height: 4),
            Text(subtitle!, style: context.texts.bodySmall),
          ],
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

Future<T?> showSafarSheet<T>(
  BuildContext context, {
  required WidgetBuilder builder,
  bool isScrollControlled = true,
}) {
  return showModalBottomSheet<T>(
    context: context,
    isScrollControlled: isScrollControlled,
    builder: (context) => Padding(
      padding: EdgeInsets.only(
        left: 20,
        right: 20,
        top: 4,
        bottom: MediaQuery.of(context).viewInsets.bottom + 24,
      ),
      child: builder(context),
    ),
  );
}

import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';

import 'package:safar_mobile/core/utils/format.dart';

void main() {
  group('date and time formatting', () {
    test('formats calendar dates', () {
      expect(formatDate('2026-03-08'), '8 Mar 2026');
      expect(formatDateShort('2026-03-08'), '8 Mar');
      expect(formatWeekday('2026-03-08'), 'Sunday');
    });

    test('returns fallbacks for missing values', () {
      expect(formatDate(null), '—');
      expect(formatDate(''), '—');
      expect(formatDateShort(null, fallback: 'TBD'), 'TBD');
      expect(formatWeekday(null), '');
    });

    test('formats 24-hour strings as 12-hour clock times', () {
      expect(formatTime('09:05'), '9:05 AM');
      expect(formatTime('13:45'), '1:45 PM');
      expect(formatTime('00:00'), '12:00 AM');
      expect(formatTime('12:30'), '12:30 PM');
    });

    test('formatClock accepts ISO timestamps and plain times', () {
      expect(formatClock('13:45'), '1:45 PM');
      final iso = DateTime(2026, 3, 8, 18, 5).toIso8601String();
      expect(formatClock(iso), '6:05 PM');
      expect(formatClock(null), '');
    });

    test('tripDays lists inclusive calendar days', () {
      final days = tripDays('2026-03-08', '2026-03-10');
      expect(days.map(isoDate), ['2026-03-08', '2026-03-09', '2026-03-10']);
    });

    test('tripDays handles inverted ranges', () {
      expect(tripDays('2026-03-10', '2026-03-08'), hasLength(1));
    });

    test('timeAgo describes recent timestamps', () {
      final now = DateTime.now().toUtc();
      expect(timeAgo(now.toIso8601String()), 'just now');
      expect(
        timeAgo(now.subtract(const Duration(minutes: 5)).toIso8601String()),
        '5m ago',
      );
      expect(
        timeAgo(now.subtract(const Duration(hours: 3)).toIso8601String()),
        '3h ago',
      );
      expect(timeAgo(null), '');
    });

    test('titleCase normalises separators', () {
      expect(titleCase('group_experience-engine'), 'Group Experience Engine');
      expect(titleCase('rain'), 'Rain');
    });

    test('formats money with currency', () {
      expect(formatMoney(120, 'EUR'), contains('120'));
      expect(formatMoney(null), '—');
    });
  });
}

@router.post("/{trip_id}/shadowplans", status_code=201)
def create_shadowplan(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: ShadowplanCreate,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    item = db.get(ItineraryItem, payload.item_id)
    if not item or item.trip_id != trip.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Itinerary item not found")
    activity = db.get(Activity, payload.backup_activity_id)
    if not activity or activity.destination_id != trip.destination_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Backup must be a catalog activity in this destination")
    plan = Shadowplan(
        trip_id=trip.id,
        itinerary_item_id=item.id,
        backup_activity_id=activity.id,
        notes=payload.notes,
        readiness={"status": "ready", "checked_at": utcnow().isoformat()},
        created_by=user.id,
    )
    db.add(plan)
    audit(
        db,
        action="shadowplan.create",
        entity_type="shadowplan",
        entity_id=plan.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
    )
    db.commit()
    return {"id": plan.id, "backup_activity_id": activity.id, "readiness": plan.readiness}


@router.get("/{trip_id}/shadowplans")
def list_shadowplans(
    trip_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    rows = db.query(Shadowplan).filter(Shadowplan.trip_id == trip.id).all()
    return {
        "items": [
            {
                "id": row.id,
                "item_id": row.itinerary_item_id,
                "backup_activity_id": row.backup_activity_id,
                "notes": row.notes,
                "readiness": row.readiness,
                "created_at": row.created_at,
            }
            for row in rows
        ]
    }

from datetime import date

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.core.deps import get_current_user, get_db, get_trip_and_member
from app.models import User
from app.services.opportunity import clock

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/trips", tags=["opportunity"])


@router.get("/{trip_id}/opportunity-clock")
def opportunity_clock(
    trip_id: str,
    on: date | None = Query(default=None),
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = get_trip_and_member(trip_id, db, user)
    target = on or (date.today() if trip.start_date <= date.today() <= trip.end_date else trip.start_date)
    if target < trip.start_date or target > trip.end_date:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=422,
            detail="Chosen date is outside this trip's dates",
        )
    return clock(db, trip, target)
"""Opportunity Clock (F24).

Answers one honest question for a single day: which catalog activities still
fit the day that is already planned, given today's opening hours and an
estimated door-to-door travel time?

It is a read-only deterministic calculation. It never writes to the database,
never touches the confirmed itinerary and never claims to know live opening
status: hours come from the catalog, travel is an estimate, and a missing
window is reported as unknown rather than guessed.
"""

import re
from datetime import date, datetime

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.models import Activity, Itinerary, ItineraryItem, Place, Trip
from app.services.geo import haversine_km, travel_minutes

DAY_START = 8 * 60
DAY_END = 22 * 60
WEEKDAY_KEYS = ("mon", "tue", "wed", "thu", "fri", "sat", "sun")
_RANGE = re.compile(r"(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})\s*-\s*(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})")

STATUS_ORDER = {
    "open_now": 0,
    "later_today": 1,
    "no_window": 2,
    "closed_today": 3,
    "unknown": 4,
}


def _hhmm_to_minutes(value: str) -> int | None:
    try:
        hours, minutes = value.split(":")
        return int(hours) * 60 + int(minutes)
    except (ValueError, AttributeError):
        return None


def _minutes_to_hhmm(total: int) -> str:
    total = max(0, min(24 * 60 - 1, total))
    return f"{total // 60:02d}:{total % 60:02d}"


def parse_opening_window(raw: str | None) -> tuple[str, tuple[int, int] | None]:
    """Return (kind, window) where kind is open/closed/unknown."""
    if raw is None or not str(raw).strip():
        return "unknown", None
    value = str(raw).strip().lower()
    if value in {"closed", "closed today", "shut"}:
        return "closed", None
    if "24" in value and ("hour" in value or "open" in value):
        return "open", (0, 24 * 60)
    match = _RANGE.search(value)
    if match:
        start = int(match.group(1)) * 60 + int(match.group(2))
        end = int(match.group(3)) * 60 + int(match.group(4))
        if end <= start:
            return "unknown", None
        return "open", (start, end)
    return "unknown", None


def _confirmed_spans(db: Session, trip: Trip, on: date) -> list[tuple[int, int, str]]:
    rows = (
        db.query(ItineraryItem)
        .filter(
            ItineraryItem.trip_id == trip.id,
            ItineraryItem.day == on,
            ItineraryItem.status == "confirmed",
        )
        .order_by(ItineraryItem.start_time)
        .all()
    )
    spans: list[tuple[int, int, str]] = []
    for item in rows:
        start = _hhmm_to_minutes(item.start_time) or DAY_START

560	  @override
561	  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
562	    final palette = context.safar;
563	    final predicted = forecast.predicted;
564	    final observed = forecast.observed;
565	    if (forecast.status != 'ok' || predicted == null) {
566	      return SafarCard(
567	        child: Column(
568	          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
569	          children: [
570	            if (forecast.status == 'insufficient_data')
571	              const StatusChip('Insufficient data', tone: ChipTone.neutral)
572	            else
573	              const StatusChip('Not available', tone: ChipTone.neutral),
574	            const SizedBox(height: 10),
575	            Text(
576	              forecast.message ??
577	                  'Not enough recent reports to forecast crowds for this place.',
578	              style: context.texts.bodySmall,
579	            ),
580	            if (forecast.requiredReports != null) ...[
581	              const SizedBox(height: 8),
582	              Text(
583	                '${forecast.availableReports ?? 0} of ${forecast.requiredReports} reports available.',
584	                style: context.texts.labelSmall,
585	              ),
586	            ],
587	            if (forecast.disclosure != null) ...[
588	              const SizedBox(height: 8),
589	              Text(forecast.disclosure!, style: context.texts.labelSmall),
590	            ],
591	          ],
592	        ),
593	      );
594	    }
595	
596	    final byWeekday = <int, List<CrowdPoint>>{};
597	    for (final point in predicted.forecasts) {
598	      byWeekday.putIfAbsent(point.weekday, () => []).add(point);
599	    }
600	    final weekdays = byWeekday.keys.toList()..sort();
601	    final all = predicted.forecasts;
602	    final maxLevel = all.fold<double>(
603	      1,
604	      (value, point) => point.expectedLevel > value ? point.expectedLevel : value,
605	    );
606	    const names = ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat', 'Sun'];
607	
608	    return SafarCard(
609	      child: Column(
610	        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
611	        children: [
612	          Row(
613	            children: [
614	              StatusChip(
615	                predicted.provenance.toLowerCase(),
616	                tone: ChipTone.ember,
617	                icon: Icons.auto_graph,
618	              ),
619	              const Spacer(),
620	              if (predicted.model != null)
621	                Text(predicted.model!, style: context.texts.labelSmall),
622	            ],
623	          ),
624	          const SizedBox(height: 12),
625	          for (final weekday in weekdays) ...[
626	            Row(
627	              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center,
628	              children: [
629	                SizedBox(
630	                  width: 34,
631	                  child: Text(
632	                    weekday >= 1 && weekday <= 7 ? names[weekday - 1] : '$weekday',
633	                    style: context.texts.labelSmall,
634	                  ),
635	                ),
636	                Expanded(
637	                  child: Row(
638	                    children: [
639	                      for (final point in byWeekday[weekday]!)
640	                        Expanded(
641	                          child: Padding(
642	                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 1.5),
643	                            child: Tooltip(
644	                              message:
645	                                  '${titleCase(point.bucket)} · ${point.levelLabel ?? point.expectedLevel.toStringAsFixed(1)}',
646	                              child: Container(
647	                                height: 18,
648	                                decoration: BoxDecoration(
649	                                  color: palette.ember.withValues(
650	                                    alpha: 0.16 +
651	                                        0.7 *
652	                                            (point.expectedLevel / maxLevel)
653	                                                .clamp(0, 1),
654	                                  ),
655	                                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(5),
656	                                ),
657	                              ),
658	                            ),
659	                          ),
660	                        ),
661	                    ],
662	                  ),
663	                ),
664	                const SizedBox(width: 6),
665	                SizedBox(
666	                  width: 44,
667	                  child: Text(
668	                    _meanLabel(byWeekday[weekday]!),
669	                    textAlign: TextAlign.right,
670	                    style: context.texts.labelSmall,
671	                  ),
672	                ),
673	              ],
674	            ),
675	            const SizedBox(height: 6),
676	          ],
677	          const SizedBox(height: 6),
678	          Row(
679	            children: [
680	              Text('Less crowded', style: context.texts.labelSmall),
681	              const SizedBox(width: 8),
682	              Expanded(
683	                child: Container(
684	                  height: 5,
685	                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
686	                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(99),
687	                    gradient: LinearGradient(
688	                      colors: [
689	                        palette.ember.withValues(alpha: 0.16),
690	                        palette.ember,
691	                      ],
692	                    ),
693	                  ),
694	                ),
695	              ),
696	              const SizedBox(width: 8),
697	              Text('Busier', style: context.texts.labelSmall),
698	            ],
699	          ),
700	          if (predicted.note != null) ...[
701	            const SizedBox(height: 10),
702	            Text(predicted.note!, style: context.texts.labelSmall),
703	          ],
704	          if (observed != null) ...[
705	            const SizedBox(height: 14),
706	            Divider(color: palette.line),
707	            const SizedBox(height: 10),
708	            Row(
709	              children: [
710	                const StatusChip('Observed', tone: ChipTone.jade),
711	                const Spacer(),
712	                Text(
713	                  '${observed.reportsUsed} of ${observed.reportsSeen} reports used',
714	                  style: context.texts.labelSmall,
715	                ),
716	              ],
717	            ),
718	            const SizedBox(height: 8),
719	            Text(
720	              observed.note ??
721	                  'Based on attributed traveller reports. Individual experience may vary.',
722	              style: context.texts.bodySmall,
723	            ),
724	          ],
725	          if (forecast.disclosure != null) ...[
726	            const SizedBox(height: 10),
727	            Text(forecast.disclosure!, style: context.texts.labelSmall),
728	          ],
729	        ],
730	      ),
731	    );
732	  }
733	
734	  static String _meanLabel(List<CrowdPoint> points) {
735	    if (points.isEmpty) return '';
736	    final mean =
737	        points.fold<double>(0, (sum, point) => sum + point.expectedLevel) /
738	        points.length;
739	    return mean.toStringAsFixed(1);
740	  }
741	}

    if (_expanded) { setState(() => _expanded = false); return; }
    final proposal = widget.proposal;

    if (existing != null) { setState(() { _impact = existing; _expanded = true; }); return; }
    setState(() { _expanded = true; _impactBusy = true; });

      if (!mounted) return;

}

"use client";

import { useParams } from "next/navigation";
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { Compass, Footprints, MapPin, Navigation, Search } from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";

import { TripMap, type MapMarker } from "@/components/TripMap";
import {
  Badge,
  Card,
  ErrorState,
  FlowNote,
  Input,
  PageSkeleton,
  Select,
  SectionTitle,
} from "@/components/ui";
import { useItinerary, useNearby, useTrip } from "@/lib/hooks";
import { formatMoney, titleCase } from "@/lib/utils";

export default function MapPage() {
  const params = useParams<{ tripId: string }>();
  const tripId = typeof params?.tripId === "string" ? params.tripId : "";
  const trip = useTrip(tripId);
  const itinerary = useItinerary(tripId);
  const [radius, setRadius] = useState(5);
  const [category, setCategory] = useState("");
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const nearby = useNearby(tripId, radius);

  const center = useMemo(
    () => ({ lat: trip.data?.base_lat || 0, lon: trip.data?.base_lon || 0 }),
    [trip.data],
  );

  const planMarkers: MapMarker[] = useMemo(
    () =>
      (itinerary.data?.items || [])
        .filter((item) => item.activity?.place)
        .map((item) => ({
          id: `item-${item.id}`,
          lat: item.activity!.place!.lat,
          lon: item.activity!.place!.lon,
          title: item.title,
          subtitle: `${String(item.day).slice(0, 10)} · ${item.start_time.slice(0, 5)}`,
          tone: "ember" as const,
        })),
    [itinerary.data],
  );

  const nearbyItems = useMemo(
    () =>
      (nearby.data?.items || []).filter((entry) => {
        const place = entry.activity.place;
        if (!place) return false;
        if (category && place.category.toLowerCase() !== category.toLowerCase()) return false;
        if (query && !entry.activity.name.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase())) return false;
        return true;
      }),
    [nearby.data, category, query],
  );

  const nearbyMarkers: MapMarker[] = nearbyItems
    .filter((entry) => entry.activity.place)
    .map((entry) => ({
      id: `nearby-${entry.activity.id}`,
      lat: entry.activity.place!.lat,
      lon: entry.activity.place!.lon,
      title: entry.activity.name,
      subtitle: `${entry.distance_km} km · ~${entry.travel_minutes} min`,
      tone: "jade" as const,
    }));

  if (trip.isLoading || itinerary.isLoading) return <PageSkeleton />;
  if (trip.error || !trip.data) {
    return <ErrorState error={trip.error || new Error("Trip not found")} retry={() => trip.refetch()} />;
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <p className="eyebrow">Map & nearby</p>
          <h2 className="mt-1 text-2xl">Where the journey happens</h2>
          <p className="mt-1 max-w-prose text-sm text-muted">
            The confirmed plan and catalog places within a radius of the shared trip base. Distances
            are straight-line estimates — not live routing, and never a live member location.
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          <Select
            value={radius}
            onChange={(event) => setRadius(Number(event.target.value))}
            className="h-9 w-32"
            aria-label="Radius"

class NearbyQuery {
  const NearbyQuery({
    required this.tripId,
    this.lat,
    this.lon,
    this.radiusKm = 5,
    this.category,
    this.limit = 20,
  });

  final String tripId;
  final double? lat;
  final double? lon;
  final double radiusKm;
  final String? category;
  final int limit;

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
      other is NearbyQuery &&
      other.tripId == tripId &&
      other.lat == lat &&
      other.lon == lon &&
      other.radiusKm == radiusKm &&
      other.category == category &&
      other.limit == limit;

  @override
  int get hashCode =>
      Object.hash(tripId, lat, lon, radiusKm, category, limit);
}

```dart
class _RelativeMap extends StatelessWidget {
  const _RelativeMap({required this.base, required this.radiusKm, required this.items, required this.route, required this.selectedId, required this.onSelect});
  final NearbyBase base; final double radiusKm; final List<NearbyItem> items; final List<({double lat, double lon, String title})> route; final String? selectedId; final ValueChanged<NearbyItem> onSelect;

  @override
  build:
    return LayoutBuilder(builder: (context, constraints) {
      final size = Size(constraints.maxWidth, 250);
      final maxKm = _maxKm();
      return GestureDetector(
        onTapUp: (details) {
          NearbyItem? best; double bestDist = 20;
          for (final item in items) {
            final place = item.activity.place; if (place == null) continue;
            final offset = _project(place.lat, place.lon, size, maxKm);
            final d = (offset - details.localPosition).distance;
            if (d < bestDist) { best = item; bestDist = d; }
          }
          if (best != null) onSelect(best);
        },
        child: CustomPaint(size: size, painter: _MapPainter(...)),
      );
    });
}
```

`_project` must be static/shared with painter. Create top-level functions:

```dart
double _maxKm(NearbyBase base, double radiusKm, List<({double lat,double lon})> route) {
  var maxKm = radiusKm;
  for (final p in route) {
    final dLat = (p.lat - base.lat).abs() * 111.32;
    final dLon = (p.lon - base.lon).abs() * 111.32 * cos(base.lat * pi / 180).abs();
    final d = max(dLat, dLon);
    if (d > maxKm) maxKm = d;
  }
  return maxKm <= 0 ? 1 : maxKm;
}
```

But need cos import 'dart:math'.

Projection: 
```dart
Offset _projectPoint(double lat, double lon, NearbyBase base, Size size, double maxKm) {
  final latKm = (lat - base.lat) * 111.32;
  final lonKm = (lon - base.lon) * 111.32 * cos(base.lat * pi / 180);
  final half = size.shortestSide / 2 - 18;
  final scale = half / maxKm;
  return Offset(size.width/2 + lonKm*scale, size.height/2 - latKm*scale);
}
```

import 'common.dart';

class CirclePost {
  const CirclePost({
    required this.id,
    required this.title,
    required this.body,
    required this.status,
    required this.createdAt,
    this.author,
    this.activityId,
  });

  final String id;
  final String title;
  final String body;
  final String status;
  final String createdAt;
  final User? author;
  final String? activityId;

  factory CirclePost.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    final authorJson = jsonMap(json['author']);
    return CirclePost(
      id: jsonText(json['id']),
      title: jsonText(json['title']),
      body: jsonText(json['body']),
      status: jsonText(json['status']),
      createdAt: jsonText(json['created_at']),
      author: authorJson.isEmpty ? null : User.fromJson(authorJson),
      activityId: jsonString(json['activity_id']),
    );
  }
}

class Circle {
  const Circle({
    required this.id,
    required this.slug,
    required this.name,
    required this.description,
    required this.memberCount,
    required this.joined,
    this.interests = const [],
    this.createdAt,
  });

  final String id;
  final String slug;
  final String name;
  final String description;
  final int memberCount;
  final bool joined;
  final List<String> interests;
  final String? createdAt;

  factory Circle.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) => Circle(
    id: jsonText(json['id']),
    slug: jsonText(json['slug']),
    name: jsonText(json['name']),
    description: jsonText(json['description']),
    memberCount: jsonInt(json['member_count']),
    joined: jsonBool(json['joined']),
    interests: jsonStringList(json['interests']),
    createdAt: jsonString(json['created_at']),
  );
}

class CircleDetail extends Circle {
  const CircleDetail({
    required super.id,
    required super.slug,
    required super.name,
    required super.description,
    required super.memberCount,
    required super.joined,
    super.interests,
    super.createdAt,
    this.posts = const [],
    this.members = const [],
  });

  final List<CirclePost> posts;
  final List<CircleMember> members;

  factory CircleDetail.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    final base = Circle.fromJson(json);
    return CircleDetail(
      id: base.id,
      slug: base.slug,
      name: base.name,
      description: base.description,
      memberCount: base.memberCount,
      joined: base.joined,
      interests: base.interests,
      createdAt: base.createdAt,
      posts: jsonObjects(json['posts'], CirclePost.fromJson),
      members: jsonObjects(json['members'], CircleMember.fromJson),
    );
  }
}

class CircleMember {
  const CircleMember({
    required this.userId,
    required this.displayName,
    required this.role,
  });

  final String userId;
  final String displayName;
  final String role;

  factory CircleMember.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) => CircleMember(
    userId: jsonText(json['user_id']),
    displayName: jsonText(json['display_name']),
    role: jsonText(json['role'], 'member'),

}

class Contributor {
  const Contributor({
    required this.id,
    required this.bio,
    required this.expertise,
    required this.verified,
    required this.acceptsRequests,
    this.user,
    this.destination,
  });

  final String id;
  final String? bio;
  final List<String> expertise;
  final bool verified;
  final bool acceptsRequests;
  final User? user;
  final Destination? destination;

  factory Contributor.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    final userJson = jsonMap(json['user']);
    final destinationJson = jsonMap(json['destination']);
    return Contributor(
      id: jsonText(json['id']),
      bio: jsonString(json['bio']),
      expertise: jsonStringList(json['expertise']),
      verified: jsonBool(json['verified']),
      acceptsRequests: jsonBool(json['accepts_requests']),

          ? null

      message: jsonString(json['message']),

}

class SocialRepository {
  SocialRepository(this._api);

  final ApiClient _api;

  Future<SerendipityFeed> feed() async =>
      SerendipityFeed.fromJson(jsonMap(await _api.get('/api/serendipity/matches')));

  Future<List<TravellerMatch>> matches() async {
    final data = jsonMap(await _api.get('/api/serendipity/matches'));
    final raw = data['matches'];
    return jsonObjects(raw, TravellerMatch.fromJson);
  }

  Future<List<ConnectionRequestItem>> requests() async {
    final data = await _api.get('/api/serendipity/requests');
    final raw = data is Map ? data['items'] : data;
    return jsonObjects(raw, ConnectionRequestItem.fromJson);
  }

  Future<void> requestConnection({
    required String toUserId,
    String? tripId,
    String? message,
  }) async {
    await _api.post(
      '/api/serendipity/requests',
      data: {
        'to_user_id': toUserId,
        'trip_id': ?tripId,
        if (message != null && message.isNotEmpty) 'message': message,
      },
    );
  }

  Future<void> decideConnection(String id, {required bool accept}) async {
    await _api.post(
      '/api/serendipity/requests/$id/decide',
      data: {'accept': accept},
    );
  }

  Future<void> blockUser(String userId) async {
    await _api.post('/api/users/me/blocks/$userId');
  }

  Future<void> unblockUser(String userId) async {
    await _api.delete('/api/users/me/blocks/$userId');
  }
}

def _link_brief(db: Session, link: CompanionLink) -> dict:
    responses = (
        db.query(func.count(CompanionResponse.id))
        .filter(CompanionResponse.link_id == link.id)
        .scalar()
        or 0
    )
    values = {
        value: count
        for value, count in (
            db.query(CompanionResponse.value, func.count(CompanionResponse.id))
            .filter(CompanionResponse.link_id == link.id)
            .group_by(CompanionResponse.value)
            .all()
        )
    }
    target = None
    if link.purpose == "vote":
        proposal = db.get(ItineraryProposal, link.target_id)
        target = {
            "kind": "proposal",
            "id": link.target_id,
            "title": proposal.title if proposal else "Decision removed",
            "status": proposal.status if proposal else "missing",
        }
    else:
        item = db.get(ItineraryItem, link.target_id)
        target = {
            "kind": "checkin",
            "id": link.target_id,
            "title": item.title if item else "Item removed",
            "day": item.day.isoformat() if item else None,
            "status": item.status if item else "missing",
        }
    return {
        "id": link.id,
        "purpose": link.purpose,
        "target": target,
        "status": companion_service.link_status(link),
        "expires_at": link.expires_at,
        "max_uses": link.max_uses,
        "used_count": link.used_count,
        "anonymous_responses": responses,
        "response_values": values,
        "created_at": link.created_at,
    }

@public_router.get("/{token}")
def companion_view(token: str, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    parsed = companion_service.parse_token(token)
    if parsed:
        companion_context(db, parsed[0])
    link, error = companion_service.resolve_active(db, token)
    if error:
        status_code = 404 if link is None else 410
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status_code, detail=error)
    return companion_service.context(db, link)


@public_router.post("/{token}/respond")
def respond(token: str, payload: CompanionResponseIn, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    parsed = companion_service.parse_token(token)
    if parsed:
        companion_context(db, parsed[0])
    link, error = companion_service.resolve_active(db, token)
    if error:
        status_code = 404 if link is None else 410
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status_code, detail=error)

    allowed = (
        companion_service.VOTE_VALUES
        if link.purpose == "vote"
        else companion_service.CHECKIN_VALUES
    )
    if payload.value not in allowed:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=422,
            detail=f"Choose one of: {', '.join(allowed)}",
        )
    ok, reason = companion_service.target_open(db, link)
    if not ok:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=reason)

    db.add(
        CompanionResponse(
            link_id=link.id,
            value=payload.value,
            comment=(payload.comment or "").strip() or None,
        )
    )
    link.used_count += 1
    audit(
        db,
        action="companion.response",
        entity_type="companion_link",
        entity_id=link.id,
        user_id=None,
        trip_id=link.trip_id,
        detail={"purpose": link.purpose, "value": payload.value},
    )
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(link)
    return {
        "ok": True,
        "recorded": payload.value,
        "anonymous": True,
        "remaining_uses": max(0, link.max_uses - link.used_count),
import '../models/json.dart';
import '../models/monitoring.dart';
import '../network/api_client.dart';

class CompanionRepository {
  CompanionRepository(this._api);

  final ApiClient _api;

  Future<List<CompanionLink>> list(String tripId) async {
    final data = await _api.get('/api/trips/$tripId/companion-links');
    final raw = data is Map ? data['items'] : data;
    return jsonObjects(raw, CompanionLink.fromJson);
  }

  Future<CompanionLinkCreated> create(
    String tripId, {
    required String purpose,
    required String targetId,
    int ttlMinutes = 1440,
  }) async => CompanionLinkCreated.fromJson(
    jsonMap(
      await _api.post(
        '/api/trips/$tripId/companion-links',
        data: {
          'purpose': purpose,
          'target_id': targetId,
          'ttl_minutes': ttlMinutes,
        },
      ),
    ),
  );

  Future<void> revoke(String tripId, String linkId) async {
    await _api.post('/api/trips/$tripId/companion-links/$linkId/revoke');
  }

  Future<CompanionResponses> responses(String tripId, String linkId) async =>
      CompanionResponses.fromJson(
        jsonMap(
          await _api.get(
            '/api/trips/$tripId/companion-links/$linkId/responses',
          ),
        ),
      );

  /// Public companion endpoints: the token is the credential, no session.
  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> publicView(String token) async =>
      jsonMap(await _api.get('/api/companion/$token'));

  Future<void> respondPublic(
    String token, {
    required String value,
    String? comment,
  }) async {
    await _api.post(
      '/api/companion/$token/respond',
      data: {'value': value, 'comment': ?comment},
    );
  }
}

129	def list_companion_links(
130	    trip_id: str,
131	    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
132	    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
133	):
134	    trip, member = get_trip_and_member(trip_id, db, user)
135	    query = db.query(CompanionLink).filter(CompanionLink.trip_id == trip.id)
136	    if member.role not in {"owner", "admin"}:
137	        query = query.filter(CompanionLink.created_by == user.id)
138	    links = query.order_by(CompanionLink.created_at.desc()).all()
139	    return {
140	        "items": [_link_brief(db, link) for link in links],
141	        "disclosure": "Tokens are shown once when created and are never listed again.",
142	    }

202	def companion_view(token: str, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
203	    parsed = companion_service.parse_token(token)
204	    if parsed:
205	        companion_context(db, parsed[0])
206	    link, error = companion_service.resolve_active(db, token)
207	    if error:

209	        raise HTTPException(status_code=status_code, detail=error)
210	    return companion_service.context(db, link)

213	@public_router.post("/{token}/respond")
214	def respond(token: str, payload: CompanionResponseIn, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
215	    parsed = companion_service.parse_token(token)
216	    if parsed:
217	        companion_context(db, parsed[0])
218	    link, error = companion_service.resolve_active(db, token)
219	    if error:
220	        status_code = 404 if link is None else 410
221	        raise HTTPException(status_code=status_code, detail=error)
222	
223	    allowed = (
224	        companion_service.VOTE_VALUES
225	        if link.purpose == "vote"
226	        else companion_service.CHECKIN_VALUES
227	    )
228	    if payload.value not in allowed:
229	        raise HTTPException(
230	            status_code=422,
231	            detail=f"Choose one of: {', '.join(allowed)}",
232	        )
233	    ok, reason = companion_service.target_open(db, link)
234	    if not ok:
235	        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=reason)
236	
237	    db.add(
238	        CompanionResponse(
239	            link_id=link.id,
240	            value=payload.value,
241	            comment=(payload.comment or "").strip() or None,
242	        )
243	    )
244	    link.used_count += 1
245	    audit(
246	        db,
247	        action="companion.response",
248	        entity_type="companion_link",
249	        entity_id=link.id,
250	        user_id=None,
251	        trip_id=link.trip_id,
252	        detail={"purpose": link.purpose, "value": payload.value},
253	    )
254	    db.commit()
255	    db.refresh(link)
256	    return {
257	        "ok": True,
258	        "recorded": payload.value,
259	        "anonymous": True,
260	        "remaining_uses": max(0, link.max_uses - link.used_count),
261	        "message": "Thank you — your answer was recorded without an account.",
262	    }
