1	"""One-Link Companion (F26).
2	
3	Short-lived, single-purpose links let somebody answer exactly one question —
4	one vote or one check-in — without an account. Tokens are HMAC-signed and
5	carry the link id, expiry, purpose and target, so a token cannot be repointed
6	at another trip, proposal or item. Responses are anonymous: no user id, IP
7	address or user agent is stored.
8	"""
9	
10	import hashlib
11	import hmac
12	from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
13	
14	from sqlalchemy import func
15	from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
16	
17	from app.core.config import settings
18	from app.models import (
19	    CompanionLink,
20	    CompanionResponse,
21	    ItineraryItem,
22	    ItineraryProposal,
23	    Trip,
24	    Vote,
25	)
26	from app.models.models import utcnow
27	
28	MAX_TTL_MINUTES = 7 * 24 * 60
29	MIN_TTL_MINUTES = 5
30	
31	VOTE_VALUES = ("yes", "no", "abstain")
32	CHECKIN_VALUES = ("in", "out", "join_later")
33	PURPOSES = ("vote", "checkin")
34	
35	
36	def _epoch(value: datetime) -> int:
37	    if value.tzinfo is None:
38	        value = value.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
39	    return int(value.timestamp())
40	
41	
42	def _signature(link_id: str, expires: int, purpose: str, target_id: str) -> str:
43	    message = f"{link_id}.{expires}.{purpose}.{target_id}".encode("utf-8")
44	    return hmac.new(
45	        settings.secret_key.encode("utf-8"), message, hashlib.sha256
46	    ).hexdigest()[:40]
47	
48	
49	def issue_token(link: CompanionLink) -> str:
50	    expires = _epoch(link.expires_at)
51	    return f"{link.id}.{expires}.{_signature(link.id, expires, link.purpose, link.target_id)}"
52	
53	
54	def parse_token(token: str) -> tuple[str, int, str] | None:
55	    parts = (token or "").split(".")
56	    if len(parts) != 3:
57	        return None
58	    link_id, raw_expires, signature = parts
59	    if len(link_id) != 32 or not link_id.isalnum():
60	        return None
61	    try:
62	        expires = int(raw_expires)
63	    except ValueError:
64	        return None
65	    return link_id, expires, signature
66	
67	
68	def token_valid(link: CompanionLink, expires: int, signature: str) -> bool:
69	    if expires != _epoch(link.expires_at):
70	        return False
71	    expected = _signature(link.id, expires, link.purpose, link.target_id)
72	    return hmac.compare_digest(signature, expected)
73	
74	
75	def link_status(link: CompanionLink, now: datetime | None = None) -> str:
76	    now = now or utcnow()
77	    if link.revoked_at:
78	        return "revoked"
79	    if _epoch(link.expires_at) <= _epoch(now):
80	        return "expired"
81	    if link.used_count >= link.max_uses:
82	        return "used"
83	    return "active"
84	
85	
86	def expires_from_now(minutes: int) -> datetime:
87	    minutes = max(MIN_TTL_MINUTES, min(MAX_TTL_MINUTES, minutes))
88	    return utcnow() + timedelta(minutes=minutes)
89	
90	
91	def resolve_active(db: Session, token: str) -> tuple[CompanionLink, str | None]:
92	    """Return (link, None) or (link/None, error message)."""
93	    parsed = parse_token(token)
94	    if not parsed:
95	        return None, "This link is not valid."
96	    link_id, expires, signature = parsed
97	    link = db.get(CompanionLink, link_id)
98	    if not link or not token_valid(link, expires, signature):
99	        return None, "This link is not valid."
100	    status = link_status(link)
101	    if status == "revoked":
102	        return link, "This link was revoked by its creator."
103	    if status == "expired":
104	        return link, "This link has expired."
105	    if status == "used":
106	        return link, "This link has already been used."
107	    return link, None
108	
109	
110	def context(db: Session, link: CompanionLink) -> dict:
111	    trip = db.get(Trip, link.trip_id)
112	    base = {
113	        "purpose": link.purpose,
114	        "trip": {
115	            "name": trip.name if trip else "Journey",
116	            "destination_name": trip.destination_name if trip else "",
117	        },
118	        "expires_at": link.expires_at,
119	        "remaining_uses": max(0, link.max_uses - link.used_count),
120	        "disclosure": (
121	            "This page answers one question without an account. Your identity is not recorded."
122	        ),
123	    }
124	    anonymous_count = (
125	        db.query(func.count(CompanionResponse.id))
126	        .filter(CompanionResponse.link_id == link.id)
127	        .scalar()
128	        or 0
129	    )
130	    base["anonymous_responses"] = anonymous_count
131	
132	    if link.purpose == "vote":
133	        proposal = db.get(ItineraryProposal, link.target_id)
134	        counts = {"yes": 0, "no": 0, "abstain": 0}
135	        if proposal:
136	            for value, count in (
137	                db.query(Vote.value, func.count(Vote.id))
138	                .filter(Vote.proposal_id == proposal.id)
139	                .group_by(Vote.value)
140	                .all()
141	            ):
142	                counts[value] = count
143	        base["target"] = {
144	            "kind": "proposal",
145	            "id": link.target_id,
146	            "title": proposal.title if proposal else "Decision unavailable",
147	            "summary": proposal.summary if proposal else None,
148	            "status": proposal.status if proposal else "missing",
149	            "registered_votes": counts,
150	        }
151	        base["question"] = "Do you support this decision?"
152	        base["options"] = list(VOTE_VALUES)
153	    else:
154	        item = db.get(ItineraryItem, link.target_id)
155	        base["target"] = {
156	            "kind": "checkin",
157	            "id": link.target_id,
158	            "title": item.title if item else "Item unavailable",
159	            "day": item.day.isoformat() if item else None,
160	            "start_time": item.start_time if item else None,
161	            "status": item.status if item else "missing",
162	        }
163	        base["question"] = "Will you join this confirmed item?"
164	        base["options"] = list(CHECKIN_VALUES)
165	    return base
166	
167	
168	def target_open(db: Session, link: CompanionLink) -> tuple[bool, str]:
169	    if link.purpose == "vote":
170	        proposal = db.get(ItineraryProposal, link.target_id)
171	        if not proposal or proposal.trip_id != link.trip_id:
172	            return False, "This decision is unavailable."
173	        if proposal.status != "open":
174	            return False, "This decision is no longer open."
175	        return True, ""
176	    item = db.get(ItineraryItem, link.target_id)
177	    if not item or item.trip_id != link.trip_id or item.status != "confirmed":
178	        return False, "This item is no longer confirmed."
179	    return True, ""

30	
31	const DAY_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
32	  mon: "Mon",
33	  tue: "Tue",
34	  wed: "Wed",
35	  thu: "Thu",
36	  fri: "Fri",
37	  sat: "Sat",
38	  sun: "Sun",
39	};

41	// Seeded rows store the raw value, new rows store {value}, changed rows store
42	// {value, previous}. Normalise both shapes so the card never shows raw JSON.
43	function describeWatchValue(field: string, raw: Record<string, unknown>): string {
44	  const stored = "value" in raw ? raw.value : raw;
45	  if (stored === null || stored === undefined) return "unknown";
46	  if (field === "wheelchair_accessible") {
47	    if (stored === true) return "step-free";
48	    if (stored === false) return "not step-free";
49	    return "unknown";
50	  }
51	  if (field === "price_estimate") {
52	    if (typeof stored === "number") return formatMoney(stored);
53	    if (stored === null) return "unknown";
54	    return String(stored);
55	  }
56	  if (typeof stored === "object" && !Array.isArray(stored)) {
57	    const entries = Object.entries(stored as Record<string, unknown>);
58	    const hours = entries.filter(([key]) => key in DAY_LABELS);
59	    if (hours.length) {
60	      const distinct = new Set(hours.map(([, value]) => String(value)));
61	      if (distinct.size === 1) return `Every day ${hours[0][1]}`;
62	      return hours.map(([day, value]) => `${DAY_LABELS[day]} ${value}`).join(" · ");
63	    }
64	    if (!entries.length) return "unknown";
65	    return entries.map(([key, value]) => `${titleCase(key)} ${String(value)}`).join(" · ");
66	  }
67	  return String(stored);
68	}

673	def sync_offline(
674	    trip_id: str,
675	    payload: list[OfflineSyncItem],
676	    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
677	    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
678	):
679	    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
680	    if len(payload) > 100:
681	        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Sync at most 100 items per request")
682	    results = []
683	    applied = 0
684	    skipped = 0
685	    rejected = 0
686	    for entry in payload:
687	        existing = (
688	            db.query(OfflineSyncQueue)
689	            .filter(OfflineSyncQueue.client_id == entry.client_id)
690	            .first()
691	        )
692	        if existing:
693	            if existing.user_id != user.id or existing.trip_id != trip.id:
694	                rejected += 1
695	                results.append(
696	                    {"client_id": entry.client_id, "status": "rejected", "reason": "Client id conflict"}
697	                )
698	            elif existing.operation != entry.operation or existing.payload != entry.payload:
699	                rejected += 1
700	                results.append(
701	                    {
702	                        "client_id": entry.client_id,
703	                        "status": "rejected",
704	                        "reason": "Client id reused with different content",
705	                    }
706	                )
707	            else:
708	                skipped += 1
709	                results.append(
710	                    {"client_id": entry.client_id, "status": existing.status, "id": None}
711	                )
712	            continue
713	        try:
714	            memory_payload = MemoryCreate(**entry.payload)
715	        except ValidationError as exc:
716	            rejected += 1
717	            results.append(
718	                {
719	                    "client_id": entry.client_id,
720	                    "status": "rejected",
721	                    "reason": "Invalid payload",
722	                    "errors": exc.errors(include_url=False),
723	                }
724	            )
725	            continue
726	        _validate_memory_content(
727	            memory_payload.kind, memory_payload.text_content, memory_payload.media_url
728	        )
729	        captured_at = _naive_utc(memory_payload.captured_at)
730	        memory = TripMemory(
731	            trip_id=trip.id,
732	            user_id=user.id,
733	            kind=memory_payload.kind,
734	            text_content=memory_payload.text_content,
735	            media_url=canonical_media_url(memory_payload.media_url),
736	            media_type=memory_payload.media_type,
737	            caption=memory_payload.caption,
738	            captured_at=captured_at,
739	            lat=memory_payload.lat,
740	            lon=memory_payload.lon,
741	            visibility=memory_payload.visibility,
742	        )
743	        db.add(memory)
744	        db.flush()
745	        db.add(
746	            OfflineSyncQueue(
747	                user_id=user.id,
748	                trip_id=trip.id,
749	                client_id=entry.client_id,
750	                operation=entry.operation,
751	                payload=entry.payload,
752	                status="applied",
753	                applied_at=utcnow(),
754	            )
755	        )
756	        applied += 1
757	        results.append(
758	            {"client_id": entry.client_id, "status": "applied", "id": memory.id}
759	        )
760	    audit(
761	        db,
762	        action="offline.sync",
763	        entity_type="trip",
764	        entity_id=trip.id,
765	        user_id=user.id,
766	        trip_id=trip.id,
767	        detail={"applied": applied, "skipped": skipped, "rejected": rejected},
768	    )
769	    db.commit()
770	    return {
771	        "applied": applied,
772	        "skipped": skipped,
773	        "rejected": rejected,
774	        "results": results,
775	        "note": "Client ids make retries idempotent. Nothing is overwritten silently.",
776	    }

3	/// Small key/value contract so the cookie jar and session logic are testable
4	/// without platform plugins.
5	abstract class JsonStore {
6	  Future<String?> read(String key);
7	  Future<void> write(String key, String value);
8	  Future<void> delete(String key);
9	}
10	
11	/// Native storage uses Keychain (iOS) and encrypted shared preferences
12	/// (Android). The refresh cookie is never written to plain shared preferences.
13	class SecureJsonStore implements JsonStore {
14	  SecureJsonStore([FlutterSecureStorage? storage])
15	    : _storage = storage ?? const FlutterSecureStorage();
16	
17	  final FlutterSecureStorage _storage;
18	
19	  @override
20	  Future<String?> read(String key) => _storage.read(key: key);
21	
22	  @override
23	  Future<void> write(String key, String value) =>
24	      _storage.write(key: key, value: value);
25	
26	  @override
27	  Future<void> delete(String key) => _storage.delete(key: key);
28	}
29	
30	/// Used by unit tests and by the web verification target, where the browser
31	/// owns HttpOnly cookies and the Dart layer must not persist them.
32	class MemoryJsonStore implements JsonStore {
33	  final Map<String, String> _values = {};
34	
35	  @override
36	  Future<String?> read(String key) async => _values[key];
37	
38	  @override
39	  Future<void> write(String key, String value) async => _values[key] = value;
40	
41	  @override
42	  Future<void> delete(String key) async => _values.remove(key);
43	}

### 1. Offline capture local store
I need a local queue for offline memory captures. Use `JsonStore` (secure storage) keyed `offline_queue` (global) or per-trip. Since JsonStore is async and Riverpod provider is sync, create a `Provider<OfflineQueueStore>` wrapping JsonStore with methods to load/save. But screens can use `ref.read(jsonStoreProvider)`. Better: create `core/storage/offline_queue.dart` with an `OfflineQueue` class taking JsonStore, storing a JSON list under key `safar.offline.queue`. Entries: `{client_id, trip_id, operation:'memory_create', payload:{...}, created_at}`. Methods: `load()`, `add(tripId, payload)`, `remove(clientIds)`. Also a `StateProvider`? Simpler: the OfflineScreen is a ConsumerStatefulWidget that loads the queue in initState and manages local list state, writing through the store. This avoids provider complexity.

Client id: `DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch` + random suffix — must be 6..80 chars, alphanumeric presumably. Use `u{millis}{random}`. Could use `Random.secure()`. E.g. `'m${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch.toRadixString(36)}${_rand().toRadixString(36)}'`, length > 6.

Payload fields: `{kind:'text', text_content: text, visibility:'trip', captured_at: ISO}`. `MemoryCreate` accepts `captured_at: datetime`, `visibility` literal. The payload stored server-side is compared for idempotency; fine.

The offline screen also needs to capture a memory while offline: a text field + "Save offline" which queues. Additionally, should the memories screen offer this? The web does this via `useOffline` store, probably in memories page. To keep it contained and satisfy "Offline Capture", I'll include capture in the offline screen (Memory capture section) and also add an "Save for offline" action in the memory composer? Let me check the memories screen `_add` to see if it's easy to add an offline queue option. Actually §2 says "Memory/Offline (Offline Capture, ...)". The offline screen's capture field is enough and visible. But it would be nice to make it discoverable. I'll include a capture card in offline screen with clear "Saved on this device until you sync" messaging. That's real functionality.

Also offline screen needs "snapshot" view (already server endpoint) and sync history.

Download/edit? Skip file download; not needed on mobile. Provide "Refresh" and "Sync now".

Note: offline queue is stored in secure storage — reasonable. But `jsonStoreProvider` is used for cookies; writing JSON list there is fine (key `safar.offline.capture`). Not sensitive beyond memory text, but secure storage is safer.

159	class _AuthInterceptor extends Interceptor {

161	
162	  final ApiClient client;
163	
164	  @override
165	  void onRequest(RequestOptions options, RequestInterceptorHandler handler) {
166	    if (options.extra['skipAuth'] != true) {
167	      final token = client.accessToken;
168	      if (token != null && token.isNotEmpty) {
169	        options.headers['Authorization'] = 'Bearer $token';
170	      }
171	      final csrf = client.csrfToken;
172	      if (_unsafeMethods.contains(options.method.toUpperCase()) &&
173	          csrf != null &&
174	          csrf.isNotEmpty) {
175	        options.headers['X-CSRF-Token'] = csrf;
176	      }
177	    }
178	    handler.next(options);
179	  }
180	
181	  @override
182	  Future<void> onError(
183	    DioException err,
184	    ErrorInterceptorHandler handler,
185	  ) async {
186	    final options = err.requestOptions;
187	    final status = err.response?.statusCode;
188	    final isAuthPath = options.path.startsWith('/api/auth/');
189	    final retried = options.extra['retried'] == true;
190	    if (status == 401 && !retried && !isAuthPath) {
191	      try {
192	        final refreshed = await client.refreshSession();
193	        if (refreshed) {
194	          final headers = Map<String, dynamic>.from(options.headers);
195	          final token = client.accessToken;
196	          if (token != null) headers['Authorization'] = 'Bearer $token';
197	          final csrf = client.csrfToken;
198	          if (_unsafeMethods.contains(options.method.toUpperCase()) &&
199	              csrf != null) {
200	            headers['X-CSRF-Token'] = csrf;
201	          }
202	          final retryOptions = options.copyWith(
203	            headers: headers,
204	            extra: {...options.extra, 'retried': true},
205	          );
206	          final response = await client.dio.fetch<dynamic>(retryOptions);
207	          return handler.resolve(response);
208	        }
209	        client.notifyUnauthorized();
210	      } on Object {
211	        // A network failure while refreshing must not sign the user out.
212	      }
213	    }
214	    handler.next(err);
215	  }

3	class ApiException implements Exception {
4	  ApiException({
5	    required this.message,
6	    this.statusCode,
7	    this.detail,
8	    this.isNetwork = false,
9	    this.isTimeout = false,
10	  });
11	
12	  final String message;
13	  final int? statusCode;
14	  final dynamic detail;
15	  final bool isNetwork;
16	  final bool isTimeout;
17	
18	  bool get isUnauthorized => statusCode == 401 || statusCode == 403;
19	
20	  factory ApiException.fromDio(DioException error) {
21	    final status = error.response?.statusCode;
22	    final detail = error.response?.data is Map
23	        ? (error.response!.data as Map)['detail'] ?? error.response!.data
24	        : error.response?.data;
25	    final message = _messageFor(detail) ?? _fallback(error, status);
26	    final type = error.type;
27	    return ApiException(
28	      message: message,
29	      statusCode: status,
30	      detail: detail,
31	      isNetwork:
32	          type == DioExceptionType.connectionError ||
33	          type == DioExceptionType.badCertificate,
34	      isTimeout:
35	          type == DioExceptionType.connectionTimeout ||
36	          type == DioExceptionType.sendTimeout ||
37	          type == DioExceptionType.receiveTimeout,
38	    );
39	  }
40	
41	  static String? _messageFor(dynamic detail) {
42	    if (detail == null) return null;
43	    if (detail is String) return detail;
44	    if (detail is List) {
45	      final parts = detail
46	          .map((item) {
47	            if (item is Map && item['msg'] != null) return '${item['msg']}';
48	            return '$item';
49	          })
50	          .where((part) => part.trim().isNotEmpty)
51	          .toList();
52	      if (parts.isNotEmpty) return parts.join(' · ');
53	      return null;
54	    }
55	    if (detail is Map) {
56	      final message = detail['message'] ?? detail['detail'];
57	      if (message != null) return '$message';
58	    }
59	    return null;
60	  }
61	
62	  static String _fallback(DioException error, int? status) {
63	    switch (error.type) {
64	      case DioExceptionType.connectionTimeout:
65	      case DioExceptionType.sendTimeout:
66	      case DioExceptionType.receiveTimeout:
67	        return 'The server took too long to respond. Check your connection and try again.';
68	      case DioExceptionType.connectionError:
69	        return 'Could not reach SAFAR. Check the API address and your network.';
70	      case DioExceptionType.badCertificate:
71	        return 'The secure connection could not be verified.';
72	      case DioExceptionType.cancel:
73	        return 'The request was cancelled.';
74	      default:
75	        if (status == 401) return 'Your session has expired. Sign in again.';
76	        if (status == 403) return 'You do not have access to this action.';
77	        if (status == 404) return 'This item could not be found.';
78	        if (status == 409) return 'That conflicts with the current plan.';
79	        if (status == 422) return 'Please check the information you entered.';
80	        if (status != null && status >= 500) {
81	          return 'SAFAR had a problem completing that request.';
82	        }
83	        return 'The request could not be completed.';
84	    }
85	  }

#### Thinking

There's a formatting glitch line 12 (imports joined). I'll fix that while editing.

Important: `/companion/:token` public route. Problems:
1. Auth redirect forces `/login` before route matching. I need to add early check: `final isPublicCompanion = location.startsWith('/companion/');` and return null before onboarding/auth checks. But onboarding not seen shouldn't matter for public link. So at the top of redirect: `if (isPublicCompanion) return null;`. But if auth unknown, router will still show splash initially because initialLocation is `/splash`. For a deep link, GoRouter initial location from platform will be `/companion/...`. If location is public, return null; route builds without auth. The ApiClient is created with a store; public endpoints don't require auth. Good.

2. The ApiClient on unauthorized path: public GET won't be 401. Fine.

3. `CompanionPublicScreen` must not depend on auth providers. Use companionRepositoryProvider only.

Now share URL base: for the companion link `url` returned is `/companion/{token}`. Mobile cannot open web path directly; absolute web origin unknown. Check env config: `API_BASE_URL` maybe in config. Let me grep for baseUrl usage/`String.fromEnvironment`.

3	/// Compile-time configuration. Secrets are never placed in the client.
4	class Env {
5	  static const String _definedBaseUrl = String.fromEnvironment(
6	    'SAFAR_API_BASE_URL',
7	  );
8	
9	  /// Dev defaults are explicit and local. A release build must supply the URL
10	  /// with `--dart-define=SAFAR_API_BASE_URL=https://...`.
11	  static String get apiBaseUrl {
12	    final raw = _definedBaseUrl.trim();
13	    if (raw.isNotEmpty) {
14	      return raw.endsWith('/') ? raw.substring(0, raw.length - 1) : raw;
15	    }
16	    if (kDebugMode) {
17	      // The Android emulator reaches the host machine through 10.0.2.2;
18	      // localhost there would be the emulator itself.
19	      if (!kIsWeb && defaultTargetPlatform == TargetPlatform.android) {
20	        return 'http://10.0.2.2:8010';
21	      }
22	      return 'http://localhost:8010';
23	    }
24	    throw StateError(
25	      'SAFAR_API_BASE_URL was not provided. Release builds must be compiled '
26	      'with --dart-define=SAFAR_API_BASE_URL=https://your-api-host.',
27	    );
28	  }
29	
30	  static const String appName = 'SAFAR';
31	  static const String policyLabel = 'Private by default · group approved';
32	}

28	String formatDate(String? raw, {String fallback = '—'}) {
29	  if (raw == null || raw.isEmpty) return fallback;
30	  final date = DateTime.tryParse(raw);
31	  if (date == null) return raw;
32	  return '${date.day} ${_months[date.month - 1]} ${date.year}';
33	}

35	String formatDateShort(String? raw, {String fallback = '—'}) {
36	  if (raw == null || raw.isEmpty) return fallback;
37	  final date = DateTime.tryParse(raw);
38	  if (date == null) return raw;
39	  return '${date.day} ${_months[date.month - 1]}';
40	}
41	
42	String formatWeekday(String? raw) {
43	  if (raw == null || raw.isEmpty) return '';
44	  final date = DateTime.tryParse(raw);
45	  if (date == null) return '';
46	  return _weekdays[date.weekday - 1];
47	}
48	
49	String formatTime(String? raw) {
50	  if (raw == null || raw.isEmpty) return '';
51	  final parts = raw.split(':');
52	  if (parts.length < 2) return raw;
53	  final hour = int.tryParse(parts[0]);
54	  final minute = int.tryParse(parts[1]);
55	  if (hour == null || minute == null) return raw;
56	  final suffix = hour >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
57	  final display = hour % 12 == 0 ? 12 : hour % 12;
58	  return '$display:${minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0')} $suffix';
59	}
60	
61	/// Formats an ISO timestamp or `HH:MM` value as a 12-hour clock time.
62	String formatClock(String? raw) {
63	  if (raw == null || raw.isEmpty) return '';
64	  final date = raw.contains('T') ? DateTime.tryParse(raw) : null;
65	  if (date == null) return formatTime(raw);
66	  final local = date.toLocal();
67	  return formatTime(
68	    '${local.hour.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}:'
69	    '${local.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}',
70	  );
71	}

73	String formatMoney(double? amount, [String currency = 'EUR']) {
74	  if (amount == null) return '—';
75	  try {
76	    return NumberFormat.simpleCurrency(
77	      name: currency,
78	      decimalDigits: amount == amount.roundToDouble() ? 0 : 2,
79	    ).format(amount);
80	  } on Object {
81	    return '${amount.toStringAsFixed(2)} $currency';
82	  }
83	}
84	
85	String timeAgo(String? raw) {
86	  if (raw == null || raw.isEmpty) return '';
87	  final date = DateTime.tryParse(raw);
88	  if (date == null) return '';
89	  final diff = DateTime.now().toUtc().difference(date.toUtc());
90	  if (diff.inSeconds < 60) return 'just now';
91	  if (diff.inMinutes < 60) return '${diff.inMinutes}m ago';
92	  if (diff.inHours < 24) return '${diff.inHours}h ago';
93	  if (diff.inDays < 7) return '${diff.inDays}d ago';
94	  return formatDateShort(raw);
95	}

102	      .map((word) => '${word[0].toUpperCase()}${word.substring(1)}')
103	      .join(' ');

108	/// Inclusive list of calendar days between [start] and [end].
109	List<DateTime> tripDays(String startDate, String endDate, {int cap = 60}) {
110	  final start = DateTime.tryParse(startDate);
111	  final end = DateTime.tryParse(endDate);
112	  if (start == null || end == null || end.isBefore(start)) {
113	    return start == null ? const [] : [start];
114	  }
115	  final days = <DateTime>[];
116	  var cursor = DateTime(start.year, start.month, start.day);
117	  final last = DateTime(end.year, end.month, end.day);
118	  while (!cursor.isAfter(last) && days.length < cap) {
119	    days.add(cursor);
120	    cursor = cursor.add(const Duration(days: 1));
121	  }
122	  return days;
123	}

```dart
  static const String _definedWebBaseUrl = String.fromEnvironment(
    'SAFAR_WEB_BASE_URL',
  );

  /// Origin of the web fallback that serves public companion pages.
  static String? get webBaseUrl {
    final raw = _definedWebBaseUrl.trim();
    if (raw.isNotEmpty) {
      return raw.endsWith('/') ? raw.substring(0, raw.length - 1) : raw;
    }
    if (kDebugMode) return 'http://localhost:3000';
    return null;
  }
```

```dart
Future<void> _create() async {
  final targetId = _targetId;
  if (targetId == null) return;
  setState(() => _creating = true);
  try {
    final created = await ref.read(companionRepositoryProvider).create(widget.tripId, purpose: _purpose, targetId: targetId, ttlMinutes: _ttl);
    ref.invalidate(companionLinksProvider(widget.tripId));
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() { _created = created; _targetId = null; });
  } on Object catch (error) { snackbar(error.toString()); }
  finally { if (mounted) setState(() => _creating = false); }
}
```

Queue interactions:
```dart
Future<void> _sync() async {
  if (_queue.isEmpty) return;
  setState(() => _syncing = true);
  try {
    final outcome = await ref.read(memoryRepositoryProvider).sync(widget.tripId, [
      for (final capture in _queue) {'client_id': capture.clientId, 'operation': 'memory_create', 'payload': capture.payload},
    ]);
    final settled = outcome.results.where((r) => r.status == 'applied' || r.status == 'skipped').map((r) => r.clientId).toSet();
    final remaining = _queue.where((c) => !settled.contains(c.clientId)).toList();
    await ref.read(offlineQueueProvider).save(remaining);
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() { _queue = remaining; _lastOutcome = outcome; });
    ref.invalidate(syncQueueProvider(widget.tripId));
    ref.invalidate(memoriesProvider(widget.tripId));
    ref.invalidate(offlineSnapshotProvider(widget.tripId));
    snackbar('${outcome.applied} applied · ${outcome.skipped} already synced · ${outcome.rejected} rejected.');
  } on Object catch (e) { snackbar('Could not sync: $e'); }
  finally { if (mounted) setState(() => _syncing = false); }
}
```

The queue\n/// lives in secure storage; entries are removed only after the server reports\n/// them applied or already known.\nclass OfflineCapture {\n  const OfflineCapture({\n    required this.clientId,\n    required this.tripId,\n    required this.text,\n    required this.capturedAt,\n  });\n\n  final String clientId;\n  final String tripId;\n  final String text;\n  final String capturedAt;\n\n  Map<String, dynamic> get payload => {\n    'kind': 'text',\n    'text_content': text,\n    'visibility': 'trip',\n    'captured_at': capturedAt,\n  };\n\n  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {\n    'client_id': clientId,\n    'trip_id': tripId,\n    'text': text,\n    'captured_at': capturedAt,\n  };\n\n  factory OfflineCapture.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) => OfflineCapture(\n    clientId: '${json['client_id'] ?? ''}',\n    tripId: '${json['trip_id'] ?? ''}',\n    text: '${json['text'] ?? ''}',\n    capturedAt: '${json['captured_at'] ?? ''}',\n  );\n}\n\nclass OfflineQueue {\n  OfflineQueue(this._store);\n\n  static const _key = 'safar.offline.captures';\n\n  final JsonStore _store;\n\n  /// Server contract: client ids are 6–80 characters.\n  static String newClientId() {\n    final time = DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch.toRadixString(36);\n    final salt = Random.secure().nextInt(1 << 32).toRadixString(36);\n    return 'm$time$salt';\n  }\n\n  Future<List<OfflineCapture>> load() async {\n    final raw = await _store.read(_key);\n    if (raw == null || raw.isEmpty) return const [];\n    try {\n      final decoded = jsonDecode(raw);\n      if (decoded is! List) return const [];\n      return decoded\n          .whereType<Map>()\n          .map((item) => OfflineCapture.fromJson(\n                item.map((key, value) => MapEntry('$key', value)),\n              ))\n          .where((capture) => capture.clientId.isNotEmpty && capture.text.isNotEmpty)\n          .toList();\n    } on FormatException {\n      return const [];\n    }\n  }\n\n  Future<List<OfflineCapture>> add(OfflineCapture capture) async {\n    final current = await load();\n    final next = [...current, capture];\n    await save(next);\n    return next;\n  }\n\n  Future<List<OfflineCapture>> remove(Iterable<String> clientIds) async {\n    final settled = clientIds.toSet();\n    final next =\n        (await load()).where((capture) => !settled.contains(capture.clientId)).toList();\n    await save(next);\n    return next;\n  }\n\n  Future<void> save(List<OfflineCapture> captures) => _store.write(\n    _key,\n    jsonEncode(captures.map((capture) => capture.toJson()).toList()),\n  );\n}\n"
```json
}
```

```dart
String _describeWatchValue(String field, Object? raw) {
  var stored = raw;
  if (raw is Map && raw.containsKey('value')) stored = raw['value'];
  if (stored == null) return 'unknown';
  if (field == 'wheelchair_accessible') {
    if (stored == true) return 'step-free';
    if (stored == false) return 'not step-free';
    return 'unknown';
  }
  if (field == 'price_estimate') {
    if (stored is num) return formatMoney(stored.toDouble());
    return '$stored';
  }
  if (stored is Map) {
    const labels = {...};
    final hours = stored.entries.where((entry) => labels.containsKey(entry.key)).toList();
    if (hours.isNotEmpty) {
      final distinct = hours.map((e) => '${e.value}').toSet();
      if (distinct.length == 1) return 'Every day ${hours.first.value}';
      return hours.map((e) => '${labels[e.key]} ${e.value}').join(' · ');
    }
    if (stored.isEmpty) return 'unknown';
    return stored.entries.map((e) => '${titleCase('${e.key}')} ${e.value}').join(' · ');
  }
  return '$stored';
}
```

Another runtime issue: In `CompanionScreen`, `DropdownButtonFormField` `initialValue: _targetId` with `key: ValueKey('${_purpose}_target')` — when `_targetId` is set via onChanged, the FormField internal state holds selection; using initialValue while rebuilt on purpose change recreates state with current `_targetId` (null after purpose switch because we reset). Good. After create, `_targetId = null` but the dropdown's internal state still shows the old selection because the same key. That means after creating, the dropdown still displays the target while `_targetId` is null. Hmm. This is a UI inconsistency. Fix: add a counter `_formRevision` and include it in the key, increment when created or purpose changes. Simpler: include `_created?.token` in the key? On create, `_created` changes → key changes → dropdown resets. Key: `ValueKey('${_purpose}_${_created?.link.id}_target')`. That would rebuild when created changes. But previewing multiple creates changes token each time? `_created` new object each create → new link id → key changes. Works. But also when the dropdown target changes, key stays same, internal state updates via onChanged. Good. Use `key: ValueKey('${_purpose}_${_created?.link.id ?? 'new'}_target')`. Yet `_created` is set after create in the same setState as `_targetId = null`, so rebuild resets. 

Alternatively use a `_formNonce` int. Clearer:
```dart
int _formNonce = 0;
...
setState(() { _purpose = purpose; _targetId = null; _formNonce++; });
...
setState(() { _created = created; _targetId = null; _formNonce++; });
...
key: ValueKey('${_purpose}_$_formNonce')
```

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException
from sqlalchemy import func
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.core.deps import get_current_user, get_db, get_trip_and_member
from app.db.context import companion_context
from app.models import (
    CompanionLink,
    CompanionResponse,
    ItineraryItem,
    ItineraryProposal,
    User,
)
from app.models.models import utcnow
from app.schemas.schemas import CompanionLinkIn, CompanionResponseIn
from app.services import companion as companion_service
from app.services.common import audit

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/trips", tags=["companion"])
public_router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/companion", tags=["companion"])


def _link_brief(db: Session, link: CompanionLink) -> dict:
    responses = (
        db.query(func.count(CompanionResponse.id))
        .filter(CompanionResponse.link_id == link.id)
        .scalar()
        or 0
    )
    values = {
        value: count
        for value, count in (
            db.query(CompanionResponse.value, func.count(CompanionResponse.id))
            .filter(CompanionResponse.link_id == link.id)
            .group_by(CompanionResponse.value)
            .all()
        )
    }
    target = None
    if link.purpose == "vote":
        proposal = db.get(ItineraryProposal, link.target_id)
        target = {
            "kind": "proposal",
            "id": link.target_id,
            "title": proposal.title if proposal else "Decision removed",
            "status": proposal.status if proposal else "missing",
        }
    else:
        item = db.get(ItineraryItem, link.target_id)
        target = {
            "kind": "checkin",
            "id": link.target_id,
            "title": item.title if item else "Item removed",
            "day": item.day.isoformat() if item else None,
            "status": item.status if item else "missing",
        }
    return {
        "id": link.id,
        "purpose": link.purpose,
        "target": target,
        "status": companion_service.link_status(link),
        "expires_at": link.expires_at,
        "max_uses": link.max_uses,
        "used_count": link.used_count,
        "anonymous_responses": responses,
        "response_values": values,
        "created_at": link.created_at,
    }


@router.post("/{trip_id}/companion-links", status_code=201)
def create_companion_link(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: CompanionLinkIn,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = get_trip_and_member(trip_id, db, user)

    if payload.purpose == "vote":
        target = db.get(ItineraryProposal, payload.target_id)
        if not target or target.trip_id != trip.id:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Decision not found")
        if target.status != "open":
            raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Only open decisions can be shared.")
    else:
        target = db.get(ItineraryItem, payload.target_id)
        if not target or target.trip_id != trip.id:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Itinerary item not found")
        if target.status != "confirmed":
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=422, detail="Only confirmed itinerary items can be shared."
            )

    link = CompanionLink(
        trip_id=trip.id,
        created_by=user.id,
        purpose=payload.purpose,
        target_id=payload.target_id,
        expires_at=companion_service.expires_from_now(payload.ttl_minutes),
        max_uses=1,
        used_count=0,
    )
    db.add(link)
    db.flush()
    token = companion_service.issue_token(link)
    audit(
        db,
        action="companion.create",
        entity_type="companion_link",
        entity_id=link.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
        detail={"purpose": link.purpose, "target_id": link.target_id},
    )
    db.commit()
    return {
        "link": _link_brief(db, link),
        "token": token,
        "url": f"/companion/{token}",
        "disclosure": (
            "Anyone with this link can answer once, without an account. Their identity is not recorded. "
            "The link expires on its own and can be revoked."
        ),
    }


@router.get("/{trip_id}/companion-links")
def list_companion_links(
    trip_id: str,

):
    trip, member = get_trip_and_member(trip_id, db, user)

    if member.role not in {"owner", "admin"}:
        query = query.filter(CompanionLink.created_by == user.id)
    links = query.order_by(CompanionLink.created_at.desc()).all()
    return {
        "items": [_link_brief(db, link) for link in links],

@router.post("/{trip_id}/companion-links/{link_id}/revoke")
def revoke_companion_link(
    trip_id: str,
    link_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, member = get_trip_and_member(trip_id, db, user)
    link = db.get(CompanionLink, link_id)
    if not link or link.trip_id != trip.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Link not found")
    if link.created_by != user.id and member.role not in {"owner", "admin"}:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Only the creator or an owner can revoke this link")
    if not link.revoked_at:
        link.revoked_at = utcnow()
        audit(
            db,
            action="companion.revoke",
            entity_type="companion_link",
            entity_id=link.id,
            user_id=user.id,
            trip_id=trip.id,
        )
        db.commit()
    return {"id": link.id, "status": companion_service.link_status(link)}


@router.get("/{trip_id}/companion-links/{link_id}/responses")
def list_companion_responses(
    trip_id: str,
    link_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, member = get_trip_and_member(trip_id, db, user)
    link = db.get(CompanionLink, link_id)
    if not link or link.trip_id != trip.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Link not found")
    if link.created_by != user.id and member.role not in {"owner", "admin"}:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Only the creator or an owner can read responses")
    rows = (
        db.query(CompanionResponse)
        .filter(CompanionResponse.link_id == link.id)
        .order_by(CompanionResponse.created_at)
        .all()
    )
    return {
        "items": [
            {"id": row.id, "value": row.value, "comment": row.comment, "created_at": row.created_at}
            for row in rows
        ],
        "anonymous": True,
        "disclosure": "No respondent identity, IP address or device identifier is stored.",
    }


@public_router.get("/{token}")
def companion_view(token: str, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    parsed = companion_service.parse_token(token)
    if parsed:
        companion_context(db, parsed[0])
    link, error = companion_service.resolve_active(db, token)
    if error:
        status_code = 404 if link is None else 410
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status_code, detail=error)
    return companion_service.context(db, link)


@public_router.post("/{token}/respond")
def respond(token: str, payload: CompanionResponseIn, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    parsed = companion_service.parse_token(token)
    if parsed:
        companion_context(db, parsed[0])
    link, error = companion_service.resolve_active(db, token)
    if error:
        status_code = 404 if link is None else 410
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status_code, detail=error)

    allowed = (
        companion_service.VOTE_VALUES
        if link.purpose == "vote"
        else companion_service.CHECKIN_VALUES
    )
    if payload.value not in allowed:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=422,
            detail=f"Choose one of: {', '.join(allowed)}",
        )
    ok, reason = companion_service.target_open(db, link)
    if not ok:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=reason)

    db.add(
        CompanionResponse(
            link_id=link.id,
            value=payload.value,
            comment=(payload.comment or "").strip() or None,
        )
    )
    link.used_count += 1
    audit(
        db,
        action="companion.response",
        entity_type="companion_link",
        entity_id=link.id,
        user_id=None,
        trip_id=link.trip_id,
        detail={"purpose": link.purpose, "value": payload.value},
    )
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(link)
    return {
        "ok": True,
        "recorded": payload.value,
        "anonymous": True,
        "remaining_uses": max(0, link.max_uses - link.used_count),

@router.post("/{trip_id}/tasks", status_code=201)
def create_task(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: TaskCreate,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    if payload.assignee_id and not _active_member(db, trip.id, payload.assignee_id):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Assignee must be an active trip member")
    task = PlannerTask(
        trip_id=trip.id,
        title=payload.title,
        description=payload.description,
        assignee_id=payload.assignee_id,
        created_by=user.id,
    )
    db.add(task)
    audit(
        db,
        action="task.create",
        entity_type="planner_task",
        entity_id=task.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
    )
    db.commit()
    return {"id": task.id, "title": task.title, "status": task.status}


@router.patch("/{trip_id}/tasks/{task_id}")
def update_task(
    trip_id: str,
    task_id: str,
    payload: TaskUpdate,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    task = db.get(PlannerTask, task_id)
    if not task or task.trip_id != trip.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Task not found")
    if task.assignee_id and task.assignee_id != user.id and member.role not in {"owner", "admin"}:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Only the assignee or an admin can update this task")
    data = payload.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
    if data.get("assignee_id") and not _active_member(db, trip.id, data["assignee_id"]):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Assignee must be an active trip member")
    for field, value in data.items():
        setattr(task, field, value)
    db.commit()
    return {"id": task.id, "status": task.status, "assignee_id": task.assignee_id}

@router.post("/trips/{trip_id}/material-watch", status_code=201)
def create_watch(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: MaterialWatchIn,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = get_trip_and_member(trip_id, db, user)
    activity = db.get(Activity, payload.activity_id)
    if not activity or activity.destination_id != trip.destination_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Activity not found for this trip")
    existing = (
        db.query(MaterialWatch)
        .filter(
            MaterialWatch.trip_id == trip.id,
            MaterialWatch.activity_id == activity.id,
            MaterialWatch.field == payload.field,
        )
        .first()
    )
    if existing:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="This field is already being watched")
    watch = MaterialWatch(
        trip_id=trip.id,
        activity_id=activity.id,
        field=payload.field,
        last_value={"value": _watch_value(activity, payload.field)},
        status="watching",
    )
    db.add(watch)
    audit(
        db,
        action="material_watch.create",
        entity_type="material_watch",
        entity_id=watch.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
        detail={"field": payload.field},
    )
    db.commit()
    return {
        "id": watch.id,
        "field": watch.field,
        "last_value": watch.last_value,
        "status": watch.status,
    }


@router.delete("/trips/{trip_id}/material-watch/{watch_id}")
def delete_watch(
    trip_id: str,
    watch_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, member = get_trip_and_member(trip_id, db, user)
    watch = db.get(MaterialWatch, watch_id)
    if not watch or watch.trip_id != trip.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Watch not found")
    db.delete(watch)
    audit(
        db,
        action="material_watch.delete",
        entity_type="material_watch",
        entity_id=watch_id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
    )
    db.commit()
    return {"ok": True}

@router.get("/activities/search")
def search_activities(
    q: str | None = Query(default=None, max_length=120),
    destination_id: str | None = None,
    tags: str | None = Query(default=None, max_length=200),
    max_budget: float | None = Query(default=None, ge=0),
    max_duration: int | None = Query(default=None, ge=15, le=1440),
    indoor: bool | None = None,
    accessible: bool = False,
    lens: str = Query(default="balanced", pattern=r"^(balanced|iconic|similar)$"),
    limit: int = Query(default=24, ge=1, le=60),
    user: User | None = Depends(get_optional_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    dna = discovery_service.dna_for_user(db, user.id) if user else None
    tag_list = [tag.strip() for tag in (tags or "").split(",") if tag.strip()]
    results = discovery_service.search_activities(
        db,
        q=q,
        destination_id=destination_id,
        tags=tag_list,
        max_budget=max_budget,
        max_duration=max_duration,
        indoor=indoor,
        accessible=accessible,
        lens=lens,
        dna=dna,
        limit=limit,
    )
    return {
        "lens": lens,
        "items": [
            {
                "activity": activity_out(item["activity"], item["place"], item["destination"]),
                "personal_fit": item["personal_fit"],
                "similar_to": item["similar_to"],
                "similarity": item["similarity"],
                "respect_note": item["respect_note"],
                "provenance": (
                    "ESTIMATED"
                    if (item["activity"].source_type or "").startswith("seed")
                    else "REPORTED"
                ),
                "catalog_freshness": _catalog_freshness(item["activity"]),
            }
            for item in results
        ],
        "personalised": bool(dna),
        "disclosure": (
            "Catalog attributes are curated data. Personal fit is an estimate from your Journey DNA, "
            "not a live provider score."
        ),
    }

@router.post("/{trip_id}/sync")
def sync_offline(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: list[OfflineSyncItem],
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    if len(payload) > 100:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Sync at most 100 items per request")
    results = []
    applied = 0
    skipped = 0
    rejected = 0
    for entry in payload:
        existing = (
            db.query(OfflineSyncQueue)
            .filter(OfflineSyncQueue.client_id == entry.client_id)
            .first()
        )
        if existing:
            if existing.user_id != user.id or existing.trip_id != trip.id:
                rejected += 1
                results.append(
                    {"client_id": entry.client_id, "status": "rejected", "reason": "Client id conflict"}
                )
            elif existing.operation != entry.operation or existing.payload != entry.payload:
                rejected += 1
                results.append(
                    {
                        "client_id": entry.client_id,
                        "status": "rejected",
                        "reason": "Client id reused with different content",
                    }
                )
            else:
                skipped += 1
                results.append(
                    {"client_id": entry.client_id, "status": existing.status, "id": None}
                )
            continue
        try:
            memory_payload = MemoryCreate(**entry.payload)
        except ValidationError as exc:
            rejected += 1
            results.append(
                {
                    "client_id": entry.client_id,
                    "status": "rejected",
                    "reason": "Invalid payload",
                    "errors": exc.errors(include_url=False),

            )
            continue
        _validate_memory_content(

        )

            caption=memory_payload.caption,
            captured_at=captured_at,
            lat=memory_payload.lat,
            lon=memory_payload.lon,
            visibility=memory_payload.visibility,
        )
        db.add(memory)
        db.flush()
        db.add(
            OfflineSyncQueue(
                user_id=user.id,
                trip_id=trip.id,
                client_id=entry.client_id,
                operation=entry.operation,
                payload=entry.payload,
                status="applied",
                applied_at=utcnow(),
            )
        )
        applied += 1
        results.append(
            {"client_id": entry.client_id, "status": "applied", "id": memory.id}
        )

@router.post("/login")
def login(
    payload: LoginIn,
    request: Request,
    response: Response,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    auth_context(db)
    email = payload.email.lower().strip()
    user = db.query(User).filter(User.email == email).first()
    if not user or not verify_password(payload.password, user.password_hash):
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, detail="Incorrect email or password"
        )
    if not user.is_active or user.deleted_at:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="This account is no longer active")
    set_user_context(db, user.id, user.is_admin)
    return _start_session(response, db, user, request)


@router.post("/refresh")
def refresh(request: Request, response: Response, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    auth_context(db)
    token = request.cookies.get(settings.refresh_cookie)
    if not token:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, detail="No refresh session"
        )
    session, new_refresh, user = rotate_refresh_token(db, token, request)
    if not session or not user:
        clear_auth_cookies(response)
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            detail="Session expired or revoked. Sign in again.",
        )
    set_user_context(db, user.id, user.is_admin)
    access_token = create_access_token(user.id, user.email, session_id=session.id)
    csrf_token = new_csrf_token()
    set_auth_cookies(response, access_token, new_refresh, csrf_token)
    return {
        "access_token": access_token,
        "token_type": "bearer",
        "expires_in": settings.access_token_expire_minutes * 60,
        "csrf_token": csrf_token,
        "user": user_out(user),
    }

def csrf_valid(request: Request) -> bool:
    cookie = request.cookies.get(settings.csrf_cookie)
    header = request.headers.get(settings.csrf_header)
    if not cookie or not header:
        return False
    return hmac.compare_digest(cookie, header)


def _resolve_user(
    request: Request,
    credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials | None,
    db: Session,
) -> User | None:
    token, source = _token_from_request(request, credentials)
    if not token:
        return None
    if (
        source == "cookie"
        and request.method not in SAFE_METHODS
        and not csrf_valid(request)
    ):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="CSRF validation failed")
    payload = decode_access_token(token)
    if not payload or not payload.get("sub"):
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            detail="Invalid or expired session",
            headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"},
        )
    # Set the RLS identity from the verified token before reading any row.
    set_user_context(db, payload["sub"])
    user = db.get(User, payload["sub"])

"""Trip workspace WebSocket channel for collaborative updates (F05).

Browsers cannot set Authorization headers on WebSocket handshakes, so the
short-lived access token is passed as a query parameter and verified before
the connection is accepted. Membership is re-checked on every connection.
"""

from fastapi import APIRouter, Query, WebSocket, WebSocketDisconnect

from app.core.realtime import manager
from app.core.security import decode_token
from app.db.context import set_user_context
from app.db.session import SessionLocal
from app.models import Trip, TripMember, User
from app.services.auth_sessions import session_is_active
from app.services.common import event_payload

router = APIRouter()


@router.websocket("/ws/trips/{trip_id}")
async def trip_socket(
    websocket: WebSocket,
    trip_id: str,
    token: str = Query(..., min_length=20),
):
    payload = decode_token(token, "ws") or decode_token(token, "access")
    if not payload or not payload.get("sub"):
        await websocket.close(code=4401)
        return

    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        set_user_context(db, payload["sub"])
        user = db.get(User, payload["sub"])
        if not user or not user.is_active or user.deleted_at:
            await websocket.close(code=4401)
            return
        session_id = payload.get("sid")
        if session_id and not session_is_active(db, session_id, user.id):
            await websocket.close(code=4401)
            return
        trip = db.get(Trip, trip_id)
        if not trip or trip.deleted_at:
            await websocket.close(code=4404)
            return
        member = (
            db.query(TripMember)
            .filter(
                TripMember.trip_id == trip.id,
                TripMember.user_id == user.id,
                TripMember.status == "active",
            )
            .first()
        )
        if not member:
            await websocket.close(code=4404)
            return
        display_name = user.display_name
    finally:
        db.close()

    await manager.connect(trip_id, websocket)
    await websocket.send_json(
        event_payload(
            "connected",
            trip_id=trip_id,
            user=display_name,
            note="Live updates for this trip workspace only.",
        )
    )
    try:
        while True:
            message = await websocket.receive_text()
            if message.strip().lower() == "ping":
                await websocket.send_json(event_payload("pong", trip_id=trip_id))
    except WebSocketDisconnect:
        pass
    finally:
        await manager.disconnect(trip_id, websocket)

import asyncio
from collections import defaultdict
from typing import Any

from fastapi import WebSocket


class TripConnectionManager:
    """In-process pub/sub for trip workspaces.

    A single-process implementation keeps the reference deployment simple.
    For multi-instance deployments swap this for Redis pub/sub behind the
    same `broadcast` interface (documented in README).
    """

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._connections: dict[str, set[WebSocket]] = defaultdict(set)
        self._lock = asyncio.Lock()

    async def connect(self, trip_id: str, socket: WebSocket) -> None:
        await socket.accept()
        async with self._lock:
            self._connections[trip_id].add(socket)

    async def disconnect(self, trip_id: str, socket: WebSocket) -> None:
        async with self._lock:
            self._connections[trip_id].discard(socket)
            if not self._connections[trip_id]:
                self._connections.pop(trip_id, None)

    async def broadcast(self, trip_id: str, event: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        async with self._lock:
            sockets = list(self._connections.get(trip_id, ()))
        for socket in sockets:
            try:
                await socket.send_json(event)
            except Exception:
                await self.disconnect(trip_id, socket)

"use client";

import { useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";

import { wsUrl } from "@/lib/api";

type Status = "idle" | "connecting" | "live" | "closed";

export function useTripSocket(tripId: string | undefined) {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<Status>("idle");
  const [lastEvent, setLastEvent] = useState<{ type: string; at: number } | null>(null);
  const retry = useRef(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!tripId) return;
    let socket: WebSocket | null = null;
    let heartbeat: number | undefined;
    let reconnect: number | undefined;
    let disposed = false;

    const connect = async () => {
      setStatus("connecting");
      const url = await wsUrl(tripId);
      if (!url || disposed) {
        setStatus("closed");
        return;
      }
      socket = new WebSocket(url);

      socket.onopen = () => {
        retry.current = 0;
        setStatus("live");
        heartbeat = window.setInterval(() => {
          if (socket?.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) socket.send("ping");
        }, 30_000);
      };

      socket.onmessage = (event) => {
        try {
          const payload = JSON.parse(event.data) as { type?: string };
          const type = payload.type || "update";
          if (type === "pong" || type === "connected") return;
          setLastEvent({ type, at: Date.now() });
          queryClient.invalidateQueries({
            predicate: (query) =>
              query.queryKey[1] === tripId ||
              query.queryKey[0] === "trips" ||
              query.queryKey[0] === "notifications",
          });
        } catch {
          /* ignore malformed frames */
        }
      };

      socket.onclose = () => {
        window.clearInterval(heartbeat);
        if (disposed) return;
        setStatus("closed");
        retry.current = Math.min(retry.current + 1, 5);
        reconnect = window.setTimeout(connect, 1500 * retry.current);
      };

      socket.onerror = () => {
        socket?.close();
      };
    };

    connect();
    return () => {
      disposed = true;
      window.clearInterval(heartbeat);
      window.clearTimeout(reconnect);
      socket?.close();
      setStatus("idle");
    };
  }, [tripId, queryClient]);

  return { status, lastEvent };
}

@router.post("/ws-ticket")
def ws_ticket(
    request: Request,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials | None = Depends(bearer),
):
    from app.core.deps import _token_from_request

    token, _ = _token_from_request(request, credentials)
    payload = decode_access_token(token or "")
    session_id = payload.get("sid") if payload else None
    if not session_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Sign in again to open live updates")
    return {"ticket": create_ws_ticket(user.id, session_id), "expires_in": 120}

import 'package:dio/dio.dart';
import 'package:dio_cookie_manager/dio_cookie_manager.dart';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../storage/json_store.dart';
import 'api_exception.dart';
import 'browser_credentials_stub.dart'
    if (dart.library.js_interop) 'browser_credentials_web.dart';
import 'cookie_jar.dart';

const _unsafeMethods = {'POST', 'PUT', 'PATCH', 'DELETE'};

class ApiClient {
  ApiClient({
    required this.baseUrl,
    required SafarCookieJar jar,
    required JsonStore store,
    this.onUnauthorized,
  }) : _jar = jar,
       _store = store {
    dio = Dio(
      BaseOptions(
        baseUrl: baseUrl,
        connectTimeout: const Duration(seconds: 12),
        receiveTimeout: const Duration(seconds: 45),
        sendTimeout: const Duration(seconds: 30),
        contentType: Headers.jsonContentType,
        responseType: ResponseType.json,
        headers: const {'Accept': 'application/json'},
      ),
    );
    if (!kIsWeb) {
      // Native clients need a persistent jar so the HttpOnly refresh cookie
      // survives restarts. Browsers own cookies for the web verification build.
      dio.interceptors.add(CookieManager(_jar));
    } else {
      enableBrowserCredentials(dio);
    }
    dio.interceptors.add(_AuthInterceptor(this));
  }

  final String baseUrl;
  final SafarCookieJar _jar;
  // ignore: unused_field
  final JsonStore _store;
  late final Dio dio;

  String? accessToken;
  String? csrfToken;
  void Function()? onUnauthorized;

  Future<bool>? _refreshInFlight;

  bool get hasSession => accessToken != null;

  Future<bool> refreshSession() {
    return _refreshInFlight ??= _refresh().whenComplete(() {
      _refreshInFlight = null;
    });
  }

  Future<bool> _refresh() async {
    try {
      final response = await dio.post<dynamic>(
        '/api/auth/refresh',
        options: Options(extra: const {'skipAuth': true}),
      );
      final data = response.data;
      if (data is! Map) return false;
      final access = data['access_token'];
      final csrf = data['csrf_token'];
      if (access is! String || access.isEmpty) return false;
      accessToken = access;
      csrfToken = csrf is String ? csrf : null;
      return true;
    } on DioException catch (error) {
      final status = error.response?.statusCode;
      if (status == 401 || status == 403) {
        await clearSession();
        return false;
      }
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  Future<void> clearSession() async {
    accessToken = null;
    csrfToken = null;
    await _jar.deleteAll();
  }

  void notifyUnauthorized() {
    onUnauthorized?.call();
  }

  Future<dynamic> get(
    String path, {
    Map<String, dynamic>? query,
    bool raw = false,
  }) => _request('GET', path, query: query, raw: raw);

  Future<dynamic> post(
    String path, {
    Object? data,
    Map<String, dynamic>? query,
    bool raw = false,
  }) => _request('POST', path, data: data, query: query, raw: raw);

  Future<dynamic> put(
    String path, {
    Object? data,
    Map<String, dynamic>? query,
  }) => _request('PUT', path, data: data, query: query);

  Future<dynamic> patch(
    String path, {
    Object? data,
    Map<String, dynamic>? query,
  }) => _request('PATCH', path, data: data, query: query);

#### Thinking

Now design Flutter WS layer:

1. Add `web_socket_channel` dependency (check pubspec whether present).
2. Create `lib/core/network/trip_socket.dart`:
   - `TripSocket` class managing connect with ticket fetch via ApiClient post '/api/auth/ws-ticket', url derived from baseUrl (http->ws, https->wss), query token.
   - Exponential backoff with jitter/cap; heartbeat ping every 30s; parse frames `event`/`at`/data; expose `Stream<TripEvent>` broadcast; dedupe consecutive identical events (event+proposal_id+at?) — requirement dedupe. Use last-seen event signature set of recent ids with timestamps.
   - Lifecycle: app paused → disconnect; resumed → reconnect. Session-bound: close on auth sign-out.
   - Do not log tokens.
3. Provider: `tripSocketProvider.family` AutoDispose + connection state notifier. Better: a `TripRealtimeController` ChangeNotifier/StateNotifier keyed by tripId, started when TripShell mounts. On event: invalidate relevant Riverpod providers:
   - itinerary.updated/proposal.* → itineraryProvider, proposalsProvider, tripProvider, nextActionProvider, cost impact etc.
   - proposal.voted → proposalsProvider + votes
   - expenses.updated → expensesProvider, balancesProvider, settlementProvider
   - member.* → membersProvider, tripProvider
   - trip.updated → tripProvider, tripsProvider
   - engine.updated → engine runs providers / itinerary
   - pulse.updated → pulseProvider
   - default → invalidate trip-scoped providers broadly (mirror web: invalidate trip queries + trips + notifications).
4. UI: a status indicator in trip shell (Live chip / reconnecting). Need to find the shell screen. Also expose last event to show subtle "Updated by X".
5. Tests: unit test parsing/backoff/dedupe without network? Maybe make `buildWsUrl` and `_backoffDelay` pure functions testable.

  @override
  int get hashCode => Object.hash(
    destinationId,
    query,
    lens,
    maxBudget,
    indoor,
    accessible,
    tags,
    limit,
  );
}

class TripOverviewScreen extends ConsumerWidget {
  const TripOverviewScreen({super.key, required this.tripId});

  final String tripId;

  Future<void> _refresh(WidgetRef ref) async {
    ref.invalidate(tripProvider(tripId));
    ref.invalidate(membersProvider(tripId));
    ref.invalidate(itineraryProvider(tripId));
    ref.invalidate(engineProvider(tripId));
    ref.invalidate(expensesProvider(tripId));
    ref.invalidate(pulseProvider(tripId));
    try {
      await ref.read(tripProvider(tripId).future);
    } on Object {
      // AsyncView renders failures.
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final palette = context.safar;
    final trip = ref.watch(tripProvider(tripId));
    final members = ref.watch(membersProvider(tripId));
    final itinerary = ref.watch(itineraryProvider(tripId));
    final engine = ref.watch(engineProvider(tripId));
    final expenses = ref.watch(expensesProvider(tripId));

    return Scaffold(
      body: AsyncView(
        value: trip,
        onRetry: () => ref.invalidate(tripProvider(tripId)),

#### Thinking

Trip routes are individual screens pushed on root navigator; no persistent trip shell. So live socket should be scoped per-screen or app-level keyed by current trip. Best approach: a reusable `TripLive` widget (ConsumerStatefulWidget) that mounts on the trip overview and maybe itinerary/proposals/expenses/pulse screens — but mounting many would create multiple sockets. Instead, a provider-based singleton: `tripRealtimeProvider` = StateNotifierProvider.family keyed by tripId, ref-counted? Riverpod family notifier stays alive while listened. Screens can `ref.watch(tripRealtimeProvider(tripId))` for status; the notifier connects while at least one listener exists, disconnects on autoDispose.

```dart
String tripSocketUrl({required String apiBaseUrl, required String tripId, required String ticket}) {
  var base = apiBaseUrl;
  if (base.startsWith('https://')) base = 'wss://${base.substring(8)}';
  else if (base.startsWith('http://')) base = 'ws://${base.substring(7)}';
  else if (!base.startsWith('ws')) base = 'ws://$base';
  return '$base/ws/trips/$tripId?token=${Uri.encodeComponent(ticket)}';
}

Duration realtimeBackoff(int attempt) {
  const steps = [1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 30];
  return Duration(seconds: steps[attempt.clamp(0, steps.length - 1)]);
}
```

Future<dynamic> delete(
    String path, {
    Object? data,
    Map<String, dynamic>? query,
  }) => _request('DELETE', path, data: data, query: query);

  Future<dynamic> _request(
    String method,
    String path, {
    Object? data,
    Map<String, dynamic>? query,
    bool raw = false,
  }) async {
    try {
      final response = await dio.request<dynamic>(
        path,
        data: data,
        queryParameters: query,
        options: Options(method: method),
      );
      if (raw) return response.data;
      return response.data;
    } on DioException catch (error) {
      throw ApiException.fromDio(error);
    }
  }

  /// Absolute URL for seeded imagery and locally issued media paths.
  String mediaUrl(String? raw) {
    if (raw == null || raw.trim().isEmpty) return '';
    final value = raw.trim();
    if (value.startsWith('http://') || value.startsWith('https://')) {
      return value;
    }
    return value.startsWith('/') ? '$baseUrl$value' : '$baseUrl/$value';
  }
}

class _AuthInterceptor extends Interceptor {
  _AuthInterceptor(this.client);

  final ApiClient client;

  @override
  void onRequest(RequestOptions options, RequestInterceptorHandler handler) {
    if (options.extra['skipAuth'] != true) {
      final token = client.accessToken;
      if (token != null && token.isNotEmpty) {
        options.headers['Authorization'] = 'Bearer $token';
      }
      final csrf = client.csrfToken;
      if (_unsafeMethods.contains(options.method.toUpperCase()) &&
          csrf != null &&
          csrf.isNotEmpty) {
        options.headers['X-CSRF-Token'] = csrf;
      }
    }
    handler.next(options);
  }

  @override
  Future<void> onError(
    DioException err,
    ErrorInterceptorHandler handler,
  ) async {
    final options = err.requestOptions;
    final status = err.response?.statusCode;
    final isAuthPath = options.path.startsWith('/api/auth/');
    final retried = options.extra['retried'] == true;
    if (status == 401 && !retried && !isAuthPath) {
      try {
        final refreshed = await client.refreshSession();
        if (refreshed) {
          final headers = Map<String, dynamic>.from(options.headers);
          final token = client.accessToken;
          if (token != null) headers['Authorization'] = 'Bearer $token';
          final csrf = client.csrfToken;
          if (_unsafeMethods.contains(options.method.toUpperCase()) &&
              csrf != null) {
            headers['X-CSRF-Token'] = csrf;
          }
          final retryOptions = options.copyWith(
            headers: headers,
            extra: {...options.extra, 'retried': true},
          );
          final response = await client.dio.fetch<dynamic>(retryOptions);
          return handler.resolve(response);
        }
        client.notifyUnauthorized();
      } on Object {
        // A network failure while refreshing must not sign the user out.
      }
    }
    handler.next(err);
  }
}

```dart
class TripEvent {

  String get actor => (data['by'] ?? data['voter'] ?? data['display_name'] ?? '') as String? ?? '';

  static TripEvent? tryParse(Object? raw) {
    if (raw is! String) return null;
    Object? decoded;
    try { decoded = jsonDecode(raw); } catch (_) { return null; }
    if (decoded is! Map) return null;
    final event = decoded['event'];
    if (event is! String || event.isEmpty) return null;
    return TripEvent(event: event, at: '${decoded['at'] ?? ''}', data: Map<String,dynamic>.from(decoded));
  }
}
```

```dart
  bool get everLive => _everLive;
  void Function(RealtimeStatus status, {bool reconnected})? onStatus;
  void Function(bool reconnected)? onCatchUp; // reconcile after reconnect

    if (_running) return;
    _running = true;
    _attempt = 0;
```

Frame handler:
```dart
void _onFrame(dynamic raw) {
  final event = TripEvent.tryParse(raw);
  if (event == null) return;
  if (event.event == 'pong' || event.event == 'connected') return;
  final key = [event.event, event.at, event.data['proposal_id'], event.data['member_id'], event.data['voter']].join('|');
  if (_recent.contains(key)) return;
  _recent.add(key);
  if (_recent.length > 50) _recent.removeAt(0);
  if (!_controller.isClosed) _controller.add(event);
}
```

On drop:
```dart
void _onDrop() {
  if (!_running) return;
  _teardown();
  _set(_everLive ? RealtimeStatus.reconnecting : RealtimeStatus.connecting);
  final delay = realtimeBackoff(_attempt);
  _attempt += 1;
  _retry?.cancel();
  _retry = Timer(delay, _connect);
}
```

```dart
}
```

@router.post("/{trip_id}/media", status_code=201)
async def upload_media(
    trip_id: str,
    file: UploadFile = File(...),
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    suffix = ALLOWED_MEDIA.get(file.content_type or "")
    if not suffix:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=415,
            detail="Supported media: JPEG, PNG, WebP, MP4, WebM audio, MP3, OGG, WAV.",
        )
    target_dir = MEDIA_ROOT / trip.id
    target_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    filename = f"{uuid.uuid4().hex}{suffix}"
    path = target_dir / filename
    size = 0
    head = await file.read(64)
    if not media_matches_type(file.content_type, head):
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=415,
            detail="The uploaded file does not match its declared media type.",
        )
    with path.open("wb") as handle:
        chunk = head
        while chunk:
            size += len(chunk)
            if size > MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES:
                handle.close()
                path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
                raise HTTPException(status_code=413, detail="Media files are limited to 25 MB.")
            handle.write(chunk)
            chunk = await file.read(1024 * 1024)
    audit(
        db,
        action="media.upload",
        entity_type="trip",

import '../models/json.dart';
import '../models/memories.dart';
import '../models/monitoring.dart';
import '../network/api_client.dart';

class MemoryRepository {
  MemoryRepository(this._api);

  final ApiClient _api;

  Future<MemoriesResponse> list(String tripId) async =>
      MemoriesResponse.fromJson(
        jsonMap(await _api.get('/api/trips/$tripId/memories')),
      );

  Future<Memory> create(
    String tripId, {
    required String text,
    String visibility = 'trip',
    String kind = 'text',
    String? caption,
  }) async => Memory.fromJson(
    jsonMap(
      await _api.post(
        '/api/trips/$tripId/memories',
        data: {
          'kind': kind,
          'text_content': text,
          'visibility': visibility,
          if (caption != null && caption.isNotEmpty) 'caption': caption,
        },
      ),
    ),
  );

  Future<void> update(
    String tripId,
    String memoryId,
    Map<String, dynamic> changes,
  ) async {
    await _api.patch('/api/trips/$tripId/memories/$memoryId', data: changes);
  }

  Future<void> delete(String tripId, String memoryId) async {
    await _api.delete('/api/trips/$tripId/memories/$memoryId');
  }

  Future<Studio> studio(String tripId) async =>
      Studio.fromJson(jsonMap(await _api.get('/api/trips/$tripId/memory-studio')));

  Future<List<StudioEvent>> suggestEvents(String tripId) async {
    final data = jsonMap(
      await _api.post('/api/trips/$tripId/memory-studio/suggest-events'),
    );
    return jsonObjects(data['created'], StudioEvent.fromJson);
  }

  Future<void> approveEvent(String tripId, String eventId) async {
    await _api.post('/api/trips/$tripId/memory-events/$eventId/approve');
  }

  Future<ReplayResponse> replay(String tripId) async =>
      ReplayResponse.fromJson(
        jsonMap(await _api.get('/api/trips/$tripId/replay')),
      );

  Future<String> travelBook(String tripId) async =>
      (await _api.get('/api/trips/$tripId/travel-book', raw: true)).toString();

  Future<OfflineSnapshot> offlineSnapshot(String tripId) async =>
      OfflineSnapshot.fromJson(
        jsonMap(await _api.get('/api/trips/$tripId/offline')),
      );

  Future<List<SyncQueueEntry>> syncQueue(String tripId) async {
    final data = await _api.get('/api/trips/$tripId/sync');
    final raw = data is Map ? data['items'] : data;
    return jsonObjects(raw, SyncQueueEntry.fromJson);
  }

  Future<SyncOutcome> sync(String tripId, List<Map<String, dynamic>> items) async =>
      SyncOutcome.fromJson(
        jsonMap(await _api.post('/api/trips/$tripId/sync', data: items)),
      );
}

@router.post("/{trip_id}/invitations", status_code=201)
def create_invitation(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: InviteCreate,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, member = _trip(db, trip_id, user, {"owner", "admin"})
    token = secrets.token_urlsafe(24)
    invitation = TripInvitation(
        trip_id=trip.id,
        token=token,
        email=str(payload.email).lower() if payload.email else None,
        role=payload.role,
        scope=payload.scope,
        created_by=user.id,
        expires_at=utcnow() + timedelta(days=payload.expires_in_days),
    )
    db.add(invitation)
    audit(
        db,
        action="invitation.create",
        entity_type="trip_invitation",
        entity_id=invitation.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
        detail={"role": payload.role, "scope": payload.scope},
    )
    db.commit()
    data = invitation_out(invitation, trip)
    data["path"] = f"/invite/{token}"
    return data


@router.get("/{trip_id}/invitations")
def list_invitations(
    trip_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user, {"owner", "admin"})
    rows = (
        db.query(TripInvitation)
        .filter(TripInvitation.trip_id == trip.id)
        .order_by(TripInvitation.created_at.desc())
        .all()
    )
    now = utcnow()
    items = []
    for row in rows:
        data = invitation_out(row, trip)
        data["expired"] = bool(row.expires_at and row.expires_at < now)
        items.append(data)
    return {"items": items}
