@invitations_router.get("/{token}")
def preview_invitation(
    token: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    set_context(db, app_invitation_token=token)
    invitation = (
        db.query(TripInvitation).filter(TripInvitation.token == token).first()
    )
    if not invitation:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Invitation not found")
    now = utcnow()
    if invitation.expires_at and invitation.expires_at < now:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=410, detail="This invitation has expired")
    trip = db.get(Trip, invitation.trip_id)
    if not trip or trip.deleted_at:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Trip not available")
    with system_context(db):
        member_count = (
            db.query(TripMember)
            .filter(TripMember.trip_id == trip.id, TripMember.status == "active")
            .count()
        )
    return {
        "trip": {
            "id": trip.id,
            "name": trip.name,
            "destination_name": trip.destination_name,
            "start_date": trip.start_date,
            "end_date": trip.end_date,
            "group_size": trip.group_size,
            "member_count": member_count,
        },
        "role": invitation.role,
        "scope": invitation.scope,
        "invited_by": db.get(User, invitation.created_by).display_name if db.get(User, invitation.created_by) else None,
        "expires_at": invitation.expires_at,
        "already_member": _active_member(db, trip.id, user.id) is not None,
        "accepted": invitation.accepted_at is not None,
        "accepted_by_you": invitation.accepted_by == user.id,
        "email_bound": invitation.email is not None,
    }

- Verify its package ID and version.
- Install it on the running emulator.
- Launch SAFAR.
- Capture startup logs and check for crashes.
- Verify API connectivity and login.
- Test session persistence and logout.

## 2. Complete Android Builds

Generate and verify:
- Debug APK.
- Release APK.
- Release Android App Bundle.

Verify release signing and network security.

Do not expose or commit signing credentials.

## 3. Test the Application on Emulator

Exercise the actual screens and interactions:

- Login and registration.
- Dashboard.
- Discover.
- Trip creation.
- Itinerary editing.
- Group Experience Engine.
- Voting.
- Expenses.
- Memories and photo upload.
- AI assistant.
- Trip Twin.
- Journey Negotiator.
- Journey Pact.
- Plan Intelligence.
- Opportunity Clock.
- Branches.
- Travel Circles.
- Missions.
- Tasks.
- Watch.
- Companions.
- Nearby.
- Offline Capture.

Test Android back navigation, keyboard behaviour, app restart and network failures.

Fix any issues discovered.

## 4. Complete F04 and F10

F04:
- Invitations.
- Role changes.
- Member removal.

F10:
- Map tiles.
- Pan and zoom.
- Markers.
- Route visualisation.
- Offline and loading states.

Keep location sharing consent-based.

If external provider credentials are needed, document them instead of inventing them.

## 5. Verify Native Functionality

Test:
- Camera.
- Gallery.
- Native sharing.
- Deep links.
- Location permissions.
- Notification permissions.
- WebSocket reconnection.
- Offline queue persistence.
- Offline sync after reconnecting.

## 6. Testing

Run Flutter analysis, all Flutter tests, backend pytest and Android build checks.

Add widget tests for major screens and test important navigation and error flows.

Do not count skipped tests as passed.

## 7. Final Report

Report exact evidence for:
- APK paths and file sizes.
- Release build result.
- AAB result.
- Emulator installation and launch.
- Screens and interactions tested.
- F04 and F10 status.
- Native capabilities.
- Test totals.
- Remaining limitations.

Do not claim a feature was tested if only its code was inspected.

Continue until all achievable Phase 10 deliverables are complete.

1	/// Maps an incoming link to a SAFAR route.
2	///
3	/// Supported forms:
4	/// - `safar://companion/<token>` (custom scheme registered by the app)
5	/// - `https://<any-host>/companion/<token>` (universal/app link when a
6	///   deployment verifies its own domain)
7	///
8	/// The companion token is the only credential, so any host may forward to it.
9	String? companionPathFromUri(Uri uri) {
10	  final segments = uri.pathSegments.where((part) => part.isNotEmpty).toList();
11	  if (uri.scheme == 'safar' && uri.host == 'companion') {
12	    if (segments.length == 1) return '/companion/${segments.first}';
13	    return null;
14	  }
15	  if (uri.scheme == 'http' || uri.scheme == 'https') {
16	    if (segments.length == 2 && segments.first == 'companion') {
17	      return '/companion/${segments[1]}';
18	    }
19	  }
20	  return null;
21	}

#### Thinking

Plan for F04 routing:
- Add route `/trips/:tripId/members` (MembersScreen) and `/invite/:token` (InvitationScreen, root navigator).
- Redirect: `/invite/...` requires signed-in. If not signed in, router redirects to /login and loses target. Need pending-invite handling:
  - In `_handleLink`, save pending path in a provider (`pendingDeepLinkProvider` StateProvider<String?>); then attempt `router.go(path)`; redirect to /login happens; after login, LoginScreen currently probably `context.go('/dashboard')`. We can make the redirect logic: if signedIn && onAuthPage → go to pending path if set, else /dashboard. Implement: in redirect, when signedIn and onAuthPage/atSplash/onOnboarding → return pendingPath ?? '/dashboard', and clear pending on consumption? Redirect must be pure-ish; reading and clearing a provider inside redirect is not ideal but acceptable if we clear via `ref.read(pendingDeepLinkProvider.notifier).state = null` after reading... that triggers notifyListeners only if state changes → could loop. Use a plain non-reactive holder (class PendingLinkNotifier with field) to avoid loops.

Simpler: store pending invite token as a plain static/global object (PendingInviteStore) consulted by redirect; clear when route is consumed by the InvitationScreen build (post-frame) or when redirect returns it once. Implement:

```dart
class PendingRoute {
  static String? value;
}
```

def member_out(db: Session, member: TripMember, viewer_id: str | None = None) -> dict:
    user = db.get(User, member.user_id) if member.user_id else None
    is_self = member.user_id == viewer_id
    data = {
        "id": member.id,
        "user": user_public(user),
        "display_name": user.display_name if user else (member.display_name or "Guest"),
        "role": member.role,
        "status": member.status,
        "joined_at": member.joined_at,
        "is_self": is_self,
    }
    # Budget limits and accessibility needs are private by default. They are
    # only surfaced back to their owner (F04/F32 privacy rule).
    if is_self:
        data["budget_limit"] = member.budget_limit
        data["accessibility_needs"] = member.accessibility_needs or []
    return data


def invitation_out(invitation: TripInvitation, trip: Trip | None = None) -> dict:
    return {
        "id": invitation.id,
        "token": invitation.token,
        "email": invitation.email,
        "role": invitation.role,
        "scope": invitation.scope,
        "expires_at": invitation.expires_at,
        "accepted_at": invitation.accepted_at,
        "created_at": invitation.created_at,
        "trip": {"id": trip.id, "name": trip.name} if trip else None,
    }

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';

import 'package:safar_mobile/core/theme/safar_theme.dart';
import 'package:safar_mobile/features/auth/login_screen.dart';

Widget _wrap(Widget child) => ProviderScope(
  child: MaterialApp(theme: SafarTheme.light(), home: child),
);

void main() {
  testWidgets('login form validates input before calling the API', (
    tester,
  ) async {
    await tester.pumpWidget(_wrap(const LoginScreen()));

    expect(find.text('Welcome back.'), findsOneWidget);
    expect(find.widgetWithText(FilledButton, 'Sign in'), findsOneWidget);

    await tester.enterText(find.byType(TextFormField).at(0), 'not-an-email');
    await tester.enterText(find.byType(TextFormField).at(1), '');
    await tester.tap(find.widgetWithText(FilledButton, 'Sign in'));
    await tester.pump();

    expect(find.text('Enter a valid email address'), findsOneWidget);
    expect(find.text('Enter your password'), findsOneWidget);
  });

  testWidgets('password field can be revealed and hidden', (tester) async {
    await tester.pumpWidget(_wrap(const LoginScreen()));

    EditableText field() => tester.widget<EditableText>(
      find.descendant(
        of: find.byType(TextFormField).at(1),
        matching: find.byType(EditableText),
      ),
    );

    expect(field().obscureText, isTrue);
    await tester.tap(find.byTooltip('Show password'));
    await tester.pump();
    expect(field().obscureText, isFalse);
    await tester.tap(find.byTooltip('Hide password'));
    await tester.pump();
    expect(field().obscureText, isTrue);
  });

  testWidgets('registration form asks for name, email and password', (
    tester,
  ) async {
    await tester.pumpWidget(_wrap(const RegisterScreen()));

    expect(find.text('Start a private trip.'), findsOneWidget);
    expect(find.text('Display name'), findsOneWidget);
    expect(find.text('Email'), findsOneWidget);
    expect(find.text('Password'), findsOneWidget);
  });
}

5	/// Builds a shareable absolute link from an API-issued path such as
6	/// `/companion/{token}`. Returns null when no public web origin is configured.
7	String? absoluteWebLink(String path) {
8	  final base = Env.webBaseUrl;
9	  if (base == null || base.isEmpty) return null;
10	  final trimmed = path.trim();
11	  if (trimmed.startsWith('http://') || trimmed.startsWith('https://')) {
12	    return trimmed;
13	  }
14	  return trimmed.startsWith('/') ? '$base$trimmed' : '$base/$trimmed';
15	}
16	
17	/// Opens the platform share sheet. Returns false when sharing is unavailable
18	/// on this platform so callers can fall back to copying the link.
19	Future<bool> shareLink({

24	  try {

29	      ),
30	    );

32	  } on Object {
33	    return false;
34	  }

class StatusChip extends StatelessWidget {
  const StatusChip(this.label, {super.key, this.tone = ChipTone.neutral, this.icon});

  final String label;
  final ChipTone tone;
  final IconData? icon;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final palette = context.safar;
    final (bg, fg) = switch (tone) {
      ChipTone.neutral => (palette.raised, palette.muted),
      ChipTone.ember => (palette.emberSoft, palette.ember),
      ChipTone.jade => (palette.jadeSoft, palette.jade),
      ChipTone.rose => (
        palette.rose.withValues(alpha: 0.12),
        palette.rose,
      ),
    };
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 9, vertical: 5),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: bg,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
        border: Border.all(color: fg.withValues(alpha: 0.25)),
      ),
      child: Row(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        children: [
          if (icon != null) ...[
            Icon(icon, size: 12, color: fg),
            const SizedBox(width: 4),
          ],
          Text(
            titleCaseLabel(label),
            style: TextStyle(
              fontSize: 11,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
              color: fg,
              letterSpacing: 0.1,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
class AsyncView<T> extends StatelessWidget {
  const AsyncView({
    super.key,
    required this.value,
    required this.builder,
    this.onRetry,
    this.skeleton,
    this.padding,
  });

  final AsyncValue<T> value;
  final Widget Function(T data) builder;
  final VoidCallback? onRetry;
  final Widget? skeleton;
  final EdgeInsetsGeometry? padding;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return value.when(
      data: builder,
      loading: () => padding == null
          ? (skeleton ?? const SkeletonList())
          : Padding(padding: padding!, child: skeleton ?? const SkeletonList()),
      error: (error, stack) => Padding(
        padding: padding ?? EdgeInsets.zero,
        child: SafarErrorView(
          message: error.toString(),
          onRetry: onRetry,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class SafarSheetHeader extends StatelessWidget {
  const SafarSheetHeader({super.key, required this.title, this.subtitle});

  final String title;
  final String? subtitle;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 16),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Text(title, style: context.texts.headlineSmall),
          if (subtitle != null) ...[
            const SizedBox(height: 4),
            Text(subtitle!, style: context.texts.bodySmall),
          ],
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

Future<T?> showSafarSheet<T>(
  BuildContext context, {
  required WidgetBuilder builder,
  bool isScrollControlled = true,
}) {
  return showModalBottomSheet<T>(
    context: context,
    isScrollControlled: isScrollControlled,
    builder: (context) => Padding(
      padding: EdgeInsets.only(
        left: 20,
        right: 20,
        top: 4,
        bottom: MediaQuery.of(context).viewInsets.bottom + 24,
      ),
      child: builder(context),
    ),
  );
}

Implementation details for pending:
In router.dart define:
```dart
class PendingRoute {
  static String? value;
}
```
Maybe better in deep_links.dart? Router needs it; app.dart writes it. Put in `lib/core/native/pending_route.dart`.

Redirect logic:
```dart
if (atSplash || onOnboarding || onAuthPage) {
  final pending = PendingRoute.take();
  return pending ?? '/dashboard';
}
```
But careful: if onboarding not seen, redirect to /welcome; user completes onboarding → /login; signs in → pending consumed. Good. If the user is already signed in and opens link → location is /invite/..., redirect returns null (signed in, not auth page) → InvitationScreen shows. Good.

But if app is signed out and link opens: `_handleLink` sets pending then router.go('/invite/x') → redirect sees not signedIn → returns '/login'; pending stays. After login → redirect pending consumed → '/invite/x'. 

Edge: user abandons login and later goes to app normally — pending would still redirect them to the invite after sign-in. That's acceptable (they opened an invite). But if the invite is expired, screen shows expired.

Also `redirect` is called on every auth refresh; consuming pending in redirect is fine because the routing decision happens once per redirect and it navigates immediately.

Risk: redirect may be called twice (for the same navigation), causing the second call to return '/dashboard' — no, once it returns '/invite/x', GoRouter navigates; new redirect for '/invite/x' returns null (signed in). Fine.

```json
  "content": "/// Maps an incoming link to a SAFAR route.\n///\n/// Supported forms:\n/// - `safar://companion/<token>` (custom scheme registered by the app)\n/// - `safar://invite/<token>` (trip invitation, single use)\n/// - `https://<any-host>/companion/<token>` (universal/app link when a\n///   deployment verifies its own domain)\n/// - `https://<any-host>/invite/<token>` (the web fallback pages)\n///\n/// The companion token is the only credential, so any host may forward to it.\nString? companionPathFromUri(Uri uri) {\n  final segments = uri.pathSegments.where((part) => part.isNotEmpty).toList();\n  if (uri.scheme == 'safar' && uri.host == 'companion') {\n    if (segments.length == 1) return '/companion/${segments.first}';\n    return null;\n  }\n  if (uri.scheme == 'http' || uri.scheme == 'https') {\n    if (segments.length == 2 && segments.first == 'companion') {\n      return '/companion/${segments[1]}';\n    }\n  }\n  return null;\n}\n\nString? invitationPathFromUri(Uri uri) {\n  final segments = uri.pathSegments.where((part) => part.isNotEmpty).toList();\n  if (uri.scheme == 'safar' && (uri.host == 'invite' || uri.host == 'invitation')) {\n    if (segments.isEmpty) return null;\n    return '/invite/${segments.first}';\n  }\n  if (uri.scheme == 'http' || uri.scheme == 'https') {\n    if (segments.length == 2 && segments.first == 'invite') {\n      return '/invite/${segments[1]}';\n    }\n  }\n  return null;\n}\n\n/// Resolves any supported SAFAR link to an in-app route.\nString? appPathFromUri(Uri uri) =>\n    companionPathFromUri(uri) ?? invitationPathFromUri(uri);\n",
```

```dart
  static String? _value;
  static void set(String path) => _value = path;
  static String? take(String? fallback) { final v = _value; _value = null; return v ?? fallback; }
  static void clear() => _value = null;
}
```

343	  List<_RoutePoint> _routePoints(Itinerary? itinerary) {
344	    if (itinerary == null) return const [];
345	    final items = itinerary.items
346	        .where((item) => !item.cancelled && item.activity?.place != null)
347	        .toList()
348	      ..sort((a, b) {
349	        final byDay = a.day.compareTo(b.day);
350	        return byDay != 0 ? byDay : a.startTime.compareTo(b.startTime);
351	      });
352	    return [
353	      for (final item in items)
354	        (
355	          lat: item.activity!.place!.lat,
356	          lon: item.activity!.place!.lon,
357	          title: item.title,
358	        ),
359	    ];
360	  }
361	}

363	class _RelativeMap extends StatelessWidget {
364	  const _RelativeMap({
365	    required this.base,
366	    required this.radiusKm,
367	    required this.items,
368	    required this.route,
369	    required this.selectedId,
370	    required this.onSelect,

380	  double get _maxKm {
381	    var maxKm = radiusKm;
382	    for (final point in route) {
383	      final extent = _kmOffset(base, point.lat, point.lon);
384	      maxKm = math.max(maxKm, math.max(extent.dx.abs(), extent.dy.abs()));
385	    }
386	    return maxKm <= 0 ? 1 : maxKm;
387	  }

400	            onTapUp: (details) {

404	                final place = item.activity.place;
405	                if (place == null) continue;
406	                final offset = _project(base, place.lat, place.lon, size, maxKm);
407	                final distance = (offset - details.localPosition).distance;
408	                if (distance < bestDistance) {

440	/// Straight-line kilometre offsets from the base, east (dx) and north (dy).
441	Offset _kmOffset(NearbyBase base, double lat, double lon) {
442	  final latKm = (lat - base.lat) * 111.32;
443	  final lonKm =
444	      (lon - base.lon) * 111.32 * math.cos(base.lat * math.pi / 180).abs();
445	  return Offset(lonKm, latKm);
446	}
447	
448	Offset _project(NearbyBase base, double lat, double lon, Size size, double maxKm) {
449	  final offset = _kmOffset(base, lat, lon);
450	  final half = size.shortestSide / 2 - 20;
451	  final scale = half / maxKm;
452	  return Offset(
453	    size.width / 2 + offset.dx * scale,
454	    size.height / 2 - offset.dy * scale,
455	  );
456	}
457	
458	class _MapPainter extends CustomPainter {
459	  const _MapPainter({
460	    required this.base,
461	    required this.radiusKm,
462	    required this.maxKm,
463	    required this.items,
464	    required this.route,
465	    required this.selectedId,
466	    required this.background,
467	    required this.ring,
468	    required this.ink,
469	    required this.muted,
470	    required this.jade,
471	    required this.ember,
472	    required this.surface,
473	  });
474	
475	  final NearbyBase base;
476	  final double radiusKm;
477	  final double maxKm;
478	  final List<NearbyItem> items;
479	  final List<_RoutePoint> route;
480	  final String? selectedId;
481	  final Color background;
482	  final Color ring;
483	  final Color ink;
484	  final Color muted;
485	  final Color jade;
486	  final Color ember;
487	  final Color surface;
488	
489	  @override
490	  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
491	    final center = Offset(size.width / 2, size.height / 2);
492	    final half = size.shortestSide / 2 - 20;
493	    final scale = half / maxKm;
494	
495	    final ringPaint = Paint()
496	      ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
497	      ..strokeWidth = 1
498	      ..color = ring;
499	    canvas.drawCircle(center, radiusKm * scale, ringPaint);
500	
501	    final ringLabel = TextPainter(
502	      text: TextSpan(
503	        text: '${radiusKm.toStringAsFixed(0)} km',
504	        style: TextStyle(fontSize: 10, color: muted),
505	      ),
506	      textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
507	    )..layout();
508	    ringLabel.paint(
509	      canvas,
510	      Offset(center.dx + 4, center.dy - radiusKm * scale - 14),
511	    );
512	
513	    if (route.length > 1) {
514	      final path = Path();
515	      for (var i = 0; i < route.length; i++) {
516	        final point = _project(base, route[i].lat, route[i].lon, size, maxKm);
517	        if (i == 0) {
518	          path.moveTo(point.dx, point.dy);
519	        } else {
520	          path.lineTo(point.dx, point.dy);
521	        }
522	      }
523	      canvas.drawPath(
524	        path,
525	        Paint()
526	          ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
527	          ..strokeWidth = 1.6
528	          ..color = ember.withValues(alpha: 0.55),
529	      );
530	      final routeDot = Paint()..color = ember;
531	      for (final stop in route) {
532	        canvas.drawCircle(
533	          _project(base, stop.lat, stop.lon, size, maxKm),
534	          2.6,
535	          routeDot,
536	        );
537	      }
538	    }
539	
540	    final basePaint = Paint()..color = ember;
541	    canvas.drawCircle(center, 4, basePaint);
542	    canvas.drawCircle(
543	      center,
544	      9,
545	      Paint()
546	        ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
547	        ..strokeWidth = 1.2
548	        ..color = ember.withValues(alpha: 0.5),
549	    );
550	
551	    String? selectedName;
552	    Offset? selectedOffset;
553	    final dotPaint = Paint()..color = jade;
554	    for (final item in items) {
555	      final place = item.activity.place;
556	      if (place == null) continue;
557	      final offset = _project(base, place.lat, place.lon, size, maxKm);
558	      if (item.activity.id == selectedId) {
559	        selectedName = item.activity.name;
560	        selectedOffset = offset;
561	        canvas.drawCircle(offset, 8, Paint()..color = surface);
562	        canvas.drawCircle(
563	          offset,
564	          8,
565	          Paint()
566	            ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
567	            ..strokeWidth = 1.6
568	            ..color = ink,
569	        );
570	      }
571	      canvas.drawCircle(offset, 3.4, dotPaint);
572	    }
573	
574	    if (selectedName != null && selectedOffset != null) {
575	      final label = TextPainter(
576	        text: TextSpan(
577	          text: selectedName,
578	          style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: ink, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
579	        ),
580	        textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,
581	        maxLines: 1,
582	        ellipsis: '…',
583	      )..layout(maxWidth: size.width - 24);
584	      final dx = (selectedOffset.dx - label.width / 2)
585	          .clamp(8.0, size.width - label.width - 8);
586	      final dy = (selectedOffset.dy + 12).clamp(8.0, size.height - 20);
587	      label.paint(canvas, Offset(dx, dy));
588	    }
589	  }
590	
591	  @override
592	  bool shouldRepaint(covariant _MapPainter oldDelegate) =>
593	      oldDelegate.selectedId != selectedId ||
594	      oldDelegate.radiusKm != radiusKm ||
595	      oldDelegate.items != items ||
596	      oldDelegate.route != route;
597	}

11	  static String get apiBaseUrl {
12	    final raw = _definedBaseUrl.trim();
13	    if (raw.isNotEmpty) {
14	      return raw.endsWith('/') ? raw.substring(0, raw.length - 1) : raw;
15	    }
16	    if (kDebugMode) {

```
onScaleStart: _startZoom = _zoom; _startCenter = _center; _startFocal = details.localFocalPoint; _lastScale = 1;
onScaleUpdate:
  final newZoom = (_startZoom + log(details.scale)/ln2).clamp(min, max);
  // keep the geo point under the initial focal point anchored
  final startWorld = project(_startCenter, _startZoom);
  final focalWorldAtStart = startWorld + (_startFocal - viewCenter)  (viewCenter = size/2)
  // geo of focal point:

  final newCenterWorld = newWorldFocal - (details.localFocalPoint - viewCenter);
  _center = unproject(newCenterWorld, newZoom);
  _zoom = newZoom;
```

```dart
}
```

Tile math:

```dart
const _tileSize = 256.0;
double _worldSize(int z) => _tileSize * (1 << z);
Offset _project(MapLatLng p, int z) {
  final n = _worldSize(z);
  final x = (p.lon + 180) / 360 * n;
  final sinLat = math.sin(p.lat * math.pi / 180).clamp(-0.9999, 0.9999);
  final y = (0.5 - math.log((1 + sinLat) / (1 - sinLat)) / (4 * math.pi)) * n;
  return Offset(x, y);
}
MapLatLng _unproject(Offset o, int z) {
  final n = _worldSize(z);
  final lon = o.dx / n * 360 - 180;
  final yNorm = o.dy / n;
  final lat = (2 * math.atan(math.exp((0.5 - yNorm) * 2 * math.pi)) - math.pi/2) * 180 / math.pi;
  return (lat: lat, lon: lon);
}
```

- delta = (tileWorld - centerWorld) * scale + centerScreen.

```dart
class MapTileConfig {
  const MapTileConfig({this.provider, this.note});
  final MapTileProvider? provider;
  final String? note;

  static MapTileConfig fromEnvironment() {
    const template = String.fromEnvironment('SAFAR_MAP_TILE_URL');
    const attribution = String.fromEnvironment('SAFAR_MAP_TILE_ATTRIBUTION');
    const minZoomRaw = String.fromEnvironment('SAFAR_MAP_TILE_MIN_ZOOM', defaultValue: '2');
    ...
    if (template.trim().isEmpty) {
      return const MapTileConfig(note: 'Set SAFAR_MAP_TILE_URL to a licensed {z}/{x}/{y} tile endpoint.');
    }
    final uri = Uri.tryParse(template...replace placeholders with 0?);
```

Uri.tryParse on a template with `{z}` may fail? `{` `}` are invalid in URIs but tryParse is lenient? Better replace placeholders with '0' for validation.

Check scheme: https always; http only kDebugMode. If https missing → note. Check host non-empty. Check placeholders present.

subdomains: `{s}` replaced round-robin by (x+y) % len.

Attribution fallback: if empty → host. Note that production should set license text.

Also `SAFAR_MAP_TILE_MAX_ZOOM` default 18, min 2. clamp.

Implementation:

```dart
@immutable
class MapTileProvider {
  const MapTileProvider({required this.urlTemplate, required this.attribution, required this.minZoom, required this.maxZoom, this.subdomains = const []});
  final String urlTemplate; ...
  String url(int z, int x, int y) {
    var out = urlTemplate.replaceAll('{z}', '$z').replaceAll('{x}', '$x').replaceAll('{y}', '$y');
    if (subdomains.isNotEmpty) out = out.replaceAll('{s}', subdomains[(x + y) % subdomains.length]);
    return out;
  }
}
```

Tile layer build:

```dart
Widget _buildTiles(Size size) {
  final z = _zoom.floor().clamp(min, max);
  final scale = math.pow(2.0, _zoom - z).toDouble();
  final tileSpan = _tileSize * scale;
  final centerWorld = _project(_center, z);
  final viewCenter = Offset(size.width/2, size.height/2);
  final n = 1 << z;
  final left = centerWorld.dx - size.width / 2 / scale;
  final right = centerWorld.dx + size.width / 2 / scale;
  final top = centerWorld.dy - size.height / 2 / scale;
  final bottom = centerWorld.dy + size.height / 2 / scale;
  final x0 = (left / _tileSize).floor();
  final x1 = (right / _tileSize).floor();
  final y0 = math.max(0, (top / _tileSize).floor());
  final y1 = math.min(n - 1, (bottom / _tileSize).floor());
  final children = <Widget>[];
  for (var x = x0; x <= x1; x++) {
    for (var y = y0; y <= y1; y++) {
      final wrapped = x % n; // Dart % gives non-negative for positive n
      final tileWorld = Offset(x * _tileSize, y * _tileSize);
      final pos = (tileWorld - centerWorld) * scale + viewCenter;
      children.add(Positioned(
        key: ValueKey('$z/$wrapped/$y'),
        left: pos.dx, top: pos.dy, width: tileSpan + 0.5, height: tileSpan + 0.5,
        child: _TileImage(...)
      ));
    }
  }
  // Guard count
  return Stack(children: children);
}
```

```json
  "content": "import 'dart:async';\nimport 'dart:math' as math;\n\nimport 'package:flutter/material.dart';\n\nimport '../native/map_tiles.dart';\nimport '../theme/safar_theme.dart';\n\ntypedef MapLatLng = ({double lat, double lon});\n\nclass SlippyMapMarker {\n  const SlippyMapMarker({\n    required this.id,\n    required this.lat,\n    required this.lon,\n    required this.label,\n    this.isAnchor = false,\n  });\n\n  final String id;\n  final double lat;\n  final double lon;\n  final String label;\n  final bool isAnchor;\n\n  MapLatLng get point => (lat: lat, lon: lon);\n}\n\n/// Web-Mercator slippy map with pan, pinch/double-tap zoom, tappable markers,\n/// a radius ring and a route overlay.\n///\n/// Tiles come from a [MapTileProvider] supplied at build time; SAFAR ships no\n/// tile endpoint. When a tile fails the widget keeps the pins and the route on\n/// a neutral grid so the screen stays usable offline.\nclass SlippyMap extends StatefulWidget {\n  const SlippyMap({\n    super.key,\n    required this.provider,\n    required this.center,\n    required this.markers,\n    this.route = const [],\n    this.radiusKm,\n    this.selectedId,\n    this.onMarkerTap,\n    this.onMapTap,\n    this.height = 320,\n  });\n\n  final MapTileProvider provider;\n\n  /// The shared trip base (or the user's consented position for this screen).\n  final MapLatLng center;\n  final List<SlippyMapMarker> markers;\n  final List<MapLatLng> route;\n  final double? radiusKm;\n  final String? selectedId;\n  final ValueChanged<SlippyMapMarker>? onMarkerTap;\n  final VoidCallback? onMapTap;\n  final double height;\n\n  @override\n  State<SlippyMap> createState() => _SlippyMapState();\n}\n\nconst double _tileSize = 256;\n\nOffset _project(MapLatLng point, int zoom) {\n  final world = _tileSize * (1 << zoom);\n  final lat = point.lat.clamp(-85.05112878, 85.05112878);\n  final sinLat = math.sin(lat * math.pi / 180);\n  final x = (point.lon + 180) / 360 * world;\n  final y =\n      (0.5 -\n          math.log((1 + sinLat) / (1 - sinLat)) / (4 * math.pi)) *\n      world;\n  return Offset(x, y);\n}\n\nMapLatLng _unproject(Offset offset, int zoom) {\n  final world = _tileSize * (1 << zoom);\n  final lon = offset.dx / world * 360 - 180;\n  final yNorm = offset.dy / world;\n  final lat =\n      (2 * math.atan(math.exp((0.5 - yNorm) * 2 * math.pi)) - math.pi / 2) *\n      180 /\n      math.pi;\n  return (lat: lat.clamp(-85.05112878, 85.05112878), lon: _wrapLon(lon));\n}\n\ndouble _wrapLon(double lon) {\n  var value = lon;\n  while (value > 180) {\n    value -= 360;\n  }\n  while (value < -180) {\n    value += 360;\n  }\n  return value;\n}\n\ndouble _metersPerPixel(double lat, double zoom) =>\n    156543.03392 * math.cos(lat.clamp(-85, 85) * math.pi / 180) /\n    math.pow(2, zoom);\n\nclass _SlippyMapState extends State<SlippyMap> {\n  double _zoom = 13;\n  late MapLatLng _center = widget.center;\n  bool _needsFit = true;\n  Size _size = Size.zero;\n\n  late MapLatLng _startCenter;\n  late double _startZoom;\n  late Offset _startFocal;\n\n  int _tileFrames = 0;\n  int _tileErrors = 0;\n  int _retryEpoch = 0;\n\n  int get _minZoom => widget.provider.minZoom;\n  int get _maxZoom => widget.provider.maxZoom;\n\n  int _tileZoom(double zoom) =>\n      zoom.floor().clamp(_minZoom, math.max(_minZoom, _maxZoom));\n\n  double _zoomScale(double zoom, int tileZoom) =>\n      math.pow(2.0, zoom - tileZoom).toDouble();\n\n  @override\n  void didUpdateWidget(covariant SlippyMap oldWidget) {\n    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);\n    if (oldWidget.center != widget.center ||\n        oldWidget.radiusKm != widget.radiusKm ||\n        oldWidget.provider.urlTemplate != widget.provider.urlTemplate) {\n      _needsFit = true;\n      _center = widget.center;\n      _tileFrames = 0;\n      _tileErrors = 0;\n    }\n  }\n\n  MapLatLng _geoAt(Offset local, Size size) {\n    final tileZoom = _tileZoom(_zoom);\n    final scale = _zoomScale(_zoom, tileZoom);\n    final world =\n        _project(_center, tileZoom) +\n        (local - Offset(size.width / 2, size.height / 2)) / scale;\n    return _unproject(world, tileZoom);\n  }\n\n  void _zoomAround(Offset local, double delta) {\n    if (_size == Size.zero) return;\n    final target = (_zoom + delta).clamp(\n      _minZoom.toDouble(),\n      _maxZoom.toDouble(),\n    );\n    if (target == _zoom) return;\n    final geo = _geoAt(local, _size);\n    final tileZoom = _tileZoom(target);\n    final scale = _zoomScale(target, tileZoom);\n    final world = _project(geo, tileZoom);\n    final centerWorld =\n        world - (local - Offset(_size.width / 2, _size.height / 2)) / scale;\n    setState(() {\n      _zoom = target;\n      _center = _unproject(centerWorld, tileZoom);\n    });\n  }\n\n  void _onScaleStart(ScaleStartDetails details) {\n    _startCenter = _center;\n    _startZoom = _zoom;\n    _startFocal = details.localFocalPoint;\n  }\n\n  void _onScaleUpdate(ScaleUpdateDetails details) {\n    if (_size == Size.zero) return;\n    final startTileZoom = _tileZoom(_startZoom);\n    final startScale = _zoomScale(_startZoom, startTileZoom);\n    final viewCenter = Offset(_size.width / 2, _size.height / 2);\n    final focalGeo = _unproject(\n      _project(_startCenter, startTileZoom) +\n          (_startFocal - viewCenter) / startScale,\n      startTileZoom,\n    );\n\n    final rawZoom =\n        _startZoom + math.log(details.scale) / math.ln2;\n    final zoom = rawZoom.clamp(_minZoom.toDouble(), _maxZoom.toDouble());\n    final tileZoom = _tileZoom(zoom);\n    final scale = _zoomScale(zoom, tileZoom);\n    final centerWorld =\n        _project(focalGeo, tileZoom) -\n        (details.localFocalPoint - viewCenter) / scale;\n\n    setState(() {\n      _zoom = zoom;\n      _center = _unproject(centerWorld, tileZoom);\n    });\n  }\n\n  void _fitToContent(Size size) {\n    var minLat = widget.center.lat;\n    var maxLat = widget.center.lat;\n    var minLon = widget.center.lon;\n    var maxLon = widget.center.lon;\n\n    void include(MapLatLng point) {\n      minLat = math.min(minLat, point.lat);\n      maxLat = math.max(maxLat, point.lat);\n      minLon = math.min(minLon, point.lon);\n      maxLon = math.max(maxLon, point.lon);\n    }\n\n    for (final marker in widget.markers) {\n      include(marker.point);\n    }\n    for (final point in widget.route) {\n      include(point);\n    }\n    final radius = widget.radiusKm;\n    if (radius != null && radius > 0) {\n      final dLat = radius / 111.32;\n      final cosLat = math\n          .cos(widget.center.lat * math.pi / 180)\n          .abs()\n          .clamp(0.1, 1.0);\n      final dLon = radius / (111.32 * cosLat);\n      minLat -= dLat;\n      maxLat += dLat;\n      minLon -= dLon;\n      maxLon += dLon;\n    }\n\n    final northWest = _project((lat: maxLat, lon: minLon), 0);\n    final southEast = _project((lat: minLat, lon: maxLon), 0);\n    final width = (southEast.dx - northWest.dx).abs();\n    final height = (southEast.dy - northWest.dy).abs();\n    final availableWidth = math.max(size.width - 64, 32.0);\n    final availableHeight = math.max(size.height - 96, 32.0);\n\n    double zoom;\n    if (width < 0.5 && height < 0.5) {\n      zoom = 14;\n    } else {\n      final scaleX = width < 0.5 ? double.infinity : availableWidth / width;\n      final scaleY = height < 0.5 ? double.infinity : availableHeight / height;\n      zoom = math.log(math.min(scaleX, scaleY)) / math.ln2;\n    }\n    _zoom = zoom.clamp(_minZoom.toDouble(), _maxZoom.toDouble());\n    _center = (\n      lat: (minLat + maxLat) / 2,\n      lon: _wrapLon((minLon + maxLon) / 2),\n    );\n  }\n\n  void _retryTiles() {\n    final urls = _visibleTileUrls(_size);\n    for (final url in urls) {\n      PaintingBinding.instance.imageCache.evict(NetworkImage(url));\n    }\n    setState(() {\n      _tileFrames = 0;\n      _tileErrors = 0;\n      _retryEpoch++;\n    });\n  }\n\n  List<String> _visibleTileUrls(Size size) {\n    if (size == Size.zero) return const [];\n    final z = _tileZoom(_zoom);\n    final scale = _zoomScale(_zoom, z);\n    final n = 1 << z;\n    final centerWorld = _project(_center, z);\n    final left = centerWorld.dx - size.width / 2 / scale;\n    final right = centerWorld.dx + size.width / 2 / scale;\n    final top = centerWorld.dy - size.height / 2 / scale;\n    final bottom = centerWorld.dy + size.height / 2 / scale;\n    final urls = <String>[];\n    final x0 = (left / _tileSize).floor();\n    final x1 = (right / _tileSize).floor();\n    final y0 = math.max(0, (top / _tileSize).floor());\n    final y1 = math.min(n - 1, (bottom / _tileSize).floor());\n    for (var x = x0; x <= x1; x++) {\n      for (var y = y0; y <= y1; y++) {\n        urls.add(widget.provider.url(z, x % n, y));\n      }\n    }\n    return urls;\n  }\n\n  Widget _tileLayer(Size size, Color placeholder) {\n    final z = _tileZoom(_zoom);\n    final scale = _zoomScale(_zoom, z);\n    final n = 1 << z;\n    final span = _tileSize * scale;\n    final centerWorld = _project(_center, z);\n    final viewCenter = Offset(size.width / 2, size.height / 2);\n\n    final left = centerWorld.dx - size.width / 2 / scale;\n    final right = centerWorld.dx + size.width / 2 / scale;\n    final top = centerWorld.dy - size.height / 2 / scale;\n    final bottom = centerWorld.dy + size.height / 2 / scale;\n\n    final x0 = (left / _tileSize).floor();\n    final x1 = (right / _tileSize).floor();\n    final y0 = math.max(0, (top / _tileSize).floor());\n    final y1 = math.min(n - 1, (bottom / _tileSize).floor());\n\n    final tiles = <Widget>[];\n    var count = 0;\n    for (var x = x0; x <= x1 && count < 160; x++) {\n      for (var y = y0; y <= y1 && count < 160; y++) {\n        count++;\n        final wrapped = x % n;\n        final position =\n            (Offset(x * _tileSize, y * _tileSize) - centerWorld) * scale +\n            viewCenter;\n        tiles.add(\n          Positioned(\n            left: position.dx,\n            top: position.dy,\n            width: span + 0.6,\n            height: span + 0.6,\n            child: _MapTileImage(\n              key: ValueKey('$_retryEpoch/$z/$wrapped/$y'),\n              url: widget.provider.url(z, wrapped, y),\n              placeholder: placeholder,\n              onLoaded: () {\n                if (!mounted) return;\n                setState(() => _tileFrames++);\n              },\n              onFailed: () {\n                if (!mounted) return;\n                setState(() => _tileErrors++);\n              },\n            ),\n          ),\n        );\n      }\n    }\n    return Stack(children: tiles);\n  }\n\n  @override\n  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n    final palette = context.safar;\n    return SizedBox(\n      height: widget.height,\n      width: double.infinity,\n      child: LayoutBuilder(\n        builder: (context, constraints) {\n          final size = Size(\n            constraints.maxWidth.isFinite ? constraints.maxWidth : 0,\n            constraints.maxHeight.isFinite ? constraints.maxHeight : widget.height,\n          );\n          _size = size;\n          if (_needsFit && size.width > 0 && size.height > 0) {\n            _fitToContent(size);\n            _needsFit = false;\n          }\n\n          final z = _tileZoom(_zoom);\n          final scale = _zoomScale(_zoom, z);\n          final centerWorld = _project(_center, z);\n          final viewCenter = Offset(size.width / 2, size.height / 2);\n          Offset project(MapLatLng point) =>\n              (_project(point, z) - centerWorld) * scale + viewCenter;\n\n          final anchorPosition = project(widget.center);\n          final markerPositions = <String, Offset>{\n            for (final marker in widget.markers)\n              marker.id: project(marker.point),\n          };\n          final routePoints = [\n            for (final point in widget.route) project(point),\n          ];\n          final selected = widget.markers\n              .where((marker) => marker.id == widget.selectedId)\n              .firstOrNull;\n          final radius = widget.radiusKm;\n          final radiusPixels = radius == null || radius <= 0\n              ? 0.0\n              : radius *\n                    1000 /\n                    _metersPerPixel(_center.lat, _zoom);\n\n          return Semantics(\n            container: true,\n            label:\n                'Map of nearby places. Pinch to zoom, drag to pan, '\n                'tap a pin to inspect the place.',\n            child: ClipRRect(\n              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24),\n              child: Stack(\n   child: _tileLayer(size, palette.raised),\n                  ),\n                  Positioned.fill(\n                    child: IgnorePointer(\n                      child: CustomPaint(\n                        painter: _MapOverlayPainter(\n                          anchor: anchorPosition,\n                          route: routePoints,\n                          radiusPixels: radiusPixels,\n selectedLabel: selected?.label,\n                          selectedOffset: selected == null\n                              ? null\n                              : markerPositions[selected.id],\n HitTestBehavior.opaque,\n                      onScaleStart: _onScaleStart,\n                      onScaleUpdate: _onScaleUpdate,\n                      onDoubleTapDown: (details) =>\n List<SlippyMapMarker> _markers(NearbyResponse data) {
```
```dart
  final markers = <SlippyMapMarker>[
    SlippyMapMarker(id: '__base', ...),
  ];
  for (final item in data.items) {
    final place = item.activity.place;
    if (place == null) continue;
    markers.add(SlippyMapMarker(id: item.activity.id, lat: place.lat, lon: place.lon, label: item.activity.name));
  }
  return markers;
}
```

```dart
      setState(() => _selected = item);

}
```

```json
{
  "file_path": "C:\\Users\\siddharth\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\safar_tile_server.py",
  "content": "\"\"\"Local XYZ tile server used only to verify SAFAR's slippy-map layer.\n\nRun:  python safar_tile_server.py 8000\nThen: adb reverse tcp:8000 tcp:8000\nand build Flutter with\n  --dart-define=SAFAR_MAP_TILE_URL=http://localhost:8000/{z}/{x}/{y}.png\n\"\"\"\n\nimport io\nimport math\nimport sys\nfrom http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer\n\nfrom PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont\n\nCACHE = {}\nSIZE = 256\n\nPAPER = (246, 241, 231)\nGRID = (227, 218, 201)\nINK = (26, 24, 18)\nMUTED = (115, 107, 92)\nJADE = (10, 110, 102)\nEMBER = (176, 74, 8)\n\n\ndef tile_png(z: int, x: int, y: int) -> bytes:\n    key = (z, x, y)\n    if key in CACHE:\n        return CACHE[key]\n    img = Image.new(\"RGB\", (SIZE, SIZE), PAPER)\n    d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)\n    # A pale checker plus grid so neighbouring tiles are visually distinct.\n    level = z % 3\n    tint = [(248, 244, 235), (242, 238, 227), (238, 233, 220)][level]\n    for cx in range(0, SIZE, 64):\n        for cy in range(0, SIZE, 64):\n            if (cx // 64 + cy // 64) % 2 == 0:\n                d.rectangle([cx, cy, cx + 63, cy + 63], fill=tint)\n    for k in range(0, SIZE + 1, 64):\n        d.line([(k, 0), (k, SIZE)], fill=GRID)\n        d.line([(0, k), (SIZE, k)], fill=GRID)\n    d.rectangle([0, 0, SIZE - 1, SIZE - 1], outline=(214, 204, 186))\n    # A stylised \"river\" that varies with the tile index.\n    wave = int(30 * math.sin((x + z) * 0.9))\n    d.line(\n        [(0, 128 + wave), (64, 120 + wave), (128, 140 + wave), (192, 118 + wave), (SIZE, 132 + wave)],\n        fill=(188, 214, 208),\n        width=10,\n    )\n    d.line(\n        [(0, 128 + wave), (64, 120 + wave), (128, 140 + wave), (192, 118 + wave), (SIZE, 132 + wave)],\n        fill=(150, 190, 182),\n        width=2,\n    )\n    try:\n        font = ImageFont.truetype(\"arial.ttf\", 18)\n        small = ImageFont.truetype(\"arial.ttf\", 12)\n    except OSError:\n        font = ImageFont.load_default()\n        small = font\n    d.ellipse([16, 22, 26, 32], fill=JADE)\n    d.text((32, 18), f\"z{z}\", fill=INK, font=font)\n    d.text((16, 40), f\"{x} / {y}\", fill=MUTED, font=small)\n    d.text((16, SIZE - 24), \"SAFAR local test tiles\", fill=MUTED, font=small)\n    d.ellipse([SIZE - 26, SIZE - 30, SIZE - 18, SIZE - 22], fill=EMBER)\n    buf = io.BytesIO()\n    img.save(buf, format=\"PNG\", optimize=True)\n    data = buf.getvalue()\n    if len(CACHE) > 4000:\n        CACHE.clear()\n    CACHE[key] = data\n    return data\n\n\nclass Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):\n    def do_GET(self):  # noqa: N802 - http.server API\n        raw = self.path.strip(\"/\")\n        parts = raw.split(\"/\")\n        if len(parts) != 3 or not parts[2].endswith(\".png\"):\n            self.send_error(404, \"expected /z/x/y.png\")\n            return\n        try:\n            z = int(parts[0])\n            x = int(parts[1])\n            y = int(parts[2][:-4])\n        except ValueError:\n            self.send_error(400, \"bad tile coordinates\")\n            return\n        n = 1 << z\n        if not (0 <= z <= 20 and 0 <= x < n and 0 <= y < n):\n            self.send_error(404, \"tile out of range\")\n            return\n        body = tile_png(z, x, y)\n        self.send_response(200)\n        self.send_header(\"Content-Type\", \"image/png\")\n        self.send_header(\"Content-Length\", str(len(body)))\n        self.send_header(\"Cache-Control\", \"public, max-age=600\")\n        self.end_headers()\n        self.wfile.write(body)\n\n    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):  # quiet\n        if len(args) > 1 and str(args[1]).startswith((\"2\", \"3\", \"4\", \"5\")):\n            return\n        sys.stderr.write(\"tiles: \" + (fmt % args) + \"\\n\")\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    port = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 8000\n    server = ThreadingHTTPServer((\"0.0.0.0\", port), Handler)\n    print(f\"serving tiles on http://localhost:{port}/{{z}}/{{x}}/{{y}}.png\")\n    server.serve_forever()\n"
}
```

Implementation:
```dart
void _pruneTiles(Set<String> visible) {
  _visibleTiles = visible;
  _loadedTiles.removeWhere((u) => !visible.contains(u));
  _failedTiles.removeWhere((u) => !visible.contains(u));
}
void _tileLoaded(String url) {
  if (!mounted) return;
  setState(() { _loadedTiles.add(url); _failedTiles.remove(url); });
}
void _tileFailed(String url) {
  if (!mounted) return;
  final visibleAtFailure = _visibleTiles.contains(url);
  setState(() { if (!_loadedTiles.contains(url) && visibleAtFailure) _failedTiles.add(url); });
}
```
Careful: failed URL may no longer be visible; ignore.

class InheritedElement extends ProxyElement {
  /// Creates an element that uses the given widget as its configuration.
  InheritedElement(InheritedWidget super.widget);

So the assertion is `debugDeactivated` in `InheritedElement`: `_dependents.isEmpty`. This fires when an InheritedElement is deactivated while descendants still depend on it — typically happens with a GlobalKey move or a widget being deactivated while dependents remain registered. Known Flutter issue: when a `Scrollable`/`TextField` inside a route is disposed in the same frame as an inherited widget is deactivated, often caused by using `Navigator.pop` during layout... Something in our invite sheet.

The sheet was a modal bottom sheet with canScrollBody? ESC key → the IME dismissal probably triggered keyboard metrics change and layout rebuild. Hmm.

Where in our code could an InheritedElement be deactivated with dependents? If we wrap something in a custom InheritedWidget that has dependents, then when the subtree containing both the widget and its dependents is removed at the same time, the assertions can fire incorrectly? Actually debugDeactivated is called in Element.deactivate. If the InheritedElement is unregistered before its dependents deactivate, the assert fires. #### Thinking

showSafarSheet is plain showModalBottomSheet with viewInsets padding. ESC likely pops the route via DismissIntent. Popping the route while the TextField is focused can trigger the framework assertion when disposing the TextEditingController after the await (controller disposed immediately after route closed but the route may still be animating out, with the TextField still mounted!). That's very plausible:

1. ESC pops the sheet route → `showSafarSheet` future completes immediately on pop? `showModalBottomSheet`'s future resolves when route is popped, which happens at pop start (route.didPop → completes future) while the exit animation still runs (300ms) and the TextField is still mounted.
2. `_invite()` resumes, disposes `TextEditingController` immediately.
3. During the exit animation the TextField still rebuilds → uses disposed controller → error. But the error we saw is _dependents.isEmpty, not "used after dispose"... although "used after dispose" error could be swallowed/replaced by the framework assertion during teardown.

The safer design: create/dispose the controller within the sheet's StatefulBuilder? Actually `StatefulBuilder` doesn't dispose. Better: don't dispose manually; or delay disposal until route fully removed. Standard practice: create controller in a StatefulWidget and dispose in dispose(). Refactor the invite sheet into a small StatefulWidget `_InviteSheet` with its own controller, role/scope/days state, and returns the record on submit. That is clean and fixes disposal timing.

There are many such patterns — controllers created in a method, passed into a sheet, disposed after the await. Each could hit the same teardown crash when the keyboard is open and the route pops (or ESC). Fixing all would be a large refactor; many are probably the same shape:

```dart
final title = TextEditingController();

title.dispose();
```

Alternative shared fix: make `showSafarSheet` delay completion of its Future until the route's animation completes. If `showSafarSheet` awaited the route's *completed* future (pushed route future + exit animation), all call sites with `await` would be safe. How? `showModalBottomSheet` returns a `Future<T?>`. We could wrap:

```dart
final result = await showModalBottomSheet<T>(...);
```
The route future completes on pop, not animation end. We can't easily chain animation end from the returned future. But we could have the caller's `builder` wrap content in a widget that delays disposal... too clever.

Cleaner shared fix: inside `showSafarSheet`, `showModalBottomSheet` with a route whose contents are wrapped by a stateful "sheet lifetime" that no-ops after route removal? The controller lives outside.

Alternative: Instead of disposing controllers immediately, do not dispose them at all — they're small; but leaking controllers per sheet open is not great, though common practice for short-lived sheets... Not acceptable.

Best approach: a small helper that keeps the controller alive until the route has fully left the tree. E.g., dispose after a Duration matching sheet animation:

```dart
Future<void> disposeAfterSheet(TextEditingController controller) async {
  await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 400));
  controller.dispose();
}
```

#### Thinking

The pattern is widespread: controller created in a method, sheet uses it, then disposed right after the sheet future completes. All of these would dispose while the sheet is animating out. Whether they crash depends on whether the TextField is still mounted during exit animation — it is, for all. So the same assertion can occur when dismissing any of these sheets while a text field had focus (e.g., press back/ESC, or tap "Cancel" — at least on debug builds).

The cleanest central mitigation without refactoring 15 sheets: make `showSafarSheet` not complete until the route's exit animation has finished AND the sheet subtree is disposed. We can achieve this by wrapping the builder content in a widget that reports when it is disposed... but the future completion is controlled by Navigator (route.didPop → completes the route future). However, we can *delay* the future we return to callers:

```dart
Future<T?> showSafarSheet<T>(...) async {
  final routeFuture = showModalBottomSheet<T>(...);
  final result = await routeFuture;
  await WidgetsBinding.instance.endOfFrame;  // not enough; animation is 250ms
  return result;
}
```
Not reliable.

Alternative: keep the future, but ensure the controller isn't disposed until the route is fully gone. We could wrap the sheet body in a `StatefulWidget` (`_SheetLifecycle`) that on dispose completes a Completer; then `showSafarSheet` returns a future that completes when both result is available and the widget is disposed. But disposing the wrapper happens at route removal (after animation), so delay is correct.

But there's a potential deadlock if the builder is never mounted: if `showModalBottomSheet` completes but the route was never built (e.g., immediately popped before the first frame?). Safer design: complete the completer when the sheet's `ModalBottomSheetRoute` finishes its pop regardless of mounting, via a fallback timer:

```dart
await Future.any([unmounted.future, Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 600))]);
```
This caps the wait; on normal flows, subtree unmount happens within ~300 ms. But if the device is slow and animation takes >600ms? Then we're back to the original crash. Bottom sheet exit is 200ms (route transition 250ms). 1 second is safe. However, if the route is never built at all (edge), we resolve after 1s — fine.

If the route is popped before its first build, `ModalBottomSheetRoute` never builds the scope, so dispose never happens; the future hangs (in tests, this could hang a test). Each open trip holds one WebSocket. The client requests a 120-second ticket
from `POST /api/auth/ws-ticket`, then connects to
`GET /ws/trips/{trip_id}?token=<ticket>`. Events for itinerary, proposals,
expenses, engine, pulse, members and the trip itself invalidate the matching
Riverpod providers. The channel reconnects with exponential backoff
(1/2/4/8/15/30 s), pauses while the app is in the background, dedupes repeated
frames and re-fetches all trip-scoped providers after a reconnection.
Pull-to-refresh and post-mutation invalidation still work without the socket.
The Live/Reconnecting chip appears on the trip overview, itinerary and
decisions screens.

## Native capabilities

| Capability | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| Companion deep links | `safar://companion/<token>` and `https://<web-host>/companion/<token>` open the public responder. Android intent filter and iOS URL type are declared. |
| Share | The companion link and CSV expense export use the platform share sheet. |
| Photos | Memory photos come from the camera or library only when the user taps Add photo; 25 MB cap, scaled to 1600 px. |
| Location | Nearby can use the current position only when the profile's location-sharing consent is on; otherwise the trip base is used. Permission is requested only on tap. |
| Offline | Offline captures are stored on the device and synced idempotently when back online. |

Push notifications are not implemented because the backend has no APNs/FCM
deliverer; in-app notifications remain the supported channel.

## Troubleshooting “Failed to fetch”

This error is the browser’s generic network failure; it is not a Flutter
exception. The causes found during Phase 8 were:

1. The web build called `http://localhost:8000` while the API ran on `:8010`.
   Fix: pass `SAFAR_API_BASE_URL` matching the running API.
2. The API’s CORS list did not include the Flutter web origin, so the browser
   blocked the response. Fix: add the exact origin to `CORS_ORIGINS` (native
   apps are unaffected by CORS).
3. An Android emulator using `localhost` reached itself instead of the host.
   Fix: use `10.0.2.2` (now the debug default) or the LAN IP for a device.
4. A plain-HTTP API on Android release builds. The debug overlay permits
   cleartext for local development; release must use HTTPS.

If the Android build fails while downloading Maven dependencies with
`PKIX path building failed`, a TLS-scanning product (for example Avast Web
Shield) is intercepting HTTPS and the JDK does not trust its root. Options are
to trust that root in a build-only truststore (a security decision that needs
explicit approval), temporarily pause TLS scanning, or build on a host without
interception. Do not disable TLS verification.

`tripsProvider` is a non-autoDispose FutureProvider. Sequence at logout: `logout()` calls API logout → clearSession → then `_ref.invalidate(tripsProvider)`. Invalidation re-runs the provider immediately (it's still alive due to dashboard being mounted until state changes to signedOut). That refetch fires with no session → 401 → error state. Then login only invalidates `meProvider`, not `tripsProvider`, so the stale error card persists until user refreshes. That's exactly the observed bug.

Fix: invalidate tripsProvider (and other data providers) on login as well. Minimal robust fix: in `login()` and `register()`, invalidate `tripsProvider`, `notificationsProvider`, `meProvider`. Possibly many other providers keyed by trip remain cached across users — a broader solution would be to reset all providers on logout/login. Riverpod has no built-in "reset all", but a common pattern: use a `userSessionProvider` dependency that data providers watch, or wrap with `ProviderContainer` reset. Another approach: in logout, avoid invalidating tripsProvider before state change (order matters), and in login invalidate the trip-scoped providers.

---
/// Maps an incoming link to a SAFAR route.
///
/// Supported forms:
/// - `safar://companion/<token>` (custom scheme registered by the app)
/// - `safar://invite/<token>` (trip invitation, single use)
/// - `https://<any-host>/companion/<token>` (universal/app link when a
///   deployment verifies its own domain)
/// - `https://<any-host>/invite/<token>` (the web fallback pages)
///
/// The companion token is the only credential, so any host may forward to it.
String? companionPathFromUri(Uri uri) {
  final segments = uri.pathSegments.where((part) => part.isNotEmpty).toList();
  if (uri.scheme == 'safar' && uri.host == 'companion') {
    if (segments.length == 1) return '/companion/${segments.first}';
    return null;
  }
  if (uri.scheme == 'http' || uri.scheme == 'https') {
    if (segments.length == 2 && segments.first == 'companion') {
      return '/companion/${segments[1]}';
    }
  }
  return null;
}

String? invitationPathFromUri(Uri uri) {
  final segments = uri.pathSegments.where((part) => part.isNotEmpty).toList();
  if (uri.scheme == 'safar' && (uri.host == 'invite' || uri.host == 'invitation')) {
    if (segments.isEmpty) return null;
    return '/invite/${segments.first}';
  }
  if (uri.scheme == 'http' || uri.scheme == 'https') {
    if (segments.length == 2 && segments.first == 'invite') {
      return '/invite/${segments[1]}';
    }
  }
  return null;
}

/// Resolves any supported SAFAR link to an in-app route.
String? appPathFromUri(Uri uri) =>
    companionPathFromUri(uri) ?? invitationPathFromUri(uri);
---
/// A deep-link target that arrived before the user was signed in.
///
/// GoRouter's redirect sends signed-out visitors to `/login`; after sign-in the
/// router hands this path back once so an invitation link still lands on the
/// invitation instead of the dashboard.
class PendingRoute {
  PendingRoute._();

  static String? _value;

  static void set(String path) => _value = path;

  static String? take(String? fallback) {
    final value = _value;
    _value = null;
    return value ?? fallback;
  }

  static void clear() => _value = null;
}

19	/// Owns the trip socket while any trip screen watches it, and maps pushed
20	/// events onto Riverpod invalidations so every open screen reconciles.
21	class TripRealtimeController extends StateNotifier<TripLiveState> {
22	  TripRealtimeController(this._ref, this.tripId)
23	    : super(const TripLiveState()) {
24	    final channel = TripChannel(
25	      client: _ref.read(apiClientProvider),
26	      tripId: tripId,
27	    );
28	    _channel = channel;
29	    channel.onStatus = (status) {
30	      if (!mounted) return;
31	      state = TripLiveState(status: status, lastEvent: state.lastEvent);
32	    };
33	    channel.onCatchUp = _reconcile;
34	    _events = channel.events.listen(_onEvent);
35	    _lifecycle = AppLifecycleListener(
36	      onPause: () {
37	        _paused = true;
38	        channel.stop();
39	      },
40	      onResume: _resume,
41	    );
42	    channel.start();
43	  }

45	  final Ref _ref;
46	  final String tripId;
47	
48	  late final TripChannel _channel;
49	  late final StreamSubscription<TripEvent> _events;
50	  late final AppLifecycleListener _lifecycle;
51	  bool _paused = false;

53	  void _resume() {
54	    if (!_paused) return;
55	    _paused = false;
56	    _channel.start();
57	  }
58	
59	  void _onEvent(TripEvent event) {
60	    if (!mounted) return;
61	    state = TripLiveState(status: _channel.status, lastEvent: event);
62	    _refreshFor(event.event);
63	  }

65	  void _refreshFor(String event) {
66	    final ref = _ref;
67	    if (event == 'itinerary.updated' || event.startsWith('proposal.')) {
68	      ref.invalidate(itineraryProvider(tripId));
69	      ref.invalidate(proposalsProvider(tripId));
70	      ref.invalidate(engineProvider(tripId));
71	      ref.invalidate(tripProvider(tripId));
72	    } else if (event == 'engine.updated') {
73	      ref.invalidate(engineProvider(tripId));
74	      ref.invalidate(itineraryProvider(tripId));
75	    } else if (event == 'expenses.updated') {
76	      ref.invalidate(expensesProvider(tripId));
77	      ref.invalidate(balancesProvider(tripId));
78	    } else if (event == 'pulse.updated') {
79	      ref.invalidate(pulseProvider(tripId));
80	    } else if (event.startsWith('member.')) {

#### Thinking

The spinner has been spinning for over a minute, and no `timeLimit` timeout occurred. This is a real robustness bug in the location path: on devices without Google Play Services (or where the fused provider never responds), `Geolocator.getCurrentPosition` doesn't complete despite `timeLimit`. The UI is left in a permanent "locating" state, disabling the button and never giving feedback.

Let me check geolocator version and its implementation detail. `LocationSettings.timeLimit` is supported since geolocator_android 4.x + geolocator 10? If `timeLimit` unsupported on the platform, geolocator throws ArgumentError "The timeLimit value is only supported..." Hmm. Actually geolocator docs: "timeLimit: on web not supported"? On Android, `LocationSettings.timeLimit` requires Android API 30+ (LocationRequest.setMaxUpdates? Actually setWaitForAccurateLocation?). Hmm.

Whatever the plugin behavior, the app should guard with its own `.timeout()` so the user is never stuck. This is exactly the kind of reliability fix Phase 10 wants.

Fix: in nearby_screen `_useMyLocation`, wrap the position request in a `.timeout(const Duration(seconds: 15))` handled by catch → "Could not read your location..." (the existing catch-all already handles TimeoutException). Add on timeout.

Also, importantly the spinner leaves the button disabled for the whole wait. With our own timeout the infinite hang becomes bounded.

But wait — should I verify whether `getCurrentPosition` hangs due to missing GMS specifically? Our app's location usage with `LocationAccuracy.low` uses fused provider by default. If geolocator's Java plugin blocks the Android main thread waiting for a GoogleApiClient connection that never happens, the app's main thread blocks → ANR; the Dart UI keeps rendering the spinner (Flutter renders on its own thread) but input events pile up.

The cause: geolocator on an emulator without Play services blocks the Android main thread. Is this the app's fault? Not directly — it's a plugin/environment limitation. But the fix in the app: avoid the fused provider and use the platform LocationManager (`AndroidSettings(forceLocationManager: true)`) which works on any Android device, no GMS needed. That is a legitimate robustness improvement: on devices without Google Play Services (e.g., AOSP/emulator/Huawei), app shouldn't hang. Using `forceLocationManager: true` uses android.location.LocationManager directly.

Hmm, but on real devices with GMS, fused provider is battery-friendly/better. A hybrid: try fused with timeout, fall back to location manager? Excellent — the ANR stack shows the app's main thread is inside:

`com.baseflow.geolocator.location.LocationManagerClient.onLocationChanged` → `GeolocationManager.stopPositionUpdates` → `LocationManagerClient.stopPositionUpdates` → `NmeaClient.stop` → `LocationManager.removeNmeaListener` → binder `unregisterGnssNmeaCallback` → blocked in ioctl/binder transact to system_server.

So it's a deadlock: geolocator's `getCurrentPosition` received a location (GNSS emulator) and then stops updates; `NmeaClient.stop()` calls `removeNmeaListener`, a binder call to the system's location service that blocks. The system_server may be busy/blocked (74% CPU). This could be an emulator system_server location service slowness, or a geolocator issue (main-thread callbacks; stop inside onLocationChanged on main thread).

Either way: the app is at the mercy of the plugin's main-thread blocking. The app-side mitigation: `forceLocationManager: true` doesn't help (that's exactly the path that hung: LocationManagerClient). Could avoid NMEA listener? The NMEA client is only enabled when `forceLocationManager`? Look at LocationManagerClient: it seems to always create NmeaClient. Hmm.

Is the ANR caused by system_server monopolizing? `unregisterGnssNmeaCallback` binder call to system_server blocked because system_server main thread is busy (we saw "Slow dispatch", BestClock spam). import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';

import 'package:safar_mobile/core/theme/safar_theme.dart';
import 'package:safar_mobile/features/auth/login_screen.dart';

Widget _wrap(Widget child) => ProviderScope(
  child: MaterialApp(theme: SafarTheme.light(), home: child),
);

void main() {
  testWidgets('login form validates input before calling the API', (
    tester,
  ) async {
    await tester.pumpWidget(_wrap(const LoginScreen()));

    expect(find.text('Welcome back.'), findsOneWidget);
    expect(find.widgetWithText(FilledButton, 'Sign in'), findsOneWidget);

    await tester.enterText(find.byType(TextFormField).at(0), 'not-an-email');
    await tester.enterText(find.byType(TextFormField).at(1), '');
    await tester.tap(find.widgetWithText(FilledButton, 'Sign in'));
    await tester.pump();

    expect(find.text('Enter a valid email address'), findsOneWidget);
    expect(find.text('Enter your password'), findsOneWidget);
  });

  testWidgets('password field can be revealed and hidden', (tester) async {
    await tester.pumpWidget(_wrap(const LoginScreen()));

    EditableText field() => tester.widget<EditableText>(
      find.descendant(
        of: find.byType(TextFormField).at(1),
        matching: find.byType(EditableText),
      ),
    );

    expect(field().obscureText, isTrue);
    await tester.tap(find.byTooltip('Show password'));
    await tester.pump();
    expect(field().obscureText, isFalse);
    await tester.tap(find.byTooltip('Hide password'));
    await tester.pump();
    expect(field().obscureText, isTrue);
  });

  testWidgets('registration form asks for name, email and password', (
    tester,
  ) async {
    await tester.pumpWidget(_wrap(const RegisterScreen()));

    expect(find.text('Start a private trip.'), findsOneWidget);
    expect(find.text('Display name'), findsOneWidget);
    expect(find.text('Email'), findsOneWidget);
    expect(find.text('Password'), findsOneWidget);
  });
}

      expect(event, isNotNull);
      expect(event!.event, 'proposal.created');
      expect(event.at, '2026-11-20T10:00:00Z');
      expect(event.actor, 'Mira');

      expect(TripEvent.tryParse('not json'), isNull);

          apiBaseUrl: 'https://api.example.test',

407	  List<_RoutePoint> _routePoints(Itinerary? itinerary) {
408	    if (itinerary == null) return const [];
409	    final items = itinerary.items
410	        .where((item) => !item.cancelled && item.activity?.place != null)
411	        .toList()
412	      ..sort((a, b) {
413	        final byDay = a.day.compareTo(b.day);
414	        return byDay != 0 ? byDay : a.startTime.compareTo(b.startTime);
415	      });
416	    return [
417	      for (final item in items)
418	        (
419	          lat: item.activity!.place!.lat,
420	          lon: item.activity!.place!.lon,
421	          title: item.title,
422	        ),
423	    ];
424	  }

444	  double get _maxKm {
445	    var maxKm = radiusKm;

448	      maxKm = math.max(maxKm, math.max(extent.dx.abs(), extent.dy.abs()));
449	    }
450	    return maxKm <= 0 ? 1 : maxKm;
451	  }

470	                final offset = _project(base, place.lat, place.lon, size, maxKm);
471	                final distance = (offset - details.localPosition).distance;
472	                if (distance < bestDistance) {
473	                  best = item;
474	                  bestDistance = distance;
475	                }
476	              }

504	/// Straight-line kilometre offsets from the base, east (dx) and north (dy).
505	Offset _kmOffset(NearbyBase base, double lat, double lon) {
506	  final latKm = (lat - base.lat) * 111.32;
507	  final lonKm =
508	      (lon - base.lon) * 111.32 * math.cos(base.lat * math.pi / 180).abs();
509	  return Offset(lonKm, latKm);
510	}
511	
512	Offset _project(NearbyBase base, double lat, double lon, Size size, double maxKm) {
513	  final offset = _kmOffset(base, lat, lon);
514	  final half = size.shortestSide / 2 - 20;
515	  final scale = half / maxKm;
516	  return Offset(
517	    size.width / 2 + offset.dx * scale,
518	    size.height / 2 - offset.dy * scale,
519	  );
520	}

522	class _MapPainter extends CustomPainter {
523	  const _MapPainter({
524	    required this.base,
525	    required this.radiusKm,
526	    required this.maxKm,
527	    required this.items,
528	    required this.route,
529	    required this.selectedId,
530	    required this.background,
531	    required this.ring,
532	    required this.ink,
533	    required this.muted,
534	    required this.jade,
535	    required this.ember,
536	    required this.surface,
537	  });
538	
539	  final NearbyBase base;
540	  final double radiusKm;
541	  final double maxKm;

544	  final String? selectedId;

553	  @override
554	  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
555	    final center = Offset(size.width / 2, size.height / 2);
556	    final half = size.shortestSide / 2 - 20;
557	    final scale = half / maxKm;
558	
559	    final ringPaint = Paint()
560	      ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
561	      ..strokeWidth = 1
562	      ..color = ring;
563	    canvas.drawCircle(center, radiusKm * scale, ringPaint);
564	
565	    final ringLabel = TextPainter(
566	      text: TextSpan(
567	        text: '${radiusKm.toStringAsFixed(0)} km',
568	        style: TextStyle(fontSize: 10, color: muted),
569	      ),
570	      textDirection: TextDirection.ltr,

3	/// A slippy-map tile source supplied at build time.
4	///
5	/// SAFAR never bundles a tile endpoint and never assumes a provider's free
6	/// tier is acceptable for this app. Supply a licensed endpoint (MapTiler,
7	/// Mapbox Static Tiles, Thunderforest, an in-house tile server, ...) with
8	/// `--dart-define=SAFAR_MAP_TILE_URL=...` and its required attribution with
9	/// `SAFAR_MAP_TILE_ATTRIBUTION`. The template must contain `{z}`, `{x}` and
10	/// `{y}`; `{s}` is optional and rotates through `SAFAR_MAP_TILE_SUBDOMAINS`.
11	@immutable
12	class MapTileProvider {
13	  const MapTileProvider({
14	    required this.urlTemplate,
15	    required this.attribution,
16	    required this.minZoom,
17	    required this.maxZoom,
18	    this.subdomains = const [],
19	  });
20	
21	  final String urlTemplate;
22	  final String attribution;
23	  final int minZoom;
24	  final int maxZoom;
25	  final List<String> subdomains;
26	
27	  String url(int z, int x, int y) {
28	    var out = urlTemplate
29	        .replaceAll('{z}', '$z')
30	        .replaceAll('{x}', '$x')
31	        .replaceAll('{y}', '$y');
32	    if (subdomains.isNotEmpty) {
33	      out = out.replaceAll('{s}', subdomains[(x + y) % subdomains.length]);
34	    }
35	    return out;
36	  }
37	}

39	/// Result of reading the tile settings from the compile-time environment.
40	class MapTileConfig {
41	  const MapTileConfig({this.provider, this.note});
42	
43	  final MapTileProvider? provider;
44	
45	  /// Human-readable reason the tile layer is off, shown in the UI.
46	  final String? note;
47	
48	  bool get hasTiles => provider != null;
49	
50	  static const String _templateKey = 'SAFAR_MAP_TILE_URL';
51	
52	  static MapTileConfig fromEnvironment() {
53	    const template = String.fromEnvironment(_templateKey);
54	    const attribution = String.fromEnvironment('SAFAR_MAP_TILE_ATTRIBUTION');
55	    const subdomainsRaw = String.fromEnvironment('SAFAR_MAP_TILE_SUBDOMAINS');
56	    const minZoomRaw = String.fromEnvironment(
57	      'SAFAR_MAP_TILE_MIN_ZOOM',
58	      defaultValue: '2',
59	    );
60	    const maxZoomRaw = String.fromEnvironment(
61	      'SAFAR_MAP_TILE_MAX_ZOOM',
62	      defaultValue: '18',
63	    );
64	
65	    final trimmed = template.trim();
66	    if (trimmed.isEmpty) {
67	      return const MapTileConfig(
68	        note:
69	            'Schematic map. Tile provider not configured for this build '
70	            '(SAFAR_MAP_TILE_URL).',
71	      );
72	    }
73	    if (!trimmed.contains('{z}') ||
74	        !trimmed.contains('{x}') ||
75	        !trimmed.contains('{y}')) {
76	      return const MapTileConfig(
77	        note:
78	            'Schematic map. SAFAR_MAP_TILE_URL must contain {z}, {x} and {y} '
79	            'placeholders.',
80	      );
81	    }
82	
83	    final probe = trimmed
84	        .replaceAll('{z}', '0')
85	        .replaceAll('{x}', '0')
86	        .replaceAll('{y}', '0')
87	        .replaceAll('{s}', 'a');
88	    final uri = Uri.tryParse(probe);
89	    if (uri == null || uri.host.isEmpty) {
90	      return const MapTileConfig(
91	        note: 'Schematic map. SAFAR_MAP_TILE_URL is not a valid absolute URL.',
92	      );
93	    }
94	    if (uri.scheme != 'https' && !(kDebugMode && uri.scheme == 'http')) {
95	      return const MapTileConfig(
96	        note:
97	            'Schematic map. Tile endpoints must use HTTPS in release builds; '
98	            'plain HTTP is only accepted in debug builds.',
99	      );
100	    }
101	
102	    final minZoom = int.tryParse(minZoomRaw.trim()) ?? 2;
103	    final maxZoom = int.tryParse(maxZoomRaw.trim()) ?? 18;
104	    final lower = minZoom.clamp(1, 22);
105	    final upper = maxZoom.clamp(lower, 22);
106	    final subdomains = subdomainsRaw
107	        .split(',')
108	        .map((part) => part.trim())
109	        .where((part) => part.isNotEmpty)
110	        .toList(growable: false);
111	    final attributionText = attribution.trim().isEmpty
112	        ? 'Map tiles © ${uri.host}'
113	        : attribution.trim();
114	
115	    return MapTileConfig(
116	      provider: MapTileProvider(
117	        urlTemplate: trimmed,
118	        attribution: attributionText,
119	        minZoom: lower,
120	        maxZoom: upper,
121	        subdomains: subdomains,
122	      ),
123	    );
124	  }
125	}

85	        ? '${months[end.month - 1]} ${end.day}'
86	        : '${months[end.month - 1]} ${end.day}, ${end.year}';

class NearbyQuery {
  const NearbyQuery({
    required this.tripId,
    this.lat,
    this.lon,
    this.radiusKm = 5,
    this.category,
    this.limit = 20,
  });

  final String tripId;
  final double? lat;
  final double? lon;
  final double radiusKm;
  final String? category;
  final int limit;

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
      other is NearbyQuery &&
      other.tripId == tripId &&
      other.lat == lat &&
      other.lon == lon &&
      other.radiusKm == radiusKm &&
      other.category == category &&
      other.limit == limit;

  @override
  int get hashCode =>
      Object.hash(tripId, lat, lon, radiusKm, category, limit);
}

final nearbyProvider = FutureProvider.family<NearbyResponse, NearbyQuery>(
  (ref, query) => ref.watch(discoveryRepositoryProvider).nearby(
    query.tripId,
    lat: query.lat,
    lon: query.lon,
    radiusKm: query.radiusKm,
    category: query.category,
    limit: query.limit,
  ),
);

class SafarSheetHeader extends StatelessWidget {
  const SafarSheetHeader({super.key, required this.title, this.subtitle});

  final String title;
  final String? subtitle;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 16),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Text(title, style: context.texts.headlineSmall),
          if (subtitle != null) ...[
            const SizedBox(height: 4),
            Text(subtitle!, style: context.texts.bodySmall),
          ],
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Resolves after the sheet's route has been popped *and* its subtree has been
/// unmounted. Callers typically create controllers before the sheet and
/// dispose them once this future completes; the route future alone resolves at
/// the start of the exit animation, while the sheet contents are still
/// mounted, so disposing then throws during teardown.
Future<T?> showSafarSheet<T>(
  BuildContext context, {
  required WidgetBuilder builder,
  bool isScrollControlled = true,
}) async {
  final unmounted = Completer<void>();
  final result = await showModalBottomSheet<T>(
    context: context,
    isScrollControlled: isScrollControlled,
    builder: (context) => _SheetScope(
      onUnmounted: () {
        if (!unmounted.isCompleted) unmounted.complete();
      },
      child: Padding(
        padding: EdgeInsets.only(
          left: 20,
          right: 20,
          top: 4,
          bottom: MediaQuery.viewInsetsOf(context).bottom +
              MediaQuery.paddingOf(context).bottom +
              24,
        ),
        child: builder(context),
      ),
    ),
  );
  await unmounted.future.timeout(
    const Duration(seconds: 2),
    onTimeout: () {},
  );
  return result;
}

class _SheetScope extends StatefulWidget {
  const _SheetScope({required this.onUnmounted, required this.child});

  final VoidCallback onUnmounted;
  final Widget child;

  @override
  State<_SheetScope> createState() => _SheetScopeState();
}

class _SheetScopeState extends State<_SheetScope> {
  @override
  void dispose() {
    widget.onUnmounted();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => widget.child;
}
