def _build_proposal_operations(db: Session, trip: Trip, proposal: ItineraryProposal) -> list[dict]:
    """Validate and normalise a proposal into concrete itinerary operations."""
    payload = proposal.payload or {}
    operations: list[dict] = []

    def add_activity_op(activity_id: str, day_value, start_time, notes, title=None):
        activity = db.get(Activity, activity_id)
        if not activity:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="A proposed activity no longer exists")
        if activity.destination_id != trip.destination_id:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="A proposed activity is outside this destination")
        if day_value is None:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="A proposed item is missing its day")
        day = day_value if isinstance(day_value, date) else date.fromisoformat(str(day_value))
        _within_trip(trip, day)
        start = start_time or "09:00"
        if len(start) != 5 or ":" not in start:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Invalid start time in proposal")
        operations.append(
            {
                "op": "add",
                "activity_id": activity.id,
                "day": day,
                "start_time": start,
                "notes": notes,
                "title": title or activity.name,
                "cost": activity.price_estimate,
                "place_id": activity.place_id,
            }
        )

    def cancel_op(item_id: str | None):
        if not item_id:
            return
        item = db.get(ItineraryItem, item_id)
        if not item or item.trip_id != trip.id:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="A referenced itinerary item no longer exists")
        operations.append({"op": "cancel", "item_id": item.id, "title": item.title, "cost": -item.cost_estimate})

    if proposal.kind == "add_activity":
        add_activity_op(
            payload.get("activity_id"),
            payload.get("day"),
            payload.get("start_time"),
            payload.get("notes"),
        )
    elif proposal.kind == "replace_item":
        cancel_op(payload.get("target_item_id"))
        add_activity_op(
            payload.get("activity_id"),
            payload.get("day"),
            payload.get("start_time"),
            payload.get("notes"),
        )
    elif proposal.kind == "remove_item":
        cancel_op(payload.get("target_item_id"))
    elif proposal.kind == "twin_adopt":
        day = payload.get("day")
        if day:
            day_value = day if isinstance(day, date) else date.fromisoformat(str(day))
            existing = (
                db.query(ItineraryItem)
                .filter(
                    ItineraryItem.trip_id == trip.id,
                    ItineraryItem.day == day_value,
                    ItineraryItem.status == "confirmed",
                )
                .all()
            )
            for item in existing:
                cancel_op(item.id)
        for entry in payload.get("items", []):
            add_activity_op(
                entry.get("activity_id"),
                entry.get("day", payload.get("day")),
                entry.get("start_time"),
                entry.get("notes"),
            )
    elif proposal.kind == "rescue":
        for entry in payload.get("items", []):
            cancel_op(entry.get("item_id"))
            if entry.get("activity_id"):
                add_activity_op(
                    entry.get("activity_id"),
                    entry.get("day"),
                    entry.get("start_time"),
                    entry.get("notes", "Trip Rescue replacement"),
                )
    else:
        for entry in payload.get("items", []):
            add_activity_op(
                entry.get("activity_id"),
                entry.get("day"),
                entry.get("start_time"),
                entry.get("notes"),
            )
        for item_id in payload.get("remove_item_ids", []):
            cancel_op(item_id)

    if not operations:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="This proposal contains no itinerary changes")
    return operations


def _pact_conflicts(db: Session, trip: Trip, operations: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
    pact = db.query(JourneyPact).filter(JourneyPact.trip_id == trip.id).first()
    if not pact:
        return []
    must_do = {str(title).strip().lower() for title in (pact.must_do or [])}
    exceptions = {str(title).strip().lower() for title in (pact.exceptions or [])}
    conflicts = []
    for operation in operations:
        if operation["op"] != "cancel":
            continue
        title = (operation.get("title") or "").strip().lower()
        if not title:
            continue
        for rule in must_do:
            if rule and (rule in title or title in rule):
                if any(exception in title or title in exception for exception in exceptions):
                    continue
                conflicts.append(
                    {
                        "item": operation["title"],
                        "rule": "Agreed must-do activity (Journey Pact)",
                        "resolution": "Add a Journey Pact exception or keep the item.",
                    }
                )
    return conflicts


def _schedule_conflicts(db: Session, trip: Trip, operations: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
    """Protected-time and overlap guard for proposal approval.

    Operations are simulated in order: cancels free a slot, adds consume one.
    A change may never remove a protected block or place an activity on top of
    one, and two activities cannot claim the same minutes.
    """
    confirmed = (
        db.query(ItineraryItem)
        .filter(ItineraryItem.trip_id == trip.id, ItineraryItem.status == "confirmed")
        .all()
    )
    remaining = {item.id: item for item in confirmed}
    added: list[dict] = []
    conflicts: list[dict] = []
    for operation in operations:
        if operation["op"] == "cancel":
            item = remaining.pop(operation["item_id"], None)
            if item and item.is_protected:
                conflicts.append(
                    {
                        "item": item.title,
                        "reason": "Protected time cannot be removed by this change.",
                        "protected": True,
                    }
                )
            continue
        day = operation.get("day")
        start = parse_hhmm(operation.get("start_time"))
        if not day or start is None:
            continue
        day_value = day if isinstance(day, date) else date.fromisoformat(str(day))
        activity = (
            db.get(Activity, operation["activity_id"])
            if operation.get("activity_id")
            else None
        )
        duration = activity.duration_minutes if activity and activity.duration_minutes else 90
        end = start + duration
        windows: list[tuple[str, int, int, bool]] = []
        for item in remaining.values():
            if item.day != day_value:
                continue
            window = item_window(db, item)
            if window:
                windows.append((item.title, window[0], window[1], bool(item.is_protected)))
        windows.extend(
            (entry["title"], entry["start_minutes"], entry["end_minutes"], False)
            for entry in added
            if entry["day"] == day_value
        )
        for title, window_start, window_end, protected in windows:
            if start < window_end and window_start < end:
                conflicts.append(
                    {
                        "item": title,
                        "proposed": operation.get("title"),
                        "reason": (
                            "Protected time would be overlapped."
                            if protected
                            else "Another confirmed item would overlap."
                        ),
                        "protected": protected,
                    }
                )
                break
        added.append(
            {
                "title": operation.get("title"),
                "day": day_value,
                "start_minutes": start,
                "end_minutes": end,
            }
        )
    return conflicts

            if member.budget_limit is not None and operation["cost"] > member.budget_limit:
                budget_conflicts.append(

@router.post("/{trip_id}/proposals", status_code=201)
async def create_proposal(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: ProposalCreate,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    if payload.kind == "add_activity" and not payload.activity_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="activity_id is required for add_activity")
    if payload.kind == "replace_item" and (not payload.activity_id or not payload.target_item_id):
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=422,
            detail="replace_item needs both activity_id and target_item_id",
        )
    if payload.kind == "remove_item" and not payload.target_item_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="target_item_id is required for remove_item")

    proposal = ItineraryProposal(
        trip_id=trip.id,
        kind=payload.kind,
        title=payload.title,
        summary=payload.summary,
        target_day=payload.day,
        created_by=user.id,
        payload={
            "activity_id": payload.activity_id,
            "day": payload.day.isoformat() if payload.day else None,
            "start_time": payload.start_time,
            "target_item_id": payload.target_item_id,
            **payload.payload,
        },
    )
    db.add(proposal)
    db.flush()
    try:
        impact = _proposal_impact(db, trip, proposal)
    except HTTPException:
        db.rollback()
        raise
    audit(
        db,
        action="proposal.create",
        entity_type="itinerary_proposal",
        entity_id=proposal.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
        detail={"kind": proposal.kind, "title": proposal.title},
    )
    notify_trip_members(
        db,
        trip,
        kind="proposal_created",
        title=f"New proposal: {proposal.title}",
        body=f"{user.display_name} asked the group to decide.",
        link=f"/trips/{trip.id}/voting",
        exclude_user_id=user.id,
    )
    db.commit()
    await manager.broadcast(
        trip.id,
        event_payload("proposal.created", trip_id=trip.id, proposal_id=proposal.id),
    )
    return {**proposal_out(db, proposal, user.id), "impact": impact}


@router.get("/{trip_id}/proposals")
def list_proposals(
    trip_id: str,
    status: str = Query(default="open", pattern=r"^(open|approved|rejected|withdrawn|all)$"),
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    query = db.query(ItineraryProposal).filter(ItineraryProposal.trip_id == trip.id)
    if status != "all":
        query = query.filter(ItineraryProposal.status == status)
    rows = query.order_by(ItineraryProposal.created_at.desc()).all()
    return {"items": [proposal_out(db, row, user.id) for row in rows]}


@router.get("/{trip_id}/proposals/{proposal_id}")
def get_proposal(
    trip_id: str,
    proposal_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    proposal = db.get(ItineraryProposal, proposal_id)
    if not proposal or proposal.trip_id != trip.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Proposal not found")
    try:
        impact = _proposal_impact(db, trip, proposal)
    except HTTPException as exc:
        impact = {"error": exc.detail}
    return {**proposal_out(db, proposal, user.id), "impact": impact}


@router.post("/{trip_id}/proposals/{proposal_id}/vote")
async def vote_proposal(
    trip_id: str,
    proposal_id: str,
    payload: VoteIn,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    proposal = db.get(ItineraryProposal, proposal_id)
    if not proposal or proposal.trip_id != trip.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Proposal not found")
    if proposal.status != "open":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="This proposal is no longer open")
    vote = (
        db.query(Vote)
        .filter(Vote.proposal_id == proposal.id, Vote.user_id == user.id)
        .first()
    )
    if not vote:
        vote = Vote(proposal_id=proposal.id, user_id=user.id)
        db.add(vote)
    vote.value = payload.value
    vote.comment = payload.comment
    audit(
        db,
        action="proposal.vote",
        entity_type="itinerary_proposal",
        entity_id=proposal.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
        detail={"value": payload.value},
    )
    db.commit()
    await manager.broadcast(
        trip.id,
        event_payload(
            "proposal.voted",
            trip_id=trip.id,
            proposal_id=proposal.id,
            voter=user.display_name,
        ),
    )
    return proposal_out(db, proposal, user.id)


@router.post("/{trip_id}/proposals/{proposal_id}/approve")
async def approve_proposal(
    trip_id: str,
    proposal_id: str,
    payload: ApprovalIn,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user, ADMIN_ROLES)
    proposal = db.get(ItineraryProposal, proposal_id)
    if not proposal or proposal.trip_id != trip.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Proposal not found")
    if proposal.status != "open":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="This proposal is no longer open")
    if not payload.approval:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Use the reject action instead")

    operations = _build_proposal_operations(db, trip, proposal)
    conflicts = _pact_conflicts(db, trip, operations)
    if conflicts:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=409,
            detail={
                "message": "This change breaks the Journey Pact.",
                "conflicts": conflicts,
            },
        )
    schedule_conflicts = _schedule_conflicts(db, trip, operations)
    if schedule_conflicts:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=409,
            detail={
                "message": "This change conflicts with protected time or an existing item.",
                "conflicts": schedule_conflicts,
            },
        )

    members = (
        db.query(TripMember)
        .filter(TripMember.trip_id == trip.id, TripMember.status == "active")
        .all()
    )
    for operation in operations:
        if operation["op"] != "add":
            continue
        for member in members:
            if member.budget_limit is not None and operation["cost"] > member.budget_limit:
                raise HTTPException(
                    status_code=409,
                    detail={
                        "message": "At least one member's stated hard budget limit would be exceeded.",
                        "item": operation["title"],
                    },
                )

    itinerary = _get_itinerary(db, trip)
    created_items: list[ItineraryItem] = []
    for operation in operations:
        if operation["op"] == "cancel":
            item = db.get(ItineraryItem, operation["item_id"])
            if item:
                item.status = "cancelled"
                item.updated_at = utcnow()
            continue
        item = ItineraryItem(
            itinerary_id=itinerary.id,
            trip_id=trip.id,
            day=operation["day"],
            start_time=operation["start_time"],
            title=operation["title"],
            activity_id=operation["activity_id"],
            place_id=operation["place_id"],
            notes=operation.get("notes"),
            cost_estimate=operation["cost"],
            created_by=user.id,
            sort_order=_next_sort_order(db, trip.id, operation["day"]),
        )
        db.add(item)
        created_items.append(item)

    proposal.status = "approved"
    proposal.decided_by = user.id
    proposal.decided_at = utcnow()
    db.add(
        ItineraryApproval(
            proposal_id=proposal.id, user_id=user.id, approval=True
        )
    )
    db.flush()
    record_itinerary_version(
        db, itinerary, user_id=user.id, note=f"Approved: {proposal.title}"
    )
    audit(
        db,
        action="proposal.approve",
        entity_type="itinerary_proposal",
        entity_id=proposal.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
    )
    notify_trip_members(
        db,
        trip,
        kind="proposal_approved",
        title=f"Approved: {proposal.title}",
        body=f"{user.display_name} confirmed the change with the group.",
        link=f"/trips/{trip.id}/itinerary",
        exclude_user_id=user.id,
    )
    total_delta = round(sum(operation.get("cost", 0) for operation in operations), 2)
    db.commit()
    await manager.broadcast(
        trip.id,
        event_payload(
            "proposal.approved",
            trip_id=trip.id,
            proposal_id=proposal.id,
            version=itinerary.confirmed_version,
        ),
    )
    return {
        **proposal_out(db, proposal, user.id),
        "confirmed_version": itinerary.confirmed_version,
        "created_items": _serialize_items(db, created_items, user.id),
        "cost_impact": {
            "total_delta": total_delta,
            "per_member_estimate": round(total_delta / max(1, len(members)), 2),
            "currency": trip.currency,
        },
    }


@router.post("/{trip_id}/proposals/{proposal_id}/reject")
async def reject_proposal(
    trip_id: str,
    proposal_id: str,
    reason: str | None = Query(default=None, max_length=500),
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user, ADMIN_ROLES)
    proposal = db.get(ItineraryProposal, proposal_id)
    if not proposal or proposal.trip_id != trip.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Proposal not found")
    if proposal.status != "open":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="This proposal is no longer open")
    proposal.status = "rejected"
    proposal.decided_by = user.id
    proposal.decided_at = utcnow()
    if reason:
        proposal.summary = f"{proposal.summary or ''}\nRejected: {reason}".strip()
    audit(
        db,
        action="proposal.reject",
        entity_type="itinerary_proposal",
        entity_id=proposal.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
        detail={"reason": reason},
    )
    notify_trip_members(
        db,
        trip,
        kind="proposal_rejected",
        title=f"Not this time: {proposal.title}",
        body=reason,
        link=f"/trips/{trip.id}/voting",
        exclude_user_id=user.id,
    )
    db.commit()
    await manager.broadcast(
        trip.id,
        event_payload("proposal.rejected", trip_id=trip.id, proposal_id=proposal.id),
    )
    return proposal_out(db, proposal, user.id)

#### Thinking

Concurrency:
- vote upsert without unique constraint race: two concurrent votes by same user could create duplicates if no unique constraint. Check model unique.
- approve: no lock. Two admins approve simultaneously: both read open, both apply, duplicate items. SQLite serializes writes but second read may happen before first commit; with async endpoints and one worker likely sequential? FastAPI async but DB blocking; requests could interleave only at awaits (none before commit). The route has no await until after commit, so on single uvicorn worker each request runs synchronously in threadpool? def endpoints run in threadpool, async endpoints run event loop; async approve has no await before DB commit, so single event loop serializes. With multiple workers/threads could race. Also SQLite write lock; on PostgreSQL real risk. Could add atomic conditional update / row lock. Phase 11 asks race conditions. We can test concurrent approvals on live SQLite and multi-worker maybe not.

- add_item `_next_sort_order` race duplicates sort_order but harmless (ordering ties).
- update item no optimistic concurrency; last-write-wins. "Conflicting itinerary changes" maybe expected last-write-wins? Could add version check? But changing contracts risky. At least test protected conflict and proposal conflict.

Potential authz issue in `remove_member`: only target membership status active; a member could remove themselves. Fine. But admin can remove another admin; expected.

Potential privacy issue: member_out may expose budget_limit/private notes to other members? Let's inspect serializers.

def member_out(db: Session, member: TripMember, viewer_id: str | None = None) -> dict:
    user = db.get(User, member.user_id) if member.user_id else None
    is_self = member.user_id == viewer_id
    data = {
        "id": member.id,
        "user": user_public(user),
        "display_name": user.display_name if user else (member.display_name or "Guest"),
        "role": member.role,
        "status": member.status,
        "joined_at": member.joined_at,
        "is_self": is_self,
    }
    # Budget limits and accessibility needs are private by default. They are
    # only surfaced back to their owner (F04/F32 privacy rule).
    if is_self:
        data["budget_limit"] = member.budget_limit
        data["accessibility_needs"] = member.accessibility_needs or []
    return data

ADMIN_ROLES = {"owner", "admin"}
MEDIA_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "storage"
MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES = 25 * 1024 * 1024
ALLOWED_MEDIA = {
    "image/jpeg": ".jpg",
    "image/png": ".png",
    "image/webp": ".webp",
    "video/mp4": ".mp4",
    "audio/webm": ".webm",
    "audio/mpeg": ".mp3",

def _trip(db, trip_id, user, roles=None):
    return get_trip_and_member(trip_id, db, user, roles)


def _naive_utc(value: datetime | None) -> datetime:
    if value is None:
        return utcnow()
    if value.tzinfo is None:
        return value
    return value.astimezone(timezone.utc).replace(tzinfo=None)


def _validate_memory_content(kind: str, text: str | None, media_url: str | None) -> None:
    if not text and not media_url:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=422,
            detail="A memory needs text or a media upload.",
        )
    if kind in {"photo", "video", "voice"} and not media_url:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=422,
            detail=f"A {kind} memory needs an uploaded media file.",
        )
    if media_url and not (
        media_url.startswith("/media/")
        or media_url.startswith("https://")
    ):
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=422,
            detail="Media must be an uploaded SAFAR file or an HTTPS URL.",
        )


def _memory_for_trip(db: Session, trip: Trip, memory_id: str, viewer_id: str) -> TripMemory:
    memory = db.get(TripMemory, memory_id)
    if not memory or memory.trip_id != trip.id or memory.deleted_at is not None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Memory not found")
    if not memory_service.can_view_memory(db, memory, viewer_id):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Memory not found")
    return memory

    trip_id: str,

):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    return memory_service.timeline(db, trip.id, user.id)


@router.post("/{trip_id}/memories", status_code=201)
def create_memory(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: MemoryCreate,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    _validate_memory_content(payload.kind, payload.text_content, payload.media_url)
    captured_at = _naive_utc(payload.captured_at)
    if captured_at > utcnow() + timedelta(minutes=5):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Capture time cannot be in the future")
    memory = TripMemory(
        trip_id=trip.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        kind=payload.kind,
        text_content=payload.text_content,
        media_url=canonical_media_url(payload.media_url),
        media_type=payload.media_type,
        caption=payload.caption,
        captured_at=captured_at,
        lat=payload.lat,
        lon=payload.lon,
        visibility=payload.visibility,
        ai_generated=False,
        approved=True,
    )
    db.add(memory)
    db.flush()
    audit(
        db,
        action="memory.create",
        entity_type="trip_memory",
        entity_id=memory.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
        detail={"kind": memory.kind, "visibility": memory.visibility},
    )
    notify_trip_members(
        db,
        trip,
        kind="memory_added",
        title=f"{user.display_name} added a memory",
        body="Photos, notes and voice memories stay visible only as each contributor allows."
        if payload.visibility == "trip"
        else None,
        link=f"/trips/{trip.id}/memories",
        exclude_user_id=user.id,
    )
    db.commit()
    return memory_out(memory, user)


@router.patch("/{trip_id}/memories/{memory_id}")
def update_memory(
    trip_id: str,
    memory_id: str,
    payload: MemoryUpdate,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    memory = db.get(TripMemory, memory_id)
    if not memory or memory.trip_id != trip.id or memory.deleted_at is not None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Memory not found")
    if memory.user_id != user.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Only the contributor can edit this memory")
    data = payload.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
    for field, value in data.items():
        setattr(memory, field, value)
    if "caption" in data:
        memory.ai_generated = False
    audit(
        db,
        action="memory.update",
        entity_type="trip_memory",
        entity_id=memory.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
        detail={"fields": list(data.keys())},
    )
    db.commit()
    return memory_out(memory, user)


@router.delete("/{trip_id}/memories/{memory_id}")
def delete_memory(
    trip_id: str,
    memory_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    memory = db.get(TripMemory, memory_id)
    if not memory or memory.trip_id != trip.id or memory.deleted_at is not None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Memory not found")
    if memory.user_id != user.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Only the contributor can delete this memory")
    memory.deleted_at = utcnow()
    db.query(MemoryPermission).filter(MemoryPermission.memory_id == memory.id).delete()
    audit(
        db,
        action="memory.delete",
        entity_type="trip_memory",
        entity_id=memory.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
    )
    db.commit()
    return {"ok": True, "note": "Removed from every shared view."}


@router.post("/{trip_id}/memories/{memory_id}/permissions")
def set_memory_permission(
    trip_id: str,
    memory_id: str,
    payload: MemoryPermissionIn,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    memory = db.get(TripMemory, memory_id)
    if not memory or memory.trip_id != trip.id or memory.deleted_at is not None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Memory not found")
    if memory.user_id != user.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Only the contributor controls this memory's permissions")
    target_member = (
        db.query(TripMember)
        .filter(
            TripMember.trip_id == trip.id,
            TripMember.user_id == payload.user_id,
            TripMember.status == "active",
        )
        .first()
    )
    if not target_member or payload.user_id == user.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Choose another active trip member")
    row = (
        db.query(MemoryPermission)
        .filter(
            MemoryPermission.memory_id == memory.id,
            MemoryPermission.user_id == payload.user_id,
        )
        .first()
    )
    if not row:
        row = MemoryPermission(memory_id=memory.id, user_id=payload.user_id)
        db.add(row)
    row.can_view = payload.can_view
    db.commit()
    return {"ok": True, "user_id": payload.user_id, "can_view": row.can_view}

@router.post("/{trip_id}/memory-events", status_code=201)
def create_event(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: MemoryEventCreate,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    start_at = _naive_utc(payload.start_at)
    end_at = _naive_utc(payload.end_at) if payload.end_at else None
    if end_at and end_at < start_at:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="End time must be after the start time")
    memory_ids = []
    for memory_id in payload.memory_ids:
        memory = _memory_for_trip(db, trip, memory_id, user.id)
        memory_ids.append(memory.id)
    event = MemoryEvent(
        trip_id=trip.id,
        title=payload.title,
        summary=payload.summary,
        start_at=start_at,
        end_at=end_at,
        member_ids=[user.id],
        memory_ids=memory_ids,
        status=payload.status,
        created_by=user.id,
    )
    db.add(event)
    audit(
        db,
        action="memory_event.create",
        entity_type="memory_event",
        entity_id=event.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
    )
    db.commit()
    return {
        "id": event.id,
        "title": event.title,
        "status": event.status,
        "memory_ids": event.memory_ids,
        "note": "Review AI-suggested events before approving them for the travel book.",
    }


@router.post("/{trip_id}/memory-events/{event_id}/approve")
def approve_event(
    trip_id: str,
    event_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    event = db.get(MemoryEvent, event_id)
    if not event or event.trip_id != trip.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Memory event not found")
    if event.created_by != user.id and member.role not in ADMIN_ROLES:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Only the creator or a trip admin can approve")
    event.status = "approved"
    audit(
        db,
        action="memory_event.approve",
        entity_type="memory_event",
        entity_id=event.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
    )
    db.commit()
    return {"ok": True, "status": event.status}

def _safe_media_url(url: str | None) -> str | None:
    if not url:
        return None
    if url.startswith("/media/") or url.startswith("https://"):
        return sign_media_url(url)
    return None


@router.get("/{trip_id}/travel-book")
def travel_book(
    trip_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    replay = memory_service.replay(db, trip, user.id)
    sections = []
    for day in replay["days"]:
        blocks = []
        for item in day["items"]:
            blocks.append(
                f"<li class='plan'>{escape(item['start_time'])} — {escape(item['title'])}</li>"
            )
        for memory in day["memories"]:
            media = _safe_media_url(memory.get("media_url"))
            media_html = ""
            if media:
                src = escape(media, quote=True)
                if memory["kind"] == "photo":
                    media_html = f"<img src='{src}' alt='{escape(memory.get('caption') or 'Trip memory', quote=True)}'>"
                elif memory["kind"] == "video":
                    media_html = f"<video controls src='{src}'></video>"
                elif memory["kind"] == "voice":
                    media_html = f"<audio controls src='{src}'></audio>"
            caption = memory.get("caption") if memory.get("approved") else None
            body = escape((caption or memory.get("text_content") or "")[:1200])
            author = escape((memory.get("author") or {}).get("display_name") or "Traveller")
            blocks.append(
                f"<figure class='memory'>{media_html}<figcaption>{body}"
                f"<span class='byline'>— {author}</span></figcaption></figure>"
            )
        for event in day["events"]:
            blocks.append(
                f"<h3 class='event'>{escape(event['title'])}</h3>"
                f"<p class='event-summary'>{escape(event.get('summary') or '')}</p>"
            )
        sections.append(
            f"<section><h2>{escape(day['date'])}</h2><ul>{''.join(blocks)}</ul></section>"
        )
    html = f"""<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8">
<title>{escape(trip.name)} — SAFAR travel book</title>
<style>
body{{font-family:Georgia,serif;max-width:760px;margin:40px auto;padding:0 20px;color:#1d1d1f;line-height:1.6}}
h1{{font-size:2.4rem;margin-bottom:.2rem}} .meta{{color:#666;margin-bottom:2rem}}
h2{{border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;padding-bottom:.4rem;margin-top:3rem}}
ul{{list-style:none;padding:0}} .plan{{padding:.3rem 0;color:#444}}
figure{{margin:1.2rem 0}} img,video{{max-width:100%;border-radius:8px}} audio{{width:100%}}
figcaption{{font-size:.95rem;margin-top:.4rem}} .byline{{display:block;color:#777;font-size:.85rem}}
.event{{margin:1.6rem 0 .2rem}} .event-summary{{color:#555;margin-top:0}}
footer{{margin-top:4rem;color:#777;font-size:.85rem}}
</style></head><body>
<h1>{escape(trip.name)}</h1>
<p class="meta">{escape(trip.destination_name or '')} · {trip.start_date} → {trip.end_date}</p>
{''.join(sections) or '<p>No recorded days yet.</p>'}
<footer>Generated by SAFAR journey replay. Only permitted media and approved captions are included.</footer>
</body></html>"""
    return HTMLResponse(content=html)

"""Memory timeline, Memory Studio suggestions and Journey Replay (F11, F12, F18)."""

from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.models import (
    Activity,
    ItineraryItem,
    MemoryEvent,
    MemoryPermission,
    Place,
    Trip,
    TripMemory,
    User,
)
from app.services.geo import haversine_km
from app.services.serializers import memory_out


def can_view_memory(db: Session, memory: TripMemory, viewer_id: str) -> bool:
    if memory.user_id == viewer_id:
        return True
    if memory.visibility == "private":
        permission = (
            db.query(MemoryPermission)
            .filter(
                MemoryPermission.memory_id == memory.id,
                MemoryPermission.user_id == viewer_id,
                MemoryPermission.can_view.is_(True),
            )
            .first()
        )
        return permission is not None
    return True


def visible_memories(db: Session, trip_id: str, viewer_id: str) -> list[TripMemory]:
    memories = (
        db.query(TripMemory)
        .filter(TripMemory.trip_id == trip_id, TripMemory.deleted_at.is_(None))
        .order_by(TripMemory.captured_at)
        .all()
    )
    return [memory for memory in memories if can_view_memory(db, memory, viewer_id)]


def visible_events(
    db: Session,
    trip_id: str,
    viewer_id: str,
    statuses: set[str] | None = None,
) -> list[MemoryEvent]:
    """Events are only visible when every memory they reference is visible.

    Otherwise an approved event would leak the title, timing and memory ids of
    a private memory to other trip members.
    """
    visible_ids = {memory.id for memory in visible_memories(db, trip_id, viewer_id)}
    query = db.query(MemoryEvent).filter(MemoryEvent.trip_id == trip_id)
    if statuses:
        query = query.filter(MemoryEvent.status.in_(statuses))
    events = query.order_by(MemoryEvent.start_at).all()
    return [
        event
        for event in events
        if all(memory_id in visible_ids for memory_id in (event.memory_ids or []))
    ]


def timeline(db: Session, trip_id: str, viewer_id: str) -> dict:
    memories = visible_memories(db, trip_id, viewer_id)
    authors = {user.id: user for user in db.query(User).all()}
    days: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
    for memory in memories:
        payload = memory_out(memory, authors.get(memory.user_id))
        days.setdefault(memory.captured_at.date().isoformat(), []).append(payload)
    return {
        "days": [
            {"date": day, "memories": entries}
            for day, entries in sorted(days.items(), reverse=True)
        ],
        "total": len(memories),
        "permissions": "Private memories are only visible to their owner and explicitly permitted members.",
    }


def _nearby_item(
    db: Session, trip_id: str, captured_at: datetime, lat: float | None, lon: float | None
) -> ItineraryItem | None:
    items = (
        db.query(ItineraryItem)
        .filter(
            ItineraryItem.trip_id == trip_id,
            ItineraryItem.day == captured_at.date(),
            ItineraryItem.status == "confirmed",
        )
        .all()
    )
    if not items:
        return None
    if lat is not None and lon is not None:
        best = None
        best_distance = 1.0
        for item in items:
            if not item.activity_id:
                continue
            activity = db.get(Activity, item.activity_id)
            place = db.get(Place, activity.place_id) if activity and activity.place_id else None
            if not place:
                continue
            distance = haversine_km(lat, lon, place.lat, place.lon)
            if distance < best_distance:
                best_distance = distance
                best = item
        if best:
            return best
    target_minutes = captured_at.hour * 60 + captured_at.minute
    for item in items:
        try:
            hours, minutes = item.start_time.split(":")
            start = int(hours) * 60 + int(minutes)
        except ValueError:
            continue
        if abs(start - target_minutes) <= 90:
            return item
    return None


def suggest_events(db: Session, trip: Trip, user_id: str) -> list[MemoryEvent]:
    memories = visible_memories(db, trip.id, user_id)
    sessions: list[list[TripMemory]] = []
    for memory in memories:
        if sessions and (memory.captured_at - sessions[-1][-1].captured_at) <= timedelta(hours=3):
            sessions[-1].append(memory)
        else:
            sessions.append([memory])

    existing = db.query(MemoryEvent).filter(MemoryEvent.trip_id == trip.id).all()
    existing_sets = {frozenset(event.memory_ids or []) for event in existing}
    created = []
    for session in sessions:
        memory_ids = [memory.id for memory in session]
        if frozenset(memory_ids) in existing_sets:
            continue
        first = session[0]
        nearby = _nearby_item(db, trip.id, first.captured_at, first.lat, first.lon)
        title = (
            f"Moments around {nearby.title}"
            if nearby
            else f"Moments on {first.captured_at.strftime('%b %d')}"
        )
        contributors = {memory.user_id for memory in session}
        summary = (
            f"{len(session)} memories from {first.captured_at.strftime('%H:%M')} "
            f"to {session[-1].captured_at.strftime('%H:%M')} contributed by "
            f"{len(contributors)} member(s)."
        )
        event = MemoryEvent(
            trip_id=trip.id,
            title=title,
            summary=summary,
            start_at=first.captured_at,
            end_at=session[-1].captured_at,
            member_ids=sorted(contributors),
            memory_ids=memory_ids,
            status="suggested",
            created_by=user_id,
        )
        db.add(event)
        created.append(event)
    return created


def caption_suggestion(db: Session, trip: Trip, memory: TripMemory) -> dict:
    nearby = _nearby_item(db, trip.id, memory.captured_at, memory.lat, memory.lon)
    parts = []
    if memory.text_content:
        parts.append(memory.text_content.strip()[:180])
    if nearby:
        parts.append(f"Captured during {nearby.title}.")
    else:
        parts.append(
            f"Captured on {memory.captured_at.strftime('%B %d at %H:%M')}."
        )
    if memory.kind in {"photo", "video"}:
        parts.append(f"Shared by the traveller who uploaded this {memory.kind}.")
    suggestion = " ".join(parts)
    return {
        "memory_id": memory.id,
        "suggestion": suggestion,
        "ai_generated": False,
        "generator": "template",
        "approved": False,
        "grounding": "Template built from the upload time, optional location and the confirmed itinerary. No people, feelings or places are invented.",
        "disclosure": "A plain template, not AI-generated text. Review before publishing; nothing is approved until you accept it.",
    }


def replay(db: Session, trip: Trip, viewer_id: str) -> dict:
    items = (
        db.query(ItineraryItem)
        .filter(ItineraryItem.trip_id == trip.id, ItineraryItem.status == "confirmed")
        .order_by(ItineraryItem.day, ItineraryItem.start_time)
        .all()
    )
    memories = visible_memories(db, trip.id, viewer_id)
    approved_events = visible_events(db, trip.id, viewer_id, statuses={"approved"})
    authors = {user.id: user for user in db.query(User).all()}
    by_day: dict[str, dict] = {}
    for item in items:
        day = item.day.isoformat()
        by_day.setdefault(
            day,
            {"date": day, "items": [], "memories": [], "events": [], "captions": []},
        )["items"].append(
            {"id": item.id, "title": item.title, "start_time": item.start_time, "protected": item.is_protected}
        )
    for memory in memories:
        day = memory.captured_at.date().isoformat()
        by_day.setdefault(
            day,
            {"date": day, "items": [], "memories": [], "events": [], "captions": []},
        )["memories"].append(memory_out(memory, authors.get(memory.user_id)))
        if memory.caption and memory.approved:

                    "summary": event.summary,
                    "memory_ids": event.memory_ids,
                }
            )
    days = sorted(by_day.values(), key=lambda entry: entry["date"])
    total_media = sum(
        1 for memory in memories if memory.kind in {"photo", "video", "voice"}
    )
    return {
        "trip": {
            "id": trip.id,
            "name": trip.name,
            "destination": trip.destination_name,
            "start_date": trip.start_date,
            "end_date": trip.end_date,
        },
        "days": days,
        "stats": {
            "days_recorded": len(days),
            "memories": len(memories),
            "media": total_media,
            "approved_events": len(approved_events),
            "contributors": len({memory.user_id for memory in memories}),
        },

--- media service ---
"""Signed media URLs.

Trip media is private by default. Files are only served with a short-lived
HMAC signature that is issued to authenticated trip members through API
responses. The previous unauthenticated StaticFiles mount let anyone with a
URL read private photos, including memories marked private.
"""

import hashlib
import hmac
import time
from urllib.parse import urlsplit, urlunsplit

from app.core.config import settings

MEDIA_TTL_SECONDS = 12 * 60 * 60


def _signature(path: str, expires: int) -> str:
    message = f"{path}:{expires}".encode("utf-8")
    return hmac.new(
        settings.secret_key.encode("utf-8"), message, hashlib.sha256
    ).hexdigest()


def canonical_media_url(url: str | None) -> str | None:
    """Strip any signature so only the stored path is persisted."""
    if not url or not url.startswith("/media/"):
        return url
    parts = urlsplit(url)
    return urlunsplit((parts.scheme, parts.netloc, parts.path, "", ""))


def sign_media_url(url: str | None, ttl: int = MEDIA_TTL_SECONDS) -> str | None:
    if not url or not url.startswith("/media/"):
        return url
    path = canonical_media_url(url)
    assert path is not None
    expires = int(time.time()) + ttl
    separator = "&" if "?" in path else "?"
    return f"{path}{separator}exp={expires}&sig={_signature(path, expires)}"


def verify_media_request(path: str, query: dict[str, str]) -> bool:
    try:
        expires = int(query.get("exp", "0"))
    except ValueError:
        return False
    signature = query.get("sig", "")
    if not signature or expires < int(time.time()):
        return False
    return hmac.compare_digest(signature, _signature(path, expires))


def media_matches_type(content_type: str, head: bytes) -> bool:
    """Check the file signature instead of trusting the client's MIME type."""
    if content_type == "image/jpeg":
        return head[:3] == b"\xff\xd8\xff"
    if content_type == "image/png":
        return head[:8] == b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"
    if content_type == "image/webp":
        return head[:4] == b"RIFF" and head[8:12] == b"WEBP"
    if content_type == "video/mp4":
        return head[4:8] == b"ftyp"
    if content_type == "audio/webm":
        return head[:4] == b"\x1aE\xdf\xa3"
    if content_type == "audio/mpeg":
        return head[:3] == b"ID3" or (len(head) >= 2 and head[0] == 0xFF and head[1] & 0xE0 == 0xE0)
    if content_type == "audio/ogg":
        return head[:4] == b"OggS"
    if content_type == "audio/wav":
        return head[:4] == b"RIFF" and head[8:12] == b"WAVE"
    return False

"""Group expenses, balances and settlement suggestions (F13)."""

from datetime import date

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query, Response
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.core.deps import get_current_user, get_db, get_trip_and_member
from app.core.realtime import manager
from app.models import Expense, ExpenseParticipant, TripMember, User
from app.models.models import utcnow
from app.schemas.schemas import ExpenseCreate
from app.services import expenses as expense_service
from app.services.common import audit, event_payload, notify_trip_members
from app.services.serializers import expense_out

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/trips", tags=["expenses"])

ADMIN_ROLES = {"owner", "admin"}


def _trip(db, trip_id, user, roles=None):
    return get_trip_and_member(trip_id, db, user, roles)


def _member_user_ids(db: Session, trip_id: str) -> set[str]:
    rows = (
        db.query(TripMember.user_id)
        .filter(
            TripMember.trip_id == trip_id,
            TripMember.status == "active",
            TripMember.user_id.isnot(None),
        )
        .all()
    )
    return {row[0] for row in rows}


def _serialize(db: Session, expenses: list[Expense]) -> list[dict]:
    return [
        expense_out(db, expense, expense_service.participant_rows(db, expense.id))
        for expense in expenses
    ]


@router.get("/{trip_id}/expenses")
def list_expenses(
    trip_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    rows = (
        db.query(Expense)
        .filter(Expense.trip_id == trip.id, Expense.deleted_at.is_(None))
        .order_by(Expense.incurred_on.desc(), Expense.created_at.desc())
        .all()
    )
    data = _serialize(db, rows)
    return {
        "items": data,
        "totals": {
            "spent": round(sum(expense.amount for expense in rows), 2),
            "count": len(rows),
            "currency": trip.currency,
            "trip_budget": trip.budget_total,
            "remaining": (
                round(trip.budget_total - sum(expense.amount for expense in rows), 2)
                if trip.budget_total
                else None
            ),
        },
    }


@router.post("/{trip_id}/expenses", status_code=201)
async def create_expense(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: ExpenseCreate,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    if payload.currency and payload.currency != trip.currency:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=422,
            detail=f"Expenses must use the trip currency ({trip.currency}).",
        )
    payer = payload.paid_by or user.id
    active_ids = _member_user_ids(db, trip.id)
    if payer not in active_ids:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="The payer must be an active trip member")

    participants = [
        participant.model_dump() for participant in payload.participants
    ]
    if not participants:
        participants = [
            {"user_id": member_id, "weight": 1.0, "share_amount": None}
            for member_id in active_ids
        ]
    for participant in participants:
        participant_id = participant.get("user_id")
        if participant_id and participant_id not in active_ids:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=422,
                detail="Every participating user must be an active trip member",
            )
        if not participant_id and not participant.get("guest_name"):
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=422,
                detail="A participant needs either a member or a guest name",
            )

    try:
        resolved = expense_service.resolve_shares(payload.amount, participants, payload.split)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=str(exc))

    expense = Expense(
        trip_id=trip.id,
        title=payload.title,
        category=payload.category,
        amount=payload.amount,
        currency=trip.currency,
        paid_by=payer,
        incurred_on=payload.incurred_on or date.today(),
        notes=payload.notes,
        created_by=user.id,
    )
    db.add(expense)
    db.flush()
    for participant in resolved:
        db.add(
            ExpenseParticipant(
                expense_id=expense.id,
                user_id=participant.get("user_id"),
                guest_name=participant.get("guest_name"),
                weight=participant["weight"],
                share_amount=participant["share_amount"],
            )
        )
    audit(
        db,
        action="expense.create",
        entity_type="expense",
        entity_id=expense.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
        detail={"amount": expense.amount, "category": expense.category},
    )
    notify_trip_members(
        db,
        trip,
        kind="expense_added",
        title=f"New expense: {expense.title}",
        body=f"{expense.amount:.2f} {expense.currency} paid by {user.display_name}.",
        link=f"/trips/{trip.id}/expenses",
        exclude_user_id=user.id,
    )
    db.commit()
    await manager.broadcast(
        trip.id, event_payload("expenses.updated", trip_id=trip.id)
    )
    return expense_out(db, expense, expense_service.participant_rows(db, expense.id))


@router.delete("/{trip_id}/expenses/{expense_id}")
async def delete_expense(
    trip_id: str,
    expense_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    expense = db.get(Expense, expense_id)
    if not expense or expense.trip_id != trip.id or expense.deleted_at is not None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Expense not found")
    if expense.created_by != user.id and member.role not in ADMIN_ROLES:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=403, detail="Only the author or a trip admin can delete an expense"
        )
    expense.deleted_at = utcnow()
    audit(
        db,
        action="expense.delete",
        entity_type="expense",
        entity_id=expense.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
    )
    db.commit()
    await manager.broadcast(
        trip.id, event_payload("expenses.updated", trip_id=trip.id)
    )
    return {"ok": True, "note": "Removed from balances and settlement suggestions."}


@router.get("/{trip_id}/expenses/balances")
def get_balances(
    trip_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    return expense_service.balances(db, trip)


@router.get("/{trip_id}/expenses/export")
def export_expenses(
    trip_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    csv_body = expense_service.expenses_csv(db, trip)
    safe_name = "".join(
        character if character.isalnum() or character in "-_" else "-"
        for character in trip.name.lower()
    ).strip("-") or "trip"
    return Response(
        content=csv_body,
        media_type="text/csv; charset=utf-8",
        headers={
            "Content-Disposition": f'attachment; filename="{safe_name}-expenses.csv"'
        },
    )

"""Trip workspace WebSocket channel for collaborative updates (F05).

Browsers cannot set Authorization headers on WebSocket handshakes, so the
short-lived access token is passed as a query parameter and verified before
the connection is accepted. Membership is re-checked on every connection.
"""

from fastapi import APIRouter, Query, WebSocket, WebSocketDisconnect

from app.core.realtime import manager
from app.core.security import decode_token
from app.db.context import set_user_context
from app.db.session import SessionLocal
from app.models import Trip, TripMember, User
from app.services.auth_sessions import session_is_active
from app.services.common import event_payload

router = APIRouter()


@router.websocket("/ws/trips/{trip_id}")
async def trip_socket(
    websocket: WebSocket,
    trip_id: str,
    token: str = Query(..., min_length=20),
):
    payload = decode_token(token, "ws") or decode_token(token, "access")
    if not payload or not payload.get("sub"):
        await websocket.close(code=4401)
        return

    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        set_user_context(db, payload["sub"])
        user = db.get(User, payload["sub"])
        if not user or not user.is_active or user.deleted_at:
            await websocket.close(code=4401)
            return
        session_id = payload.get("sid")
        if session_id and not session_is_active(db, session_id, user.id):
            await websocket.close(code=4401)
            return
        trip = db.get(Trip, trip_id)
        if not trip or trip.deleted_at:
            await websocket.close(code=4404)
            return
        member = (
            db.query(TripMember)
            .filter(
                TripMember.trip_id == trip.id,
                TripMember.user_id == user.id,
                TripMember.status == "active",
            )
            .first()
        )
        if not member:
            await websocket.close(code=4404)
            return
        display_name = user.display_name
    finally:
        db.close()

    await manager.connect(trip_id, websocket)
    await websocket.send_json(
        event_payload(
            "connected",
            trip_id=trip_id,
            user=display_name,
            note="Live updates for this trip workspace only.",
        )
    )
    try:
        while True:
            message = await websocket.receive_text()
            if message.strip().lower() == "ping":
                await websocket.send_json(event_payload("pong", trip_id=trip_id))
    except WebSocketDisconnect:
        pass
    finally:
        await manager.disconnect(trip_id, websocket)

import asyncio
from collections import defaultdict
from typing import Any

from fastapi import WebSocket


class TripConnectionManager:
    """In-process pub/sub for trip workspaces.

    A single-process implementation keeps the reference deployment simple.
    For multi-instance deployments swap this for Redis pub/sub behind the
    same `broadcast` interface (documented in README).
    """

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._connections: dict[str, set[WebSocket]] = defaultdict(set)
        self._lock = asyncio.Lock()

    async def connect(self, trip_id: str, socket: WebSocket) -> None:
        await socket.accept()
        async with self._lock:
            self._connections[trip_id].add(socket)

    async def disconnect(self, trip_id: str, socket: WebSocket) -> None:
        async with self._lock:
            self._connections[trip_id].discard(socket)
            if not self._connections[trip_id]:
                self._connections.pop(trip_id, None)

    async def broadcast(self, trip_id: str, event: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        async with self._lock:
            sockets = list(self._connections.get(trip_id, ()))
        for socket in sockets:
            try:
                await socket.send_json(event)
            except Exception:
                await self.disconnect(trip_id, socket)


manager = TripConnectionManager()

Potential WS issue: manager.broadcast serializes sends; a slow socket blocks all sends in that request. Disconnect on failure. Acceptable.

WS membership re-check only at connection, not on every event. If member removed, their existing socket stays connected and continues receiving events! That's a real privacy bug: member removal event broadcast includes only member_id, but removed member's socket still receives all future events (itinerary titles, expenses). Requirement "role changes and member removal" and privacy. Need test. We can fix by tracking user_id with websocket and re-checking on broadcast or disconnect removed member. Restructure manager connections to store (socket, user_id, trip_id) and on member removal broadcast then close socket. Simpler: on `member.removed`, manager.disconnect_user(trip_id, user_id) and close socket. Need know user_id target. remove_member has target.user_id. Also when owner transfer/leave? role change less. import os
import sys
import tempfile
from contextlib import contextmanager
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

API_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(API_ROOT))

_TMP = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="safar-tests-"))
_pg_url = os.environ.get("SAFAR_TEST_DATABASE_URL")
os.environ["DATABASE_URL"] = _pg_url or f"sqlite:///{(_TMP / 'safar-test.db').as_posix()}"
os.environ["SAFAR_SEED"] = "1"
os.environ["ENVIRONMENT"] = "test"
os.environ["SECRET_KEY"] = "test-only-secret-never-use-outside-tests"
os.environ["RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE"] = "100000"
os.environ["AUTH_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE"] = "100000"
os.environ["COMPANION_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE"] = "100000"
os.environ["UPLOAD_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE"] = "100000"
os.environ["CORS_ORIGINS"] = "http://localhost:3000"


def _reset_postgres() -> None:
    """Drop and rebuild the PG schema, then apply the real migrations."""
    import psycopg

    with psycopg.connect(_pg_url.replace("postgresql+psycopg://", "postgresql://")) as conn:
        conn.execute("DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS public CASCADE")
        conn.execute("CREATE SCHEMA public")
        conn.commit()

    from alembic import command
    from alembic.config import Config

    cfg = Config(str(API_ROOT / "alembic.ini"))
    cfg.set_main_option("script_location", str(API_ROOT / "migrations"))
    command.upgrade(cfg, "head")


if _pg_url:
    if not _pg_url.startswith("postgresql+psycopg://"):
        raise SystemExit("SAFAR_TEST_DATABASE_URL must use postgresql+psycopg://")
    if os.environ.get("SAFAR_TEST_PREPARED") == "1":
        # Prepared mode connects as the non-owner application role. Schema,
        # grants and RLS policies were applied beforehand by the runner.
        os.environ["SAFAR_CREATE_SCHEMA"] = "0"
    else:
        _reset_postgres()

def system_db():

    from app.db.context import system_context

    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        with system_context(db):

@router.get("/{trip_id}/sync")
def list_sync_queue(
    trip_id: str,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    rows = (
        db.query(OfflineSyncQueue)
        .filter(OfflineSyncQueue.trip_id == trip.id, OfflineSyncQueue.user_id == user.id)
        .order_by(OfflineSyncQueue.created_at.desc())
        .limit(100)
        .all()
    )
    return {
        "items": [
            {
                "client_id": row.client_id,
                "operation": row.operation,
                "status": row.status,
                "applied_at": row.applied_at,
                "created_at": row.created_at,
            }
            for row in rows
        ]
    }


@router.post("/{trip_id}/sync")
def sync_offline(
    trip_id: str,
    payload: list[OfflineSyncItem],
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    if len(payload) > 100:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Sync at most 100 items per request")
    results = []
    applied = 0
    skipped = 0
    rejected = 0
    for entry in payload:
        existing = (
            db.query(OfflineSyncQueue)
            .filter(OfflineSyncQueue.client_id == entry.client_id)
            .first()
        )
        if existing:
            if existing.user_id != user.id or existing.trip_id != trip.id:
                rejected += 1
                results.append(
                    {"client_id": entry.client_id, "status": "rejected", "reason": "Client id conflict"}
                )
            elif existing.operation != entry.operation or existing.payload != entry.payload:
                rejected += 1
                results.append(
                    {
                        "client_id": entry.client_id,
                        "status": "rejected",
                        "reason": "Client id reused with different content",
                    }
                )
            else:
                skipped += 1
                results.append(
                    {"client_id": entry.client_id, "status": existing.status, "id": None}
                )
            continue
        try:
            memory_payload = MemoryCreate(**entry.payload)
        except ValidationError as exc:
            rejected += 1
            results.append(
                {
                    "client_id": entry.client_id,
                    "status": "rejected",
                    "reason": "Invalid payload",
                    "errors": exc.errors(include_url=False),
                }
            )
            continue
        _validate_memory_content(
            memory_payload.kind, memory_payload.text_content, memory_payload.media_url
        )
        captured_at = _naive_utc(memory_payload.captured_at)
        memory = TripMemory(
            trip_id=trip.id,
            user_id=user.id,
            kind=memory_payload.kind,
            text_content=memory_payload.text_content,
            media_url=canonical_media_url(memory_payload.media_url),
            media_type=memory_payload.media_type,
            caption=memory_payload.caption,
            captured_at=captured_at,
            lat=memory_payload.lat,
            lon=memory_payload.lon,
            visibility=memory_payload.visibility,
        )
        db.add(memory)
        db.flush()
        db.add(
            OfflineSyncQueue(
                user_id=user.id,
                trip_id=trip.id,
                client_id=entry.client_id,
                operation=entry.operation,
                payload=entry.payload,
                status="applied",
                applied_at=utcnow(),
            )
        )
        applied += 1
        results.append(
            {"client_id": entry.client_id, "status": "applied", "id": memory.id}
        )
    audit(
        db,
        action="offline.sync",
        entity_type="trip",
        entity_id=trip.id,
        user_id=user.id,
        trip_id=trip.id,
        detail={"applied": applied, "skipped": skipped, "rejected": rejected},
    )
    db.commit()
    return {
        "applied": applied,
        "skipped": skipped,
        "rejected": rejected,
        "results": results,
        "note": "Client ids make retries idempotent. Nothing is overwritten silently.",
    }

"""Per-IP sliding-window rate limiting.

Single-process in-memory limiter: adequate for one API instance. Horizontal
scaling needs a shared limiter at the gateway or a Redis-backed limiter; both
are documented in DEPLOYMENT.md. Health endpoints are exempt so probes never
consume the budget.
"""

import time
from collections import defaultdict, deque

from starlette.middleware.base import BaseHTTPMiddleware
from starlette.requests import Request
from starlette.responses import JSONResponse

from .config import settings

WINDOW_SECONDS = 60.0
MAX_TRACKED_CLIENTS = 20_000
EXEMPT_PATHS = {"/api/health", "/api/ready", "/api/openapi.json"}


def _client_ip(request: Request) -> str:
    if settings.trust_proxy_headers:
        forwarded = request.headers.get("x-forwarded-for")
        if forwarded:
            candidate = forwarded.split(",")[0].strip()
            if candidate:
                return candidate
    return request.client.host if request.client else "unknown"


def _bucket_for(path: str, method: str) -> tuple[str, int]:
    if path in {"/api/auth/login", "/api/auth/register", "/api/auth/refresh", "/api/auth/logout"}:
        return "auth", settings.auth_rate_limit_per_minute
    if path.startswith("/api/companion/") and path.endswith("/respond") and method == "POST":
        return "companion", settings.companion_rate_limit_per_minute
    if method == "POST" and (
        path.endswith("/media") or path.endswith("/memories") or path.endswith("/sync")
    ):
        return "upload", settings.upload_rate_limit_per_minute
    return "default", settings.rate_limit_per_minute


class RateLimitMiddleware(BaseHTTPMiddleware):
    def __init__(self, app):
        super().__init__(app)
        self._hits: dict[tuple[str, str], deque[float]] = defaultdict(deque)

    def _trim(self, now: float) -> None:
        if len(self._hits) <= MAX_TRACKED_CLIENTS:
            return
        for key in [key for key, window in self._hits.items() if not window]:
            self._hits.pop(key, None)
        while len(self._hits) > MAX_TRACKED_CLIENTS:
            self._hits.pop(next(iter(self._hits)))

    async def dispatch(self, request: Request, call_next):
        path = request.url.path
        if not path.startswith("/api") or request.method == "OPTIONS" or path in EXEMPT_PATHS:
            return await call_next(request)

        now = time.monotonic()
        bucket, limit = _bucket_for(path, request.method)
        key = (_client_ip(request), bucket)
        window = self._hits[key]
        while window and now - window[0] > WINDOW_SECONDS:
            window.popleft()
        if len(window) >= limit:
            retry_after = max(1, int(WINDOW_SECONDS - (now - window[0])) + 1)
            return JSONResponse(
                status_code=429,
                headers={"Retry-After": str(retry_after)},
                content={"detail": "Too many requests. Please slow down."},
            )
        window.append(now)
        self._trim(now)
        return await call_next(request)

"""Cross-cutting HTTP hardening: request correlation, headers, body limits."""

import json
import logging
import re
import time
import uuid

from starlette.types import ASGIApp, Message, Receive, Scope, Send

from app.core.config import settings
from app.core.logging import redact_path, request_id_var
from app.core.security import hash_client_ip

REQUEST_ID_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{8,64}$")
REQUEST_ID_HEADER = settings.request_id_header.lower().encode()
access_logger = logging.getLogger("safar.access")
error_logger = logging.getLogger("safar.error")

SECURITY_HEADERS = [
    (b"x-content-type-options", b"nosniff"),
    (b"x-frame-options", b"DENY"),
    (b"referrer-policy", b"no-referrer"),
    (
        b"permissions-policy",
        b"geolocation=(self), camera=(), microphone=(), payment=(), usb=()",
    ),
    (b"cross-origin-opener-policy", b"same-origin"),
    (b"cross-origin-resource-policy", b"same-site"),
    (
        b"content-security-policy",
        b"default-src 'none'; img-src 'self' data:; media-src 'self'; "
        b"style-src 'unsafe-inline'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'self'; "
        b"frame-ancestors 'none'",
    ),
]

DOC_PATHS = ("/api/docs", "/api/openapi.json")


def _request_id(scope: Scope) -> str:
    for key, value in scope.get("headers", []):
        if key == REQUEST_ID_HEADER:
            candidate = value.decode("latin-1").strip()
            if REQUEST_ID_PATTERN.match(candidate):
                return candidate
    return uuid.uuid4().hex


class RequestContextMiddleware:
    """Outermost user middleware: request id, access log and safe errors."""

    def __init__(self, app: ASGIApp) -> None:
        self.app = app

    async def __call__(self, scope: Scope, receive: Receive, send: Send) -> None:
        if scope["type"] != "http":
            await self.app(scope, receive, send)
            return

        request_id = _request_id(scope)
        token = request_id_var.set(request_id)
        path = scope.get("path", "")
        method = scope.get("method", "")
        client = scope.get("client")
        client_hash = hash_client_ip(client[0])[:16] if client else "-"
        started = time.perf_counter()
        state = {"status": 500, "started": False}

        async def send_wrapper(message: Message) -> None:
            if message["type"] == "http.response.start":
                state["started"] = True
                state["status"] = message["status"]
                headers = list(message.get("headers", []))
                present = {key.lower() for key, _ in headers}
                headers.append((b"x-request-id", request_id.encode()))
                for key, value in SECURITY_HEADERS:
                    is_doc = any(path.startswith(prefix) for prefix in DOC_PATHS)
                    if key == b"content-security-policy" and is_doc:
                        continue
                    if key not in present:
                        headers.append((key, value))
                if path.startswith("/api") and b"cache-control" not in present:
                    headers.append((b"cache-control", b"no-store"))
                elif path.startswith("/media/") and b"cache-control" not in present:
                    headers.append((b"cache-control", b"private, no-store"))
                if settings.is_production and scope.get("scheme") == "https":
                    if b"strict-transport-security" not in present:
                        headers.append(
                            (
                                b"strict-transport-security",
                                b"max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains",
                            )
                        )
                message = {**message, "headers": headers}
            await send(message)

        try:
            await self.app(scope, receive, send_wrapper)
        except Exception:
            error_logger.exception(
                "unhandled_error",
                extra={"method": method, "path": redact_path(path), "client": client_hash},
            )
            if not state["started"]:
                payload = json.dumps(
                    {
                        "detail": "Internal server error",
                        "request_id": request_id,
                    }
                ).encode()
                await send(
                    {
                        "type": "http.response.start",
                        "status": 500,
                        "headers": [
                            (b"content-type", b"application/json"),
                            (b"content-length", str(len(payload)).encode()),
                            (b"x-request-id", request_id.encode()),
                        ],
                    }
                )
                await send({"type": "http.response.body", "body": payload})
            state["status"] = state["status"] if state["started"] else 500
        finally:
            duration_ms = round((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000, 2)
            access_logger.info(
                "request",
                extra={
                    "method": method,
                    "path": redact_path(path),
                    "status": state["status"],
                    "duration_ms": duration_ms,
                    "client": client_hash,
                },
            )
            request_id_var.reset(token)


class BodyTooLarge(Exception):
    pass


class BodySizeLimitMiddleware:
    """Reject oversized bodies before they reach application code."""

    def __init__(self, app: ASGIApp, max_bytes: int | None = None) -> None:
        self.app = app
        self.max_bytes = max_bytes or settings.max_request_bytes

    async def __call__(self, scope: Scope, receive: Receive, send: Send) -> None:
        if scope["type"] != "http":
            await self.app(scope, receive, send)
            return

        headers = {key.lower(): value for key, value in scope.get("headers", [])}
        declared = headers.get(b"content-length")
        if declared:
            try:
                if int(declared) > self.max_bytes:
                    await self._reject(send)
                    return
            except ValueError:
                await self._reject(send)
                return

        received = 0
        response_started = False

        async def limited_receive() -> Message:
            nonlocal received
            message = await receive()
            if message["type"] == "http.request":
                received += len(message.get("body", b""))
                if received > self.max_bytes:
                    raise BodyTooLarge()
            return message

        async def tracking_send(message: Message) -> None:
            nonlocal response_started
            if message["type"] == "http.response.start":
                response_started = True
            await send(message)

        try:
            await self.app(scope, limited_receive, tracking_send)
        except BodyTooLarge:
            if not response_started:
                await self._reject(send)

    async def _reject(self, send: Send) -> None:
        payload = json.dumps({"detail": "Request body too large"}).encode()
        await send(
            {
                "type": "http.response.start",
                "status": 413,
                "headers": [
                    (b"content-type", b"application/json"),
                    (b"content-length", str(len(payload)).encode()),
                ],
            }
        )
        await send({"type": "http.response.body", "body": payload})

    The token itself is never stored: it is an HMAC over the link id, expiry,
    purpose and target. Responses are anonymous by design and are recorded
    separately so no traveller identity is attached to them.
    """

    __tablename__ = "companion_links"

@router.get("/{trip_id}/activity")
def trip_activity(
    trip_id: str,
    limit: int = Query(default=30, ge=1, le=100),
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = _trip(db, trip_id, user)
    rows = (
        db.query(AuditLog)
        .filter(AuditLog.trip_id == trip.id)
        .order_by(AuditLog.created_at.desc())
        .limit(limit)
        .all()
    )
    return {
        "items": [
            {
                "id": row.id,
                "action": row.action,
                "entity_type": row.entity_type,
                "entity_id": row.entity_id,
                "detail": row.detail,
                "created_at": row.created_at,
            }
            for row in rows
        ]
    }

def test_realtime_broadcasts_pulse_updates_to_other_members(client, mira, aiko, kyoto):
    trip_id = kyoto["id"]
    token_mira = mira["Authorization"].split(" ", 1)[1]
    token_aiko = aiko["Authorization"].split(" ", 1)[1]
    with client.websocket_connect(
        f"/ws/trips/{trip_id}?token={token_mira}"
    ) as socket_mira, client.websocket_connect(
        f"/ws/trips/{trip_id}?token={token_aiko}"
    ) as socket_aiko:
        assert socket_mira.receive_json()["event"] == "connected"
        assert socket_aiko.receive_json()["event"] == "connected"

        updated = client.put(
            f"/api/trips/{trip_id}/pulse",
            headers=aiko,
            json={"energy": 4, "interests": ["food"], "available_minutes": 240},
        )
        assert updated.status_code == 200, updated.text

        event_mira = socket_mira.receive_json()
        event_aiko = socket_aiko.receive_json()
        assert event_mira["event"] == "pulse.updated"
        assert event_aiko["event"] == "pulse.updated"
        assert event_mira["trip_id"] == trip_id

from datetime import date

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.core.deps import get_current_user, get_db, get_trip_and_member
from app.models import User
from app.services.opportunity import clock

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/trips", tags=["opportunity"])


@router.get("/{trip_id}/opportunity-clock")
def opportunity_clock(
    trip_id: str,
    on: date | None = Query(default=None),
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    trip, _member = get_trip_and_member(trip_id, db, user)
    target = on or (date.today() if trip.start_date <= date.today() <= trip.end_date else trip.start_date)
    if target < trip.start_date or target > trip.end_date:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=422,
            detail="Chosen date is outside this trip's dates",
        )
    return clock(db, trip, target)
